An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether a financial gap threatens status holders now that COA no longer applies for their benefit allowances, and what support municipalities will receive. The minister replied that status holders remain responsible for their own allowance applications, that the COA's support service ended on 1 January 2025, and that alternative help exists, while acknowledging no national figures on resulting arrears are available.
No national figures are available on the number of status holders who build up payment arrears due to delays in obtaining allowances.
Er zijn geen landelijke cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal statushouders dat betalingsachterstanden oploopt door vertraging bij het verkrijgen van toeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over adviezen van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State naar de media zijn gelekt

An MP asked the Asylum and Migration Minister whether leaks of Raad van State advisory opinions to the media were unusual, whether only the ministry received the opinions, and whether the leak would be reported to the police. The minister said the leaked content was unusual and undesirable but declined to qualify it as criminal, said no criminal complaint would be filed for lack of grounds, and noted the opinions were later published by the Raad van State on schedule.
I consider it undesirable when statements are made about Raad van State advisory opinions before they are made public by the Raad van State.
Ik vind het onwenselijk wanneer mededelingen worden gedaan over adviezen van de Raad van State, voordat deze openbaar zijn gemaakt door de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Paternotte over de Nederlandse aanwezigheid bij de vergadering van het Verdrag inzake het verbod op kernwapens

MPs Piri and Paternotte asked whether the Netherlands, a non-signatory to the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons, would attend the TPNW states-parties meeting as an observer, as requested by a parliamentary motion. The Minister answered that the Netherlands has no added value from attending, given its strong diplomatic position and existing NPT exchanges, and does not intend to attend.
No. As explained in the cabinet's response to the Van Dijk/Sjoerdsma motion, the cabinet does not consider renewed participation in a TPNW states-parties meeting meaningful.

Nee. Zoals toegelicht in de reactie van het kabinet op de motie Van Dijk/ Sjoerdsma (Kamerstuk 21 501-02, nr. 2497 ), acht het kabinet hernieuwde deelname aan een vergadering van statenpartijen van het TPNW niet zinvol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Piri over de beschieting van het Wereldvoedselprogramma door Israëlische troepen

MPs Hirsch and Piri asked the government about the Israeli shooting at a clearly marked WFP convoy in January 2025, whether such attacks breach international humanitarian law, and whether the Netherlands signalled concern to Israel. The minister answered that attacks on humanitarian workers violate IHL, that a court and Israel itself must establish the facts before a breach can be judged, and that the Netherlands raised concerns with Israel and urged compliance.
The cabinet does not have all the relevant facts.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over alle relevante feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Piri over de erkenning van het recht op een gezonde leefomgeving in het Europese Verdrag van de Rechten van de Mens

MPs Gabriëls and Piri asked whether the Netherlands will support recognising a right to a healthy environment in the European Convention on Human Rights, given other EU states' constitutional recognition and UN resolutions. The minister replied that Dutch law already protects the environment through the Constitution, Omgevingswet and related statutes, that the Netherlands is still studying the Council of Europe's CDDH report, and that a national position will be sent to Parliament later.
Your House will be informed about this position in due course by letter to Parliament, in accordance with motion 32 735 no. 373.
Uw Kamer wordt t.z.t. over deze inzet geïnformeerd per Kamerbrief conform motie 32 735 nr. 373.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Eerdmans over het nieuws dat Russische geheim agenten met vissersschepen naar Nederland kunnen reizen

MPs asked whether the NVWA can fully inspect Russian fish imports, impose fines or seize cargo, and whether the government will push for a ban on Russian whitefish, sanctions on Norebo, restrictions on Russian crews and measures against financing of Russia via Dutch ports. The minister answered that inspections are risk-based within EU benchmarks, that the NVWA lacks powers over catch quotas, that no fines were issued, and that the government favours exploring a whitefish import ban while leaving options open and withholding details of its negotiating position.
It is not in the interest of the Dutch negotiating position, nor of the surprise effect necessary for sanctions to be effective, to go into more detail on the Dutch negotiating position.

Het is niet in het belang van de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie en van de voor de effectiviteit van sancties noodzakelijke verrassingseffect om in meer detail op de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Paternotte over het ontzeggen van toegang aan de Brits-Palestijnse dokter Ghassan Abu-Sittah tot het Schengengebied

MPs Piri and Paternotte asked why the government did not grant an exception to the German entry ban for British-Palestinian surgeon Ghassan Abu-Sittah, and whether Dutch obligations under the host-state agreements with the ICC and OPCW apply to him as a witness or expert. The government declined to share information on individual cases, said he is no longer listed in the SIS, and stated that the ICC and OPCW alone decide who qualifies as a witness or expert, so it commits to no action.
On behalf of the Minister of Asylum and Migration, the cabinet as a rule does not share information about individual cases with the House.
Namens de Minister van Asiel en Migratie deelt het kabinet in de regel geen informatie over individuele zaken met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Piri over de onlangs verschenen rapporten van Amnesty, Human Rights Watch en Artsen Zonder Grenzen over de situatie in Gaza

MPs Dassen and Piri asked the Foreign Minister about reports by Amnesty International, Human Rights Watch and Doctors Without Borders alleging genocide and related crimes by Israel in Gaza, including whether the evidence meets the ICJ 'only reasonable inference' test, the water access findings, arms embargo and EU Association Council steps. The Minister answered that the government is generally reluctant to qualify situations as genocide, that it awaits ICJ rulings, that it urges Israel to expand humanitarian access and will raise this in the Association Council, and referred to a separate letter for most substantive points.
The Netherlands is as a rule reluctant to qualify situations as genocide.
Nederland is in de regel terughoudend om situaties als genocide te kwalificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pirir over het bericht 'Gemeenten en minister oneens over wat sobere opvang voor statushouders is: 'Faber vindt één persoon per slaapkamer niet sober genoeg''

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether she told the municipality of Apeldoorn that single-occupancy rooms with shared facilities are not sober enough for transit locations for recognised refugees, and what objective standards apply. The minister denied saying this, said no decision has been made, that rules and a funding scheme are still being drafted with municipalities, and that no proposed transit locations have been rejected.
To support municipalities, a funding scheme is being drawn up under which the national government will contribute towards setting up a transit location.
Om gemeenten te ondersteunen wordt een bekostigingsregeling gemaakt, waar vanuit het Rijk een bijdrage wordt geleverd om een doorstroomlocatie in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Piri over het bericht «Sancties omzeild bij project van scheepsbouwer Damen in Rusland»

MPs Klaver and Piri asked whether Dutch shipbuilder Damen's components reached Russia despite sanctions, what enforcement is underway, and how transit and dual-use exports via third countries are controlled. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, stated that enforcement is handled by the supervisor, OM and courts, and described general export licensing, due diligence and cooperation measures.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri , Ceder, Koekkoek en Podt over het bericht 'Faber beperkt inspraak van adviesorganen bij overhaaste wetgeving’

MPs asked why the Minister for Asylum and Migration shortened the consultation period for two asylum bills (two-status system and tighter family reunification) and why the emergency asylum bill was not sent to the Dutch Bar Association, and how this fits Dutch legislative drafting guidelines. The minister answered that urgency justified the accelerated process, that consultation was only with directly affected bodies such as the IND, the Council for the Judiciary and the Raad van State division, that the 'confidential' marking was an error, that no shortened consultation is planned for other migration bills, and that IND concerns about implementation will be taken into account.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat er grote zorgen zijn bij hoge rechtsorganen over asielwetten

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about reported serious concerns at the Council for the Judiciary and other high judicial bodies over the two-status asylum system and the emergency asylum law, including workload, costs for the IND and courts, and the short consultation period. The minister acknowledged the concerns, gave cost estimates for the IND, said the courts' costs would be assessed later, and said advice received later would still be taken into account.
As I stated in the committee debate of 19 December 2024, I will still take into account advice received at a later stage in the legislative process.
Zoals ik aangaf in het commissiedebat op 19 december 2024, zal ik adviezen die op een later moment nog worden ontvangen alsnog betrekken in het wetgevingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Piri over zorg voor zwangere vrouwen en baby’s in aanmeldcentrum en AZC’s

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Piri asked the ministers about maternity care for pregnant asylum seekers in reception centres, citing the EGALITE report on higher stillbirth and birth complications, and asked about relocations, interpreters, hygiene, privacy and the status of the Ketenrichtlijn. The minister acknowledges the problems, points to the Musselkanaal wing, the strain on reception capacity and planned action (raising the guideline with professional bodies, reviewing the EGALITE recommendations), but declines to change birth registration rules and does not commit to new binding standards.
I will therefore ask the professional organisations in maternity care to bring the chain guideline again to the attention of their members.
Ik zal de beroepsorganisaties in de geboortezorg daarom verzoeken om de ketenrichtlijn opnieuw onder de aandacht te brengen bij hun achterban.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Piri en Podt over de (beveiligde) opvang van COA-bewoners en ongedocumenteerden met ernstige psychische problemen

MPs asked the government why it appeared to downplay concerns that the Veldzicht centre would stop accepting COA residents and undocumented migrants with severe psychiatric problems, and where such people could be placed safely. The minister answered that no decisions had yet been taken, that beds for the group remain available with case-by-case assessment, that responsibility is shared across ministers, and that the group will not be left on the street, while deferring full answers until a decision on the cooperation agreement was taken.
Discussions are taking place between the parties involved to ensure it is clear under which criteria and conditions this group can be placed in the reserved beds at Veldzicht.
Er vinden gesprekken plaats tussen betrokken partijen om te borgen dat duidelijk is onder welke criteria en randvoorwaarden deze groep op de gereserveerde bedden in Veldzicht geplaatst kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over Turkije.

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish strikes in northeast Syria that cut water and power, possible violations of international law, and the removal of elected Kurdish mayors in southeast Turkey, including sanctions and support for human rights groups. The minister acknowledged Turkey's security concerns and urged respect for international law and civilian infrastructure, said the government raises concerns with Turkish authorities, and declined to summon the ambassador or back EU sanctions.
The cabinet chooses to raise its concerns about replacing mayors with so-called trustees in talks with Turkish authorities, both via the EU and bilaterally.
Het kabinet kiest ervoor haar zorgen over het vervangen van burgemeesters door zogenoemde «trustees» op te brengen in gesprekken met de Turkse autoriteiten, zowel via de EU als bilateraal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over Israëlische ongewenste inmenging

An MP asked the government to share the NCTV investigation into alleged Israeli undue interference, to explain its scope and method, to investigate other Israeli interventions and incidents, and to say whether the ambassador was summoned. The government declined to share the findings publicly, citing security interests, said it would share further information through appropriate channels, and confirmed it raised the matter with the Israeli ambassador.
This information cannot be shared publicly because it could harm our security interests.
Deze informatie kan niet in het openbaar worden gedeeld omdat dit onze veiligheidsbelangen kan schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht aangaande de aanstelling van een woordvoerder op het ministerie van Asiel en Migratie

An MP asked the ministers whether Minister Faber (Asylum and Migration) refused to appoint a former spokesperson of the Amsterdam mayor, how spokesperson appointments work, and why the appointment was withdrawn. The government answered the procedure questions in general terms but declined to comment on the individual case, and gave no figures on refused appointments.
I do not make statements about individual case matters.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Hirsch en Nordkamp over de handhaving van de internationale rechtsorde ten aanzien van Israël

Three GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about export licences for military and dual-use goods to Israel, journalist access to Gaza, and Israel's halt on visas for international NGO staff. The minister answered that two military export licences were granted since 7 October 2023, 28 dual-use licences in 2024, that F-35 parts and engines are no longer exported to Israel after the court ruling, and that Israel should allow journalists and aid workers access but no sanctions or consequences were announced.
The Netherlands calls on Israel to facilitate the work of aid organisations, including by improving visa issuance.
Nederland roept Israël op om het werk van hulporganisaties te faciliteren, inclusief middels verbetering van visumverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van Nispen over het bericht 'GGD-arts slaat alarm: 'Asielkinderen opvang Assen zijn ondervoed en bang'

MPs Piri and Van Nispen asked whether children should no longer be housed in the Expo Hal emergency shelter in Assen, how long residents stay and how often the 20-day limit is exceeded, and how the child-appropriate housing motion will be implemented. The Minister answers that emergency shelter is still needed to prevent people sleeping on the street, that the COA is working to move children to regular shelters, that residents stay on average 15 days with 90 of 473 exceeding 20 days, and that no firm end date can be given.
Given that I depend on other parties to realise shelter, I cannot give a timeframe for when the use of emergency shelter locations will no longer be needed.
Gelet op het feit dat ik voor het realiseren van opvang afhankelijk ben van andere partijen kan ik geen termijn geven waarop de inzet van noodopvanglocaties niet meer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat gemeenten volgend jaar minder geld krijgen voor de opvang van Oekraïners

Piri (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked whether the government's planned cut of about 30% in the per-day reimbursement for municipal Ukrainian refugee shelter would stop municipalities creating enough places, and how this fits the target of 125,000 places. The minister answered that the rates are recalibrated to a cost study, that the exception allowing actual costs to be claimed remains, and that municipalities will not be financially disadvantaged, while many questions were answered only by restating policy or referring to the cost-study outcome.
The starting point here is that municipalities do not suffer any financial disadvantage from the reception task for displaced persons from Ukraine.
Het uitgangspunt hierbij is dat gemeenten geen financieel nadeel ondervinden van de opvangtaak voor ontheemden uit Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Boswijk over de rechtszaak van Nederland tegen Afghanistan

MPs Piri and Boswijk asked for the written claim Netherlands, Australia, Canada and Germany filed against Afghanistan over violations of the Women's Convention, asked whether it affects asylum procedures for Afghan women, and asked about grant rates and the risks of tightened IND assessment criteria. The minister said the claim is at the negotiation stage and the strategy is confidential, that there is no legal link to asylum decisions which rest on the Afghanistan country report and individual assessment, and gave grant-rate figures (about 95% overall, 75% since July 2024 on small numbers).
The progress and strategy of the negotiations is confidential in the interest of the process.
De voortgang en strategie van de onderhandelingen is in het belang van het proces vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op op vragen van het de leden Piri en Hirsch over de brief inzake het contact tussen de minister van Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingshulp en de Oegandese minister van Buitenlandse Zaken

MPs Piri and Hirsch asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about his meeting with Uganda's foreign minister, including whether returning rejected asylum seekers from the Netherlands to Uganda was discussed and whether a meeting report exists. The minister confirmed the letter, said asylum reception and returns were discussed (returns previously at official level), and said a report of the whole Uganda visit exists with the meeting included, though no separate report was made.
A report was made of the entire visit to Uganda. The conversation with the Ugandan Minister of Foreign Affairs is included in this report.
Van het gehele bezoek aan Oeganda is een verslag gemaakt. Het gesprek met de Oegandese Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken is in dit verslag opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Hirsch over recente ontwikkelingen in Israël-Palestina

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government how it views Israeli laws threatening UNRWA's operations in the occupied Palestinian territories, whether the Netherlands should join partner statements against them, and about humanitarian access, the Israeli 'General Plan' and possible responses. The government answered that the laws are worrying, that Israel as occupying power must ensure alternatives to UNRWA services and humanitarian access, and that it is too early to speculate on consequences while it presses Israel through bilateral, EU and UN channels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over Israëlische beschietingen tegen VN-vredesmacht UNIFIL

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli shelling of UNIFIL peacekeeping positions, including a tank round hitting a watchtower and fire on a bunker, and whether the Netherlands would condemn it, summon the Israeli ambassador, and whether a Dutch soldier was hurt. The minister condemned the attacks, said they are a serious violation of international humanitarian law and called for an immediate halt, confirmed no Dutch soldier was injured, and declined to summon the ambassador at this time, relying on diplomatic pressure instead.
The cabinet continues to hold Israel to account diplomatically and politically for its responsibility to protect UNIFIL soldiers and respect the UNIFIL mandate.
Het kabinet blijft Israël diplomatiek en politiek aanspreken op zijn verantwoordelijkheid om UNIFIL-militairen te beschermen en het mandaat van UNIFIL te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de uitspraak van de minister van VWS ‘Als het staatsnoodrecht in gaat, wil ik nog wel eens zien wie zo stoer is om het tegen te houden’

An MP asks whether a minister's remark that she would like to see who dares to stop emergency powers (staatsnoodrecht) from taking effect is a threat to parliament or the courts and whether it conflicts with collective cabinet responsibility and the rule of law. The minister says it was not meant as a threat, expresses respect for parliament, and states that parliament has the final word on emergency powers.
Parliament has the last word on the use of emergency powers.
Het parlement heeft het laatste woord over de inzet van het staatsnoodrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Podt over het proefballonnetje van de minister

MPs Piri and Podt asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration whether the cabinet had decided to cut asylum residence permits from five to two years, and why she floated this in the media before a formal decision. The minister answered that no decision has yet been taken, that she wants two years for subsidiary protection holders based on her Denmark visit, and that the measure will be elaborated with other duration options.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over haar tweede proefballonnetje van de week

An MP asks the Minister for Asylum and Migration about a reported plan to have provinces take turns housing asylum seekers from Ter Apel, questioning whether it is in the coalition agreement, whether it was agreed in cabinet, its finances and why the Spreidingswet is not implemented. The minister says no such system has been decided, that emergency measures are being explored and will be implemented once worked out, and that she still intends to repeal the Spreidingswet while abiding by it for now.
No, everything is aimed at ensuring that everyone who applies for asylum in the Netherlands is provided with a bed; despite all efforts, the reception situation remains critical.
Nee, alles is erop gericht om te zorgen dat iedereen die in Nederland asiel aanvraagt, voorzien wordt van een bed, ondanks alle inspanningen blijft de opvangsituatie kritiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk en Ceder over de interne communicatie en adviezen met betrekking tot de overbrenging van Afghaanse bewakers.

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Asylum and Migration to send all internal communication and advice on the decision not to transfer Afghan guards to the Netherlands. The ministers respond that they partially meet the request by providing the official advice drafted since the new cabinet took office.
We partially meet your request by providing the official advice drafted since the new cabinet took office regarding the transfer of Afghan guards.

Wij komen gedeeltelijk tegemoet aan uw verzoek door de ambtelijke adviezen te verstrekken die zijn opgesteld sinds het aantreden van het nieuwe kabinet met betrekking tot de overbrenging van Afghaanse bewakers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Kathmann over het onderzoek van Trollrensics over desinformatienetwerken tijdens de EU verkiezingen

MPs Piri and Kathmann asked the government about a Trollrensics report on disinformation networks targeting the 2024 European elections, including whether AIVD, MIVD and NCTV confirm it, whether similar campaigns occurred in the Netherlands, the role of Dutch hosting infrastructure, and whether the DSA suffices against platforms like X. The minister answered that the network was not observed in the Netherlands, that the services cannot publicly confirm investigations, that DSA enforcement by the European Commission is ongoing, and that a broader Dutch disinformation strategy is underway.
The cabinet cannot publicly disclose where the intelligence and security services are or are not conducting investigations.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen naar waar de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten al dan niet onderzoek naar doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de situatie van Nederlanders in Libanon

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the number of Dutch nationals still in Lebanon, contact with them, and evacuation options as commercial routes closed. The minister said no exact count is possible since there is no registration obligation, announced active repatriation flights with military and commercial means, and said evacuation by the state is not currently needed.
An exact number cannot be given, partly because there is no registration obligation for Dutch nationals abroad.
Een exact aantal is niet te geven, mede omdat er geen registratieplicht is voor Nederlanders in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Boswijk over de dreigende sluiting van het Walaardt Sacré Kamp in Huis ter Heide

MPs Piri and Boswijk asked whether the Walaardt Sacré Kamp asylum reception site in Huis ter Heide would close, where Afghan refugees and family members were housed, and about alternative housing, medical care and schooling. The minister answered that the site is being returned to Defence from September 2024, that residents were moved to other locations, and that Defence has repeatedly weighed extensions but needs the site for its own growing organisation.
Defence needs the barracks for its own growing organisation.
Defensie heeft de kazerne nodig voor de eigen groeiende organisatie.
Antwoord op de leden Kröger en Piri over het bericht 'Russisch staatsbedrijf sluist honderden miljoenen aan uraniumwinst door Nederland'

MPs Kröger and Piri asked the government about reports that Russian state company Rosatom earns hundreds of millions from uranium trade through the Netherlands, and how Russian dependence in nuclear energy and medical isotopes can be ended. The minister answered that the government opposes this revenue, pushes for EU sanctions on Russia's civil-nuclear earnings and LNG imports, notes residual dependence through legacy contracts and enriched ytterbium for medical isotopes, and says alternatives are being explored.
In line with the Klaver et al. motion, the cabinet advocates at EU level for sanctions that hit Russia's earnings in the civil-nuclear domain.
Het kabinet pleit conform de motie Klaver c.s. (Kamerstuk 36 476, nr. 3 ) in Europees verband voor sancties die het Russische verdienvermogen in het civiel-nucleaire domein raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Chakor over de “buitengewone omstandigheden” die de minister-president zouden nopen het parlement buitenspel te zetten

MPs Piri and Chakor asked the Minister of the Interior whether the government's plan to invoke emergency powers under articles 110-111 of the Aliens Act to suspend chapters 1-7 for an asylum crisis is lawful, and whether it bypasses parliament. The minister answered that the Aliens Act and these powers fall under the Minister of Asylum and Migration, that a reasoned justification will follow, that a bill extending article 111 must be submitted promptly to parliament, and that the Council of State will advise.
Importantly, after article 111 is brought into force, a bill on the continuation of article 111 must be submitted to the House of Representatives without delay.
Van belang hierbij is dat, na de inwerkingstelling van artikel 111, onverwijld een wetsvoorstel bij de Tweede Kamer moet worden ingediend over het voortduren van de werking van artikel 111.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Kahraman, Paternotte, Dobbe, Van Campen en Ceder over het vredesproces tussen Armenië en Azerbeidzjan

MPs asked the government about the Armenia-Azerbaijan peace process, including the trilateral meeting in Washington, Azerbaijan's demand to amend Armenia's constitution, and what the Netherlands could do to speed up a deal. The minister said the government urges both sides toward a durable agreement based on mutual recognition of territorial integrity, declined to comment publicly on negotiating positions, and noted EUMA's de-escalating role and a mandate running to February 2025.
However, it is not in the interest of the negotiating parties to publicly address their negotiating positions in this answer.
Het is echter niet in het belang van de onderhandelende partijen om in deze beantwoording publiekelijk in te gaan op de onderhandelingsposities van de partijen bij de vredesbesprekingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Paternotte over het nieuws dat de Israëlische regering Noorse diplomaten gaat uitwijzen na de Noorse erkenning van Palestina

MPs Paternotte and Piri asked Foreign Minister Veldkamp about Israel's decision to withdraw accreditation from Norwegian diplomats after Norway recognised Palestine, including whether it obstructs ICC proceedings and whether the Netherlands will raise it at the EU Foreign Affairs Council. The minister called the Israeli decision unwise, said he had raised concerns bilaterally with Israel's foreign minister, and gave substantive but largely non-committal answers on Israel's compliance with international law.
It is not for me to explain why Israel has taken this step.
Het is niet aan mij om uit te leggen waarom Israël hiertoe is overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het corruptieschandaal rond de asielopvang in Van der Valk-hotels

An MP asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration how fraud in asylum hotel contracts is being prevented, whether the LCHD intermediary's role in other hotel chains will be examined, and whether criminal complaints or sanctions will follow after the Van der Valk corruption affair. The Minister says COA is reviewing contracts and procedures, is working to phase out expensive emergency hotel reception, confirms LCHD also worked with other chains, and states that the OM and FIOD are conducting a criminal investigation with no additional steps taken for now.
The OM and FIOD are currently conducting a criminal investigation. I am closely monitoring this investigation
Het OM en FIOD voeren momenteel een strafrechtelijk onderzoek uit. Ik houd dit onderzoek nauwlettend in de gaten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Piri en Teunissen over het opzeggen van het verdrag inzake clustermunitie door Litouwen

Three MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs whether he knew of Lithuania's withdrawal from the Convention on Cluster Munitions, whether he shared the coalition's concerns, and whether he would urge Lithuania to reverse its decision. The minister confirmed the withdrawal, said the Netherlands regrets it, and reported that the government has already raised concerns with Lithuania, which points to its security situation, while noting that the withdrawal takes effect after a six-month period following notification to the UN.
The cabinet has already had contact with Lithuanian authorities about the withdrawal from the convention.
Het kabinet heeft reeds contact gehad met Litouwse autoriteiten over het opzeggen van het verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Piri over het bericht 'Anti-Palestijnse desinformatie in de Kamer: ‘Dit is niet hoe het hoort te gaan’'

MPs Hirsch and Piri asked the ministers about a Groene Amsterdammer report that former minister Van Leeuwen suspended UNRWA funding unilaterally, whether he consulted advisers, his deleted social media posts, and UNRWA's role. Minister Klever answered that the decision was within his responsibility, no advisory memo was prepared, no evidence has been provided that UNRWA funds were used in the 7 October attack, and that the deleted posts were not managed by the ministry, though most questions were answered only in part and some were declined as not appropriate to account for.
A Minister is entitled to ask civil servants for advice before decision-making (and to decide whom to ask), but is not obliged to do so.
Een Minister is bevoegd om voorafgaand aan besluitvorming advies aan ambtenaren te vragen (en te beslissen aan wie), maar is daartoe niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de steun voor een verklaring over UNRWA

An MP asked whether the Netherlands should sign a statement of over 100 countries recognising UNRWA's critical role for Palestinian refugees, and why it had not, and whether the government still backs the European Council's view that UNRWA's services are essential. The minister answered that the Netherlands did not sign because it disagreed with points such as UNRWA being irreplaceable, which conflicts with its wish to diversify aid channels, but stressed UNRWA's important role in Gaza; the government does stand behind the European Council conclusions.
The Netherlands could not agree with all points in the statement and therefore decided not to sign it.
Nederland kon zich niet op alle punten vinden in de verklaring en heeft daarom besloten niet mee te tekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de zorgelijke mensenrechtensituatie in Tunesië

Piri (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the government about the deteriorating human rights situation in Tunisia, including arrests of lawyers, NGO workers and journalists, and about Dutch and EU funding and oversight. Minister Veldkamp answered that concerns were raised at senior official level, that trial monitoring and rights support continue, and that the EU Ombudsman inquiry into the EU-Tunisia MoU is ongoing, while giving limited detail on programmes and funding.
Given the confidential nature of these activities, the cabinet cannot go into further detail on this.
In verband met het vertrouwelijke karakter van deze activiteiten kan het kabinet hier niet verder op in gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht ‘Nederland stuurt toch minister naar Hongarije’

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA, PvdD and Volt asked whether the government would send ministers to informal EU Council meetings in Hungary after PM Orbán's Moscow visit, and how this relates to EU sanctions and Hungary's presidency. Minister Veldkamp answered that the government condemned Orbán's visit, that Nederland does not undermine sanctions, and that after the Hoge Vertegenwoordiger moved the informal meetings to Brussels no ministerial delegation will go to Budapest.
The Netherlands is not undermining sanctions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Ceder over de detentie en uitzetting van de familie Babayants

Two MPs (Piri and Ceder) asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the detention and planned deportation to Uzbekistan of the Babayants family, who have lived in the Netherlands for about ten years, including children born there, and whether this is consistent with children's rights and the best interests of the child. The Minister declined to discuss the individual case, said the best interests of the child are considered but not decisive, defended detention of families as a last resort in a family facility, and saw no reason to revise the policy.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de vertraging in de rechtszaak rondom Tent of Nations

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Foreign Minister about the postponed court case concerning Tent of Nations and whether the government would change its stance toward Israel and continue Dutch support for Palestinian land rights. The minister answered that a new hearing is set for 12 September 2024, that the Netherlands has raised concerns with Israeli authorities, and that existing policy against settlements and land confiscation continues.
The Netherlands recently expressed its concerns to the Israeli authorities about the length of the legal process and the failure to reach a decision.
Nederland heeft recentelijk zijn zorgen uitgesproken bij de Israëlische autoriteiten over de duur van het juridische proces en het uitblijven van een besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht: ‘Oekraïense vluchtelingen worden dagen in de cel gehouden bij aankomst per vliegtuig’

An MP asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about reports that Ukrainian displaced persons arriving by plane at Schiphol are held in cells, questioning the legal basis and proportionality of applying the border procedure to them. The minister defended the practice as existing law applied to those seeking long stays, noted only ten Ukrainians completed the procedure since January 2024, and declined to publish rejection figures citing privacy rules.
Because of the low numbers of foreign nationals with Ukrainian nationality, these figures are not made public under the GDPR and traceability considerations.
Vanwege de lage aantallen vreemdelingen met de Oekraïense nationaliteit worden deze aantallen in het kader van de AVG en herleidbaarheid niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het artikel 'Kolonisten in Palestijns gebied krijgen hun helmen en drones van orthodox-christelijk Nederland'

An MP asks the ministers whether tax-deductible donations from the Dutch charity Christenen voor Israël fund protective gear and drones for settlers in occupied territory, and whether that conflicts with Dutch policy. The government says it was unaware of the donations, considers settlements contrary to international law and undesirable to fund, but states that under neutral ANBI rules protective helmets and vests can count as generally beneficial and the charity status is not withdrawn, while pledging continued EU sanctions efforts against violent settlers.
Because the tax authority is bound by the confidentiality duty of article 67 of the General Tax Act, no further information can be provided about individual institutions.

Omdat de belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan geen nadere informatie worden verstrekt over individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht 'U.S. expected to sanction IDF unit for human rights violations in West Bank'

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister how she assesses the IDF Netzah Yehuda battalion, which the US planned to sanction over human rights abuses in the West Bank, and whether the Netherlands would follow suit. The minister called the reports very concerning, said Israel must prevent settler violence, and declined to follow the US measure, which she described as a Leahy Law restriction rather than a sanction, while pointing to EU settler sanctions the Netherlands supports.

Because the Netherlands only cooperates with Israel within the internationally recognised 1967 borders, the Netherlands has no relationship with the Netzah Yehuda battalion and there is no sanction in the sense of entry bans or asset freezes, the Netherlands does not follow the American example.

Omdat Nederland alleen met Israël binnen de internationaal erkende grenzen van 1967 samenwerkt, Nederland geen relatie met het Netzah Yehudabataljon heeft en er geen sprake is van een sanctie in de zin van inreisverboden of tegoedbevriezingen, volgt Nederland het Amerikaanse voorbeeld niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat een medeweker van de Nederlandse ambassade in Jemen is gearresteerd

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Houthi authorities arrested an embassy employee in Yemen, and what is known about the reason, place of detention and contact with the employee's family and the embassy. The minister confirmed the arrest, said the employee was taken on 9 June to an unknown location without a warrant or charge, and that diplomatic means are being used for release, but declined further detail citing safety.
Given the safety of this employee and his family and the effectiveness of the effort, it is not possible to elaborate further on this.
Gelet op de veiligheid van deze medewerker en zijn familie en de effectiviteit van de inzet is het niet mogelijk hier nader over uit te wijden.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Piri over het bezoek van Viktor Orbán aan Moskou

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether Hungarian PM Orbán's visit to Putin in Moscow is appropriate for the EU Council presidency holder, and whether the Hungarian ambassador should be summoned. The minister answers that the visit is a strictly bilateral matter, the rotating presidency has no external competence, and the government has already publicly distanced itself without seeing a need to summon the ambassador.
The cabinet therefore does not consider it necessary to summon the Hungarian ambassador.
Het kabinet acht het daarmee niet nodig de Hongaarse ambassadeur te ontbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de uitvoering van de Spreidingwet

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the implementation of the Dispersal Act: full funding of municipal support, clarity on funds and quality frameworks for municipal exploitation of reception, COA realisation timelines, use of Rijksvastgoed buildings, provincial and ministerial intervention powers, and funding timing for newcomer education. The State Secretary answered that funding arrangements follow the Intergovernmental Relations Code, that a quality framework is ready with a handbook to follow, that realisation of reception takes weeks to three years, that the ministry will escalate interventions via a stepwise ladder ending in replacement of municipalities, and that education funding is being changed to start from first enrolment.

The steps in interadministrative supervision for neglect of duties are signalling, requesting and validating information, active supervision, pre-announcement of legal intervention, a decision on replacement, and execution ("escalation ladder").

De stappen in het interbestuurlijk toezicht bij taakverwaarlozing zijn signaleren, informatie opvragen en valideren, actief toezicht, vooraankondiging juridische interventie, besluit tot indeplaatsstelling en uitvoeren («escalatieladder»).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Veldkamp en Paternotte over mogelijkheden om bevroren Russische tegoeden te gebruiken voor hulp aan Oekraïne

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Estonia's law enabling use of frozen Russian assets for Ukraine could serve as a basis in the Netherlands and the EU, and about the state of the Brekelmans motion and a possible 'Navalny Act'. The minister answered that Dutch sanctions law does not allow confiscation of private assets outside criminal proceedings, that no international consensus exists on using the underlying assets, and that the government remains ambitious in exploring options.
Without this criminal-law framework, confiscation on the basis of sanctions raises serious questions about safeguarding individual rights such as property rights.
Zonder dit strafrechtelijk kader roept het overgaan tot confiscatie op basis van sancties serieuze vragen op omtrent de waarborg van individuele rechten zoals het eigendomsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Veldkamp, Paternotte en Teunissen over de Tent of Nations in de buurt van Bethlehem

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the Tent of Nations peace farm near Bethlehem, including land registration delays, a road built on the family's land, restricted access, and whether the government will press Israeli authorities. The minister answered that the access restrictions and road works are illegal under international law and should stop, that the Dutch mission raises the matter regularly and will keep pressing, and that the case is typical of pressures on Palestinian farmers in Area C.
The Netherlands will continue to press on this.
Nederland zal hier op blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat de IND in de zomer al beschikte over cijfers inzake gestapelde nareis

MP Piri asked the Justice Minister and State Secretary about reports that the IND had preliminary figures on stacked family reunification in summer 2023, probing who knew what and when, and why the August 2023 draft note was only sent to parliament after the European elections. The government largely refers to an attached process sketch, declines to name officials, says the former secretary-general was not informed of the draft, and states the draft was only found to fall within the request scope after the February 2024 request.
Sharing the names of officials and their functions is not compatible with ministerial responsibility.
Het delen van namen van ambtenaren en functies van ambtenaren past niet bij de ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en White over het bericht dat honderd oudere Surinamers een verblijfsstatus aanvragen

MPs Piri and White asked the Interior and Justice ministers about reports that about a hundred elderly former Dutch-Surinamese residents were applying for residence status, and about a possible scheme for this group. The state secretary said a targeted one-off scheme was examined but not developed, that the caretaker cabinet would leave new policy to its successor, and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
Given the caretaker status of the current Cabinet, I am of the view that it is no longer for me to develop policy.
Gelet op de demissionaire status van het huidige Kabinet ben ik van oordeel dat het niet meer aan mij is beleid te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Piri en Van Baarle over het artikel 'Kabinet zoekt na verbod naar andere wegen voor leveren F-35-onderdelen aan Israël'

MPs Dassen, Piri and Van Baarle asked whether the ministry sought indirect routes to supply F-35 parts to Israel after a court ruling, whether parts were delivered to other countries or indirectly reached Israel, and whether indirect supply breaches international law. The minister denied seeking alternative routes, said no internal correspondence exists on this, acknowledged exports of F-35 parts to other F-35 countries since the ruling, and could not exclude indirect end-use in Israel, referring to a letter of 24 April 2024.
There has been no request to look for alternative routes to still supply F-35 parts to Israel.
Er is niet gevraagd naar alternatieve routes te zoeken om alsnog F-35-onderdelen te kunnen leveren aan Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht ‘IND handelt in hoger tempo asielaanvragen af, maar de wachttijd blijft oplopen’

MP Piri asks why the IND cannot keep pace with asylum intake, why no contingency plan for peaks has been adopted despite EY advice from 2021, and how backlogs, staff turnover, sickness absence and hearing dropout will be addressed. The State Secretary answers that intake exceeded IND capacity, lists structural measures and the BAA project, but acknowledges processing times will keep rising in 2024.
No reliable figures can be generated from the IND systems on the percentage of hearings that fall through.
Er zijn geen betrouwbare cijfers uit de systemen van de IND te genereren over het percentage gehoren dat uitvalt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga en Piri over het bericht ‘UNRWA Chief Tells Haaretz: We Take Israel's Claims of Hamas Infiltration Seriously, but Yet to See Evidence Against Gaza ‘Employees’

MPs Paternotte, Bamenga and Piri asked the Dutch ministers about UNRWA staff allegedly involved in the 7 October attacks, whether Israel had shared evidence, and whether Dutch aid to UNRWA should be resumed during the investigation. The minister replied that the UN OIOS is investigating, that Israel has shared public information without it being independently verified, and that donors will decide individually on resuming funding while referring to a letter of 26 April 2024.
The cabinet and other donors therefore call on all parties to fully cooperate with the investigation.
Het kabinet en andere donoren roepen alle partijen daarom op tot volledige medewerking aan het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de uitgelekte asielplannen van de formerende partijen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether an 'asylum crisis' could lawfully be declared to allow stricter measures, including suspending reception, and about EU and Dutch law limits, consequences for dispersal, and court risk. The State Secretary answered that emergency derogation under article 111 Vreemdelingenwet is limited to situations like war, that access to the asylum procedure and reception cannot be denied under EU directives, and that legal views have not changed, while declining to speculate on hypothetical outcomes.
This means that foreigners cannot be denied access to the asylum procedure and asylum reception.
Dat betekent dat vreemdelingen niet de toegang tot de asielprocedure en de asielopvang kan worden ontzegd.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Piri en Kathmann over nieuwssites die al jaren pro-Chinese desinformatie verspreiden

MPs Piri and Kathmann asked the government about a network of news sites spreading pro-Chinese disinformation, including reach, platform promotion, and whether EU rules (DSA, disinformation code) can address it. The government answered that the sites have negligible reach, fall largely outside DSA scope, that it will report on its disinformation strategy in spring, and that further EU regulation is not yet needed.
The cabinet is in close contact, both bilaterally and multilaterally, with friendly countries on foreign interference and Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference (FIMI).

Het kabinet staat zowel bilateraal als in multilateraal verband in nauw contact met bevriende landen over de problematiek van buitenlandse inmenging en Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference (FIMI).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het artikel 'Palestinians ‘beaten and sexually assaulted’ at Israeli detention centres, UN report claims.'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a UN report alleging abuse and sexual assault of Palestinian detainees in Israeli detention centres, and what the government would do about it. The minister said the report is not yet public, that the government finds the allegations concerning, supports NGO monitoring such as Hamoked, and will raise detainee rights and access for organisations like the ICRC with Israel, but made no firm commitment to its own investigation.
The UN report referred to in the Guardian article is not public.
Het VN-rapport waarover in het artikel van de Guardian wordt gesproken, is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Veldkamp, Van Nispen en Koekkoek over gestapelde gezinshereniging

MPs Piri, Veldkamp, Van Nispen and Koekkoek asked the Minister of Justice and Security why she claimed thousands of people were affected by chained family reunification (nareis-op-nareis), given IND's uncertainty and expert signals of a marginal phenomenon, and how this squares with the cabinet's fall. The Minister answered that her conclusion rested on general family reunification figures and IND's Stand van de uitvoering 2023, that the law leaves room for misuse, that a broad migration package could not be agreed and the change is left to a next cabinet.
I concluded, based on the general figures on family reunification plus the total inflow figures and the IND's Stand van de uitvoering, that chained family reunification is a problem.
Ik heb op basis van de algemene cijfers over nareis plus de totale instroom cijfers en de Stand van de uitvoering 5 van de IND geconcludeerd dat nareis op nareis een knelpunt is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de Nederlandse bijdrage aan openbare hoorzittingen bij Internationaal Gerechtshof

An MP asked why the Dutch contribution to the ICJ oral hearings on the legal consequences of Israel's occupation policies only set out general international law rules, without naming Israel or the Occupied Palestinian Territories or appraising the occupation. The minister replied that the Netherlands aimed to assist the Court by identifying applicable law and presenting its legal view, that the Court itself must apply the law to the facts, and that it would not share a substantive appraisal while the advisory proceedings are pending.
No. The request for an advisory opinion is now before the court.
Nee. Het verzoek om advies is nu onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de samenwerking van Frontex met de Libische kustwacht.

An MP asks the government about Frontex sharing migrant boat coordinates with the Libyan coast guard, including links to militias, Libya's unsafe status, EU funding and whether the EU does enough to prevent abuses. The government answers that Frontex must alert the responsible rescue centre, that no formal cooperation with Libya exists, that it finds such coordinate sharing undesirable, and that it will raise human rights and due diligence issues in EU forums.
The cabinet considers it important that Frontex's internal procedures and rules for assessing maritime emergencies it detects through surveillance are examined.
Het kabinet hecht eraan dat gekeken wordt naar de interne procedures en regels bij Frontex aan de hand waarvan het maritieme noodsituaties beoordeelt die het via zijn bewaking detecteert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Klaver, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over Russische desinformatiecampagnes

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about Russian disinformation campaigns, including Czech intelligence reports that Voice of Europe served as a conduit for Russian payments to Dutch politicians, and whether the Czech government was asked to share that information and whether further investigation and capacity investment are planned. The answer declines to answer in writing and asks that the questions be put orally in the plenary debate instead.
I request that you put the questions orally during the debate on the report that, according to the Czech secret service, Russia paid cash to Dutch and European politicians
Ik verzoek u de vragen mondeling te stellen tijdens het debat over het bericht dat volgens de Tsjechische geheime dienst Rusland cash betaalde aan Nederlandse en Europese politici
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over de Russische desinformatiecampagne via sociale media in Duitsland

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about a reported Russian disinformation campaign on X in Germany and whether similar campaigns target the Netherlands, including the adequacy of Dutch law, the EU Digital Services Act and platform responsibility. The minister acknowledged foreign interference risks, said no concrete Dutch cases were identified in the election, pointed to EU and NATO information sharing, announced a review of whole-of-government disinformation policy, and noted the European Commission opened a formal DSA procedure against X.

In its letter of 9 November 2023 the cabinet already announced it would examine whether, and if so how, the whole-of-government approach to disinformation about the core democratic processes should be strengthened.

In de brief 9 november 2023 heeft het kabinet daarom al aangekondigd te onderzoeken of, en zo ja hoe, de Rijksbrede aanpak van desinformatie over de kernprocessen van de democratie versterkt moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de dreigende sluiting vanhet Walaardt Sacré Kamp in Huis ter Heide

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Minister of Defence why the Walaardt Sacré Kamp refugee reception site in Huis ter Heide is being closed despite a shortage of reception places. The government answered that Defence's support was always temporary, that a parliamentary motion led to a gradual wind-down agreed for July 2024 with the municipality, and that most residents now have refugee status and are awaiting housing.
With this, I am honouring your motion.
Hiermee doe ik uw motie gestand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Van der Laan en Sjoerdsma over de rol van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken rondom het WK mannenvoetbal in Qatar

MPs asked whether the Foreign Ministry blocked open criticism of host country Qatar for the 2022 World Cup, kept risks for LGBTIQ+ visitors out of Parliamentary letters, and what has been done for migrant workers. The government denies prioritising trade, says the process was a delicate balancing of interests, and outlines its constructive-critical dialogue, ILO-linked reforms, and planned follow-up.
The official tension could well have been mentioned.
Het ambtelijk spanningsveld had wel genoemd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Paternotte over het rapport van Don’t Buy into the Occupation (DBIO) aangaande investeringen in nederzettingen op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

MPs Piri and Paternotte asked the Foreign Minister about a DBIO report finding European financial institutions, including Dutch ones and Booking.com, active in Israeli settlements, and why the Dutch discouragement policy is not working. The minister reaffirmed that settlement activity is undesirable, pointed to the existing discouragement policy and OECD guidelines, said the government will approach Dutch financial institutions and study the report's recommendations, and declined to say why Booking.com was not approached earlier beyond stating it had been in discussion with the ministry.
The cabinet will carefully study the recommendations in the report.
Het kabinet zal de aanbevelingen in het rapport zorgvuldig bestuderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Piri over het uitleveringsverdrag dat Nederland heeft gesloten met Marokko

MPs Mutluer and Piri asked the Justice Minister about the extradition treaty with Morocco, including its scope, the reliability of Moroccan justice, and safeguards for journalists and activists. The Minister explained the treaty extends extradition beyond multilateral-treaty offences to any offence with a sentence of at least one year, that political-offence refusal grounds apply, and that human rights assessments were made, but declined to give a judgement on Moroccan courts or offer blanket guarantees.
I refrain from giving a judgement on the Moroccan judiciary.
Ik onthoud mij van een oordeel over de Marokkaanse rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Mutluer en Piri over de aanhouding van medewerkers van NCTV en politie vanwege het lekken van staatsgeheime informatie

MPs Sneller, Mutluer and Piri asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the arrest of NCTV and police staff for allegedly leaking state secret information, including risks to people, critical infrastructure, timing of an investigation, and foreign contacts. The minister declined to give operational details pending criminal and Auditdienst Rijk investigations, said no signals currently show acute risk to critical infrastructure, and promised to inform parliament once the investigation concludes.
In the interest of those investigations, and given the risk of harm if sensitive or classified information reaches third parties prematurely, no additional information can be provided at this time.

In het belang van die onderzoeken en gelet op het afbreukrisico indien voortijdig gevoelige of gerubriceerde informatie bij derden terechtkomt, kan er op dit moment geen aanvullende informatie worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hammelburg, Piri, Van der Lee en Dassen  over ‘De Russische oorlog tegen Oekraïne is eenpraktijkexamen voor Europa – en de tijd begint te dringen’

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks and Volt asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether the government sees risks to US military aid to Ukraine from congressional gridlock and a possible 2024 US administration cutting support, and whether Europe can cover any shortfall. The government answered that US, European and international support remains essential, that a new House speaker has been appointed, that Europe must take more responsibility, and that it will continue support in consultation with allies while F-16 transfer and munitions decisions depend on training, infrastructure, US export approval and EU criteria.
The cabinet will continue to support Ukraine for as long as necessary.
Het kabinet blijft Oekraïne steunen zolang als dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over nieuwsberichten over Soedan

An MP from the Labour party asks the Foreign Minister about the conflict in Sudan, humanitarian aid, EU sanctions, and the security contract with Shield Protective Solutions, including whether the embassy knew of its links to the RSF. The minister answers that the conflict continues, describes Dutch humanitarian and diplomatic efforts, says the embassy did not know of the RSF links at the time, and explains the shift to Shield for security while promising an evaluation report early next year.
The House of Representatives will be informed about this.
De Kamer zal hierover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Piri over de actuele situatie in Israël en Gaza

MPs Klaver and Piri asked the Foreign Minister about humanitarian access, the al-Ahli hospital explosion, hostage release, Gaza blockade and the Rafah crossing. The minister answered that the Netherlands backs a humanitarian pause and unhindered aid, supports independent investigation via the ICC, and says it cannot yet determine whether a total blockade violates international law.
Thorough and independent investigation will be necessary to bring the relevant facts to light.
Gedegen en onafhankelijk onderzoek zal nodig zijn om de relevante feiten boven water te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de Nederlandse onthouding bij stemming in de VN Algemene Vergadering over een humanitair staakt-het-vuren

An MP asked why the Netherlands abstained on a UN General Assembly resolution calling for a humanitarian ceasefire in Gaza, and whether the full cabinet or vice-premiers were informed. The minister explains the abstention as a balance of supported elements against missing ones (Israel's right to self-defence, condemnation of Hamas, release of hostages), keeps EU unity, and admits in hindsight that broader consultation would have been better, while stating the steminstructie was not normally put to the cabinet.
As a rule, a voting instruction is not submitted to the Council of Ministers.
In de regel wordt een steminstructie niet voorgelegd aan de ministerraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de levering van F-35 onderdelen

An MP asks why the government did not block Dutch-routed deliveries of F-35 parts to Israel despite advice warning of possible humanitarian law violations, and asks for the advice, prior refusals and civilian casualty figures. The ministers answer that they chose not to intervene in the general licence NL009 on integrated foreign-policy and security grounds, provide the two internal memos and legal annexes, and decline to share diplomatic implications.

To meet your request as transparently as possible, we provide you with the full memos containing the legal elements as well as the other elements that contributed to the broad assessment underlying the decision taken.

Om zo transparant mogelijk aan uw verzoek tegemoet te komen geven we u de volledige nota's waarin u de juridische elementen aantreft evenals de andere elementen die hebben bijgedragen aan de brede afweging die ten grondslag ligt aan het genomen besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Piri over huwelijksdwang of achterlating in het buitenland

Two MPs asked ministers about forced marriage and abandonment of girls abroad, including BRP deregistration, prevalence data, residence and nationality recovery, legal aid and feminist foreign policy. The government answered that precise prevalence data are lacking, outlined existing registration and reporting rules, pointed to planned research and measures, and described routes for recovering residence status and nationality.
Precise and reliable figures on the extent of forced marriage in the Netherlands are lacking.
Precieze en betrouwbare cijfers over de omvang van huwelijksdwang in Nederland ontbreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Pakistaans homostel met geregistreerd partnerschap volgens IND geen koppel: 'Geen toekomst zonder Ali''

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about an IND decision not to accept the homosexuality of an asylum-seeking same-sex registered partner and how marriages and partnerships are weighed, including the verification role of civil registrars and the separate placement of the two partners. The State Secretary answered that partnership evidence is weighed on the whole file without decisive weight to formal status, that the IND does not aggregate such decisions, and that COA will try to keep family members together within legal limits.
Such information is not stored in a way that allows it to be made available in aggregated form.
Dergelijke informatie wordt niet opgeslagen op een manier dat dit geaggregeerd inzichtelijk gemaakt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Piri over de detentie van een Nederlander in Spanje

MPs Mutluer and Piri asked about the detention in Spain of a Dutch national from Tilburg, whether the Netherlands was involved, whether he was flagged for terrorism, and whether a 'white list' should be created. The ministers declined detailed comment citing the pending case and privacy rules, stated the Netherlands had no link to the Spanish grounds for arrest, noted he had since been returned to the Netherlands, and rejected a generic white list as unsuitable.
The case of the person concerned is currently before the court.
De zaak van betrokkene is op dit moment onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Piri en Van der Lee over de levering van F-16’s aan Oekraïne

Three MPs asked the government about the timeline, conditions, pilot training and number of F-16 aircraft to be delivered to Ukraine. The Minister of Defence answered that delivery depends on completed training, infrastructure, coalition coordination and US approval, that the Netherlands expects to make 12 to 18 aircraft available for a training centre in Romania, and that the exact numbers are not yet fixed.
Your House will be informed in due course about the envisaged delivery timeline.
Uw Kamer wordt op termijn nader geïnformeerd over het beoogde tijdpad van levering.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk, Boswijk, Ceder, Belhaj, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Sylvana Simons, Dassen en Christine Teunissen over de evacuatie van lokale oud-medewerkers van de Nederlands

MPs from many parties asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the evacuation and resettlement of local former Afghan Security Guards and other local staff, including whether guards were excluded and why EUPOL staff were refused. The government answered that individual requests are assessed under the 2014 interpreter arrangement and special scheme, that criteria were not tightened, and that the resettlement project was folded into the ministries' standing organisations while the remaining group of about 100 people is still being pursued.
Defence aims to take current insights into account in implementing policy and will therefore examine these signals further.
Defensie streeft ernaar actuele inzichten te betrekken bij de uitvoering van beleid en zal deze signalen derhalve nader onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kroger en Piri over de berichtgeving rondom de Tunesië-deal

MPs Kroger and Piri asked about the formal status, accountability and human rights safeguards of the EU-Tunisia memorandum of understanding on migration and partnership. The government answered that the MoU is a non-binding political commitment agreed by the European Commission, with no formal role for the European Parliament, and that existing human rights obligations are unchanged, while committing to press Tunisia on rights and to keep the House informed on implementation and funding.
There is no formal role for the European Parliament in the drafting of MoUs.
Er is geen formele rol van het Europees parlement bij de totstandkoming van MoU’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het artikel 'Ik dacht: ze gaan ons vermoorden. Ze gaan alle zwarte mensen in Tunesië vermoorden'

An MP asks the ministers whether they are aware of reports that Tunisian authorities expelled Black migrants without food, water or phones into the desert near the Libyan border, whether this breaches the EU-Tunisia MoU and human rights law, and what steps will be taken. The government says it is aware of worrying reports but that it is unclear what exactly happened, notes the MoU is not legally binding, and says it will keep raising migration management and human rights with Tunisia through EU and bilateral channels.
Based on the information known to the cabinet, it is unclear exactly what happened.
Op basis van de bij het kabinet bekende informatie is onduidelijk wat er precies is gebeurd.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omtzigt, Piri, Boswijk, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Christine Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Eppink, Van der Lee, Ephraim, Van Haga, Baudet, Ceder, Dassen, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Simons

MPs asked the government whether it recognises the expert opinion of Luis Moreno Ocampo that the Lachin blockade amounts to ongoing genocide against Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to prevent genocide and enforce the ICJ interim measures. The minister answers that the Netherlands is very concerned, follows the situation via EUMA and other sources, describes its duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and states that the EU and the Netherlands continue to call on Azerbaijan to comply with the ICJ order.
The Netherlands and the EU will continue to call on Azerbaijan to do so.
Nederland en de EU blijven Azerbeidzjan hiertoe oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Het leed in Hawija erkennen en verzachten is mislukt'

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked the Defence Minister about reports that Dutch-funded reconstruction in Hawija failed to directly compensate bombing victims, including questions on individual compensation, IOM and UNDP spending, alleged corruption, community involvement and a possible IOB evaluation. The Minister defended the 2020 decision for collective voluntary compensation, reported project outcomes, said there is no evidence of corruption in the final reports, declined an IOB study for now, and noted a possible virtual visit to Hawija.
Defence is in discussion with IOM about whether and how the financial accountability can be shared with your House.
Defensie is in gesprek met IOM of en hoe de financiële verantwoording met uw Kamer kan worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over de dood van een drie maanden oude baby in het aanmeldcentrum Ter Apel

MPs Kröger and Piri asked about the death of a three-month-old baby at the Ter Apel asylum centre, including unhygienic conditions, why the mother had to travel to Ter Apel despite holding a residence permit, and steps to prevent recurrence. The State Secretary acknowledged the poor conditions, said no causal link to the death could be established, and listed measures such as ending use of the sports hall for vulnerable residents and expanding capacity, though several answers were delayed or deferred to later policy responses.
Unfortunately I have not managed to answer your questions within the usual timeframe, as not all necessary information has yet been received.
Helaas is het mij niet gelukt om binnen de gebruikelijke termijn uw vragen te beantwoorden, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Hoe onderzoek naar nazi-uitingen binnen het leger werd gesaboteerd'

An MP from the PvdA asked the Defence Minister, after a NRC report, why an investigation into Nazi expressions within the armed forces was allegedly sabotaged, why a whistleblower was intimidated and why the COID handled reports in a non-independent way, plus whether an independent investigation will be held. The state secretary answered that such expressions are unacceptable, described existing screening and integrity measures, rejected the claim of systematic extremism and of a flawed investigation, and declined a new independent investigation while expressing regret over one withdrawn report and promising tighter handling of investigation data.
At this moment I have no reason to doubt the investigation and the conclusions attached to it.
Ik heb op dit moment geen reden om aan het onderzoek – en de daaraan verbonden conclusies – te twijfelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Kröger over het gebrek aan opvangplekken

MPs Piri and Kröger asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a looming shortage of asylum reception places, including whether 8,000 places would be missing by April and what concrete steps are being taken. The State Secretary answered that a shortage has been averted for now through coordinated measures, that many places are still needed, that ongoing monitoring and talks with municipalities and COA continue, and that the Spreidingswet is pending in parliament.
I have therefore asked the provincial coordination tables to coordinate the reception and housing needs.
Ik heb daarom aan de provinciale regietafels gevraagd om de opvang- en huisvestingsbehoefte te coördineren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over het aantal minderjarigen in (crisis)noodopvangvoorzieningen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why the promised overview of minors in crisis emergency shelters, showing locations and access to education and care, had not been sent, and for the latest figures before a debate. The State Secretary apologised for the delay, citing logistical issues from the 1 July closure of crisis shelters, gave a headcount of about 980 children across 89 locations, and declined to provide a location-by-location breakdown because it could be traced to individuals, promising a separate letter on conditions and access to education and care.
A concrete overview broken down by which locations children stay at would contain information that can be traced back to the individual, and for that reason I cannot provide it to you.
Een concreet overzicht waarbij is uitgesplitst op welke locaties kinderen verblijven zou informatie bevatten welke tot de persoon te herleiden is en kan ik u om die reden niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Afgevinkt en uitgezet'

MP Piri asks about a report that outsourced medical examinations (MediFirst) for asylum seekers rely on nurses without relevant expertise, do not record scars, and fall under no dedicated oversight. The State Secretary defends the medical advice procedure as sound, notes the IND may ask MediFirst follow-up questions, and says BIG registration and healthcare inspectorate/disciplinary oversight suffice, so no new oversight body is needed.
I do not consider it necessary to establish further supervision in addition to this.
Ik acht het niet nodig aanvullend hierop verder toezicht in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat militairen zelf moeten boeten voor de misstanden die ze melden

An MP asks the State Secretary of Defence about reports that soldiers who report misconduct are themselves punished, including questions on career consequences, independence of the COID, procedures, confidentiality and protection of whistleblowers. The government answers that Defence protects reporters, rejects retaliation, describes its procedures and monitoring, and commits to a feedback evaluation and further improvements.
Defence therefore does not accept it when commanders or supervisors confront reporters with this.
Defensie accepteert het dan ook niet wanneer commandanten of leidinggevenden melders hiermee confronteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Piri, Van der Lee, Dassen en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Germany unsure if Orbán fit to be ‘EU president’'

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks, Volt and VVD asked whether Hungary's upcoming EU Council presidency in July–December 2024 is acceptable given its unresolved rule-of-law and corruption problems, its Article 7 procedure, and risks to the MFF and Ukraine solidarity, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The minister replied that the rotation follows the agreed Council decision, that the cabinet will stress Hungary's presidency duties and keep pressing on rule of law, that it will not seek to change the rotation, and that it has no information on Germany opposing the presidency.
In the run-up to the Hungarian EU presidency, the cabinet will, together with as many like-minded member states as possible, emphasise that it expects Hungary to meet these responsibilities.
Het kabinet zal in aanloop naar het Hongaarse EU-voorzitterschap, samen met zo veel mogelijk gelijkgezinde lidstaten, benadrukken te verwachten dat Hongarije deze verantwoordelijkheden nakomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van Wijngaarden over het wetsvoorstel wat het verkrijgen van Servisch burgerschap makkelijker zou maken voor Russen

MPs Piri and Van Wijngaarden asked the Foreign Minister about a Serbian bill easing citizenship for Russians, its security risks, Russian influence, and EU/bilateral pressure on Serbia over sanctions and its alignment with EU foreign policy. The minister answered that the Commission has raised the bill, the Serbian parliament has postponed it, the government sees no signs of Russian influence, and it presses Serbia bilaterally and at EU level on sanctions and visa-related concerns.
The government continues to press Serbia bilaterally to adopt the sanctions.
Het kabinet blijft er bilateraal op aandringen dat Servië de sancties overneemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over Soedanese paspoorten op de Nederlandse ambassade

MP Piri asked the Foreign Minister about dozens of Sudanese passports left at the closed Dutch embassy in Khartoum, whether holders were warned, how many were contacted, and whether the government will ensure their safety. The minister answered that the embassy closed suddenly due to fighting, staff could not retrieve the passports, holders are being contacted individually, and support options such as official statements are being explored.
