The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has by now contacted several dozen passport holders individually by phone and email.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft inmiddels op individuele basis telefonisch en per email contact met enkele tientallen paspoorthouders.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van der Lee over de ophanden zijnde juridische hervormingen in Israël

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked the Foreign Minister about proposed Israeli judicial reforms curbing the Supreme Court, their effect on democracy and on Palestinians' legal recourse, and what Netherlands and EU steps are possible. The minister called the reforms concerning for judicial independence, said Netanyahu paused them for talks, and described raising concerns bilaterally and within the EU.
An independent judiciary is the foundation of a democratic constitutional state.
Een onafhankelijke rechterlijke macht is het fundament voor een democratische rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Piri over vergiftiging van schoolmeisjes in Iran

MPs Van der Lee and Piri asked the Foreign Minister about the poisoning of about 700 Iranian schoolgirls, whether the regime is responsible, and whether the Netherlands will push for ICC investigation and evidence-gathering programmes. The minister condemned the poisonings, said the perpetrators are unknown though Iranian authorities announced an inquiry and arrests, and explained that an ICC referral is legally unavailable while Nederland supports the UN Fact Finding Mission and evidence guidelines.
The cabinet will continue to closely follow this.
Het kabinet zal dit op de voet blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Westerveld over het voortduren van het gebrekkige onderwijsaanbod voor kinderen in asielopvangvoorzieningen

MPs Kröger, Westerveld and Piri asked about the continuing shortfall in education for children in asylum reception facilities, including delays, placement policy and whether gaps are structurally addressed. The State Secretary answered that data on children missing schooling is not yet available, that placement of families in crisis emergency shelters is undesirable but cannot always be refused, and that a bill and evaluations are in preparation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de aangekondigde wet in Georgië over het aanmerken van media en maatschappelijke organisaties als buitenlandse vertegenwoordigers

MP Piri asked the Foreign Minister about Georgia's proposed 'foreign influence' law that would label media and civil society organisations receiving foreign funding as foreign agents, asking about consequences for press freedom, EU accession and Dutch diplomatic action. The minister answered that the law would have been harmful, that it was formally withdrawn on 10 March, and that the Netherlands is raising press freedom and civil society concerns with Georgian authorities and within the EU.
On 8 March I conveyed the Dutch concerns about the first-reading adoption of this law via a tweet.
Ik heb op 8 maart jl. middels een tweet de Nederlandse zorgen over het aannemen in eerste lezing van deze wet overgebracht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Staaij, Ceder, Piri, Van der Lee, Koekkoek, Teunissen, Eppink en Van der Plas over de uitspraak van het Internationaal

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands will ensure Azerbaijan complies with the ICJ provisional measures order to reopen the Lachin corridor, and whether it has raised this with Azerbaijan. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Azerbaijan to comply through bilateral talks, the ambassador, and EU and multilateral channels, but gives no new concrete commitment beyond continued advocacy.
Following this ruling, the Netherlands called on the Azerbaijani authorities to comply with the ruling.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak de Azerbeidzjaanse autoriteiten opgeroepen om de uitspraak na te leven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van der Lee, Ceder, Teunissen, Piri, Kuzu en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de overdracht van Singh aan Nederland gebaseerd is op politieke onwil

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Foreign Ministers whether the government has done enough to bring detained Dutch national Jaitsen Singh from the United States to the Netherlands, and why a transfer (WOTS procedure) was not pursued after a parole denial. The government answers that a WOTS transfer does not meet the policy criteria because of insufficient ties to the Netherlands, that a pardon route on humanitarian grounds remains open, and that the family's willingness to take him in does not change the assessment.
The cabinet continues to make efforts to bring Mr Singh to the Netherlands on humanitarian grounds because of his advanced age and fragile health, provided he poses no danger to society.
Het kabinet blijft zich inspannen om de heer Singh op humanitaire gronden vanwege zijn hoge leeftijd en fragiele gezondheid naar Nederland te brengen, mits hij geen gevaar voor de samenleving vormt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Piri en Mutluer over het bericht dat de Duitse Rijksoverheid overweegt om mensen uit Turkije en Syrië die getroffen zijn door de aardbeving tijdelijk een visum te geven

MPs from the PvdA asked the Foreign Minister whether, following Germany and Belgium, the Netherlands would grant quick and simple visas to Turkish and Syrian earthquake victims with relatives in the Netherlands, and how visa policy is coordinated in Europe. The minister answered that first and second-degree relatives of Dutch residents already get priority visa processing under existing EU rules, with individual assessment and a 90-day Schengen visa, and described coordination with Schengen partners and EU bodies.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in close consultation with the Ministry of Justice and Security, facilitates first and second-degree relatives of Dutch residents from the earthquake area in applying for a Schengen visa.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken faciliteert, in nauwe samenspraak met het Ministerie van JenV, eerste/tweede graads-familieleden van Nederlanders uit het aardbevingsgebied bij de aanvraag van een Schengenvisum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van der Lee over het actieplan Nederland-Marokko

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked about the Netherlands-Morocco action plan, its timing relative to journalist Omar Radi's conviction, a clause on non-interference in internal affairs, and advance notice of NGO funding. The minister answered that the Netherlands took the initiative, that the plan is a non-binding cooperation document, that human rights remain part of dialogue despite the non-interference clause, and that the parties agreed to inform each other in advance of project funding, without inspection or approval.
The cabinet sees no link between the date of Mr. Radi's conviction and the date of signing of the action plan
Het kabinet ziet geen verband tussen de datum van de veroordeling van dhr. Radi en de datum van ondertekening van het actieplan

Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over het bericht ‘Asieldeal wéér onder vuur van rechter: uitspraak hekelt nu ook ander onderdeel van het akkoord’ en de uitspraak van rechtbank Den Haag

MPs Kröger and Piri asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the Den Haag court ruling that the generic six-month extension of asylum decision deadlines was not lawfully adopted, and about why IND backlogs persist despite staff growth. The State Secretary attributed high intake to multiple factors, explained that training takes about a year, said the extension will continue while an appeal is filed, and promised a further update on financial risks of penalty payments.
I am in continuous discussion with the IND about the measures needed to clear the backlogs.
Ik ben continu met de IND in gesprek over de benodigde maatregelen om de voorraden weg te werken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Piri over het bericht ‘Bedreigde Iraans-Nederlandse activist kreeg telkens nul op rekest bij Nederlandse politie voordat hij werd vermoord’

MPs Van der Lee and Piri asked how police failed to protect an Iranian-Dutch activist who reported repeated threats before being murdered, whether a reporting point for diaspora threats and stronger measures against foreign-regime intimidation are planned, and whether embassies of Morocco, Turkey, China and Iran were confronted. The minister declined to discuss the specific case for security reasons, said protection responsibility lies with local authorities, outlined diplomatic sanctions and a three-track approach, and promised further information on a reporting point.
For security reasons I cannot go into a specific case or the considerations made or not made.
Omwille van veiligheidsredenen kan ik niet ingaan op een specifieke casus en de afwegingen die wel of niet gemaakt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Piri over het bericht dat Israël een recent gebouwde Palestijnse basisschool heeft verwoest

MPs Van der Lee and Piri asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Israeli forces demolished a Palestinian primary school in Masafer Yatta, its legality under the UN Children's Rights Convention, the threatened forced relocation of residents, and the Netherlands' settlement discouragement policy. The minister said the Netherlands and the EU have raised serious concerns bilaterally and in EU statements, reiterated Israel's international obligations, and described the settlement discouragement policy's scope without listing concrete annual targets or results.
The Dutch discouragement policy applies to activities of Dutch companies when they directly contribute to the establishment and maintenance of settlements.
Het Nederlandse ontmoedigingsbeleid is van toepassing op activiteiten van Nederlandse bedrijven als zij direct bijdragen aan de aanleg en instandhouding van nederzettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Piri en Sylvana Simons over geheime gevangenissen langs de EU-buitengrenzen

MPs Kröger, Piri and Simons asked the state secretary whether reports of secret detention facilities at the EU external border in Bulgaria, funded with EU money and involving beatings and pushbacks, are true, what Frontex's role is, and what the Netherlands will do. The government said it cannot verify the reports, expects the Commission and national monitoring mechanisms to investigate, stated Frontex's role is limited to surveillance support, and said no signals of abuse came from Dutch Frontex staff.
The cabinet is of the view that reports of abuses at the external borders should be investigated by the Member States concerned.
Het kabinet is van mening dat berichtgeving over misstanden aan de buitengrenzen onderzocht moeten worden door de betrokken lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Brekelmans, Piri en Omtzigt over de podcast uitzending ‘Kim Lane Scheppele on Viktor Orbán’s Hungary’

Four MPs (Van Wijngaarden, Brekelmans, Piri, Omtzigt) asked the Foreign Minister about a podcast on Hungary's democratic decline, covering rule of law, EU sanctions, Russian diplomats, the IIB bank, Ukrainian refugees, EU funds, the state of emergency, EPPO membership and the EU's rule-of-law toolkit. The Minister answered that Hungary is not currently a fully democratic rule-of-law state, that the Commission should use all EU instruments, and that the Netherlands has consistently raised concerns and urged EPPO accession, while noting several questions fall to member states or the Commission.
Hungary violates fundamental values set out in Article 2 of the EU Treaty.
Hongarije schendt fundamentele waarden genoemd onder artikel 2 van het EU Verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Jasper van Dijk over een Europees programma ter ondersteuning van de evacuatie van bepaalde bijzonder kwetsbare personen uit Afghanistan

MPs Piri and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the Netherlands implemented the EU Council decision on evacuating vulnerable Afghans, how many were transferred, why others were not, and whether pending court-case applicants were checked for eligibility. Minister Hoekstra answered that 24 of a maximum 25 agreed journalists, human-rights defenders and judges and their core family were transferred, one more may follow, the national family definition was unchanged, and the government did not examine the EDEO list because it was compiled by the EDEO and not shared with it for privacy reasons.
The cabinet has not examined whether persons in the group belong to the category that would be eligible for the EDEO list.
Het kabinet heeft niet onderzocht of er personen tot de groep behoren die in aanmerking zouden komen voor de EDEO lijst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over het gebrekkige onderwijsaanbod voor kinderen in asielopvangvoorzieningen

MPs Kröger and Piri asked about children in asylum reception being moved to a cruise ferry without education in place, and why this happens, how often, and what measures will prevent repetition. The government admits the move should not have happened, acknowledges pressure on newcomer education, and points to planned legislation and a flexibilisation agenda to reduce relocations.
Since not all necessary facilities in Velsen were ready for the group, this group should not yet have been moved.
Aangezien voor de groep nog niet alle noodzakelijke voorzieningen in Velsen gereed waren, had deze groep echter nog niet verhuisd moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Piri over ongedocumenteerde studenten die eigenlijk niks kunnen met hun diploma als ze hun opleiding hebben afgerond

MPs De Hoop and Piri asked whether undocumented youths who finish vocational training cannot use their diplomas, whether they were overlooked in labour-shortage measures, and how the government views their exclusion from work, including the German 'Duldung' approach. The State Secretary answered that undocumented migrants are not part of the labour-shortage plan, that admitting them to the labour market is undesirable for migration and welfare reasons, and that this changes no existing policy.
The answers have no consequences for the existing policy.
De antwoorden hebben geen consequenties voor het geldende beleid.
Antwoord op schriftelijke vragen van de leden Piri en Kröger over ‘Nederland kan weer migranten uitzetten naar Marokko - maar mag geen kritiek meer geven op het land’

MPs Piri and Kröger asked whether the Netherlands has stopped publicly criticising human rights abuses in Morocco in exchange for renewed cooperation on migrant returns, and about a possible extradition treaty. The minister replied that the relationship is constructive, denied any agreement to refrain from public criticism, said human rights are discussed case by case and that exploring an extradition treaty is at official level, while committing only to keep the Chamber informed.
No agreements have been made that the Netherlands will no longer publicly voice criticism regarding human rights.
Er zijn geen afspraken gemaakt dat Nederland niet langer openbaar kritiek uit ten aanzien van mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Marokkanen 'ten einde raad' door problemen en fraude bij visa'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about long visa waiting times, slot resale fraud and the ministry's responsibility for outsourced visa processing for Moroccan applicants. The minister acknowledged ministry responsibility, cited capacity constraints and technical anti-fraud measures, and committed to raising processing capacity to 80% of pre-COVID levels by year end.
Yes. Increasing the processing capacity for visa applications submitted worldwide is an important priority.
Antwoord 5 Het verhogen van de capaciteit van de behandeling van de wereldwijd ingediende visumaanvragen is een belangrijke prioriteit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Kuzu, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Brekelmans, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons en Piri over het bericht dat waarnemers van de Organisatie voor Veiligheid en Samenwerkin

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about two Ukrainian OSCE staff members sentenced to over ten years by courts in the unrecognised Luhansk region, asking about their detention conditions, pressure on Russia, evacuation of local staff, and whether Turkey could help secure their release. The minister confirmed the sentences, said detention location is unknown, listed joint EU and OSCE calls for release, and said the OSCE Secretary General is working on their release.
At this time it is not known where the detainees are being held.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend waar de gevangenen worden vastgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Belhaj en Jasper van Dijk over de voortgang overbrenging uit Afghanistan

Three MPs asked whether the 1 November deadline for evacuations from Afghanistan applies only to people with passports who refused the offer, and whether people unable to travel through no fault of their own remain eligible. The minister confirmed both points: the deadline covers only passport holders who refused earlier, four of 28 such people did not respond, and those unable to travel for reasons beyond their control keep their eligibility with no deadline set.
For this group, no deadline has been set for the time being.
Voor deze groep is vooralsnog geen deadline gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Belhaj en Ceder over de voortgang overbrengingen Afghanistan

MPs Piri, Belhaj and Ceder asked the foreign and defence ministers about the progress of evacuations from Afghanistan, including whether an end date applies, how applications are assessed, and why former Dutch embassy guards were not evacuated. The minister answered that no end date has been set yet, that the criteria are applied as consistently as possible, and that the decision on the guards was made earlier and remains unchanged.
As promised during the debate of 31 March, the cabinet's intentions regarding a possible end date for the evacuation operation will be communicated to your House in advance.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het debat van 31 maart jl. zullen voornemens van het kabinet met betrekking tot een eventuele einddatum van de overbrengingsoperatie vooraf aan uw Kamer worden gecommuniceerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Kuzu, Van der Lee en Piri over het feit dat Taiwan graag waarnemend lid wil worden van de Internationale Burgerluchtvaartorganisatie

MPs from seven parties asked the government about Taiwan's wish to become an observer at the ICAO, including whether it could be invited under the Council's rules, its safety relevance for flights, and whether the Netherlands would support its participation at the 41st Assembly. The minister answered that Taiwan could in principle be invited as an 'other body' observer to the Council only if China agreed, is excluded from the Assembly under Taiwan's non-state status, and that the Netherlands supports meaningful Taiwan participation in coordination with like-minded countries while respecting its one-China policy.
Taiwan is not considered a state by the Netherlands and most other states in the world and therefore cannot in principle participate as an observer in these meetings.
Taiwan wordt door Nederland en de meeste andere staten in de wereld niet als staat beschouwd en kan daarom in principe niet als waarnemer aan deze vergaderingen deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Piri over het annuleren van Europride

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Piri asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would protest Serbia's cancellation of Europride and press for it to go ahead under police protection, and whether this should weigh in EU accession assessments. The minister agreed that freedom of assembly must be upheld and said the Netherlands has raised the issue bilaterally and with EU partners, with the Commission expected to address it in its progress report.

Since the reports on Europride, the Netherlands has consulted closely with civil society partners in Serbia, the EU and like-minded countries on possible options for action both publicly and behind the scenes.

Nederland heeft sinds de berichtgeving over Europride nauw overleg gevoerd met maatschappelijke partners in Servië, met de EU en met gelijkgezinde landen over mogelijke handelingsopties voor zowel voor als achter de schermen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Omtzigt over het eerdere totaal ontwijkende antwoord op de vraag hoeveel olie en andere brandstoffen Nederland uit Rusland importeert en het bericht 'Who’s Still Buying Fossil Fuel

MPs Piri and Omtzigt asked why the government earlier gave an evasive answer on Russian oil and fuel imports, and about reports that the Netherlands is a leading importer of Russian gas and that Russian-origin oil reaches Europe via Indian diesel. The minister answers that the CREA figures are modelled rather than official customs data, that monthly customs data is only available up to April 2022 and some data is withheld for competitive reasons, and that the government is pursuing phase-out and EU sanctions while acknowledging Indian diesel of Indian origin falls outside the sanctions.
As indicated in the answer to question 2, the information for the Visual Capitalist image was produced by the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA).
Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 2 is de betreffende informatie voor de afbeelding van Visual Capitalist geproduceerd door het Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over de intentie om het recht van statushouders op gezinshereniging te beperken

MPs Kröger and Piri asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the planned restriction of family reunification rights for refugees with status, and whether it complies with the Children's Rights Convention and EU law. The State Secretary answered that the best interests of the child remain central, that reunification is only postponed by up to six months, and that the measure was chosen as necessary to address the reception crisis, while the courts would ultimately judge its legal tenability.
In every situation it is ultimately up to the judiciary to rule on the legal tenability.
In elke situatie is het uiteindelijk aan de rechtspraak om te oordelen over de juridische houdbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Piri en Ceder over de toezeggingen die zijn gedaan aan de veiligheidsregio’s t.a.v. (extra) crisisnoodopvanglocaties voor asielzoekers

MPs Piri and Ceder asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the government's commitments to safety regions on medical care, staffing and registration at emergency reception locations for asylum seekers. The answers say medical care at some locations is not yet adequate, around 80 civil servants are assigned to specific locations with about 30 active, and registration is being intensified.
The cabinet is currently examining whether it is possible to organise care with other parties in the regions where this has not yet succeeded.
Momenteel onderzoekt het kabinet of het mogelijk is met andere partijen alsnog de zorg te organiseren in de regio's waar dat tot nu toe nog niet gelukt is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht ‘Moroccan authorities accused of trying to cover up Melilla deaths’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Moroccan authorities tried to cover up deaths at the Melilla border, including calls for an independent investigation and questions on EU funding and mistreatment of migrants. The minister condemned the events, said Spanish and Moroccan investigations are underway, and that the government lacks independent information on several allegations.
At this moment the cabinet does not have information on exactly what happened during the tragic events of 24 June
Op dit moment beschikt het kabinet niet over informatie over wat zich precies heeft afgespeeld tijdens de tragische gebeurtenissen op 24 juni
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de lange wachttijden bij het aanvragen van een Schengenvisum voor Nederland

MP Piri (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister why Schengen visa applications from Suriname and Morocco take four to six months, despite a 15-day standard, and what will be done. Minister Hoekstra attributed the delays to a Covid-era reduction in processing capacity, a capped intake of applications in high-volume countries, and recruitment of staff, with a target of 80% of 2019 output by year-end.
The aim is for Schengen visa issuance to reach 80% of pre-Covid 2019 output by the end of this year, so that visa applicants can again submit their applications within the applicable deadline.

Het streven is dat de Schengenvisumverlening eind dit jaar 80% bedraagt van de productie in het pre-Covid jaar 2019, waarmee visumaanvragers in staat worden gesteld hun visumaanvraag weer binnen de geldende termijn te kunnen indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Sylvana Simons en Belhaj over het bericht ‘Afghaans ambassadepersoneel moet betalen voor verblijf in azc's’

MPs asked whether it is fair that former Afghan embassy staff must pay a contribution for asylum reception from their severance pay, given they still lack permanent housing and job offers fell through. The Minister says BZ provided extensive psychosocial and job support, that job offers were cancelled in 14 cases due to distance from housing, that 18 of 37 have been allocated housing, and that the small contribution under the REBA rules is justified.
A small contribution under the REBA scheme is realistic and justified, partly in light of all the efforts BZ as former employer has made and is still making.
Een geringe eigen bijdrage conform de REBA-regeling is reëel en gerechtvaardigd, mede in het licht van alle gedane en nog lopende inspanningen die BZ als voormalig werkgever heeft gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Piri over het bericht ‘’Honderden gemartelde homo’s in Tsjetsjenië, toch doen PwC, Deloitte en KPMG er zaken’

MPs Thijssen and Piri asked the ministers about reports that PwC, Deloitte and KPMG do business in Chechnya despite serious human rights abuses, and whether the Dutch government will hold these firms to account under OECD guidelines and due diligence rules. The ministers said the government has concerns about Chechnya, that sanctions target individuals rather than firms, that the firms are largely not Dutch-registered, and that the government will pursue IMVO legislation at EU level without committing to a specific action against the firms.
The cabinet cannot assess whether these companies have insufficiently met their due diligence obligation.
Het kabinet kan niet beoordelen of deze bedrijven hun due diligence-verplichting onvoldoende zijn nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Kröger over het bericht ‘Verdriet en onbegrip over starre aanmeldprocedure in Ter Apel: 'Niemand kan dit uitleggen''

MPs Piri and Kröger asked why newly arriving family members (nareizigers) of asylum status holders must still register at the Ter Apel reception centre despite the shortage of places, and whether the obligation could be dropped. The Secretary of State answered that registration is needed for BRP enrolment, TB screening and identity checks, that a separate Zevenaar route exists for some groups, and that COA and IND are working towards a change by end 2022 without yet committing to scrapping the obligation.
I agree that it would be good if the process for family members whose sponsor takes part in the guest arrangement or hotel arrangement no longer burdened the reception in Ter Apel.

Ik deel dan ook dat het goed zou zijn als het proces voor nareizigers van wie de referent deelneemt aan de logeerregeling of de hotelregeling en de verblijfplaats van de vreemdeling ook opvangmogelijkheden biedt voor de nagereisde familieleden, niet meer de opvang in Ter Apel zou belasten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Nauwere samenwerking tussen Nederlandse en Marokkaanse politie’

MPs Piri and Mutluer asked the government why it pursued closer police cooperation with Morocco before answering earlier questions, and whether this could intimidate Moroccan political opponents in the Netherlands given past torture and spyware allegations. The minister answered that Morocco is an important partner against organised crime, that an extradition treaty would only be explored, and that the government finds the alleged spyware use unacceptable, while leaving the allegations to Moroccan authorities and deferring the written consultation answers to a later date.
The visit of the police chief to Morocco was intended as a get-to-know-you meeting, to strengthen relations and discuss mutual interests in better cooperation to combat organised crime.

Het bezoek van de korpschef aan Marokko stond in het teken van nadere kennismaking, het aanhalen van de relaties en het bespreken van de wederzijdse belangen in betere samenwerking om georganiseerde criminaliteit te bestrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de steun aan een Nederlander die in Syrië gevangen zat en gemarteld is

An MP asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers why the government did little to find and help a Dutch citizen from Arnhem detained and tortured in Syria, and whether his case could support prosecution or state liability proceedings. The government answered that consular options in Syria were extremely limited, that it kept the family informed and explored options, and that it follows the family's decision on whether the case is used in the liability claim.
The Dutch policy of not entering into diplomatic contacts with the Syrian government is motivated by the war crimes and human rights violations committed by the Assad regime.
Het Nederlandse beleid om geen diplomatieke contacten met de Syrische overheid aan te gaan is ingegeven door de oorlogsmisdrijven en mensenrechtenschendingen door het regime van Assad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Omtzigt over de olietanker Sunny Liger

MPs Piri and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the tanker Sunny Liger carrying Russian oil, including contacts with buyers, options to block docking, shipment lists, and monthly import figures. The minister answered that the government had no contact with the owners, the ship had left Dutch waters, no shipment list was available, and some import data was withheld on competition grounds.
Some of this information cannot be made available by Statistics Netherlands due to competitive interests.
Een deel van deze informatie kan door het CBS niet beschikbaar worden gesteld vanwege concurrentiebelangen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Piri, Kuzu, Teunissen, Stoffer, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Brekelmans en Dassen over het gebrek aan humanitaire toegang in de Tigray-regio in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the lack of humanitarian access to Tigray, Ethiopia, including calls for UN investigations, sanctions, safe zones and press freedom. The minister answered that Nederland supports independent investigation and humanitarian access, has pressed for sanctions and an arms embargo within the EU without sufficient support, and will raise press access with the EU Special Envoy.
The Netherlands will continue to press, in EU and international contexts, on the three priorities mentioned above.
Nederland zal zich in blijven zetten, in EU- en internationaal verband, op de hierboven genoemde drie prioriteiten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Jasper van Dijk over het besluit van het Israëlisch Hooggerechtshof dat de weg vrijmaakt voor gedwongen uitzetting van een grote groep Palestijnen uit Masafer Yatta

MPs Piri and Jasper van Dijk asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands will condemn and act against an Israeli Supreme Court ruling enabling forced eviction of about 1,000 Palestinians from Masafer Yatta. The minister said the Netherlands respects Israeli judicial independence but is concerned, has urged Israel bilaterally and with EU partners not to act on the ruling, and will keep monitoring the case without announcing new concrete measures.
The Netherlands respects the independence of the judiciary in Israel, but is very concerned about the possible consequences of this ruling.
Nederland respecteert de onafhankelijkheid van de rechtspraak in Israël, maar is zeer bezorgd over de mogelijke gevolgen van deze uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Thijssen en Piri over de gevolgen van de oorlog in Oekraïne voor gaslevering

Three PvdA MPs asked the minister about gas supply risks from the war in Ukraine, including scenarios for a halt in Russian gas, low storage levels, and the Groningen phase-out. The minister answered at length, referring to ENTSO-G outlooks, the Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas, storage subsidies and earlier Kamerbrieven, while committing to share future analyses with the Kamer.
As soon as new ENTSO-G analyses are public, they will be shared with the Kamer.
Zodra er nieuwe analyses van ENTSO-G openbaar zijn, zullen die met de Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van der Graaf en Piri over de situatie aan de grens met Oekraïne

MPs asked the government about human trafficking risks for Ukrainian refugees at the border, including unaccompanied children, and whether it would press for EU coordination and raise the issue in Council meetings. The government answered that it shares the concerns, has raised them in EU and UN contacts, and describes registration, monitoring and awareness measures in the Netherlands.
The cabinet generally shares UNHCR's concerns about signals of human traffickers in Europe exploiting vulnerable people, including unaccompanied children fleeing Ukraine.

Het kabinet deelt in algemene zin de zorgen van UNHCR over signalen van mensenhandelaren in Europa die misbruik maken van kwetsbare personen, inclusief alleenstaande kinderen die uit Oekraïne vluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van der Lee, Kröger, Piri en Thijssen over het bericht dat Rusland stopt met het leveren van aardas aan Polen en Bulgarije

MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about Russia halting gas supplies to Poland and Bulgaria, Dutch firms' dealings with Gazprom and Gazprombank, EU and Dutch preparedness for next winter, and whether Russian state firms like Gazprom can be sanctioned out of the Dutch energy system. The minister answered that Dutch firms' use of Gazprombank and new Gazprom contracts is unknown, that the Dutch plans are set out in earlier letters, that the Bergermeer storage cost levy is still being designed, and that the legal options to exclude Russian firms are under study with a further letter promised.
The House will be further informed about this.
Hierover wordt uw Kamer nog nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sylvana Simons en Piri over de mishandeling van asielzoekers uit Wit-Rusland in Polen

MPs Simons and Piri asked about reported mistreatment, arbitrary detention and possible racism against asylum seekers from Belarus in Poland, and how the government presses Poland and the EU to ensure equal treatment and enforce EU law. The minister said the government finds the reports worrying, supports border detention under EU rules with safeguards, has raised rule-of-law and humanitarian concerns bilaterally and in EU bodies, and noted that the European Commission, as guardian of the treaties, can act under Article 258.
The government attaches importance to member states complying with Union law, especially where fundamental rights are concerned.
Het kabinet hecht eraan dat lidstaten het Unierecht naleven, in het bijzonder wanneer dit fundamentele rechten betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Turkse zakenman Kavala veroordeeld tot levenslange gevangenisstraf'

An MP from the PvdA asks the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the life sentence imposed on Turkish businessman and activist Kavala, including demands to press Turkey for his release, to remove Turkey from the Council of Europe, and to halt accession talks and customs union modernisation. The minister replies that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the case, supports the EU statement and the Council of Europe infringement procedure, backs a rule-of-law condition in customs union talks, and supports suspending pre-accession aid, but gives no firm commitment on sanctions or bilateral steps beyond waiting for the Council of Europe process.
The cabinet will continue to convey this message in various forums and at various levels as described above, and will also do so at the next appropriate bilateral contact moment.

Het kabinet zal deze boodschap blijven uitdragen, in verschillende fora en op verschillende niveaus zoals beschreven in bovenstaande antwoorden, en zal dit ook doen bij het volgende passende bilaterale contactmoment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Piri over de Russische 'sigarettenkoning' die onder Europese sancties uitkomt, omdat Nederland er niet in slaagt om zijn vermogen te bevriezen

MPs Kuzu and Piri asked whether Russian oligarch Kesajev's assets can be frozen under EU sanctions, given his resignation from a supervisory board, and how control, ownership, UBO identification and supervision by DNB work. The government answered that resignation alone does not avoid sanctions, that control can be decisive, that DNB confidentiality limits disclosure of individual cases, and that Netherlands will keep pressing for lowering the ownership threshold from 50% to 25%.
Furthermore, no funds, economic resources or other benefits may be made available, directly or indirectly, to sanctioned persons, such as shareholders.
Daarnaast mogen er (direct en indirect) geen tegoeden en economische middelen of andere voordelen ter beschikking worden gesteld aan gesanctioneerde (rechts)personen zoals aandeelhouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van der Graaf en Piri over de situatie aan de grens met Oekraïne

MPs from ChristenUnie and PvdA asked the government about long border waits for Ukrainian refugees, humanitarian funding, reported discrimination against Roma at the Hungarian border and trafficking risks. The government answered that it finds long waits undesirable, is supporting neighbouring states via Frontex, EUAA and EU civil protection, increased humanitarian funding, and found no evidence of discrimination on the EU side while stating it monitors the situation closely.
The Netherlands intends to respond positively to this.
Nederland is voornemens hier positief op te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Kuiken, Nijboer en De Hoop over 50.000 opvangplekken voor vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne

Opposition PvdA MPs asked how the government will support municipalities in securing and managing about 50,000 reception places for Ukrainian refugees, and about preparations for education, healthcare, housing, language lessons and work. The government answered that safety regions coordinate place creation with municipalities, a national reception programme is being prepared, and that housing, education and healthcare measures are being worked out, with further letters promised.
The cabinet considers it important that displaced persons from Ukraine residing in our country have the opportunity to learn the Dutch language
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat ontheemden uit Oekraïne die in ons land verblijven de mogelijkheid hebben om de Nederlandse taal te leren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Kröger over verdrinkingen bij «pushbacks» bij de Egeïsche eilanden

MPs Piri and Kröger asked the Foreign Minister about alleged violent pushbacks in the Aegean that led to drownings, and what the government would do to stop them and to press Greece and the Commission. The minister answered that the Netherlands actively raises concerns about alleged pushbacks bilaterally and with the Commission, that the Commission can start infringement proceedings, that a Greek prosecutor's investigation is pending, and that a state visit to Greece is postponed.
The cabinet therefore actively takes a position against alleged pushbacks and raises this both in multilateral and bilateral contexts.
Het kabinet neemt dan ook actief stelling tegen vermeende pushbacks en kaart dit, zowel in multilateraal als bilateraal verband aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het krantenartikel ‘Invallen in grensregio: politie stuit op ‘Roemeense slaven’ die in Nederlandse slachthuizen werken’

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports of Romanian workers exploited in Dutch slaughterhouses, including whether temp agencies are involved, whether permanent contracts should be mandatory, and how housing across the border is used to evade Dutch wage deductions. The minister condemns the abuses, points to ongoing investigations and cross-border cooperation with Germany, but declines to name agencies or slaughterhouses and offers no binding new rules.
I cannot go into ongoing investigations.
Op lopende onderzoeken kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Piri over de voorbereidingen voor de opvang van Oekraïners die hun land moeten ontvluchten vanwege de Russische invasie

MPs Ploumen and Piri asked about preparations for receiving Ukrainians fleeing the Russian invasion, including EU coordination, capacity, asylum procedures and whether Ukraine should remain a safe country of origin. The government answered that it is preparing for large-scale reception with municipalities and safety regions, has imposed a half-year decision and departure moratorium, and has suspended Ukraine's safe-country designation, but gave mostly general answers and referred to earlier letters.
The designation of Ukraine as a safe country of origin has also been suspended for at least the same period, until a new reassessment has taken place.
Ook is de aanwijzing van Oekraïne als veilig land van herkomst opgeschort voor in ieder geval dezelfde periode, totdat een nieuwe herbeoordeling zal hebben plaatsgevonden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Teunissen, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Simons en Dassen over het lot van de Afghaanse ambassadebewakers

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Afghan guards employed by an external contractor at the Dutch embassy in Kabul were not evacuated, when the Belhaj motion called for evacuating those who assisted the Dutch government, and whether the contractor was informed of the decision. The minister answered that the guards were not embassy employees and guarded other states' diplomatic missions, so they fell outside the evacuation criteria; he acknowledged the contractor received no timely written reply and that the lists and correspondence are shared only confidentially.
The request of 15 August and both reminders are shared with you on a confidential basis.
Het verzoek van 15 augustus en beide rappels worden op vertrouwelijke basis met u gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Piri over het artikel 'VN: Taliban hebben al ruim honderd voormalige functionarissen gedood in Afghanistan'

MPs Simons and Piri asked the Foreign Minister whether a UN report of over a hundred killings of former officials by the Taliban proves risks despite their amnesty, and what this means for evacuation policy and protection of Afghans. The minister calls the reports deeply concerning, notes the Taliban deny central policy and attribute killings to personal disputes, says evacuation criteria remain unchanged while alternative routes are explored, and outlines UN human rights monitoring steps including a Special Rapporteur.
These reports are extremely worrying and point to gross violations of human rights.
Deze berichten zijn uiterst zorgelijk en duiden op grove schendingen van de mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Piri over het bericht “In Brussel hat Putin schon gesiegt”

MPs Ploumen and Piri asked the Prime Minister whether the Netherlands had resisted excluding Russia from SWIFT in EU discussions, and how that squared with calls for maximum sanctions, asking for a reply before the upcoming debate. The Prime Minister denied that the Netherlands opposed SWIFT exclusion, saying it has consistently pushed for the strongest possible package including SWIFT, and answered the remaining questions by referring back to that answer.
No. The Netherlands has consistently advocated for as large and severe a package as possible, with all options on the table.
Nee. Nederland heeft steeds gepleit voor een zo groot en zwaar mogelijk pakket, waarbij alle opties op tafel liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het artikel 'Zijn mensenrechten nou universeel of niet?'

MP Piri asked the Foreign Minister whether human rights are universal, whether national variation is allowed, and whether the 'receptor approach' has a place in foreign policy. The minister answered that human rights are universal and indivisible, that national implementation may differ but must rest on internationally developed principles, and that the receptor approach is undesirable and has no place in Dutch foreign policy.
Yes, human rights are universal, indivisible and mutually dependent.
Ja, mensenrechten zijn universeel, ondeelbaar en onderling afhankelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Ellemeet, Van der Graaf, Piri, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu en Teunissen over het bericht 'Polish coalition dynamics complicate rule-of-law talks, says EU’s justi

MPs asked the government whether the EU rule-of-law conditionality mechanism would be activated before Hungary's April 2022 elections and why it had not yet been used, and urged the Netherlands to press the Commission. The minister replied that the Commission had delayed the mechanism pending guidelines and a Court of Justice ruling (issued 16 February 2022), that the procedure takes at least three months so cannot be finished before the Hungarian vote, and that the Netherlands continues to urge swift guidelines and activation.

The government continues to urge the Commission to fully use the MFK rule-of-law regulation by establishing guidelines as soon as possible and starting the procedure to suspend or stop payments of EU funds.

Het kabinet blijft er bij de Commissie op aandringen om de MFK-rechtsstaatverordening volledig te benutten, door nu zo snel mogelijk richtsnoeren vast te stellen, en de procedure om tot de opschorting of stopzetting van uitkering van EU-middelen te komen, te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Ceder, Koekkoek, Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Piri  en Kuzu over afwijzingen kort verblijf familieleden Syrische Nederlanders

MPs asked why Syrian visitors for family visits, even when they appear to meet the Visa Code conditions, are refused at a high rate (55% for Syrians overall, about 75% for family visits), and whether the Syrian war is treated as breaking ties to the home country. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that each application is assessed on its merits under the Visa Code, that refusals mostly reflect insufficient ties to the country of origin and doubts about timely return, and that Syrian nationals can only obtain a family visit visa if these concerns are resolved.
Every visa application is assessed on its own merits in accordance with the provisions of the Visa Code.
Alle visumaanvragen worden echter op hun eigen merites beoordeeld overeenkomstig de bepalingen van de Visumcode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Nederland kon bewijzen dat journalist Omar Radi geen spion was, waarom deed het dat niet?'

An MP asks the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands did not attend or actively pursue the trial of journalist Omar Radi in Morocco, despite earlier claims that the case was observed, and whether it contacted Radi's family or lawyer. The minister answers that the embassy attended other hearings but not the first-instance trial, that Morocco must ensure a fair process, and that the Netherlands rejected spying allegations and sent letters but does not interfere in the proceedings.
It is up to Morocco to guarantee a careful process. The Netherlands does not interfere in the course of justice.
Het is aan Marokko om een zorgvuldig proces te garanderen. Nederland mengt zich niet in de rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Gevluchte Afghanen moeten bij vertrek kleren achterlaten'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why Afghan evacuees must leave clothing and belongings behind when moved between temporary shelters, and what is being done about frequent relocations and the motion on a warm welcome. The State Secretary acknowledged the situation is undesirable, said COA tries to provide tailored transport and storage, and promised a separate letter on the motion's implementation.
This situation is undesirable and COA aims for more structural shelter where residents can stay longer.
Deze situatie is onwenselijk en het COA streeft naar meer structurele opvang waar bewoners langer kunnen verblijven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Koekkoek, Jasper van Dijk, Kröger, Piri en Ceder over het Fiche 'Voorstel voor een Raadsbesluit betreffende voorlopige noodmaatregelen ten behoeve van Letland, Litouwen en Polen'

Six MPs from D66, Volt, SP, GroenLinks, PvdA and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether emergency measures for Latvia, Lithuania and Poland under Article 78(3) TFEU are still necessary, legally grounded, time-limited and consistent with asylum and human rights safeguards, including the risk of pushbacks. The government answered that the Commission's assessment of an unprecedented influx from Belarus justifies the measures, that the measures are time-limited to six months, that they largely codify existing derogations, and that it will press these states on lawful border management while not withholding support for the proposal.
The government closely follows the situation at the borders with Belarus and considers the European Commission's assessment of the situation of great importance.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie aan de grenzen met Belarus nauwlettend en acht daarbij het oordeel van de Europese Commissie ten aanzien van de beoordeling van de situatie van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Gijs van Dijk over het besluit van Israël om zes Palestijnse mensenrechtenorganisaties als terroristisch aan te merken

MPs Piri and Gijs van Dijk asked the Dutch government about Israel's designation of six Palestinian human rights NGOs as terrorist organisations, including whether the government shares concerns that this aims to intimidate donors and whether it has evidence for the allegations. The government said it shares serious concern, has requested the underlying information from Israel without yet judging its reliability, and that the Dutch-Israeli defence cooperation will not be reviewed.
The Netherlands has, in bilateral contacts and through the EU, called for this information to be shared, including with the NGOs concerned.
Nederland heeft in bilaterale contacten en via de EU opgeroepen deze informatie te delen, ook met de betrokken ngo's.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu, Teunissen, Simons, Van der Plas en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse Zaken weigert Afghaanse bewakers ambassade Kabul te evacueren’

MPs asked why Dutch embassy security guards employed via a subcontractor in Kabul were not evacuated while Hungarian guards were, and whether a new direct-employment criterion was introduced without informing parliament. The government answered that the criteria for evacuation (Belhaj motion) were unchanged, that embassy guards fall under host-state responsibility and their employer is responsible, and gave figures on remaining interpreters and Afghans awaiting transfer.
There is no question of a new criterion.
Er is geen sprake van een nieuw criterium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Van de Nederlandse rechter trekt de ambassade zich weinig aan’

MPs Piri and Gijs van Dijk asked the Foreign Minister about reports that foreign embassies in the Netherlands, including those of Egypt, Morocco, Saudi Arabia and Kuwait, ignore Dutch court rulings on the treatment of their local staff, and what the government will do about it. The minister said embassies must respect Dutch law, that the ministry reminded the ambassadors of this, and that it can mediate in labour disputes only with both parties' consent, while international immunity limits enforcement against foreign states.
All foreign diplomatic and consular missions established in the Netherlands must respect Dutch law, including the mandatory provisions of Dutch labour law.

Alle in Nederland gevestigde buitenlandse diplomatieke en consulaire vertegenwoordigingen dienen de Nederlandse wet, inclusief de dwingende bepalingen van het Nederlandse arbeidsrecht, te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Ellemeet, Koekkoek en Teunissen over het bericht over mogelijke push back van een groep van 27 vluchtelingen op het Griekse eiland Lesbos

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary about reports of a group of 27 refugees hiding on Lesbos to avoid alleged pushback, including claims of a pushback of a minor, unlawful strip searches of detained activists, Greek laws criminalising aid and restricting lawyers, and the status of an independent EU monitoring mechanism. The government answered that it awaits findings from Greek and EU investigations, supports an independent monitoring mechanism, notes the Commission is responsible for enforcement, and does not accept that pushbacks are normal practice.
In the absence of independent information, I await the results of such investigations.
Bij het ontbreken van eigenstandige informatie wacht ik de resultaten van dergelijke onderzoeken af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en van der Lee over het bericht ‘Wij waren hun enige hoop’ van de Groene Amsterdammer

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked about a Groene Amsterdammer report on the end of Dutch funding to the White Helmets via Mayday Rescue, including the IOB review, the Grant Thornton audit and the withheld final payment. The ministers answered that the contract simply expired in November 2018 due to changed security conditions, defended the IOB process and the withholding of EUR 57,435, and said resumption of stabilisation support is not appropriate, while noting humanitarian funding via Grand Challenges Canada.
There was no decision to stop Dutch support to the foundation Mayday Rescue: the contract for the activity expired on 30 November 2018.
Er is geen sprake geweest van een besluit tot stopzetting van de Nederlandse steun aan de stichting Mayday Rescue: het contract van de betreffende activiteit liep af per 30 november 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht ‘Polen ligt met volle kracht op ramkoers met Europa’

MP Piri asks the Foreign Minister about the Polish Constitutional Tribunal ruling challenging EU law primacy, and what the Netherlands will do via Article 7 procedures, bilateral pressure, Commission action, the RRF and the rule-of-law conditionality mechanism. The minister answers that the ruling has far-reaching EU implications, that the Netherlands backs Commission action and will push for infringement proceedings and rule-of-law measures, but acknowledges a four-fifths majority for Article 7 steps is unrealistic.
The Netherlands will keep calling on the Commission to start infringement proceedings against Poland.
Nederland zal de Commissie blijven oproepen om een inbreukprocedure tegen Polen te starten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Piri over de evacuatie uit Afghanistan

MPs Omtzigt and Piri asked the government about the Afghanistan evacuation, including embassy correspondence, meeting records, military protection, Council of Ministers decisions, EUPOL interpreters and a promised independent inquiry. The ministers answered most questions substantively, provided some documents with redactions, declined to provide phone-call records because none exist, and committed to establishing an independent inquiry commission.
The cabinet will establish an independent external temporary commission to investigate the crisis approach, including the evacuations of the recent period.
Antwoord 17 Een onafhankelijke externe commissie van tijdelijke aard om onderzoek toe doen naar de crisisaanpak inclusief de evacuaties van de afgelopen periode zal door het kabinet worden ingesteld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri en Van der Werf over de grondhouding bij de beoordeling van asielzaken door de IND en de rol van taalexperts bij het beantwoorden van vragen over de identiteit

MPs Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri and Van der Werf asked the State Secretary about the IND's basic attitude toward asylum cases and the use of language experts in identity assessments, citing an internal 2009 discussion paper and a specific Burundi case. The State Secretary answered that the IND does not steer toward rejection, that language analyses are only supplementary indications, and that no independent investigation is needed given court review.
It has never been IND policy, either now or in the past, to primarily steer toward rejecting asylum applications.
Het is nimmer het beleid van IND geweest, in het heden noch het verleden, om primair te sturen op het afwijzen van asielaanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Piri en Jasper van Dijk over het Follow the Money artikel over Nordstream 2 en de Werkgroep Energie

MPs Van der Lee, Piri and Jasper van Dijk asked the government about a Follow the Money report on the Dutch-Russian Energy Working Group, its restart, possible agreements linked to Nord Stream 2, and the protocol and sanctions implications. The minister replies that the working group made no agreements on specific projects such as Nord Stream 2, that the 2018 protocol has no formal status, and that the government keeps a neutral position on Nord Stream 2 as a commercial project.
There was (and is) no question of agreements on specific energy projects, such as Nord Stream 2.
Er was (en is) geen sprake van afspraken over specifieke energieprojecten, zoals Nord Stream 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht ‘Voor vrouw is sfeer op KMA giftig’

An MP asked the Defence State Secretary about reports that the atmosphere at the Royal Military Academy (KMA) is toxic for women, asking how long problems with social safety have been known, what action plans exist, who is responsible, and what is being done about women's position. The minister answered that structural measures under a social-safety plan of action are being embedded, that the KMA-specific Taskforce plan is being implemented over three to five years, and that a planned evaluation of the independent reporting point is due by mid-2022.
The plan of the NLDA, and therefore also specifically for the KMA and the KIM, is currently being implemented.
Het plan van de NLDA, en daarmee ook specifiek voor de KMA en het KIM, wordt op dit moment geïmplementeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri en Simons over het rapport 'Onzichtbaar' van de Amsterdamse Ombudsman en het WODC-onderzoek naar mensen zonder rechtmatig verblijf

MPs asked the government about the Amsterdam Ombudsman's estimate that 4-6% of pupils in Amsterdam schools are undocumented, the national share, post-18 education and work prospects, economic costs, and return figures. The minister gave national percentages of students without a BSN, said the national share of undocumented children is likely lower, announced a study on newcomer funding, and declined further research on economic costs and returns, citing the legal framework.
It is not possible to state how many children staying unlawfully in the Netherlands receive national education.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel onrechtmatig in Nederland verblijvende kinderen landelijk onderwijs volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de bosbranden in Turkije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the EU and the Netherlands respond to the deadly wildfires in Turkey, including whether more EU aid should be pressed for and whether Dutch firefighting help can be offered. The minister answered that EU Civil Protection Mechanism assistance was already provided, that no extra EU request is currently warranted, and that the Netherlands has no firefighting aircraft of the type Turkey requested.
There is currently no reason to advocate extra help within the EU.
Er is op dit moment geen aanleiding om in EU verband te pleiten voor extra hulp.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van Dijk, Piri en Van der Werf over de situatie van de door Nederland naar Bahrein uitgezette asielzoeker A.S.

MPs asked how the government monitors the detention of asylum seeker A.S. in Bahrain, whether he is isolated and mistreated, and what steps Netherlands and the EU take to secure his release. The minister says the embassy follows the case through regular human rights work, has raised concerns with Bahraini authorities, cannot confirm the reported conditions yet, and will continue to press for better detention conditions.
The Netherlands nevertheless follows A.S.'s case as part of the embassy in Kuwait's regular human rights work.
Nederland volgt evenwel de zaak van A.S. als onderdeel van het reguliere mensenrechtenwerk van de ambassade in Koeweit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Werf en Piri over het terugsturen van Soedanese afgewezen asielzoekers naar Soedan

MPs from four parties asked the State Secretary about deportations of rejected Sudanese asylum seekers, including the use of language analysis, reports of ill-treatment after return, and possible contact with Sudanese intelligence officers at the embassy. The State Secretary defended the procedures as careful, said language analysis is only a supplementary indication, and maintained that there is no reason to believe returnees are targeted merely for returning.
A language analysis is only used as a supplementary instrument, namely when there is serious doubt about the stated country of origin.
Een taalanalyse wordt alleen als aanvullend instrument ingezet, namelijk wanneer er ernstige twijfel bij het gestelde land van herkomst is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Bromet, Ceder, Kuzu en Dassen over Afghaanse tolken

MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how the government would support Afghan interpreters and their families to evacuate as security collapsed, including whether passport requirements would be waived and a charter flight arranged. The government said it is doing everything possible to bring the group to safety, explained that Afghan authorities and airlines required passports and that airport access depends on verifiable identity, and promised a further letter on the consequences of recent developments.
The cabinet will shortly send a further letter to address the consequences of the recent developments.
Het kabinet zal op korte termijn een nadere brief sturen om in te gaan op de consequenties van de recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Bromet, Ceder en Kuzu over het beschermen van Afghanen die werkzaam waren voor Nederland tijdens de Afghanistanmissies

MPs from six parties asked the cabinet why it is not doing more to quickly bring Afghan interpreters and other former local staff who worked for Dutch missions to safety, including questions on the asylum process, document problems, non-interpreter staff, and a deportation moratorium. The ministers answered that additional staff were deployed, interpreters' remaining requirements were dropped, about 43 interpreters had arrived since June, non-interpreters are assessed individually and generously, and the moratorium's extension will be decided later.
The cabinet is taking all steps within its own power to bring the interpreters and their families to the Netherlands as quickly as possible.
Het kabinet onderneemt alle stappen die binnen het eigen vermogen liggen om de tolken en hun gezinnen op een zo kort mogelijke termijn naar Nederland over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Ceder en Kuzu over ‘De Nederlandse militairen zijn weg uit Afghanistan, maar hun tolken lopen gevaar’

MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers about Afghan interpreters and guards who worked for the Dutch mission still awaiting admission, including passport delays, EUPOL interpreters and exclusion of guards. The government gave detailed figures, explained passport and identity-verification obstacles, said it will consider guards case by case, and answered that each question would be addressed separately.
The cabinet makes maximum efforts to do what is possible if an applicant does not have a passport.
Het kabinet zet zich maximaal in om te doen wat mogelijk is indien een aanvrager niet over een paspoort beschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Piri over het bericht ‘De F-35 fersteurt it libben fan Friezen’

MPs De Hoop and Piri asked the State Secretary for Defence about reports that F-35 noise causes stress, sleeplessness and disturbance for residents near Leeuwarden air base, and whether the noise norms should be reconsidered. The State Secretary acknowledged the nuisance, said the 35 Ke norm is respected and noise measurement networks and local consultation committees exist, but declined to change the norm and only offered to explore operational adjustments.
Defence is certainly willing to look for ways to limit the nuisance, for example by adjusting flight procedures during take-off and landing.
Defensie is zeker bereid om te zoeken naar mogelijkheden om de hinder te beperken, bijvoorbeeld door het aanpassen van vliegprocedures tijdens start en landing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Volgens Olga Karatsj is geen Wit-Russische activist nog veilig: Het regime bereidt operaties voor binnen de EU'

MP Piri asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers whether they knew of reports that the Belarusian regime is preparing operations inside the EU against activists, and about the safety of Belarusians in the Netherlands. The government says it has no signals of such planned operations, has received some reports of insecurity that are being examined, points to existing contacts with the diaspora, diplomatic protest options and the OBI (unwanted foreign interference) approach, but sees no need for a special reporting point.
The cabinet has no signals that the Belarusian authorities are preparing to arrest Belarusian activists within the EU.
Bij het kabinet zijn geen signalen bekend dat de Belarussische autoriteiten voorbereidingen treffen om binnen de EU Belarussische activisten op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht ‘Marokko neemt wraak op Spanje door migranten door te laten.’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Morocco let migrants pass into Ceuta as revenge on Spain, including the situation of minors, one death, and alleged mistreatment at the border. The minister confirmed the crisis and the deaths, said the Netherlands shares the view that migrant rights must be respected, raised the issue through diplomatic channels and EU statements, and pointed to EU migration partnerships with Morocco without committing to a specific new step.
The cabinet does not have independent information about what happened at the border, but if mistreatment did occur, the cabinet rejects this way of treating irregular migrants.

Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie over wat er zich aan de grens heeft afgespeeld, maar mochten zich mishandelingen hebben voorgedaan, dan verwerpt het kabinet deze wijze van behandeling van irreguliere migranten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Kuzu en Ceder over de noodsituatie van de Afghaanse tolken

MPs from five parties asked the Defence Minister how many Afghan interpreters and their families had arrived in the Netherlands in June 2021, how many remain in Afghanistan, and what is being done to speed up their transfer and protect them. The government answered with case counts (90 families arrived since 2014, 84 active applications in Afghanistan, 113 rejected), listed measures to accelerate processing, and said the embassy in Kabul will remain open if security allows.
For security reasons I cannot go into these measures.
Omwille van veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik niet ingaan op deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Belhaj en Piri over het uit de vaart nemen van een marineschip door een ernstig tekort aan personeel

MPs asked the State Secretary why technical staff shortages forced the navy to take Johan de Wit and Van Speijk out of service, and how Defence plans to create specialist career paths to retain personnel. The government attributes the decommissioning to staff shortages and to redeploying crews to other ships, and sets out HR transition measures including specialist career paths that still need union agreement.
The temporary removal from service of Johan de Wit and Van Speijk is driven by two causes.
Het tijdelijk uit de vaart halen van Zr. Ms. Johan de Wit (JWIT) en Zr. Ms. Van Speijk (VSPK) wordt door twee oorzaken ingegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Piri, Van der Staaij en Jasper van Dijk over de dreigende executie van een Egyptische monnik

MPs from four parties asked the Foreign Minister whether she knew of Amnesty's appeal on the death sentence of Egyptian monk Wael Tawadros, whether torture-based confession and unfair trial could be confirmed, and whether she would press Egypt and the EU to stop the execution. The minister answered that she could not independently verify the allegations, noted rising executions in Egypt, and reported that Tawadros had already been executed on 9 May 2021, with Dutch and EU concern conveyed to Egyptian authorities at senior official level.
I therefore do not have independent information that confirms or refutes these reports, and can therefore give no further judgment on them.
Ik beschik derhalve niet over eigenstandige informatie die deze berichtgeving bevestigt dan wel ontkracht, en kan daar dan ook geen verder oordeel over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het misbruik van ‘grijze paspoorten’ door de Turkse AK-partij

An MP asked the government whether it is aware that municipal officials linked to Turkey's ruling AK party allegedly sold grey service passports used for irregular travel to Germany, whether this facilitates people smuggling, and whether any such travellers have reached the Netherlands. The government answered that it is concerned, that Turkey has suspended service passports for non-officials on project travel, that Dutch border checks and Europol cooperation address smuggling risks, and that it is not known whether anyone obtained a passport through corruption and travelled to the Netherlands.
Reports that official documents are being misused to facilitate irregular migration towards the EU are worrying and must be thoroughly investigated.
Berichten dat officiële documenten oneigenlijk worden gebruikt om irreguliere migratie richting de EU te faciliteren zijn zorgelijk en dienen grondig te worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht ‘Militairen verontwaardigd over achterlaten Afghaanse tolken’

MP Piri asks the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that soldiers are outraged at leaving Afghan interpreters behind, and about the number, timing, and process for bringing interpreters to the Netherlands. The minister answers that vetting of identity and Dutch service is required, that 68 interpreter households have been brought over, and that the process is ongoing with no fixed end date, while numbers are shared confidentially with parliament rather than publicly.
The cabinet has agreed to inform your House in detail about the process and the numbers in a confidential technical briefing.
Het kabinet heeft ingestemd om uw Kamer in een vertrouwelijke technische briefing in detail te informeren over het proces en de aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Meer beschietingen op Israël en Palestijnse gebieden: doden in Gaza’

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to escalating violence in Israel and Gaza, the threatened eviction of Palestinian families in East Jerusalem, and whether Israel's conduct will be condemned and what further measures will be taken. The minister answered that the government is deeply concerned, has urged de-escalation and restraint by all parties, opposes settlement expansion and the evictions as contrary to international law, and points to earlier Kamerbrieven and the EU discussion for details.
The cabinet remains, like the EU, very critical of Israeli settlement expansion in the West Bank and East Jerusalem.
Het kabinet is en blijft, net als de EU, zeer kritisch ten aanzien van Israëlische nederzettingenuitbreidingen op de Westelijke Jordaanoever en in Oost-Jeruzalem
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht ‘Morocco: Release Omar Radi and Guarantee Fair Trial Proceedings’

An MP from the Labour party asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Moroccan journalist Omar Radi, his hunger strike, the lack of new information on the case, and whether the Netherlands would press Morocco for a fair trial. The minister confirmed awareness of the calls and the hunger strike (reportedly ended 30 April), said there was no new unequivocal information, and stated that a fair trial is for the Moroccan authorities to guarantee while the Netherlands monitors the case and raises press freedom bilaterally or in the EU.
It is for the Moroccan authorities to guarantee a fair legal process.
