Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Piri, Van der Lee en Amhaouch over het bericht 'EU efforts to observe the Palestinian election fall flat'

MPs Sjoerdsma, Piri, Van der Lee and Amhaouch asked the Foreign Minister about reports that EU efforts to observe the Palestinian elections had stalled, including whether the EU could still observe and support the vote, Israel's reasons for not admitting EU staff, and alternative partners. The minister replied that President Abbas postponed the elections without a new date, that the EU has urged a new date and called on Israel to facilitate elections, and that the EU will renew its observation effort once a date is set.
Once a new date for the elections is set, the EU will again work towards organising an observation mission.
Wanneer een nieuwe datum voor de verkiezingen is vastgesteld, zal de EU opnieuw inzetten op de organisatie van een waarnemingsmissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Ceder, Jasper van Dijk en Piri over de dreigende uitzetting van Amsterdamse modelburgers Sofia en Najoua

MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the threatened deportation of two Amsterdam-raised young women, questioning whether the IND's decision, its appeal against the court ruling and the rules for residence under article 8 ECHR were consistent with the rights of children and the courts' findings. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, noted the IND has withdrawn the appeal and granted residence, and explained general routes and guidance for adults who grew up in the Netherlands without residence status.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases nor into the considerations underlying the decision to lodge an appeal.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken noch op overwegingen die ten grondslag liggen aan het instellen van Hoger Beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de kwalificatie 'veilig land' in asielzaken

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security how the Council of State's ruling that the 'safe country' designations in asylum cases must be better substantiated affects pending and past asylum decisions, and how sources will be broadened. The State Secretary answers that re-assessments of Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia and Georgia have started with more sources, that pending cases are finished where possible, and that past decisions may need re-assessment where the motivation cannot be repaired.
However, a larger number of sources must be consulted, including in particular information from other member states, EASO, UNHCR, the Council of Europe and other relevant international organisations.
Wel moet een groter aantal bronnen worden geraadpleegd, waaronder in het bijzonder informatie uit andere lidstaten, EASO, UNHCR, Raad van Europa en andere relevante internationale organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeets, Kuik, Jasper van Dijk, Ceder en Piri over het bericht ‘Tina en Jacob moeten weg!’

MPs from D66, CDA, SP, ChristenUnie and PvdA asked whether Armenian Syrians facing revocation of asylum status are treated unequally, and why some keep their permits while others lose them. The State Secretary answered that re-assessment is individual, that the IND does not register these figures, and that a 2021 court ruling concerned insufficient reasoning on equality, not discrimination.
The requested numerical data cannot be provided.
De gevraagde cijfermatige gegeven kunnen niet verstrekt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Ellemeet, Ceder, Kuik en Koekkoek over de mogelijke uitzetting van Tina en Jacob

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why Tina and Jacob, Syrian-Armenians, faced deportation to Armenia and whether their family ties and residence in the Netherlands should count. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case on privacy and confidentiality grounds, explained the IND's general approach to dual nationals and safe third countries, and noted that the IND had granted a residence permit.
As said, I cannot go into the individual case.
Zoals gezegd kan ik niet ingaan op de individuele zaak.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra en Von Martels over het bericht 'Haal vervuilde bouwgrond langs N206 weg'

CDA MPs asked about reports that contaminated AEC bottom ash with batteries was used in construction along the N206 near Katwijk, raising health and water risks. The state secretary answered that partner tests and an additional study show the ash meets the Soil Quality Decree, that no health risks are expected, that RIVM research is unnecessary, and that the municipality and province are the first contacts for residents.
I am currently considering options for tightening the Soil Quality Decree in this area.
Ik bekijk op dit moment de opties voor aanscherping van het Besluit bodemkwaliteit op dit vlak.
Antwoord op vragenvan  de leden Van den Anker en Von Martels over het bericht ‘Rivierenbuurt kampt met rattenplaag: Springen zelfs uit de wc'

MPs Van den Anker and Von Martels asked the State Secretary about a newspaper report on a rat plague in Amsterdam's Rivierenbuurt, covering national action on pest control, oversight of municipalities' public health duties, food safety risks, the handling of pest-control information, a complaints point, rat monitoring, and emergency protocols. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are the first point of contact, that the national government sets the framework and works on IPM and knowledge-sharing, that interbestuurlijk toezicht is applied only restrictively, and that several follow-up steps (working group, monitoring, a motion-based reallocation of information tasks, a revised handbook) are planned.

However, the national government takes a restrained approach to interbestuurlijk toezicht, but such supervision (according to the intervention ladder) is possible if the tasks are narrowly defined and it is reasonably unmistakable that the decentralised authority is failing in its duties.

Vanuit het Rijk wordt er echter terughoudend omgegaan met interbestuurlijk toezicht, maar er is interbestuurlijk toezicht (volgens de interventieladder) mogelijk indien de taken nauw omschreven zijn en het bij taakverwaarlozing redelijk onmiskenbaar is dat de decentrale overheid in gebreke blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht 'Bij recycling van asfalt komt veel te veel kankerverwekkend benzeen vrij'

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether asphalt plants routinely exceed the benzene emission limit, how long this has been known, why enforcement has been lacking, and what action will be taken. The Staatssecretaris answered that 10 of 29 active plants exceed the limit, 11 have no benzene data, enforcement varies by competent authority, the industry is researching reduction, and the current limit remains valid with a promised update to the Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van Helvert over de olifant Buba

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about the circus elephant Buba, arguing she should be allowed to stay with her circus family and that precedent should not block this. The minister replied that an exemption under conditions was granted on 25 March 2021 for an indefinite period, while noting that the keeper was responsible for her residence and that earlier relocation efforts had been supported.
At the request of Mr Freiwald, I granted an exemption on 25 March 2021.
Ik heb op verzoek van de heer Freiwald op 25 maart 2021 een ontheffing afgegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries, Von Martels, De Groot en Dik Faber over het signaal dat de NVWA niet overgaat tot het aanwijzen van verschillende havens als ‘dedicated landing port third countrie

MPs asked why the NVWA has not designated additional Dutch ports, such as Den Helder, as dedicated landing ports for third-country fishing vessels, which hurts shipyards once British vessels lose access after Brexit. The minister explains the EU IUU-regulation limits such designations, reports lost turnover and an intention to allow maintenance-only calls by UK vessels in specified ports, and declines to reconsider the broader landing-port designations.
I have received a confidential overview from the sector of the estimated turnover losses per shipyard.
Ik heb van de sector vertrouwelijk een overzicht gekregen van de geschatte omzetverliezen per werf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Von Martels over "amateurvoetbalverenigingen die in financiële problemen komen vanwege een bureaucratische regel van de overheid"

Two CDA MPs asked why amateur football clubs miss NOW 3.0 wage compensation because June 2020 was chosen as the reference month, when many clubs have no trainers on payroll during the summer break. The minister acknowledges the problem but says no fix is possible without undue risk, points clubs to the TASO scheme, and says the government is looking at extending TASO for the first and second quarters.
The cabinet hopes in this way to meet the amateur clubs.
Het kabinet hoopt hiermee de amateurclubs tegemoet te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht 'Brussel wil camera’s op schepen om vissers in de gaten te houden'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about an EU proposal to fit cameras on fishing vessels to monitor compliance with the discard ban, and whether this harms fishers' privacy and is feasible. The minister is not opposed to cameras in principle but wants pilot projects first to test effectiveness and privacy compatibility, and pursues a level playing field and alternative technologies.
I am therefore not opposed to cameras on board.
Ik ben dan ook niet tegen camera’s aan boord.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht 'Bossche bedrijf AVI werd eerder op de vingers getikt voor branden'

An MP asked the minister about repeated smouldering fires at the AVI recycling company in Den Bosch, including the 9 March 2021 fire that closed COVID test sites and sent schoolchildren home, and whether enforcement had been adequate and an independent inquiry warranted. The state secretary answered that the province and environmental service have enforcement responsibility, outlined the enforcement history including an enforced penalty order still in force, and said the province is investigating the stored waste quantities during the fire.
It is the responsibility of the competent authority to provide an adequate permit and to enforce it.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het bevoegd gezag om te voorzien in een adequate vergunning en deze te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'Wederom levensgevaarlijke stenenactie Greenpeace in VK-wateren' van de Nederlandse Vissersbond

MPs Von Martels and Agnes Mulder asked the minister whether she was aware of Greenpeace UK's rock-dumping action south of Brighton, which they said endangers fishers, and what she would do given her earlier stance on the North Sea agreement. The minister said she condemns the action, raised it in international fisheries consultations, and that UK authorities are investigating and the Dutch Public Prosecution Service found no grounds for criminal investigation of a similar earlier action.
This concerns an action by the British branch of Greenpeace in the English part of the North Sea.
Het betreft een actie van de Britse tak van Greenpeace in het Engelse deel van de Noordzee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht dat de minister een termijn heeft laten verstrijken in een rechtszaak over vergunningen van garnalenvissers

An MP asked the minister why the deadline in a court case over shrimp fishing permits lapsed, letting Natuurmonumenten's appeal succeed, and what will be done to resolve the uncertainty for fishers. The minister admits the ministry failed to request an extension in time, the Raad van State upheld the appeal on cumulative effects, and new objection decisions will be taken as soon as possible, which she regrets delays legal certainty.
By mistake, no timely request for an extension of the deadline was made.
Per abuis is niet tijdig om verlenging van de termijn verzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het artikel 'Konijn en haas op rode lijst met bedreigde zoogdieren, otter en zeehond eraf'

An MP asked the minister about the 2020 Red List of mammals (basisrapport), covering the choice of contractor, the advisory committee, the 1950 baseline, trend methods, use of hunting-district counts, and predator effects. The minister defended the methodology, said WBE data could be used once standardised and validated, and disputed that predation-by-cats was the only factor.
I will look into whether this is possible in the future.
Ik ga bekijken of dit in de toekomst mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma, Geurts en Von Martels over de kosten van kentekens van trekkers

MPs Postma, Geurts and Von Martels (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the RDW plans to charge far more than the promised maximum of €61 per new agricultural vehicle for identification and registration, and whether the RDW will be instructed to cap costs and introduce accelerated registration. The Minister acknowledges the sector's surprise, explains the cost structure, and proposes a transition period until 1 July 2021 with conversion-method registration and work toward accelerated registration, but does not commit to instructing the RDW on a €61 cap.
I have therefore entered into discussions with the RDW and the sector to reach an appropriate and swift solution in light of the law's entry into force on 1 January 2021.
Ik ben daarom samen met de RDW en de sector in gesprek gegaan om te komen tot een passende en snelle oplossing in het licht van de inwerkingtreding van de wet per 1 januari 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het artikel 'Overheid raadt kastomaat van eigen bodem af'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture whether it is correct that the government-funded Milieu Centraal advised consumers against winter tomatoes grown in Dutch soil, and whether this harms the reputation of Dutch horticulture. The Minister replied that it is not for government to dictate independent advice, noted the outdated calendar was taken offline, and said it is not possible to judge the environmental impact without current calculations.
It is not for the government to determine what advice independent organisations, such as Milieu Centraal, give.
Het is niet aan de overheid om te bepalen welk advies onafhankelijke organisaties, zoals Milieu Centraal, geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Von Martels over de berichten Plasticafval: hoe een Nederlands dropzakje kon eindigen in een Turkse berm en Nederlands plastic illegaal gestort in Turkije

MPs Ziengs and Von Martels asked the State Secretary about reports that Dutch plastic waste, including Dutch exports to Turkey, ended up dumped illegally, and how export and oversight of plastic waste can be tightened. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, said Dutch oversight of actual recycling in Turkey is impossible, and pointed to tightened OECD/Basel rules from 2021, planned broadening of producer responsibility, and ILT investigation of exports.
However, the Netherlands has no possibility to supervise the actual beneficial use in Turkey.
Nederland heeft echter geen mogelijkheden in Turkije toezicht te houden op de daadwerkelijke nuttige toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het artikel 'Zwaar weer dreigt voor boeren bij Wierdense Veld'

An MP from the CDA asked the minister whether the Wierdense Veld studies were independent, whether nitrogen targets are feasible given foreign deposition, and about the costs, certainty and proportionality of保 restoring the bog under Natura 2000. The minister defended the independence of the consultancies, acknowledged cost estimates of about 39.5 million euro, and said the government will discuss proportionality of Natura 2000 measures with the European Commission.
The cabinet therefore intends to enter into discussion with the European Commission about the proportionality of the measures to be taken under Natura 2000.
Het kabinet is daarom voornemens het gesprek met de Europese Commissie aan te gaan over de proportionaliteit van de te nemen maatregelen in het kader van Natura 2000.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geluk-Poortvliet over opleidingsvergoedingen voor transfers van vrouwenvoetballers

MPs Von Martels and Geluk-Poortvliet asked whether the absence of training compensation for transferred women footballers constitutes discrimination and whether the government will raise it with the KNVB and in Europe. The minister answers that gender equality is paramount, that the KNVB is working on professionalising the youth structure and studying training compensation, but that international responsibility lies with FIFA and the government will keep discussing developments with the KNVB.
Equality between men and women in general, and therefore also in sport and football, is paramount for me.
Gelijkwaardigheid tussen mannen en vrouwen in het algemeen en dus ook in de sport en daarmee het voetbal, staat voor mij voorop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over het bericht 'EU-hof zet streep door subsidie grondaankoop natuur'

MPs Von Martels and Geurts (CDA) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a CJEU ruling that ended state-aid subsidies for land purchases by nature organisations and whether the state faces interest claims. The minister answered that the ruling does not judge whether nature organisations may run economic activities, that the state still considers the subsidies compatible state aid, and that any interest claim depends on a new Commission decision.
The European Court's ruling contains no substantive judgment on whether nature organisations are permitted to carry out economic activities on land intended for nature management.
De uitspraak van het Europese Hof bevat geen inhoudelijk oordeel of het natuurorganisaties is toegestaan economische activiteiten te verrichten op gronden die zijn bestemd voor natuurbeheer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Von Martels over (vakantie)verhuurplatforms en toeristenbelasting

MPs Palland and Von Martels asked how Dutch tourist tax collection through holiday rental platforms differs from other European countries, why France can have platforms collect it while the Netherlands does not, and whether an agreement with platforms is feasible. The minister answered that no comparative overview exists, that platform collection is not necessary in the Netherlands given the registration obligation in the new short-stay rental law, and that no signal shows parties now consider a platform agreement feasible.
An overview of the manner of any local tourist tax levy in other European countries is not available, so no comparison with the Netherlands can be made.
Een overzicht van de (wijze van de) eventuele heffing van (lokale) toeristenbelasting in andere Europese landen is niet beschikbaar, dus er kan geen vergelijking met Nederland worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Von Martels over het bericht ‘Bewapening boa stelselmatig afgewezen: Groene boa’s te vaak zonder bewapening het bos ingestuurd’

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister why nature-area enforcement officers (groene boa's) are often denied renewal of armament, including firearms, despite facing drug crime and poaching, and why coding of armament differs across regions. The Minister replied that a new regulation is being drafted to give more uniform, risk-based armament decisions, that armament remains optional with individual case assessment, and that groene boa's can still obtain weapons, including an extendable baton added in July 2020.
A new decision on arming and equipping boa's is currently being drafted, in which security risks will carry more weight.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een nieuw besluit bewapening en uitrusting boa's, waarin veiligheidsrisico's meer maatgevend zullen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van den Berg en Von Martels over berichten dat mensen met overgewicht meer risico lopen bij het coronavirus

Three CDA MPs asked the state secretary for Health about links between overweight and severe COVID-19, and about strengthening healthy-lifestyle policy, including UK measures and coordination of local prevention and sport agreements. The state secretary agreed the link is plausible, pointed to existing prevention agreements, promised to monitor UK measures, and announced a RIVM evaluation and further steps on children's marketing and local funding.
By preventively countering overweight, a great deal of disease burden can be prevented.
Met het preventief tegengaan van overgewicht kan veel ziektelast worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van der Molen over de berichten ‘Thialf verder in de problemen nu tekort oploopt tot 1 miljoen euro’ en ‘Wie betaalt de medailles van Sven en Sjinkie’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about the financial continuity of the Thialf skating venue, a shortfall of about 1 million euro, and the funding of top sport infrastructure. The minister acknowledged the deficit and referred to a pending Mulier Institute study, existing NOC*NSF/CTO funding for ice rental, and a recovery plan being prepared, without committing to new funds.
I think it is too early to make any commitments on that at this moment.
Ik vind het te vroeg om daar op dit moment al toezeggingen over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht dat garnalenvissers meer mogen vissen in Natura-2000-gebieden

MP Von Martels (CDA) asked the minister about a report that shrimp fishers could fish more in Natura 2000 areas, including how fishing hours in the permit were calculated, the software errors involved, and how individual fishers can comply with collectively granted hours. Minister Schouten answered that the hours capture the assessed fishing level rather than freezing it, that the errors (speed assumptions, a software bug, counting zero-knot sailing) were corrected in December 2018, and that enforcement would suspend permits for an area if hours are exceeded by 10%, leaving compliance largely to the fishers' representative organisations.
When setting the initial fishing hours for the reference year 2015, a fishing speed that was too low for the southern Natura 2000 areas was used.
Bij het vaststellen van de initiële visuren voor het ijkjaar 2015 is met een, voor de zuidelijke Natura 2000-gebieden, te lage vissnelheid gerekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over het bericht dat het draagvlak voor het keurmerk 'On the way to PlanetProof' afbrokkelt

Two CDA MPs asked the agriculture minister about reports that farmers see little added value in the PlanetProof sustainability label and bear extra costs without a price premium. The minister acknowledged the criticism, gave illustrative cost figures, said a farm ownership agenda and ACM monitoring of prices are underway, but did not commit to new rules.
For that reason, and because of the importance I attach to it, I am working on drafting an agricultural entrepreneurship agenda.
Daarom, én vanwege het belang dat ik eraan hecht, ben ik bezig met het opstellen van een agrarische ondernemerschapsagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het verbeteren van de Nederlandse wolvenaanpak

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how the Dutch wolf policy can be improved, including timing of intervention, preventive culling, damage liability and whether the wolf presence threatens Natura 2000 targets. The Minister answers that provinces have set intervention criteria, that wolves are protected and that the government will keep working with provinces, but declines to commit to a new policy and says no action is needed now on several points.
The public support study confirmed that a majority of the Dutch agree with this.
Het draagvlakonderzoek heeft bevestigd dat een meerderheid van de Nederlanders het hier mee eens is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over maatregelen tegen de eikenprocessierups

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about preventive measures against the oak processionary caterpillar, the lessons from 2019 and whether a national prevention plan will be made with local governments. The minister answered that a Knowledge Platform was set up, the guideline and waste protocol were updated, and that a national prevention plan is not opportune because control is tailored locally by municipalities and land owners.
Preventive and control measures actually taken in the field fall under the responsibility of the relevant municipalities and land owners.
Preventie- en bestrijdingsmaatregelen die concreet in het veld worden getroffen vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van desbetreffende gemeenten en terreineigenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Peters over het bericht ‘Aanpassing Arbobesluit 7.23d werkbakken leidt tot meer ongevallen

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary whether the amended Arbobesluit 7.23d allowing work baskets on crane hooks for personnel transport increases risks, citing TNO and RIVM findings and claimed costs of over 42 million euro per year. The State Secretary defended the amendment as a narrowly conditioned extension that remains exceptional, disputed the cost figure and said the RIVM study did not assess relative risks of work methods.

With the proposed amendment of Article 7.23d of the Arbobesluit, the possibility has been created to use equipment not designed and set up for transporting persons when no suitable equipment or work methods exist to reach the locations safely.

Met de voorgenomen wijziging van artikel 7.23d van het Arbobesluit is de mogelijkheid gecreëerd om een arbeidsmiddel, dat niet bestemd en ingericht is voor het vervoer van personen, in te zetten als er geen geëigende arbeidsmiddelen en/of werkmethodes zijn om de plaatsen veilig te kunnen bereiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Peters over het bericht 'Samenwerking bij verwijderen asbest loopt vast, 'overheid moet ingrijpen''

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a critical report on the asbestos certification system (Ascert, innovation, possible independent authority, risk classes, schemes) and the government answered each question, rejecting an independent regulator for now, pointing to its reform measures and new innovation body VIP, and declining to answer one question because it belongs to another ministry. The answers commit to several concrete steps such as a convenant with Ascert and an upcoming scheme update, while largely restating existing policy.
An independent authority on top of the existing ones is not on the agenda.
Een onafhankelijke autoriteit bovenop de reeds bestaande, is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van Nispen over het bericht dat verenigingen voor jeugd- en jongerenwerk in de problemen komen door de coronacrisis

MPs Von Martels, Peters and Van Nispen asked the health minister about youth and scouting associations and playground foundations facing financial trouble due to the COVID-19 crisis, and whether they are excluded from support. The minister replied that some such organisations may qualify for national support schemes, that municipalities are primarily responsible, and that the full effects are not yet known.

The municipality is the first responsible government for these associations, and if the situation for scouting or youth work lasts long, these associations will have to look with the municipality at what options exist to keep these facilities from being endangered.

De gemeente is de eerstverantwoordelijke overheid voor deze verenigingen en mocht de situatie voor de scouting of jeugdwerk langdurig voortduren dan zullen deze verenigingen dan ook met de gemeente moeten kijken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over berichten dat aangevoerde grond voor de aanleg van een aarden wal bij Emmen is besmet met de wratzieke

An MP asked the agriculture minister why contaminated soil brought in for an earthen dike near Emmen was only tested long after delivery, why no testing duty exists, and what compensation farmers receive. The minister answered that no phytosanitary basis for testing existed, that NVWA tested voluntarily and found contamination in 2 of 15 samples, that local measures suffice, and that farmers are not compensated by the state but may sue the supplier.
Based on the phytosanitary regulations for soil organisms, there was no reason for soil investigation.
Op basis van de fytosanitaire regelgeving voor bodemorganismen was er geen aanleiding voor grondonderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen het lid Von Martels over het voorstel van de eigenaar van het bosreservaat 'Achter de Voort' (Staatsbosbeheer) om vanuit de aanwijzing als bosreservaat een aantal aanpassingen ten aanzien van de intern

An MP asked the minister about a proposal by Staatsbosbeheer to adjust internal management measures for Achter de Voort, which is both a forest reserve and a Natura 2000 site, and whether this conflicts with the forest reserve status. The minister replied that no real conflict exists, only the search zone for one measure changes, the reserve is excluded, and no EU discussion is needed.
The owner of the Achter de Voort forest reserve has assured me that there is no such conflict.
De eigenaar van het bosreservaat Achter de Voort heeft mij verzekerd dat er van het genoemde conflict geen sprake is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de Maximale Residu Limiet voor fluopicolide in blauwmaanzaad

An MP asked the Minister whether the very low EU residue limit of 0.01 mg/kg for fluopicolide in blue poppy seed harms Dutch growers, whether it is justified, whether imports face a different limit, and whether the government will push for a higher limit. The Minister answered that the default limit applies because no use was ever applied for, that the same limit applies to all poppy seed regardless of origin, and that the onus lies with companies to submit a request, which one has reportedly done at the Ctgb.
The reason the MRL of 0.01 mg/kg applies to blue poppy seed is that the use of fluopicolide on blue poppy seed and a higher MRL for this use were never requested and therefore never assessed.

De reden dat de MRL van 0,01 mg/kg voor blauwmaanzaad van toepassing is, is het feit dat de toepassing van fluopicolide op blauwmaanzaad en een hogere MRL voor deze toepassing niet zijn aangevraagd en dus niet zijn beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Geurts en Von Martels over schade aan mestkelders, ventilatiekanalen en funderingen veroorzaakt door mijnbouwactiviteiten in Groningen

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers whether agricultural damage to manure cellars, ventilation shafts and foundations from Groningen gas extraction had been wrongly excluded from reinforcement and damage handling by NAM, CVW and the TCMG, and how farmers are heard and supported. The government answered that the TCMG handles new damage claims, uses civil liability law with the statutory presumption of causation, is consulting an expert panel on manure cellar damage due around June 2020, and is working with the Province on a programmatic approach for farmers.
The panel's advice is expected to be ready around mid-June 2020.
Naar verwachting is het advies van het panel medio juni 2020 gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht dat Britten de visrechten van Europese vissers af willen pakken

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that Britain wants to end the automatic fishing rights of European fishers in British waters, and whether Dutch fishers would need permits and how the Netherlands is preparing. The minister confirmed awareness, said the UK will set its own fishing rules after the transition period and a permit regime is likely, and described Dutch negotiating positions and the July 2020 target for a fisheries agreement.
It is therefore up to the UK to assess whether a permit must be granted in this zone for fishing by vessels not flying the UK flag.
Het is daarmee aan het VK om te beoordelen of in deze zone voor de visserij door vaartuigen die niet onder de vlag van het VK vissen een vergunning moet worden verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de aanwijzing van natuurgebieden en het toevoegen van stikstofgevoelige habitats in het verleden

MP Von Martels (CDA) asked the minister about the designation of Natura 2000 areas, including claims that habitats were added or designated without being present and that conservation status is not improving. The minister rejected several claims, defended the designations as legally required, and gave limited answers on monitoring data, noting evaluations are still ongoing.
Afterwards, in a few cases a nitrogen-sensitive habitat was added where, according to the Council of State, this had wrongly not yet been done.
Nadien is in enkele gevallen een stikstofgevoelig habitat toegevoegd als dat volgens de Raad van State ten onrechte nog niet was gebeurd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over recente ontwikkelingen met betrekking tot het gebruik van rubbergranulaat bij kunstgrasvelden

An MP asked the ministers about a Rotterdam court ruling convicting a sports club for spreading rubber granules from its artificial pitch, and about how clubs can meet the duty of care, including cheaper alternatives and support for volunteer-run clubs. The government said it takes note of the ruling, that duty-of-care measures are described in sector guidelines, that clubs can get 30% subsidy for spread-prevention measures, and that research on more environmentally friendly pitches is funded with results expected in early 2021.
It is up to the competent authority to assess whether the duty of care has been properly implemented.
Het is aan het bevoegd gezag om te beoordelen of sprake is van een juiste invulling van de zorgplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Von Martels en Van der Graaf over een onkostenvergoeding van vrijwilligers bij het Songfestival

MPs Van der Molen, Von Martels and Van der Graaf asked why volunteers at the Eurovision Song Contest cannot claim travel costs while paid staff can, and whether the minister would agree arrangements on volunteer expense reimbursement. The minister agreed volunteering deserves recognition, explained that paid staff are compensated under their contracts while volunteers get a local OV card, catering and clothing, and said he would raise volunteer positions with the NPO rather than commit to a specific reimbursement arrangement.
I will also draw the NPO's attention to the position of the volunteers.
Ik zal de NPO ook attenderen op de positie van de vrijwilligers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over problemen met de toepassing van thermisch gereinigde grond (TGG)

An MP asked the minister about the halt on applying thermally cleaned soil (TGG) since 2017, its causes, the expected duration, and how the market can resume. The minister answered that quality problems led to the halt, verification by the ILT and the reclaimers is now complete, TGG can be offered again, and a RIVM evaluation of norms is due by end 2020.
Now that the ILT states that the verification inspections of the stored TGG at both cleaners were reliably carried out, TGG can be offered again.
Nu de ILT aangeeft dat de verificatiekeuringen van de opgeslagen TGG bij de beide reinigers betrouwbaar tot stand zijn gekomen, kan TGG weer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over natura 2000 en het toevoegen van habitats

MP Von Martels (CDA) asked the agriculture and nature minister about adding nitrogen-sensitive habitats to Natura 2000 sites, asking whether this is an EU obligation, its consequences and whether the plan will be suspended. The minister answered that adding the habitats is required under the Habitats Directive, that the amendment will be suspended and reconsidered, and that talks with the European Commission are ongoing.
Yes, I am willing to do so. The 'amendment on present values' decision will be suspended and reconsidered.
Ja, hiertoe ben ik bereid. Het «wijzigingsbesluit aanwezige waarden» wordt opgeschort en heroverwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over natuurbeheer en klimaatbeleid

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about dune restoration on Terschelling (removing helm grass so dunes drift again), whether it serves species like the natterjack and rabbits, how nature management aligns with climate policy and carbon storage, and the link to the biomass roadmap. The minister answers that the measures are part of a nitrogen-reduction package under the PAS, that they protect habitats and coastal climate adaptation, that no forest is removed, and that forest carbon storage is addressed in the forest strategy and the biomass roadmap is due in early 2020.
No forest is removed in the measures on Terschelling.
Bij de maatregelen op Terschelling wordt geen bos verwijderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Von Martels over mogelijk te hoge PFAS-waarden in strooizout

MPs De Pater-Postma and Von Martels asked whether PFAS contamination of road salt could endanger winter road gritting, whether expert follow-up research was planned, and what alternatives exist. The minister answered that PFAS contamination of deep-mined salt is very unlikely, that current NEN standards do not include PFAS, that stocks for the coming winter are already purchased, and that no alternatives are needed.
As indicated in the answer to question 2, it is very unlikely that road salt, which is largely extracted from old and deep soil layers, is contaminated with PFAS.
Zoals bij het antwoord op vraag 2 is aangegeven, is het zeer onwaarschijnlijk dat strooizout dat veelal uit oude en diepe grondlagen wordt gewonnen, vervuild is met PFAS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels en Van den Berg over het niet exporteren van kernafval naar COVRA maar naar Rusland

MPs Von Martels and Van den Berg asked whether depleted uranium from URENCO is being exported to Russia instead of stored at COVRA, who paid for the storage halls, why exports stopped in 2009, how much is produced and exported, the waste definition, and what Russia does with the material. The government confirmed that URENCO financed the halls, that exports stopped in 2009 with no current plans to resume, withheld export volumes as commercially confidential, explained the waste definition and ANVS supervision, and stated that Russian use is subject to IAEA safeguards and civil end-use guarantees.
The amount of depleted uranium that URENCO Nederland produces and how much of it is exported is commercially confidential information and is therefore not made public.
De hoeveelheid verarmd uranium die URENCO Nederland produceert en hoeveel daarvan wordt geëxporteerd is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en wordt daarom niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Ronnes over consequenties PFAS (poly- en perfluoralkylstoffen)

MPs Von Martels and Ronnes (CDA) asked about the consequences of the PFAS temporary framework for construction and dredging, including project delays, housing construction, jobs and comparison with other countries. The minister says she is in talks with the sector, has organised information meetings and regional working conferences, and is taking measures to unblock projects while noting the national framework is needed for health reasons.
I do not have independent figures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Von Martels, Lodders en Bisschop over het artikel 'Grote onvrede over aanpak pootgoedfraude'

MPs from CDA, VVD and SGP asked the minister about NVWA and NAK handling of seed potato fraud (valse NAK-labels), the enforcement tools of the plant inspection services, and cooperation between the agencies. The minister answered that the NVWA acted within its powers, that a criminal investigation is ongoing, that the inspection services' fines powers are limited under current law, and that an evaluation of enforcement instruments is planned by 2021.
I will evaluate the use of the enforcement instruments currently included in this legislation and will also involve the plant inspection services and the sector.
Ik zal de inzet van de nu in deze regelgeving opgenomen handhavingsinstrumenten evalueren en daarbij ook de plantaardige keuringsdiensten en de sector betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Von Martels over het bericht ‘Jagers: voorlopig geen e-screening voor wapenvergunning’

MPs Van Dam and Von Martels (CDA) asked Minister Grapperhaus about the suspension of the e-screener for hunters and sport shooters, the seizure of weapons after negative results, and the legal protection available to licence holders. The minister said only new applicants will be screened with the e-screener for two years, that weapons will be returned case by case under a three-category approach, and that objection and appeal procedures remain available, while declining to meet the one-week deadline.
As I indicated in my letter of 29 October, it is being examined promptly, case by case, whether weapons are returned.
Zoals ik aangaf in mijn brief van 29 oktober wordt voortvarend van geval tot geval bekeken of wapens worden teruggegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Von Martels en Palland over het bericht 'Brandweer dreigt alle vrijwilligers kwijt te raken'

CDA MPs asked the Justice and Security Minister about reports that the volunteer fire service risks losing its volunteers due to the Wnra civil service law, and about recruitment, diversity and the working group. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the Wnra does not itself threaten volunteerism, that a working group and recruitment programme are underway, and that the Wnra's entry into force for fire services is postponed pending clarity.
It is not correct that the Wnra civil service law causes the fire service to risk losing its volunteer character.
Het klopt niet dat de Wet normalisering rechtspositie ambtenaren (Wnra) ervoor zorgt dat de brandweer haar vrijwillige karakter dreigt te verliezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over 'Baggersector ligt goeddeels stil door strengere norm chemische stoffen PFAS'

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary why the dredging sector is largely halted by the strict PFAS norm of 0.1 microgram per kilogram, questioning its scientific basis and asking for a workable solution before the definitive framework of end 2020. The State Secretary answers that the limit follows the precautionary and stand-still principles, that a temporary PFAS framework allows reuse for housing and industry, and that she will hold information sessions, regional conferences and a taskforce, while RIVM is asked for provisional background values.
My aim is to reach a workable and safe approach to PFAS-containing soil and dredged material as quickly as possible.
Mijn inzet is om zo snel mogelijk te komen tot een werkbare en veilige omgang met PFAS-houdende grond en baggerspecie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht 'En het Songfestival gaat naar ... Rotterdam!'

An MP from the CDA asked whether the government would act on adopted motions to promote the Netherlands at the Eurovision Song Contest 2020 in Rotterdam, and how regional and sector partners would be involved. The state secretary answered that the organising broadcasters and the municipality are developing the concept, that the ministry will offer knowledge and expertise via RVO.nl and NBTC, and that promotion will be aligned with the national branding effort, without committing to specific funding or a fixed step.
The Eurovision Song Contest 2020 offers an ideal opportunity to highlight the unique aspects of the Netherlands.
Het Eurovisie Songfestival 2020 biedt een uitgelezen kans om de unieke kanten van Nederland te belichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de tussenevaluatie van de nota Gezonde Groei, Duurzame Oogst

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality to respond to criticism from farm organisations and Agrifacts of the PBL interim evaluation of the Gezonde Groei, Duurzame Oogst policy note, on the measurement period, the biodiversity framing, sampling representativeness, assessment method, and the 50% reduction target. The Minister answered each point, defending the PBL methodology as consistent with the Water Framework Directive and stating that the 50% target for 2018 was not met.
Yes. The PBL has since published two responses to the criticism from the Agrifacts foundation on its website.
Ja. Het PBL heeft inmiddels twee reacties op de kritiek van stichting Agrifacts gepubliceerd op zijn website.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over de eerdere beantwoording over het zogeheten gelijkberechtigingsdossier

MPs Von Martels and Geurts (CDA) asked the government to respond to the Vereniging Gelijkberechtiging Grondbezitters' claims about state aid to nature organisations (TBOs), including whether the General Court annulment, the interest claim under the CELF ruling, and settlement options were handled correctly. The state secretary defended the earlier position, said the state intervened in support of Natuurmonumenten, argued the Commission's approval may well be reconfirmed, and declined to pursue interest recovery or concrete settlement proposals pending the court procedures.
It is for the European Commission to take a new decision, should it decide to open the formal investigation procedure.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie om een nieuw besluit te nemen, mocht zij besluiten tot het openen van de formele onderzoeksprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht “onverwoestbaar stofje gaat bouwprojecten lamleggen” en over de gevolgen van de industriële stof PFOS voor de bouwwereld

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about lab capacity shortages for PFAS soil analyses that were reportedly stalling construction and dredging projects, and about storage, soil supply and cleaning options. The answers state that the lab delays were temporary and have shortened to one to two weeks, that no extra criteria apply to labs, that storage is primarily the market's responsibility with talks ongoing among competent authorities, and that the State Secretary will consult authorities on enabling soil cleaning.
I will therefore consult with the decentralised competent authorities to see what is needed to provide for such cleaning operations.
Ik zal daarom in overleg treden met de decentrale bevoegde gezagen om te bezien wat er nodig is om in dergelijke reinigingen te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Von Martels over het handelen van de NVWA met ondeugdelijk pootgoed en opvolging van meldingen door keuringsdiensten

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture how the NVWA handled fraudulent seed potatoes and follow-up on reports from inspection bodies, including cross-border aspects with Belgium. The minister answered that an NVWA investigation is ongoing, that fields were partly ordered destroyed-free but subject to phytosanitary inspection, and that existing enforcement powers are sufficient, while committing to talks with inspection services.

I cannot provide further information at this stage, except to note that both the Dutch General Inspection Service for seed and seed potatoes (NAK) and the Belgian Federal Agency for the Safety of the Food Chain (FAVV) are involved by the NVWA in this matter.

Ik kan hierover in dit stadium geen nadere informatie verstrekken, met uitzondering van de mededeling dat zowel de Nederlandse Algemene Keuringsdienst voor zaaizaad en pootgoed van landbouwgewassen (NAK) als het Belgische Federaal Agentschap voor de Veiligheid van de Voedselketen (FAVV) hierbij door de NVWA betrokken worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Von Martels over de openstelling van de Afsluitdijk voor fietsers

MPs Schonis (D66) and Von Martels (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why bicycle access to the Afsluitdijk is limited in 2020-2021 and whether alternatives such as closing the road or separating lanes were considered. The minister answered that construction makes safe openings very limited, that closing the A7 or splitting lanes is not feasible given its regional importance, and that only a bicycle bus and a possible incidental opening will be considered.
For 2020 and 2021 the opportunities for opening appear very limited, but in due course I will examine whether opportunities arise to let cyclists and walkers use the dike incidentally and safely.

Voor 2020 en 2021 lijken de mogelijkheden voor openstelling zeer beperkt, maar ik zal te zijner tijd bezien of zich dan ook kansen voordoen om fietsers en wandelaars incidenteel veilig van de dijk gebruik te laten maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Geurts en Slootweg over de aanpak van knooppunt Hoevelaken

MPs of the CDA ask the minister about the stalled redevelopment of the Hoevelaken junction after the contract with BAM and Van Oord was reportedly terminated, including the delay to construction, traffic costs and possible coordination with the A1/A30 Barneveld project. The minister confirms the planned start of 2021 is now delayed to after the route decision (expected 2020), promises to inform the Chamber on re-tendering later, and gives partial answers on other points.
I will inform you at a later moment about how the realisation will be re-tendered.
Ik zal u op een later moment informeren over de wijze waarop de realisatie opnieuw wordt aanbesteed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het opvoeren van elektrische fietsen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the tampering of electric bicycles to exceed 25 km/h, including its prevalence, causes, enforcement and software chips. The minister said tampering is not banned but illegal tuned bikes are dangerous, that the problem's size is unknown, that she is monitoring it with industry and cyclist groups, and that enforcement includes road tests.
I am not aware of how large the problem is.
Het is mij niet bekend hoe groot het probleem is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Von Martels over de coulanceregeling Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

Two MPs asked the minister whether drivers harmed by CBR delays can expect a temporary coulance (goodwill) arrangement, and why medically flagged drivers cannot get faster renewals and police cannot verify doctors' letters. The minister confirmed no short-term coulance will be granted, citing road safety and that the arrangement cannot be verified, while saying the situation is regrettable.
That is correct. I understand the wish of your House.
Dat klopt. Ik begrijp de wens van uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Ziengs over de communicatie door het RIVM omtrent het onderzoeksrapport gewasbescherming en gezondheid

Two MPs asked why the RIVM's report on pesticide exposure among residents was leaked to media and published prematurely, and how the RIVM communicates with other government bodies. The minister regretted the early publications, said the RIVM was addressed on both incidents, and declined to direct the RIVM's communication, saying it has its own legal independence.
I may not direct them in that regard and I do not want to either.
Ik mag daar niet op sturen en wil dat ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de brief betreffende een algeheel verbod op het gebruik van de stroomhalsband

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the scientific basis for a total ban on electric shock collars for dogs, whether any use can be justified, and how the ban would be enforced. The minister cited recent scientific review evidence that shock collars are a serious, unavoidable welfare infringement without proven superior training results, declined to seek advice from the Animal Affairs Council, and said enforcement would fall to inspection bodies and the Public Prosecution Service.
No, I did not consider it necessary to request advice from the Animal Affairs Council, because the latest scientific insights on welfare harm from shock collars underpin my decision.

Nee, het vragen van een advies aan de Raad voor Dierenaangelegenheden vond ik niet nodig omdat de laatste wetenschappelijke inzichten inzake de welzijnsaantasting van het toepassen van de stroomband mijn besluit onderbouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Afsluitdijk dicht ook Fietsersbond baalt'

MPs asked the minister about the closure of the Afsluitdijk to cyclists for three years, the protests from cycling organisations, and whether temporary measures could keep the route open during high season. The minister confirmed the closure is needed for large construction works, pointed to a replacement bike bus, said temporary openings in summer are being investigated, and committed to sending the reply to the cycling organisations to the Chamber.
I am investigating whether temporary measures could make cycling over the Afsluitdijk safely possible on some days in high season.
Ik onderzoek of met tijdelijke voorzieningen op een aantal dagen in het hoogseizoen fietsen over de Afsluitdijk veilig mogelijk kan worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de Grote Kolksluis

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about plans to close the Grote Kolksluis permanently after the Meppelerdiep sluice was built, and about the impact on recreational boating, events and local businesses in Zwartsluis. The Minister confirmed the plan is being considered on cost grounds, saying the bridges will no longer be opened except for maintenance and events, and declined to designate the sluice as a national monument, saying that falls to another ministry.
Closing the movable bridges at the Grote Kolksluis lock complex does not come at the expense of safety.
Het afsluiten van de beweegbare bruggen bij het sluiscomplex de Grote Kolksluis gaat niet ten koste van de veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Von Martels over verbreding van de sluis bij Kornwerderzand

MPs Van der Graaf and Von Martels asked the minister about the widening of the Kornwerderzand lock, including the Prime Minister's statement that it will go ahead and how the remaining funding gap will be closed. The minister confirmed the statement, said no promises can be made on outcomes, and outlined work on cost optimisation, extra funding options with the region, and an employment-effects study.
With the regional administrators I made working agreements at the administrative consultation of 22 November, to look together for ways to close the financial gap that exists.
Met de regionale bestuurders heb ik in het bestuurlijk overleg van 22 november jl. werkafspraken gemaakt, om samen met hen op zoek te gaan naar manieren om het financiële gat, dat er is, te dichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Amhaouch over de ongelukken op de A67

CDA MPs asked the minister about accidents on the A67 motorway, including recent accident figures for 2018 compared with 2017 and whether other sources than BRON are used, and which safety measures are being studied under the MIRT exploration. The minister says 2018 figures are not yet available in BRON pending quality checks, will only communicate validated BRON data, and lists short-term measures such as emergency lanes, better merging, and tyre-related incident prevention plus a capacity expansion in the Leenderheide-Zaarderheiken section.
Once the definitive figures are available, I will inform the House further about the accident situation on the A67.
Ik zal zodra de definitieve cijfers beschikbaar zijn de Kamer nader informeren over de ongevalssituatie op de A67.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht ‘Directeur probleemkind Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR) stopt ermee’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the departure of the CBR director, the tightened oversight of the CBR, the causes and remedies of its long processing times, and correspondence with the CBR. The minister answered that the director will not be reappointed, that oversight has been tightened and will stay so as long as needed, that the digitalisation project is the structural fix, and listed the correspondence shared with parliament.
The ministry's supervision of the CBR has recently been tightened by me and will remain tightened for as long as necessary.
Het toezicht door het ministerie op het CBR is onlangs door mij aangescherpt en zal aangescherpt blijven zolang dit nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Dik-Faber, Sienot en Von Martels over het bericht dat de metingen in de Groninger bodem niet kloppen

Four MPs asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management how KNMI measurement errors in Groningen went unreported from August 2018 until February 2019, and what will prevent recurrence. The government answered that the KNMI delayed reporting, announced an evaluation, a working group, and an additional SodM audit, while stating the hazard models and damage decisions are not affected.
We regret that the KNMI did not report the identified deviations in a timely manner.
Wij betreuren het dat het KNMI niet tijdig een melding heeft gemaakt van de geconstateerde afwijkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Von Martels over de problematische situatie in de suikerbietenteelt na het wegvallen van het gebruik van neonicotinoïden

Two MPs asked the minister about the problems facing sugar beet cultivation after the EU restrictions on neonicotinoids, including delays in consultation, the handling of the Cruiser SB exemption request, and the environmental impact of alternatives. The minister answered that the restrictions were supported for bee risks, that a temporary exemption was judged unworkable and undesirable, and that long-term issues will be addressed in a crop protection vision.
I have informed your House as soon as possible about my decision.
Ik heb uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd over mijn beslissing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Von Martels over de bestrijding van de Japanse duizendknoop

CDA MPs asked about the spread of Asian knotweed, its damage costs, EU and national listing as an invasive species, and support for a national protocol. The minister said damage costs are not tracked, control is difficult with no single effective method, she supports a protocol and will approach parties, but declined EU listing and national designation under article 3.19 of the Nature Conservation Act.
No data are kept by the managers on the damage caused by Asian knotweed and the associated costs for residents, businesses and governments.
Er worden door de beheerders geen gegevens bijgehouden over de schade door Aziatische duizendknopen en daarmee gepaard gaande kosten voor inwoners, bedrijven en overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Von Martels en Omtzigt over de brand bij een Duitse kerncentrale vlakbij de Nederlandse grens

MPs from the CDA asked why the Dutch government and safety regions were not informed about a fire at a nuclear fuel plant in Lingen, Germany, and how the incident was classified and would be evaluated. The state secretary answered that the fire was not at the Emsland plant, no radioactive release occurred, it was provisionally classed INES-0, and the Veiligheidsregio Twente will evaluate it and share the findings with parliament.
The Veiligheidsregio Twente has indicated that it will evaluate this incident and involve the ANVS, the DCC IenW and the NCC (JenV).
De Veiligheidsregio Twente heeft aangegeven dit incident te gaan evalueren en daarbij de ANVS, het DCC IenW en het NCC (JenV) te zullen betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de containers die overboord zijn geslagen bij de Waddeneilanden

Von Martels (CDA) asked the minister about the roughly 270 containers, some with toxic substances, lost overboard from MSC Zoe near the Wadden islands, covering liability, salvage, cooperation, causes, prior inspection follow-up, and tracking. The minister answered that the shipowner is liable and pays clean-up costs, a criminal investigation by the OM is ongoing, and tracking containers via chips is being explored but requires international agreements.
The investigation by the Public Prosecution Service must show whether criminal offences have been committed.
Uit het onderzoek van het OM moet blijken of er sprake is van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Von Martels over regels en procedures die mogelijk onderzoek van gentherapie hinderen

MPs Van den Berg and Von Martels asked whether outdated EU and Dutch environmental-risk rules (GGO directives, implemented in the Besluit GGO 2013) hinder gene therapy research, and whether the Netherlands interprets EU rules more strictly than Belgium. The minister explained the permit procedure, denied stricter interpretation, defended the environmental risk framework as necessary, and said the government pushed the Commission for harmonisation and reduced burdens, though the Commission ruled out amending the GGO directives.
The Netherlands does not apply a stricter interpretation of the EU regulations.
Nederland hanteert geen striktere interpretatie van de EU-regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot, Weverling en Von Martels over het bericht dat patenten toch mogelijk zijn op veredelde groenten en planten

MPs De Groot, Weverling and Von Martels asked whether the European Patent Office appeals board allowing patents on natural plant traits and classically bred plants undermines Dutch law, and what the government will do. The minister says the written ruling is not yet available, that the government opposes such patents and will push for a lasting EU-level solution, but has not yet decided whether treaty amendment is the right route.
I am in favour of a swift and lasting solution to this matter.
Ik ben voor een snelle en duurzame oplossing van deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Remco Dijkstra, Van der Graaf, Von Martels, Gijs van Dijk, Van Aalst, Schonis en Laçin over de nieuwe prijsverhoging voor tachograafkaarten

MPs asked whether the government would accept a proposed 5% price rise for tachograph cards by Kiwa, how the Dutch price compares with neighbouring countries, and why the new fee system has not yet taken effect. The minister said the current card price stays at 95 euro while a new generation card is priced at 100 euro due to new EU requirements, promised a benchmark study and a letter later in the year, and refused to suspend the price increase despite a motion.
No, the tariffs for tachograph cards remain at the established price.
Nee, de tarieven voor de tachograafkaarten blijven op de vastgestelde prijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Von Martels over zorgvervoer en privacyregels

MPs Slootweg and Von Martels asked whether online booking of patient transport is becoming more common, whether strict GDPR privacy rules force two-factor login that burdens users, and whether booking confirmations can show reserved wheelchair space. The minister answered that internet communication is increasing, that GDPR and existing national rules apply, that two-factor login is separate from the booking confirmation which is the transporter's responsibility, and that no concrete change or action was promised.
Without further information about the reason for your question, or without further explanation, it is not possible for me to answer this question precisely.
Zonder nadere informatie over de aanleiding van uw vraag cq. zonder nadere duiding, is het voor mij niet mogelijk deze vraag precies te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Amhaouch over de onbewaakte spoorwegovergangen in Santpoort-Zuid

MPs Von Martels and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management for an update on the unguarded level crossings at Santpoort-Zuid, why the planned parallel road is delayed, its completion timeline, and how the project will be concluded quickly. The State Secretary answered that the parallel road is delayed by a landowner refusing cooperation and pending objections against permits, with a building-road target of summer 2019 and final road summer 2020, and that ProRail is pursuing legal options and a possible temporary route while hoping for an amicable settlement.
I share the conclusion that it is dangerous to cross these level crossings.
Ik deel de conclusie dat het gevaarlijk is om deze overwegen te kruisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over het lozen van giftige gassen door tankers in Gelderland

CDA MPs Von Martels and Geurts asked the government about tankers venting toxic gases in Gelderland, whether venting is legal, when it will be banned nationwide, and how enforcement is organised. The minister replied that venting by inland vessels is still permitted except for benzine, that a ban under the Scheepsafvalstoffenverdrag is being implemented around 2020, and that enforcement of provincial rules lies with the provinces, while promising to proceed with the ban.
Work is proceeding briskly on preparing the entry into force of the national venting ban, which is foreseen for 2020.
Er wordt voortvarend doorgewerkt aan de verdere voorbereiding van de inwerkingtreding van het nationale ontgassingsverbod, die voorzien is in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Von Martels over het feit dat ASML in België medische isotopen gaat ontwikkelen

MPs from the CDA asked why the Lighthouse medical isotope project, named a Dutch National Icon, is being developed in Belgium instead of the Netherlands, and what financing was tried. The government answered that Lighthouse keeps its icon status, that Dutch private investors judged the risk too high, and that the Belgian IRE is now the partner, with the state-aid compliance left to Belgium.
It is up to the Belgian government to ensure that the agreements comply with the European state aid rules.
Het is aan de Belgische overheid om te zorgen dat de afspraken voldoen aan de Europese staatssteunregels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Von Martels over de staat van onderhoud van het Kanaal van Gent naar Terneuzen en wateroverlast Sluiskil

MPs Van den Berg and Von Martels asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the maintenance of the Gent-Terneuzen canal and groundwater flooding in Sluiskil, including follow-up to earlier questions, causes, responsibility and remedies. The minister listed completed and ongoing maintenance actions, attributed the moisture problem to high groundwater and pre-Bouwbesluit housing, denied shared responsibility with the municipality and North Sea Port, and said Rijkswaterstaat will not directly consult the parties but will help if maintenance recurs.
Rijkswaterstaat has agreed with North Sea Port and the municipality of Terneuzen that the municipality maintains contact with those involved.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft met North Sea Port en gemeente Terneuzen afgesproken dat de gemeente contact onderhoudt met betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over getroffen rozentelers door Ralstonia en crisisaanpak plantenziekten

Von Martels (CDA) asked the Minister of Agriculture about growers of cut roses hit by Ralstonia, asking whether state aid under EU rules is possible, whether a compensation scheme will be introduced, and about the risks of future outbreaks. The minister declined to individually assess growers' financial situation, refused a dedicated aid scheme while keeping the possibility of sector-financed risk coverage under study, and noted the reporting duty.
It does not befit me to go into individual situations.
Het past mij niet op individuele situaties in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Von Martels en Moorlag over “designer dogs and cats”

MPs Weverling, Von Martels and Moorlag asked the minister about breeding of 'designer dogs and cats' with hereditary health problems, citing a petition, a European conference, and the adequacy of existing rules and enforcement. The minister agreed such breeding is unacceptable, pointed to Article 3.4 of the Besluit houders van dieren and ten NVWA inspections (four with enforcement), announced a review of enforcement due by year end, and said the issue is being raised in an EU subworking group.
I have commissioned research to make this more enforceable.
Ik heb onderzoek uitgezet om dit beter handhaafbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Von Martels over het bericht 'Minister geeft geen extra geld voor Noordelijke Randweg Utrecht'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the government will honour the coalition agreement and earlier commitments on the Noordelijke Randweg Utrecht and the Utrecht ring road, and why no extra funding is provided. The minister answered that the state contribution of 168 million euro is sufficient, that extra non-statutory measures must be financed by the region, and that the municipality has committed to implementing the existing plan in 2020-2025.
Since IenW already contributes substantially (168 million euro) to this municipal project, I have indicated that I see no further possibility to supplement this amount.
Aangezien IenW al substantieel bijdraagt (€ 168 mln) aan dit gemeentelijk project, heb ik aangegeven geen verdere mogelijkheid te zien om dit bedrag verder aan te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Ronnes en Beckerman over PUR-schuim in Vriezenveen

Three MPs asked the Minister of Interior about a family in Vriezenveen left facing a large claim after no contractor would remove demolition rubble containing PUR foam, and about PUR recycling, Bouwbesluit rules and comparisons with Germany and Belgium. The minister acknowledged the case, said the rubble was dumped as non-reusable, committed to amending the Bouwbesluit by mid-2019, and declined an independent inquiry.
However, I see no reason to commission further independent research in addition to the announced amendment of building regulations and the planned Health Council study.
Ik zie echter geen aanleiding om naast de door mij aangekondigde wijziging van de bouwregelgeving en het nog geplande onderzoek door de Gezondheidsraad nader onafhankelijk onderzoek te laten doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over veiligheid in tunnels

Von Martels (CDA) asked the Infrastructure Minister about a reported secret 'Pact van Houten' and fire-safety problems in recent tunnels, including whether results were withheld and whether the Chamber was informed. The minister denied any secret pact or concealment, acknowledged that concrete in four new tunnels does not meet fire requirements, and promised to inform the Chamber of measures within a month, though closures were not yet known.
On the measures I intend to take to bring the tunnels back into compliance with the requirements, I expect to inform you within a month.
Over de maatregelen, die ik van plan ben te nemen om de tunnels weer aan de eisen te laten voldoen, informeer ik u naar verwachting binnen een maand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over stremming bij sluizen in het Twentekanaal

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the closure of the Delden lock in the Twente Canal, attributed to staff shortages, was properly weighed against inland shipping interests, and whether Rijkswaterstaat had long known of staffing problems. The minister answered that the closure resulted from a combination of drought workload, holidays and unexpected absences, that staff were redeployed to Eefde, that there is no structural shortage or vacancy, and that the situation was unique.
There is no question of a staff shortage.
Er is geen sprake van een personeelstekort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over milieustickers in Franse steden

An MP asked the state secretary about French city environmental stickers that are hard for Dutch tourists to understand and obtain, and whether the Netherlands would push for EU-wide harmonisation. The state secretary acknowledged the difficulty, pointed Dutch drivers to ANWB advice and on-site information, and said she favours automatic number-plate recognition and alignment with Dutch harmonised zone rules.
That is not known to me.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Amhaouch over zware ongevallen A67

MPs Von Martels and Amhaouch asked the minister about serious accidents on the A67 motorway in 2018, their causes and casualties, truck involvement, and short- and long-term safety measures. The minister said 2018 accident data is not yet available, gave 2017 figures and traffic data, and pointed to a broadened MIRT study with possible safety measures to be decided this autumn.
I cannot say anything about this at the moment.
Hierover kan ik op dit moment nog geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van den Berg over het bericht dat Noord-Holland opheldering eist over uitspraken Wiebes over Pallas-reactor

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government will act quickly so that Noord-Holland's final 40 million euro loan tranche to the Pallas reactor foundation is released and isotope supply delays are avoided. Minister Bruins answered that a go/no-go decision is expected soon, that the province is responsible for the loan decision, and that intensive contact with Noord-Holland is ongoing, without committing to a specific new step.
I am not responsible for the decision-making of the province of Noord-Holland.
Ik ben niet verantwoordelijk voor de besluitvorming van de provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over door bruinrot getroffen rozentelers

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about rose growers hit repeatedly by Ralstonia (brown rot), including whether compensation should be given for losses from rightful containment measures and how the sector's plant health covenant and the source of infection will be handled. The Minister answered that such losses are normal business risk, that the Netherlands has chosen not to compensate under EU rules, and that talks with the sector on risk coverage and source tracing are ongoing.
The Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and several sector organisations in the plant sector are in consultation to reach agreements to limit phytosanitary risks in general.

Het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en enkele sectororganisaties in de plantaardige sector zijn in overleg om te komen tot afspraken om fytosanitaire risico's in het algemeen te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Von Martels en Van der Molen over oesterbanken voor de haven van Terschelling

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers about Japanese oyster banks affecting currents and access to the Terschelling harbour, dredging and ferry berths, a possible sailing ban near seal sandbanks, and the addition of the grey seal to Wadden dune habitat designations. The minister confirmed monitoring of the oyster banks with results expected end of the year, said the banks lie outside the ferry channel and do not affect access, confirmed planned maintenance of ferry infrastructure from 2019, and explained the limited scope of the grey seal designation.
These oyster banks are scheduled to be re-measured by Wageningen Marine Research this spring.
Deze oesterbanken worden volgens de planning dit voorjaar opnieuw ingemeten door Wageningen Marine Research.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Von Martels over het omgaan met de mogelijkheden om deelplatforms te kunnen onderwerpen aan nationale regels

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers whether a 2018 EU Court ruling allowing member states to regulate taxi platforms changes Dutch policy on regulating sharing-economy platforms and their enforcement. The government replied that the ruling does not extend member-state freedom beyond existing taxi rules, that platform regulation requires case-by-case assessment, and that it pursues dialogue with platforms, a regulatory review by the ATR due in Q3 2018, and improved fiscal enforcement.
There is no reason to impose new rules on taxi platforms in the Netherlands.
Voor het opleggen van nieuwe regels aan taxiplatforms in Nederland is geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Omtzigt, Remco Dijkstra en Van der Graaf over de verkeersveiligheid op de N36

MPs from CDA, VVD and ChristenUnie asked the minister why the N36 would not be widened along two sections during this year's maintenance, despite a motion adopted by parliament, and whether the government would guarantee full widening. The minister confirmed awareness of the motion and the coalition agreement, outlined interim safety measures, and said the remaining sections are being studied with results due in the second half of 2018, but gave no guarantee of full widening.
Following the adopted motion, I am examining the added value of widening on the sections where major maintenance is not currently taking place.
Naar aanleiding van de aangenomen motie onderzoek ik wat de meerwaarde is van verbreding op de delen waar groot onderhoud nu niet plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Von Martels over het bericht ’Vieze’ auto parkeren fors duurder

MPs Ziengs and Von Martels asked whether a proposal to let municipalities charge higher parking fees for polluting cars would unfairly burden motorists with older cars and modest incomes. The State Secretary answered that the measure is a incentive for zero-emission vehicles, not a penalty, that categories will be fixed in law to prevent misuse, and that the proposal is still being developed with municipalities.
The categorisation will be legally anchored and there is no room for municipalities' own interpretation.
De categorisering wordt juridisch verankerd en daarbij is geen ruimte voor eigen interpretatie door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht "Streekvervoer in drie regio's verstoord door stakingen"

An MP from the CDA asked the Staatssecretaris of Infrastructure and Water Management how people dependent on regional bus transport are protected during strikes in several regions, whether all hospital and care access remains possible, and whether passengers are adequately informed and have a reporting point. The state secretary regrets the disruption, says a general answer on reachable destinations cannot be given because strikes differ, notes that providers inform passengers via social media and stop displays, and states that there are no reporting points other than the operators' service desks, with legality of strikes reviewable by a court.
