I therefore cannot state in general terms which destinations remain reachable by public transport.
Ik kan daarom niet in algemene zin aangeven welke bestemmingen wel en niet bereikbaar blijven met het openbaar vervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Omtzigt over het onderzoek naar paasvuren

MPs Von Martels and Omtzigt asked why RIVM is studying Easter bonfire emissions, who commissioned it, its cost, and whether Easter fires are intangible heritage. The government answered that RIVM is updating the national emissions register under international obligations, estimated Easter fire PM10 emissions at about 10% of stove emissions, and budgeted 6,800 euro for a sizing study before any decision on inclusion.
Therefore it was decided to further determine the size of the source in 2018.
Daarom is besloten om in 2018 de grootte van de bron nader te gaan bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht dat er een wachtrij is voor het afleggen van een rijexamen

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the long waiting times for driving exams, asking whether the causes were foreseeable, whether the CBR's recovery plan will work, and whether poor driving schools should be named. The Minister acknowledges the problem, attributes it to both rising demand and examiner shortages, outlines CBR measures, and says publishing school pass rates is already done periodically, while declining to give separate waiting times by group beyond referring to the CBR website.
I have asked the CBR to provide clear information on its website to help people choose a driving school.
Ik heb het CBR gevraagd om op haar website duidelijke informatie te geven ten behoeve van het kiezen van een rijschool.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Bruins, Ziengs, Van Aalst, Baudet en Von Martels over het gebruik van werkbakken aan hijskranen bij asbestsanering

MPs asked whether the government will allow cranes with work baskets for asbestos roof removal in exceptional cases, given a sector decision system and an Aboma report criticising stricter Dutch rules. The State Secretary said a независимый study will report before summer 2018 and that a decision on any regulatory change will follow, without committing to temporary relief now.
As promised to the House, I will commission an independent study into the problems the asbestos removal contractors describe.
Ik laat, zoals aan uw Kamer is toegezegd, een onafhankelijk onderzoek uitvoeren naar de problematiek die de asbestsaneerders aangeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de aanbesteding van de Afsluitdijk

An MP asked whether the Kornwerderzand bridges can be made reliable for their remaining life, and whether the €81 million tender windfall on the Afsluitdijk project could fund a wider lock and bridge replacement now. The minister answered that maintenance is planned, that adding the bridges and lock to the Afsluitdijk tender is not possible for legal, funding and delay reasons, and that a regional financing proposal is still being worked out with an update promised mid-year.
It is therefore not yet possible to give a general update on the financing proposal before the spring memorandum.
Het is daarom nog niet mogelijk voorafgaand aan de voorjaarsnota een algemene stand van zaken te geven over het financieringsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van Helvert over de berichten dat oude diesels niet meer welkom zijn in Arnhem en Maastricht

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about Arnhem and Maastricht introducing municipal low-emission zones that exclude old diesels, and whether this fits the coalition agreement and risks a patchwork of local zones. The state secretary replied that she will agree nationwide harmonisation with municipalities and the VNG before summer, that municipalities keep the power to set zones, and committed to improving collection of foreign fines.
It remains the municipality's competence to decide whether and where a low-emission zone is introduced and to what extent it is proportionate as a measure to improve air quality.
Het blijft de bevoegdheid van de gemeente om te bepalen of en waar een milieuzone wordt ingevoerd en in hoeverre deze proportioneel is als maatregel om luchtkwaliteit te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van der Molen over het bericht dat de vaarweg naar Ameland geen karrenspoor moet worden

MPs Von Martels and Van der Molen asked the minister about reports that the ferry route to Ameland should not become a 'cart track', about the reliability of the ferry connection due to low water, and whether the island could become unreachable. The minister answered that short-term measures are underway with Wagenborg, a long-term solution process starts after 2029, and there are no indications the island will become unreachable before then.
At the same time, under the direction of RWS and in line with the OPP advice, a process starts to reach a long-term solution for Ameland's accessibility beyond 2029.

Tegelijkertijd start onder regie van RWS – in overeenstemming met het OPP advies – een proces om te komen tot een lange termijn oplossing voor de bereikbaarheid van Ameland op de langere termijn (na 2029).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ellemeet, Dik-Faber en Von Martels over de situatie dat het openbaar vervoer in de dorpen niet altijd toegankelijk is voor rolstoelgebruikers

MPs asked whether wheelchair users can be refused when transferring from a regular bus to a community bus, and whether the Wet personenvervoer 2000 should be amended to close a gap. The government answers there is no legal omission: the Wgbh/cz applies, community buses are deliberately outside its scope as small vehicles, the province chose not to impose further demands on volunteer-run services, and gemeenten must provide small-scale wheelchair transport instead.
There is no omission in the Wet personenvervoer 2000 that would need to be repaired.
Er is geen sprake van een omissie in de Wet personenvervoer 2000 die gerepareerd zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts, Omtzigt, Von Martels en Slootweg over transparantie regionaal BO van 18 december 2017 en Alderstafel Lelystad Airport

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about transparency of the regional administrative consultation of 18 December 2017, whether minutes and agenda would be public, the remaining steps before the environmental impact report, and the evaluation of the Schiphol advisory council. The Minister confirmed the importance of transparency but declined to publish the minutes of the 18 December consultation for now, citing confidential input from provincial officials, and promised further consultation and a letter to parliament in early February.
Therefore I will not yet make the minutes of the administrative consultation of 18 December 2017 public at this time.
Derhalve zal ik het verslag van het bestuurlijk overleg van 18 december 2017 op dit moment nog niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over elektromagnetische velden en elektrohypersensitiviteit

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Netherlands takes fewer precautions on electromagnetic radiation than other countries, how the health council's advice on mobile phones is implemented, whether guidelines are possible, whether non-thermal cellular effects are considered, whether electrohypersensitivity is rising, and whether stakeholders can be brought back to the knowledge platform. The state secretary answered that Dutch policy follows the EU recommendation and ICNIRP limits, that a cohort study continues, that no binding measures are planned because evidence is weak, that electrohypersensitivity is not tracked in recent health outlooks, and that the platform aims at a broad public rather than one stakeholder group.
Following the health council's advice, I have decided, together with the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate, to continue the ongoing cohort research in this field after 2017.

Naar aanleiding van het advies van de Gezondheidsraad heb ik, samen met de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en Klimaat, besloten om het lopende cohortonderzoek op dit terrein na 2017 voort te laten zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Von Martels over opwaardering Maaslijn en realisatie station Grubbenvorst Greenport-Venlo

MPs Jetten and Von Martels asked why the Maaslijn upgrade faces a funding shortfall and whether station Grubbenvorst Greenport-Venlo can still be realised. The state secretary answers that the national government paid its contributions, that the shortfall stems from the province misreading VAT rules, that the state remains willing to provide a capped subsidy if the province applies, and that the project planning is the province's responsibility.
The decision whether or not to proceed with building station Grubbenvorst rests with the province of Limburg.
De afweging om al dan niet over te gaan tot aanleg van station Grubbenvorst is aan de provincie Limburg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Von Martels over CETA en het succes van de op de Canadese markt aanwezige genetisch gemodificeerde zalm

Two CDA MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade whether genetically modified salmon sold in Canada could reach the Dutch market under CETA, and how origin labelling and EU rules apply. The minister answered that GM animals and derived products are not authorised in the EU, that export to the EU is not allowed, that CETA contains no provisions on GM fish and changes nothing to EU GMO rules, and that EU labelling rules make fish origin traceable.
CETA contains no agreements on EU imports of genetically modified fish.
In CETA zijn geen afspraken gemaakt over de EU-import van genetisch gemodificeerde vis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Ronnes over de rol van de Nederlandse Spoorwegen bij de verliezen die in Schotland worden geleden

MPs Von Martels and Ronnes asked whether the minister knew Abellio ScotRail, an NS subsidiary, was loss-making and received a group loan support, and whether this is reasonable given NS's Dutch-state ownership. The minister answered that the losses were known through regular shareholder consultation, that the group guarantee is a market-standard concession requirement capped under a risk framework, and that he sees no reason to doubt NS's expectation of eventual profitability.
That was known to me. The ministry, as shareholder, regularly consults with NS on the financial position of NS and relevant group companies.
Dat was mij bekend. Het ministerie heeft als aandeelhouder regelmatig overleg met NS over de financiële stand van zaken van NS en relevante groepsonderdelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de beschikbare zitplaatsen in treinen van de NS

An MP asks the State Secretary about seat shortages on NS trains in September 2017, including expected record crowding, the share of growth due to the economy, the new Flirt trains, and whether a study of the September peak and student travel is needed. The State Secretary answers that September peaks are known, ties growth mainly to economic factors, says standing during peaks is acceptable and NS must still meet concession requirements, and declines a new study while pointing to existing student travel pilots.
I therefore see no reason to launch further research into the causes of the September crowding.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om nader onderzoek in te stellen naar de oorzaken van de septemberdrukte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Remco Dijkstra en Weverling over het bericht ‘Tuinbouw in de knel door raffinaderijbrand Pernis’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the greenhouse sector's CO2 supply disruption after the Pernis refinery fire needs an emergency fix and talks with industry to prevent recurrence. The minister replied that CO2 supply is a private arrangement with no government role, but that EZ is exploring additional CO2 sources and buffering within existing green deal and smart grid frameworks, with timing unpredictable and supply restored from 21 August.
This is a collaboration between private parties, in which the government plays no role.
Dit is een samenwerking tussen private partijen, waarbij de overheid geen rol speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over het landelijk asbestvolgsysteem en de programmatische aanpak asbestdaken

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary about recurring faults, slowness and usability problems with the national asbestos tracking system LAVS, and about rules that prevent combining indoor and outdoor asbestos removal on agricultural buildings. The government answers that problems are normal during ICT development, that capacity and user meetings are being improved, and that combined indoor-outdoor removal is not prohibited, with a handbook under review.
In consultation with users, problems are discussed and addressed as quickly as possible.
In overleg met de gebruikers worden problemen besproken en zo snel mogelijk geadresseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Von Martels, Nijkerken-de Haan en Middendorp over het behoud van het station Valkenburg door de Zuid-Limburgse Stoomtrein Maatschappij

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the State Secretary about the ILT's refusal to let the Zuid-Limburgse Stoomtrein Maatschappij run over the main line to Valkenburg station without machinist licences, and whether the rules are stricter than EU requirements. The State Secretary answered that no regulatory change occurred, the ILT had no legal basis for an exemption, and ZLSM is expected to obtain a new safety certificate by early 2018 with a study into training for its machinists.
The ILT's decision arose from a request by the ZLSM.
Het besluit van de ILT komt voort uit een verzoek van de ZLSM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de onbewaakte spoorwegovergang in Santpoort-Zuid

An MP asked the state secretary about the unguarded level crossing at Santpoort-Zuid, its timeline, a possible expropriation, and whether obstacles or a mediator were needed. The state secretary explained that the southern crossing will close once a farm business is relocated, the northern one awaits agreement with several rights holders, and the state secretary has prioritised closing such crossings but is not a party to local measures.
Tackling public and publicly accessible unguarded level crossings on the passenger network is indeed a priority for me.
Het aanpakken van openbare en openbaar toegankelijke NABO's op het reizigersnet heeft voor mij inderdaad prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de implementatie van het Nagoya Protocol en de gevolgen daarvan voor Nederland

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the EU implementation of the Nagoya Protocol, including fears of perpetual patents, retroactive application in China, and whether commercial varieties should be excluded. The State Secretary answered that the EU cut-off date of 12 October 2014 applies, that commercial varieties are under discussion in EU expert groups, and that Dutch positions are being prepared.
Formal questions for clarification have been submitted to the relevant Chinese authorities.
Er zijn formeel vragen voor verduidelijking ingediend bij de betreffende Chinese autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over misleiding bij autoverhuur aan toeristen in het buitenland

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about consumers being misled by hidden extra costs when renting cars abroad, and how transparency and supervision could be improved. The minister answered that consumers must not be misled, pointed to existing EU consumer rules and the ACM's supervision, noted improvements from an EU-level joint action, and saw no need for further measures for now.
At this moment I see no need to take other measures, since the measures taken at European level have led to more transparent offers and conditions at car rental companies.

Op dit moment zie ik geen noodzaak tot het nemen van andere maatregelen aangezien de in Europees verband getroffen maatregelen hebben gezorgd voor transparantere aanbiedingen en voorwaarden bij de autoverhuurbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Von Martels over berichten dat consumenten problemen met hun voertuig ondervinden na het toepassen van de software-update van Volkswagen

MPs Van Eijs and Von Martels asked whether the Volkswagen software update causes higher fuel use, power loss and EGR valve failures, whether EGR removal is adequately regulated, and how consumers are compensated. The minister replied that independent tests (KBA, RDW, TNO) found no negative effects on fuel use or power, that a ban on removing emission controls is being prepared, and that PON handles complaints individually while the recall is voluntary for consumers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over treinvertragingen door wangedrag

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary whether it is true that most train delays are caused by misconduct such as reckless behaviour, vandalism and bomb threats, what share of delays could be avoided, where such delays concentrate, and what is being done about track-trespassers and level-crossing offenders, including enforcement priority. The State Secretary confirmed the reports, explained that third-party disruptions account for 53% of disruptions (over half of which are trespassers), described prevention programmes and enforcement by ProRail inspectors, and promised an annual disruption report, while withholding the locations of high-risk sites for reasons of sensitivity.
ProRail however prefers, given the sensitivity of this issue, not to make these locations public.
ProRail geeft er echter, gelet op de gevoeligheid van deze problematiek, de voorkeur aan deze locaties niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de onveiligheid van conducteurs van NS

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary about conductors feeling unsafe in the evening, rising aggression figures, and what measures have been taken since 2015. The State Secretary answered that a dual-staffing measure is being implemented, a monitoring survey is planned, the WODC evaluation found it too early to draw conclusions, and an action programme (HIC-aanpak OV) with 23 measures is underway with a progress report promised for autumn 2017.
Together with NS I want to await the evaluation of this measure to see whether and what effect it has had.
Samen met NS wil ik de evaluatie van deze maatregel afwachten om te bezien of en welk effect deze heeft gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Ronnes, Omtzigt, Jetten en Van Weyenberg over het bericht in de Trouw van 4 mei 2017 “Staatsbedrijf NS ontwijkt fiscus weer”

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the government about reports that state-owned NS avoids Dutch tax via an Irish leasing subsidiary, including whether the 2015 agreements were honoured and how much tax is lost. The minister defended the arrangement as consistent with a 'level playing field' for foreign concessions, and refused to give tax figures citing secrecy rules and business confidentiality while promising phase-out of the Irish route on Dutch lines.

A more detailed specification of amounts I cannot give because under article 67 of the AWR I cannot make statements about the taxes of individual taxpayers, as business confidentiality precludes this.

Een nadere specificatie van bedragen kan ik niet geven omdat ik op grond van artikel 67 van de AWR geen uitspraken kan doen over de belastingen van individuele belastingplichtigen omdat bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid zich hiertegen verzet.

This amendment prevents persons who do not demonstrably breach the duty to provide information intentionally or through gross negligence from being disproportionately affected.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Raemakers over het bericht dat de overheveling van de ggz naar Wlz op de lange baan wordt geschoven

MPs Sahla and Raemakers asked the minister why the transfer of mental health care into the Wlz is being postponed, how many clients use the transitional arrangement, and whether it is budget-neutral and on what timeline it will be resolved. The minister answered that about 25,000 clients remain under the transitional rules, that the arrangement does not breach the law, that ending it is still the aim but needs more time for budget-neutral design, and that a concrete timeline will be given later with a report before summer 2024.
On 1 June 2023 there were about 28,500 people with a ggz-living indication under the Wlz.
Op 1 juni 2023 waren er circa 28.500 mensen met een indicatie voor ggz-wonen vanuit de Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over signalen van gebedsgenezers die autisme claimen te kunnen genezen door uitdrijving van demonen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports of faith healers claiming to cure autism through demon exorcism, including reactions to a Rotterdam event, whether the government would investigate, supervise or revoke ANBI status, and privacy safeguards for filmed participants. The State Secretary answered that these gatherings are religious rather than treatment under youth or care law, that no investigation or enhanced supervision is planned, that ANBI status cannot be refused on this basis, and that the Dutch DPA is being alerted about the filming.
In view of the answers above, I do not intend to conduct research.
Gelet op de antwoorden hierboven ben ik niet voornemens om onderzoek te doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Raemakers over het artikel 'Het gebrek aan zorg voor psychiatrische patiënten met een verslaving drijft ouders tot wanhoop: ‘Wij zijn gevangen in de zorg voor hem’

D66 MPs Kat and Raemakers asked the state secretary and minister about a newspaper report on people with psychiatric problems and addiction who fall between care providers, lose housing and end up in severe cases. The government acknowledges the problem, points to existing dual-diagnosis standards, the Integraal zorgakkoord and regional escalation models, says care providers do not record referrals, and promises to pass the Querido pilot to municipalities and to inform itself via the national addiction rapporteur.
Care providers do not keep data on referrals to other care providers, so there is no national picture of how large this group is.
Zorginstanties houden geen gegevens bij over het doorverwijzen naar andere zorginstanties, dus er is geen landelijk beeld hoe groot deze groep is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht dat er toch weer jeugddelinquenten geplaatst worden in Cadier en Keer

An MP asked whether juvenile offenders are being placed in closed youth care facilities (Cadier en Keer) alongside vulnerable youths, and why the small-scale juvenile justice facilities (KVJJ) are under-used. The Minister replies that the reported sequence is incorrect since closed youth care placement always requires a separate civil court authorisation, and defends the mixed-group approach while announcing a review of KVJJ placement criteria with results expected by June 2023.
Placement in closed youth care always requires a separate (civil law) authorisation from the children's judge.
Voor de plaatsing in de gesloten jeugdhulp is altijd een afzonderlijke (civielrechtelijke) machtiging van de kinderrechter vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht in Trouw over het gebrek aan landelijk overzicht van de wachttijden in de jeugdzorg

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport about the lack of a national overview of youth care waiting times, which a Trouw report highlighted, and what has been done to create one since the Youth Act of 2015. The state secretary answered that no national overview or regional average waiting times exist, that municipalities are responsible, that the Aanpak Wachttijden with a learning network and a national picture is under way, and that the Rijnmond follow-up continues.
It is not known what the current average waiting time per region is for the most common forms of youth care.
Het is niet bekend wat op dit moment de gemiddelde wachttijd per regio is voor de meest voorkomende vormen van jeugdzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over de berichten dat het aantal jongeren met suïcidale gedachten ook na corona hoog is en dat er een toename van zelfdodingen onder jongvolwassenen is

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that youth suicidal thoughts and young-adult suicides remain high after COVID, and what the government will do. The secretary acknowledged the concerning data, cited huisarts visit increases of 39%, and listed mental-health prevention measures, including the national mental health approach, loneliness policy and suicide prevention agenda.
Yes, I am aware of the reports.
Ja, ik ben bekend met de berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht dat kleinschalige jeugdgevangenissen weinig gebruikt worden

An MP from D66 asks the Minister for Legal Protection why small-scale youth detention facilities (KVJJ) are underused, including the role of the central Divisie Individuele Zaken in placement decisions and the placement criteria. The Minister acknowledges low occupancy, defends central placement by DIZ to ensure uniformity, and says the criteria are being revised by autumn 2022 with a monitor report due April 2023.
No. Since the decision to include the KVJJ in the system, the placement process and DIZ's role have been aligned with the broader placement process.
Nee. Sinds het besluit om de KVJJ op te nemen in het stelsel, is het plaatsingsproces van de KVJJ en de rol van DIZ daarin in lijn gebracht met het bredere plaatsingsproces
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Paulusma over de uitspraak van de advocaat-generaal aan de Hoge Raad ten aanzien van verplichte anticonceptie in de gesloten jeugdzorg

MPs Raemakers and Paulusma asked the State Secretary for Health about the Advocate-General's opinion that compulsory contraception under the Wvggz may breach the ECHR, and whether it is also imposed in closed youth care. The State Secretary declined to anticipate the Supreme Court ruling, said closed youth care falls under the Youth Act rather than the Wvggz, and argued that compulsory contraception there should be exceptional and rare.
I await the Supreme Court's ruling with interest.
Ik wacht de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad met belangstelling af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Toezichthouder verzamelt ongevraagd info over 800.000 ggz-patiënten'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport whether the NZa (healthcare regulator) may collect patients' mental health data without explicit consent, on what legal basis, and whether privacy principles and the Data Protection Authority were properly addressed. The minister answered that the NZa acts under its statutory powers in the Wmg, that data are pseudonymised and will be destroyed after use, that the reporting obligation was postponed to 1 January 2023, and that no further investigation will be ordered because the NZa decides itself how to gather information.

I will not instruct further research as described in questions 8 and 9, because, as stated in my answer to question 1, the NZa as an independent administrative body makes its own considerations about how it generates information.

Ik zal geen opdracht geven tot nader onderzoek zoals omschreven in vraag 8 en 9, omdat zoals gesteld in mijn antwoord op vraag 1 de NZa als ZBO haar eigen afwegingen maakt over de wijze waarop zij informatie genereert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over de lange wachttijden bij de ggz

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about long mental health waiting times, underspending of the budget by insurers, staff shortages at GGZ institutions, regional complex-care tables, transparency of waiting lists, and the promised letter on insurers' duty of care. The Minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to measures and IZA agreements, promised transparency improvements and further talks, and gave a partial answer on some points without addressing budget oversight directly.
I therefore want to make agreements in the context of the Integrated Care Agreement (IZA) with care providers, professionals and health insurers on this point
Ik wil daarom in het kader van het Integraal Zorg Akkoord (IZA) afspraken maken met zorgaanbieders, professionals en zorgverzekeraars op dit punt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Westerveld, Van den Berg en Bikker over de staat van de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz)

Four MPs asked the minister about financial strain, possible closures, staffing shortages and the new mental health care payment model in Dutch GGZ. The minister answered that insurers and providers must resolve continuity and financial problems through contracting, that the NZa is monitoring and was asked to analyse closures, and that a joint working-arrangement process on freelance staffing was started, while leaving much of the detail to the sector.
I have asked the NZa to analyse the recent closures and inform me about any common underlying causes.
Ik heb de NZa gevraagd om de recente sluitingen te analyseren en mij te informeren over eventuele gemeenschappelijke achterliggende oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht dat duizenden medewerkers de jeugdbescherming de rug hebben toegekeerd

An MP asked the minister whether thousands of youth protection staff are leaving, with figures on departures, sick leave, workload and remedies. The minister said these figures are not centrally recorded, promised to ask providers for data and monitoring, pointed to extra funding and an upcoming exploration of the labour market problem, and noted that a future scenario for child protection is in consultation.
These figures are not centrally recorded or registered.
Deze cijfers worden niet centraal bijgehouden of geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over een opnamestop bij de Zuyderland ziekenhuizen door een ict-storing

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a full admission stop at Zuyderland hospitals caused by an ICT failure during the second COVID wave, including effects on care and whether backup systems should exist. The minister said hospitals are responsible for backup arrangements, that no planned operations were postponed, and that the hospital had a dual setup that became unstable after a cable was damaged.
Healthcare providers are responsible for delivering good and safe care.
Zorgaanbieders zijn verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van goede en veilige zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het bericht dat zorgmedewerkers met corona toch moeten komen werken

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked the health minister whether zorgmedewerkers with COVID-19 may still be made to work, whether they accept exceptions to isolation rules when rosters cannot be filled, and how care continuity is ensured without endangering patients. The minister answered that positive staff must not work and cannot be forced to, that narrow exceptions in FMS and RIVM guidance require documented, safe risk assessments, and that regional steering groups and staffing measures will be used; the answer to the eighth question was not given in time for the committee debate.
Staff who have tested positive may not work and may also not be forced to work.
Medewerkers die positief getest zijn, mogen niet werken en mogen ook niet worden gedwongen om te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Hijink en en Wörsdörfer over wederom een datalek in de jeugdzorg

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health whether a new data leak at a youth care provider (Kenter/Jeugdriagg) could have been prevented given an earlier 2019 leak, and what steps have been taken on the earlier motions about securing youth care data, Z-CERT affiliation, penetration tests and ethical hacking rules. The State Secretary acknowledged the leak resulted from an old unclosed domain name, described the steps taken with branch organisations and Deloitte-run penetration tests, and said Z-CERT affiliation could start in early 2021 while stressing providers bear primary responsibility.
Through Z-CERT's risk-driven approach we will again examine the possibilities for affiliation.
Door de risico gestuurde aanpak van Z-CERT gaan we opnieuw de mogelijkheden voor aansluiting onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Raemakers over het artikel ‘Buitenlandse Artsen in Nederland: ‘Ik denk dat niemand mij zal bellen’

MPs Paternotte and Raemakers asked the ministers about a press article on foreign-trained doctors facing long, costly re-qualification procedures and about the abolition of the supervised-practice scheme. The minister said patient safety comes first, promised to explore streamlining the procedure with the CBGV and VBGA, and gave historical and procedural explanations.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Paternotte en Raemakers over het tekort aan virusremmer remdesivir tegen corona

Three MPs asked the Health Minister how many remdesivir doses the EU allocated to the Netherlands, when shortages became clear, how the EU distributes supply, and whether shortages would persist. The minister answered that the Netherlands received 24,000 doses for October, that EU allocation follows hospital admission incidence, and that a monthly supply contract with Gilead now applies, though precise longer-term supply and the effect of shortages remain unknown.
The Netherlands was allocated 24,000 doses (for about 4,000 patients) for the month of October.
Nederland heeft voor de maand oktober een hoeveelheid van 24.000 doses (voor ongeveer 4000 patiënten) toegewezen gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over gebrekkige afspraken over betaalbaarheid, transparantie en toegankelijkheid van geneesmiddelen in de toolkit Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Licentiëren

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about gaps in the NFU toolkit for responsible licensing of publicly funded medicines, including price transparency, affordability and access, and whether government should take the lead. The Minister says some clauses could be useful, that the toolkit will be evaluated in two years, that government lacks the expertise to impose licence clauses now, and that EU-level cooperation and transparency on pricing are the preferred routes.
Confidential price agreements were made about Myozyme by my predecessor, and I cannot elaborate on them.
Over Myozyme zijn door mijn ambtsvoorganger vertrouwelijke prijsafspraken gemaakt, waarover ik niet kan uitweiden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Wilders, Graus, Emiel van Dijk, Regterschot, Nijkerken-De Haan, Raemakers, Ploumen, Gijs van Dijk, Öztürk en Wassenberg over het advies van de Raad van Europa over a

Multiple MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she shares the Council of Europe's view that Limburgish and other regional languages need more government attention, and what the government does to promote them. The minister answered that the government gives ample attention to regional languages, pointed to the 2019 Limburgish convenant with the province, the symposia, education and childcare provisions, and the province's leading role, without committing to new obligations such as recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
The government is not working on recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
De regering werkt niet aan het erkennen van het Limburgs als overheidstaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Raemakers over de consultatie van de Wet houdende wijziging van de Jeugdwet en enige andere wetten

MPs Wörsdörfer and Raemakers asked why the consultation on the Youth Act amendment bill started on 10 July 2020 when the minister had said he hoped to start it after the summer, and whether the consultation period of about eight weeks, overlapping holidays, gave municipalities enough time to respond. The minister answered that the aim had long been summer consultation, that the eight-week period accommodates all parties, and that he will not extend the period but will discuss the outcome with parliament this autumn.
I would like to discuss with your House this autumn how I intend to deal with the outcome of the consultation, and I therefore do not intend to extend the consultation period in general.
Ik wil graag dit najaar nog met uw Kamer bespreken hoe ik met de opbrengst uit de consultatie wil omgaan en ben daarom niet van plan om de consultatieperiode in zijn algemeenheid te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor kinderen en jongeren in jeugdzorg

An MP asked the Health Minister about the effects of the COVID-19 crisis on youth care, including reduced care delivery, the risk of children falling out of view, monitoring, and youth participation in treatment. The minister answered that effects on long-term demand are not yet clear, that care is partly recovering since mid-May, and that impact is monitored with commitments to keep working with providers and youth councils.
This means it is not yet possible to make statements about the long-term effects of the coronavirus crisis on the number of young people needing youth care.
Dit maakt dat het op dit moment nog niet mogelijk is om uitspraken te doen wat de effecten van de Coronacrisis zijn op het aantal jongeren die jeugdhulp nodig hebben voor de lange termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Menstruatiearmoede: geen geld voor maandverband, dan maar wc-papier’

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked the government about reports that some young women in the Netherlands cannot afford menstrual products, and whether the government would investigate price barriers, identify at-risk groups, change VAT or adopt a free-provision policy like Scotland's. The Secretary of State answered that the government supports an integrated poverty approach, points to school sex education, a planned handreiking for schools and municipal support, and declined to commission separate price research.
Are you willing to conduct further research into the extent to which the price of menstrual products hinders access to these products for people living near the poverty line?
Bent u bereid nader onderzoek te doen naar in welke mate de prijs van menstruatieproducten de toegankelijkheid van deze producten belemmert voor mensen die rond de armoedegrens leven?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het stoppen met het herindicatie circus voor mensen met een chronische aandoening of een beperking

MPs Bergkamp, Raemakers and Slootweg asked whether the one-time diagnosis rule for chronically ill people (no repeated reassessments) would apply equally to Wmo and Jeugdwet support, and what would be done about repeated re-indication for blind people and people with disabilities. The minister answered that the Zvw change covers only health insurance, that Wmo and youth support require individual assessment, and that the VNG will survey municipal practice without a uniform legal change.
For young people with a disability, the need for help will change over time, and it is desirable to reassess the required help to best match their needs.
Voor jongeren met een beperking zal met het verstrijken van de tijd de hulpvraag veranderen en is het wenselijk de benodigde hulp opnieuw te inventariseren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over de rol die transferverpleegkundigen en transferbureaus spelen in persoonsgerichte zorg

Two D66 MPs asked about the role of transfer nurses and transfer agencies in person-centred care, including staff numbers, opening hours, and coordination with municipalities under the Wmo. The minister said there is no good overview of transfer nurse numbers, that the sector is mainly hospital-based, and that he will ask V&VN and VNG about local agreements with municipalities.
There is no good overview of the number of transfer nurses and the number of full-time equivalents.
Er is geen goed overzicht van het aantal transferverpleegkundigen en het aantal fte's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Raemakers over het bericht “Het raadsel rond de val van burgemeester Peter de Koning: Dit is een stille coup”.

MPs Den Boer and Raemakers asked about the unexplained forced resignation of Gennep mayor Peter de Koning and whether the procedure followed the Municipalities Act, and called for more transparency on mayoral departures. The minister said the breakdown was regrettable, that the commissaris van de Koning reported on the background, that no formal dismissal procedure under article 61b applied, and that she saw no reason for further research but would discuss the theme with the commissioners.
I see no reason for further investigation. However, following the Gennep case I will discuss the theme with the commissioners of the King.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nader onderzoek. Wel zal ik naar aanleiding van de casus Gennep de thematiek met de commissarissen van de Koning bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht 'Gemeenten niet gericht op schuldenvrij maken inwoners'

An MP asks the state secretary for Social Affairs about a report finding that municipal debt assistance focuses on behavioural change rather than debt-free futures, that registrations are incomplete, and that access and quality vary. The state secretary largely defends the current system, points to benchmarks, a planned amendment to the Wgs, CBS research and a checklist, but mostly leaves quality control and steering with municipalities.
Municipalities are responsible for debt assistance. They must have, or obtain, (numerical) insight in order to steer on the effectiveness of the implementation of their debt assistance.

Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de schuldhulpverlening. Zij moeten (cijfermatig) inzicht hebben of verkrijgen om te kunnen sturen op de effectiviteit van de uitvoering van hun schuldhulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht dat jeugdrechtadvocaten massaal overwegen piketdienst terug te schroeven

Rep. Raemakers (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that youth-law advocates were considering scaling back their police-interview duty service, including the inadequate per-client fee and the risk of breaching the EU juvenile directive. The minister confirmed that legal assistance at police interviews of minors is now mandatory since 1 June 2019, said the fee would be discussed with stakeholders, and expressed confidence that a shortage would not occur.

I will discuss the fee in the consultations that will take place shortly with the youth-law advocates, the Legal Aid Board, the police and the Public Prosecution Service on the practical implementation of the law.
Ik zal de vergoeding bespreken in de overleggen die op korte termijn zullen plaatsvinden met jeugdrechtadvocatuur, Raad voor rechtsbijstand, politie en OM over de praktische uitvoering van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Van Helvert en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘RIVM scherpt vaccinatieadvies mazelen aan’

MPs Raemakers, Van Helvert and Sjoerdsma asked about RIVM's measles vaccination advice for infants travelling to high-risk countries and whether the Foreign Ministry should adjust its travel advice accordingly. The minister answered that the advice is updated annually based on WHO data, and that the Foreign Ministry defers health information to the national travel health centre (LCR) by linking to it rather than copying the measles guidance, while examining automatic integration.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is examining whether it is possible to automatically load the LCR information into the BZ Travel App.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken onderzoekt wel of het mogelijk is om de informatie van de LCR automatisch in de BZ Reisapp in te laden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht ‘Opnieuw datalek in Utrechtse Jeugdzorg’

An MP asked the health minister about a data leak at the Utrecht youth care sector: a test website of the professional register SKJ wrongly published 34 non-anonymised disciplinary decisions, and whether the government will strengthen cybersecurity across healthcare. The minister acknowledges the leak as undesirable, reports steps including pen-tests, an IGJ inspection and a Jeugdzorg Nederland review, and promises a separate letter on information security in September.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Sjoerdsma over het aanpassen van reisadviezen naar aanleiding van de uitbraak van mazelen in een Haagse kinderopvang

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Affairs Minister why travel advice does not specifically warn of measles risk in Europe and whether it should be updated, as the GGD does. The minister replied that travel advice links directly to the LCR's current health information, which covers measles, and that the ministry is not the health authority and will not copy changing health advice into its advice.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is examining whether it is possible to automatically load the LCR information into the BZ Travel app.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken onderzoekt wel of het mogelijk is om de informatie van de LCR automatisch in de BZ Reisapp in te laden.
Àntwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Van Eijs en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘800.000 Nederlanders kregen kanker, na ‘genezing’ houden zij problemen’

Three D66 MPs asked the health, finance and social affairs ministers about reports that many cancer survivors face lasting problems, including ongoing fatigue, lack of aftercare and advice, difficulties returning to work, and problems obtaining mortgages and insurance. The ministers answered that care providers should be doing more, that existing initiatives such as a no-risk insurance pilot and a Taskforce Cancer Survivorship are underway, and that the government sees little need for its own intervention, while promising to review mortgage and insurance issues with the sector.

In preparation for the next Platform meeting in 2020, I will ask how lenders handle the life insurance requirement and whether parties experience other bottlenecks in mortgage provision to (ex-)cancer patients.

Ik zal in voorbereiding op de volgende Platform bijeenkomst in 2020 uitvragen hoe kredietverstrekkers omgaan met de overlijdensrisicoverzekering en of partijen andere knelpunten ervaren op het gebied van hypotheekverstrekking aan (ex)kankerpatiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat een niet-bewezen effectieve therapie bij ADHD wel door zorgverzekeraars vergoed wordt

MPs Raemakers and Van Weyenberg asked the ministers whether insurers, municipalities and UWV fund horse therapy for ADHD and other treatments not proven effective. The minister replied that such therapy is outside the basic package, that insurers set their own supplementary coverage, that UWV buys horse-coaching as Werk-Fit activation with success monitoring, and that the Jeugdwet and PGB rules apply to municipalities without a full list of funded treatments.
We therefore do not have a (complete) overview of which treatments or therapies are reimbursed from the supplementary package.
Wij beschikken dan ook niet over een (totaal)overzicht van welke behandelingen of therapieën uit het aanvullende pakket vergoed worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het bericht ‘20 jaar terug in de tijd’

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked the Minister for Medical Care why the government now departs from a 2001 policy that a missing male partner can be a sufficient indication for artificial insemination, and whether non-reimbursement of insemination for single women and lesbian couples conflicts with equal treatment. The Minister replied that the 2001 position concerned admission to treatment, not reimbursement under the Zvw, which requires a medical indication, and that the government will decide around summer 2019 on the role of government in funding such treatment, with insurers asked to keep reimbursing in 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens, Bergkamp en Raemakers over het niet van de grond komen van projecten die over schotten heen werken

MPs Diertens, Bergkamp and Raemakers asked about the Nova Me care initiative that collapsed over funding divides between care domains, and about budgets and the Wlz experiment article. The minister answered that no funding is earmarked for the experiment article, that VGZ found the care not suitable, and declined to convene a dedicated meeting on lessons learned.
I have no insight into the amount of money that parties in daily practice invest in realising appropriate cross-domain care for clients.
Ik heb geen zicht op de hoeveelheid geld die er in de dagelijkse praktijk wordt geïnvesteerd door partijen om passend aanbod over domeinen heen voor cliënten te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het rapport ‘Behoorlijk invorderen vanuit het burgerperspectief’ van de Nationale ombudsman

An MP asked the Minister about the National Ombudsman's report on fair debt collection and about the government's approach to stacking and escalation of administrative fines and premiums, including whether authorities should send free payment reminders. The Minister answered that the government is taking steps such as relaxed payment arrangements and a planned emergency-stop procedure, but that free reminders may not reach the indebted group and that the policy reply to the Ombudsman will follow.
In the coming months a plan for an emergency-stop procedure will be developed.
De komende maanden zal worden gewerkt aan een plan voor een noodstopprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Medische gegevens duizenden Nederlanders verplaatst naar Google: 'Riskant'’

MPs Verhoeven and Raemakers asked whether patient medical data moved to Google Cloud by Medical Research Data Management was safe, whether patients and the Dutch Data Protection Authority were informed, and whether privacy-friendlier alternatives exist. The minister said hospitals bear responsibility for informing patients, that data stays in Dutch datacentres under double encryption with Google barred from access, and that he will commission independent research on non-European cloud platforms.
I will have independent research carried out into the desirability of using non-European cloud platforms to store healthcare data.
Ik zal onafhankelijk onderzoek laten doen naar de wenselijkheid van het gebruik van niet-Europese Cloud platforms voor het opslaan van zorgdata.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over de vergoeding van vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen van lesbische en alleenstaande vrouwen

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked the Minister of Medical Care about unclear reimbursement of fertility treatment (donor insemination) for lesbian and single women, and about the Zorginstituut's position. The minister replied that without a medical indication such treatment is not covered by the basic insurance, that a decision on government financing will come around summer 2019, and that insurers will keep reimbursing ongoing cases during 2019.
Your House will receive a cabinet position around the summer on the financing of fertility treatments without a medical indication, so that clarity arises for everyone before 2020.
Uw Kamer ontvangt rond de zomer een standpunt van het kabinet over de financiering van vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen zonder medische indicatie, zodat vóór 2020 voor iedereen duidelijkheid ontstaat.
Antwoord op het vragen van het lid Raemakers over “vaak geen passende jeugdzorg”

An MP asked the minister about the Inspectorate's finding that young people in youth care often do not receive appropriate help, including suicides, and about related questions on integrated care, suicide research, professional standards, youth participation and regional expert teams. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to existing programmes, research and guidelines, and committed to including the findings in an action plan for closed youth care to be sent to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Van Weyenberg over zzp’ers zonder schuldhulp

MPs Raemakers and Van Weyenberg (D66) asked why many large municipalities deny debt assistance to self-employed people, why partners' income can block access, and what the government will do. The State Secretary acknowledges the problem, says municipalities cannot exclude self-employed groups, and promises a change to the Wgs, guidance and knowledge sharing, though some data requests are answered only partially.
Self-employed people may not be excluded as a group from debt assistance.
Zelfstandigen mogen niet als groep worden uitgesloten van schuldhulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht dat veel kankerpatiënten weinig informatie krijgen over het leven na hun behandeling

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that many cancer patients receive little information about life after treatment, including unaddressed late effects, future plans, and differences between hospital types and between men and women. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to outcome information development, shared decision-making campaigns, training, and cooperation with hospitals and insurers, while declining to measure and compare hospitals' shared decision-making practice.
Now measuring and comparing the extent to which care providers apply shared decision-making would partly deprive care providers of the room to learn from each other and innovate on this point.
Nu gaan «meten» en vergelijken in hoeverre zorgaanbieders samen beslissen toepassen, zou zorgaanbieders de ruimte om te leren van elkaar en te innoveren op dit punt deels ontnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Raemakers over het vergoeden van de hersteloperatie na vrouwelijke genitale mutilatie

MPs Sjoerdsma and Raemakers asked the Minister of Medical Care whether female genital mutilation reconstructive surgery should be covered by the basic health insurance, given earlier promises of a working group and a draft guideline. The minister answered that evidence on effectiveness is too uncertain to include reconstruction in the basic package, that the new guideline does not address reimbursement, and that the health institute will advise once the guideline is authorised.
I will ask the Zorginstituut to carry out the necessary procedure quickly.
Ik zal het Zorginstituut verzoeken om de hiervoor noodzakelijke procedure snel uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Honderdduizenden senioren lopen risico geld te laten liggen’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Raemakers asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs about research showing many 55-plus households may miss out on healthcare and rent allowances, and about outreach to eligible seniors and Wajong beneficiaries. The government answered that non-take-up is known (about 17% for rent and healthcare allowance in earlier studies), that outreach exists, and that the issue will be examined in an upcoming IBO study with conclusions to inform further action.
Regarding the group of older migrants and single elderly, which you refer to in your question, no data are available in the aforementioned studies.
Over de groep oudere migranten en alleenstaande ouderen, waar u in uw vraag aan refereert, zijn in voornoemde onderzoeken geen gegevens voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Kuiken over de uitzending van Brandpunt+ over eenzame jongeren

MPs Raemakers and Kuiken asked the health minister about a Brandpunt+ broadcast on loneliness among young people, including whether the action programme 'Eén tegen eenzaamheid' neglects young people, the causes and risks, municipal and youth-care responses, suicide trends and an LHBTI project. The minister answered that the programme focuses on older people for substantive reasons, acknowledged that loneliness among young people is a taboo and a social problem, outlined preventive and youth-care measures, and declined to set up a separate action programme for young people.
I am not planning to draw up an action programme for loneliness among young people as well.
Ik ben niet voornemens om ook voor eenzaamheid onder jongeren een actieprogramma op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over "de problemen met het recht op dubbele kinderbijslag voor ouders met kinderen met autisme"

An MP asked the state secretary about perceived arbitrariness, application volumes and outcomes, and the complexity of applications for double child benefit for parents of children with autism. The secretary denied arbitrariness, reported 2017 figures (9,283 granted, 11,081 rejected, 403 objections, 164 upheld) and pointed to communication improvements and an ongoing evaluation.
In the ongoing evaluation of the Wet Hervorming Kindregelingen I am specifically also looking at the double child benefit for intensive care and the related process.
Ik kijk bij de nu lopende evaluatie van de Wet Hervorming Kindregelingen nadrukkelijk ook naar de dubbele kinderbijslag intensieve zorg en het bijbehorende proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over de juiste behandeling bij niet aangeboren hersenletsel

Two D66 MPs asked about the correct diagnosis and treatment of acquired brain injury, including waiting times for rehabilitation and support from municipalities. The minister answered that diagnosis is difficult, that a care standard for traumatic brain injury exists and is being implemented, that waiting times for outpatient consultations average about five weeks, and that existing initiatives to improve chain cooperation are underway.
No figures are known on this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Diertens en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Maak vaccineren verplicht’

MPs asked whether mandatory childhood vaccination should apply in daycare centres, how other EU countries handle it, and whether parents can learn daycare vaccination rates. The government opposes mandatory vaccination in daycare (limited effect, constitutional objections) and says a rate-disclosure obligation has little benefit and lacks support, promising a plan of action in autumn.
I am not in favour of making vaccination mandatory for children at daycare centres.
Ik ben geen voorstander van het verplicht stellen van vaccinatie voor kinderen op kinderdagverblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Raemakers over het niet toekennen van het loonkostenvoordeel na stage

MPs Van Weyenberg and Raemakers asked why employers lose the wage-cost advantage (loonkostenvoordeel) when a paid internship is not followed by timely registration of a target-group declaration, and whether this can be corrected. Minister Koolmees explained the three-month registration rule, said UWV will inform employers, and that he is examining a one-off 2018 exception for workers hired directly after a paid internship.
To ensure the target-group declaration is requested in time, UWV will actively inform employers, possibly via the education institutions involved.
Om ervoor te zorgen dat de doelgroepverklaring tijdig wordt aangevraagd, zal het UWV de werkgevers, al dan niet via de betrokken onderwijsinstellingen, actief gaan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Financiële administratie voor velen een worsteling’

MPs Bruins and Raemakers asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a Nibud study showing many people struggle with financial administration, especially due to automatic direct debits and digital post, and asked about measures on hidden direct debits, youth support, free paper post and the debt collection register. The State Secretary answered that the findings are concerning, pointed to Nibud recommendations, existing financial literacy initiatives, and said the scope of a debt collection register is still being investigated with a further letter to follow.
I am not aware of figures on how often these direct debits lead to payment problems, accumulation of (collection) costs and debt problems.
Er zijn mij geen cijfers bekend over hoe vaak deze incasso's leiden tot betalingsproblemen, stapeling van (incasso)kosten en schuldenproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Algoritme voorspelt wie fraude pleegt bij bijstandsuitkering’

MPs Raemakers and Verhoeven asked whether municipalities use algorithms to detect welfare benefit fraud, which firms supply them, what data is used, and how discrimination and transparency are controlled. The state secretary answered that data-driven enforcement is supported within legal limits, that the algorithm may be withheld to protect detection methods, that data comes from municipal benefit records, and that a BZK study on government algorithms is expected in the second half of 2018.
In the interest of protecting the modus operandi for detecting fraud, the municipal executive may decide not to release the algorithm.
In het belang van het beschermen van de modus operandi om fraude op te sporen, kan door het college worden besloten het algoritme niet vrij te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over jongeren in de Participatiewet

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary why the number of benefit recipients under 27 has not fallen despite the strong economy, and about youth with temporary incapacity, employability, and volunteer-work allowances. The secretary answered that the group has stabilised rather than fallen, explained the pathways for youth, and said data on training and volunteering are not kept nationally, while noting municipalities hold primary responsibility and commitments to monitoring and to a new statistics round.
Support for young people on social assistance is the responsibility of the municipalities.
De ondersteuning van jongeren in de bijstand is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het bericht 'GGD onderzoekt verdacht letsel bij kwetsbaren'

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about GGD Amsterdam's forensic medical examinations of injuries in vulnerable groups (intellectually disabled people, elderly, children) and whether this expertise should be safeguarded nationally. The minister agreed such expertise matters, said on-site injury examination has value, and committed to asking GGD GHOR Nederland for advice and informing the Chamber about a proposal.
I am happy to adopt your suggestion to ask GGD GHOR Nederland for advice to come with GGD Amsterdam to a proposal on how forensic medical expertise can be safeguarded regionally.
Ik neem graag uw suggestie over om aan GGD GHOR Nederland advies te vragen om met GGD Amsterdam te komen tot een voorstel over hoe forensisch medische expertise regionaal kan worden geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Peters over het bericht ‘Jeugdhulp is online bedreiging beu’

MPs Raemakers and Peters asked the Minister of Health about online threats and false accusations against youth care workers and what the government would do. The minister acknowledged the problem is worrying, pointed to existing campaigns and guidance, and said talks with employers, police, prosecutors and internet companies would report back before summer 2018.
Before summer 2018 we will inform you of the results of this consultation.
Vóór de zomer van 2018 zullen wij u informeren over de resultaten van dit overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over de uitzending van Zembla ‘Verdachte ouders’

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked about a Zembla broadcast on suspected Munchausen by proxy/PCF cases, including rising Veilig Thuis reports, support for doctors, the role of the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, and the need for fact-finding. The ministers answered that professionals are supported through protocols, expert centres and joint guidance, that no Dutch research exists on prevalence, and that a fact-finding action plan will be sent to parliament in spring 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Gemeenten weigeren massaal onderzoek jeugd’

MPs El Yassini and Raemakers asked the health minister about reports that municipalities refuse the mandatory client-experience survey for youth care, including low response rates and privacy risks when youths are written to. The minister answered that privacy is a municipal responsibility supported by VNG, that a pilot questionnaire is being evaluated, and that he will discuss improving the survey with municipalities, while no sanction on non-compliant municipalities is announced.
It is not known how many municipalities additionally carried out the youth client-experience survey but did not send the results to the ministry.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel gemeenten daarnaast het cliëntervaringsonderzoek Jeugd wèl hebben uitgevoerd, maar de uitkomsten ervan niet aan VWS hebben verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over rehabilitatie bij onterechte jeugdbeschermingsmaatregelen

The MPs asked whether wrongful private-law child protection decisions can cause serious harm, how many such cases exist, whether the state bears responsibility for rehabilitation and support, and how erroneous information in child protection databases is corrected. The minister declined to give a count because 'wrongful' is undefined and the criminal-law analogy does not hold, stated that appeal and cassation exist and that families are supported when children return, and said an action plan on fact-finding is being drawn up for early 2018 and that incorrect facts will be corrected in the file.
An overview of the number of 'in hindsight wrongful private-law rulings' cannot be given, because it is unclear what the definition of that is.
Een overzicht van het aantal «bij nader inzien onterechte privaatrechtelijke uitspraken» is echter niet te geven, omdat onduidelijk is wat de definitie daarvan is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Bergkamp over vennootschapsbelasting in de jeugdhulpverlening

MPs Raemakers and Bergkamp asked whether youth care organisations fall under corporate tax and which care sectors are exempt, after a 2017 article raised confusion. The state secretaries answered that youth care providers are generally now taxable since the 2015 funding change, but may qualify for the care-institution exemption if they meet its three conditions, as other care sectors can.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over recente berichtgeving rondom zelfmoorden van jongeren

MP Raemakers asked the State Secretary of Health about recent youth suicides in Heerlen, Venlo and Deelen and possible failures of youth care, including suicide figures, inspection reports and prevention roles. The State Secretary gave CBS figures, explained the mandatory calamity-reporting system and inspection follow-up, described suicide prevention funding and programmes, and said current communication with municipalities is adequate.
Providers of youth care, youth protection and Veilig Thuis are legally obliged to report calamities to the inspectorates.
Aanbieders van jeugdhulp, jeugdbescherming en Veilig Thuis zijn wettelijk verplicht calamiteiten te melden bij de inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Raemakers over de toegenomen weigeringen van Verklaringen omtrent gedrag

MPs Groothuizen and Raemakers asked why VOG refusals rose from 0.35% to 0.4% in 2016, how many refusals concerned young people and work or internships, and whether a youth information campaign had started. The state secretary answered that the rise is within normal yearly fluctuation, gave refusal figures for under-23s, and described the new youth website, films, letters and festival outreach.
The share of refused VOG applications fluctuates somewhat each year, because the Justis Service assesses each application on its merits and does not steer towards refusal percentages.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het al dan niet verplicht aanbesteden in de zorg

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Health and the Minister of the Interior whether public tendering of care in the social domain is mandatory, given conflicting reports, and what will be done to clarify it. The government answered that tendering is not always required, depends on whether the arrangement is a procurement or a subsidy, and that a working group and PIANOo support center have been set up to clarify the rules for municipalities.
Public tendering in the social domain is not by definition and in all cases mandatory.
Een openbare aanbesteding in het sociale domein is niet per definitie en in alle gevallen verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over klachten over betalingsachterstanden van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) aan schrijf- en gebarentolken

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked about UWV payment delays to sign-language and written-language interpreters, including unpaid invoices, VAT burdens, and poor reachability. The state secretary answered that about 1,730 invoices were paid late due to capacity problems and internal miscommunication, that all arrears have now been cleared, and that UWV will discuss service improvements with interpreter organisations and report to parliament after the summer.
UWV will keep the Ministry of SZW informed of the outcomes. On that basis, your House will be informed after the summer about improvement measures that follow from them.
Het UWV zal het Ministerie van SZW op de hoogte houden van de uitkomsten. Op basis hiervan zal uw Kamer na de zomer worden geïnformeerd over verbetermaatregelen die hieruit voortvloeien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het nog niet toegezonden actieplan pleegzorg

MP Raemakers asks why the promised action plan on foster care has not yet been sent to parliament, when it can be expected, and which parties were consulted. The Secretary of State says he expects to send the plan before 1 June 2017, that it addresses motions on tariffs, foster parents' legal position and dropout, and lists the consulted parties.
I expect to be able to present the Action Plan Foster Care to your House before 1 June 2017.
Ik verwacht het Actieplan Pleegzorg vóór 1 juni 2017 aan uw Kamer te kunnen aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Engelshoven en Raemakers over het publiceren van uitslagen per stembureau

MPs Van Engelshoven and Raemakers asked why the Kiesraad did not collect polling-station-level results after the 2017 election, and whether municipalities published them. The minister explained that digital transfer was banned for security reasons, so only municipal totals were transferred, that municipalities could publish station results, and that inspection rights had lapsed; he will include the issue in the evaluation.
That return (article N11 Kieswet) contains only the totals per party and per candidate for the whole municipality, not per polling station.
In die opgave (artikel N11 Kieswet) staan alleen de totalen per partij en per kandidaat voor de hele gemeente en niet per stembureau.

Motie-Dijkgraaf c.s. over evaluatie van convenanten op hun effectiviteit
Asks the government to systematically evaluate covenants for effectiveness, measured against autonomous developments.
requests the government to systematically evaluate covenants on their effectiveness, focusing on what covenants contribute relative to autonomous developments.
verzoekt de regering convenanten stelselmatig te evalueren op hun effectiviteit, waarbij centraal staat wat convenanten bijdragen ten opzichte van autonome ontwikkelingen
Motie-Slob c.s. over een rentmeesterschapagenda met initiatieven op het gebied van duurzaamheid
Asks the government to draw up a stewardship agenda with concrete sustainability initiatives as an extra priority for the coming term.
requests the government to draw up a stewardship agenda as an extra priority for the coming term
verzoekt de regering als extra prioriteit voor de komende regeerperiode een Rentmeesterschapsagenda op te stellen
Motie-Van Veldhoven c.s. over terugdraaien versobering van de uitvoering van de Kaderrichtlijn Water
Asks the government to reverse the scaling back of Water Framework Directive implementation and find alternative funding to avoid local tax increases.
requests the government to reverse the scaling back of the implementation of the Water Framework Directive
verzoekt de regering de versobering van de uitvoering van de Kaderrichtlijn Water terug te draaien
Motie-Van Veldhoven c.s. over het aandeel duurzaam gecertificeerd tropisch hardhout

Asks the government to work with the sector in 2011 on a step plan to raise certified sustainable tropical hardwood in Dutch construction to 100% within five years, possibly by excluding uncertified wood in the Bouwbesluit.
requests the government to work with the sector in 2011 on developing a step plan
verzoekt de regering om zich in 2011 in overleg met de sector in te zetten voor het uitwerken van een stappenplan
Motie-Slob c.s. over de mate van robuustheid van het spoorsysteem bij verstoringen

Asks the government, with ProRail and NS, to carry out a new analysis of how robust the rail system is to disruptions, including backup switching and whether to compartmentalise security at large hubs.
requests the government, with parties such as ProRail and NS, to make a new analysis of the degree of robustness of the rail system
verzoekt de regering met betrokken partijen als ProRail en NS een nieuwe analyse te maken van de mate van robuustheid van het spoorsysteem
Motie-Van Tongeren/Bashir over geen hogere prijsstijgingen in het openbaar vervoer dan in het personenverkeer over de weg
Asks the government to ensure public transport fare increases do not exceed average road passenger price developments over the cabinet period.
requests the government to ensure public transport price increases do not exceed average road passenger price developments over the coming cabinet period

verzoekt de regering te bewerkstelligen dat de prijsstijgingen in het openbaar vervoer die van de gemiddelde prijsontwikkelingen in het personenverkeer over de weg de komende kabinetperiode niet overstijgen
Motie-Ouwehand/Van Tongeren over het systeem van dierrechten na 2015 in stand houden
Asks the government to prepare a law keeping the manure production rights system in place after 2015.
requests the government to prepare a legal amendment to maintain the animal rights system also after 2015
verzoekt de regering een wetswijziging voor te bereiden om het systeem van dierrechten ook na 2015 in stand te houden
Motie-Samsom c.s. over maatregelen om overschrijding van Europese luchtkwaliteitsnormen te voorkomen
Motion asking the government to present a costed package of measures by 1 January 2011 to prevent exceedance of European air quality norms.
requests the government to present to the House by 1 January 2011 a costed package of measures
verzoekt de regering om voor 1 januari 2011 een doorgerekend pakket van maatregelen aan de Kamer voor te leggen
Motie-Van Veldhoven c.s. over een aanscherping van de Europese doelstelling voor CO2-beperking
Asks the government to work for tightening the EU 2020 CO2 reduction target to 26 percent.
requests the government to work in the meantime for tightening the European CO2 reduction target for 2020 to 26%
verzoekt de regering zich in de tussentijd in te spannen voor het aanscherpen van de Europese doelstelling voor CO 2 -beperking in 2020 tot 26%
Motie-Jansen c.s. over aandacht voor de regio's die niet vallen onder de regio's Amsterdam, Rotterdam en Eindhoven
Asks the government to elaborate and send to the House the promised attention to regions outside Amsterdam, Rotterdam and Eindhoven when updating the Nota Ruimte.
requests the government, when updating the Nota Ruimte, to elaborate the passage in the policy letter on attention to other regions and send it to the House
verzoekt de regering om bij de actualisering van de Nota Ruimte, de passage uit de beleidsbrief over de aandacht voor andere regio's uit te werken en aan de Kamer te doen toekomen
Motie-Van Tongeren c.s. over volledige informatie aan de Kamer over de plannen voor nieuwe kerncentrales
Asks the government to publicly release all correspondence from the past five years with third parties on new nuclear plants, placing commercially sensitive parts confidentially before the Chamber.

requests the government to make public all correspondence the government has conducted with third parties over the past five years on building and operating new nuclear power plants, including meeting reports

verzoekt de regering alle correspondentie die de regering in de afgelopen vijf jaar met derden gevoerd heeft over de bouw en exploitatie van nieuwe kerncentrales, inclusief verslagen van gesprekken, openbaar te maken
Motie-Ouwehand c.s. over voorkomen van onherstelbaar biodiversiteitverlies
Asks the government to ensure no irreversible biodiversity loss occurs in state waters designated as Natura 2000 areas.
requests the government to ensure that no irreversible biodiversity loss occurs in the state waters
verzoekt de regering ervoor te zorgen dat er geen onherstelbaar biodiversiteitverlies optreedt in de rijkswateren
Motie-Van Tongeren c.s. over opstellen van specifieke CO2-reductiedoelen voor de sectoren verkeer, landbouw en bebouwde omgeving
Asks the government to set specific CO2 reduction targets for the transport, agriculture and built environment sectors.
Motie-Van Tongeren/Van Veldhoven over het aanjagen van financiering voor groene projecten
Asks the government to make agreements with lenders to stimulate financing for green projects within its green deal.
requests the government to make agreements with credit providers on stimulating financing for green projects within its green deal
verzoekt de regering om in het kader van haar green deal in elk geval afspraken te maken met kredietverstrekkers over het aanjagen van financiering voor groene projecten
Motie-Jansen c.s. over uitvoering van de motie-Polderman (29675, nr. 54) uit 2008
Asks the government to start in 2011 implementing the earlier Polderman motion by securing spatial claims in the National Water Plan and drafting a starting document for a North Sea spatial plan.
requests the government to start implementing the Polderman motion in 2011
verzoekt de regering om in 2011 te starten met de uitvoering van de motie-Polderman
Motie-Ouwehand c.s. over een meer plantaardig eetpatroon
Asks the government to act on climate policy in line with a shift toward a more plant-based diet and against intensifying livestock farming.
requests the government to act accordingly in its climate policy
verzoekt de regering dienovereenkomstig te handelen in haar klimaatbeleid
Motie-Van Veldhoven c.s. over het opsporen van invoer van illegaal gekapt hout
Asks the government to push in EU channels for stronger joint customs checks on timber imports to detect illegally felled wood.
requests the government to work within the EU in 2011 for a greater joint effort in customs work to check timber imports
