verzoekt de regering om zich in 2011 in EU-verband in te zetten voor een grotere gezamenlijke inspanning bij douanewerkzaamheden ter controle van de invoer van hout
Amendement van het lid Slob c.s. ter dekking van het amendement Slob c.s. (Kamerstuk 32 500 XII, nr. 9)
Shifts 30 million euro within the budget from the national road network article to offset a restored 2011 public transport (BDU) cut.
This amendment serves to cover the Slob et al. amendment
Dit amendement dient ter dekking van amendement Slob c.s.
Amendement van het lid Slob c.s. over het ter beschikking stellen van middelen voor ERTMS
Amendment shifts 37.5 million euro within the rail budget to fund installing ERTMS train safety equipment in existing rolling stock.
With this amendment funds are made available for installing the new European train safety standard ERTMS
Met dit amendement worden middelen ter beschikking gesteld voor de inbouw van de nieuwe Europese standaard voor treinbeveiliging ERTMS
Amendement van de leden Van Tongeren en Van Gent over het in staat stellen van de NS om alsnog toiletten in te bouwen in Sprinters
Shifts 50 million euro within the rail budget so NS can install toilets in Sprinter trains, with funding from Prorail tender savings.
This amendment frees up 50 million euro to enable the Dutch Railways to install toilets after all
Dit amendement speelt 50 miljoen euro vrij om de Nederlandse Spoorwegen in staat te stellen alsnog toiletten in te bouwen
Amendement van het lid Slob c.s. over het terugdraaien van de bezuiniging op BDU
Reverses the 2011 budget cut on the regional public transport grant (BDU) by shifting funds from motorway spending in the Infrastructure Fund.
This amendment therefore reverses the BDU cut for the year 2011.
Dit amendement draait daarom de bezuiniging op de BDU voor het jaar 2011 terug.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Van Tongeren over het bericht 'Klagen over ongelijke behandeling kan niet in Caribisch Nederland'

MPs Özütok and Van Tongeren asked whether complaints about unequal treatment can be lodged in Caribbean Netherlands, given that equal-treatment law does not apply there, and which rights protections are missing. Minister Ollongren answered that residents can still go to court under the Constitution, international treaties and the BWBES, that the government considers legislative restraint necessary, and that an exploration of extending equal-treatment legislation to the islands will be carried out.

I intend, partly in response to the College's recommendation in its report 'Five years College for Human Rights', to have an exploration carried out into the possibility of introducing equal-treatment legislation in Caribbean Netherlands.

Ik ben, mede naar aanleiding van de aanbeveling van het College in zijn rapport «Vijf jaar College voor de Rechten van de Mens», voornemens om een verkenning te laten uitvoeren naar de mogelijkheid om de gelijkebehandelingswetgeving in te voeren in Caribisch Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over vergunningsaanvragen van energie-intensieve activiteiten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether municipal environmental services can set energy-related conditions in permits for energy-intensive activities, and whether they should be able to apply local climate and energy policy. The minister answered that permits can impose energy-efficiency requirements for non-ETS installations, that ETS installations are exempt, that local criteria can be raised in the Klimaatakkoord talks, and that no overview of permit applications is available.
It is not possible to provide an overview of business activities that meet the criterion you mention.
Het is niet mogelijk om een overzicht te geven voor bedrijfsactiviteiten die voldoen aan het criterium dat u noemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de zorgen over het verscherpte toezicht op AkzoNobel dat van kracht blijft

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the continued enhanced supervision of AkzoNobel's salt mining, including delayed enforcement after leaking brine pipes, leaking wells, the lack of a decommissioning (abandonment) policy, unexplained cavern changes at Heiligerlee, and diesel-free mining research. The minister answers that the leaks were due to manufacturing defects, that SodM found a penalty order disproportionate, that AkzoNobel will be asked for further plans, and that SodM will publish studies in the autumn, with a response on the sector report due in September.
Under those circumstances, SodM considered a penalty order not proportionate.
SodM vond onder die omstandigheden een last onder dwangsom niet proportioneel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het ontwerpinstemmingsbesluit voor het winningsplan Pieterzijl Oost en Borgsweer

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the draft approval decision for the Pieterzijl Oost gas field production plan, covering cost-benefit and seismic risk, deviated drilling, formation depth and stimulation, a 2016 production test, and water injection at Borgsweer. The Minister answered that seismic risk falls in the lowest category, that the detailed stimulation work programme will be submitted to SodM and NAM may share it publicly, and that the 2016 production test was agreed with SodM.
It is up to SodM whether and how they handle the publicity of the approval of this work programme.
Het is aan het SodM of en hoe ze omgaan met de openbaarheid van de goedkeuring van dit werkprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Buitenweg over het horen van slachtoffers / getuigen in de strafzaak rond de Groningse gaswinning

MPs Van Tongeren and Buitenweg asked whether the investigating judge would hear witnesses and victims at their homes, in the presence of NAM's lawyers, in the criminal case on Groningen gas extraction, and how secondary victimisation could be avoided. The Minister answered that the suspect's counsel have a statutory right to attend, that the home-hearing request came from the witnesses themselves, that the Public Prosecution Service opposed it, and that the investigating judge had not yet authorised it, with each witness supported by a lawyer during questioning.
The Public Prosecution Service opposed hearing the witnesses on location.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft zich verzet tegen het horen van de getuigen op locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Ruim 600 euro 'afsluitboete' voor huiseigenaar die gasloos gaat wonen, dat mag dus niet’

GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Geschillencommissie Energie ruling that a grid operator could not charge a homeowner over 600 euro for fully removing a gas connection, and whether the Wet VET and the motion on low disconnection tariffs remain adequate. The minister answered that the ruling has no general effect, that grid operators will be asked to review whether cheaper sealing solutions are safe, and that talks with grid operators on lowering disconnection costs are ongoing.
This ruling has no general effect.
Deze uitspraak heeft geen generieke werking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Van Tongeren over de afhandeling van oude schades door de NAM

MPs Beckerman, Nijboer and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that NAM handles old Groningen damage claims carelessly, including forgotten files and delays after court rulings. The Minister says NAM must process claims carefully and promptly, reports that over half of old claims are resolved, and points to an independent survey and the Onafhankelijke raadsman and Arbiter Bodembeweging as routes for complaints.
In principle I do not go into individual cases.
Ik ga in beginsel niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Van Tongeren en Nijboer over de afhandeling van oude schades

MPs Beckerman, Van Tongeren and Nijboer asked the minister whether NAM's handling of old Groningen earthquake damage claims is truly successful, raising concerns about low offers, inspections, the six-week arbiter deadline, the waardevermeerdering scheme, independent research, complaints channels and enforcement of arbiter rulings. The minister replied that acceptance rates are encouraging but success is not yet certain, pointed to an independent study and a SNN scheme for the former buitengebied, and said he cannot impose a deadline on NAM but will press it to act on arbiter rulings.
In addition, an independent investigation into the handling of old damage reports has been started. I will inform your House of the outcomes of this investigation.
Daarnaast is een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de afhandeling van oude schademeldingen gestart. Ik zal uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Tongeren over het bericht: ‘Woningstichting FCB ‘not amused’ over opstelling Knops’

MPs Voortman and Van Tongeren asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about reports that the Bonaire housing foundation FCB is 'not amused' by his refusal to provide a state guarantee for social housing loans, and about the housing shortage and tools across the Caribbean Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that he prefers alternatives to guarantees, that FCB's collaboration with Dutch housing corporations stalled, that the housing policy is an island-level task, and that the Housing Market Act implementation was postponed.
I will use the coming period to look into this further and to get back in contact with FCB.
Ik zal de komende periode gebruiken om mij hier verder in te verdiepen en opnieuw in contact treden met FCB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘Enschede ontevreden over zoutwinningsplan Ganzebos’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why Enschede and Overijssel say the ministry does not respond to their advice on the Ganzebos salt-mining plan, including vibration monitoring, alternative mining agents, cavern reuse and communication. The minister replied that advice is weighed and motivated in the decision, that existing KNMI seismometers suffice, that AkzoNobel is already researching alternatives, and that cavern reuse belongs in a separate permit; liability for the concession stays with AkzoNobel Salt B.V.
In the draft consent decision for Ganzenbos I also weighed the advice and gave reasons for it in the considerations of the decision.
Ook in het ontwerpinstemmingsbesluit Ganzenbos heb ik de adviezen meegewogen en gemotiveerd in de overwegingen van het besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht 'Woonarken aan Weesper dijk moeten áán het aardgas: ‘Gas is toch op z’n retour?'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether houseboat residents in Weesp being forced onto natural gas, and the municipality's role, conflict with the goal of a gas-free built environment, and whether the threshold for sustainable alternatives should be lowered. The Minister answered that the grid operator is obliged under the Gas Act to connect these residents, that municipalities currently cannot compel residents of existing homes to choose a non-gas alternative, and that the Klimaatakkoord table for the built environment will address phasing out gas.
At present it is not possible for municipalities to force residents of existing homes to choose an alternative to a gas connection.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk voor gemeenten om bewoners van bestaande woningen te dwingen om te kiezen voor een alternatief voor een gasaansluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Nijboer en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Van Engelshoven stelt 17 miljoen euro beschikbaar voor Gronings erfgoed’

MPs asked whether the government will extend subsidies for mining-damaged national monuments in Groningen to monuments outside the ten earthquake municipalities, and about complaints that NAM damage offers ignore monumental value. The minister answered that monuments outside those municipalities are not eligible for the earthquake-specific subsidies but can use other schemes, and that expert damage assessment remains a principle in the TCMG process.
It is correct that these national monuments are not eligible for the relevant subsidy schemes.
Het klopt dat deze rijksmonumenten niet in aanmerking komen voor de betreffende subsidieregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Moorlag over het bericht ‘Groningen en Drenthe in gevaar door falende aanpak bij catastrofe kerncentrale Lingen Case’

MPs Van Tongeren and Moorlag asked the Dutch state secretary about reports that emergency plans for the Lingen nuclear plant in Germany were outdated and that evacuation planning did not cover Dutch residents. The government answered that the German plan is being updated (expected 2019), that evacuation zones lie entirely on German territory, that bilateral consultation continues, and that Dutch national plans were updated in 2017 with the Lingen plan revised in 2015 and a new version due end 2018.
Coordination with our neighbouring countries on cooperation in crisis management of nuclear accidents is of great importance to me.
Afstemming met onze buurlanden over samenwerking bij de crisisbeheersing van kernongevallen vind ik van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het rapport 'OPERA Safety Case'

An MP asked the state secretary about the OPERA Safety Case report on final disposal of radioactive waste in Boom clay, questioning whether safety had been demonstrated, whether COVRA should coordinate follow-up research, and who bears the cost. The government answered that the report is an initial safety case, that full safety assessment will come later under ANVS, and that polluter-pays principles and COVRA's cost structure apply, while an integrated policy response is promised later this year.
As indicated in the answer to question 2, the OPERA Safety Case is an initial Safety Case in a series of Safety Cases that will follow up to the moment of licence application.
Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 2 is aangegeven, is de OPERA Safety Case een initiële Safety Case in een reeks van Safety Cases die gaan volgen tot het moment van vergunningaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Van Tongeren over de houding van de NAM bij een arbitragezaak

MPs asked the minister whether he still trusts NAM to handle Groningen damage claims fairly after NAM refused fresh damage photos and sought a counter-expertise in an arbitration case already assessed at tens of thousands of euros. The minister replied that he and the Groningen Commissioner of the King monitor NAM's handling of old claims closely and trust the independent Arbiter Bodembeweging, to which NAM has committed.
For individual damage cases in procedure before the Arbiter Bodembeweging, I have confidence in the working method and independent judgment of the Arbiter.
Voor individuele schadezaken die in procedure zijn bij de Arbiter Bodembeweging geldt dat ik vertrouwen heb in de werkwijze en het onafhankelijke oordeel van de Arbiter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht “Cijfers NRG: Pallas-reactor overbodig voor 98,8% nucleaire geneeskunde”

MP Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) asked the ministers whether the Pallas reactor's business case, based largely on technetium-99m, is undermined by alternative production methods such as accelerators and ASML's Lighthouse project, and what total subsidy is expected. The government answered that Pallas also targets therapeutic isotopes, that the business case is being re-examined before the final loan tranche, that a reactor remains needed for supply security, and that the Pallas loan is capped at 40 million euro for phase 1 with construction and operation intended to be privately financed.
For the decision on the last tranche of the loan that the State and the province of North Holland grant to Pallas, the business case will be reviewed again.
Ten behoeve van de besluitvorming over de laatste tranche van de lening die de Staat en de provincie Noord-Holland verlenen aan Pallas wordt de businesscase opnieuw bekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘NAM waarschuwt voor aardbevingen in Overijssel’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the NAM's new gas extraction plan for Hardenberg, including information meetings, consultation of local authorities, chemical handling, the NAM-SodM dispute, the reversed burden of proof, and baseline surveys of buildings. The Minister answered that the procedure is at an early stage, that advisers including SodM, Tcbb and local bodies will be consulted, that an information evening will follow publication of the draft decision, and that a national independent damage scheme is being explored.
At present I still have advice requests outstanding with the Tcbb and with the municipality, province and water board.
Momenteel heb ik nog adviesvragen uitstaan bij Tcbb en bij de gemeente, provincie en het waterschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht 'Deel nieuw netwerk AkzoNobel lek als een mandje'

MP Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the newly built AkzoNobel brine pipeline network leaks, whether the measures taken are sufficient, how defective pipes were installed, whether the rest of the network is safe, and whether the old network may stay in use. The Minister answered that SodM considers the measures sufficient though work is unfinished, that up to fifteen factory-defective pipe sections were supplied, that the untested five-kilometre section is not in use, and that the investigation into other buyers is still ongoing.
In September 2016 the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) placed AkzoNobel's salt activities under intensified supervision.
In september 2016 heeft Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) de zoutactiviteiten van AkzoNobel onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Tongeren over waterzijdig inregelen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether waterside balancing of central heating systems is known to save energy, whether it is being promoted for SMEs, whether the estimated savings and payback period are correct, and whether it should be added to mandatory measures under the Environmental Management Act. The Minister confirmed awareness, said the measure will be addressed in talks with industry and Energy Agreement partners and in updating the approved measures list with a 5-year payback criterion, and said the payback estimates will be examined.
In the updating process I will examine in which sectors the measure meets the 5-year payback criterion.
In het actualisatieproces zal ik onderzoeken in welke branches de maatregel aan het criterium van 5 jaar terugverdientijd voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Tongeren over door de politie afgelegde huisbezoeken aan aardbevingsdemonstranten

MPs Buitenweg and Van Tongeren asked whether police home visits to earthquake protesters before a minister's Groningen visit were lawful, proportionate and compatible with the right to demonstrate, and what will prevent repetition. The minister defended the visits as normal police information-gathering under mayoral responsibility, saw no reason to change the practice, and noted the Groningen mayor said phoning could have been used instead.
I therefore see no reason to change the police's approach on this point.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om de werkwijze van de politie op dit punt te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Van Tongeren en Beckerman over de NAM-uitspraken en technische mogelijkheden voor het verminderen van gaswinning

MPs Nijboer, Van Tongeren and Beckerman asked the minister about NAM's claim that no additional safety measures were needed after a tremor, that the code red was wrongly issued, and about options to reduce Groningen gas extraction and exports of low-calorific gas. The minister defended SodM's assessment that the earthquake fit expected patterns, and outlined short-term limits and longer-term options to reduce gas demand, while declining to direct NAM's communications.
However, I do not decide on the way NAM presents its figures, reports and letters.
Ik ga echter niet over de wijze waarop NAM zijn cijfers, rapporten en brieven presenteert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de artikelen 'Vragen en zorgen over gaswinning Zuidwest-Drenthe' en 'Opnieuw informatieavond gaswinning: Te druk, te chaotisch'

MP Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about public concerns over gas extraction by Vermilion in Zuidwest-Drenthe, including consultation practices, baseline measurements, the company's compliance record, and whether the decision was predetermined at information evenings. The minister responded that participation follows the statutory procedure, that SodM advice is weighed but not always followed, and that the company bears primary responsibility for community communication.
Although SodM's advice carries great weight, this does not mean that all advice is adopted in every case.
Hoewel de adviezen van SodM zeer zwaarwegend zijn, betekent dit niet dat in alle gevallen alle adviezen worden overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Van Tongeren over het bericht “Echtpaar kraakt droomhuis om sloop te voorkomen”

MPs asked the minister about a couple who squatted a characteristic farmhouse in Middelstum to prevent its demolition by NAM, and whether NAM's demand that they leave within two days was acceptable. The minister said the couple left for safety reasons, that the future of the building is separate, that heritage preservation is a key principle and NAM has pledged to work toward keeping the house, and that a state housing company will be set up to manage acquired property.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de aardbeving in Groningen op maandag 8 januari 2018 met een kracht van 3.4 op de schaal van Richter

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the 8 January 2018 Groningen earthquake, including whether gas extraction should be cut further, the Loppersum cluster, damage settlement without a protocol, and inspections of dikes and chemical plants. The minister answered that extraction must come down, that a new damage protocol and monitoring measures are being prioritised, and that advice from SodM and Gasunie is awaited.
I am awaiting both advices before I can address the measures proposed by NAM.
Ik wacht beide adviezen af voordat ik kan ingaan op de voorgestelde maatregelen van de NAM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de artikelen 'Bewoners Zuidlaren weinig wijzer van onderzoek aardbevingsschade' en 'Ziek worden we van gedrag van de NAM'

MP Van Tongeren asks the minister why residents of Zuidlaren and Annen still lack clarity on NAM compensation for earthquake damage, whether the cost of damage investigations can exceed repair costs, and whether scratch damage should automatically be attributed to the quake. The minister acknowledges the need for transparent, independent damage handling, has asked the Tcbb to explore a nationwide damage protocol with an independent body, and will consult NAM and local authorities on speeding up settlement.

I have therefore asked the Technical Committee on Bodembeweging (Tcbb) to explore the option of establishing a uniform damage protocol for all of the Netherlands for damage caused by mining, with an independent body handling the damage.

Ik heb daarom de Technische commissie bodembeweging (Tcbb) gevraagd de optie te verkennen om voor heel Nederland een gelijkluidend schadeprotocol in te richten voor schade veroorzaakt door mijnbouw met een onafhankelijk orgaan dat de schade afhandelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van Tongeren over het artikel 'Nuclear accident sends 'harmless' radioactive cloud over Europe'

MPs Van Ojik and Van Tongeren asked whether the government knows who was responsible for a radioactive ruthenium-106 release over Europe, whether Russia or Kazakhstan violated early-notification duties, and what risks follow. The minister says the source is not known with certainty but likely the southern Urals, that the Netherlands raised the matter at the IAEA board, and that the national radiation monitoring network can detect such releases.
The Netherlands, together with several other European countries, asked the other IAEA member states for clarification at the recent IAEA board meeting.

Nederland heeft, tezamen met een aantal andere Europese landen, tijdens de afgelopen bestuursraad van de Internationaal Atoomenergieagentschap (IAEA) opheldering gevraagd aan de andere IAEA-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de uitzendingen van Kassa over de veiligheid van slimme gasmeters

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why only Stedin replaced its smart gas meters quickly, whether an independent investigation could follow, whether Enexis would be pressed to inform customers correctly, who supervises meter safety, and who can force faster replacement. The Minister answered that the grid operators judged the meters not an immediate safety risk, that SodM is now investigating and has ordered replacement of meters with short threads by 1 April 2018, and that the supervisory responsibilities are being clarified through a bill.
From this it appears that the grid operators immediately stopped installing meters after the first signals from practice about the production defect.
Daaruit blijkt dat de netbeheerders direct zijn gestopt met het plaatsen van meters na de eerste signalen uit de praktijk over de productiefout.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Kröger en Van der Lee over de berichten 'CO2-uitstoot auto's in EU met een derde omlaag in 2030' en ‘Autokoper gaat weer voor groot en zwaar’

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about the EU proposal for tighter CO2 standards for new cars from 2025 and 2030, the rise in average CO2 emissions of new cars after the Autobrief II tax changes, and whether a ban on fossil-fuel car imports is planned. The state secretary answered that a detailed position will follow in a BNC-fiche, that emissions may temporarily rise but are expected to fall as zero-emission car sales grow, and that an import ban would conflict with the EU treaty on free movement.
You will shortly receive the BNC-fiche containing the cabinet position and the Dutch negotiating stance for the upcoming negotiations.
U ontvangt op korte termijn het bnc-fiche met daarin het kabinetsstandpunt en de Nederlandse inzet voor de aankomende onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Tongeren over het rapport van de Kinderombudsman over aandacht voor kinderen en jongeren in aardbevingsgebied

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Children's Ombudsman report on children and young people in the earthquake area, covering consideration of children's interests in gas extraction and repair decisions, relocation, school building safety, information for children, the earthquake lesson pack, and health research. The minister answered that child safety is central, that a school programme targets completion by 2020, that relocation is arranged with residents where possible, and that the National Coordinator Groningen will improve information and stimulate use of the lesson pack, while leaving broader research on children to be considered.
Figures on the use of the lesson pack are not known, but the findings of the Children's Ombudsman show its added value.
Cijfers over het gebruik van het lespakket zijn niet bekend, maar de bevindingen van de Kinderombudsman laten de toegevoegde waarde ervan zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Tongeren, Van der Lee en Beckerman over overheidssteun voor de productie en het gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen

MPs from GroenLinks and the SP asked the government about the ODI/CAN-E report on public support for fossil fuels, the Netherlands' commitment to phase out inefficient fossil fuel subsidies, the absence of a consolidated overview of such support, and the state's share of decommissioning costs. The government denied direct specific support to fossil fuel firms, said budgets do not separate fossil from renewable support, and pointed to the Masterplan for Decommissioning and the new Nexstep platform.

Overviews that specifically distinguish between companies that use and/or produce fossil energy and companies that use and/or produce renewable energy are not available, as that distinction is not made in the budgets.

Overzichten die een specifiek onderscheid maken tussen bedrijven die fossiele energie gebruiken en/of produceren en bedrijven die hernieuwbare vormen van energie benutten en/of produceren, zijn niet voorhanden, aangezien dat onderscheid in de begrotingen niet wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Kröger over het bericht 'Minister Schultz in beeld als nieuwe baas Schiphol'

GreenLeft MPs Van Tongeren and Kröger asked whether a minister moving to a state-owned company (Schiphol) in his own policy field is acceptable, and about the cooling-off rules, the Schiphol CEO succession and any contacts with the Finance Minister. The government replied that a two-year cooling-off period applies to lobbying in one's own policy field, that former ministers decide on their own integrity, and that the minister had not been approached and had no contacts about the succession.
Cabinet policy is that a two-year cooling-off period applies to lobbying in one's own policy field.
Het kabinetsbeleid is dat er een afkoelingsperiode van twee jaar geldt voor het lobbyen op het eigen beleidsterrein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het rapport gebiedsdossier Weerselo, onderdeel van de Gebiedsdossiers drinkwaterwinningen Overijssel

An MP asked whether the minister knows that the Weerselo groundwater dossier leaves unclear whether NAM actually monitors effects of wastewater injection, and what powers the province has to enforce monitoring and safeguard drinking water. The minister answered that the monitoring passage was included in error, that risk is considered negligible and existing NAM permits and SodM supervision apply, and that provinces have sufficient instruments.
The province will inform all parties involved about this.
De provincie zal alle betrokken partijen hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘Gesprekken over schadeprotocol aardbevingsgebied vastgelopen’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why talks on a new damage protocol for the Groningen earthquake area stalled, whether NAM still plays a role in assessing damage, whether the burden of proof will shift, whether the protocol covers Drenthe and Friesland, how the backlog will be cleared, whether the Commissie Bijzondere Situaties continues, and when the protocol will be adopted. The minister acknowledged the talks have not yet produced the desired result, confirmed NAM will no longer assess causes and amounts while retaining liability, confirmed the statutory presumption of causation will apply, and said the protocol will likely be adopted only after the next cabinet takes office.
All parties, including NAM, agree that NAM should no longer play a role in assessing damage causes and deciding compensation amounts, while NAM retains its liability.

Alle partijen, inclusief NAM, zijn het eens over het uitgangspunt dat NAM niet langer een rol dient te spelen in het proces van beoordeling van schadeoorzaken en beslissingen over de hoogte van vergoedingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht 'Vervuilde bodem NAM in Manderveen geen gevaar voor gezondheid'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about contaminated soil at gas and oil extraction sites, including which sites are polluted, the status of remediation at Coevorden 5 and 17, and who is responsible when the polluter cannot be held liable. The minister answered that no national overview exists, that SodM has been asked to compile one, that provinces hold competence for historical pollution, and that the polluter is primarily liable for remediation.
I therefore do not currently have the overview requested by your House.
Ik beschik op dit moment dan ook niet over het door uw Kamer gevraagde overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht dat Rijkswaterstaat via een omweg de noodzakelijke toetsen omtrent luchtvervuiling en natuurwaarden probeert te omzeilen

An MP asked whether Rijkswaterstaat was circumventing mandatory air-pollution and nature tests to speed up the Blankenburg tunnel, and whether a court case on air quality affects it. The minister denied any circumvention, said a project-specific nature assessment with compensation measures was added to the route decision, and said the air-quality court ruling does not touch this project.
There is no question of circumventing necessary tests.
Van het omzeilen van noodzakelijke toetsen is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht dat Kustpact over bebouwing leidt tot scherpe conflicten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about conflicts over coastal construction under the Kustpact, including permits in Kijkduin, whether the pact can be enforced, and the number of pipeline projects. The minister answered that zoning under provincial guidance will guide new recreational building, that permits predate the pact and are a matter for the municipality, that consequences for non-compliance are possible but not yet relevant, and that pipeline figures are not reliably inventoried.
I will inform your House annually about the progress of the agreements.
Ik zal uw Kamer jaarlijks over de voortgang van de afspraken informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Tongeren over de berichten “Vijf jaar na de aardbeving die Groningen wakker schudde” en “Alders in actie tegen afketsen 'Groningen-verzekering'”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM had indicated it would not extract less than 20 billion cubic metres per year, why this was not reported to parliament, and whether the government would pursue alternative gas operators, fund test cases and keep arbiters available for Groningen residents. The minister denied any signal from NAM about a 20 billion cubic metre threshold, said alternative operators were not warranted, deferred the test-case funding to a successor and promised talks with the insurers' association and the National Coordinator.
During the debate of 4 July I indicated that I was not aware of this signal, and that still holds.
Ik heb tijdens het debat van 4 juli aangegeven dat mij dit signaal niet bekend is, en dat geldt nog steeds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over kartelafspraken van de grote Duitse autobouwers over prijzen en ook om niet of slechts minimaal aan de milieunormen te voldoen

Questions from MP Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) ask whether reported German car-maker cartel arrangements on prices and emissions, the possible deal on recall without type-approval withdrawal, and the emissions-defeat software issue have legal consequences in the Netherlands, and how APK, type approval and urban zones should respond. The government answers that cartels are a European Commission matter, that Dutch law currently gives no basis to compel recalls or prosecute the manufacturers, that about 77,000 Dutch vehicles still have an open Volkswagen recall, and that type-approval withdrawal and zone exclusion are limited or up to municipalities.
Currently there is no legal basis to prosecute manufacturers for this conduct or impose sanctions.
Momenteel is er geen juridisch aanknopingspunt om fabrikanten met deze handelwijze te vervolgen en sancties op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘weer paraffine gevonden op Noord- en Zuid-Hollandse stranden’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports of paraffin washing up on North and South Holland beaches, including volumes and cleanup costs, prevention measures, IMO negotiations and public warnings. The minister withheld current volume and cost figures pending a contract negotiation, described existing controls and an IMO discharge-ban push with decisions expected in 2018, and said no extra at-sea checks are currently planned.
I cannot yet inform you about the quantity of paraffin washed ashore in recent months and the cleanup costs.
Over de hoeveelheid aangespoelde paraffine van de afgelopen maanden en kosten voor het ruimen ervan kan ik u nog niet informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Dik-Faber over het bericht 'Rijksdienst: 'Maak van niet te redden monumenten ruïnes'

MPs Van Tongeren and Dik-Faber asked whether the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed was effectively giving up on monuments in the Groningen earthquake area by recommending ruins, and how the government would protect heritage. The ministers replied that the RCE's framework aims to preserve monuments, that some monuments may be irreparable with owners and municipalities deciding, that data on their number is lacking, and that a heritage programme will be sent to parliament before the summer recess.
At this moment we do not yet have sufficient data available to make a reliable statement about this.
Op dit moment hebben wij nog niet voldoende gegevens beschikbaar om hier een betrouwbare uitspraak over te kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de olievervuiling aan de oostkust van Bonaire

An MP asked the ministers about oil pollution on Bonaire's east coast, its risks, frequency, economic effects, the adequacy of local capacity, spillover to other islands and existing regional cooperation. The minister answered that the tar balls posed limited risk, most oil was removed, local authorities were capable with Dutch support, and regional cooperation exists under the Cartagena Convention.
The public body Bonaire informed the population about this and took appropriate measures to prevent contact and ingestion.
Het openbaar lichaam Bonaire heeft de bevolking hierover geïnformeerd en passende maatregelen getroffen om contact en opname te voorkomen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de rechterlijke uitspraak waarin staat dat het Openbaar Ministerie strafrechtelijk onderzoek moet doen naar de aardbevingsschade die is veroorzaakt door de gaswinning van

An MP asked ministers whether the Public Prosecution Service should investigate Groningen earthquake damage caused by NAM gas extraction, whether the Landelijk Parket should take the case, and whether the Raad van State hearing should be delayed. The government confirmed it would not appeal the Dijk ruling, declined to direct the prosecutor in an individual case, and said it would not further delay the July 2017 Raad van State hearing.
The Minister of Security and Justice may, under the Judiciary Organisation Act, give general and specific instructions on the performance of the Public Prosecution Service's duties and powers.

De Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie kan volgens de Wet op de Rechterlijke Organisatie algemene en bijzondere aanwijzingen geven betreffende de uitvoering van de taken en bevoegdheden van het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘Maak haast met gasloos’

MPs Van der Lee and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a news report on slow progress in building gas-free new homes, and whether the gas connection obligation should be scrapped and gas networks replaced with renewable heat plans. The minister said gas-free building is already possible, a change to the Gas Act is planned via an amendment, and no national overview of network replacement dates exists yet.
Amending the Gas Act is desirable to give effect to the Energy Agenda intention that in principle no new gas infrastructure is laid in new-build neighbourhoods.
Aanpassing van de Gaswet is wenselijk om het voornemen uit de Energieagenda te effectueren dat in beginsel geen nieuwe gasinfrastructuur meer aangelegd wordt in nieuwbouwwijken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van den Berg, Omtzigt, Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven en Dik-Faber over lekkages bij AKZO-Nobel in Twente

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about new well leaks at AkzoNobel in Twente, the number and effects of leaks, SodM's enforcement and projects, and liability for leak damage. The minister answered that lists of leaks are published and checked by SodM, that the effects appear limited to the immediate vicinity of leaking wells, that enhanced supervision continues with a research programme due by end 2017, and that liability stays with the party responsible at the time of the leak.
SodM urged AkzoNobel to give appropriate urgency to the investigation and remediation of leaks and possible contamination in Twente.
SodM heeft bij AkzoNobel aangedrongen op gepaste urgentie bij het onderzoek en de sanering van lekkages en mogelijke verontreinigingen in Twente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Wassenberg en Beckerman over het bericht 'Netherlands to get first US LNG cargot'

MPs Van Tongeren, Wassenberg and Beckerman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that a US shale gas LNG cargo would arrive in Rotterdam, whether it is meant for the Dutch market, whether shale gas from the US is undesirable, and whether the government can block this transport. The minister answered that the buyer decides the destination, that the origin of the gas cannot be verified, that countries are sovereign over their resources, and that a blockade would be unenforceable, contrary to EU law and to diversification goals.
In doing so, I see no reason nor possibility to impose a blockade on gas from the United States or on shale gas.
Daarbij zie ik geen reden noch mogelijkheid om een blokkade op te werpen ten aanzien van gas uit de Verenigde Staten of ten aanzien van schaliegas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht 'Nieuw schadeprotocol gaswinning vanaf 1 juli'

Green Left MP Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the reported withdrawal of NAM from Groningen damage handling and its takeover by the National Coordinator Groningen, plus related questions on contracts, burden of proof, arbiters, the Technical Commission on ground movement, Centrum Veilig Wonen and gas extraction reduction. The minister answered most questions briefly, largely by referring to earlier letters and debates, stating no additional agreements exist, the new protocol will be set by 1 July 2017, and a further 10% production cut is being prepared.
No additional agreements have been concluded.
Er zijn geen aanvullende overeenkomsten gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Dik-Faber, Remco Dijkstra, Ouwehand, Cegerek, Van Veldhoven, Van Tongeren en Geurts over het bericht dat chemiebedrijven de veiligheidsregels schenden

MPs asked the state secretary how to respond to reports that more than half of Dutch major-risk chemical firms repeatedly violated safety rules, including risks to workers and residents in Zaltbommel and how inspections and enforcement work. The state secretary replied that violations fell from 850 to 615 in 2015, that most are light offences, that inspectors act immediately on serious ones, that Zaltbommel is being handled through a planning and permit process, and that repeat offenders face escalated sanctions.
As previously promised, I will send the State of Safety of Major Risk Companies report for 2016 to your House before the summer, including an analysis of regional differences in compliance rates.
Zoals eerder toegezegd, zal ik de Staat van de Veiligheid Majeure Risicobedrijven over 2016 voor de zomer naar uw Kamer sturen inclusief een analyse van regionale verschillen in naleefpercentages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Tongeren over de registratie van geweld tegen vluchtelingen

MPs Voortman and Van Tongeren asked whether figures on violence against refugees and asylum seekers exist, whether police will record the victim's status, and how reporting is encouraged. The Minister answered that police record whether an offence is discriminatory, that the 2015 discrimination figures were sent to parliament, that efforts to raise reporting willingness continue, and rejected the claim that racist violence is structurally under-recognised.
Police officers must record all reports and complaints of discrimination and incidents in which a discriminatory aspect may be present.
Politieagenten dienen alle aangiften en meldingen van discriminatie en van incidenten waarin mogelijk een discriminatoir aspect aanwezig is, te registreren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Van Tongeren over de ‘bijna ramp’ en illegale oliepraktijken voor de Nederlandse kust

MPs Van Veldhoven and Van Tongeren asked about a near-disaster involving chemical processing on the tanker Franz Schulte off Scheveningen and whether inspectorates can detect such illegal practices. The minister said the ILT found no violations since the 2014 SOLAS ban, that it is considering joint checks with other inspection services, and that international action depends on further information.
Based on inspections of ships in ports, the ILT has found no violations of the ban on chemical processing during sea voyages since 1 January 2014.
Op basis van controles aan boord van schepen in havens heeft de ILT sinds 1 januari 2014 geen overtredingen van het verbod op chemische bewerkingen gedurende zeereizen vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over een plan voor een recreatieproject in het Veerse Meer

An MP from GroenLinks asks the ministers about a proposed large recreational peninsula in the Veerse Meer, including the municipality's stance, a 50-year ground lease by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, land exchanges, and whether the government will block the plan before the coastal pact. The minister replies that the municipality decides, that the lease is subject to permits by competent authorities, and that the government will not block the plan now but will set rules in the Kustpact and the Barro.
Ahead of the final signing of the Kustpact and applications for permits, I cannot yet give insight into that.
Vooruitlopend op de definitieve ondertekening van het Kustpact en aanvragen voor vergunningen kan ik daar nog geen inzage in geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over uitwisseling van personeel tussen ministeries en overige, bij de gaswinning betrokken instanties

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether personnel are exchanged between ministries and gas-extraction bodies, how the roles of licensor, supervisor and operator are kept separate after the OVV report, and about bonus policies at Gasunie, Gasterra, SodM, EBN and NAM. The minister answered that staff mobility is normal, that secondments occurred only with Gasunie and EBN, that the gas-ceiling decision followed the regular licensing procedure, and that bonus criteria tied to gas sales were dropped from 2016.
It does not befit me to interpret these individual considerations.
Het past mij niet om deze individuele overwegingen te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over problemen op het spoor na invoering van de nieuwe dienstregeling

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about rail disruptions on three routes after the new timetable, including subsidence on the Utrecht-Leiden line, a financing dispute with the province, and overcrowding. The State Secretary answered that the disruptions were mostly unrelated to the new timetable, denied the subsidence claim, said no extra track is currently planned, and pointed to performance agreements with NS and ProRail and a pending enforcement decision on overcrowding.
With NS and ProRail I have made clear agreements on operational performance across the entire rail network.
Met NS en ProRail heb ik duidelijke afspraken gemaakt over de operationele prestaties op het gehele spoornetwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Ouwehand over het overzicht methaanemissies door olie- en gasindustrie

MPs Van Tongeren and Ouwehand asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about methane emission estimates and measurement methods in the oil and gas industry, including reporting gaps, the 1990s basis of the calculation method, and verification by SodM. The minister answered that emissions are calculated from measured flow rates and standard factors, that SodM supervises company reporting with four experts, and that NOGEPA is reviewing methods, while declining to fully answer the questions on Groningen gas production data that were covered by a separate Wob request.
For answering questions 28 to 31 I refer to my response to these questions, which I sent to your House on 9 February.
Voor de beantwoording van vragen 28 t/m 31 verwijs ik naar mijn reactie op deze vragen, die ik uw Kamer op 9 februari jl. heb toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Tongeren over het Wob-verzoek inzake de besluitvorming aangaande de gaswinning in Groningen d.d. 20 december 2016

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Groningen gas extraction decision-making, including NAM's reduced storage volume, seismicity models, SodM's advice, preventive measures, and the Norg field. The minister answered most questions in substance, citing SodM advice and the extraction plan, while declining to treat some related items as separate matters and pointing to ongoing procedures.
SodM advises maintaining an annual production level of 24 billion Nm3
SodM adviseert om een jaarlijks productieniveau aan te houden van 24 miljard Nm 3
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over zoutwinning

An MP asked the minister about soil contamination from diesel leakage at salt-mining well 335 by AkzoNobel, the scope of the investigation into other wells, and the integrity of pipelines and wells under intensified supervision by SodM. The minister largely accepted SodM's conclusions, explained the phased testing programme and pipeline repairs, and said no further measures were needed for now since SodM reports the intensified supervision is working.
SodM's intensified supervision made AkzoNobel recognise the seriousness of the matter, insofar as this was still necessary.
Het verscherpt toezicht van SodM heeft AkzoNobel, voor zover dat nog nodig was, de ernst van de zaak doen inzien
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Voortman over de energieprestatievergoeding bij zeer energiezuinige woningen met een gasaansluiting

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked why the energy performance allowance (EPV) for very energy-efficient homes now allows gas connections despite the government's plan to phase out gas, and about the consequences for consumers, gas networks and costs. The minister replied that gas-connected homes are allowed for pragmatic reasons backed by housing associations, that the option is temporary (no new EPV gas contracts for renovations starting after 2022), that gas grid phase-outs are handled via local pilot projects with residents, and that no gas pipes need replacing unnecessarily.
I will have the regulation take effect on 1 February 2017.
Ik zal de regeling per 1 februari 2017 in laten gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Volp, Kooiman en Van Tongeren over het bericht dat burgemeester van der Laan vasthoudt aan de sluiting van acht coffeeshops

MPs Bergkamp, Volp, Kooiman and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Amsterdam's mayor insisting on closing eight coffee shops near schools, including the legal basis of an earlier informal agreement with the minister's predecessor and whether it obliges the mayor to enforce a 250-metre distance criterion. The minister answered that the agreement was oral, concerns phased enforcement priorities, that enforcement of the residence and distance criteria lies with the mayor or municipality, and declined to judge local research or to answer on the shorter deadline.
My predecessor made an oral agreement with the mayor of Amsterdam on prioritisation in enforcement regarding local coffee shop policy.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft met de burgemeester van Amsterdam een mondelinge afspraak gemaakt over prioritering in de handhaving met betrekking tot het lokale coffeeshopbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van Tongeren over de uitspraak van de bestuursrechter betreffende vergunning voor het opsporen van schaliegas door Cuadrilla

MPs Dik-Faber and Van Tongeren asked whether a court ruling that the refusal to extend Cuadrilla's shale gas exploration permits was unfounded affects the ban on commercial shale gas drilling, and what options the minister has. The minister replied that the ruling does not affect the moratorium, that he chose to appeal rather than extend or revoke the permits, and that the new Mining Act allows permits to be revoked or restricted in light of changed societal views.
I have therefore lodged an appeal against the court's ruling on 11 January 2017.
Ik heb daarom 11 januari 2017 hoger beroep ingesteld tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Dik-Faber, Ouwehand, Smaling en Jan Vos over het WOB-verzoek van Milieudefensie over gaswinningsbesluit 2016

Five MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the NAM's influence on the 2016 Groningen gas extraction decision, including a pre-sent expectations letter, consultations with NAM and Shell, and the withholding of an SodM advice from parliament. The minister answered that a draft expectations letter was shared with NAM only to test interpretation and feasibility, that the SodM advice was not actively sent but was later provided and published, and that the extraction ceiling was set on safety grounds at 24 billion m3 per year.
Since the SodM advice only confirmed that the process communicated to your House could proceed, I did not find it necessary to actively inform your House about it.
Aangezien het advies van SodM slechts bevestigde dat het met uw Kamer gecommuniceerde proces doorgang kon vinden, heb ik het niet nodig gevonden uw Kamer hier actief over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over kosten salderingregeling zonne-energie

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Economic Affairs minister about the cost of the net-metering (salderingsregeling) scheme for solar power and the postcode-rose scheme, including forgone energy tax revenue, cost-effectiveness per tonne of CO2 and how the schemes compare with SDE+. The state secretary answered with estimates of forgone revenue, cost figures from an IBO report, a commitment to evaluate the scheme and to inform parliament in the first half of 2017.
The research will be completed this year. The Minister of Economic Affairs and I will inform your House in December about the outcomes of the evaluation and the follow-up process.
Het onderzoek wordt dit jaar afgerond. De Minister van Economische Zaken en ik zullen uw Kamer in december informeren over de uitkomsten van de evaluatie en het vervolgproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Tongeren over de term ‘verkooppraatje’ bij het opleggen van een bijzondere voorwaarde aan een veroordeelde

MPs Van Nispen and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Justice about the term 'verkooppraatje' used when imposing a special probation condition on a convicted offender, and why the government's letters of 31 August and 27 September 2016 appeared to conflict. The Minister answered that the statements are not contradictory: the August letter concerned the Public Prosecution Service's interpretation of the recordings, while the September letter concerned the words actually used, which both sides agree included 'verkooppraatje' by one advocate-general.
There was also then no difference of view between Van der G.'s lawyer and the OM that the word 'verkooppraatje' was used during the conversation of 17 September 2015.
Er bestond ook toen geen verschil van inzicht tussen de advocaat van Van der G. en het OM dat het woord «verkooppraatje» tijdens gesprek van 17 september 2015 is gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het onderzoek naar de kerncentrale Borssele

MP Van Tongeren asked the minister about a report on the financial position of the Borssele nuclear plant and whether the Holtkamp scenarios and cost assumptions hold, including investment history, decommissioning costs, and options for storing unused contaminated fuel. The minister confirmed the report's findings, declined to give a full investment overview, explained the modelling assumptions, and said direct storage of unused fuel would need new facilities, with no firm cost or timeline.
Due to the commercial sensitivity of the underlying amounts and the possible consequences for EPZ's negotiating position, the Holtkamp report gives only a global description of the total amount.

Vanwege de bedrijfsgevoeligheid van onderliggende bedragen en de mogelijke consequenties voor de onderhandelingspositie van EPZ, wordt in het rapport Holtkamp slechts een globale omschrijving van de hoogte van het totale bedrag gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over mogelijke staatssteun aan Lelystad Airport

MP Van Tongeren asks whether discounts for charter and low-cost airlines at Lelystad Airport amount to unlawful state aid, how this fits the Aldersakkoord, and what profit expectations apply to regional airports and Lelystad. The Staatssecretaris rejects the state-aid claim, says discounts are not in themselves unlawful and are left to the operator within competition rules, and gives general profit outlooks while noting some details are not yet known.
Applying discounts as such in principle does not constitute (unlawful) state aid.
Het hanteren van eventuele kortingen als zodanig vormt in beginsel geen (onrechtmatige) staatssteun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over grensoverschrijdende gaswinning Groningse gasveld

MP Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about cross-border gas extraction from the Groningen field under the Ems estuary, including pressure communication with German wells and whether seismic risk models account for offshore volumes. The minister answered that the offshore part is integral to the Groningen field and included in subsidence and seismicity models, that German fields are not connected and thus excluded, and that EBN co-financed exploratory wells on German territory to refine the estimate of original gas in place.
That part of the Groningen gas reservoir extending under the Ems estuary has been included in the models used to calculate reservoir compaction and subsidence.
Dat deel van het gasreservoir van het Groningenveld dat zich uitstrekt onder de Eemsmonding, is meegenomen in de modellen, waarmee reservoircompactie en bodemdaling zijn berekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Van Tongeren over een conflict tussen het verpakkende bedrijfsleven en gemeenten aangaande het inzamelen van kunststof verpakkingen

MPs Van Veldhoven and Van Tongeren asked about a dispute between packaging industry and municipalities over payment for collecting plastic packaging, including non-packaging plastics and PET-trays. The State Secretary answered that talks with the VNG have not yet reached agreement, that the packaging body StAV questions the lawfulness of paying for non-packaging plastic, and that the evaluation of the framework agreement and a plan for PET-trays are pending.
I aim for a solution that is workable for all parties.
Ik streef naar een oplossing die voor alle partijen uitvoerbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het aannemen van een bewijsvermoeden bij aardbevingsschade

An MP asks the Economic Affairs minister whether the court's recognition of a causal presumption linking gas-extraction earthquakes to Groningen damage should lead the State and NAM to stop litigating and to reassess settled claims. The minister answers that causation must be judged case by case, that the presumption only applies to the specific case, that the wetsvoorstel bewijsvermoeden will introduce a statutory presumption for the future, and that no reassessment of closed claims is planned.
I see no reason to ask NAM to reassess claims that have already been closed.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om NAM te vragen reeds afgesloten zaken opnieuw te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Dik Faber en Van Tongeren over schade aan huurwoningen in Middelstum

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about damage to rental homes in Middelstum caused during reinforcement works, including months of drainage problems and loose structural bolts, and whether the Centrum Veilig Wonen and the NCG could intervene. The minister confirmed it concerns one dwelling, declined to detail an individual damage case, said a repair plan exists, and agreed that the corporation will check bolts in all Middelstum homes soon.
It does not befit me as Minister to go into the details of an individual damage case at length.
Het past mij als Minister niet om uitgebreid in te gaan op de details van een individueel schadegeval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het Voorlopige Kustpact

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment about the draft Coastal Pact, its definition of coastal values, the zoning and building ban, how it relates to Natura 2000, and how compliance by provinces and municipalities will be ensured. The minister answered that zoning will be worked out by provinces with partners, that the pact is a set of intentions to be translated into provincial and municipal rules, and that annual progress reports will be sent to parliament.
On the progress of the implementation of these agreements I will inform your House annually.
Over de voortgang van de uitvoering van deze afspraken zal ik uw Kamer jaarlijks informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Swinkels, Van Tongeren en Segers over de financiering van de rechtspraak

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Security and Justice about how the judiciary is funded, including judicial independence, the role of efficiency considerations, funding for new projects and workload from new legislation, and the Warsaw declaration on objective budget criteria. The answers were referred to a separate letter ('Positionering en financiering rechtspraak', Kamerstuk 29 279, nr. 352) rather than answered in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over “de Volkswagen dieselgate”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about Volkswagen and Renault emissions updates, including whether independent testing of recalled models should be required and whether Renault's emissions study omitted details. The government answered that independent technical services already oversee Volkswagen testing, that an RDW/TNO second opinion is underway, that there is no legal basis to force manufacturers to run real-driving tests on updated models, and that it sees no reason to query France directly.
At the request of your House, the RDW and TNO will carry out a second opinion on the solution approved by KBA.
Op verzoek van uw Kamer 3 voeren de RDW en TNO wel een second opinion uit naar de door KBA goedgekeurde oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de voorgenomen ontwikkelingen en professionalisering van het havenbedrijf van Sint Eustatius

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about plans to expand and professionalise the port of Sint Eustatius, including container and cruise facilities, and whether such expansion would damage protected coral reefs. The minister answered that cruise, diving and fishing are the focus, a professionalised port company is the precondition, no structural planning exists yet, and any plan will go through an environmental impact assessment under the Wet maritiem beheer BES with results shared with parliament.
Your House will be informed of the outcomes.
Uw Kamer zal over de uitkomsten worden geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Recourt, Van Nispen, Van Tongeren, Thieme, Van Klaveren, Krol, Houwers en Klein over de brief van een Nederlandse politieliaison in Thailand aan de Thaise autoriteiten

MPs asked the ministers about a 14 July 2014 letter from a Dutch liaison officer in Thailand requesting that Thai authorities open their own investigation into Van Laarhoven, and whether the Dutch government bears responsibility for his Thai prosecution. The minister answered that the request was made at the public prosecutor's request to speed up mutual legal assistance, that the courts found the state's conduct lawful, that consular assistance is provided, and that the prosecutor decides on instruments such as a transfer.
In general, cooperation with foreign authorities is not unusual when a suspect is located in another country.
In zijn algemeenheid is het niet ongebruikelijk dat samenwerking plaatsvindt met buitenlandse autoriteiten indien een verdachte zich in een ander land bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Van Tongeren en Dik-Faber over het bericht dat er sprake is van een ophoping van kernafval in Petten door falende apparatuur

MPs from D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the minister about reports of a build-up of nuclear waste at Petten caused by failing equipment, including how often the COVRA transfer deadline has been postponed, the VINISH problems, cost estimates and financial risks for ECN/NRG. The minister answered that the deadline was extended three times to 2022, that current VINISH problems are software-related and expected to be resolved, that cost estimates from 2015 remain valid, and agreed to publish the Turkenburg and Holtkamp reports with some passages redacted.
In accordance with articles 10 and 11 of the Open Government Act, a number of passages in the letter and the reports have been redacted.
Overeenkomstig de artikelen 10 en 11 van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur is een aantal passages in de brief en de rapporten weggelakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de ontvoering van de heer R. van Duijn

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about the 1970 criminal investigation into the abduction of R. van Duijn, including why no prosecution followed, whether an apology was made, and whether the case should be reopened. The Minister confirmed knowledge of the case, said the evidence was insufficient for prosecution, noted that the College of Procurators-General recently apologised to Van Duijn in a private meeting, and referred him to the Noord-Hollands archief for access to the archived files.
It is not appropriate for me to make further public statements about the content of these contacts.
Het past mij niet publiekelijk over de inhoud van deze contacten nadere uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht “Italianen weigeren Gronings gas te betalen”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that Italian company Eni refuses to pay for Groningen gas, including whether such gas is still exported and whether supplies should be halted. The minister answered that the arbitration dispute is ongoing and declined to comment on individual contracts, said the Eni contract concerns high-calorific gas, that no export volumes can be stated, and that stopping supply is not an option.
Apart from the fact that I do not make statements about individual contracts, it therefore cannot be stated how much Groningen gas is supplied to Eni.
Nog los van het gegeven dat ik geen mededelingen doe over individuele contracten, is daarom niet aan te geven hoeveel Groningengas er aan Eni is en wordt geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘Kamp vindt Green Deals nuttig, maar zet financiering stop’

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the government will stop funding Green Deals, despite judging them useful, and about the effects on success rates and scaling. The minister replies that most Green Deals have no government funding, that the instrument is about cooperation, network support and a single contact point, and that ending funding mainly means that funded-type Green Deals will no longer be concluded.
The expected effect is that the type of Green Deals that request financial support will no longer be concluded, and in time will no longer be requested.
Het effect dat wordt verwacht is dat het type Green Deals waar financiële ondersteuning bij gevraagd wordt niet meer zullen worden gesloten, en op termijn ook niet meer zullen worden aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Tongeren over het gebruik van een privé-e-mailadres voor werkaangelegenheden

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about his use of a private email account for work matters, the security rules that apply, the 2014 hacking investigation and possible foreign access to the data. The minister admitted frequent but not prohibited business use of private email, ordered an Auditdienst Rijk investigation into whether classified material was present, and promised to inform parliament after the summer recess.

I have therefore instructed the Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) to investigate whether documents bearing the classifications Departmental Confidential, State Secret Confidential, State Secret Secret or State Secret Top Secret under the VIR-BI were present in my private email account.

Ik heb daarom de Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) opdracht gegeven onderzoek te doen naar de vraag of documenten met de rubriceringen Departementaal Vertrouwelijk, Staatsgeheim Confidentieel, Staatsgeheim Geheim of Staatsgeheim Zeer Geheim zoals bedoeld in het Voorschrift Informatiebeveiliging Rijksdienst Bijzondere Informatie (VIR-BI) op mijn privé e-mailaccount aanwezig waren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Dik-Faber en Van Tongeren over het bericht dat er sprake is van een ophoping van kernafval

MPs from D66, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks asked the minister about reports that faulty measuring equipment at Petten leaves stored nuclear waste drums uncertain in content, and about delays in transferring the waste to COVRA. The minister confirmed the ANVS knew of the equipment shortcomings since spring 2015, said the waste remains safely stored, and gave partial answers on costs, delays and the NRG safety culture while referring some points to the regulator and the parliamentary debate.
The ANVS has been aware since spring 2015 that the accuracy of the VINISH installation at that time was not sufficient to achieve the characterisation agreed with COVRA.

De ANVS is sinds het voorjaar 2015 op de hoogte van het feit dat de nauwkeurigheid van de VINISH-installatie op dat moment niet voldoende was om de met COVRA afgesproken karakterisering te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over het gebruik van de term aardbevingsschade in plaats van mijnbouwschade

MPs Jan Vos and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Arbiters Aardbevingsschade decrees still use the narrower term earthquake damage instead of the broader mining damage that the minister had promised. The minister replied that the NCG follows the Civil Code concept, that the decrees will be amended only once all relevant parties commit to the arbiter's rulings, and that the arbiter adds a low-threshold dispute mechanism distinct from the Mijnraad and Tcbb, which remain in place.
Once this is the case, amending the establishing decree can be considered.
Wanneer dit het geval is, kan aanpassing van het instellingsbesluit worden overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Tongeren over de noodstroomvoorziening Borssele

An MP asked ministers about the Borssele nuclear plant's emergency power supply, the absence of an environmental impact assessment for the licence revision, and whether the plant meets its safety commitments. The minister answered that the regulator found no significant environmental impact, that the plant has a backup grid connection and diesel generators, and that a planned upgrade in 2017 will further improve safety.
The ANVS has judged that these proposed changes do not involve significant adverse environmental effects and that an environmental impact assessment is not necessary for them.
De ANVS heeft geoordeeld dat bij deze voorliggende wijzigingen geen sprake is van belangrijke nadelige gevolgen voor het milieu en dat het niet nodig is om hiervoor een m.e.r. uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over Otapan

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether the state should recover the costs of cleaning up the Otapan toxic ship from its owners now that they are known, and what steps the government would take. The State Secretary answered that a 2012 cost-recovery effort was ended because the Dutch default judgment was not recognised in Mexico, and that she is now examining whether recovery from the company's director and owners is possible and appropriate, promising results before the summer recess.
The report you cite has given me reason to examine to what extent cost recovery from the director of the company Basilisk and the owners of that company is now possible and expedient.

Het door u aangehaalde bericht is voor mij aanleiding te onderzoeken in hoeverre kostenverhaal op de in het bericht genoemde bestuurder van de vennootschap Basilisk en de eigenaren van die vennootschap thans mogelijk en opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de NAM BTW-constructie

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Economic Affairs about a VAT construction by NAM in which damage compensation to Groningen earthquake victims was invoiced in NAM's name, so that VAT could be reclaimed, and whether this could be criminal or burdened victims. The State Secretary answered that VAT on repair services is generally due but declined to give details about NAM's specific arrangements citing tax confidentiality (art. 67 AWR), and refused to give victims legal immunity or request a tax ruling.
Given the fiscal confidentiality duty of art. 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot go into this matter concretely.
Gelet op de fiscale geheimhoudingplicht van art. 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet concreet ingaan op deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over sluiting van kolencentrales

Two MPs asked whether a previously announced CCS obligation for coal plants should reduce any compensation owed to operators if coal plants are phased out, and whether a 2007 ministerial statement implied such an obligation. The minister answered that compensation depends on many factors still being studied, that the 2007 minister did not state a binding CCS requirement within ten years, that operators were not clearly told of a CCS obligation, and that the financial consequences are still under investigation.
At present I am investigating what the possible financial consequences of measures concerning coal-fired power plants would be.
Op dit moment ben ik aan het onderzoeken wat de mogelijke financiële consequenties zouden zijn van maatregelen rond kolencentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Jan Vos over de waardevermeerderingsregeling

MPs Van Tongeren and Van Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why no applications for the value-increase scheme (waardevermeerderingsregeling) were processed since December 2015, whether missing information from the Centrum voor Veilig Wonen causes delays, how this fits with the budget running out, and how the government will act on motions. The minister denied that no applications were processed, explained the sequencing rule and privacy-based data handling, and said the government will inform parliament in the spring budget memorandum.
The cabinet will take the motions into account in the spring budget memorandum and will then inform the House.
Het kabinet betrekt de moties bij de behandeling van de voorjaarsnota en zal uw Kamer dan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de handhaving REC dioxine-uitstoot

An MP asked the state secretary about dioxin emissions exceeding norms at the REC Harlingen waste incinerator, alleged structural bypass use, faulty dust meters, and whether the national inspectorate ILT was informed. The secretary acknowledged elevated dioxin emissions in October 2015, said the province of Fryslân is responsible for supervision and enforcement, and said the ILT is examining the province's performance after receiving a signal of possible tolerance.
The province of Fryslân is responsible for supervision of the company.
De provincie Fryslân is verantwoordelijk voor het toezicht op het bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Tongeren over de berichtgeving van RTV Oost over het gevaar voor mens en natuur van de afvalwaterinjectieputten van NAM

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about media reports on risks from NAM's wastewater injection wells in Twente, including new research, corrosion of injection pipes, transport pipeline leaks, and disclosure of wastewater composition. The Minister answered that the evaluation was ongoing with a decision expected mid-2016, that existing controls and monitoring were in place, and that some information would be provided or published while other points were answered with reference to existing reports and procedures.
I have asked the Commission for Environmental Impact Assessment to advise on this evaluation study.
Ik heb de Commissie voor de m.e.r. gevraagd een advies te geven over dit evaluatieonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over sluiting van kolencentrales en de mogelijke kosten hiervan

MPs Jan Vos and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about an op-ed claiming closing Dutch coal plants would cost little, about the link to a 2018 CCS obligation, emissions-rights costs, the Urgenda ruling, and SDE+ subsidies for biomass co-firing. The minister disagreed that a 2018 CCS obligation would reduce state costs, said compensation depends on factors still under study, and promised a cabinet response to the IBO CO2 report in the first half of 2016.
The IBO CO2 will provide building blocks for additional measures to implement the Urgenda ruling.
Het IBO CO 2 zal bouwstenen aandragen voor aanvullende maatregelen om het vonnis in de Urgenda-zaak uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Swinkels en Van Nispen over de arrestatie van enkele demonstranten te Spijkenisse

MPs from GroenLinks, D66 and SP asked whether the arrest of demonstrators in Spijkenisse and the handover of one arrestee to the aliens police was lawful and compatible with freedom of expression. The Minister answers that the demonstrators defied repeated police orders to move to a designated location, that nine were released the same day, and that one was handed to the aliens police only to establish her identity, after which she was released without detention.
