For that reason she was handed over on Sunday morning, in line with established policy, to the aliens police to establish her identity.
Daarom is zij zondagochtend, conform vastgesteld beleid, overgedragen aan de vreemdelingenpolitie om haar identiteit vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Dik-Faber over aanhoudende incidenten bij Belgische kerncentrales

MPs Van Tongeren and Dik-Faber asked the minister about Belgian nuclear plants Doel and Tihange: life extension without a full environmental impact assessment, alleged illegal state aid, joint inspections, municipal involvement, and reliability ratings. The minister said the Belgian authorities judged an EIA unnecessary, that the Dutch and Belgian regulators held a first joint inspection and will do more, that Dutch municipalities are informed but lack formal involvement in Belgian decisions, and that state aid is for the European Commission to assess.

The Belgian authorities, on the basis of the relevant law and regulations and licence, judged that drawing up an EIA is not necessary for extending the operating life of Doel 1 and Doel 2 nuclear plants.

De Belgische autoriteiten hebben op basis van de relevante wet en regelgeving en vergunning geoordeeld dat het opstellen van een MER niet noodzakelijk is voor de bedrijfsduurverlenging van de kerncentrales Doel 1 en Doel 2.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over de bij- en meestook van duurzame biomassa in kolencentrales

MPs Jan Vos and Van Tongeren asked whether the approximately 3 billion euro subsidy for biomass co-firing in coal plants is cost-efficient, whether alternatives like wind or solar should be chosen, and whether the subsidy should be reconsidered in light of the Urgenda ruling. The minister defended the co-firing subsidy as needed to meet the 2020 renewable energy target, said no realistic alternative exists for 25 PJ by 2020, and deferred the Urgenda cost questions to a forthcoming study.
At this moment it is not possible to state the societal costs and the costs per household and for SMEs for the mentioned policy packages.
Op dit moment is het niet mogelijk om voor de genoemde beleidspakketten de maatschappelijke kosten en de kosten per huishouden en voor het MKB aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over mijnbouwschade in Delfzijl

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Economic Affairs minister about mining damage (gas extraction) in villages around Delfzijl outside the official damage contours, and what this means for the KNMI PGA map, NAM compensation, the Meijdam advice, and infrastructure safety. The minister answers that an independent research into causes is starting, that damage reports outside NAM's contour are assessed case by case, and that the PGA map is for reinforcement prioritisation rather than damage estimation.

The National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) will start in the first quarter of this year an investigation into the causes of the high percentages of damage cases located at the edges of the earthquake area.

De Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) start in het eerste kwartaal van dit jaar met een onderzoek naar de oorzaken van de hoge percentages schadegevallen die gelokaliseerd zijn aan de randen van het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het rapport “Gesjoemel met bodembeweging”

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether gas-extraction subsidence in Franeker and Northeast Friesland exceeds the forecasts made at licensing, whether subsidence is assessed by the producer, and whether models and their timing errors are disclosed. The minister acknowledges that subsidence has been larger than forecast (up to factor 3-4 in Franeker), says damage is not expected, states the producer normally sets subsidence figures with SodM supervising, and says some models are publicly available with independent TNO checks.
Damage to buildings is not expected, not even on the basis of the revised (higher) subsidence forecasts.
Schade aan bebouwing wordt niet verwacht, ook niet op basis van de bijgestelde (hogere) voorspellingen voor de bodemdaling
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het geweld in Zuidoost-Turkije (ingezonden 23 december 2015).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of military destruction of neighbourhoods, civilian suffering, possible deaths of PKK fighters, proportionality of Turkish military action, calls for a ceasefire, and access for independent journalists and observers in southeast Turkey. The minister said he shares the concerns and referred to a separate letter to the European Affairs committee rather than answering each question.
I refer further for these answers to the letter on the current situation in southeast Turkey that was sent to the standing committee on European Affairs
Ik verwijs verder voor deze antwoorden naar de brief over de actuele situatie in Zuidoost-Turkije die is toegegaan aan de vaste commissie Europese Zaken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over TNO-metingen van Euro 5-motorvoertuigen

MP Van Tongeren asked the government about TNO measurements of Euro 5 vehicle emissions, including whether chassis dynamometer tests reflect real-world emissions and whether the proposed 130 km/h limit on the A2 affects local air quality. The Staatssecretaris answered that the dynamometer tests remain a good indicator of practical emissions, that the TNO conclusions were already incorporated into the emission factors, and that the 130 km/h plan has no consequences for the A2.

It is correct that TNO indicates chassis dynamometer, or roller bench, tests are used, but it is not correct that this test method does not adequately approximate real-world emissions for Euro 5 diesel cars.

Het klopt dat TNO aangeeft dat er chassis dynamometer oftewel rollenbanktests worden gehanteerd, maar het klopt niet dat deze testmethodiek in geval van Euro-5 dieselauto's de werkelijke praktijkemissie niet goed benadert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Smaling over de verdere besluitvorming inzake Pallas

MPs Van Tongeren and Smaling asked about the province of Noord-Holland withholding the second tranche of the Pallas reactor loan, the business case, go/no-go milestones, isotope supply, state aid and the Petten contamination. Minister Kamp answered that the bestuursakkoord would be shared, but declined to share the business case or provincial correspondence, and gave general answers on timetable, isotopes and the cleanup.

Given the importance of efficient and well-considered implementation of the decision-making on the project, in particular the Foundation's task of attracting private financing for the construction of the Pallas reactor, I do not consider it desirable to share the business case with the House of Representatives, whether confidential or not.

Gelet op het belang van een efficiënte en weloverwogen uitvoering van (de besluitvorming over) het project, in het bijzonder de taak van de Stichting voorbereiding Pallas-reactor om private financiering voor de bouw van de Pallas-reactor aan te trekken, acht ik het niet wenselijk om de business case – al dan niet vertrouwelijk – te delen met de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het terugvorderen van ten onrechte verleende belastingvoordelen bij sjoemelende autofabrikanten

An MP asked whether tax benefits given to Volkswagen cars should be recovered after the emissions fraud, and whether lost tax revenue from CO2 misreporting would be pursued. The State Secretary said the NOx fraud is outside the scope of CO2-based tax incentives, that an investigation into possible CO2 irregularities and their tax consequences has started, and that Volkswagen will bear any additional levies, but could not yet quantify lost revenue.
I have therefore started an investigation into the possible consequences of these irregularities for tax collection.
Ik ben daarom een onderzoek gestart naar de mogelijke gevolgen van deze onregelmatigheden voor de belastingheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de invoering van grenscontroles tijdens de Klimaattop in Parijs

An MP asked whether France's temporary reintroduction of border controls during the Paris climate summit was meant to block demonstrators and whether the Netherlands would press France to protect peaceful protest. The government answered that France notified the Commission under Schengen Borders Code Article 23 for threats to public order and security, that the Netherlands did the same for a 2014 summit, and that it trusts France to respect the right to protest.
I trust that France will abide by its international legal obligations and will not restrict the right to peaceful protest.
Ik vertrouw erop dat Frankrijk zich aan zijn internationaalrechtelijke verplichtingen zal houden en het recht op vreedzaam protest niet zal inperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het gevaar van lozingen in de Rijn

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about PFT contamination from Düsseldorf airport reaching the Rhine, its known history since 2007, and cross-border cooperation to improve river water quality. The minister replied that there is currently no danger to the Netherlands, monitoring shows negligible concentrations, a German cleanup plan takes effect in 2016, and cooperation with neighbouring countries already exists.
So far there is no danger to the Netherlands.
Tot op heden is er geen gevaar voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Tongeren en Van Veldhoven over het vermeende manipuleren van de prognoses voor zonne- en windenergie

MPs Jan Vos, Van Tongeren and Van Veldhoven asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about allegations that the IEA manipulated its wind and solar growth forecasts, and whether its outlook is accurate. The minister denied any bias, explained that the WEO presents scenarios rather than forecasts, said the IEA's methodology is careful, and argued the scenarios help inform policy choices.
However, the IEA does not present growth forecasts in the sense of predictions in its annual World Energy Outlook.
Het IEA presenteert in de jaarlijkse World Energy Outlook echter geen groeiprognoses in de zin van voorspellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de onderzoeksrapporten inzake schaliegas

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how follow-up research on shale gas would be designed, including the number, location and technique of scientific boreholes, their costs and funding, and whether municipalities and provinces could refuse them. The minister answered that no research programme is currently on the table, pending the Energy Report 2015, and gave only broad outlines, promising open data and consultation with local authorities.
A research programme on shale gas is currently not on the agenda.
Een onderzoeksprogramma naar schaliegas is op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de Isla-raffinaderij

An MP asked whether ISLA refinery emissions on Curaçao are rising, exceed permit limits and WHO guidelines, and why the Dutch government has not acted to protect the population. The minister confirmed emissions rose over 2011-2014 but said exceedance is hard to establish because several installations contribute, and that responsibility for enforcement and action lies with Curaçao.
This concerns an autonomous responsibility of the country of Curaçao.
Het gaat hier om een autonome verantwoordelijkheid van land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het uitblijven van een Nationaal Programma voor eindberging van radioactief afval

An MP asked why the government missed the 23 August 2015 deadline to submit a national programme for final disposal of radioactive waste to the European Commission, and about the cost and funding of final disposal. The minister acknowledged the delay due to longer supporting studies, promised public consultation this autumn, said the Waarborgfonds holds about 68 million euro against an estimated 2 billion euro cost, and deferred some answers.

The national radioactive waste programme will be submitted to the European Commission after it has been open for public consultation, the House of Representatives has been informed and I have adopted the programme.

Het nationale programma radioactief afval zal aan de Europese Commissie worden aangeboden nadat dit programma voor inspraak ter inzage heeft gelegen, de Tweede Kamer is geïnformeerd en ik het programma heb vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Omtzigt en Van Tongeren over meetgegevens op het Nederlandse olie- en gasportaal

MPs Mulder, Omtzigt and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reported monthly wastewater injection volumes above a 300,000-barrel threshold at Rossum-Weerselo-2, the relevance of a Science study on US injection and induced seismicity, and felt tremors near the injection well. The minister replied that monthly averages stay below that threshold, that the US study is not directly transferable to Dutch conditions, that TNO and SodM are assessing it with results expected in late September, and that the geophone network is being expanded.
I expect an answer from SodM and TNO at the end of September and will inform your House about it then.
Ik verwacht eind september een antwoord van SodM en TNO en zal uw Kamer hier dan over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht dat delen van het Groninger Forum zouden moeten worden gesloopt

MP Van Tongeren asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that parts of the Groninger Forum must be demolished, how costs of the construction pause and reinforcement are split, whether the state co-pays, and whether other new-build projects are halted or must be demolished for earthquake risk. The minister confirms the pause was agreed with the municipality and NAM, NAM agreed to consider delay costs for compensation, cost allocation is still under negotiation, and cost-sharing for other projects is agreed per project.
This concerns an ongoing negotiation for a specific project, involving the contractor, the client and third parties, and the final outcomes are not yet settled.

Het betreft hier een nog lopend onderhandelingstraject voor een specifiek project, waarbij de aannemer, de opdrachtgever en derde partijen betrokken zijn en de definitieve uitkomsten nog niet vaststaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van Oosten, Rebel, Oskam, Van Tongeren en Van der Staaij over de inzet van de Koninklijke Marechaussee bij de bestrijding van mensenhandel

MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Royal Marechaussee's role in combating human trafficking, its legal basis in the Police Act, and more sniffer dogs for searching lorries. The minister confirmed the KMar's frequent involvement and stated that its trafficking-combating task is covered by existing police tasks, with a review of possible legal changes ongoing and some capacity measures taken.
Consultations are currently taking place between my department, the Public Prosecution Service, the police and the KMar to further improve cooperation in combating human trafficking.

Momenteel vindt er overleg plaats tussen mijn departement, het Openbaar Ministerie, de politie en de KMar om de samenwerking op het gebied van de bestrijding van mensenhandel nog verder te verbeteren.
Vragen van het lid VanTongeren (GroenLinks) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de dood van een arrestant te Den Haag (ingezonden 1 juli 2015).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about unrest in The Hague's Schilderswijk after a man died in police custody, about trust between residents and police, SCP findings on perceived discrimination, and whether the festival policing and the Rijksrecherche investigation will be evaluated and reported. The Minister describes community-relations efforts, notes perceived but not established police discrimination, and says the Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie has been asked to investigate neck-hold use and training, with the Rijksrecherche investigation ongoing so no statements on it are possible.
I have, as I reported to your House by letter on 10 July, asked the Inspectorate for Security and Justice to conduct an investigation into the police use of the neck hold.
Ik heb, zoals ik uw Kamer op 10 juli jl. per brief heb gemeld, de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie verzocht een onderzoek in te stellen naar het gebruik van de nekklem door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Recourt, Berndsen-Jansen, Segers en Van Tongeren over de uitzending van Argos over de verdwenen tapgesprekken

MPs from five parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about an Argos broadcast on missing wiretap recordings, including whether the ADR inquiry into the system failure was adequate, the role of the supplier, and whether the government controls the stored data. The minister replied that the broadcast revealed no new facts, that the ADR found no sign of deliberate human action, that the supplier withheld one detail for trade-secret reasons, and that the police manage the system and have taken additional measures.
It is true that the ADR investigation did not provide complete clarity on all points.
Het klopt dat het onderzoek van de ADR niet op alle punten volledige duidelijkheid heeft opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over de sluiting van de kerncentrale Tihange

MPs Jan Vos and Van Tongeren asked whether the government would act on Dutch municipal motions urging closure of the Belgian Tihange plant, press Belgian counterparts, and clarify iodine tablet distribution and emergency planning. The minister replied that nuclear safety is a Belgian national responsibility handled by FANC, that cooperation with FANC is being strengthened, and described the regional emergency plans and iodine tablet stocks without giving an exact distribution radius.
Nuclear safety is a national responsibility and it is therefore the Belgian regulator that decides whether the plant is safe or must be closed.
Nucleaire veiligheid is een nationale verantwoordelijkheid en het is dan ook de Belgische toezichthouder
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de inwerkingtreding van de negende tranche van de Crisis- en herstelwet in Groningen

An MP asked whether adding earthquake-related measures (Groningen reinforcement, value-enhancing works, cables and pipelines) to the ninth tranche of the Crisis and Recovery Act would limit provincial and municipal influence, conflict with the Onderzoeksraad's recommendation, and allow faster expropriation or other rule changes. The minister answered that the tranche only accelerates administrative procedures without changing local competences, that other rules (expropriation, monuments, nature, environment) are unchanged, and that the Act will not be reconsidered.
Including the said measures in Annex I of the Crisis and Recovery Act means that the administrative-law procedural accelerations of chapter 1, section 2 of the Act apply to them.
Het opnemen van de genoemde maatregelen in Bijlage I van de Chw betekent dat hierop de bestuursrechtelijke procedurele versnellingen van hoofdstuk 1, afdeling 2, van de Chw van toepassing zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Dik-Faber, Van Tongeren en Van Veldhoven over subsidiering van biomassa bijstook

Four MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether subsidising biomass co-firing (including 15% cheaper residual streams such as animal meal) risks over-subsidisation, and questioned the basis of the SDE+ base amounts and the withheld ECN/DNV GL reports. The minister answered that the NGO agreement does not fix the SDE+ rate, that the price effect is within calculation margins, and that the preliminary ECN note will not be published though the final version was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, De Boer en Dik-Faber over mobiliteitskaarten

MPs asked whether NS unilaterally terminated contracts with alternative mobility-card providers, whether this threatens an NS monopoly, and whether ACM is investigating. The state secretary answered that NS did not renew contracts on the same terms, agreed in principle with some providers, and that ACM has found no apparent infringement and is not starting an investigation.
ACM is currently not starting an investigation and for the time being is halting its official interventions.
ACM start op dit moment geen onderzoek en staakt vooralsnog de ambtelijke interventies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de noodzaak om de kerncentrale Borssele te controleren op scheurtjes

MP Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Borssele nuclear plant's reactor vessel should be fully inspected for cracks after Belgian findings, and why the 2013 inspection report was not published. The minister answered that Borssele's vessel differs from the Belgian ones, that the inspection sampling was sufficient, and that the report is for the operator EPZ to publish; no additional inspection was deemed necessary, though ANVS will monitor developments.
The NRG report was commissioned by EPZ, the licence holder of the KCB. It is therefore up to EPZ whether or not to make the report public.
Het rapport van NRG is in opdracht van EPZ, de vergunninghouder van de KCB, opgesteld. Het is daarom aan EPZ om het rapport al dan niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over gasboringen op Terschelling

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the permitting status, Natura 2000 and tourism risks, CO2 content, drilling and stimulation techniques, blow-out risk, financial liability and reserve volumes of the Terschelling gas field. The minister answered that a winning permit decision is expected mid-year, that the environmental and natura assessments will follow under the national coordination regime, that liability rests with the operator, and declined to give reserve or revenue estimates before the permit is granted.
First I must decide whether the winning permit requested by Tulip Oil under the Mining Act can be granted.
Eerst dien ik te besluiten of de door Tulip Oil aangevraagde winningsvergunning op grond van de Mijnbouwwet kan worden verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Tongeren over de tienjarige levensduurverlening van Doel 1 en Doel 2 in België

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Belgium's decision to extend the life of the Doel 1 and Doel 2 reactors by ten years, including whether a cross-border environmental impact assessment is required. The minister replied that the decision rests with the operator, the Belgian government and the FANC, that no MER procedure is required under Belgian rules, and that he has agreed closer cooperation with the Belgian regulator.
The choice whether or not to extend the operating life of the Doel 1 and Doel 2 nuclear plants lies with the licence holder (Electrabel), the Belgian government and the FANC.
De keuze om wel of niet de levensduur van de kerncentrales Doel 1 en Doel 2 te verlengen is aan de vergunninghouder van de kerncentrales (Electrabel), de Belgische regering en het FANC.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de buitenwerkingstelling van de Wet bewaarplicht telecommunicatiegegevens

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the court ruling suspending the data retention law would be implemented immediately for all obligated parties, and how providers would be prevented from retaining user data. The Minister answered that the ruling has direct effect, that retention without business purpose is no longer allowed, and that Agentschap Telecom will supervise deletion.
Supervision of the storage and processing of traffic data for business purposes has been assigned to Agentschap Telecom.
Het toezicht op het opslaan en verwerken van verkeersgegevens voor bedrijfsdoeleinden is belegd bij Agentschap Telecom.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het risico op aardbevingen door afvalwaterinjectie

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about earthquake risks from deep wastewater injection, including the De Hoeve quake, reported leaks and incidents in Twente, and seismicity near Borgsweer in Groningen. The minister answers that injection permits account for induced seismicity, monitoring is in place, incidents were low-risk, and a 2011 evaluation is planned, while largely defending current practice.
I am currently in discussion with the province of Overijssel on this subject and it is being examined whether this evaluation can be brought forward.
Ik ben momenteel met de provincie Overijssel in gesprek over dit onderwerp en er wordt gekeken naar de mogelijkheid deze evaluatie naar voren te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over uraniumspeculatie bij Urenco

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about uranium speculation by Goldman Sachs stored at Urenco's Almelo site, including safety, transport permits, Euratom ownership and the planned Covra depleted uranium expansion. The minister confirmed Goldman Sachs stores UF6 there via a subsidiary, stated that speculation has no effect on safety, permits, or enriched uranium volumes, and said it is commercially confidential which other firms store uranium there.
Which companies besides Goldman Sachs store uranium on Urenco's site in Almelo, and how much they store, is commercially confidential information.
Welke bedrijven naast Goldman Sachs uranium opslaan op het terrein van Urenco in Almelo en hoeveel uranium zij daar opslaan, is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Schouw, Van Tongeren en Gesthuizen over de onwettigheid van de bewaarplicht van telecomgegevens van burgers

Four MPs asked whether the Dutch data retention law, which the Court of Justice had found incompatible with EU rights, should be suspended, and whether providers could claim damages or be shielded from client claims. The minister replied that the Dutch regime is more detailed than the annulled directive and is compliant, that there is no reason to suspend it, that providers may face damages claims left to the courts, and that no reliable investment estimate exists.
I see no reason to freeze the implementation of the current law until parliament has dealt with the proposed amendment.
Ik zie geen aanleiding de uitvoering van de huidige wet te bevriezen totdat het parlement de voorgestelde wetswijziging heeft behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht “Mansveld niet naar klimaattop in Lima”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Prime Minister why the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment would not attend the Lima climate summit, whether a substitute minister should go, and what this means for Dutch negotiating room on emissions targets and climate finance. The government replied that the climate envoy substitutes for the state secretary, that the EU negotiating team has a binding mandate so her absence does not affect negotiating room, and that the Dutch points will be raised by the envoy.
A team of negotiators from the Member States and the European Commission is negotiating in Lima on behalf of the EU, within the mandate set out in Council conclusions.
Een team van onderhandelaars uit de Lidstaten en de Europese Commissie onderhandelt in Lima – binnen het in raadsconclusies vastgelegde mandaat – namens de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de uitvoering van de motie over een bindende doelstelling voor duurzame energie per lidstaat

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government had changed its instructions to the Permanent Representation in Brussels to implement a motion calling for binding national renewable energy targets per member state. The minister declined to disclose the instructions to protect negotiating position, reported that the Netherlands pushed for national breakdown at the October European Council without majority support, and that the outcome was a binding EU-wide 27% target for 2030 without national breakdown.
To safeguard the Dutch position in European negotiations, official instructions to the Permanent Representation in Brussels are not public.
Om de Nederlandse positie in Europese onderhandelingen te waarborgen zijn ambtelijke instructies aan de Permanente Vertegenwoordiging in Brussel niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Tongeren en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat lijkschouwers misdrijven missen door een gebrekkige opleiding

MPs Van Nispen, Van Tongeren and Bruins Slot asked the ministers about reports that medical examiners miss crimes due to inadequate training, and about the Health Council's findings on forensic medicine training and funding. The minister replied that existing registers and quality guidelines suffice for now, declined to fund the forensic physician training or a chair, and promised a further update in mid-2015.
Recent signals from the field and from your House are grounds to examine whether the quality of the body inspection should be tightened.
Recente signalen vanuit het veld en uw Kamer zijn aanleiding om na te gaan of de kwaliteit van de lijkschouw dient te worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op aanvullende vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de invoering van de maximumsnelheid van 100 km/u op de A1/A35 nabij Borne en Hengelo

MP Van Tongeren asks whether the government has sent the promised written response on the A35 complaints point concerning the 100 km/h speed limit near Borne and Hengelo to parliament, and asks it to do so if not. The minister confirms the earlier promise and states that the response was given in the letter of 13 June 2014 ahead of the MIRT committee meeting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘Bedrijven staan niet te trappelen om hun stukje spoor over te nemen’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that companies are unwilling to take over rail sidings, whether maintaining rail links for businesses is important, what measures will bring more freight onto rail, whether public funding should cover freight rail, and whether NS's siding duties could move to ProRail. The state secretary confirmed the importance of rail freight, listed Long-Term Rail Agenda actions and a rail freight table, said no figures exist on firms' rail use, and said a scenario study on moving siding tasks to ProRail is under way at no cost to the state.
I am currently researching, together with the sector, how the tasks of NS Spooraansluitingen can best be carried out.
Momenteel onderzoek ik samen met de sector hoe de taken van NS Spooraansluitingen het beste kunnen worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren naar aanleiding van het bericht “CPB onderzoekt gevolgen “instortend” Schiphol”

An MP asked whether the CPB is studying the economic effects of Schiphol losing its hub function and whether this affects the Lelystad expansion. The government denied any such commissioned study, explaining only that the CPB and PBL are updating long-term scenarios in which the hub position is one uncertainty, without economic effects being examined.
No. The Netherlands Bureau for Economic Policy Analysis (CPB) is not conducting research into the economic consequences of Schiphol losing its hub function, including in relation to Lelystad.
Nee. Het Centraal Planbureau (CPB) doet geen onderzoek naar de economische gevolgen van het wegvallen van de hubfunctie van Schiphol, ook niet in relatie tot Lelystad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over een aanhouding bij de Nederlandse Veteranendag

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether a spectator carrying the Morgenstervlag was arrested at the Veteranendag parade, whether the flag played a role, and whether the arrest was proportionate. The government answered that the person was arrested for climbing a fence into a closed security zone, not for the flag, that the Comité Nederlandse Veteranendag banned non-regimental flags at the parade by agreement with veterans' associations, and that the case is a standalone matter for local authorities and the Openbaar Ministerie.
In the first instance it is up to the local authorities to judge what happened.
Het is in eerste instantie aan het lokale gezag om een oordeel te geven over hetgeen er is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het klimaat- en energiebeleid

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about internal EU-level preparations on the 2030 climate and energy framework, including whether surplus 'hot air' could carry into the post-2020 period and weaken the 40% emissions target. The state secretary answered every question only by referring to ongoing preparatory work, the forthcoming PBL/ECN study and future briefings, and restated the government's position of at least 40% CO2 reduction and 27% renewables at EU level.

At present it is still unknown how the European balance of power will develop, which negotiating options will be on the table, and what consequences the different options may have for the Netherlands.

Momenteel is nog onbekend hoe het Europese krachtenveld zich zal ontwikkelen, welke onderhandelingsopties op tafel zullen liggen, en welke consequenties verschillende opties voor Nederland kunnen hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de verlening van erkenningen aan Halliburton B.V. te IJmuiden

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether issuing explosives-handling recognitions to four Halliburton B.V. staff in IJmuiden prejudges the decision on shale gas, and about the company's safety and environmental record. The minister answered that the recognitions only allow explosives use for mining activities under a licence-holder's order, that no shale gas activity will occur pending the structuure plan, and that the Explosives Act does not allow revocation or require financial security.
I am not in a position to comment on investigations and legal proceedings currently underway in another country.
Ik ben niet in een positie om uitlatingen te doen over onderzoeken en juridische procedures die momenteel gaande zijn in een andere natie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven en Smaling over het bericht “Geen doorstart luchthaven Twente”

MPs Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven and Smaling asked whether the Twente airport decision procedure should be halted after the regional initiator stopped pursuing a commercial airport, and whether the military airport designation and regulation could still apply. The state secretary replied that talks with the region are ongoing, that the procedure's consequences will be reviewed, and that military designation of Twente will be extended to 1 November 2016 for existing users.
I will consult with the region about the situation that has arisen.
Ik ga met de regio in overleg over de ontstane situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Tongeren en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat lijkschouwers misdrijven missen door een gebrekkige opleiding

MPs asked the government how it responds to reports that medical examiners miss crimes due to inadequate training, and whether training should be publicly funded to prevent a shortage and quality problem. The minister said employers are responsible for staffing, a professional register safeguards quality, and no short-term measures or public funding are currently warranted.
I saw and see no reason to take measures in the short term.
Ik zag en zie daarin geen aanleiding om op korte termijn maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven, Dik-Faber en Ouwehand over schaliegasboringen Argentinië

MPs from GroenLinks, D66, ChristenUnie and PvdD asked the government about Shell's shale gas test drilling in Argentina, including proximity to a protected area, environmental information access, consultation and compensation for local farmers, and OECD guideline compliance. The minister answered that the drilling lies outside the current protected area, that Shell claims legal compliance and denies harm to livestock, that the embassy's 2013 site visit was routine economic diplomacy, and that OECD guideline questions fall to the National Contact Point.
Whether and to what extent the Environment and Information Disclosure chapters apply to Shell's activities in Vaca Muerta, I cannot assess.
Of en in hoeverre de hoofdstukken Milieu en Informatieverstrekking van toepassing zijn op de activiteiten van Shell in Vaca Muerta, kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over verlaging van RVOB-grondtarieven

An MP asked why the government lowered the SDE+ land compensation for wind on land, whether RVOB's land rates are above market and how they compare with coal and biomass plants. The minister confirmed the reduction to limit price-raising effects on land, stated RVOB sits at the low end of market-conform prices, and said land pricing is primarily RVOB's responsibility.
I am in principle not involved in land transactions.
Ik ben in beginsel niet bij grondtransacties betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en van Tongeren over de mogelijkheid om een spoorverbinding tussen Utrecht en Breda te realiseren langs de A27

MPs Smaling and van Tongeren asked why the government chose to widen the A27 between Utrecht and Breda for over 800 million euro rather than a rail link, and whether a rail line was studied, including its jobs and benefits. The State Secretary answered that the widening addresses a capacity problem on a national freight and traffic corridor, that the rail link was studied and rejected on a cost-benefit score of 0.05 with investment costs above 4 billion euro, and that infrastructure investment will continue to support jobs.
From these studies the conclusion was drawn that it is not justified to take further steps regarding this possible new railway line.
Uit deze onderzoeken is de conclusie getrokken dat het niet verantwoord is verdere stappen te ondernemen ten aanzien van deze mogelijke nieuwe spoorlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Tongeren over de samenstelling van de staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Van Tongeren asked whether a member of the Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap should be reconsidered given his tweet that there should be no more than two legal parents or guardians, and whether the government would reconsider his appointment. The Secretary of State confirmed the tweet, said all members are chosen for expertise and may hold views, and saw no reason to reconsider the appointment.
The mere fact that Prof. Nuytinck, prior to his appointment to the state commission, took part in the public debate via a tweet does not mean he would be biased regarding the commission's outcomes.

Het enkele feit dat (bijvoorbeeld) prof. Nuytinck zich, voorafgaand aan zijn benoeming in de staatscommissie, door middel van een tweet heeft gemengd in het maatschappelijk debat, betekent niet dat hij vooringenomen zou zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘Zoektocht naar olielek in Duitse Amtsvenn bij Enschede ook tijdens Pasen’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether an oil leak from a salt cavern in Germany near Enschede undermines the safety of the planned diesel storage there, whether further soil-safety research is needed, and whether the AkzoNobel permit should be suspended. The minister replied that the Dutch storage permitting and SodM supervision are adequate, no extra research is needed, the permit will not be suspended, and SodM and the ministry are monitoring the German situation.
At this moment I also see no reason to halt AkzoNobel's preparatory work or to revoke the permits.
Ik zie op dit moment ook geen aanleiding om de voorbereidende werkzaamheden van AkzoNobel stil te leggen of de vergunningen in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over  afspraken over bezoeken van buitenlandse delegaties

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Chinese security screens that blocked protesters from view during Xi Jinping's Amsterdam visit, and whether foreign security details may hold special powers or immunity in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Dutch state is responsible for security, foreign security staff have no powers, foreign official missions enjoy immunity under customary law, and that permitting demonstrations is primarily a local matter.
The Dutch State is responsible for the security of foreign delegations and takes all necessary measures to this end.
Antwoord 4 en 5 De Nederlandse Staat is verantwoordelijk voor de veiligheid van buitenlandse delegaties en treft hiertoe alle benodigde maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van Tongeren over het opnemen van de Structuurvisie Schaliegas in de Structuurvisie Ondergrond

Two MPs asked whether the Structuurvisie Schaliegas will be integrated into the Structuurvisie Ondergrond, whether test drilling should wait for that integrated assessment, whether the role of shale gas and need-and-necessity questions will be addressed before legal changes, and whether drinking water and geothermal energy will get priority over shale gas drilling. The minister answered that the shale gas vision will be fully integrated, that mining companies agreed to undertake no activities until it is adopted, that CE Delft is studying costs and benefits with the planMER, and that functions get no absolute priority, with scarcity-linked functions possibly favoured.
As you know, I have agreed with the mining companies that no activities will be undertaken until the Structuurvisie Schaliegas has been adopted.
Zoals u weet heb ik met de mijnbouwondernemingen afgesproken dat totdat de Structuurvisie Schaliegas is vastgesteld er geen activiteiten worden ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de veiligheidssituatie op rangeerterrein Kijfhoek

MP Van Tongeren asked the State Secretary about the Council of State's annulment of local safety conditions for the Kijfhoek shunting yard, and how hazardous-goods safety and emergency access will be protected. The State Secretary replied that external safety limits are met, that the court ruling bars local rules on transport matters, and that a voluntary framework and national general rules under the Environment Act are being prepared.
Given the Council of State's ruling, it is legally not possible to impose additional local conditions for this; that can only be done through national regulation.
Gelet op de uitspraak van de Raad van State is het juridisch niet mogelijk om lokaal hiervoor aanvullende voorschriften te stellen; dat kan uitsluitend in landelijke regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Tongeren, Paulus Jansen, Agnes Mulder en Ouwehand over het verstrekken van jodiumpillen in verband met het beperken van effecten van een nucleaire ramp

MPs from GroenLinks, SP, CDA and PvdD asked the Minister of Health whether Dutch households should receive iodine tablets in advance of a nuclear accident, given the Tsjernobyl and Fukushima experience with central storage. The minister said she is considering door-to-door distribution for some zones, will consult regional partners and the ministries involved, and admitted she does not know how long distribution takes or how many people could be reached.

In the coming months I want to work out, in consultation with the Ministers of Economic Affairs and of Security and Justice and the relevant regional partners, a proposal for effective and efficient distribution of iodine tablets.

De komende maanden wil ik in overleg met de Ministers van Economische Zaken en Veiligheid en Justitie en de betrokken regionale partners een voorstel uitwerken voor een effectieve en efficiënte distributie van jodiumtabletten.

Vragen van de leden Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) en Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) aan de Minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking over boringen naar onconventioneel gas in Oekraïne (ingezonden 7 maart 2014)

Two MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Shell's unconventional gas drilling in Ukraine, including open waste pits, a Ukrainian contract partner with alleged corruption links, and OECD guideline compliance. The minister answered that the practices comply with Ukrainian and Dutch rules, that Shell's due diligence found no reason to suspect corruption, and that she asked Shell to monitor the company's developments.
I have asked Shell to closely monitor developments surrounding this company.
Ik heb Shell gevraagd de ontwikkelingen rondom dit bedrijf nauwlettend te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over een arrest van het Europees Hof van Justitie over het hyperlinken en embedden van reeds openbaar gemaakt materiaal

An MP asked whether the CJEU Svensson ruling on hyperlinking and embedding should lead Buma/Stemra to stop its embedding levy and the public broadcaster to drop its restrictions. The government answered that the Court ruled embedding of freely available material is not a communication to the public and that member states may not grant broader protection, noting Buma has voluntarily stopped requiring licences for such links and the NPO has been asked via the media regulator to consult on consequences.
The Minister of Education, Culture and Science has asked the Commissariat for the Media to consult with the NPO on the consequences of the ruling.
De Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap heeft het Commissariaat voor de Media verzocht met de NPO in overleg te treden over de consequenties van het arrest.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Dik-Faber, Van Tongeren, en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat het nieuwe handelsverdrag met de VS het Nederlandse schaliegasverbod bedreigt

MPs Dik-Faber, Van Tongeren and Agnes Mulder asked whether the proposed EU-US trade deal (TTIP) and its investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS) clause could undermine a Dutch shale gas fracking ban and expose the state to damages claims, and whether Chevron's support for ISDS poses a risk. Minister Ploumen answered that ISDS would contain an exception for indirect expropriation covering general non-discriminatory public-interest measures, that parliament remains free to ban fracking, that a study on ISDS effects including on environmental regulation is underway with results due before summer, and that she cannot guarantee Chevron will not use ISDS but considers a successful claim unrealistic.
Yes, even after the conclusion of TTIP, the Dutch parliament can still take a decision on a ban on shale gas extraction.
Ja, ook na het sluiten van TTIP, kan het Nederlandse parlement nog steeds een besluit nemen over een verbod op schaliegaswinning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven en Smaling over het ontwerp luchthavenbesluit luchthaven Twente

MPs Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven and Smaling asked the state secretary about the draft airport decree allowing Twente airport to grow to 22,000 aircraft movements, including the absence of a European Commission state-aid ruling, the withheld business plan and financial figures, passenger forecasts, the operator's inexperience, and the 6-km nature restrictions. The state secretary answered that the decree rests on a tendered concession and a verified low-growth scenario, that the business plan and parts of the financial report are withheld as commercially sensitive, and that the decree will only be finalised after a positive Commission state-aid decision.
The business plan for Twente airport was drawn up by the operating company.
Het businessplan voor luchthaven Twente is opgesteld door de exploitatiemaatschappij.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht dat de Commissie voor de milieueffectrapportage (Commissie voor de m.e.r.) niet wordt betrokken bij de opstelling van een milieueffectrapport voor de Blankenbu

An MP asked the minister why the Commission for Environmental Impact Assessment (Commissie m.e.r.) would not be involved in the environmental impact study for the Blankenburg tunnel, and whether that is justified given the project's size, complexity and public opposition. The minister answered that the Crisis- and Herstelwet does not require advice from the Commission for this project, that the environmental effects will still be examined carefully through the project-MER with stakeholder involvement, and that the Commission will not be consulted.
I will not involve the Commission for Environmental Impact Assessment in the studies of environmental effects of the Blankenburg connection.
Ik zal de commissie voor de m.e.r. niet betrekken bij de onderzoeken naar milieueffecten van de Blankenburgverbinding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het besluit van de minister om de snelheidsverhogingen op de A10 en A13 terug te draaien

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister why she reversed speed-limit increases on the A10 and A13, and whether this affected other roads, legal challenges, air quality recalculation and EU targets. The minister defended her principle of faster where possible, slower where necessary, said the decision had no consequences elsewhere, and declined to recalculate air quality outside the annual NSL monitoring.
Comparable specific situations, such as at the A13 Overschie and the A10 West, do not occur elsewhere along the main road network.
Vergelijkbare specifieke situaties, zoals bij de A13 Overschie en de A10 West doen zich verder langs het hoofdwegennet niet voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de invoering van de maximumsnelheid van 100 km/u op de A1/A35 nabij Borne en Hengelo

GroenLinks MP Van Tongeren asked the minister about rising accidents on the A1/A35 near Borne and Hengelo, the closely spaced junctions, residential exposure, fine dust and noise, and whether the speed limit should be cut to 100 km/h. Minister Schultz van Haegen answered that the road meets design and air and noise standards, that a lower speed would not ease congestion, and that she sees no reason to lower the limit, while promising a written reaction on the complaints portal before the June MIRT debate.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Tongeren over het ontgassen door de binnenvaart

MPs Van Gerven and Van Tongeren asked the state secretary about timing of an international ban on degassing by inland shipping, the legal room for a unilateral ban or municipal measures, risk zones around residential areas, the basis for calling emissions incidental, enforcement compliance, and RIVM emission estimates. The state secretary committed to pursuing a degassing ban via the CDNI treaty and to informing parliament, while stating that municipalities have little legal room and that a unilateral national ban is possible but less preferred.
I will inform the House, as I promised you at the General Consultation on 12 December 2013, when an (international) ban on degassing by inland vessels will take effect.
Ik zal de Kamer informeren, zoals ik u bij het Algemeen Overleg op 12 december 2013 toegezegd heb, wanneer een (internationaal) verbod op ontgassen door binnenvaartschepen van kracht zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de gevolgen van miscalculatie van de busvervoerder EBS

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about the consequences of bus operator EBS's miscalculation, including whether concession holders may change timetables mid-contract and what happens to drivers. The state secretary answered that the regional authority (Stadsregio Amsterdam) is responsible, that timetable changes within concession terms are permitted, and that staffing is outside national government's remit.
In this matter, responsibility therefore lies with the Amsterdam city region as concession grantor and with bus company EBS as concession holder.
In deze kwestie ligt de verantwoordelijkheid dan ook bij de stadsregio Amsterdam als concessie-verlener en bij het busbedrijf EBS als de concessiehouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de bescherming van rijksmonumenten in het aardbevingsgebied van Noord Oost Groningen

An MP asked ministers about damage to listed monuments in the Groningen earthquake zone and who enforces the ban on destroying protected monuments. The government said enforcement under the Monumentenwet lies with municipalities, while a provincial taskforce and a joint agreement with NAM aim to coordinate repair and prevention.
The current Article 11(1) of the Monumentenwet 1988 places enforcement with the lower government.
Het huidige artikel 11, eerste lid, van de Monumentenwet 1988 legt de handhaving bij de lagere overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Van Ojik over het onderbreken van een project voor jonge werkzoekenden bij de politie Assen

MPs Van Tongeren and Van Ojik asked why a Assen police project offering work experience to young jobseekers was halted and whether a national rollout would be pursued. The minister answers that the original training project ended this year, a national working group is examining options, and 5 to 10 placements will be set up at two police units with an ambition of 100.
Last January, in implementation of the Marcouch motion, I indicated that I would research national possibilities for the national police to offer work experience places to unemployed young people.

Afgelopen januari heb ik ter uitvoering van de motie Marcouch aangegeven onderzoek te gaan doen naar landelijke mogelijkheden voor de nationale politie om werkervaringsplaatsen aan te bieden aan werkloze jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over vrijkomende schadelijke stoffen bij het ontgassen van schepen in Rotterdam

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about degassing emissions from inland tankers in Rotterdam, including the gap between CE Delft and RIVM figures, health and air-quality effects, the definition of residential areas, and a MTBE ban. The state secretary acknowledged the CE report, said health effects cannot be determined, committed to pursuing a degassing ban via the CDNI treaty with a decision expected in June 2014, and did not give the MTBE quantity.
Moreover, I am working towards a ban on degassing by inland vessels by amending the convention on the collection, delivery and reception of waste in the Rhine and inland navigation (CDNI).
Overigens werk ik toe naar een verbod op het ontgassen door binnenvaartschepen door aanpassing van het verdrag inzake de verzameling, afgifte en inname van afval in de Rijn- en binnenvaart (CDNI).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van Tongeren over de richtlijn bekendmaking niet-financiële informatie

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government would oppose Lithuanian Council presidency compromise text narrowing non-financial reporting duties to risks material to the company itself and allowing firms to withhold information harmful to them. The minister answered that the government supports the directive in principle, will treat its BNC-fiche position as the starting point, and cannot discuss specific confidential compromise proposals.
Because of the confidentiality of the compromise proposals, I cannot go into specific proposals that may be made therein.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de compromisvoorstellen kan ik niet ingaan op specifieke voorstellen die daarin mogelijk worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de niet opgenomen telefoongesprekken met de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie in de strafzaak tegen de heer Van Rey

Green Left MP Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a 50-minute outage in the police wiretap system on 20 September 2012 caused unrecorded calls in the Van Rey criminal case, how often such failures occur, whether a risk analysis and backups exist, and why the public prosecutor was not informed. The Minister explains the outage was a power-supply fault in the storage component, that about 2,000 active taps were affected, that the audit and information-security measures are being reviewed, and that the prosecution was belatedly informed.

However, it was neglected to inform the users of the wiretap system and the Public Prosecution Service that a malfunction had occurred, and that as a result there was a chance that conversations had not been recorded.

Er is echter verzuimd om de gebruikers van het tapsysteem en het OM op de hoogte te stellen van het feit dat zich een storing had voorgedaan, en dat daardoor de kans aanwezig was dat gesprekken niet waren opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Dik-Faber, De Rouwe en Van Tongeren over het bericht dat NS stations overslaat bij vertraging

Four MPs asked the state secretary about reports that NS skips stations when trains are delayed, asking for figures, justification, passenger information, and whether the practice should be restricted. The state secretary said skipping is in principle unacceptable but may be a last-resort measure to prevent wider delays, provided passengers are informed; NS will report annually on the practice and no new restrictions or overload declaration are planned.

I have therefore agreed with NS that the company will provide me annually with an overview of figures, as NS has now compiled for the years 2010 through 2013, with an explanation of the routes where the measure is most often applied.

Ik heb daarom met NS de afspraak gemaakt dat het bedrijf mij jaarlijks een overzicht met cijfers levert zoals NS dat nu voor de jaren 2010 t/m 2013 heeft opgesteld en daarbij een toelichting geeft op de trajecten waar de maatregel het meest wordt getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over een rapport over overheidsinkomsten en –uitgaven betreffende gemotoriseerd wegverkeer

An MP asks the minister about a Ecorys report on public revenues and expenditures from motor road traffic, and about a letter from motoring organisations claiming revenues exceed spending. The minister confirms awareness, says the handbook on external infrastructure costs will be sent in Q1 2014, declines to pre-judge the unfinished report's conclusions, and states that budget rules separate revenues from expenditures.
It is foreseen that the 'Handbook external and infrastructure costs traffic' will be completed in the first quarter of 2014 and then sent to the House.
Voorzien is dat het «Handboek externe en infrastructuurkosten verkeer» het eerste kwartaal van 2014 wordt afgerond en dan ook aan de Kamer zal worden gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het vrijstellingsbesluit voor luchthaven Twente

An MP asked the state secretary why the development company ADT, rather than an airport operator, applied for an exemption decision for Twente airport, and about its obligations and oversight. The secretary said ADT is already de facto operator, that it will be bound by safety obligations and needs a safety certificate, and that the ILT (inspectorate) enforces compliance, while deferring the decision pending an appeal ruling.
The ILT is responsible for enforcing the obligations under the exemption decision.
De ILT is verantwoordelijk voor de handhaving van de verplichtingen uit het vrijstellingsbesluit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Klaver over de uitwerking van het verlaagde energiebelastingtarief voor decentrale duurzame elektriciteitsopwekking door coöperaties en V.v.E.’s zoals overeengekomen in het

GreenLeft MPs asked how the reduced energy tax rate for cooperatives and homeowners' associations generating renewable electricity would work, including metering, self-consumption, and whether business members may participate. The State Secretary answered that metering and netting are allowed under conditions, that business members are excluded for policy and state-aid reasons, and that the scope for business small users will be studied by summer 2014.
Entrepreneurs may not be members of the cooperative, because the scheme is intended for local renewable energy generation by cooperatives of, and for, private small consumers.

Ondernemers mogen geen lid zijn van de coöperatie, omdat de regeling is bedoeld voor de lokale duurzame energie opwekking van energie door coöperaties van – en ten behoeve van – particuliere kleinverbruikers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren met betrekking tot het bericht “Huurcontract bindt gemeente in dossier schaliegas”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a private contract between the municipality of Boxtel and a Cuadrilla subsidiary on shale gas, and about the liability of the municipality and the State for damages if permits are delayed or the contract is ended. The Minister replied that the State is not a party to the contract, that municipal liability depends on the circumstances, and that the State would be liable for damages only in limited cases such as a wrongful permit withdrawal, while offering a briefing on the mining permit procedures.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs is not a party to this agreement and therefore was not involved in its creation.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken is geen partij bij deze overeenkomst en dus ook niet betrokken geweest bij de totstandkoming ervan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren met betrekking tot het bericht “Next checkt: Na proefboring is winning amper tegen te houden”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the criteria for shale gas exploration and extraction licences, whether licences can be withdrawn, liability for damages, and the financial position of Brabant Resources. The minister answered that licences are assessed under the Mining Act, that withdrawal grounds concern market regulation and the applicant's technical and financial capacity rather than environmental effects, that no security was requested, and that the company's financial data are confidential.
Such data are commercially confidential and cannot be made public.
Dergelijke gegevens zijn bedrijfsvertrouwelijk en kunnen niet openbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Van Ojik over de dreigementen van de Russische kustwacht aan het adres van het Greenpeace-schip Artic Sunrise

MPs Van Tongeren and Van Ojik asked the government about Russian coast guard threats to fire on the Greenpeace ship Arctic Sunrise, the denial of access to the Kara Sea, and Russian oil exploration in the Arctic. The minister condemned the threats, invoked UNCLOS coastal-state rules on the Northern Sea Route, reported summoning the Russian ambassador, and referred to earlier policy on Arctic oil exploration.
On 27 August the Russian embassy was summoned to obtain clarification about the inspection of the Arctic Sunrise carried out by Russia.
Op 27 augustus jl. is de Russische ambassade ontboden teneinde opheldering te verkrijgen over de door Rusland uitgevoerde inspectie van de Artic Sunrise.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de uitkomst van de consultaties over de 15% THC-norm voor cannabis

MP Van Tongeren asked the ministers why the consultation results on the 15% THC norm for cannabis were not sent with the impact analysis, and asked what weight was given to the arguments. The minister replied that the consultation advice was internal, now sent to the Chamber as an annex with formal reactions (municipal advice summarized), and that the Garretsen recommendation prompted the impact analysis, while article 3b(2) Opiumwet is not directly linked.
Nevertheless I am happy to comply with your request to send these to your House afterwards, as an annex to these answers.
Ik voldoe evenwel graag aan uw verzoek om deze alsnog aan uw Kamer te verzenden, als bijlage bij deze antwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het nationaal programma radioactief afval

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how public participation on the national radioactive waste programme would be made fair, whether reversibility of final disposal is required, whether disposal should await solutions for long-term knowledge retention, and whether waste imports should be banned. The minister answered that participation channels will be equal and a participation trajectory will start, that reversibility is a Dutch national requirement, that new waste may be produced and final disposal is planned after at least 100 years of storage, that knowledge retention is handled by COVRA, and that a ban on imports will not be introduced.
Soon a public participation trajectory will start in which the public and various organisations will be informed and involved in the choices that must be made to arrive at final disposal.

Binnenkort zal er een publieksparticipatie traject starten waarin het publiek en verschillende organisaties geïnformeerd en betrokken worden bij de keuzes die voorliggen om tot een eindberging te komen.

Vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Tongeren (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie Nederland in gebre

MPs Voortman and Van Tongeren asked the minister and state secretary about the European Commission's infringement notice against the Netherlands for not implementing the energy performance of buildings directive, and what the government would do to meet the obligations and reduce voluntary measures. The government answered that it takes the notice seriously, is in consultation with the Commission and simplifying the energy label, and expects the EU targets to be met with the chosen mix of measures, with an evaluation planned for 2016.
I of course take this notice seriously.
Ik neem dit bericht uiteraard serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de rol van de Rijksoverheid bij het inpassen van windparken in de provincie Drenthe

An MP from GroenLinks asks why the national government should coordinate the siting of Drenthe wind farms over 100 MW, whether the provincial alternative will be assessed, and how the national government will keep control. The ministers answer that the national coordination scheme applies, the provincial variant will be assessed in the environmental report, and the national government retains decision-making on spatial siting after consulting the province and municipalities.
Decision-making regarding spatial integration is and remains reserved for the national government.
Besluitvorming met betrekking tot de ruimtelijke inpassing is en blijft voorbehouden aan het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht dat de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) niet zegt te gaan over de veiligheid van vervoersmiddelen zoals de Fyra

MP Van Tongeren asked whether the ILT should take a more active role in checking the safety of vehicles such as the Fyra, given that type approval does not guarantee safety, and whether the ILT has the capacity for this. State Secretary Mansveld answered that the ILT is legally obliged to grant type approval once the technical file and procedure are complete, that individual train quality is the responsibility of the client and producer, and that an audit of the approval process will report by 1 November 2013.
In my earlier letter I indicated that I am having an audit carried out of the licensing process.
In mijn eerdergenoemde brief heb ik aangegeven dat ik een audit laat uitvoeren op het proces van vergunningverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht dat een klokkenluider melding maakt van falende controle bij de bouw van de A4 Midden Delfland

An MP asked the minister whether a whistleblower's report of inadequate checks on the A4 Midden Delfland tunnel construction was accurate, and whether inspections were rushed and should be independent of government. The minister answered that structural safety is not in doubt, that municipal and Rijkswaterstaat checks are thorough, that government building-code oversight is a legal public task, and pointed to forthcoming private quality assurance proposals.
Experts from the municipality check the design against requirements and regulations as set out in the Building Decree.
Deskundigen van de gemeente toetsen het ontwerp op eisen en voorschriften zoals die zijn opgenomen in het Bouwbesluit.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de niet-nakoming van controles op de correcte uitvoering van de Wet Politiegegevens (ingezonden 25 juni 2013).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the police did not carry out the mandatory self-checks under the Police Data Act on time, and whether this undermines public trust and justifies widening police powers. The state secretary answered that the 2013 re-check was completed in April 2013 and published, the police is compliant with its reporting duties to the CBP, and the next external privacy audit is planned for late 2014, while declining to commit to more frequent audits pending an evaluation.
The CBP receives, in line with the legal framework, the results of the four-yearly external privacy audit and, on request, the results of the interim internal checks.
Het CPB ontvangt, conform de wettelijke kaders, de resultaten van de vierjaarlijke externe privacy- audit en, op verzoek, de resultaten van de tussentijdse interne controles.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de publiek-private aanbesteding van een nieuw te bouwen penitentiaire inrichting te Zaanstad

Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) asked whether the Rijksgebouwendienst will award the PPS prison project in Zaanstad to consortium Pi2, when the PPS trajectory started relative to the DJI Masterplan, what risks the state bears, and whether the award should be suspended pending consultation with parliament. Minister Plasterk answered that the award is planned for 22 July 2013, that the project followed existing ministerial policy and was reported in annual progress reports, that risks are allocated to the party best able to control them, and that suspending the award would cost about 30 million euro.
Do you think it would have been more logical to start such a trajectory only after consulting the House of Representatives?
Bent u van mening dat het meer voor de hand had gelegen om pas met een dergelijk traject te beginnen nadat met de Tweede Kamer was overlegd?

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de gebrekkige informatievoorziening na de brand bij chemiebedrijf ELD in Oo

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about deficient public information to residents after the fire at chemical company ELD in Oosterhout, including why the siren and NL-Alert were not used sooner. The minister acknowledged communication was insufficient, said local authorities bear responsibility, and listed national crisis communication improvements made since 2011.
Communication during incidents of this kind is a local responsibility.
Communicatie bij dit soort incidenten is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen Van Tongeren over de onregelmatigheden bij chloortransport door Amersfoort

An MP asked the state secretary about irregularities during chlorine rail transports through Amersfoort, including route deviations, unreported timetable deviations and alternative routing. The state secretary said the ILT recorded the irregularities, drew up official reports for criminal prosecution, found the Betuweroute alternative less safe, and declined a meeting with the German counterpart.
The results of the criminal investigation being conducted by the Public Prosecution Service, however, will not be made public.
De resultaten van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat bij het Openbaar Ministerie loopt, worden echter niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragenvan het lid Van Tongeren over de Haagse spionagekastjes

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about hidden camera and recording cabinets found in The Hague's Schilderswijk, who placed them, whether the city was informed, and whether other such cabinets exist. The Justice minister replied that police placed them with prosecutor approval for an observation in a property-crime investigation, the city was not informed as no legal duty exists, and no overall inventory is available.
No overall overview is available of the cabinets and/or recording equipment placed in that context.
Er is geen algeheel overzicht beschikbaar van de in dat kader geplaatste kasten en/of opnameapparatuur.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister-president en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat het Openbaar Ministerie gevallen van majesteitsschennis toch zal aanpakken (ingezonden

MP Van Tongeren asked the prime minister and the Justice minister whether prosecutors would act against lese-majeste insults during the 2013 inauguration, and how this squares with earlier statements that such prosecutions were not a priority. The minister's answer refers the MP to the joint answers already sent on 21 May 2013 on this and related questions, and sees no reason to change them.
I see no reason to change the answers to the above written questions.
Ik zie geen aanleiding de beantwoording van bovenstaande schriftelijke vragen te wijzigen.
Antwoord vragen Van Tongeren over het wegnemen van belemmeringen voor de bouw van een Russische olieterminal in de Rotterdamse haven

An MP asked the economics minister how he had actively helped remove obstacles for a Russian-linked oil terminal in Rotterdam port, what permits were involved, whether security risks existed, and how the operator was selected. The minister replied that the obstacles concerned WWII explosives surveys delaying a lease, that he made no promises on permits which follow regular procedures before the province and municipality, and that the port authority chose the operator through an open procedure in which he was not involved.
There is no question of commitments on my part regarding the permit procedures.
Van toezeggingen mijnerzijds aangaande de vergunningprocedures is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Paulus Jansen over een belastingaanslag over wateronttrekking ten behoeve van een installatie voor warmte-koudeopslag

MPs Van Tongeren and Paulus Jansen asked whether a heat-cold storage (WKO) installation that extracts and reinjects groundwater was liable for groundwater tax under the Wbm, and why nine-year-old residents in Etten-Leur received an assessment. The State Secretary answered that the exemption required a permit, closed-loop reinjection into the same aquifer, and compliance with permit conditions, that the tax was abolished from 1 January 2012, and that he had no indication the inspector misinterpreted the law, citing tax confidentiality for concrete cases.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation, I cannot provide information on concrete cases.
In verband met de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik over concrete gevallen geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over mogelijke marktverstoring door Keuringsinstituut Kiwa

An MP asked the economics minister whether the keuringsinstituut Kiwa's unfounded claims about declining solar panel yields and its planned quality register distort the market, and whether an independent solar quality mark is needed. The minister said he has no professional view on Kiwa's claims, that Kiwa is a commercial firm responsible for its own statements, and that government oversight of solar panel safety rests with the NVWA under the Warenwet, leaving a quality mark to the sector.
I have no professional opinion on this. Kiwa itself bears responsibility for its statements.
Ik heb hier geen professionele mening over. Kiwa draagt zelf verantwoordelijkheid voor zijn uitspraken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over problemen bij de aanleg van de A4 Midden-Delfland

An MP asked the minister whether problems with soft-soil piles discovered during construction of the A4 Midden-Delfland would breach agreed tunnelling and landscape-integration commitments, why the piles were only found now despite a 1979 report, and what extra costs follow. The state secretary answered that the solution stays within the approved route decision and agreements, that the piles were reported by the contractor in June 2012 and linked to a 1979 report, and that no cost estimate exists yet pending research.
Research is being carried out into the best solution. I therefore do not yet have an estimate of the costs.
Er wordt onderzoek verricht naar de beste oplossing. Ik heb daarom nog geen raming van de kosten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Tongeren over het weigeren van blindengeleidehonden door taxichauffeurs

MPs Voortman and Van Tongeren asked whether taxi drivers refusing guide dogs, shown on PowNews, is acceptable and what measures exist to guarantee taxi accessibility. The state secretary condemned refusals, said municipalities can impose accessibility and carriage duties under the Taxiwet, promised to urge municipalities to act, and said national legislation is not needed.
I will urge the municipalities to include this point in their local taxi regulations.
Ik zal bij de gemeenten aandringen dit punt in hun locale taxiregelgeving op te nemen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over de sterke daling van de CO2-prijs

Three MPs (Van Veldhoven, Jan Vos, Van Tongeren) asked the state secretary whether the sharp fall in the EU ETS carbon price after the ITRE vote was unexpected, whether confidence in the ETS is structurally at stake, and what the timetable is for backloading and structural reform. The secretary answered that the price drop was foreseeable given the emissions-rights surplus, that the ETS itself is not in question but needs strengthening, and gave a timetable (EP vote on backloading around 15 April, PBL follow-up study in April) and a count of member states' positions.
I recently informed you by letter about the input the government intends to provide
Ik heb u recentelijk bij brief geïnformeerd over de inbreng die de regering voornemens is te leveren
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren inzake de borging van kennis bij de Raad voor de leefomgeving en infrastructuur (Rli)

An MP asked the state secretary whether the knowledge and expertise of the dissolved Adviesraad Gevaarlijke Stoffen would be preserved within the new Rli advisory council, including why former AGS members were not reappointed. The government answered that former members were invited as associate members, a former project leader was hired, the Rli is independent and responsible for its own knowledge, and a former AGS member sits on a Rli committee on BRZO-company supervision.
The Rli is an independent advisory council and is therefore itself responsible for safeguarding the necessary knowledge and expertise.
De Rli is een onafhankelijke adviesraad en is dus zelf verantwoordelijk voor het borgen van de benodigde kennis en knowhow.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de verhouding tussen de gebiedsvisie van de provincie Drenthe en lopende grote windprojecten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how two large wind park projects under the national coordination scheme (RCR) relate to the Drenthe provincial wind area vision that omits them, and whether they will proceed after the national wind structure vision is adopted.
