The minister answered that the national scheme applies by law, that the projects will be tested against the national vision and an MER study including one provincial variant, and that certainty can only come at the decision stage.

Certainty about the continuation of the currently ongoing RCR projects can only be given at the moment of decision-making on the relevant zoning plans, based on the necessary MER study and the frameworks then established in the national wind structure vision.

Zekerheid over het doorgaan van de nu lopende RCR-projecten kan pas worden gegeven op het moment van besluitvorming omtrent de betreffende inpassingsplannen op basis van het daarvoor noodzakelijke (MER)-onderzoek en de dan vastgestelde kaders van de Rijksstructuurvisie wind op land.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Tongeren, Schouw en Krol over het bericht dat uitgeprocedeerde Somalische asielzoekers weer op straat zijn gezet

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary about reports that Somali asylum seekers whose applications were rejected were put back on the street after leaving a tent camp in Amsterdam, and whether this could have been avoided under the earlier motion and the Bestuursakkoord; they also asked how this squares with a Raad van State ruling on detention and how many Somalis had returned voluntarily. The state secretary answered that about 50 were sent away, that only a shelter conditional on cooperating with return was offered and not taken up, that conditional shelter remains policy, and that about 25 Somalis returned voluntarily since 2010, with forced return to all of Somalia now possible again.
I am willing to offer shelter to these foreigners, on condition that they cooperate with return.
Ik ben bereid om onderdak te bieden aan deze vreemdelingen, onder de voorwaarde dat wordt meegewerkt aan terugkeer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Schouw en Krol over het bericht dat uitgeprocedeerde Somalische asielzoekers weer op straat zijn gezet

MPs from SP, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks, D66 and 50PLUS asked whether most residents of the former Amsterdam tent camp were put on the street on 30 November, whether this is responsible in winter, and whether it could have been prevented under the Gesthuizen motion and the 2007 agreement with the VNG. The State Secretary answered that most were sent away after arrest, that the alternative shelter required cooperation with return, and that he sees no need for structural emergency shelter by municipalities.
It is true that the majority of the foreigners were sent away after their arrest.
Het klopt dat het merendeel van de vreemdelingen na hun aanhouding is heengezonden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van Tongeren over Eritrese praktijken

MPs Van Ojik and Van Tongeren asked about Eritrean consulate practices of taxing diaspora Dutch nationals with threats of withheld services, and whether international law and UN Security Council resolution 1907 were breached. The minister says extraterritorial taxation is not itself contrary to the Vienna Conventions, extortion is unacceptable and existing law suffices, that no further investigation of the arms embargo question is needed now, and that complaints depend on victims filing reports, with anonymity only conditionally possible.
Once a report has been filed, the police under the direction of the Public Prosecution Service will investigate it.
Zodra er aangifte is gedaan zal de politie onder leiding van het OM daar onderzoek naar doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de tegemoetkoming van adoptiekosten

An MP asked whether the state's adoption-cost tegemoetkoming (allowance), which runs from 2009 to 1 January 2013, would be continued after that date, and under what conditions, including income-dependence. The State Secretary answered that given the economic situation and budget cuts he does not consider it responsible to offer an alternative for the period after 1 January 2013.
Given the current economic situation and the associated budget-cut task, I do not consider it responsible to come up with an alternative for adoptive parents for the period after 1 January 2013.
Gezien de huidige economische situatie en de daarbij behorende bezuinigingsopdracht, vind ik het niet verantwoord om met een alternatief te komen voor adoptieouders voor de periode na 1 januari 2013.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘RWE wil vier olieproefboringen in Waddenzee

An MP asks whether the government will press German authorities against RWE's planned oil test drillings in the Wadden Sea and whether drilling should stop altogether there. The minister answers that the drillings fall within agreed Dutch-German-Danish rules under the Wadden Sea Plan 2010, that drilling is prohibited only in the World Heritage area, and that no further action toward RWE is planned.
No, because the test drillings in question fall within the agreements we jointly made during the World Heritage nomination process.
Nee, want de proefboringen waarover het hier gaat vallen binnen de afspraken die wij gezamenlijk hierover hebben gemaakt tijdens het werelderfgoednominatieproces.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over uitlatingen van de staatssecretaris over de dood van een verdachte van inbraak (ingezonden 27 september 2012).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether his public remarks about the death of a burglary suspect in Diessen judged the case and risked undermining judicial independence and possibly incited crime. The State Secretary refers to his earlier answers to MP Kooiman, says citizens should take preventive measures, and rejects the suggestion that citizens are left to fend for themselves.
I refer to the answer to question 2 from MP Kooiman.
Ik verwijs naar het antwoord op vraag 2 van het lid Kooiman
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het Haarlemse alternatief voor de wietpas

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he welcomes Haarlem's own alternative to the national cannabis pass for coffeeshops and whether it could replace the national rollout. The minister confirmed the report, praised Haarlem's attention to prevention, and described the Haarlem keurmerk as a bundling of existing national policy and instruments, without committing to examine a national roll-out.

The Haarlem keurmerk concerns a collection of existing policy (as it stood before 1 January 2012) from the ministries of Security and Justice and of Health, Welfare and Sport, and existing instruments.

Het keurmerk in Haarlem betreft een verzameling van bestaand beleid (zoals dat gold voor 1 januari 2012) van de ministeries van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en bestaande instrumenten
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren  over Odfjell: “Heeft u kennis kunnen nemen van het artikel ‘Onafhankelijkheid inspectie is bijna geheel verdwenen’?”

An MP asked the state secretaries whether the government would act on the Chemie-Pack and Odfjell cases, why enforcement in the chemical sector lagged, whether budget cuts were to blame, and whether an independent supervisor should be created. The state secretary admitted compliance problems, pointed to uniform enforcement strategy, legal safeguards and regional consolidation of inspections, and declined to pre-empt the Safety Board's ongoing investigation.
I do not want to anticipate the conclusions of that investigation.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de conclusies van dat onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren naar aanleiding van berichtgeving in de media over een lek in de Belgische kerncentrale Tihange 1

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about a long-running leak of radioactive water at the Belgian Tihange 1 reactor, the regulator's knowledge of it, and calls for closure, transparency, joint investigation and emergency zoning. The minister replied that the leak is in an inner wall of a spent-fuel pool without threat to people or environment, that Belgium is responsible for the reactor, that Dutch monitoring finds no anomalies, and that a Limburg protection zone and decentral iodine pill storage will be arranged.
Nuclear safety is primarily a national responsibility, and the information provided to me by the Belgian regulator gives me no indication that cross-border risks arise from the leak in Tihange 1.

Nucleaire veiligheid is primair een nationale verantwoordelijkheid en de aan mij door de Belgische toezichthouder geleverde informatie geeft mij geen indicatie dat er grensoverschrijdende risico´s aan de orde zouden zijn als gevolg van het lek in Tihange 1.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren naar aanleiding van berichtgeving in de media over de financiering van de onderzoeksreactor Pallas

An MP asked the minister about media reports on radioactive waste problems and leaking drums at the Petten reactor, and on the funding of its cleanup. The minister denied any leakage, stated that corroded packages were reported to parliament, outlined planned measures to remove the waste to COVRA, and declined further independent research, citing existing expert review and enhanced supervision.
I already asked the Nuclear Physics Service at the beginning of this year to carry out extra supervision of the activities at the Petten research location.
Ik heb de Kernfysische Dienst begin dit jaar al verzocht extra toezicht te houden op de activiteiten op de onderzoekslocatie Petten
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren naar aanleiding van berichtgeving in de media over een mogelijk defect in de kerncentrale Doel 3

The MP Van Tongeren asks the minister about reports that nuclear plant Doel 3 in Belgium was shut down over possible reactor vessel defects, including information exchange with Belgium and the safety of Borssele. The minister answers that Doel 3 is offline pending inspections, that Borssele poses no safety concern, and that nuclear safety in Belgium is a Belgian national responsibility, relying on the Belgian regulator FANC.
Nuclear safety is primarily a national responsibility.
Nucleaire veiligheid is primair een nationale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Dikkers en van Tongeren inzake het verpakkingenakkoord

Three MPs asked the state secretary whether the deadline for signing the packaging agreement with industry could be moved to 5 July, and what the legal basis was for refusing. The state secretary answered that the deadline cannot be moved, pointed to the Belastingplan 2012 requirement to report by 30 June, and said the agreement was already signed.
It is not possible to postpone the agreement to 5 July.
Het is niet mogelijk het akkoord te verschuiven naar 5 juli.
Antwoord vragen Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘Meer asbest Derde Merwedehaven dan gedacht’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of more asbestos at the Derde Merwedehaven waste dump, its health risks, the inspectorate's role and whether the province is acting. The state secretary said the province is the competent authority, that asbestos has been landfilled with low concentrations within permit limits, that quarterly asbestos measurements continue until closure, and that the provincial investigation was resumed.
Until the closure of the waste deposit on 31 December 2012, the province carries out an asbestos measurement every quarter.
De provincie voert tot aan de sluiting van de afvalberging op 31 december 2012 elk kwartaal een asbestmeting uit.
Antwoord vragen Van Tongeren over de kosten van een alternatief voor het ontpolderen van de Hedwigepolder

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Deltares alternative IIa for the Hedwige polder costs 300 million euro, whether it meets the ministry's criteria, how many hectares of nature restoration it yields, and whether spending that much on a few farmers is justified. The secretary answered that Deltares priced IIa at 270 million, that the cabinet decision of 17 June 2011 uses a maximum of 190 million, and referred to that letter for the details of the measures and hectares.
Antwoord vragen Van Tongeren over het gebruik van chemicaliën bij gaswinning in de omgeving van Wijk & Aalburg en Brakel

Green Left MP Van Tongeren asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the twelve chemicals used in 2008 fracking at Wijk en Aalburg and Brakel, their REACH registration, disclosure, SodM oversight and NPN's planned new drilling. The minister answered that SodM was informed via the work programme, that information on composition was released after a supplier reclassified it, that SodM monitors by risk without on-site inspection during fracking, and that a new chemical registry and an independent study are planned.
Antwoord vragen Van Tongeren over de verlichting op het hoofdwegennet

An MP asked the minister whether street lighting on the main road network would be switched off on parts of the network, what effects this has on road safety, the results of an LED lighting pilot on the A44, and the pace of LED rollout. The minister confirmed that lighting will be turned off between 23:00 and 05:00 on roads without demanding traffic conditions, that a study found no demonstrable negative safety effect, and gave the LED pilot results as forthcoming while describing LED rollout as tied to replacement cycles.
On roads without demanding traffic conditions, the lighting will be switched off between 23:00 and 05:00 from the summer onward.
Op wegen zonder rijtaakverzwarende omstandigheden wordt de verlichting vanaf de zomer uitgezet tussen 23.00 en 05.00 uur.
Antwoord vragen Van Tongeren over de uitvoering van afspraken uit het Scheldeverdrag

Rep. Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether he had received a letter from Flemish minister-president Peeters on implementing the Scheldt Treaty and asked him to send it to the House immediately. The state secretary confirmed receipt and said the letter was sent to the House on 20 January 2012.
Yes. I sent the letter from minister-president Peeters to your House on 20 January 2012.
Ja. De brief van minister-president Peeters heb ik op 20 januari 2012 aan uw Kamer gezonden.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouten (ChristenUnie), Ferrier (CDA), Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Dijkhoff (VVD), Van der Staaij (SGP), Dikkers (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP) en Hachchi (D66)

Ten MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about child labour in Turkish hazelnut harvesting one year after it was first reported, including whether enforcement is adequate, whether companies are meeting their responsibilities, and the status of various studies and working groups. The government answered that the problem lies mainly with Turkey, that the embassy raised it with Turkish authorities and funds a study, that industry bodies have adopted guidelines and a Turkish action plan exists, but that it could not confirm concrete results of the Turkish working group and could not answer in time for the scheduled debate.
The cabinet will continue to raise this issue within the EU framework, including in the Council conclusions.
Het kabinet zal hier in EU-kader aandacht voor blijven vragen, ook in de Raadsconclusies.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Provincie wil rijkssteun voor tweede kerncentrale Borssele» (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

An MP asks the Economic Affairs minister whether state money will be put into a possible second nuclear plant at Borssele, given a provincial lobbying push, and about the planned split of Delta and Evides. The minister repeats that no public money will improve the business case for a nuclear plant, that financing is the initiators' responsibility, and that Evides dividends go fully to shareholders, while the Delta-Evides split is planned by end 2013.
As I have frequently stated, I will not deploy public money to improve the business case of a nuclear power plant.
Zoals ik inmiddels veelvuldig heb aangegeven, zal ik geen publiek geld inzetten om de business case van een kerncentrale te verbeteren
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het onderhouden van de verdiepte vaargeul in de Westerschelde (ingezonden 28 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether dredging permits for the Westerschelde channel must be renewed periodically, whether lack of nature compensation could lead to annulment, and whether Flanders could claim hundreds of millions if Dutch actions prevented maintenance. The state secretary confirmed permits are needed, said current permits expire in 2015 and no compensation is required, and said no Flemish pre-announcement of a dispute procedure has been made.
The Flemish Region has not given any advance notice of starting a dispute settlement procedure.
Door het Vlaams Gewest is geen vooraankondiging gedaan van de start van een geschillenbeslechtingsprocedure.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economie, Landbouw en Innovatie over het artikel «Delta twijfelt over Borssele 2» (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether investment in a second nuclear plant is viable, whether public money will be used, what talks have been held with Delta and others, and whether correspondence will be shared. The minister answers that investment is a market matter, no public money will be used to improve the business case, no talks on specific financing were held, and correspondence is not shared as it falls outside the usual permitting procedure.
However, I have held talks at a higher level of abstraction about the progress of the talks between DELTA, RWE and EdF.
Wel heb ik op een hoger abstractieniveau gesprekken gevoerd over de voortgang omtrent de gesprekken tussen DELTA, RWE en EdF.

Vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, El Fassed en Peters (allen GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Shell oil paid Nigerian military to put d

MPs from GroenLinks asked whether Shell paid the Nigerian military to suppress protests, and whether the government would press for independent investigation of human rights abuses and require Shell to clean up and compensate in Ogoniland. The ministers answered that the events concern the 1990s, that the UNEP report calls for joint action by all parties, that the Nigerian government must decide on independent inquiry, and that Shell's subsidiary SPDC has engaged on remediation without committing to a specific government-led action.
It is up to the Nigerian government to decide whether independent research should be carried out in addition to the UNEP report.
Het is aan de Nigeriaanse overheid om te bepalen of er in aanvulling op het UNEP-rapport onafhankelijk onderzoek moet komen.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over schaliegas (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

Green Left MP Van Tongeren asked the minister about chemicals for fracking shale gas by Cuadrilla, DSM and Queensland Gas Company, REACH registration, and whether a moratorium should be imposed. The minister answered that drilling programmes are not yet submitted, that REACH compliance will be checked before drilling, and that a moratorium is unnecessary because an enforceable ban on non-authorised chemicals already exists.
Announcing a moratorium is therefore not an issue at this time.
Het afkondigen van een moratorium is nu dan ook niet aan de orde.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Van Veldhoven (D66), Leegte (VVD), Van Tongeren (GL), Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (CU), Van der Werf (CDA), Van Vliet (PVV), Samsom (PvdA) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecret

Nine MPs asked why the Hagestein hydropower plant has been out of use since 2005, why a renovation plan and a private 20-year concession offer were not acted upon, and what the government's view is on the case. The state secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat is still studying technical, legal and environmental requirements and will decide in 2012 whether to tender, integrate or shut down the plant, and will inform stakeholders in coming months.
RWS will take the initiative to inform the interested companies and governments about the state of affairs in a few months' time.
RWS zal het initiatief nemen om de belanghebbende bedrijven en overheden over enkele maanden in te lichten over de stand van zaken

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Verhagen ziet vergunning kolencentrale alsnog komen» (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether he had studied the Council of State ruling annulling the Eemshaven coal plant permit before saying the plant could proceed, and urged alternatives such as biomass and a rethink of energy policy. The minister replied that the provincial authority decides, that he only expressed confidence that new studies would not block a new permit, that energy policy stays unchanged, and that a meeting with the initiators is not appropriate.
Decisions on whether construction of the coal plant may proceed are taken by the competent authority, in this case the province.
Besluiten over de doorgang van de bouw van kolencentrale zijn genomen door het bevoegd gezag, in dit geval de provincie.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over olie- en gaslekkages (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of frequent oil and gas leaks in the North Sea, whether leaks should be penalised with platform closure after three incidents, whether Shell is responsible for most leaks, and whether all leak information will be made public. The minister answered that leaks are already reported and sanctioned under existing law, that closing platforms after three leaks is not appropriate, that Shell's share is not known and NAM is not treated differently, and that the statistics are already public via the SodM annual report.
For the Dutch part of the North Sea, oil and gas leaks must always be reported to SodM.
Voor het Nederlandse deel van de Noordzee geldt dat olie- en gaslekkages altijd behoren te worden gemeld aan SodM
Vragen van de leden Van Gent en van Tongeren (beiden GroenLinks) aan staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de Europese aanpak om fijnstof terug te dringen (ingezonden 6 juli 2011).

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about the EU approach to fine particulate matter, including whether the Netherlands will meet the 2015 PM2.5 limits, whether standards should target health risks or ultrafine particles, and whether diesel soot filters capture the finest particles. The government answered that PM2.5 compliance is very likely, that new standards are not yet justified and an EU review is pending, and that current filters capture over 95% of fine particles.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het WANO-veiligheidsonderzoek in de kerncentrale van Borssele (Ingezonden 27 juli 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether the Borssele nuclear plant should be closed until safety is fully secured given 15 safety improvement points from a WANO self-assessment, and whether a terrorism or cyberattack scenario is being studied. The minister refused closure, stating the plant meets its licence requirements, and said EU ad hoc working group reports on security would be sent to parliament, though plant-specific security details are confidential.
At European level it was agreed that the interim and final reports will not address the specific security of individual nuclear plants, because it concerns confidential data.
In Europees verband is afgesproken dat de tussen- en eindrapportage niet zullen ingaan op de specifieke beveiliging van individuele kerncentrales, omdat het vertrouwelijke gegevens betreft.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de status van het besluit over het ontwikkelen van een alternatief voor de ontpoldering van de Hedwigepo

An MP asked the state secretary whether the 2009 cabinet decision to depolder the Hedwigepolder had lapsed and what legal status the June 2011 alternative nature-compensation decision has. The state secretary answered that the 2009 decision has lapsed, the new approach is a factual communication rather than a legally binding decision, and no formal publication in the Staatscourant is required.
The cabinet decision of 17 June as such is not an act aimed at legal effects and therefore not a decision within the meaning of the General Administrative Law Act.
Het kabinetsbesluit van 17 juni jl. als zodanig is geen op rechtsgevolg gerichte handeling en daarom geen besluit in de zin van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over inkoop van duurzaam hout (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary about a Milieudefensie report finding that 70% of audited central-government projects contained wood not meeting the government's sustainable timber criteria, and about the government's failure to meet its own procurement standards. The State Secretary acknowledges shortcomings in contract compliance and supply-chain verification, commits to exploring improvements with Milieudefensie and market parties, but rejects the advice to require FSC specifically.
Although the 100% target has not yet been reached, I conclude from this that the sustainable timber procurement criteria are widely applied in central-government projects.
Hoewel de 100% nog niet gehaald wordt, concludeer ik hieruit dat de inkoopcriteria voor duurzaam hout breed worden toegepast in rijksprojecten.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het evaluatierapport van de Veiligheidsregio Rotterdam-Rijnmond (VRR) over

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister and the Infrastructure and Environment state secretary about the Rotterdam-Rijnmond safety region's evaluation of the Moerdijk fire, covering LOCC/NCC coordination, a chemical incident registry, crisis information systems, communication with other regions, and drinking-water utilities. The minister answered that the questions will be addressed in forthcoming Inspectorate and Safety Board reports and a later government response, without substantive conclusions.

How these actions proceeded and whether they were adequate will be addressed in the reports of the Inspectorate for Public Order and Safety and the Dutch Safety Board on the fire at Chemie Pack Moerdijk.

Hoe deze zijn verlopen en of deze acties toereikend zijn geweest zal aan de orde komen in de rapporten van de Inspectie Openbare Orde en Veiligheid (IOOV) en de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OvV) over de brand bij Chemie Pack Moerdijk.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Gesthuizen (SP) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en In

MPs from six parties asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about child labour and underpaid adult labour in Dutch cocoa and hazelnut supply chains, including whether hazelnut processors acting through the FNLI and the IDH business network can be held responsible. The government answered that industry bodies are meeting their supply-chain responsibility within the limits of reasonable expectation, describes FNLI and IDH activities, and says the SZW dialogue with Turkey has not yet taken place.
Our answer of 15 December 2010 stated that companies must simply do what can reasonably be expected of them to combat child labour in their chain.
In ons antwoord van 15 december 2010 is aangegeven dat bedrijven zonder meer dienen te doen wat redelijkerwijs van hen mag worden verwacht om kinderarbeid in hun keten te bestrijden.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Jaarlijkse splijtstofwisselperiode kerncentrale EPZ» (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether the Borssele nuclear plant's annual refuelling outage should be combined with an extensive safety review, whether it should stay closed until independent safety checks are done, and whether an independent expert commission should be set up. The minister refuses these requests, saying the plant meets current safety standards and that the planned EU-linked stress test will suffice.
The starting point is that the Borssele nuclear plant is safe, because it currently meets all existing high safety requirements.
Het uitgangspunt is dat de kerncentrale in Borssele veilig is, omdat deze op dit moment voldoet aan alle nu geldende, hoge veiligheidseisen.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de bypass bij Kampen (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary to guarantee 117 million euros for the second phase of the Kampen bypass, the cost of a river crossing at Roggebot, and why the project should not be delayed given Rijkswaterstaat's view that it is not urgent for water safety. The state secretary confirms the funding commitment, gives a cost estimate of 19.9 million euros, says a decision on the bypass will follow around summer, and notes the province's role as initiator.
I am awaiting the province's plan and will take a decision on the bypass around the summer.
Ik wacht het plan van de provincie af en zal rond de zomer een beslissing nemen over de bypass.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de terugkeer van de chloortrein (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

An MP asked the minister why chlorine trains will run via the Oldenzaal-Amersfoort route instead of the Betuwe line, and whether route restrictions can be imposed for safety reasons. The state secretary confirmed incidental chlorine transports for maintenance at Akzo Nobel, said the route was chosen under the existing chlorine regime, and stated that the planned Basisnet law will allow a ban on chlorine on main lines except for the incidental transports covered by the convenant.
To respect the agreements with Akzo Nobel in the convenant, this power does not apply to the incidental chlorine transports.
Om de afspraken met Akzo Nobel uit het convenant te eerbiedigen, geldt deze bevoegdheid niet voor de incidentele chloortransporten.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de afwikkeling van de brand in Moerdijk (ingezonden 26 januari 2011).

An MP asked the health minister why measurement results for the 10 km zone around the Moerdijk chemical fire were still unclear more than two weeks later, when they would be released, how organic farmers would know when they can resume, whether rules on livestock, crops and irrigation would follow, and why the emergency fund had not been set up. The minister answered that results became available after three weeks due to scientifically sound measurement, that no additional rules were considered necessary, and that the emergency fund had not been established, referring to separate letters on compensation.
I see no reason to set additional rules.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om aanvullende regels te stellen.

Vragen van de leden Slob (ChristenUnie), Dijksma (PvdA), Bashir (SP), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Verhoeven (D66) en Thieme (PVDD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de voortgang van de werkzaamheden Landtu

Six MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the schedule, budget and legal challenges for the A2 Leidsche Rijn tunnel and the temporary bypass. The minister answered that the schedule and budget are unchanged, the court rejected residents' challenge on 11 February 2011, and the bypass will open by 1 April 2011.
On Friday 11 February 2011 the court ruled. The appeal was declared unfounded and the request for an interim injunction was also rejected.
Op vrijdag 11 februari 2011 heeft de Rechtbank uitspraak gedaan. Het beroep is ongegrond verklaard en ook het verzoek voor een voorlopige voorziening is afgewezen.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het gebruik van Colombiaanse kolen (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the minister whether Dutch energy firms buying coal from Drummond, which faces union-related murder allegations and a US lawsuit, should stop, and whether subsidies, tax breaks and import rules should change. The state secretary answers that firms bear responsibility under CSR and OECD guidelines, refuses to end generic subsidies or tax breaks, and points to an industry dialogue on sustainable coal rather than unilateral import restrictions.
As far as is known, other potentially relevant companies, for reasons of commercial sensitivity, in principle wish to treat information on the origin of purchased coal as confidential.

Voor zover bekend wensen de overige mogelijk relevante bedrijven, uit oogpunt van commerciële gevoeligheid, informatie over de herkomst van ingekochte steenkolen in beginsel als vertrouwelijk te beschouwen.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de vondst van explosieven bij de milieudienst in Dordrecht (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

Green Left MP Van Tongeren asked the Justice minister about explosives found at the Dordrecht environmental service and whether threats came from landlords, whether similar threats occur, whether the municipality requested help, whether enforcement capacity is affected, and which preventive measures apply. The minister declined to give details of the ongoing police investigation, said such severe threats are rare, noted that the municipality requested no help, said no enforcement shortage arose, and pointed to responsibility of employers and local authorities plus the national VPT programme.
In the interest of the investigation, no further statements can be made about this.
In het belang van het onderzoek kunnen hierover verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.

Vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en El Fassed (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een Ivoriaanse exportban op cacao (ingezonden 27 januari 2011

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers whether the government supports President Ouattara's call for a cocoa export ban in Ivory Coast to cut off funds to Gbagbo's regime, and how the Netherlands and Amsterdam port would be involved. The minister answered that the Netherlands respects Ouattara's choice, supports EU sanctions aimed at Gbagbo's funds while sparing the population, and will consider effects on the cocoa trade and Amsterdam port.
The Netherlands has recently supported various sanctions measures within the EU aimed at blocking the money flows of Mr Gbagbo and his supporters.
Nederland heeft recent in EU-verband diverse sanctiemaatregelen ondersteund die gericht zijn op het blokkeren van de geldstromen van de heer Gbagbo en zijn aanhangers.

Vragen van de leden Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) en Van Dijk (SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat de Verenigde Staten (VS) niet bereid waren Nederland te helpen bij het bep

MPs asked whether the US refused to help the Netherlands reduce noise from AWACS aircraft at Geilenkirchen, whether the government misled parliament about engine replacement given US reluctance, why the minister of Environment lobbied for a flight simulator while Defence doubted it, and whether the NAPMO board was informed of a parliamentary motion. The minister declined to comment on alleged US internal assessments, but described the engine-replacement study, the simulator investment and the notification of the NAPMO board about the motion.
As set out in today's letter from the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, the cabinet cannot be expected to answer questions on the accuracy of the alleged American intelligence reports.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een uitspraak van de Nationale Ombudsman over de afhandeling van bezwaren tegen Maastricht Aachen Airport (ingezonden 15 dece

Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) asked why the minister has waited nearly three years to issue a new decision on objections to the Maastricht Aachen Airport designation after the Council of State annulled it, and how this fits with the government's push for faster procedures. The state secretary admits delays, explains that the full reassessment was needed and promises updated studies in January 2011 and a decision in summer 2011, while defending the shift to earlier participation and a possible faster route via the Crisis- en herstelwet.
The National Ombudsman rightly signals that the requirement of timeliness is at stake here.
De Nationale Ombudsman signaleert terecht dat hiermee het vereiste van voortvarendheid in het geding is.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het Provinciaal Inpassingsplan Buitenring Parkstad Limburg (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether the province of Limburg addressed the VROM-inspectie's objections to the Buitenring Parkstad road plan, whether doubts about its contribution to regional restructuring were resolved, and whether objections on ecological and landscape impacts were resolved. The minister answered that the province partly upheld and partly rejected the objections, adjusted the justification, accepted that not all restructuring measures can be included, and attached no consequences, leaving the matter to the provinces.
In light of the cabinet's aim to place more responsibility for the spatial domain with the provinces, I attach no further consequences to the rebuttal of the objection.

Mede in het licht van het kabinetstreven de verantwoordelijkheid voor wat betreft het domein ruimte meer bij de provincies te leggen verbind ik verder geen consequenties aan de weerlegging van de zienswijze.

Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP), Neppérus (VVD), Veldhoven-van der Meer (D66), Ouwehand (PvdD) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de st

MPs from several parties asked whether asbestos, pesticides and herbicides from the Stichting Machinale Landbouw have polluted the Wageningen area in Suriname, whether Dutch responsibility and cancer mortality are involved, and whether Dutch assistance is available. The minister answered that no recent research exists, that Suriname's authorities are investigating and planning awareness activities, and that the Netherlands will consider assistance if Suriname requests it.

Due to the lack of research data, the Surinamese authorities cannot determine the extent to which the operations of Stichting Machinale Landbouw have affected negative developments in the living environment of Wageningen and surroundings.

Vanwege het ontbreken van onderzoeksdata is door de Surinaamse autoriteiten niet vast te stellen in hoeverre de bedrijfsvoering van Stichting Machinale Landbouw van invloed is op negatieve ontwikkelingen in de leefomgeving van Wageningen en omstreken.
Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP) en Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het blenden van stookolie (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

MPs Jansen and Van Tongeren asked the minister whether ships are still mixing hazardous chemical waste into bunker fuel, what law applies, what penalties exist, how reporting duties and enforcement are arranged, and what priority enforcement has been given since the 2008 North Refinery case. The state secretary confirmed the reported practice is suspected but its scale is unknown (research planned for 2011), described the existing legal framework, penalties, reporting duties and inspection capacity (about 1.75 FTE), and declined to say more about the North Refinery criminal investigation while it is ongoing.
Hiernaar zal in 2011 onderzoek worden gedaan.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het rapport «Definitieve berging van hoogradioactief en/of langlevend kernaf

I will not ask NIRAS to respond because NIRAS has already indicated that the main elements of Mr Weyns' arguments have been incorporated into the current research.
Ik zal NIRAS niet verzoeken om een reactie te geven omdat NIRAS al heeft aangegeven dat de belangrijkste elementen van de argumenten van de heer Weyns meegenomen zijn in het huidige onderzoek
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de milieuvergunning voor Sinterfabriek van Thermphos (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

The state secretary answered that the NeR norm is not immediately achievable, that RIVM studies show no unacceptable health effects, that the province justified the deviation, and that no reason exists to intervene at present.
There is no acute danger to health. Considering all this, I currently see no reason to intervene.
Er is geen acuut gevaar voor de gezondheid. Dit alles overwegende zie ik vooralsnog geen reden om in te grijpen.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de plannen van gemeenten en provincies om een tweede kerncentrale in B

The minister replies that the market decides, that the company must comply with EU competition and state aid rules, that the government supports nuclear for security of supply and CO2 reduction, that no public support is contemplated, and that geological disposal remains the long-term solution.

Het is aan de initiatiefnemer om te bezien hoe zij hun middelen willen inzetten.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren aan de minister van Defensie over weekendvluchten op vliegveld Eindhoven (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

Van Tongeren asks why the minister dropped the weekend flight limit at Eindhoven Airport, whether it is realistic that airlines would relocate, on what criteria economic interests outweighed residents' interests, and what weight is given to earlier agreements with stakeholders. The minister answers that the one-third weekend rule was not restored in the 2010-2011 permit after objections were weighed, that airlines would likely move flights elsewhere if it returned, that complaints have fallen and the airport is taking noise measures, and that the earlier regional agreements do not bind the state.
After weighing economic and transport interests and the interests of the surroundings, it was decided not to add a one-third rule to the civil-use permit for 2010 and 2011.

Na afweging van de economische en vervoersbelangen en de belangen van de omgeving is besloten niet alsnog een eenderderegeling toe te voegen aan de beschikking burgermedegebruik voor de jaren 2010 en 2011.

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the environment minister flew home from Italy by private jet at taxpayers' expense, whether ministers often do this, and whether such flights are defensible in times of ecological and economic crisis. The minister confirmed a government flight to Rotterdam, cited the entitlement rules for transport and accompaniment, said the return was by scheduled flight and that all business travel is now fully carbon-compensated.

Op dinsdag 17 augustus ben ik met een regeringsvlucht van Perugia naar Rotterdam gevlogen.

An MP asks the ministers about shale and coal-seam gas exploration: how many permits exist, the role of EBN, chemical risks to groundwater, US incidents, landscape impact, public opposition and CO2 emissions. The ministers answer that four exploration permits were granted, that chemicals are regulated under REACH and Arbo law with SodM oversight, and that Dutch impacts and energy use cannot be assessed until drilling occurs.

De samenstelling van de chemicaliën is vaak bedrijfsgeheim, omdat deze mede het succes en de effectiviteit van het «kraken» bepaalt.

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports that energy policy was being revised, including whether the 2020 CO2 target had been lowered, renewable energy obligations for utilities, nuclear waste, and nuclear energy's role. The minister denied changing the CO2 target, said the cheapest renewable options should be subsidised or obliged, defended keeping nuclear energy open, and left the decision on new nuclear plants to the next cabinet.
It is up to the next cabinet to decide whether or not to allow new nuclear power plants, including the conditions under which this policy should be implemented.
Het is aan het volgende kabinet om wel of geen nieuwe kerncentrales toe te staan, inclusief de condities waaronder dit beleid zou moeten worden geëffectueerd.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het rapport «Beleidsgericht onderzoeksprogramma fijn stof» (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd om na te gaan (a) hoe op basis van de nieuwe inzichten de methodiek om de hoogte van de zeezoutaftrek vast te stellen, zou kunnen worden aangepast
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over zwemmen in rivieren (ingezonden 30 juli 2010).

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ‘een integrale audit van ideologisch gedreven overheidsuitgaven en mogelijke systeemfraude in de overheidsadministratie’ aan

An FvD MP asked for a full audit of ideologically motivated government spending, including subsidies to organisations that have sued the state, checks on ghost employees and unused payment cards, and a DOGE-style taskforce. The government declined to create a list of litigating organisations or a taskforce, citing existing audit bodies (ADR, Algemene Rekenkamer) and disproportionate cost, while providing partial data on payroll ages and payment cards.
The Internal Audit Service of the State (ADR) and the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) are both independent auditors that oversee lawful and efficient use of public funds.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Nederlandse zakenmannen verkopen voor tientallen miljarden aan Israëlische wapenindustrie’

MP Van Baarle asked ministers about reports that Dutch businessmen supply electronic components via SASMOS to Israeli arms firms, raising prosecution, export control, and complicity questions. The government mostly declined to comment on individual companies, stated that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, and reaffirmed Dutch export control and the 2025 measures on Israel.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether conduct that may be criminal and over which the Netherlands has jurisdiction is involved.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of sprake is van gedragingen die mogelijk strafbaar handelen opleveren en waarover Nederland rechtsmacht heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Hirsch over het bericht van SOMO over Israëlische wapenindustrie

MPs Piri and Hirsch asked whether the government will act on SOMO reporting that Dutch businessmen direct SASMOS, which exported arms components to Israel, and on Israel-related genocide and international-law obligations. The minister answered that the government does not comment on individual companies, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, and described existing export restrictions and a broader policy of discouraging trade with settlements.
In principle, the cabinet does not make public statements about individual companies or persons.
Het kabinet doet in beginsel geen publieke uitspraken over individuele bedrijven of personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over wapenexportvergunningen voor het Israëlische Iron Dome-systeem

An MP asked the ministers about the minister's remark on two export licences for parts of Israel's Iron Dome system and what exports were involved. The government answered that two licences (January 2024 and March 2025) covered radar components made in Canada, transited via the Netherlands to Germany, and were not exported directly to Israel.
These are goods that were not produced in the Netherlands but in Canada.
Het gaat hier om goederen die niet in Nederland, maar in Canada zijn geproduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Piri, Teunissen, Van Baarle, Paternotte en Dassen over het Nederlandse busbedrijf EBS en banden met de illegale bezetting van de Palestijnse Gebieden

MPs asked the government about Dutch bus operator EBS, owned by Israel's Egged Transportation, which the UN lists in connection with settlements, and whether Dutch public money paid through student travel products and provincial concessions amounts to assistance to the occupation. The government confirmed the facts, restated its discouragement policy on economic ties with settlement businesses, said it has no insight into the financial flows between EBS and Egged, and declined to take concrete steps beyond encouraging decentralised authorities to follow the policy.
The cabinet has no insight into the business relationship and financial flows between EBS and Egged Transportation Ltd. and therefore cannot make statements about them.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de zakelijke verhouding en financiële stromen tussen EBS en Egged Transportation Ltd. en kan hier dus geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Piri over de nieuwe regels en controles op (wapen)export naar Israël

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked why the government only now amended general export licences for Israel, what changed in the security situation, which goods were exported under those licences, and whether individual licences remain. The minister answered that the ceasefire breakdown and Israeli operations in Gaza drove the changes, that Israel is now excluded so all transactions require prior individual review, and that seven individual military licences remain valid while the cassation appeal against the F-35 parts ruling continues.
With this change, all individual transactions of strategic goods to Israel are checked before export and transit.
Met deze wijziging worden alle individuele transacties van strategische goederen naar Israël voorafgaand aan uitvoer en doorvoer getoetst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Dobbe, Hirsch, Bamenga en Paternotte over het bericht 'Pentagon chief scraps program from first Trump term to boost women in security'

MPs asked the Dutch government whether it would press the United States and other partners to uphold UN Women, Peace and Security resolutions and related treaties after the US scrapped its own WPS programme, and what Netherlands itself will do to fund and implement them. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands raises these principles bilaterally and multilaterally, noted the US has not ratified CEDAW or the Arms Trade Treaty, and listed existing commitments including a small Syria grant and Defence gender-integration activities without committing to new funding.
The Netherlands speaks out in favour of implementing and complying with international agreements and treaties, both publicly and behind closed doors.
Nederland spreekt zich voor en achter gesloten deuren uit over het belang van implementatie en naleving van internationale afspraken en verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht “Nationale Ombudsman haalt bakzeil: Ed Nijpels en SER wél eerlijk over windenergie”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a report that the National Ombudsman revised his finding on SER and Ed Nijpels' statements on wind energy, and whether the Ombudsman had come under pressure and should resign. The minister answered that the matter is for the Ombudsman, that the revision followed a legitimate review request and new information about how the factcheck was prepared, and that there is no reason for the Ombudsman to resign.
I regard this as a matter for the National Ombudsman.
Ik beschouw dit als een zaak van de Nationale ombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Tony van Dijck over de te hoge buffers van zorgverzekeraars

Two PVV MPs asked the Finance and Health ministers about health insurers' excessive capital buffers, the EU Solvency II rules, insolvency risk and consequences for insured persons, and whether premium money is effectively being stolen. The ministers replied that Solvency II already accounts for the Dutch system, that the insolvency probability is about 0.5% per year, that insured persons are protected under Article 31 Zvw, and that insurers may choose their own safety margins, with excess solvency returned via lower premiums.
Should a health insurer go bankrupt, insured persons will look for a new health insurer and take out new health insurance.
Mocht een zorgverzekeraar failliet gaan, dan zullen verzekerden een nieuwe zorgverzekeraar zoeken en een nieuwe zorgverzekering afsluiten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat de Nationale Ombudsman Ed Nijpels en de Sociaal-Economische Raad (SER) op de vingers tikt, omdat zij onvolledige en eenzijdige informatie geven over windenergie

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how he views the National Ombudsman's finding that Ed Nijpels and the SER gave one-sided information on wind energy, and whether he would reprimand or dismiss Nijpels for repeatedly misleading citizens. The minister agreed that government information must be objective and correct, deferred to the Ombudsman as the SER has filed a review request, and rejected the claim of systematic misinformation, so he sees no reason to act.
I do not share the view that there would be systematic provision of incorrect information by the chair of the Borgingscommissie.
Ik deel de opvatting niet dat er sprake zou zijn van stelselmatige verstrekking van verkeerde informatie door de voorzitter van de Borgingscommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de Zembla uitzending 'Gevaarlijk spel'

The MP Klever asks the ministers why the government reversed its position on banning rubber granulate in artificial turf, whether the RIVM study was adequate, and whether children with leukaemia used such pitches. The minister replies that the government followed the Commission's classification of granulate as a mixture, that no unacceptable health risk has been identified, that RIVM research and an ECHA report are pending, and that no ban is planned.
I have asked the RIVM to determine the presence of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and other substances in granulate.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd de aanwezigheid van polycyclische aromatische koolwaterstoffen (pak's) en andere stoffen in granulaat te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de patiëntenstop bij Ziekenhuis Nij Smellinghe

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether a patient admission stop at Nij Smellinghe hospital should end immediately, whether the IGZ was notified and whether patients were endangered, and what solutions exist for hospital budget problems. The minister answered that no general admission stop existed, that the hospital did not notify the IGZ (no legal duty), that the IGZ sees no quality risks, and that hospital and insurers bear responsibility for contracting while the minister committed only to reaffirming existing agreements.
There is also no legal obligation to inform the inspectorate in advance of such measures.
Er geldt ook geen wettelijke verplichting om de inspectie vooraf te informeren over dergelijke maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat patiënten in de rij staan bij het ziekenhuis Medisch Spectrum Twente

An MP asked the health minister how she would respond to reports of patients queuing at Medisch Spectrum Twente after a dispute between the hospital and insurer VGZ, and what she would do to get them treated quickly, and whether she would hold the hospital and insurer to their duty of care and what sanctions were available. The minister said such disputes should not be fought out over patients, pointed to insurer and hospital responsibilities, and said the independent market regulator NZa is examining whether the insurer meets its duty of care and can use enforcement measures if needed.
The NZa is investigating whether the health insurer is fulfilling its duty of care.
De NZa onderzoekt of de zorgverzekeraar zijn zorgplicht nakomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over de komst van een Turks ziekenhuis in Amsterdam

PVV MPs Klever and De Graaf asked whether they object to a Turkish hospital opening in Amsterdam, whether Turkish influence should be resisted, and whether the Inspectorate will check the clinic, including on circumcision and medication. The minister replied that she has no objection while the clinic meets Dutch standards, that the IGZ and NZa supervise it, and that it will be inspected like other new entrants.
The IGZ treats and inspects the Stichting Acibadem International Medical Center as it inspects all new entrants to check whether they meet the standards applicable in the Netherlands.
De IGZ behandelt en inspecteert de Stichting Acibadem International Medical Center zoals zij alle nieuwe toetreders inspecteert of aan de in Nederland geldende normen wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de opening van een polikliniek voor allochtonen

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister whether a clinic for people of non-Dutch origin with memory disorders should be stopped, questioning whether it is discriminatory and who pays for extra services. The minister said she has no objection as long as care meets Dutch rules and standards, that differentiated diagnostics by population group can sometimes be necessary, and that she will not block the clinic.

As long as the care provided there complies with Dutch healthcare legislation and good care is delivered as established by Dutch stakeholders and professional associations, I have no objection to this clinic.
Zolang de zorg die daar verleent wordt, voldoet aan de Nederlandse gezondheidszorgwetgeving en goede zorg wordt geleverd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat orthodontisten de rekening opdrijven

An MP asked the health minister about reports that orthodontists inflate bills through paper intermediary companies and why braces have not become cheaper despite tariff cuts. The minister answered that the NZa supervises one-to-one pass-through of material costs, that a complaints channel found many patients felt under-informed, and that the NZa has tightened supervision and will act where rules are broken.
It is up to the NZa to supervise the one-to-one pass-through of material and technique costs and it will enforce where necessary.
Het is aan de NZa om toezicht te houden op het één op één doorberekenen van de materiaal- en techniekkosten en zal waar nodig handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat de ambulancedienst in de regio Haaglanden het werk niet aan kan

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health about reports that the ambulance service in the Haaglanden region cannot cope with its workload, including staff and vehicle shortages, response times and emergency ward waiting times. The Minister acknowledged the signals of pressure, attributed them to rising demand and staff scarcity, and said she would inform the House after the summer, though she declined to provide ward waiting time data and deferred the closure decision at Antoniushove to the hospital.
I do not have such figures.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de doofpotcultuur bij medische missers

An MP (PVV) asked the health minister about a culture of concealing medical errors, failure to report calamities to the Inspectorate, lack of support for patients after errors, and whether fines were imposed on hospitals for late or non-reporting. The minister answered that the IGZ will issue a circular on the reporting duty and hold dialogues with the sector, that fines and warnings apply for late or non-reporting (warnings in 2013-2015, one fine in 2015), and that aftercare for patients fits within the Wkkgz, with the sector responsible for implementing it.
The IGZ will send a circular in the autumn explaining the duty to report calamities and will discuss with the care sector what a calamity is.
De IGZ zal in het najaar een circulaire sturen met een toelichting op de meldplicht bij calamiteiten en zal met het zorgveld in gesprek gaan over wat een calamiteit is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de misleidende uitspraken van de voorzitter van de Borgingscommissie Energieakkoord

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about claims by the chair of the Energy Agreement oversight committee on wind-energy cost reduction and fossil fuel subsidies, and whether he should be replaced. The minister rejected the claims as inaccurate, said the 40% cost reduction target is on track, and declined to ask the chair to retract or resign.
I think Mr Nijpels gives an excellent interpretation of his role as chair of the Energy Agreement oversight committee.
Ik vind dat de heer Nijpels op uitstekende wijze invulling geeft aan zijn rol als voorzitter van de Borgingscommissie Energieakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over dat er tonnen verdiend worden met ‘slimmer declareren’

An MP from the PVV asks the health minister how she views reports that mental health providers earn large sums by advising on 'smart declaring' (billing) and whether this conflicts with policy on patient care and fraud. The minister says she prefers correct billing, rejects financially driven care, refuses to name a revenue overview or order an NZa investigation, and points to planned reforms and existing controls.
I have not found in the article you cited any facts that give reason to ask the NZa to carry out further investigation.
Ik heb in het door u aangehaalde artikel geen feiten aangetroffen die aanleiding geven om de NZa te vragen nader onderzoek te laten doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Graus over het bericht “Weer dode potvissen gezien bij Texel”

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs whether electromagnetic radiation from undersea power cables could disturb whale navigation, whether this is considered in new cable permits, and whether it will be included in the investigation into stranded sperm whales. The state secretary replied that research has not shown that such cables cause measurable effects on marine mammals, that stranding causes remain unknown, and that the cause of death is generally suffocation under their own weight.
It is noted that it is not known that magnetic fields from undersea power cables cause demonstrable effects on marine mammals.
Geconstateerd wordt dat het niet bekend is dat magnetische velden van onderzeese stroomkabels aantoonbare effecten veroorzaken op zeezoogdieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het lekken van patiëntgegevens

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the government would investigate who was responsible for leaking 4,559 patient records from a Geldrop hospital and whether the incident fell under the data breach notification duty and constituted a breach of medical confidentiality. The minister answered that hospitals are primarily responsible, that the breach was reported to the Dutch Data Protection Authority, and that prosecution or sanctions are for the Public Prosecution Service and the Data Protection Authority to decide.
Hospitals themselves are primarily responsible for this.
Ziekenhuizen zijn hier in eerste plaats zelf verantwoordelijk voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht «Directeur verdiende aan gesubsidieerde windmolens»

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that a former director of a wind energy company linked to ECN earned over 1 million euros from subsidised windmills, raising conflict-of-interest concerns. The minister said the director was not responsible for subsidy advice, that the risk lay with the operator under MEP and the state under SDE+, that no insider knowledge misuse was found, and that the appearance of conflict of interest was acknowledged with integrity measures promised.
As I explained in my answer to question 2 from Member Smaling, I agree with ECN's conclusion that the appearance of a conflict of interest has been created.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 van het lid Smaling heb toegelicht ben ik het eens met de conclusie van ECN dat de schijn van belangenverstrengeling is gewekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat een rechtsbijstandsverzekering voor Groningers in het aardbevingsgebied taboe is

An MP asked the government about reports that legal expenses insurance is refused to Groningen residents in the earthquake area, and whether this inequality would be ended. The minister replied that the insurers' association says cover is possible though not guaranteed, that the Minister of Economic Affairs asked the National Coordinator Groningen to investigate insurers' conditions, and that subsidised legal aid is available for those who qualify.

The Minister of Economic Affairs has therefore asked the National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) to conduct further research into the conditions insurers impose for taking out legal expenses insurance within the earthquake area.

De Minister van Economische Zaken heeft daarom de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) gevraagd om nader onderzoek te doen naar de voorwaarden die verzekeraars stellen om een rechtsbijstandsverzekering af te sluiten binnen het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Wilders over het advies om een grensverleggend medicijn in de strijd tegen longkanker niet te vergoeden

MPs Klever and Wilders asked why the Zorginstituut advised against reimbursing nivolumab for lung cancer, questioned the €80,000 cost-effectiveness benchmark, savings on medicines, and budget priorities compared with asylum spending. Minister Schippers said negotiations with the manufacturer are ongoing and she will inform parliament of the outcome, that the €80,000 figure is a reference value rather than a fixed ceiling, and that the savings were redirected elsewhere in healthcare.
Once this negotiation is concluded, I will inform your House of the outcome and of my decision whether or not to admit Nivolumab to the insured package.
Na afronding van deze onderhandeling zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomst hiervan en mijn besluit of ik Nivolumab wel of niet toelaat tot het verzekerde pakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Agema over de geheugenpoli voor immigranten

MPs Klever and Agema (PVV) asked the health minister whether a memory clinic for immigrants is undesirable, whether autochthonous patients can attend, who pays for interpreters and social work, and why it should not be ended. The minister saw it as strengthening regional dementia care, said such targeted services can be acceptable if financially viable, and stated that access is guaranteed for all and that she has no intention of changing the Health Insurance Act.
I do not intend to amend the Health Insurance Act on these points.
Ik ben niet voornemens de Zorgverzekeringwet op deze punten te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat omzetplafonds de keuzevrijheid van de patiënt bedreigen

An MP asked the health minister whether hospital revenue caps (omzetplafonds) threaten patients' freedom of choice and create waiting lists, and whether patients with restitution policies are protected. The minister replied that insurers' duty of care and the legal right to continue started treatment apply regardless of caps, that the NZa monitors transparency, and that she rejects a general ban on revenue caps.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het niet meer vergoeden van medicatie

An MP asks the health minister why a patient's medication for neurofibromatosis was reportedly no longer reimbursed, whether stopping treatment without alternative breaches insurers' duty of care, and why medicines are cut while insurers hold large reserves. The minister replies that the drug is in the basic package and still reimbursed, that she does not know the patient's specific reason, that complaints can go to the provider or the national complaints point, and that insurers may not stop basic-package treatment unless the treating doctor advises it.
If the patient disagrees that he no longer receives the drug, he can file a complaint with his care provider.
Mocht de patiënt het niet mee eens zijn dat hij het middel niet meer krijgt, kan hij een klacht indienen bij zijn zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Fritsma over het opschorten van de screening op TBC bij Syrische asielzoekers

MPs Klever and Fritsma asked why TB screening of Syrian asylum seekers was suspended, whether the minister considered passport fraud, how many unscreened asylum seekers remain, for how long, and whether no asylum seeker should be admitted. The minister answered that screening is risk-based, Syrian TB risk is low, about 3,000 unregistered people were present with roughly 900 non-Syrians unscreened, the backlog should be cleared in about two weeks, and asylum seekers able to find protection in the region should be returned there.
Parties involved in infectious disease control have indicated they will work to clear this backlog as soon as possible.
Partijen betrokken bij de infectieziektebestrijding hebben aangegeven zich in te zullen spannen om deze achterstand zo spoedig mogelijk weg te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Klever over het bericht dat windmolenparken op zee 80% minder energie opleveren

MPs Madlener and Klever asked whether offshore wind farms really produce 80% less energy than claimed, whether subsidy and cost calculations should be revisited, and whether all wind plans should be halted. The minister replied that the wake effect is known and accounted for, that the press report confused installed capacity with output per square kilometre and used a hypothetical scenario unrealistic for the Netherlands, that no new insights change subsidy or costs, and that plans will not be halted.
No, see the answers to questions 2 and 3.
Nee, zie de antwoorden op vraag 2 en 3.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Klever over het bericht dat ouderen afzien van zorg wegens geldgebrek

Mr. Klever (PVV) asked the minister whether elderly people forgoing medication or specialist checks due to money problems is acceptable, how this will be prevented, and why asylum seekers receive free care while Dutch citizens pay their own risk. Minister Schippers said a study on care avoidance will be delivered before the budget debate, noted the GP visit is excluded from the own risk, and explained that asylum seekers' care is organized by COA and that once housed they must take out insurance.
That research will be ready in October and is being carried out by the Ministry of VWS together with the Consumentenbond, the Landelijke Huisartsenvereniging and Zorgverzekeraars Nederland.
Dat onderzoek zal in oktober gereed zijn en laat het Ministerie van VWS samen met de Consumentenbond, de Landelijke Huisartsenvereniging en Zorgverzekeraars Nederland uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de hoge zorgkosten van allochtonen

An MP asked the health minister about the higher healthcare costs of allochtonen, whether this relates to unpaid premiums, and how to curb it. The minister answered that the data show higher average costs for some groups but not excessive use, that care is not free and collection measures apply, and that she sees no added value in research linking non-payment to care use.
I furthermore see no added value in research that establishes a link between the extent to which people fail to pay and the amount of care they use.
Ik zie voorts geen toegevoegde waarde voor onderzoek dat een relatie legt tussen de mate waarin mensen wanbetalen en de hoeveelheid zorg die zij gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het Nederlands ziekenhuis in het weekend dodelijker is

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister how she responds to reports that Dutch hospitals have higher weekend mortality, whether specialists are more often absent at weekends, and whether she will investigate why Australian hospitals do not show this effect. The minister answered that the Dutch monitoring data show a weekday-weighted pattern with more harm on Thursday and Friday, that the cited study covered only six hospitals and cannot prove Australian hospitals are safer, that weekend staffing is lower but sufficient specialist availability is required, and declined to start a new investigation.
No. I refer to my answer to question 1 and question 5.
Nee. Ik verwijs daarvoor naar mijn antwoord op vraag 1 en vraag 5.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat patiënten zorg mijden vanwege de kosten voor het eigen risico

An MP asked the minister whether patients avoiding care because of the deductible (eigen risico) was acceptable and what measures would be taken. The minister said the matter is under study and the results will be sent to parliament before the VWS budget debate, without committing to specific measures now.
As previously promised, I will send the results of this study to your House before the VWS budget debate.
Zoals eerder is toegezegd zal ik de resultaten van dit onderzoek voor de behandeling van de VWS-begroting aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat de ramadan goed zou zijn tegen diabetes

An MP from the PVV asks the minister of health whether she will act against claims that Ramadan fasting cures diabetes, which the MP says is dangerous medical advice, and whether the resulting extra care costs can be recovered from its source. The minister answers that assessing diabetes and Ramadan is a matter for the medical profession and individual care plans, that patients decide how to manage their illness with their care providers, and refers to earlier answers on the cost question.
I consider the assessment of the effects of participation in Ramadan on diabetes to be a responsibility of the medical profession.
De beoordeling van de effecten van deelname aan de ramadan op diabetes vind ik een verantwoordelijkheid van de medische beroepsgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de afkoopsom die het LangeLand Ziekenhuis heeft betaald aan een ex-topman

An MP asked the health minister how a hospital could pay a settlement of nearly half a million euros to an ex-director who had driven it near bankruptcy, and whether measures could prevent such payouts and provide overviews of severance packages. The minister said the court had ruled on the settlement and that the hospital's own boards can pursue liability for mismanagement, and promised an annual report on sector executive pay later without providing the requested per-institution data.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de afkoopsom van een vertrokken zorgbestuurder

An MP asked the Minister of Health about severance payments of about EUR 977,020 total to three departed VUmc board members who were involved in serious scandals, and whether these reduce the budget for expensive medicines. The minister said the government favours limiting severance pay, pointed to the WNT cap in force since 2013, said the payments do not come from the expensive-medicines budget, and noted that CIBG supervises WNT compliance.
The cabinet considers limiting severance payments desirable for society.
Het kabinet acht beperking van ontslagvergoedingen maatschappelijk wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de wachtgeldregeling van een vertrokken zorgbestuurder

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a €370,419 severance payment to a departing hospital executive, whether current executives can claim similar packages, and how the government will address overpaid executives. The minister said the CIBG is checking compliance with the Wet Normering Topinkomens, that the cap applies from 2013 with older arrangements under transitional rules, that no forced dismissals occurred at the OZG hospital group, and that the government supports moderate executive pay.
The CIBG is examining whether this severance arrangement was implemented in accordance with the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT).
Het CIBG onderzoekt of deze wachtgeldregeling conform de Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT) is uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over corruptie bij de FIFA

An MP asked the health minister about FIFA corruption, including whether the Netherlands should file a complaint, claim back the 4.5 million euro contributed to the 2018 World Cup bid, and whether FIFA's leadership could be re-elected. The minister said she awaits the Swiss and US investigations, will consider steps if corruption in the award process is shown, and that a new, more transparent FIFA leadership is now a matter for FIFA's members.
Should the investigation show that the award process was corrupt, I will consider taking steps.
Mocht uit het onderzoek blijken dat het proces bij de gunning corrupt is geweest dan zal ik me beraden op te nemen stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Klever en Wilders over het bericht 'Medische raad bij ramadan'

Three PVV MPs asked whether patients who fast during Ramadan knowingly endanger their health and whether insurers should bear the extra advice and care costs of those who become medically unstable. Minister Schippers answered that the Health Insurance Act requires care decisions to rest on care-content criteria, that she does not intend to amend it, and that no registrations exist to determine the extra costs.
I am not aware of any records from which these extra costs could be derived without further ado.
Er zijn mij geen registraties bekend waar deze extra kosten zonder meer uit af te leiden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over haperende apparatuur van Gelderse ambulances

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health about malfunctioning monitoring equipment in Gelderland ambulances, whether it is acceptable, who is responsible, and whether patient safety is at risk across all safety regions. The minister declined to comment on the specific case because the Inspectorate for Health Care is handling a report, pointed to the ambulance provider and manufacturer as responsible, and said the inspectorate will act if needed.
I therefore cannot go into the substance of the case.
Ik kan daarom niet inhoudelijk op de casus ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat windturbines in het offshore Amaliawindpark bij IJmuiden niet veilig zijn en dreigen te bezwijken
