An MP asked the minister whether offshore wind turbines at the Amalia wind farm are unsafe and could collapse, and what this means for the planned offshore rollout, subsidies, and onshore turbines. The minister acknowledged a first-generation design error, said repairs are underway with a fix that will not affect new parks, subsidies do not cover repair costs, and the error does not apply to onshore turbines.
This concerns a design error that occurs in the first generation of offshore wind farms.
Het betreft hier een ontwerpfout die voorkomt bij de eerste generatie windparken op zee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de defecte Spijkenisserbrug, die cruciaal is voor ambulances

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health whether ambulance access to Voorne-Putten is at risk given repeated stoppages of the Spijkenisse bridge, and what will be done about pressure on emergency staff and the lack of a 24/7 emergency department in Spijkenisse. The Minister replied that partners report no disruption to ambulance care or measurable effect on response times, that Rijkswaterstaat and the province have arranged a backup via the Hartel bridge, and that the Inspectorate has received no incident reports.
The parties involved have informed me that the stoppages of the past period have not yet led to disruptions of ambulance care on Voorne Putten.
De betrokken partijen hebben mij laten weten dat de stremmingen van de afgelopen periode nog niet hebben geleid tot verstoringen van de ambulancezorg op Voorne Putten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de oproep van viroloog Osterhaus

An MP asked the health minister about virologist Osterhaus's call urging people to obtain antivirals from their GP, whether she would distance herself from it, and about his financial ties to pharmaceutical firms and the value of flu vaccination. The minister answered that patient care is a matter between doctor and patient guided by professional standards, that the debate is for experts, that she has no overview of his financial interests, and that she sees no reason to change the flu vaccination programme.
I have no overview of the financial interests of prof. dr. Osterhaus.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de financiële belangen van prof. dr. Osterhaus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het interview met de heer Nijpels “Windmolens moeten er toch komen”

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether claims by Nijpels, chair of the Energy Agreement guarantee commission, about wind subsidies and job creation are accurate, and why the SDE+ levy is not abolished. The Minister answers that maximum subsidy costs are about 3.5 billion euro for onshore wind to 2032 and 5.5 billion for offshore wind, that a rough estimate of about 1 billion per year is needed for new renewable projects, that the 15,000 jobs target is considered achievable, and that Nijpels' statements are his own responsibility.
The statements of Mr Nijpels are for his own account.
De uitspraken van de heer Nijpels zijn voor zijn eigen rekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de financiële risico’s van leaseconstructies voor zonnepalen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the promised energy savings and tax benefits of a 17-year solar panel lease are guaranteed and what financial risks consumers face. The minister said he cannot assess the contract terms, reaffirmed that net metering is guaranteed until 2020, and noted that operational leases fall outside the financial supervision act while the AFM is exploring leasing risks more broadly.
I am not familiar with the contract terms of the offering party and therefore cannot make any statements about them.
Ik ben niet bekend met de contractvoorwaarden van de aanbiedende partij en kan om die reden hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Wilders over het bericht dat het eigen risico niet meer te betalen is

MPs Klever and Wilders asked the health minister how she would respond to reports that people can no longer afford the mandatory deductible, and whether she would lower it using insurer reserves and cut spending on asylum, EU payments and aid. The minister replied that the solidarity system and zorgtoeslag protect low incomes, that reserves are private and cannot be used to lower the deductible though insurers may return surpluses, and that health care remains a government priority.
Healthcare costs should in principle not be a reason to forgo necessary care.
Zorgkosten hoeven in beginsel geen reden te zijn om af te zien van noodzakelijke zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de berisping van een dissidente zorgverzekeraar door de branchevereniging

An MP asked the health minister for her reaction to the industry association ZN reprimanding dissident insurer DSW, whether the association behaves like a cartel, and whether the ACM should investigate possible cartel formation. The minister called the matter an internal affair of ZN, said the ACM and NZa can intervene if cartel formation occurs, and declined to ask the ACM to investigate.
The ACM, as supervisor, is itself responsible for initiating such an investigation if it sees reason to do so.
De ACM is als toezichthouder zelf verantwoordelijk om dergelijk onderzoek in gang te zetten indien zij daar aanleiding toe zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht `De Nationale Energie Verkenning van PBL en ECN`

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about press criticism of the 2014 National Energy Exploration (NEV) and its household energy bill figures, including the SDE+ levy, network costs and the fixed-cost assumptions. The minister acknowledges errors in the NEV that overstated the 2020 bill reduction (EUR 46 instead of EUR 66), says the 14% renewable target is still assumed achievable, and promises a fuller analysis in the NEV 2015.
I deeply regret the above errors in the NEV, all the more so because as a result the House could not have the correct information either.
Ik betreur de bovenstaande fouten in de NEV zeer, temeer omdat hierdoor ook uw Kamer niet over de juiste informatie kon beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat Nederlandse huishoudens vele honderden miljoenen euro’s te veel hebben betaald voor hun gas en hun energiebelasting

An MP asked whether Dutch households were overcharged for gas and energy tax for decades due to temperature-related metering errors, and whether they will be refunded retroactively. The minister denied overcharging on average, explained the 2008 study, the 2015 temperature-correction changes, and refused refunds, noting energy tax is tied to measured volumes.
On average, therefore, there is no question of amounts having been overpaid.
Gemiddeld genomen is daarom geen sprake van teveel betaalde bedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat windturbineparken op zee gebakken lucht zijn

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how he responded to reports that offshore wind parks yield no CO2 savings, whether subsidies should stop, and how the 50 billion euro investment figure from the Energy Agreement was derived. The minister rejected the link to combined heat and power, refused to stop offshore wind subsidies citing climate and supply security, said the 50 billion figure was an investment estimate by another person whose basis is unknown, and defended the Energy Agreement.
I am not prepared to stop subsidising offshore wind energy.
Ik ben niet bereid te stoppen met het subsidiëren van windenergie op zee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever, Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat een zwaar gesubsidieerde elektrische auto bijna net zoveel fijnstof produceert als een benzinewagen

Three PVV MPs asked whether the government will stop subsidising electric cars after a report claimed they emit almost as much fine particulate matter as petrol cars, and whether VAT and registration tax should be cut instead. Minister Kamp answered that total particulate emissions including brake and tyre wear are about a third lower for electric cars, that subsidies will be reconsidered in the Autobrief 2.0, and that the 160,000 euro-per-car figure is not recognised.
Antwoord op vragen het van het lid Klever over het bericht dat patiëntgegevens zonder toestemming zijn gedeeld

MP Klever (PVV) asked the Health Minister about reports that patient data were shared without consent, citing a CBP finding that consent could not be proven in 8 of 149 sampled files, and asked about sanctions under the data protection act and ending the LSP. Minister Schippers answered that the CBP is the independent supervisor and decides on further investigation herself, that VZVZ took tightened consent measures, that a bill giving the CBP power to impose administrative fines was sent to parliament, and that the LSP will not be ended.
I do not intend to conduct further investigation.
Ik ben niet van plan nader onderzoek te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat de bouw van windmolenparken op zee de maatschappij 5 miljard euro schade oplevert

PVV MP Klever asks whether the government will stop offshore wind development after a report claimed it causes 5 billion euro in damage, and how it will justify subsidy spending. Minister Kamp replies that the cited figure comes from a cost-benefit analysis of inside-12-mile-zone wind parks that does not address whether offshore wind is desirable, and that offshore wind remains necessary for climate targets and supply security, so he will not stop it.
I am not willing to stop promoting offshore wind energy.
Ik ben niet bereid te stoppen met de stimulering van windenergie op zee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Wilders over de ebola uitbraak

Two PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands was not part of a ministerial emergency meeting on Ebola, whether the government takes the public health risk seriously, and whether it will push for an EU-wide halt to flights from West Africa. The Minister replied that no invitation was received, that the risk is taken seriously with reference to a letter, and that she rejects flight bans because the virus should be isolated and regional borders kept open.
No. The three affected countries have, in line with WHO guidelines, introduced exit screening.
Nee. De drie getroffen landen hebben, conform de WHO richtlijnen, exit screening ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de aanzienlijk grotere kans op complicaties bij longkankeroperaties op vrijdag

An MP asked the health minister about a study finding higher complication rates for lung cancer surgery on Fridays, personnel shortages in evening and weekend care, and whether patients can access quality information. The minister said the cause is not yet proven, that hospitals and professionals are responsible with the Inspectorate supervising, and that quality transparency efforts continue.
It is primarily up to the care providers themselves to deliver good and safe care and to continuously seek how it can be improved.
Het is primair aan de zorgverleners zelf om goede en veilige zorg te leveren en permanent te zoeken hoe het nog beter kan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat mensen die mogelijk met ebola besmet zijn met een leugentje en ibuprofen op het vliegtuig naar Nederland kunnen stappen

An MP asked the health minister about reports that possibly Ebola-infected travellers could board flights to the Netherlands by lying and taking ibuprofen, and asked whether screening is inadequate and whether flights from risk areas should be banned. The minister did not share the concerns and referred to a separate letter on exit and entry screening.
I do not share or endorse your view. In my letter of 21 October 2014 on Ebola I go into exit and entry screening in detail.
Ik deel of onderschrijf uw mening niet. In mijn brief van 21 oktober 2014 over Ebola ga ik uitgebreid in op exit en entry screening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht ‘Gaswinning. Dan krijg je dit’

An MP asked the minister about a Groningen family whose barn collapsed and who still await compensation and replacement housing four months later, plus alleged intimidation by NAM and the municipality and the use of a 620,000 euro dialogue table budget. The minister answered that responsibility for the collapse (storm damage, neglect, possible quake contribution) is still being determined by an expert firm, the insurer has paid for stolen goods, a housing offer was made and the acute housing need appears resolved, and both NAM and the municipality deny pressuring the family.
Because more cases are expected where earthquake damage is not, or not initially, identified as the main cause, I will consult with municipalities to agree a careful procedure for such cases.

Omdat voorzien wordt dat er meer gevallen zijn of zullen volgen waarbij aardbevingsschade niet, of niet als eerste instantie, als hoofdoorzaak wordt aangemerkt zal ik met gemeenten in overleg treden om in deze gevallen een zorgvuldige procedure af te spreken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever (PVV) over de wanorde bij toezichthouder de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa)

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister how she would respond to reports of disorder at the NZa, including unsafe medical data and an ignored whistleblower, and whether the board should be suspended pending an investigation. The minister's answer, given by referring to a prior written consultation on the NZa's 2012 functioning, does not address the questions on substance and points to the earlier document.
The written questions from MP Klever (PVV), question number 2014Z06732, have been answered by means of the letter 'Report of a written consultation on the functioning of the NZa 2012'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Klever (PVV), vraagnummer 2014Z06732 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Verslag van een schriftelijk overleg over het functioneren van de NZa 2012»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever (PVV) over het schrappen van alarmerende cijfers over de financiële positie van ziekenhuizen door de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa)

An MP from the PVV asks the minister why the Dutch healthcare regulator NZa allegedly removed alarming figures on hospital finances from a market scan, whether this amounts to manipulation, and whether the minister knew of it, with questions on the regulator's independence and a request for the uncensored version. The minister refers to a previous written consultation report on the NZa's functioning and does not answer the questions directly.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat instanties het medisch beroepsgeheim omzeilen

An MP asks whether insurers and benefit agencies routinely request full medical files, and what the government will do to stop this bypassing of medical confidentiality. The minister says agencies may need some medical data but must request only what is necessary with patient consent, points to pending penalty legislation and NPCF/KNMG information efforts, and declines a broad government awareness campaign.
I have no reason to doubt the accuracy of the figures, as presented by the NPCF.
Ik heb overigens geen reden te twijfelen aan de juistheid van de cijfers, zoals door de NPCF gepresenteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘Eneco laat particulieren beleggen in zijn windpark’

MPs Klever and Tony van Dijck asked the ministers about a report that Eneco lets private individuals invest in its wind park, including how the AFM checks and warns about risks, whether subsidised returns of 8 to 12% are possible, what happens to investors if subsidies or electricity prices fall. The minister answered that the AFM reviews prospectuses for completeness, consistency and comprehensibility, that the 8 to 12% figures were wrongly reported, that subsidy changes affect only new parks, and that the AFM oversees advertising but no advance warning was committed.
The AFM checks whether the prospectus is complete, consistent and comprehensible.
De AFM controleert of het prospectus volledig, consistent en begrijpelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht 'Slechts één kliniek voor protonenbestraling'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health whether the allocation of only one proton therapy clinic, and the granting of four licences, amounts to a cartel arrangement by health insurers and whether the NZa and ACM should be asked to impose fines. The Minister answered that the ACM, not the NZa, supervises cartel rules, that insurers are responsible for compliance, and that the licences were granted because all four applicants met the regulation's conditions.
It is therefore up to the ACM to assess whether there are cartel agreements that restrict competition.
Het is dan ook aan de ACM om te toetsen of sprake is van kartelafspraken die de concurrentie beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Klever over het bericht dat illegalen in Amsterdam de eigen bijdrage voor medicijnen terugkrijgen

Two PVV MPs asked why undocumented migrants in Amsterdam receive free medicines, whether the mayor breaches agreements, and how the government will ensure departure. The minister answered that undocumented migrants are responsible for care costs, that reimbursement via Zorginstituut is possible with a €5 correction, that the mayor's payment of that amount is a municipal matter, and that she was not consulted in advance.
To what extent municipalities bear these costs themselves and how they have organised this is not for me to assess.
In hoeverre gemeenten deze kosten voor eigen rekening nemen en hoe zij dit georganiseerd hebben, staat niet aan mij ter beoordeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de gouden handdruk van een weggestuurde ziekenhuisbestuurder

An MP asked the health minister about a severance payment of about half a million euros given to a dismissed hospital board member and asked for measures and a blacklist of underperforming executives. The minister said the Wnt pay-cap law now limits such severance, that the supervisory board honoured prior contractual agreements, and that a blacklist would not be set up, while the boards must screen candidates carefully.

I am of the view that supervisory boards must exercise all due care when filling executive vacancies and must examine candidates' earlier careers for factors that could show they are unsuitable for the post.
Ik ben van mening dat Raden van Toezicht bij het vervullen van vacatures voor bestuurders alle zorgvuldigheid in acht moeten nemen en de eerdere loopbaan van kandidaten moeten nalopen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Fritsma over de verwachte toename van medische kosten voor asielzoekers

PVV MPs Klever and Fritsma asked about rising costs of medical care for asylum seekers, including screening, costs per asylum seeker, the budget source, contraception coverage, co-payments and whether a deductible or medically-necessary-only limit should apply. The answers state that asylum seekers are screened for tuberculosis at arrival, that 2013 curative medical costs were 72.6 million euro (about 4,870 per person), that the extra costs are funded from the ODA budget, and that the government declines to introduce a deductible or limit care to medically necessary treatment.
Introducing a deductible would mean that the Dutch government reimburses this to itself for asylum seekers.
Het instellen van een eigen risico zou betekenen dat de Nederlandse overheid dit voor asielzoekers aan zichzelf vergoedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht «Essent start bouw Windpark Zuidwester», waarin RWE aankondigt dat zijn deelpark in 2017 in bedrijf zal worden gesteld

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the RWE wind park Zuidwester, delayed to 2017, would lose its SDE+ subsidy, and why an exception was being made for RWE. The minister answered that the subsidy is reduced pro rata rather than withdrawn, that the park still contributes to the renewable energy target, and that no exceptions are made for RWE.
No exceptions are made for RWE, see also the answers to questions 5 and 6.
Er worden geen uitzonderingen gemaakt voor RWE, zie ook het antwoord op de vragen 5 en 6.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Tony van Dijck over het ontbreken van democratische controle op de kosten van het Energieakkoord

PVV MPs Klever and Tony van Dijck asked whether the government accepts that the Energieakkoord lacks a carefully substantiated cost calculation and asked for an overview of direct and indirect costs, including tax revenue loss and private damage. Minister Kamp rejects the claim that the calculation is missing, points to the PBL and ECN analyses and promised annual energy projections (NEV) from October 2014, but did not provide the requested overview.
Are you willing to send the Chamber an overview of all costs arising from the Energy Agreement?
Bent u bereid om alsnog een overzicht van alle uit het Energieakkoord voortvloeiende kosten naar de Kamer te sturen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Helder over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa)  het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft gepasseerd bij het fraudeonderzoek in het St. Antonius Ziekenhuis te Nieuwegei

MPs Klever and Helder asked whether the NZa bypassed the Public Prosecution Service (OM) by imposing only an administrative fine in the St. Antonius hospital fraud case, and whether the tripartite protocol was followed. The ministers answered that the NZa independently concluded there was no intent, so the case did not qualify as a criminal offence under the ne bis in idem rules, that the hospital repaid improper claims, and that fraud must be fought through an integrated approach.

The NZa independently concluded, on the basis of the available investigative material, that no intent had been shown in this case and that the conduct therefore did not also constitute a criminal offence.

De NZa heeft zelfstandig, op basis van het beschikbare onderzoeksmateriaal, de conclusie getrokken dat er in het onderhavige geval van opzet niet is gebleken en de gedraging derhalve niet tevens een strafbaar feit opleverde.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de brief over windenergie van de provincie Gelderland, die o.a. aan de gemeente Ermelo is gestuurd, waarin staat dat voor fossiele energie jaarlijks 5,8 miljard euro subsidie wo

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Gelderland province letter stating that EUR 5.8 billion per year is spent on fossil energy subsidies, and whether the province should correct it. The minister answers that the figure is incorrect, lists the excise exemptions and degressive energy tax structure as the items at issue, and states that these answers serve as the correction.
The passage in which the province of Gelderland states that EUR 5.8 billion in subsidies is granted annually to fossil energy is not correct.
De passage waarin de provincie Gelderland aangeeft dat jaarlijks 5,8 miljard euro subsidie wordt verstrekt aan fossiele energie is niet correct.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat experts alarm slaan over gevaarlijke bijwerkingen van antidepressiva

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister for her response to reports that experts warn of dangerous side effects of antidepressants, including whether SSRIs are over-prescribed for mild conditions, whether an aggression warning should be added to packaging, and whether DNA testing should be introduced. The minister answered that prescribing is a matter for treating physicians under guidelines, that she referred to earlier answers, and that the medicines regulator CBG is primarily responsible for assessing studies and considering further measures.
It is up to the treating physicians to assess whether antidepressants should be prescribed to the patient, and if so, which ones.
Het is aan de behandelende artsen om te beoordelen of aan de patiënt antidepressiva moeten worden voorgeschreven, en zo ja welke.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het ontbreken van een spoedeisende eerste hulp in Spijkenisse n.a.v. een chloorlek in het zwembad aldaar, waardoor veel kinderen met spoed naar het ziekenhuis moesten

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health about the absence of a 24-hour emergency department in Spijkenisse after a chlorine leak at a local pool sent many children to hospital, and about ambulance and helicopter deployment. The minister answered the factual questions, said the 45-minute standard applies to spread rather than arrival times, and stated that regional emergency care is coordinated through partner hospitals without committing to a new emergency department in Spijkenisse.
For me the starting point is that care in the region is responsible and accessible and matched to regional needs.
Voor mij is het uitgangspunt dat de zorg in de regio verantwoord en bereikbaar is en is afgestemd op de behoeften in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het aantreffen van het levensgevaarlijk MERS-virus in Nederland

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister when the MERS-infected patient was identified, whether all contacts had been traced, what measures prevent MERS import and spread, and whether all travellers from Saudi Arabia should be screened. The minister answered that all close contacts were reached and monitored, that travellers and doctors are informed through existing channels, and that universal screening is neither necessary nor feasible.
No. Many thousands of people travel from the Netherlands to the Middle East each year. It is neither necessary nor feasible to test all of these people on return for the MERS coronavirus.
Nee. Per jaar reizen er vele duizenden mensen vanuit Nederland naar het Midden-Oosten. Het is niet nodig en niet haalbaar om al deze mensen bij thuiskomst te testen op het MERS-Corona virus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht «NAM ontruimt huis Lageland na bevingsschade»

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why a house in Lageland was emptied after earthquake damage, how many homes are bought out, the criteria, whether owners are fully compensated, and whether NAM should publish which homes it buys. The minister explained the house was evacuated for safety, described the compensation schemes including a value-loss scheme, declined to publish buyout details citing privacy, and rejected a generic buyout scheme in favour of reinforcing homes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Wilders over het weigeren van het naleven van hygiëneregels door een moslima

MPs Klever and Wilders asked whether hospital hygiene rules should outweigh a Muslim employee's religious conviction, why the IGZ did not enforce hygiene rules, how many similar cases exist, and how hospitals can avoid lawsuits and settlements. The minister answered that religious dress can be restricted only with objective justification such as hygiene, that the IGZ advised the hospital and the hospital bears responsibility, that no overview is available, and that labour relations in care are not her responsibility.
It is not my responsibility to intervene in labour relations in the care sector.
Het behoort niet tot mijn verantwoordelijkheid om te treden in arbeidsrelaties in de zorg.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de integriteit van het management van Typhoon Capital over het boek Windhandel en aanvullende vragen over de gevolgen van het onderzoek dat de curatoren van het failliete Econce

An MP asks the minister whether the management of Typhoon Capital, largely former Econcern managers, is beyond doubt on integrity given the book Windhandel and the curators' bankruptcy report, and whether a Bibob integrity check was done before a 4.5 billion euro subsidy. The minister declines to judge integrity from a book, notes curators and the rechter-commissaris handle such matters, and refuses to request a Bibob advice because the subsidies went to ZeeEnergie CV and Buitengaats CV, not to Typhoon's managers.
If not, why not? Answer 5: No, I am not willing to still invoke the Bibob act to check the management of Typhoon.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 5 Nee, ik ben niet bereid om alsnog een beroep op de wet Bibob te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de gevolgen van het onderzoek dat de curatoren van het failliete Econcern hebben uitgevoerd voor de directie van Typhoon

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the implications of the Econcern curators' investigation for Typhoon's management, including possible bribery, and whether the SDE subsidy or permits should be suspended. The minister declined to comment on the curators' findings, saw no reason for a special forensic investigation or subsidy suspension, and said the subsidy decisions of May 2010 remain unchanged with payments expected from 2016.
I have no opinion on the curators' investigation report. It is part of the curators' duty of care to wind up the Econcern estate.
Over het onderzoeksverslag van curatoren heb ik geen mening. Het behoort tot de zorgplicht van curatoren om de boedel van Econcern te vereffenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever inzake overheidssubsidie voor duurzame energie

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about innovation and SDE subsidies for the Noordoostpolder wind park, including risk allocation, locational costs, and cable and transformer costs. The minister answered that developer risks are passed to the initiator, that the subsidy was approved by the European Commission and will be reviewed, and that location-specific factors can justify innovation subsidies, while some questions were answered only by reference to earlier letters.
After construction, a Milieusteunkader review will still take place, on the basis of which it will again be examined whether too much subsidy has been paid.
Na de bouw zal nog een Milieusteunkader toetsing plaatsvinden op basis waarvan nogmaals bekeken wordt of er niet teveel subsidie is betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat patiënten hun eigen medisch dossier niet kunnen inzien

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister whether doctors refusing patients access to their own medical records break the law, where patients can turn, and why patients cannot manage their own records. The minister confirmed that patients have a legal right to inspect or receive copies, pointed to complaint and civil court routes, and rejected the idea that patients should manage their own records.
The starting point is that every patient has the right to inspect, or receive a copy of, his or her file.
Uitgangspunt is dat elke patiënt recht heeft op inzage in, dan wel afschrift van zijn of haar dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het vergoeden van een medicijn voor MS-patiënten

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the CVZ compared Fampyra with physiotherapy costs, whether a pay-for-performance arrangement could be considered, and which European countries reimburse the drug. The minister answered that no cost comparison was made because no comparative effect data exist, that the CVZ advised against reimbursement, and that conditional admission is being studied with a decision expected in spring 2014.
As I answered previous questions from you, I am studying the possibilities of conditionally admitting Fampyra.
Zoals ik op eerdere vragen van u heb geantwoord bestudeer ik de mogelijkheden om Fampyra voorwaardelijk toe te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Klever over medische zorg voor vreemdelingen

PVV MPs asked how many asylum seekers use medical care during their procedure, what it costs, whether they pay co-payments, and how many rejected applicants receive care. The government answered that care is provided under the Rva and RZA, costs were 72 million euro in 2012, asylum seekers pay no co-payments or deductibles, and it cannot track several requested figures due to medical confidentiality and lack of registration.
Which medical care an asylum seeker has received falls under medical professional confidentiality and is therefore not visible to the non-medical staff of the immigration chain.
Welke medische zorg een asielzoeker heeft ontvangen valt onder het medische beroepsgeheim en is daarom niet inzichtelijk voor het niet-medische personeel van de vreemdelingenketen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Klever en Wilders over het zwichten van voetbalclub Vitesse voor de Jodenhaat van de VAE (Verenigde Arabische Emiraten)

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether Vitesse's decision to travel to the UAE without Jewish player Dan Mori, who was unwelcome there, reflects antisemitism and dhimmitude, and what measures would follow. The minister called the decision a bad signal, acknowledged concern about contemporary antisemitism and announced a study into its causes, but declined any measures against the club and noted that the question about admitting the player was moot after the team's return.
It was a bad signal from Vitesse to travel to the United Arab Emirates without its own player Mori.
Het was een slecht signaal van Vitesse om zonder haar eigen speler Mori af te reizen naar de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over het bericht dat de bouw van windmolens 6000 banen kost

PVV MPs Klever and De Graaf asked whether the reported loss of 6,000 jobs from offshore wind farms within the 12-mile zone is acceptable and whether those plans will be scrapped, and why regional effects are not studied. The minister answered that the figures come from a preliminary study measuring intended visits rather than actual effects, that the feasibility study is still in its final phase, and that regional effects are acknowledged and may be examined in a later phase.
It is therefore too early to conclude that placing wind turbines within the 12-mile zone would cost 6,000 jobs.
Het is daarom te vroeg om te concluderen dat plaatsing van windmolens binnen de 12-mijlszone 6.000 banen zou kosten.

Vragen van de leden De Graaf, Wilders en Klever (allen PVV) aan de Ministers van Economische Zaken en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «accijnzen nekslag pomphouders» (ingezonden 7 januari 2014).

MPs De Graaf, Wilders and Klever asked whether a news report on excise increases hurting petrol station owners in border regions would prompt the government to cut excise duties to undercut neighbouring countries. The state secretary acknowledged the border-region impact, said a report would follow by mid-May 2014, and declined to commit to lowering excise duties yet, citing the need for more time to assess effects.
My predecessor promised to send a report to the House before the summer.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft toegezegd voor de zomer een rapportage aan de Kamer te zullen zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat het Catharina ziekenhuis in Eindhoven één miljoen euro moet betalen aan vier frauderende dermatologen

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the hospital board or the medical staff is ultimately responsible in a hospital, after an arbitration ruling that the board and specialists are not in a hierarchical relationship. The minister said the hospital board bears final responsibility for quality, safety and billing, disagreed with the ruling, and noted that fraud action remains possible.
The hospital board bears final responsibility for the whole hospital and must be able to be held accountable for it.
De raad van bestuur draagt de eindverantwoordelijkheid voor het totale ziekenhuis en moet daarop kunnen worden aangesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de 120.000 verzekerden die al jarenlang geen zorgpremie betalen, waardoor er één miljard euro aan onbetaalde premies open staat

An MP asked the minister how she will tackle the 120,000 chronic non-payers of health insurance premiums (about one billion euros outstanding), whether the planned amendment to the non-payer scheme will address them, and about the share of allochtonen and the effect of opening borders to Bulgarians and Romanians, and whether such non-payers should still receive all care. The minister answered that enforcement is already strict within legal limits, that referral back to insurers is being prepared with CVZ and municipalities, that CBS data on background characteristics is provided and further analysis requested, and that suspending insurance would shift the problem to providers so she opposes it.
I will continue to look for measures or initiatives that substantially reduce this group.
Ik zal voortdurend blijven zoeken naar maatregelen of initiatieven die deze groep substantieel verkleint.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Wilders over discriminerende zorgverzekeraars die een spotgoedkope zorgverzekering met nul eigen risico aanbieden aan uitsluitend buitenlanders

MPs Klever and Wilders asked the minister about insurers offering very cheap health policies with zero deductible only to foreigners, and whether this should be ended and extended to Dutch citizens. The minister replied that these are voluntary collective add-on arrangements for groups such as seasonal workers, that the NZa monitors them and finds them small (under 2%), and that she cannot ban them, though she asked the NZa to give them extra attention in its market scan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de vergoeding van een medicijn voor MS-patiënten

An MP asked the health minister why the CVZ rejected reimbursement of Fampyra for MS patients despite research showing benefit, whether insurers are dropping physiotherapy cover, and whether the drug will be conditionally admitted. The minister answered that the CVZ's finding of no demonstrated added value over physiotherapy is decisive, that a decision on conditional admission is pending and a decision is expected in spring 2014.
I therefore cannot give a conclusive answer at this time on whether Fampyra can be conditionally admitted.
Ik kan daarom op dit moment geen uitsluitsel geven of Fampyra voorwaardelijk kan worden toegelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat het landelijk schakelpunt uitbreidt naar ketenzorg

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about extending the LSP health data exchange to chronic care, including privacy, consent, CBP oversight and insurer incentives. The minister answered that data sharing must comply with WBP and WGBO rules, that the CBP can enforce, and that the LSP is not an obligation for providers.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority (CBP) is tasked with supervising the processing of personal data.
Het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP) heeft tot taak toe te zien op de verwerking van persoonsgegevens.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over over het bericht dat honderden hoogzwangere, vooral West-Afrikaanse vrouwen de laatste tijd naar Groot-Brittannië zijn gevlogen om daar tijdens hun bevalling gratis gebruik te make

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether birth tourism, or free use of Dutch healthcare by foreign pregnant women, occurs in the Netherlands and what it costs. The minister gave partial figures for illegal residents (EUR 747,000 for 970 pregnancies in 2012), said data for hospital care and uninsured foreigners are not yet available, and committed to asking hospital associations for more figures.
As far as medical specialist care in hospitals or uninsured foreigners other than illegal residents or uninsurable foreigners is concerned, I currently have no figures available on this.

Voor zover het gaat over medisch specialistische zorg in ziekenhuizen of over onverzekerde buitenlanders, anders dan illegalen of onverzekerbare vreemdelingen,heb ik hierover op dit moment geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Klever over het bericht van de Nationale ombudsman “fraude valt mee”

Two PVV MPs asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about the National Ombudsman's statement that fraud is less serious than assumed, and whether they agree that all fraud must be tackled and that such statements insult taxpayers. The Minister replied that all fraud is unacceptable, pointed to the Rijksbrede aanpak Fraude and the zorgfraude plan of action, and said he does not share the view that the Ombudsman's statement is an insult, as the Ombudsman's task is to oversee government.
No, I do not share that view. The National Ombudsman's task is to oversee the government and make statements about it.
Nee, die mening deel ik niet. De Nationale Ombudsman heeft tot taak om toe te zien op de overheid en daarover uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over prijsafspraken voor vruchtbaarheidsmiddelen

Opposition MP Klever asks the Health Minister about reported price agreements for fertility drugs that may have excluded cheaper products and breached competition law. The minister says she was not involved or informed of the alleged agreements, defends negotiations between providers and manufacturers as lawful, and refers competition oversight to the ACM.
I am not involved in the alleged price agreements and am therefore not aware of their content.
Ik ben niet betrokken bij vermeende prijsafspraken en ben van de inhoud dan ook niet op de hoogte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over het bericht dat het Rijk met verkeerde cijfers rekent en dat het bouwen van windmolens op zee veel duurder gaat uitpakken

PVV MPs Klever and De Graaf asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the government miscalculates offshore wind costs, including whether a 40% cost reduction derives from industry figures and whether tourism job losses were assessed. The minister said a feasibility study on wind within the 12-mile zone is nearing completion, that cost reduction depends on several factors, and that environmental impact assessments already cover tourism effects, so separate reporting is unnecessary.
I hope to be able to inform the House about the results in the first half of 2014.
Ik hoop de Kamer in de eerste helft van 2014 over de resultaten te kunnen informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever naar aanleiding van beantwoording van vragen over het bericht dat overheidssubsidie voor duurzame energie moet worden beperkt tot bedrijven die nieuwe productiemethodes introduceren

MP Klever asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the extra innovation subsidy of 116 million euro for the Noordoostpolder wind park, including the cost per kWh, the grid connection costs and the subsidy deadlines. The minister answered that the subsidy covers 92 million for offshore-style turbines in shallow water and 24 million for large onshore turbines, that these projects involve technical innovation, and that the subsidy works out at about 5.7 and 2.4 cents per kWh respectively.
There is 92 million euro available for wind turbines built in shallow water and 24 million euro for the wind turbines on land.
Er is 92 miljoen euro beschikbaar voor windturbines die gerealiseerd worden in ondiep water en 24 miljoen Euro voor de windturbines op het land
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de hoge kankersterfte in Nederland

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister whether high cancer mortality in the Netherlands relates to care avoidance due to co-payments, to high cancer drug prices, whether a maximum reimbursement should be introduced, and whether action will follow a Lancet study. The minister answered that the study covers 2000-2007 when co-payments were limited, sees no link to drug prices, rejects the need for a maximum reimbursement while describing price arrangements, and sees no reason for specific action.
I see no reason to take specific action in response to this study.
Ik zie geen reden om naar aanleiding van dit onderzoek specifieke actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Van Klaveren over multiresistente bacteriën bij deelnemers aan de jihad in Syrië

MPs Klever and Van Klaveren asked whether returning jihadists from Syria could carry multi-resistant bacteria, whether they are screened and whether they should be quarantined. The minister answered that hospital isolation rules apply only to patients treated abroad, that ordinary travellers are not a risk group, and that quarantine is unnecessary, while prosecution is for the public prosecutor.
Because the risk of spread is limited and no different from that of ordinary travellers, it is unnecessary to place this person in quarantine.
Omdat het risico op verspreiding beperkt is en niet anders dan bij «gewone» reizigers is het onnodig deze persoon in quarantaine te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Klever over het bericht ‘Miljoenensubsidie voor taxi's die amper reden’

Two PVV MPs asked about press reports of a subsidy for taxi firm Prestige GreenCab that barely operated, asking how the former director behaved, how the money would be recovered, and what electric-driving subsidy projects exist with measurable targets. The minister answered that the project submitted incomplete financial proof, the subsidy was set at zero with a six-week objection period before recovery, and listed the subsidy programmes with their monitoring and disbursement rules.
On that basis, AgentschapNL decided on 16 December to set the subsidy for the project at zero.
Op grond daarvan heeft AgentschapNL op 16 december jl. besloten de subsidie van het project vast te stellen op «nihil».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de fors stijgende energierekening

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that grid costs and the household energy bill would rise sharply due to green electricity, and asked for a breakdown of current and projected bills. The minister answered that grid integration costs are uncertain, gave 2012 and 2013 bill breakdowns and forward price and surcharge trends, and said the energy bill is not expected to rise sharply on grid costs alone, pointing to ACM's regulatory oversight of grid operators.
It is not possible to give an exact prediction of the future development of the overall energy bill.
Het is niet mogelijk om een exacte voorspelling te geven van de toekomstige ontwikkeling van de gehele energierekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over het bericht dat overheidssubsidie voor duurzame energie moet worden beperkt tot bedrijven die nieuwe productiemethodes introduceren

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that EU state aid rules would restrict renewable energy subsidies to innovation, what this means for the Dutch SDE+ scheme, and the innovation subsidy for the Noordoostpolder wind park. The minister replied that the Commission's guidance is not an instruction to limit subsidies to innovation, that SDE+ already uses competitive allocation, that wind parks can be innovative, and that the subsidy goes to the project initiators with budgets reserved until 2016.
As is customary after the publication of a Commission Communication, the cabinet will shortly send you a BNC fiche with a more extensive explanation of the Dutch position.
Zoals gebruikelijk na het verschijnen van een Mededeling van de Commissie zal het kabinet u binnenkort een BNC-fiche met daarin een meer uitgebreide toelichting op het Nederlandse standpunt sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht ‘Half miljoen werklozen, ook bakkers en slagers; Chemiesector vreest ontslaggolf door hoge energierekening’

MP Klever (PVV) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he shares fears of mass layoffs in the chemical sector due to high energy costs, how this fits with the Energy Agreement's job projections, and whether structural measures beyond ETS compensation are needed. The minister acknowledged pressure on chemical competitiveness, pointed to a roundtable with industry and a letter on agreed measures, argued the Energy Agreement lowers energy cost increases and creates investment-driven jobs, and provided the Deloitte report.
The report referred to, commissioned by the VNCI, is attached as annex 4 to this letter.
Het bedoelde rapport, dat is opgesteld in opdracht van de VNCI, is als bijlage 4 bij deze brief gevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de gevaarlijk hoge werkdruk van co-assistenten

An MP asked the health minister how to respond to reports that co-assistants (medical students in clinical rotations) face dangerously high workloads, and what causes it and what measures exist. The minister answered that the 46-hour maximum study load is acceptable, that causes are psychosocial and tied to the transition to clinical practice, that faculties offer support measures, and that patient safety is protected by supervision.
Only on the instruction of a supervising doctor on site may the co-assistant treat a patient themselves.
Slechts in opdracht van een superviserend arts ter plekke mag de coassistent een patiënt zelf behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over nut, noodzaak en kosten van windenergie

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the public should vote on the Energy Agreement, why the costs are not 70 billion euro, what analysis shows the country needs wind farms, and whether citizens should be consulted on wind parks. The minister answers that the Netherlands is a representative democracy, that the agreement has broad support, that the 70 billion figure is incorrect, and that wind energy is needed to meet EU renewable targets.
The Netherlands is a representative democracy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over het bericht “Ingreep in emissiehandel wekt woede van Tata Steel”

PVV MPs Klever and De Graaf asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Netherlands pushes to strengthen the EU ETS while compensating energy-intensive firms like Tata Steel, and whether the cross-sectoral correction factor fits the Steel Action Plan. The minister answered that the correction factor is mandated by the EU Directive and cannot be changed without revising it, and defended the ETS as the central instrument, with Dutch efforts focused on post-2020 safeguards for internationally competitive firms.
This intervention is however in line with the European emissions trading directive (ETS).
Deze ingreep is echter in lijn met de Europese richtlijn emissiehandel (ETS).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over valse declaraties door nep-artsen en nep-zorginstellingen door het gebruik van valse artsencodes

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister how fraud with fake doctor codes (AGB-codes) in healthcare declarations could occur so widely, whether insurers do enough to check it, and what sanctions and prevention measures are planned. The minister answered that no signals of large-scale fraud are known, announced periodic checks of the AGB register against public registers from November 2013, and described existing sanctions while stating that the insurers' role and sanction powers are not hers to impose.
Vektis, the manager of the AGB registration, will periodically check the files in the short term.
Vektis, de beheerder van de AGB-registratie, gaat op korte termijn de bestanden periodiek controleren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over de afkoopsom van een ex-bestuurder van het Langeland Ziekenhuis

An MP asked the health minister about a severance payment to a former board member of Langeland Ziekenhuis, and whether such payments can be reclaimed or board members held liable. The minister said the supervisory board, not the government, must act, that the Wnt pay cap is in force, and that she has no instrument to recover the payment.
I have no instrument for such an action. It is the supervisory board that could take action in this matter.
Ik heb geen instrument voor een dergelijke actie. Het is de Raad van Toezicht die in dezen tot actie over zou kunnen gaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over de berichtgeving inzake de opmars van de gevaarlijke Aziatische tijgermug in Nederland en de lakse aanpak van de overheid

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister how the government will respond to press reports that the Asian tiger mosquito is spreading in the Netherlands and that the government is lax in tackling it, including health risks, lessons from Q-fever, whether a voluntary covenant with the tyre industry is ineffective, and whether importers should be required to import mosquito-free goods as Australia does. The minister answered that she had already set out her policy in a June letter, that the measures are proportionate given limited scientific knowledge and uncertainty, that the covenant will be evaluated after summer 2014, and that the goal is protecting public health without committing to mandatory import requirements.
After the summer of 2014 we will evaluate whether the covenant sufficiently prevents the introduction of Asian tiger mosquitoes.
Na de zomer van 2014 zullen wij evalueren of met het convenant de insleep van Aziatische tijgermuggen voldoende wordt voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat een aan alcohol verslaafde huisarts jarenlang zijn praktijk mag voortzetten van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister why an alcohol-dependent GP was allowed to continue his practice for years despite a court removing him, and why the IGZ inspectorate had not referred him to the College Medisch Toezicht. The minister answered that the IGZ is investigating the GP's functioning and will act if patient safety is at stake, announced new powers for temporary suspension and a sector-wide enforcement framework, and explained the limits of the CMT referral route.
Within disciplinary law I want to create the possibility to immediately suspend a healthcare professional by way of an interim measure.
In het kader van het tuchtrecht wil ik de mogelijkheid creëren om een beroepsbeoefenaar bij wijze van voorlopige voorziening direct te schorsen
Antwoord vragen Klever over de stortvloed aan operatiefouten

An MP asks the minister how she will tighten supervision of surgical teams after reports of procedural failures and unrecorded errors, and whether providers should pay for corrective care. The minister says the inspectorate will make unannounced visits to 20 hospitals, prosecute wrong-site surgery cases before the disciplinary court, and that providers should pay for care caused by negligence.
The inspectorate will make unannounced visits to the operating departments of 20 hospitals in 2013.
Zo bezoekt de inspectie in 2013 onaangekondigd de operatieafdelingen van 20 ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord vragen Klever over de vertrekbonus van de bestuursvoorzitter VUmc (VUmedisch centrum)

An MP asks the health minister about a four-million-euro departure bonus paid to the VUmc board chair despite Inspectorate concerns about patient safety, and whether it can be reclaimed and how wanbestuurders can be held accountable. The minister answers that the bonus was agreed in 1999 and paid under pre-Wnt rules, that no legal basis exists for reclaiming it, and that she plans a duty for supervisory boards to vet directors, a verklaring omtrent het gedrag, and personal liability for supervisors.
I therefore intend to explicitly impose a duty on supervisory boards to satisfy themselves that they appoint a capable director.
Ik ben daarom van plan de toezichthouders nadrukkelijk een plicht op te leggen om zich ervan te vergewissen dat zij een bestuurder aanstellen die capabel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht “Ziekenhuisfraude van 4 miljard per jaar”

An MP asked the health minister about reports that around 10% of hospital declarations are fraudulent, the NZa's capacity and enforcement record, whether insurers are checked, and whether a fraud reporting duty or government leadership is needed. The minister answered that the scale is unknown and a study is underway, detailed the NZa's inspections, fines and directives against hospitals, insurers and care providers, rejected a reporting duty, and left prosecution decisions to the Public Prosecution Service.
The NZa has had incorrect declarations in its sights for several years, for example an investigation started in 2009 at the Ommelander Ziekenhuisgroep in Winschoten.
De NZa heeft incorrecte declaraties al enige jaren in het vizier, denk bjivoorbeeld aan een in 2009 gestart onderzoek bij de Ommelander Ziekenhuisgroep te Winschoten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Klever over Iraanse gasexport naar Nederland

MPs De Roon and Klever asked whether the government would investigate Iranian claims of gas exports to the Netherlands in 2012 despite sanctions, and how it assessed existing Iran sanctions. The minister replied that the sanctions are effective, that the EU gas import ban only took effect on 21 December 2012 so no violation occurred for earlier exports, and that EU sanctions have territorial reach, so no international investigation is pursued, though the EU lobbies third countries to join.
As a result, there is no violation of sanctions if gas was exported to the Netherlands before that date.
Hierdoor is er geen sprake van overtreding van sancties indien voor die datum gas naar Nederland is geëxporteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de berichten “Antibraakmiddel eist mogelijk 100 levens” en “Onschuldige kwaal, fataal medicijn”?

PVV MP Klever asked the health minister about reports that the anti-nausea drug domperidone may cause around 100 deaths a year in the Netherlands, and whether it should be removed from the market or made prescription-only. The minister said the figure is a rough estimate from a 2005 study, noted that pharmacists check patients' risk factors before supplying it, and stated that the EU medicines authorities, not the minister, decide on market withdrawal or classification, with a re-evaluation underway.
I am not competent to withdraw domperidone from the market nor to change the classification status of domperidone.
Ik ben niet bevoegd Domperidon uit de handel te nemen noch om de indelings-status van Domperidon te wijzigen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over de berichten  “Aziatische tijgermug heeft zich in Nederland gevestigd” en “Misverstand over tijgermug in Nederland”

The MP Klever (PVV) asked the health minister about reports that the Asian tiger mosquito had established itself in the Netherlands, and about how the ECDC map distinguished introduction from establishment. The minister answered that the map error stemmed from repeated introductions being categorised as establishment, that the mosquito has been introduced but not established, and that monitoring, biocide treatment of imported plants and a contingency plan are in place.

As the director of the Centre for Infectious Disease Control of the RIVM indicated in response to reports including in De Volkskrant, the tiger mosquito has been introduced in the Netherlands but not established.

Zoals de directeur van het Centrum Infectieziektebestrijding van het RIVM in reactie op de berichten in o.a. de Volkskrant heeft aangegeven, is de tijgermug in Nederland wel geïntroduceerd maar niet gevestigd.
Antwoord vragen Klever over de gevolgen van de energietransitie voor onze werkgelegenheid, concurrentiepositie en staatskas

An MP from the PVV asked the economics minister about the effects of the energy transition on jobs, competitiveness and state revenue, citing German criticism and a TNO report, and asked whether the government would pause to analyse these consequences first. The minister replied that the Netherlands pursues a cost-efficient transition via SDE+ and innovation, gave a table of declining gas revenues to 2017, and said the SER national energy accord will model economic and affordability effects before it is finalised in summer.
In the Netherlands we aim for a cost-efficient transition to a sustainable energy supply.
In Nederland streven we naar een kostenefficiënte overgang naar een duurzame energievoorziening.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht «EU leitet Beihilfeverfahren gegen Deutschland ein»

An MP asked the Economics minister whether the EU's state-aid investigation into German energy transport-cost exemptions affects Dutch industry, notably aluminium smelter Aldel, and what the government will do to protect jobs. The minister answered that the investigation supports the Dutch position, that a Dutch scheme capped at 50% should not be treated as unlawful aid, and that EU rules apply equally to all member states.
I will maintain contact with the EC to stay informed about the possible shape of European legal frameworks regarding a large-consumer scheme.
Ik zal contact onderhouden met EC om op de hoogte te blijven van de mogelijke invulling van Europese juridische kaders omtrent een grootverbruikerregeling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat het Catharina Ziekenhuis een frauderende arts in dienst houdt

MP Klever asks the minister why she relied on an accountant's and insurer's findings rather than checking with the NZa about alleged fraud by a doctor at Catharina Ziekenhuis, and whether a fraud investigation is warranted. The minister explains the answers were based on those findings, that she was unaware of the NZa's own investigation, and that she will await its results rather than order a separate inquiry.
As announced in this letter, I will inform the Chamber of the outcomes of the investigation.
Zoals in deze brief aangekondigd zal ik de Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Klever (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een gelekte lijst met 1000 medische fouten (ingezonden 21 februari 2013).

An MP asks the health minister about a leaked list of about 1000 medical incidents that the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) mistakenly gave to RTL Nieuws, and about the security of medical data held by the inspectorate. The minister acknowledges the leak should not have happened, cannot guarantee it will not recur, points to an ongoing improvement process, and commits to more transparency about medical incidents and inspectorate reports.
As I have stated before, I find it unacceptable that confidential information from the IGZ became known to RTL.
Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, vind ik het onacceptabel dat vertrouwelijke informatie van de IGZ bij RTL bekend is geworden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de Diane-35 pil

An MP asks the health minister how her earlier answers on the Diane-35 pill were compiled, why she was unaware of 97 new adverse event reports including 9 deaths, and how she explains that a newspaper had more information than she gave Parliament. The minister answers that Lareb and the CBG were aware of the reports by the day she answered, that timing was overtaken by events as reports kept arriving, and that she did not have the information Trouw reported on 1 March.
On 28 February, Lareb brought this data to the attention of the CBG.
Op 28 februari jl. heeft Lareb deze gegevens ter kennis gebracht bij het CBG.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat het Catharina Ziekenhuis een frauderende arts in dienst houdt

An MP asks the minister whether a hospital that kept a physician suspected of fraud can dismiss her, whether the NZa and IGZ should investigate, and what is being done about whistleblowers and a duty to report fraud. The minister replies that the hospital found no fraud, only improper billing that was repaid, so there is no legal ground for dismissal and no need for NZa or IGZ action, while referring whistleblower protection to a separate initiative and rejecting a reporting duty as too burdensome.
Since this does not concern fraud, there is no legal ground for dismissal (given existing case law).
Aangezien het hier niet gaat om fraude is er geen juridische grond voor ontslag (gegeven bestaande jurisprudentie).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over de Diane-35 pil

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister how she responds to France's plan to withdraw the Diane-35 pill, whether the Netherlands will do the same, and whether users can be assured it is safe. The minister replied that the CBG, not the minister, decides on market withdrawal, that an EU safety review is underway with the Netherlands as rapporteur, and that patients should consult their doctor rather than stop.
I am not authorised to withdraw medicines from the market.
Ik ben niet bevoegd geneesmiddelen uit de handel te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klever, Van Klaveren en Wilders over de poging van de KNVB om de mening van een scheidsrechter te verbieden

MPs from the PVV asked the minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the KNVB's attempt to silence a referee who had made comments on social media about Moroccan youth problems. The minister said the KNVB respects free speech but was concerned about offensive posts, that it is for the KNVB to set its own rules, and declined to summon the KNVB board or demand an apology.
I leave it to the KNVB to choose its own course within the federation.
Ik laat het aan de KNVB om binnen de bond daarin een eigen weg te kiezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever, Bosma en Wilders over het bericht “Graaiers moeten inleveren”

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Health why top salaries in the public and semi-public sector keep rising, whether pay rises before the WNT pay-cap took effect were improper, and whether executives who sued to escape the cap should be pursued. The minister defended the WNT and its transitional rules, said there is no evidence of pre-emptive pay rises, and stated that challenging government decisions in court is a right.
Anyone is free to have government decisions reviewed by the court.
Het staat een ieder vrij om beslissingen van de overheid door de rechter te laten toetsen.
Antwoord vragen Klever over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars te duur hebben ingekocht

An MP asks the health minister about reports that health insurers overpaid hospitals in 2012 through lump-sum contracts, including payments for unproduced care and fewer patients. The minister replies that the picture is not yet clear, that contracting is the responsibility of individual insurers and hospitals, that only delivered care may be paid, and that an expert commission's report is expected by 1 April.
I hope to obtain such an overview, but that will still take some time.
Ik hoop een dergelijk overzicht te krijgen, maar dat zal nog wel enige tijd duren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht “Ziekenhuisfusies zonder winnaar”

An MP from the PVV asks the health minister about reports that hospital mergers in the Netherlands have pushed hospitals beyond optimal size, raising costs, and whether the competition regulator should get stronger tools and the burden of proof on mergers should be reversed. The minister replies that optimal size is not absolute, that mergers are neither inherently undesirable nor desirable, that a pending bill adds mandatory merger impact reports and a care-specific merger test by the NZa, and that she sees the existing two-track merger review as adequate.
As long as the bill establishing the care-specific merger test has not been adopted, I write to all hospitals that indicate they want to merge and point them to the provisions of that bill.

Zolang het wetsontwerp dat de zorgspecifieke fusietoets (zie verder hieronder) nog niet is aangenomen schrijf ik alle ziekenhuizen die aangeven te willen fuseren aan en wijs ik hen op de bepalingen uit dat wetsontwerp.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over de ontwikkelingen rondom neuroloog Jansen Steur

MP Klever (PVV) asked the health minister about reports that neurologist Jansen Steur obtained a German post via the Inspectorate for Healthcare (IGZ), about an IGZ settlement with him, whether voluntary BIG-register deregistration is possible, why he was not suspended in 2003, and how to prevent doctors from deregistering voluntarily and to require background checks at job applications. The minister answered that the answers depend on how the German hospital handled IGZ information, that voluntary deregistration is possible at any time, and referred most questions to paragraph 4 of the accompanying letter.
I refer you to paragraph 4 of the accompanying letter.
Ik verwijs u naar paragraaf 4 van de begeleidende brief.
Antwoord vragen Klever over het hoge aantal sterfgevallen in het Ruwaard van Putten ziekenhuis in Spijkenisse

An MP asked the health minister about the high number of deaths at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital in Spijkenisse, why this surfaced only now, how patients and relatives are informed, and when inspection findings will come. The minister described the inspectorate's measures (admission stop, transfer of cardiology patients, supervised supervision, a ban on the cardiology group), the communication channels, and that results depend on ongoing investigations.
The IGZ is investigating whether patients of the doctors involved received the care they should have received under the professional standard.
De IGZ onderzoekt of patiënten van de betrokken artsen de zorg hebben gekregen die zij op basis van de professionele standaard hadden moeten krijgen
Antwoord vragen Klever over het bericht dat Amerika mogelijk in het EPD (Elektronisch Patiëntendossier) kan kijken

An MP asked whether the Patriot Act or FISA could allow US authorities to access Dutch electronic patient records held through CSC, the US firm that built the national LSP. The minister said VZVZ demanded a guarantee from CSC, that Dutch privacy law must be complied with, and that the matter is raised at EU level, while leaving oversight to the IGZ and CBP.
I do not consider it acceptable that Dutch law and regulations are not applied and complied with.
Ik vind het niet toelaatbaar dat de Nederlandse wet en regelgeving niet wordt toegepast en nageleefd.
Antwoord vragen De Graaf en Klever over het bericht ‘Subsidie voor erotische zitzak’

MPs De Graaf and Klever asked the minister of Economic Affairs about a news report on a subsidy for an erotic beanbag, its public benefit, whether such subsidies are pointless, and a full list of innovation subsidies since 2005. The minister answered that the WBSO is a generic tax scheme judged effective, that the government does not determine project goals, and that fiscal scheme projects cannot be listed due to tax secrecy, while stating it will keep generic innovation schemes.
This is a generic fiscal scheme aimed at encouraging companies in all sectors of the economy to innovate.
Dit is een generieke fiscale regeling die er op gericht is bedrijven in alle sectoren van de economie aan te zetten tot innovatie.
Antwoord vragen Klever over het bericht dat patiënten van de Antonius apotheek geen medicijnen krijgen als zij niet aangesloten zijn op het EPD

An MP asked the health minister whether a hospital pharmacy really refuses medicines to patients not connected to the EPD, whether it should stop, whether other providers do this, and what measures will be taken. The minister answered that the hospital called the report incorrect, that patients decide themselves on EPD participation, that pharmacists have a duty of care, and that further measures or investigation are not needed.
The St Antonius Hospital labelled the report about not dispensing medication when the patient gives no consent for access to their data via the care infrastructure as incorrect and corrected it.

Het st Antonius Ziekenhuis heeft het bericht over het niet verstrekken van medicatie als de patiënt geen toestemming geeft voor inzage in zijn gegevens via de zorginfrastructuur als onjuist bestempeld en gecorrigeerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf, Klever, Graus, Bosma en Van Vliet over het bericht “Topsalaris staatsbedrijven nog ruim boven Balkenendenorm”?

PVV MPs asked whether state-owned enterprise executive pay exceeding the Balkenende norm should be clawed back, and whether the Balkenende norm is high enough. The minister replied that state holdings fall outside the Balkenende pay-cap law because they are not publicly funded, but that the state's pay policy for these holdings is assessed against its own framework, which will be revised.
state holdings do not fall under the Public and Semi-Public Sector Senior Officials (Remuneration) Act, because they are not financed with public funds
staatsdeelnemingen vallen niet onder de Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semipublieke sector, omdat zij niet met publieke middelen worden bekostigd
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat de Inspectie een neparts heeft aangehouden

An MP asked the health minister about a man who worked for years as an illegal doctor, whether the employing institutions would be held accountable, how often impersonation occurred, and whether patients were harmed or informed. The minister replied that the Inspectorate handed the case to the Public Prosecution Service, that employers are primarily responsible for verifying credentials, that no harmed patients have been identified, and that no further Inspectorate action is needed for now.
This investigation has been completed and the case will shortly be transferred to the Public Prosecution Service in connection with criminal offences.
Dit onderzoek is afgerond en de zaak wordt op korte termijn overgedragen aan het OM in verband met strafrechtelijke feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over financieel misbruik bij zorgverzekeraars

An MP asked the health minister about reported financial misuse by health insurers and whether the government would investigate, impose sanctions, and take measures. The minister replied that Zorgverzekeraars Nederland has set up an expert committee to examine signals, that no funds have yet been drawn from the Zvf, and that she will await the findings before deciding on sanctions or measures.
Before I make a statement about measures to be taken, I first want insight into the actual course of events and to assess whether there is a need to intervene.
Voordat ik een uitspraak doe over te nemen maatregelen wil ik eerst inzicht in de feitelijke gang van zaken en bezien of er noodzaak is om in te grijpen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over het medicijntekort

An MP asked the health minister about the rising number of unavailable medicines and whether shortages stem from the crisis or the preferential-pricing policy, and whether further shortages are expected. The minister answered that a project with IGZ, CBG and RIVM is studying causes and risk models, that preferential policy may contribute but insurers bear the duty of care, and that EU import rules on active ingredients may pose future risks.
At the end of this year both products will be delivered, after which the House of Representatives will be informed.
Eind dit jaar worden beide producten opgeleverd, waarna de Tweede Kamer zal worden geïnformeerd.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de terreurdreiging vanuit Pakistan en de Nederlandse wapenexport naar dat land

An MP asks the government about arms exports to Pakistan, alleged state support for jihadist terrorism, undisclosed radar exports, and India's concerns, and asks for full transparency on exports from 2021 to 2025. The government answers that licences are assessed against EU criteria, that a 27.2 million euro radar export was wrongly not reported to parliament, and it publishes a table of licences but does not comment on diplomatic talks.
The transaction concerned the export of parts of ships being built in Romania by the receiving party, with the Pakistani navy as end user.
De transactie betrof de uitvoer van delen van schepen waarmee in Roemenië door de ontvangende partij schepen werden gebouwd met als eindgebruiker de Pakistaanse marine.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Thijssen over de berichtgeving rondom de levering van kritieke grondstoffen uit China

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked about China's export licensing requirement on rare earths and magnets, its impact on Dutch industry, the role of the Netherlands Materials Observatory (NMO), and possible copper shortages. The ministers answered that the government was informed only hours before the measure, that companies face delivery delays and uncertainty without quantifying sectoral impact for security and confidentiality reasons, and that the government is raising the issue with the European Commission and working on supply security under the national raw materials strategy.
For security reasons and commercial confidentiality, no further statements can be made about specific Dutch sectors or individual companies most affected by the export control measure.

Vanuit veiligheidsoogpunt en bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid kunnen geen nadere uitspraken worden gedaan over specifieke Nederlandse sectoren of individuele bedrijven waarop de exportcontrolemaatregel de grootste impact heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over het bericht van WNL dat hulporganisaties met overheidsgeld rechtszaken aan zouden spannen

An MP asked whether Development Minister Klever wrongly implied that government funds paid for NGO lawsuits such as the Oxfam Novib F-35 case, and about the cost of the State's cassation appeal. The minister denied any inaccuracy, said the F-35 case was crowdfunded, confirmed NGOs may sue the State, and said no total cost overview of the F-35 procedures exists.
The ministry does not have a total overview of those costs.
Het ministerie beschikt niet over een totaaloverzicht van die kosten.
Antwoord op vragen lid De Korte over het beëindigen van de opschorting van importheffingen op Oekraïense producten per 6 juni 2025

An MP asked the government whether the EU's temporary suspension of import duties on Ukrainian products, ending 6 June 2025, would be reinstated and what its impact and Dutch position would be. The State Secretary answered that the suspension lapsed by operation of law, that the Commission is pursuing a permanent deepening of trade under Article 29 of the Association Agreement and adopted an implementing decision to bridge the gap, and that the Netherlands supports Ukraine while many questions were answered only by restating policy.
Your House will be informed about this proposal.
Uw Kamer zal over dit voorstel worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Hirsch over de verwerking van ingezamelde kleding door modeketens

MPs Gabriëls and Hirsch asked about Radar's finding that clothing collected by fashion chains is often exported to developing countries rather than reused or recycled, and about transparency, consumer information, enforcement and export rules. Minister Madlener answered that export data and transparency are limited, that the UPV Textiel reporting and enforcement are still being built out, and that the revised EU waste shipment regulation and waste framework directive will tighten export rules from 2027.
There is currently little transparency about what happens to the clothing after it has been collected.
Er is op dit moment weinig transparantie over wat er met de kleding gebeurt nadat het is ingezameld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Piri en Dobbe over geweld tegen hulpverleners

MPs Hirsch, Piri and Dobbe asked the government about attacks on aid workers in Sudan and Gaza, EU sanctions and trade talks with the UAE, accountability and the scope of Dutch jurisdiction under the International Crimes Act.
