The Minister condemns attacks on aid workers, says accountability is primarily a matter for the states concerned and international courts, and declines to commit to new sanctions, extra funding or state liability claims due to budget constraints and legal conditions.
Given the sensitive nature of such considerations and discussions at European level, I cannot make further statements on this.
Gezien de gevoelige aard van dergelijke overwegingen en besprekingen in Europees verband kan ik daar geen verdere uitlatingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over het stopzetten van grootschalige voedselhulp in Ethiopië

Two SGP MPs asked the government about the WFP halting food aid to 650,000 malnourished women and children in Ethiopia due to funding shortfalls, its consequences, risks to peace in Tigray, the funding gap, and Dutch and EU options to help. Minister Klever answered that 3.6 million people risk losing aid, that Dutch contributions (EUR 60 million to WFP, EUR 9 million to the Ethiopia humanitarian fund) cannot offset large US aid cuts, and that the government is raising the issue within the EU and other donor fora.
The Netherlands has managed to keep the humanitarian aid budget at its level, but it is impossible for the Netherlands to compensate for large global reductions in life-saving aid.
Nederland heeft het budget voor humanitaire hulp op peil weten te houden, maar het is voor Nederland onmogelijk om forse wereldwijde reducties in levensreddende hulp te compenseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht '150.000 extra hiv-doden in Afrika verwacht na stop hulp uit VS'

An SP MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that US aid cuts to PEPFAR could cause up to 150,000 extra HIV deaths in Africa, and about Dutch contacts, GFATM and UNAIDS responses and international advocacy. The minister answered that the impact is uncertain, that the Netherlands is in contact with the US and partners and offers flexibility on existing funds, but says there is no room for extra investment due to budget cuts.
In this context the Netherlands advocates a sharper focus on core tasks and a reprioritisation, and a medium-term reorganisation of the global health architecture.
Nederland pleit daarbij voor een scherpere focus op kerntaken en een herijking van prioriteiten, en voor een herinrichting van de mondiale gezondheidsarchitectuur op de middellange termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Stoffer en Flach over het bericht Cryptomijnen in een land onder hoogspanning

MPs Van Dijk, Stoffer and Flach asked the ministers whether Dutch and EU rules apply to Dutch firms mining crypto in Ethiopia, and about its benefits, its effect on the local population's electricity, and the government's moral view. The minister answered that OECD and UN business standards apply, that crypto mining brings foreign currency but little direct benefit to the population, and that no additional legislation is needed.
The cabinet expects all Dutch companies operating internationally to apply the OECD Guidelines on responsible business conduct and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven die internationaal opereren dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen inzake maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen en de UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights toepassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Hoe christelijke donateurs in Nederland radicale Israëlische kolonisten steunen'

An MP asks the government about reports that Dutch Christian and Zionist foundations fund Israeli settlers building on the occupied West Bank, asking about legality, oversight, sanctions, tax status and prosecution. The government acknowledges the occupation is unlawful, says private relations are not prohibited but undesirable, states it does not monitor such financial flows, and declines to comment on individuals, prosecutions or tax status.

The cabinet does not conduct general supervision of financial flows abroad and therefore does not have information on where and for what purpose money from foundations such as Christenen voor Israël actually goes.

Het kabinet houdt geen algemeen toezicht op financieringsstromen richting het buitenland en beschikt daarom ook niet over informatie waar en met welke bedoeling geld van stichtingen zoals Christenen voor Israël exact naar toe gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de ontwikkelingen omtrent de strategische partnerschappen tussen de Europese Unie en Jordanië, Libië, Polen en Griekenland

An MP asked the government about the EU strategic partnerships with Jordan, Libya, Poland and Greece, covering the Commissioner's role, border management funding, Frontex and Europol roles, human rights conditionality, Libyan mass graves, Schengen evaluation of Poland and pushbacks. The government answered at length, largely describing EU instruments and Dutch positions, declining to publish the EUBAM Libya strategic review, and deferring some matters to Frontex, the Commission or later reports.
This review will not be made public.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht dat 15 hulpverleners zijn vermoord door het Israëlische leger

Parliamentarian Bamenga asked the government whether it considers the killing of 15 aid workers in Gaza by the Israeli army a war crime, what it is doing to investigate, whether it will impose consequences or restrict arms exports and military cooperation with Israël, and what it is doing to protect aid workers. Minister Veldkamp condemned the attack, reported the Israeli internal investigation and reprimand, said Nederland will call for an international investigation, and reviewed arms export licences and EU-Israel Association Agreement steps without ruling out further action.
In line with the Kahraman/Ceder motion, the Netherlands will call for an international investigation at the European level.
Nederland zal conform de motie Kahraman/Ceder ( 21 501-02, nr. 3107 ) in Europees verband oproepen tot een internationaal onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'EU to roll back Ukraine trade perks to protect its farmers'

An MP asked whether the minister knows of reports that the EU will roll back Ukraine trade concessions to protect its farmers, and whether the minister will press at the Foreign Affairs Council to avoid weakening trade liberalisation as the motion Paternotte/Kamminga requests. The minister confirms awareness, supports deeper reciprocal tariff liberalisation under the Association Agreement as more durable support, and calls for a smooth transition from the autonomous trade measures.
The cabinet supports Ukraine, including economically and in reconstruction.
Het kabinet steunt Oekraïne, ook op economisch gebied en in de wederopbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de hervatte Israëlische aanvallen op Gaza

MP Dobbe asked whether Israel unilaterally violated the Gaza ceasefire, what concrete pressure the government applied, why no sanctions or suspension of the EU Association Agreement or arms export restrictions were pursued, whether starvation and collective punishment amount to war crimes, and what the government thinks of Israeli protests. The minister answered that Nederland pressed for a return to the ceasefire through diplomatic channels, requested an evaluation of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the EU-Israel Association Agreement, withheld advisory documents on sanctions and export policy, and stated that Israel's humanitarian blockade conflicts with international humanitarian law.
Official advice on this concerns these elements and for that reason is not shared.
Adviezen hierover betreffen deze elementen en worden om die reden niet gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Piri over de IOB-evaluatie van het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers about the IOB evaluation of Dutch human rights policy, covering export credit insurance, trade missions to high-risk countries, and human rights in bilateral consultations. The minister responded that human rights are considered within export credit risk assessments, that budget cuts limit embassy capacity, that transparency of human rights impact assessments remains primarily a matter for project owners, and that trade missions will continue to receive risk briefings without making disclosure of the MVO self-scan a condition for participation.
The cabinet will therefore not make public disclosure of the individual companies' MVO self-scan a condition for participation in trade missions to high-risk countries.
Het kabinet zal openbaarmaking van de «MVO-zelfscan» van individuele bedrijven dus niet als voorwaarde voor deelname aan handelsmissies naar hoog-risicolanden stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het artikel ‘Despair Haunts Ramadan for Palestinians Displaced in West Bank.’

An MP asked the government about displacement of Palestinians in the northern West Bank, Israeli military operations, the Palestinian Authority's role in Jenin, humanitarian aid and prospects for return. The government answered that it is concerned, calls on Israel to act within international law, notes the PA's primary security responsibility in Area A, and says Israel has stated displaced Palestinians may not return to certain camps for the coming year.
The cabinet calls on Israel to show restraint and to act within the framework of international law.
Het kabinet roept Israël op tot terughoudendheid en om te handelen binnen de kaders van het internationaal recht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Thijssen over het artikel “Europa hééft wel grondstoffen voor halfgeleiders, maar kan er niet bij”

Two MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Development and of Economic Affairs about a newspaper article claiming EU critical-raw-materials partnerships have not proven effective, and how to reduce dependence through local value addition, recycling and concrete targets. The government answered that it is too early to judge the partnerships, stressed reciprocity, circularity and the National Raw Materials Strategy, and said it will study setting national targets once risks are better mapped.
It is a long process, so it is still too early to judge whether MoUs have proven effective.
Het is een lang proces, waardoor het nog te vroeg is te oordelen of MoU’s effectief zijn gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Hirsch over het EU-Mercosur-akkoord

MPs Teunissen and Hirsch asked the minister about the EU-Mercosur agreement's content and decision-making, including pesticides, deforestation, the rebalancing mechanism, labour rights and the Dutch appraisal. The minister replied that a full cabinet appraisal will come in spring 2025 after the final texts, and answered several technical points (EUDR scope, the EUR 1 billion fund, mixed-agreement procedure) while deferring most substantive questions to that appraisal.
The Chamber is expected to receive a cabinet appraisal of the EU-Mercosur agreement in the spring, based on the draft texts of the negotiated agreement of 6 December 2024.
Naar verwachting ontvangt uw Kamer in het voorjaar een kabinetsappreciatie van het EU-Mercosur akkoord op basis van de conceptteksten van het onderhandelaarsakkoord van 6 december 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ram over de onduidelijkheid rondom Nederlands belastinggeld bij USAID

An MP from the PVV asked the minister why EUR 18.5 million in Dutch aid funds sent to USAID since 2014 remains unclear regarding its use and possible repayment, and whether payments via USAID should stop. The minister answered that monitoring and reporting exist, that USAID's overdue report prevents assessment of whether funds were used as intended and whether repayment is due, and that no new contributions via USAID are currently planned.
Only on the basis of the report can I assess whether the amount was used for the intended goals, and whether (part of) the money must be repaid.
Op basis van de rapportage kan ik pas beoordelen of het bedrag is ingezet voor de beoogde doelen, en of (een deel van) het geld moet worden teruggestort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over de voorgenomen ontslagrondes bij UNHCR en IOM

MPs Bontenbal and Boswijk asked the minister about planned job cuts at UNHCR and IOM caused by US funding reductions, and about the impact on refugees and possible Dutch or EU responses. The minister confirmed the cuts and the US role as largest donor, gave 2024 Dutch contributions, expressed concern, but said the Netherlands cannot restore US funding, that it faces its own budget cuts, and that EU options are still being examined.
For 2025 these amounts are not yet known.
Voor 2025 zijn deze bedragen nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Hirsch, Van der Lee, Thijssen, Patijn, Haage en Kathmann over de gevolgen van Trumps handelsoorlog voor Nederland

Members of GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the economic and financial risks of Trump's tariff war for the Netherlands, including market volatility, Chinese import diversion, sector support, employment, pensions, purchasing power, dependence on US digital services and strategic dependencies. The minister answered that financial institutions are sound and monitored, that CPB will update its impact study, that no direct support to firms is planned, and that the government favours EU unity and diversification while declining to speculate on further measures.
Question 22: Do you have a picture of which undesirable strategic dependencies the Netherlands has on the US?
Vraag 22 Heeft u in beeld welke ongewenste strategische afhankelijkheden we in Nederland hebben ten aanzien van de VS?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het bericht 'Aantal Nederlandse handelsmissies afgenomen, ook fors minder opbrengst'

An MP asked the trade minister about a news report that the number of Dutch trade missions has fallen and yields have dropped, and how missions will be planned, targeted and involve business. The minister answered that business organisations and sector bodies are consulted twice yearly, that evaluations show satisfied participants, and that about twelve missions per year fits business needs, with upcoming missions to Italy, Indonesia and Japan.
Roughly twelve missions per year appears to fit well with the needs and capacities of business.
Ongeveer twaalf missies per jaar lijkt goed aan te sluiten bij de behoeften en mogelijkheden van het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Baarle over het rapport ‘Gaza and West Bank Interim Rapid Damage and Needs Assessment’

An MP from DENK asked the government about the World Bank/EU/UN damage and needs assessment for Gaza and the West Bank, covering casualties, reconstruction funding, humanitarian access, and Dutch aid. The minister answered that the government deplores the suffering, has pledged EUR 82 million in extra humanitarian aid plus EUR 20 million for reconstruction, condemns blockades of aid, and is in diplomatic talks with Israel and partners.
The cabinet has no overview of financial support by other countries for the reconstruction of the Gaza Strip.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van financiële steun door andere landen voor de wederopbouw van de Gazastrook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte, Sneller en Bromet over het voorgenomen staatsbezoek aan Kenia

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the planned Dutch state visit to Kenya, amid serious human rights violations under President Ruto, would legitimise his government and what concrete steps the government would take. The minister replied that a state visit is not a personal endorsement, that human rights concerns were raised privately with Kenyan authorities and in public signals, and that Nederland will continue joint EU and partner statements.
During the visit I conveyed my concerns about the human rights situation in discussions with my counterpart.
Tijdens het bezoek heb ik mijn zorgen over de mensenrechtensituatie overgebracht in de gesprekken met mijn ambtsgenoot.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Eerdmans over invoering van importheffingen op Amerikaanse producten

MP Eerdmans asked whether EU countermeasures against US tariffs, which may include food products such as meat and nuts, should be avoided given rising grocery costs, and cited a Rabo report on price effects. Minister Klever confirmed the US steel and aluminium tariffs and the EU list including food, said food should be assessed product by product, and gave no commitment to remove food from the list.
For the Netherlands this is an important point of attention in its efforts in Brussels regarding this list.
Dit is voor Nederland een belangrijk aandachtspunt bij de inzet in Brussel ten aanzien van deze lijst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Korte en Koops over bijdrage aan Anti Corruptie Rechtbank Oekraïne

Two MPs asked whether the Dutch government's refusal to fund the selection committee for Ukraine's High Anti-Corruption Court, after US funding was withdrawn, conflicts with its constitutional and treaty duties to support the international legal order and anti-corruption. The minister answered that the committee was never Dutch-funded, that other donors covered the gap, that Nederland supports anti-corruption in Ukraine, and that it is assessing the impact of the US funding freeze.
Nederland is currently assessing, together with other countries, the exact consequences of the freeze or termination of American aid, in the short and longer term.
Momenteel inventariseert Nederland in samenwerking met andere landen welke gevolgen de bevriezing dan wel stopzetting van Amerikaans hulp precies heeft, op de korte en langere termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het bericht ‘Rabo: heffingen VS kunnen Nederland €12 mrd gaan kosten’

An MP asked the trade minister about possible US tariffs of 25% on EU goods, their effects on Dutch food, beverage and other firms, possible relocation to the US, and EU-US trade relations. The minister said tariffs are only announced, with no executive order yet, that the effects depend on timing, height and scope, and that the government is in dialogue with both the US and the EU while preparing countermeasures.
No executive order has been published since the announcement that gives further substance to it.
Er is sinds de aankondiging geen uitvoeringsbesluit (executive order) gepubliceerd dat hier nadere invulling aan geeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Troebele Hollands glorie in de Baai van Manilla: hoe baggeraar Boskalis zich vertilde aan een prestigeproject'

MPs Hirsch and Van der Lee asked about the Dutch export credit guarantee for the Manila Bay airport project by Boskalis and San Miguel, raising sea-level rise, habitat compensation, relocated families and transparency concerns. The government answered that the project meets international standards, that compensation is being monitored and largely delivered, and that it sees no reason to change its decision.

An independent evaluation of the monitoring of this project, recently shared with your House, shows that it is robust and adequately designed to address any irregularities in implementation in a timely manner.

Uit een onafhankelijke evaluatie van de monitoring van dit project die recent met uw Kamer is gedeeld, blijkt dat deze robuust is en adequaat is ingericht om eventuele misstanden in de uitvoering tijdig te adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Piri en Dobbe over de situatie in de Democratische Republiek Congo en de rol van de Europese Unie

MPs Hirsch, Piri and Dobbe asked the government about the humanitarian crisis in eastern DRC, the effects of the US freeze of USAID, the EU-Rwanda raw materials memorandum, sanctions and MONUSCO. The ministers answered that the Netherlands funds humanitarian aid, calls for a ceasefire and Rwandan withdrawal, supports EU discussions on suspending the MoU and sanctions, and will send a separate letter on the humanitarian situation and MONUSCO.
The Netherlands raises Rwanda's support for M23 and its violation of DRC sovereignty bilaterally, through the EU and through the International Contact Group for the Great Lakes.
Nederland spreekt Rwanda bilateraal, via de EU, en via de International Contact Group for the Great Lakes (ICG) aan op zijn steun voor M23 en zijn schending van de soevereiniteit van de DRC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Dobbe en Boswijk over het bericht 'Goudkoorts blokkeert de weg naar vrede in Sudan'

MPs Ceder, Dobbe and Boswijk asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about gold trade fuelling the Sudan conflict, arms diversion, Russian involvement, EU sanctions and humanitarian response. The ministers answered that the Netherlands shares the concerns, points to existing EU conflict-minerals and forced-labour rules, the CSDDD and arms embargoes, and says it is pushing for EU engagement, a contact group and humanitarian exemptions, without committing to new concrete measures on gold imports.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies to act in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises on responsible business conduct.
Het kabinet verwacht dat Nederlandse bedrijven ondernemen in lijn met de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen inzake maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Boswijk over het artikel 'Rebels Backed by Rwanda Announce Capture of Key City in Eastern Congo'

MPs Bamenga and Boswijk asked about the M23 advance in eastern DRC, the humanitarian situation, Dutch and EU responses, and the EU-Rwanda critical minerals memorandum. The government answers that Dutch humanitarian funding continues, that Rwanda is being pressed bilaterally and in the EU to halt support for M23, and that the minerals MoU is under discussion for possible suspension.
Due to the confidentiality of this process, the cabinet cannot make further statements on this.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van dit proces kan het kabinet hier verder geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de berichten ‘Oppermachtig Rwanda is in Congo vooral op zoek naar kostbare grondstoffen’ en 'EU speelt gevaarlijk dubbelspel met Rwanda in Congo'

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the foreign and trade ministers about reports on Rwanda's role in eastern Congo, including the Rwandan army's control over M23, humanitarian aid for displaced people, sanctions, the ambassador's summoning, and the EU-Rwanda raw materials MoU. The ministers answered that the Netherlands shares the UN view of Rwandan support to M23, has pressed Rwanda bilaterally and in the EU, backs sanctions and a suspension of the MoU, and funds humanitarian aid and responsible mineral supply chains.
The Netherlands shares the UN's view on Rwandan support to M23, as also shown in reports of the UN Group of Experts.
Nederland deelt de visie van de VN over de Rwandese steun aan M23, zoals ook aangetoond in rapporten van de VN Group of Experts .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het bericht “EU zal terugslaan na Trumps heffingen op import van staal en aluminium.”

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade about US tariffs on EU steel and aluminium, the scope and timing of EU countermeasures, and the impact on Dutch firms such as Tata Steel. The minister answered that the US measures reactivate 2018 tariffs with a wider product scope and that the EU will decide on countermeasures in coming weeks, while giving no firm commitments on specifics.
At European level it will be decided in the coming weeks whether and how the countermeasures will be reactivated, after studying the American implementing decisions.
In Europees verband zal in de komende weken worden besloten of en hoe de tegenmaatregelen worden gereactiveerd, na bestudering van de Amerikaanse uitvoeringsbesluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over een mogelijke wapenleverantie aan Israël door een schip onder Nederlandse vlag

An SP MP asked whether the Dutch-flagged vessel Nordic carried military goods from India to Israel, and what policy applies to Dutch-flagged ships transporting arms to Israel. The government confirmed the ship flies the Dutch flag, said it has no specific policy on arms transport by Dutch-flagged ships beyond sanctions, and reported very limited transit of military goods to Israel via Rotterdam, with the last transit notification in 2023.

The Netherlands has no specific policy on the transport of weapons by Dutch transport companies and/or ships sailing under the Dutch flag to or abroad, including to Israel, except where it falls under a sanctions measure.

Nederland voert geen specifiek beleid ten aanzien van het vervoer van wapens door Nederlandse transportbedrijven en/of schepen varend onder Nederlandse vlag naar of in het buitenland, dus ook niet naar Israël, behalve indien dat valt onder een sanctiemaatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Piri over de beschieting van het Wereldvoedselprogramma door Israëlische troepen

MPs Hirsch and Piri asked the government about the Israeli shooting at a clearly marked WFP convoy in January 2025, whether such attacks breach international humanitarian law, and whether the Netherlands signalled concern to Israel. The minister answered that attacks on humanitarian workers violate IHL, that a court and Israel itself must establish the facts before a breach can be judged, and that the Netherlands raised concerns with Israel and urged compliance.
The cabinet does not have all the relevant facts.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over alle relevante feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de Nederlandse steun aan projecten in de Palestijnse gebieden

An MP asked why certain Dutch-funded reconciliation projects in the Palestinian territories are hidden or anonymised on the aid portal, and whether the documents will be published. The minister answered that anonymity protects participants in sensitive reconciliation work, that the government refuses to publish the withheld documents, and that financial oversight follows the usual contractual and reporting routine.
To enable the organisations concerned to carry out reconciliation projects, it has been decided not to make this information public.
Om de betreffende organisaties in staat te stellen om verzoeningsprojecten uit te voeren wordt ervoor gekozen om deze informatie niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over bedrijven die verdienen aan illegale Israëlische nederzettingen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about companies profiting from illegal Israeli settlements, including financial links and pension fund investments, and whether the Dutch settlement discouragement policy and monitoring should be tightened. The minister answered that the government considers settlements unlawful, reaffirms the existing discouragement policy and corporate due diligence expectations for pension funds, and says the policy framework will be implemented in line with the ICJ advisory opinion without committing to new measures.

The cabinet will continue to vigorously implement the current national policy following the Court's advisory opinion and is also in contact with European partners on this matter, such as France and Germany.

Het kabinet zal het huidige nationale beleid nadrukkelijk blijven uitvoeren naar aanleiding van het advies van het Hof en houdt terzake ook met Europese partners contact, zoals met Frankrijk en Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de protesten in Mozambique

An MP asked the government about the post-election protests in Mozambique, police violence, Rwandan troops funded by EU money, and Dutch trade interests. The minister said the Netherlands condemns violence against civilians via the EU and bilaterally, denies that Rwandan troops are involved in repression, and sees no reason for independent investigation.
In my view there is no reason for an independent investigation.
Tot een onafhankelijk onderzoek bestaat naar mijn mening geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Martens-America over de artikelen `Energieminister Qatar dreigt gaslevering EU te stoppen` en `Topman Boskalis `verketterd` om kritiek op vestigingsklimaat

MPs Kamminga and Martens-America (VVD) asked the ministers about newspaper reports on Qatar threatening EU gas supply and on criticism of the investment climate, and about the impact of the CSDDD on competitiveness, compliance costs and implementation. The minister answered at length, largely defending the CSDDD and its Dutch implementation, promising ongoing dialogue and business support, and arguing that the Dutch law adds no extra requirements.
The cabinet endorses the goal of reducing regulatory burden, as also included in the coalition programme.
Het kabinet onderschrijft het doel van regeldrukvermindering, zoals ook opgenomen in het regeerprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht 'Israël saboteert stelselmatig Nederlandse ontwikkelingsprojecten voor Palestijnen'

An MP asked the minister whether Israeli forces and settlers have repeatedly destroyed Dutch-funded development projects in the West Bank, what compensation was sought, and what further action is planned. The minister confirmed incidents such as the Wadi al-Seeq raid and stated that damage is raised with Israeli authorities, pursued for compensation under the Knops motion, and that no compensation has yet been paid, while declining to provide a full incident list.
It is therefore not possible to share an overview of all incidents of the past ten years.
Het is dus niet mogelijk om een overzicht van alle voorvallen van de afgelopen tien jaar te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Van der Lee over een exportkredietverzekering (ekv) voor een project in Kazachstan

MPs Hirsch and Van der Lee asked about a 2014 Dutch export credit guarantee for a Van Oord canal project at Tengiz oil field in Kazakhstan, including corruption, UBO ownership of the debtor Tenizservice, environmental and social risk assessment, and monitoring. The ministers answered that no claims were paid, the project was assessed under the 2014 policy with risks judged mitigated, UBO identification was not then required, and monitoring was introduced only from 2022.
No, at the time the policy was issued monitoring was not yet laid down in the policy.
Nee, ten tijde van afgifte van de polis was monitoring nog niet vastgelegd in het beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Martens-America over het rapport 'Effect van Amerikaanse invoertarieven op de Nederlandse en Europese economie’ van het Centraal Planbureau

MPs Kamminga and Martens-America asked the ministers about the CPB report on the effects of US import tariffs on the Dutch and European economy, covering sectoral impacts, EU countermeasures, trade diversion, investment relocation, financing, ports and employment. The government answered that the report shows limited but real effects, pointed to existing EU trade instruments and business-support tools, and said it is too early to commit to specific measures on financing or employment.
It is too early to take measures on business financing.
Het is te vroeg om maatregelen te nemen rondom bedrijfsfinanciering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Hirsch over het bericht dat Nederland inzet op een bilaterale handelsrelatie met de VS

MPs Thijssen and Hirsch asked the ministers about reports that the Netherlands was pursuing a bilateral trade relationship with the US, including contacts with Trump's team, the role of the EU, and the risk of undermining joint EU trade policy. The government answered that it maintains broad stakeholder contacts, that trade policy is an exclusive EU competence while member states may pursue bilateral economic cooperation, and that it will keep coordinating within the EU while strengthening bilateral economic ties with the US.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Omtzigt over de situatie van Aramese christenen in Maaloula (Syrië)

Two MPs asked the government about reports of threats, forced expulsion and property seizures against Aramean Christians in Maaloula, Syria, by HTS-linked groups, and about Dutch efforts to protect minorities and HTS's status. The minister says the government has no information confirming sectarian incidents against Aramean Christians there, lists existing accountability and diplomatic efforts, and reviews HTS's terrorist listing and citizenship revocation rules without committing to new concrete measures.
The cabinet has no information confirming that sectarian incidents against Aramean Christians in Maaloula have taken place since the fall of the Assad regime.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die de berichten bevestigt dat er sinds de val van het Assad-regime sektarische incidenten hebben plaatsgevonden tegen Aramese christenen in Maaloula.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Westerveld, Paulusma, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Teunissen over de gevolgen van de overwinning van Trump voor vrouwen wereldwijd

Six MPs asked the ministers how Trump's return and the expanded Mexico City Policy (Global Gag Rule) would affect women's health and abortion access worldwide, and what the Netherlands would do to fill any gap. The minister confirmed awareness of the policy and Project 2025 but declined to speculate on US changes, pointing instead to a forthcoming development policy letter and continued Dutch commitment to partners.
The cabinet is not anticipating that.
Het kabinet loopt daar niet op vooruit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Hirsch over de uitkomsten van de COP29

Two MPs asked the Climate and Foreign Trade ministers whether they were satisfied with COP29's outcomes, including the climate finance goal, fossil fuel phase-down, and the protection of human rights and gender equality. The ministers answered that the Netherlands is partly satisfied, commits to the Paris goals and to a meaningful climate finance contribution, and points to further discussion in 2025 without committing to new funding.
The cabinet has chosen to first send the letter to the Chamber appraising the outcomes of COP29.
Het kabinet heeft ervoor gekozen om eerst de Kamerbrief met de appreciatie van de uitkomsten van COP29 te versturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ram over het langlopende conflict tussen Multraship en de Roemeense overheid

An MP asked the Minister of Foreign Trade and Development whether the government would press Romania to pay Terneuzen salvage firm Multraship an arbitration award unpaid for about 20 years, and what steps it would take. The minister answered that Romanian courts refused enforcement over procedural faults by Multraship, that the Netherlands is facilitating dialogue, and that the matter will be raised with the Romanian counterpart once a new government is in place.
Once a new cabinet has taken office I will raise this matter with my Romanian counterpart.
Zodra een nieuw kabinet is aangetreden zal ik deze zaak opnemen met mijn Roemeense counterpart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel 'Congres VS eist inzage in ASML-export naar China'

An MP asks the government about a US House committee's request to ASML and other chip-equipment makers for details of their China export sales, and about Dutch export-control and sanctions policy. The minister answers that the US request is a matter for ASML, that contacts with US authorities take place but their content is confidential, and that the Netherlands takes its own export-control measures for security reasons.
I will not comment on the content of those conversations for reasons of confidentiality.
Over de inhoud van die gesprekken doe ik omwille van de vertrouwelijkheid geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het advies van de Advocaat-Generaal aan de Hoge Raad inzake de export van F-35-onderdelen aan Israël

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the government about the Advocate-General's advice to the Supreme Court that the ban on F-35 parts exports to Israel may stand, including whether Israeli F-35 parts could reach Dutch channels and whether arms imports from Israel should be cancelled. The minister declined to comment on the advice while the case is pending, said no Dutch parts are known to reach Israeli jets, rejected claims of complicity in war crimes, and said defence procurement from Israel will continue where it offers the best equipment.
The cabinet cannot go into the substance of this now, as the case is still pending before the Supreme Court.
Het kabinet kan hier nu niet inhoudelijk op ingaan, aangezien de zaak nog voorligt bij de Hoge Raad.
Antwoord op vragen vragen de leden Kostić, Ram, Graus, Hirsch, Paternotte, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de wrede jacht op kangoeroes en de Nederlandse betrokkenheid daarbij

MPs from several parties asked the government about the cruel kangaroo hunt, Dutch imports of kangaroo meat and leather, and calls for an import ban. The Staatssecretaris answered that animal welfare concerns are shared, that Australia regulates its own hunting, that an import ban can only be set at EU level and must comply with WTO rules, and that a plan under a prior motion is being prepared; several answers were deferred.
Banning the import of a product from a country outside the European Union, in this case Australia, can only be arranged at European level.
Import van een product verbieden dat uit een land komt van buiten de Europese Unie, in dit geval Australië, kan alleen op Europees niveau geregeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Bamenga, Dobbe, Teunissen, Koekkoek en Van Baarle over de appreciatie van de Minister van het amendement Stoffer/Eerdmans

Six MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Aid whether her opposition to the Stoffer/Eerdmans amendment, which proposed cutting the Dutch UNRWA contribution from 19 million to zero or 9 million euro, still holds given the legal obligation to pay 19 million. The minister confirmed the amendment was revised to 15 million in 2025, and referred the substance of the appreciation questions to a letter of 6 December while declaring the timing questions no longer applicable.
On this matter your House has been informed by means of the letter of 6 December.
Hierover is uw Kamer geïnformeerd middels de Kamerbrief van 6 december jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Kamminga over het bericht 'Kabinet wil uitgeprocedeerde Afrikaanse asielzoekers naar Oeganda sturen'

MPs Rajkowski and Kamminga asked the government about reports that the cabinet wants to send rejected African asylum seekers to Uganda, and about migration deals with third countries, Uganda's anti-LGBTI law, and plans for return hubs. The minister confirmed that partnerships with third countries are a key element, said talks with Uganda are at an early exploratory stage, and declined to give figures, costs, timelines or a timeframe for answering.
The talks with Uganda are at an initial stage.
De gesprekken met Oeganda bevinden zich in een beginstadium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de catastrofale situatie in het Zamzam vluchtelingenkamp in Soedan

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the catastrophic situation in Zamzam camp in Sudan, including aid levels, air drops, an arms embargo, diplomacy, reconstruction, gender-sensitive aid, and sexual violence and accountability. The Minister answered that extra emergency funds were provided, that land access is preferred over air drops which are ruled out, that the government pushed for a Sudan-wide arms embargo, and that it supports accountability mechanisms and documentation of atrocities.
Air drops are truly a last resort when other options have been exhausted.
Luchtdroppingen zijn echt een laatste redmiddel als andere opties uitgeput zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de staande overeenkomst met UNRWA voor de periode 2023–2025

An MP asked the minister how much of the annual 19 million euro UNRWA contribution is legally binding, asked for the 2023-2025 agreement, and asked whether it contains termination conditions. The minister referred to earlier letters, confirmed the contract has termination and conditional clauses (use only for the agreed programme, no use contrary to Dutch foreign policy, parliamentary budget approval), and quoted clauses allowing the minister to stop transfers and claim repayment.

Subsequent instalments for 2024 and 2025 will be transferred upon receipt of a written request for payment in the first quarter of the calendar year; but will be subject to prior parliamentary approval of the overall budget of the Minister.

Subsequent instalments for 2024 and 2025 will be transferred upon receipt of a written request for payment in the first quarter of the calendar year; but will be subject to prior parliamentary approval of the overall budget of the Minister.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Hirsch en Thijssen over het bericht 'Nederlands bedrijfsleven omarmt strengere Europese klimaatregels'

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the CSDDD climate duty for large companies, enforcement resources, business support and level-playing-field concerns. The minister said the Netherlands supports uniform EU implementation, funds supervision via HGIS resources, has ACM test enforceability, and will support companies with guidance while pushing for harmonised implementation abroad.
At the 2024 Spring Decision-Making, HGIS funds were allocated in the BHO budget for implementing and supervising the CSDDD legislation.
Bij Voorjaarsbesluitvorming 2024 zijn er HGIS-middelen gealloceerd op de BHO-begroting voor implementatie van en toezicht op de IMVO-wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de investeringsclaim die ExxonMobil indient vanwege het dichtdraaien van de Groningse gaskraan

An MP asked the government about ExxonMobil's investment arbitration claim under the Energy Charter Treaty over the closure of the Groningen gas field, including damages, transparency, third-party participation and parliamentary information. The government answered that it cannot yet disclose the claim amount, will seek maximum transparency subject to agreement or a tribunal decision, will keep parliament informed at key procedural moments, and rejects the claim as unfounded and overbodig.
The cabinet will inform the House at important procedural moments, as has also happened in earlier investment arbitration procedures against the State.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer op belangrijke procesmomenten informeren, zoals ook in eerdere investeringsarbitrageprocedures tegen de Staat is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Hirsch en Nordkamp over de handhaving van de internationale rechtsorde ten aanzien van Israël

Three GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about export licences for military and dual-use goods to Israel, journalist access to Gaza, and Israel's halt on visas for international NGO staff. The minister answered that two military export licences were granted since 7 October 2023, 28 dual-use licences in 2024, that F-35 parts and engines are no longer exported to Israel after the court ruling, and that Israel should allow journalists and aid workers access but no sanctions or consequences were announced.
The Netherlands calls on Israel to facilitate the work of aid organisations, including by improving visa issuance.
Nederland roept Israël op om het werk van hulporganisaties te faciliteren, inclusief middels verbetering van visumverlening.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Zeedijk over steun aan het maatschappelijk middenveld wereldwijd

MPs Hirsch and Zeedijk asked the minister about pressure on civil society worldwide, its role in supply chains and development, and whether the Civic Space Fund will be maintained. The minister largely agreed with the concerns and described existing business-NGO cooperation, but on the Civic Space Fund and the motion-based questions referred to a letter on new policy and gave no concrete commitment.
On the new policy I have informed you in the letter Future cooperation with civil society organisations in development aid.
Over het nieuwe beleid heb ik u geïnformeerd in de Kamerbrief Toekomst samenwerking met maatschappelijke organisaties in ontwikkelingshulp
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de ontkoppeling van ontwikkelingshulp

An MP asked whether the decision to decouple development aid from economic growth was discussed with coalition parties, and about a past statement by an NSC financial spokesperson denying it was discussed with his faction. The minister answers that the cabinet chose not to adjust the ODA budget to the new BNI forecast, reporting the decision was communicated via the budget documents and a letter, and declines to pre-empt the spring 2025 review.
The cabinet chose not to update the ODA budget in the budget for the new GNI forecast in the CPB's Macro-Economic Outlook, in light of the overall government-wide problems.

Het kabinet heeft ervoor gekozen om in de begroting het ODA-budget niet te actualiseren voor de nieuwe BNI-raming in de Macro-Economische Verkenning (MEV) van het CPB, in het licht van de totale Rijksbrede problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Van Nispen en Ceder over het artikel 'The brutal truth behind Italy’s migrant reduction: beatings and rape by EU-funded forces in Tunisia'

MPs Koekkoek, Van Nispen and Ceder asked the government about a Guardian report on abuses by Tunisian coast guard forces funded through EU migration cooperation, including rape, beatings, EU financing, and EU monitoring. The government answered that it has raised concerns with the European Commission, that EU funds must not contribute to human rights violations, that it has no independently verified evidence of several alleged abuses, and that it will keep raising human rights in bilateral and EU contacts.
The Netherlands has conveyed these concerns to the European Commission.
Nederland heeft deze zorgen bij de Europese Commissie kenbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op op vragen van het de leden Piri en Hirsch over de brief inzake het contact tussen de minister van Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingshulp en de Oegandese minister van Buitenlandse Zaken

MPs Piri and Hirsch asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about his meeting with Uganda's foreign minister, including whether returning rejected asylum seekers from the Netherlands to Uganda was discussed and whether a meeting report exists. The minister confirmed the letter, said asylum reception and returns were discussed (returns previously at official level), and said a report of the whole Uganda visit exists with the meeting included, though no separate report was made.
A report was made of the entire visit to Uganda. The conversation with the Ugandan Minister of Foreign Affairs is included in this report.
Van het gehele bezoek aan Oeganda is een verslag gemaakt. Het gesprek met de Oegandese Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken is in dit verslag opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Hirsch over recente ontwikkelingen in Israël-Palestina

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government how it views Israeli laws threatening UNRWA's operations in the occupied Palestinian territories, whether the Netherlands should join partner statements against them, and about humanitarian access, the Israeli 'General Plan' and possible responses. The government answered that the laws are worrying, that Israel as occupying power must ensure alternatives to UNRWA services and humanitarian access, and that it is too early to speculate on consequences while it presses Israel through bilateral, EU and UN channels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Zeedijk over het bericht «Hulpverlening aan Gaza dreigt verder in knel te komen: Israël verbiedt UNRWA»

MPs Kamminga and Zeedijk asked the minister about Israel's legislation banning UNRWA and its effects on humanitarian aid in Gaza and on Dutch funding. The minister answered that the laws threaten UNRWA's operations and aid in Gaza, that no other organisation can easily replace it, and that the Dutch annual contribution of EUR 19 million remains unchanged for 2022–2025.
The cabinet's position on the annual contribution remains unchanged.
Het kabinetsstandpunt met betrekking tot de jaarlijkse bijdrage blijft onveranderd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Van Campen over het bericht «Europese miljarden voor bestrijding migratie in Afrika komen nauwelijks goed terecht: «school zonder elektriciteit kreeg blender cadeau»»

MPs Kamminga and Van Campen asked the ministers whether the EUR 4.5 billion EU Trust Fund for Africa spent on curbing migration had real impact, following a European Court of Auditors report on poor spending. The minister answered that the government does not share the report's conclusion of negligible impact, accepts the auditors' recommendations, will press the Commission to implement them, and says there is no ready-made formula for migration control.
The Netherlands will firmly urge the European Commission to implement this and will ask the Commission to inform the member states about it.
Nederland zal er bij de Europese Commissie stevig op aandringen dat dit ook gebeurt en zal de Europese Commissie vragen de lidstaten hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Teunissen over het EU-Mercosur-verdrag

MPs Ouwehand and Teunissen asked how the government gives effect to the 'don't import what we may not produce' commitment, the 2023 motion to block any EU-Mercosur deal including agriculture, and what Nederland is doing on the deal. The minister replied that the cabinet will only take a position once negotiations conclude and the deal goes to the Council, that it has repeatedly signalled sensitivity over agriculture, and that the Commission's current focus is deforestation and the Paris Agreement rather than reopening agricultural market access.

The cabinet will only determine a position on a possible EU-Mercosur agreement once the negotiations have concluded and all necessary documents are submitted by the European Commission to the Council for decision-making.

Het kabinet zal pas een positie bepalen over een mogelijk EU-Mercosur akkoord wanneer de onderhandelingen zijn afgerond en alle daartoe noodzakelijke stukken door de Europese Commissie ter besluitvorming aan de Raad worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op van de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over het bericht dat “stokoude, slecht verzekerde tankers met Russische olie meermaals per dag langs de Nederlandse kust varen”

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked about reports that old, poorly insured tankers carrying Russian oil pass the Dutch coast hundreds of times, raising pollution risk, possible sabotage use, liability, legal options, sanctions effectiveness and oil refining loopholes. The minister replied that the Netherlands cannot block such vessels in international waters and relies on port state control, IMO and IOPC Fund measures, EU sanctions listings and continued work on sanctions evasion, while giving only general answers on future sanctions proposals.
It is not in the interest of the negotiations or the Dutch negotiating position to go further into detail on concrete proposals.
7 Het is echter niet in het belang van de onderhandelingen en de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie om verder in detail te gaan over concrete voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over het aanstaande werkbezoek aan Oeganda

The MP Hirsch asks the minister about a planned visit to Uganda, including whether the minister will meet NGOs opposing the EACOP oil pipeline, how the government assesses the project and the arrests of activists, and the anti-homosexuality law. The minister answers that the visit already took place in October, lists meetings held, says the government has no own appreciation of the pipeline, and states that human rights and the anti-LGBTI law were raised in the bilateral meeting with the Ugandan justice minister.
The cabinet has no own appreciation of this project and its consequences.
Het kabinet heeft geen eigen appreciatie van dit project en de gevolgen hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Kamminga over het bericht ‘Russen maken microchips met oude ASML-machines voor wapens’

MPs Van der Burg and Kamminga asked the ministers whether Russia is obtaining ASML spare parts and machines despite sanctions and what can be done about intermediaries. The government said it cannot confirm the reported shipment numbers or the number of machines in Russia, cites confidentiality, and says it works with the EU sanctions envoy and other partners to counter circumvention, while acknowledging that listing intermediaries takes time.
The cabinet cannot provide insight into the number and type of ASML machines in Russia.
Het kabinet kan geen inzicht geven in het aantal en het soort ASML-machines in Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Kamminga over vrouwenrechten in Afghanistan

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about Taliban restrictions on women's rights in Afghanistan, EU and UN engagement, sanctions and visas for Taliban members, and whether aid can be misused. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the restrictions, co-holds Afghanistan liable under CEDAW, keeps conditional aid and monitoring, and sees no case for a full aid stop.

The Netherlands, bilaterally and within the EU, strongly condemned this law and called on the Taliban to respect human rights and especially women's and girls' rights in line with international treaty obligations.

Nederland heeft bilateraal en in EU verband deze wet ten sterkste veroordeeld en de Taliban opgeroepen mensenrechten en vrouwen- en meisjesrechten in het bijzonder in lijn met internationale verdragsverplichtingen te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Boswijk over het wegschrijven van verwijzingen naar genderbeleid en SRGR in antwoorden op schriftelijke vragen

MPs Dobbe and Boswijk asked whether the ministry's edits to earlier written answers, which removed or softened references to Dutch gender policy, SRGR and investment in women's rights, changed policy. The minister answers that the edits are textual only, that women's rights, gender equality and SRGR remain part of Dutch foreign policy priorities, and that development policy details will follow later.
The mentioned changes are textual and do not represent a change in policy.
De genoemde wijzigingen zijn tekstueel en houden geen wijziging van beleid in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over de toespraak van Eurocommissaris Wopke Hoekstra op de TU Eindhoven op 2 september 2024

An MP asked the minister about Commissioner Hoekstra's speech on EU-China relations, unfair Chinese competition, cheap non-compliant imports such as TEMU, EV tariffs, and reducing dependence on China. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described existing EU trade defence instruments and ongoing investigations, and referred to government policy on strategic dependencies and raw materials without committing to new specific measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Aardbevingsslachtoffers Marokko zijn wanhoop nabij: 'Ze zijn ons vergeten'

An MP from DENK asked the minister about reports that earthquake victims in Morocco feel forgotten, including whether many remain in temporary housing and whether reconstruction is lagging. The minister acknowledged uneven reconstruction, described Dutch emergency funding of 5 million euro via the Red Cross and a 50 million euro Invest International contribution, and said the issue is raised internationally.
The importance of reconstruction and relief is raised in international contacts.
Het belang van wederopbouw en hulpverlening wordt in internationale contacten onder de aandacht gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het bericht “Ook PVV-Minister Klever geeft geld aan UNRWA in Gaza maar wel minder”

An MP from the VVD asked the foreign trade and development minister why 3 million euro earmarked for UNRWA was redirected to UNICEF, and what safeguards exist for UNRWA's neutrality and against Hamas links. The minister cited concerns about UNRWA neutrality, the Colonna review and its implementation, diversification of aid channels, and the handling of staff allegedly linked to the 7 October attacks.

The cabinet closely follows the implementation together with other donors, because it is important that the organisation takes all possible steps to minimise the chance of breaches of the neutrality principles.

Nederland volgt de implementatie nauwgezet met andere donoren, omdat het van belang is dat de organisatie alle mogelijke stappen zet om de kans op schendingen van de neutraliteitsprincipes te minimaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Eerdmans over de houding van het kabinet ten opzichte van UNRWA-financiering

Dutch MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the minister whether Dutch UNRWA funding could have reached Hamas, how UN investigations into staff were weighed in resuming funding, whether neutrality enforcement is adequate, and about future funding and diversification. The minister answered that UNRWA is subject to vetting, audits and the Colonna recommendations, that the staff investigations were inconclusive and led to dismissals, and that funding for 2023-2025 is committed and future budgets are not yet decided.
The cabinet, together with other donors, raised these concerns with both the organisation and the UN Secretary-General.
Het kabinet heeft, samen met andere donoren, deze zorgen aan de orde gesteld bij zowel de organisatie als bij de Secretaris-Generaal van de VN.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de humanitaire situatie in Soedan

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the official famine finding in Sudan, obstructed humanitarian access, diplomatic consequences, aid funding amid budget cuts, and arms export controls. The minister answered that the famine finding was shocking but not unexpected, that obstruction of aid violates humanitarian law, and that Netherlands is pressing parties and the EU on access, while noting multi-year aid commitments and deferring the effects of 2025 cuts to the budget.
The effects of the 2025 cuts under the coalition agreement will be communicated to you with the 2025 draft budget.
Over de effecten van de bezuinigingen uit het Hoofdlijnenakkoord in 2025 wordt u bij de ontwerpbegroting 2025 geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Martens-America over het bericht ‘Nederland wil export ASML naar China verder beperken’

MPs Kamminga and Martens-America asked whether the government plans to further restrict ASML's exports of chip-making machines to China, which tools and risks are involved, and how businesses are consulted. The minister denies a plan to restrict exports, describes a country-neutral export-control measure that requires licences rather than banning exports, and gives largely general answers, declining to give licence numbers and deferring to ASML on its own impact.
The cabinet does not make statements about individual licences to specific destinations.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over individuele vergunningen naar specifieke bestemmingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Thijssen over Chinese dreigementen om ASML van Chinese markt te weren

MPs Hirsch and Thijssen asked whether China has threatened to exclude ASML from its market, what the consequences would be, and whether the Netherlands will adopt additional US-style export restrictions. Minister Klever declined to discuss diplomatic contacts or speculate on impacts, stating that Dutch export controls are national security decisions and that further measures would be pursued multilaterally and in EU coordination.
The cabinet cannot go into the content of confidential diplomatic conversations.
Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op de inhoud van vertrouwelijke diplomatieke gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bamenga over de zorgwekkende humanitaire situatie in Zuid-Soedan

MPs Boswijk and Bamenga asked about the humanitarian crisis in South Sudan, donor conferences, resettlement of Sudanese refugees and Dutch contributions to peace efforts and budget cuts. The minister answered that Netherlands is a major humanitarian donor, that a separate donor conference is unlikely to yield substantial extra funds, that resettlement resumes under country-based policy, and that budget effects were already reported in the draft budget.
You were informed about the effects of the cuts from the Coalition Agreement in 2025 in the draft budget 2025.
Over de effecten van de bezuinigingen uit het Hoofdlijnenakkoord in 2025 bent u bij de ontwerpbegroting 2025 geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over twee artikelen inzake ASML

An MP asks the minister why export licences for ASML spare parts for Chinese customers will not be renewed, what the reasons and US contacts were, and what the economic and strategic consequences are. The minister answers that export controls are being extended to older lithography machines and related services for national security reasons, that each licence is assessed individually, and declines to disclose the content of talks with foreign partners.
I do not comment on the content of conversations with foreign partners, for reasons of confidentiality.
Over de inhoud van gesprekken met buitenlandse partners doe ik omwille van vertrouwelijkheid geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op de leden Kröger en Piri over het bericht 'Russisch staatsbedrijf sluist honderden miljoenen aan uraniumwinst door Nederland'

MPs Kröger and Piri asked the government about reports that Russian state company Rosatom earns hundreds of millions from uranium trade through the Netherlands, and how Russian dependence in nuclear energy and medical isotopes can be ended. The minister answered that the government opposes this revenue, pushes for EU sanctions on Russia's civil-nuclear earnings and LNG imports, notes residual dependence through legacy contracts and enriched ytterbium for medical isotopes, and says alternatives are being explored.
In line with the Klaver et al. motion, the cabinet advocates at EU level for sanctions that hit Russia's earnings in the civil-nuclear domain.
Het kabinet pleit conform de motie Klaver c.s. (Kamerstuk 36 476, nr. 3 ) in Europees verband voor sancties die het Russische verdienvermogen in het civiel-nucleaire domein raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Hirsch, Van der Lee en Koekkoek over de exportkredietverzekering voor het LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs Teunissen, Hirsch, Van der Lee and Koekkoek asked the ministers about the export credit insurance for Total's LNG project in Mozambique, including the re-assessment process, independence of security information, Total's role, the Palma attacks, and compliance with the Thijssen motion. Minister Heinen answered that the re-assessment is not finished, that all Proximities report recommendations were implemented, that the government will not postpone the decision as the motion asked, and that delayed Woo requests led to penalty payments.
As long as the assessment process is ongoing, I cannot make statements about its content in order to ensure a careful process.
Zolang het beoordelingsproces loopt, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de inhoud daarvan om zo een zorgvuldig proces te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het het lid Hirsch over de veroordeling van milieuactivisten in Cambodja

Hirsch (GroenLinks-PvdA) asks the ministers whether they will condemn and press for the release of ten Mother Nature environmental activists convicted in Cambodia, and whether the shrinking civil society space is unacceptable. Minister Veldkamp answers that UN experts found due process was not respected, that the embassy in Bangkok monitors the case and raises human rights in bilateral and UPR settings, and that a decision on civil society policy under the new cabinet will follow later.
The Netherlands will continue to follow the matter and speak out where possible and appropriate.
Nederland zal de kwestie blijven volgen en zich uitspreken waar dat mogelijk en passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over het nieuwe Oxfam-rapport Water War Crimes van 17 juli

An MP asked the government about an Oxfam report alleging Israel uses water deprivation as a weapon in Gaza, citing per-capita water access figures, ICJ provisional measures and Dutch water diplomacy. The minister acknowledged the severe shortage, urged Israel to comply with ICJ measures and said Nederland will keep raising the issue bilaterally, while stating that consequences for Israel are not yet linked to the failure to improve access.

The Netherlands sees diplomatic engagement with Israel, both bilaterally and multilaterally, together with the funding and support for aid organisations mentioned in answer 8, as currently the most effective way to achieve results.

Nederland ziet diplomatieke inzet richting Israël, zowel bilateraal als multilateraal, in samenhang met de onder antwoord 8 genoemde financiering en steun aan hulporganisaties, op dit moment als de meest effectieve manier om resultaten te bereiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Bushoff over het besluit van Nederland om vooralsnog niet in te gaan op de oproep van de WHO om mpox-vaccins naar Afrika te sturen

MPs Hirsch and Bushoff asked why the Netherlands is not donating mpox vaccines to Africa despite WHO's call and the international emergency, and how the risk trade-off was made. The Minister replies that the Netherlands keeps its national stockpile of about 100,000 doses, cannot donate because of its national safety buffer and expiring stock, and contributes EUR 3 million to WHO's response plan instead.
I am currently not making vaccines available for donation to other countries, because the stock in the Netherlands would then fall below the national safety buffer.
Ik stel op dit moment geen vaccins beschikbaar voor donatie aan andere landen, omdat de voorraad in Nederland daarmee onder de nationale veiligheidsbuffer zou zakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Kamminga over de berichtgeving omtrent mpox-vaccins, o.a. op NU.nl ‘Geen Nederlandse mpox-vaccins naar Afrika vanwege ‘nationale paraatheid’’

MPs Tielen and Kamminga asked the Ministers of Health and of Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the Netherlands would not donate its mpox vaccine stock to Africa for national preparedness reasons, and about the stock size, donations, replenishment and expected use. Minister Agema answered that the stock of about 99,700 vaccines is a safety reserve, that donation is not ruled out but is currently declined, that replenishment depends on manufacturer delivery expected in early 2025, and that the Netherlands contributes EUR 3 million to the WHO response plan.
As I indicated earlier, I have decided not to donate mpox vaccines now because the 100,000 vaccines I have are our safety stock and delivery of new vaccines will only take place in 2025.

Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, heb ik besloten nu geen mpox-vaccins doneren omdat de 100.000 vaccins die ik heb onze veiligheidsvoorraad zijn en levering van nieuwe vaccins pas in 2025 plaats zal vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht Wc-papier komt vaak uit de groene woestijn van Brazilië

An MP asked whether FMO's 40 million euro loan to Suzano, a Brazilian pulp company, is justified given NGO claims of environmental and Indigenous harm, and whether the state should tighten FMO's sustainability policy and EU rules on financial flows linked to deforestation. The minister replied that FMO operates at arm's length within agreed frameworks, that FSC certification and an Environmental and Social Action Plan mitigate the risks, that the state cannot itself change FMO's policy, and that the EU will assess financial-flow rules by June 2025.
The State cannot itself change or tighten FMO's CSR and sustainability policy.
De Staat kan niet zelf het IMVO- en duurzaamheidsbeleid van FMO wijzigen of aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de situatie in Bangladesh

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development how the Netherlands will support a peaceful, democratic transition in Bangladesh after the fall of Sheikh Hasina, investigate alleged human rights violations during protests, and protect garment workers. The government answered that it supports human rights defenders, backs a UN OHCHR inquiry, supports monitoring, and works with ILO, IFC and partners on garment-sector labour conditions.
The Netherlands intends to continue this support during this important transition period in Bangladesh.
Nederland is voornemens deze steun voort te zetten in deze belangrijke tijd van transitie in Bangladesh.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het onderzoek in hoeverre Chinese auto’s een veiligheidsrisico opleveren voor de nationale veiligheid

Boswijk (CDA) asked about the status of the motion requiring a national security analysis of Chinese electric vehicles, whether the Netherlands was present at a US meeting on Chinese software in cars, and whether the Netherlands and EU should adopt US restrictions. The government said the risk analysis has started with interdepartmental working groups and results are expected by year end, declined to discuss the confidential meeting, said US measures are not yet known and the Netherlands will make its own assessment, preferring EU-level action.
By the end of the year, the House will be informed about the first results of these working groups.
Voor het einde van het jaar zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd over de eerste resultaten van deze werkgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Piri over het bericht 'Anti-Palestijnse desinformatie in de Kamer: ‘Dit is niet hoe het hoort te gaan’'

MPs Hirsch and Piri asked the ministers about a Groene Amsterdammer report that former minister Van Leeuwen suspended UNRWA funding unilaterally, whether he consulted advisers, his deleted social media posts, and UNRWA's role. Minister Klever answered that the decision was within his responsibility, no advisory memo was prepared, no evidence has been provided that UNRWA funds were used in the 7 October attack, and that the deleted posts were not managed by the ministry, though most questions were answered only in part and some were declined as not appropriate to account for.
A Minister is entitled to ask civil servants for advice before decision-making (and to decide whom to ask), but is not obliged to do so.
Een Minister is bevoegd om voorafgaand aan besluitvorming advies aan ambtenaren te vragen (en te beslissen aan wie), maar is daartoe niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de steun voor een verklaring over UNRWA

An MP asked whether the Netherlands should sign a statement of over 100 countries recognising UNRWA's critical role for Palestinian refugees, and why it had not, and whether the government still backs the European Council's view that UNRWA's services are essential. The minister answered that the Netherlands did not sign because it disagreed with points such as UNRWA being irreplaceable, which conflicts with its wish to diversify aid channels, but stressed UNRWA's important role in Gaza; the government does stand behind the European Council conclusions.
The Netherlands could not agree with all points in the statement and therefore decided not to sign it.
Nederland kon zich niet op alle punten vinden in de verklaring en heeft daarom besloten niet mee te tekenen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Kamminga en Van der Burg over het bericht 'Burkina Faso volgende Afrikaanse land dat homoseksualiteit strafbaar wil maken'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that Burkina Faso plans to criminalise homosexuality and what the Netherlands is doing in response, including aid, contacts with the regime and Sahel policy. The ministers answered at length, saying the legal consequences are still unclear, that the embassy raised the issue and supports civil society indirectly, and that public statements are currently judged counterproductive, while committing to raise the issue at EU-AU level.
The cabinet will work to achieve this.
Het kabinet zal zich daarvoor inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Kahraman over de implementatie van de sanctiepakketten tegen Rusland

MPs Omtzigt and Kahraman asked the ministers about the implementation of the EU sanctions packages against Russia, including whether the Coast Guard enforces them, and whether any sanctions go unenforced or incompletely implemented. The minister answered at length that all sanctions are nationally implemented via the Sanctieregeling, that the government aims for strict compliance, that the Coast Guard was agreed to prioritise packages 1 to 10 given limited capacity with alternatives found for later packages, and that implementation is a national matter with no formal notice from the Commission.
The cabinet's starting point is strict compliance with all sanctions, and the cabinet therefore does not share the view that there are measures that are not enforced.
Uitgangspunt van het kabinet is het strikt naleven van alle sancties, en het kabinet deelt dus ook niet het beeld dat er maatregelen zijn die niet gehandhaafd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over het bloedbad bij studentenprotesten in Bangladesh

Hirsch asked the ministers about the deadly crackdown on student protests in Bangladesh, its impact on stability, communication shutdowns, the bilateral relationship, and what Netherlands and EU steps are being taken. The government condemned the violence, described the situation and the EU's suspension of PCA talks, and said it is pressing for a peaceful democratic transition and independent investigation.
The Netherlands and the EU immediately strongly condemned the violence by the Bangladeshi authorities against peaceful demonstrators and called for the protection of peaceful demonstrators.
Nederland en de EU hebben het geweld van de Bangladeshi autoriteiten richting vreedzame demonstranten onmiddellijk sterk veroordeeld en opgeroepen tot bescherming van vreedzame demonstranten.

m: Amendement van het ld Agnes Mulder c.s. over het maximeren van het aantal keren dat door de IMG in te roepen deskundigen tegenbewijs mogen leveren

Het Instituut stelt eisen aan de deskundige, waaronder begrepen het aantal keren dat de deskundige per aanvraag mag onderzoeken

By general administrative order one or more areas may be set in which the presumption in the first paragraph applies in any case.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen een of meer gebieden worden vastgesteld waarbinnen het vermoeden, bedoeld in het eerste lid, in ieder geval geldt.

requests the government to give tenants of private rental homes more options and a right of initiative
verzoekt de regering om huurders van particuliere huurwoningen meer mogelijkheden en recht op initiatief te geven
Motie van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over een evenwichtige vertegenwoordiging namens Rijk, regio en bewoners binnen de commissie moeilijk uitlegbare verschillen

requests the government to ensure balanced representation of national government, region and residents on this commission
