Motie van het lid Segers c.s. over het IMG vragen om mediation aan bewoners voor te stellen in de fase tussen bezwaar en beroep
Motion asking the IMG to offer residents mediation between objection and appeal stages in damage-claim procedures to avoid burdensome court cases.
requests the government to ask the IMG to offer residents mediation where possible in the phase between objection and appeal.
verzoekt de regering het IMG te vragen om wanneer mogelijk mediation aan bewoners voor te stellen in de fase tussen bezwaar en beroep
Motie van het lid Van Meenen c.s. over groningse gemeentes ondersteunen bij het indienen van een aanvraag voor het NIP
Asks the government to help Groningen municipalities apply for NIP insulation funds and to process those applications with priority.
requests the government to support Groningen municipalities in submitting an application for the NIP and to process these applications with priority
verzoekt de regering om Groningse gemeentes te ondersteunen bij het indienen van een aanvraag voor het NIP en deze aanvragen vervolgens met voorrang te behandelen
Motie van het lid Van Meenen c.s. over bedrijven van binnen de provincie Groningen betrekken bij de opdrachten tot versterking
Asks the government to consider involving construction firms from within Groningen province when awarding reinforcement contracts.
requests the government to critically examine involving companies from within the province of Groningen when awarding reinforcement contracts
verzoekt de regering om bij het aanbesteden/vergeven van opdrachten tot versterking kritisch te kijken naar de mogelijkheid om hierbij bedrijven van binnen de provincie Groningen te betrekken
Motie van het lid Van Wijngaarden c.s. over het in Groningen beleggen van een Conferentie voor het Noorden
Asks the cabinet to hold a Conference for the North in Groningen after the enquiry report is debated, to draw up a long-term investment agenda.
requests the cabinet, after the parliamentary treatment of the Groningen enquiry report, to hold a Conference for the North in Groningen
verzoekt het kabinet om na de parlementaire behandeling van het rapport van de parlementaire enquêtecommissie aardgaswinning Groningen een Conferentie voor het Noorden in Groningen te beleggen
Motie van het lid Van Meenen c.s. over het IMG om een toelichting vragen op de toepassing van de trillingstool
Asks the government to ask the Mining Damage Foundation (IMG) to explain how the tremor tool is used in damage claims in practice and whether alternatives exist, and to inform the House.
requests the government to ask the IMG for an explanation of the application of the tremor tool in practice
verzoekt de regering om het IMG om een toelichting te vragen op de toepassing van de trillingstool in de praktijk
Motie van het lid Beckerman c.s. over alles op alles zetten om problemen van huurders van Marenland op te lossen
Motion asking the government to inventory tenants' problems with Marenland, talk to stakeholders, work to solve them and report periodically to the House.
requests the government to inventory with tenants what all the problems and desired solutions are
verzoekt de regering met huurders te inventariseren wat alle problemen en gewenste oplossingen zijn
Motie van de leden Agnes Mulder en Segers over het beter verdelen van de lasten en lusten in de betrokken regio’s van de gaswinning op land
Asks the government to propose a fairer distribution of the burdens and benefits of onshore gas extraction in the affected regions.
requests the government to make a proposal for better distributing the burdens and benefits in the regions affected by onshore gas extraction
verzoekt de regering een voorstel te doen voor het beter verdelen van de lasten en de lusten in de betrokken regio's van de gaswinning op land
Motie van de leden Nijboer en Agnes Mulder over inventariseren wat er nodig is om de vier dorpen aardgasvrij te maken
Asks the government to inventory what is needed to make four Groningen villages natural-gas-free, as a first step toward a wider analysis for the earthquake area.
requests the government to inventory, starting with the four villages, what is needed to make these villages natural-gas-free
verzoekt de regering te inventariseren, te beginnen met de vier dorpen, wat er nodig is om deze dorpen aardgasvrij te maken
Motie van het lid Segers c.s. over geen vertragende werking van de extra opgave om dorpen volledig aardgasvrij te maken
Asks the government to ensure the extra task of making villages fully gas-free does not slow down the earthquake reinforcement program in Groningen.
calls on the government to ensure that the extra task of making the villages fully gas-free does not slow down the reinforcement task
roept de regering op er zorg voor te dragen dat de extra opgave om de dorpen volledig aardgasvrij te maken niet vertragend zal werken op de versterkingsopgave
Motie van het lid Beckerman c.s. over het herbeoordelen van onterecht afgewezen schades
Asks the government to ensure that wrongly rejected Groningen subsidence damage claims by the damage-handling agency are reassessed.
requests the government to ensure that these wrongly rejected damages are reassessed
verzoekt de regering te borgen dat deze onterecht afgewezen schades worden herbeoordeeld
Motie van het lid Segers c.s. over in gesprek treden met de Kinderombudsman over het verrijken van het toekomstperspectief voor kinderen en jongeren in Groningen
Asks the government to engage with the Children's Ombudsman on improving the future perspective for children and young people in Groningen, including a child rights test for future plans.
requests the government to enter into dialogue with the Children's Ombudsman
verzoekt de regering in gesprek te treden met de Kinderombudsman

the period for paying compensation for self-managed assessment goes from eight weeks to five weeks
de periode voor het uitkeren van een vergoeding voor de beoordeling in eigen beheer van acht weken naar vijf weken gaat
Motie van het lid Hagen c.s. over het binnen de kaders van het Klimaatfonds uitwerken van een regeling om circulaire koplopers te ondersteunen
Asks the government to design a scheme under the Climate Fund to support circular economy frontrunners.
requests the government to develop, within the Climate Fund framework, a scheme to support circular frontrunners

Motie van het lid Hagen c.s. over een voorstel voor een circulaire-economiewet
Asks the government to come up with a proposal for a circular economy act to give legal steering to raw material policy.
requests the government to come with a proposal for a circular economy act
verzoekt de regering met een voorstel voor een circulaire-economiewet te komen
Motie van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over in kaart brengen hoe Nederland en de EU een grotere inzet kunnen leveren aan de autonome economische ontwikkeling van de Palestijnse gebieden
Asks the government to map how the Netherlands and the EU could increase support for the autonomous economic development of the Palestinian territories, especially young entrepreneurs.
requests the government to map out how the Netherlands and the European Union can contribute more
verzoekt de regering in kaart te brengen op welke wijze Nederland en de Europese Unie een grotere inzet kunnen leveren
Motie van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over een onderzoek naar extra inzet voor humanitaire ontmijning in Cherson
Asks the government to investigate whether extra resources can be provided for humanitarian demining in the Kherson region.
requests the government to investigate whether extra effort can be made for humanitarian demining in the Kherson region
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of er extra inzet kan worden geleverd voor humanitaire ontmijning in de regio Cherson
Amendement van de leden Ceder en Agnes Mulder over middelen voor verzoeningsprojecten tussen Israël en Palestina

This amendment aims to increase the available funds for projects that promote cooperation and reconciliation from the bottom up by 250,000 euro in the coming budget year.
Dit amendement beoogt de beschikbare middelen voor projecten die samenwerking en verzoening «van onderop» bevorderen het komend begrotingsjaar met € 250.000 te verhogen.
Amendement van het lid Ceder c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 17 over middelen voor verzoeningsprojecten tussen Israël en Palestina

Motie van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over zich binnen de VN inspannen om Iran te verwijderen uit de Commissie voor de Status van de Vrouw

requests the government to work within the United Nations to remove Iran from the Commission on the Status of Women

Asks the House to declare Russia a state sponsor of terrorism, citing attacks on civilian targets in Ukraine.
declares that Russia must be designated a state sponsor of terrorism
spreekt uit dat Rusland moet worden aangemerkt als «staatssponsor van terrorisme»
Amendement van het lid Sjoerdsma c.s. over middelen voor een taskforce om moorden op journalisten op te lossen
Moves 500,000 euro from the UN crisis-management contribution to a one-off taskforce on unsolved murders of journalists.
The submitters propose to release 500,000 euro once for this purpose.
Indieners stellen voor hiervoor eenmalig € 500.000 euro vrij te maken.
Motie van de leden Brekelmans en Agnes Mulder over het zich binnen de EU inzetten voor een Europese versie van OFAC
Asks the cabinet to push within the EU for a European version of the US OFAC to monitor and enforce extraterritorial sanctions.
requests the cabinet to work within the European Union for a European version of OFAC
verzoekt het kabinet zich binnen de Europese Unie in te zetten voor een Europese versie van OFAC
Motie van de leden Brekelmans en Agnes Mulder over migratieafspraken tot belangrijke prioriteit in het buitenlandbeleid maken en daar bilateraal en multilateraal meer aandacht aan geven
Asks the government to make migration agreements with countries of origin and transit a major foreign policy priority in bilateral and multilateral talks.
requests the government to make concluding migration agreements to gain more grip on migration an important priority in foreign policy
verzoekt de regering het maken van migratieafspraken om meer grip te krijgen op migratie tot een belangrijke prioriteit te maken in het buitenlandbeleid
Amendement van het lid Sjoerdsma c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 14 over middelen voor een taskforce om moorden op journalisten op te lossen
Moves 500,000 euro from crisis management contributions to the foreign affairs budget to fund a taskforce investigating murders of journalists.
With these funds the Netherlands, as co-chair of the Media Freedom Coalition, can make a start on an international team of legal and forensic experts
Met deze middelen kan Nederland als medevoorzitter van de media freedom coalition een begin maken aan een internationaal team van juridische en forensische experts
Amendement van het lid Piri c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over middelen voor het NFRP-Matra fonds
Shifts 1 million euro within the foreign affairs budget to the NFRP-Matra fund for rule of law and democracy in neighbouring countries.
The funds benefit article 2.5 Promotion of transition in priority areas
De middelen komen ten goed aan artikel 2.5 Bevordering van transitie in prioritaire gebieden
Motie van de leden Agnes Mulder en Ceder over de steun voor verzoeningsprojecten voor Israëlische en Palestijnse jongeren intensiveren
Asks the government to map the extent of support for Israeli-Palestinian youth reconciliation projects and inform the Chamber before the budget debate.

requests the government to map the extent to which support for reconciliation projects bringing Israeli and Palestinian youth closer can be intensified, and to inform the Chamber before the budget debate

verzoekt de regering in kaart te brengen in hoeverre de steun voor verzoeningsprojecten waarbij Israëlische en Palestijnse jongeren nader tot elkaar worden gebracht, vanuit Nederland en internationale fondsen kan worden geïntensiveerd, en de Kamer hierover voor de begrotingsbehandeling te informeren
Motie van het lid Ceder c.s. over samen met andere EU-lidstaten de Armeense en de Oeigoerse genocide erkennen
Asks the government to examine with like-minded EU member states whether and how to recognise the Armenian and Uyghur genocides together, and to report before the 2023 budget debate.
requests the government to check with like-minded EU member states whether and how recognition can proceed simultaneously
verzoekt de regering om bij gelijkgestemde EU-lidstaten na te gaan of en hoe gelijktijdig met deze landen overgegaan kan worden tot erkenning
Motie van de leden Brekelmans en Agnes Mulder over een interdepartementale taskforce om strategische afhankelijkheden te verminderen

requests the government not to cut the four priority areas

Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 23 over het verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor FLOW met € 10 miljoen in 2013
Shifts €10 million within the development budget from Mali budget support to the FLOW fund for women and girls in developing countries in 2013.
Coverage is provided by a reduction of article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden door een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Motie Agnes Mulder over de inzet algemene begrotingssteun
Asks the government to commit no new money to general budget support and to seek further international limits on this instrument.
requests the government not to spend new money on general budget support
verzoekt de regering, geen nieuw geld uit te geven aan algemene begrotingssteun
Motie Sjoerdsma c.s. over inzicht in de besteding van de ontwikkelingsgelden
Asks the government to give the best possible insight into how development aid funds are spent and their results, through digital publication.
requests the government to give the best possible insight into the spending of development funds and their results
verzoekt de regering, een zo goed mogelijk inzicht te geven in de besteding van de ontwikkelingsgelden en de resultaten daarvan
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. over het verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor FLOW met € 10 miljoen in 2013
Amendment moving 10 million euros to the FLOW fund for women in developing countries in 2013, financed by cutting budget support for Mali.
Funding is provided by a reduction of article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden door een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. over het in 2013 eenmalig verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor UN-Women met € 2 miljoen
Increases funding for UN Women by 2 million euros in 2013 by reducing budget support for Mali.
Funding is provided by reducing article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden via een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Amendement van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over het inzetten van € 1,5 miljoen via maatschappelijke organisaties in Rwanda
Proposes moving €1.5 million within the foreign aid budget to civil society organisations in Rwanda and stopping sectoral budget support to Rwanda.
sectoral budget support should now be stopped
zou sectorale begrotingssteun nu moeten worden stopgezet
Motie Agnes Mulder over giften aan particuliere initiatieven
Motion asking the government for its views on strengthening society's involvement in development cooperation and facilitating gifts to private initiatives.
requests the government to give its view on how society's involvement can be strengthened
verzoekt de regering, haar visie te geven op de wijze waarop de betrokkenheid van de samenleving kan worden versterkt
Motie Geurts en Agnes Mulder over een thermometer regeldruk
Asks the government to set up a thermometer of regulatory burden, reporting net amounts to the public and the House each year.
requests the government to establish a regulatory burden thermometer and make the results available in net amounts to the public and to report to the House annually
verzoekt de regering, een thermometer regeldruk in te stellen en de resultaten in netto bedragen beschikbaar te maken voor het publiek en de Kamer hierover elk jaar te rapporteren
Motie Geurts en Agnes Mulder over bedrijfsopvolging in familiebedrijven
Asks the government for a plan of action on the scale of succession problems in family businesses and how to facilitate succession.
in the coming spring to present an action plan describing how large the succession problem in Dutch family businesses really is
in het komende voorjaar te komen met een plan van aanpak waarin wordt omschreven hoe groot de problematiek rond bedrijfsopvolging in Nederlandse familiebedrijven nu werkelijk is
Motie Geurts en Agnes Mulder over een samenhangende agenda voor de detailhandel
Asks the government for a coherent agenda for the retail sector to address short-term problems and prepare the sector for the future.
requests the government to come up with a coherent agenda for the retail sector
verzoekt de regering om, met een samenhangende agenda te komen voor de detailhandel
Motie van de leden Agnes Mulder en Dik-Faber over het plaatsen van windturbines
Motion asking the government to explore placing wind turbines on state-owned or state-managed land, with resident participation and availability to wind cooperatives.
requests the government to investigate whether it is possible to place wind turbines in areas owned or managed by the central government
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken of het mogelijk is windturbines te plaatsen in gebieden die in eigendom of beheer van de rijksoverheid zijn
Amendement van het lid Schouten c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 dat regelt dat winkeliers niet contractueel kunnen worden verplicht hun winkel op zon- en feestdagen te openen
Amendment makes contractual clauses void that oblige a shop tenant to open on Sundays or specified public holidays.
A provision in a contract is void if it obliges a party to keep a shop open
Een bepaling in een overeenkomst is nietig indien deze een partij verplicht tot het geopend houden van een winkel
Amendement van het lid Schouten c.s. over het behouden van de belangenafweging
Amendment requiring municipal councils to weigh employment, Sunday rest and liveability interests and motivate this when granting Sunday shop-opening exemptions.
Through this amendment municipalities must explicitly justify how the named interests were weighed in decision-making.
Door dit amendement moeten gemeenten expliciet motiveren op welke wijze genoemde belangen zijn meegewogen in de besluitvorming.
Amendement van het lid Schouten c.s. dat regelt dat winkeliers niet contractureel verplicht kunnen worden hun winkel op zon- en feestdagen te openen
Makes void any contract clause that obliges a shopkeeper to keep the shop open on Sundays and specified public holidays.
A provision in a contract is void if it obliges a party to keep a shop open within the meaning of the Shop Hours Act: a. on Sunday
Een bepaling in een overeenkomst is nietig indien deze een partij verplicht tot het geopend houden van een winkel in de zin van de Winkeltijdenwet: a. op zondag

Amendement van het lid Agnes Mulder over het goedkeuren van beleidsregels op het terrein van de Mededingingswet en het uitsluiten van de vernietigingsbevoegdheid uit de Kaderwet ZBO's op besluiten van

Restores the minister's power to approve in advance competition-law policy rules of the ACM and to annul them for lack of competence, excluding the general annulment power of the framework act for independent bodies.
This amendment therefore provides that the minister again has the power to approve in advance policy rules in the field of the Competition Act.
Dit amendement regelt dan ook dat de minister weer de bevoegdheid heeft om beleidsregels op het terrein van de Mededingingswet vooraf goed te keuren.
qa: Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Staaij, Ceder, Piri, Van der Lee, Koekkoek, Teunissen, Eppink en Van der Plas over de uitspraak van het Internationaal

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands will ensure Azerbaijan complies with the ICJ provisional measures order to reopen the Lachin corridor, and whether it has raised this with Azerbaijan. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Azerbaijan to comply through bilateral talks, the ambassador, and EU and multilateral channels, but gives no new concrete commitment beyond continued advocacy.
Following this ruling, the Netherlands called on the Azerbaijani authorities to comply with the ruling.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak de Azerbeidzjaanse autoriteiten opgeroepen om de uitspraak na te leven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Eppink, Van der Staaij, Van der Plas en Agnes Mulder over de ontmoeting tussen de minister-president en de Azerbeidzjaanse president Aliyev

MPs asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about the January 2023 meeting with Azerbaijani President Aliyev in Davos, including gas deliveries, the Lachin corridor blockade, ECHR rulings and Armenian prisoners. The government answered that the meeting raised Dutch concerns about the humanitarian situation and the Lachin blockade, that it did not address the ECHR interim measures or Armenian prisoners, and that it did not condemn Azerbaijan's occupation of Armenian territory, while promising continued calls for compliance.
During the conversation, the Prime Minister conveyed the Dutch concerns about the humanitarian situation in Nagorno-Karabakh resulting from the de facto blockade of the Lachin corridor.
Tijdens het gesprek heeft de Minister-President de Nederlandse zorgen over de humanitaire situatie in Nagorno-Karabach als gevolg van de de facto blokkade van de Laçın-corridor overgebracht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van der Lee, Ceder, Teunissen, Piri, Kuzu en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de overdracht van Singh aan Nederland gebaseerd is op politieke onwil

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Foreign Ministers whether the government has done enough to bring detained Dutch national Jaitsen Singh from the United States to the Netherlands, and why a transfer (WOTS procedure) was not pursued after a parole denial. The government answers that a WOTS transfer does not meet the policy criteria because of insufficient ties to the Netherlands, that a pardon route on humanitarian grounds remains open, and that the family's willingness to take him in does not change the assessment.
The cabinet continues to make efforts to bring Mr Singh to the Netherlands on humanitarian grounds because of his advanced age and fragile health, provided he poses no danger to society.
Het kabinet blijft zich inspannen om de heer Singh op humanitaire gronden vanwege zijn hoge leeftijd en fragiele gezondheid naar Nederland te brengen, mits hij geen gevaar voor de samenleving vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het melden en afhandelen van mijnbouwschade in Limburg

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why a promised scheme for handling mining damage from former coal mining in South Limburg, announced in 2015, is still not ready, and what the state of play is regarding a single contact point, the role of the Commissie Mijnbouwschade and the Calamiteitenfonds, the reduction of bureaucracy, the Calamiteitenfonds method, the number of affected properties, and SodM's supervision of after-effects. The State Secretary answers that a damage protocol and compensation scheme are expected by mid-2023, with the ministry taking over claims and pursuing successors, and promises a single point of contact and oversight changes to the Mijnbouwwet, while stating that the exact number of affected homes is not known.
I expect to have the required damage protocol ready by mid-2023.
Ik verwacht het benodigde schadeprotocol medio 2023 gereed te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Ceder over het bericht dat Nagorno-Karabach kampt met een tekort aan voedsel en medicijnen door wegblokkade.

MPs Mulder and Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about reports of food and medicine shortages in Nagorno-Karabakh caused by the blockade of the Lachin corridor, including humanitarian options, EU/US pressure on Azerbaijan, Russian peacekeepers' role and an EU monitoring mission. The minister answered that the ICRC delivers aid, a airlift is not feasible without Azerbaijani consent, Azerbaijan has not complied, and the government is pressing Azerbaijan and considering an EU monitoring mission.
The Netherlands will continue to press for this in the relevant EU bodies.
Nederland zal hierop blijven aandringen in relevante EU-gremia.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Agnes Mulder over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya, dat 6 jaar geleden is ontvoerd naar India

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about the case of Dutch girl Insiya, abducted to India six years ago, and what has been done to restore her contact with her mother and return her to the Netherlands. Minister Hoekstra answered that the government raises the case with Indian authorities, relies on Indian court proceedings with no timeline for return, and that India has said the father's pending cases cannot be pursued in the local courts.
Unfortunately, no timeframe can currently be given for Insiya's return.
Er is helaas op dit moment geen termijn te geven voor de terugkeer van Insiya.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Agnes Mulder over ‘Zwarte Russen’ in Oekraïne: Afrikanen geronseld door Wagner en Russisch leger’

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about reports of Wagner recruiting convicted murderers and sex offenders from prisons in Russia and Africa, sexual violence by Russian forces in occupied Ukraine, aid for victims, and diplomatic responses. The government acknowledged signs of widespread sexual violence, noted under-reporting, described Dutch funding to UNFPA and humanitarian organisations, and said it lacks its own data on the recruited prisoners and sees no legal ban on recruiting convicts, while pointing to general EU and UN capacity programmes.
The cabinet has no independent information on the precise number of prisoners convicted of murder and sex offences recruited by the Wagner Group for the Russian army.

Het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie over de precieze omvang van de groep voor moord en zedenmisdrijven veroordeelde gevangenen die door de Wagner Groep zijn gerekruteerd voor het Russische leger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat een Nederlands vrachtschip betrokken is bij een illegaal wapentransport naar Libië

MPs Boswijk and Agnes Mulder asked whether a Dutch-flagged cargo ship carried a shipment of armoured vehicles to Libya in breach of the UN arms embargo, who was responsible, whether the cargo was sanctioned, why the ship had documentation, whether Dutch shipping firms will be prevented from future involvement, and whether an investigation has started. The government confirms the ship was inspected in October and the cargo seized pending a UN Panel of Experts investigation that has not concluded, declines to name the client or judge the documentation, says any criminal investigation is for the Public Prosecution Service, and does not name individual cases.

The investigation by the UN Security Council Sanctions Committee Panel of Experts into the client, the cargo, the required documentation including licences, and the possible breach of the arms embargo is still ongoing.

Het onderzoek door het Panel of Experts van het VN Veiligheidsraad Sanctiecomité naar de opdrachtgever, de lading van het schip, de benodigde documentatie – waaronder vergunningen – en de mogelijke schending van het wapenembargo is nog gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Agnes Mulder en Haverkort over de rol van afvalenergiecentrales in Nederland

MPs Bontenbal, Agnes Mulder and Haverkort asked about the Royal HaskoningDHV report on waste-to-energy plants, the effects of the waste import levy on CO2 emissions, the role of waste incinerators in a climate-neutral system, CO2 capture and chemical recycling. State Secretary Heijnen answered that the levy reduced cross-border waste incineration, disputed the claimed emissions increase, and said incinerators will play a shrinking role as waste is shifted to higher-value recycling, while committing to examine how instruments can support both transitions.
The cabinet will examine in the coming period how instruments can be deployed to support both the transition to a climate-neutral economy and the transition to a circular economy.

Het kabinet zal de komende tijd bezien hoe instrumenten zo kunnen worden ingezet dat zij zowel de transitie naar een klimaatneutrale economie als de transitie naar een circulaire economie ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de waterinjectie in Twente

An MP asked whether NAM intends to restart wastewater injection in Twente in 2023, what permit is needed, and whether it can be refused. The State Secretary says he wants injection in Twente stopped, will discuss this with NAM, and will treat any extension request under the normal procedure, while noting SodM has found risk management in order.
I want the water injection in Twente not to be restarted.
Ik wil dat de waterinjectie in Twente niet meer wordt opgestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder en Kuzu over de modernisering van de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap

MPs from D66, VVD, CDA and DENK asked about the coalition agreement's plans for a private register of unwanted nationality and for revising the automatic loss of Dutch nationality after thirteen years abroad. The government answered that the register is a societal initiative the state would only support if taken up, and that it will draft a bill in the first quarter of 2023 amending the Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap to revise the loss rule and add a recovery option.
I am preparing a bill that amends the Netherlands Nationality Act on these two points.
Ik bereid een wetsvoorstel voor dat de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap op deze twee onderdelen wijzigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen, Agnes Mulder, Dassen en Boucke over het bericht “COP27: Egypt pressed to make human rights move before climate summit”

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA, CDA, Volt and D66 asked the government about reports that Egyptian authorities restrict civil society and that many Egyptian organisations could not register for COP27, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about shrinking civic space, has raised accreditation inclusiveness and human rights with Egypt bilaterally and at EU level, but stressed that UNFCCC and Egypt as host carry the responsibility for participation.
The Netherlands, like other European countries, urges both bilaterally and multilaterally for an inclusive COP27 without participating organisations having to fear oppression or repercussions.

Nederland dringt, net als andere Europese landen, zowel bilateraal als in multilateraal verband, aan op een inclusieve COP27 zonder dat deelnemende organisaties hoeven te vrezen voor onderdrukking of repercussies.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Kuzu, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Brekelmans, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons en Piri over het bericht dat waarnemers van de Organisatie voor Veiligheid en Samenwerkin

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about two Ukrainian OSCE staff members sentenced to over ten years by courts in the unrecognised Luhansk region, asking about their detention conditions, pressure on Russia, evacuation of local staff, and whether Turkey could help secure their release. The minister confirmed the sentences, said detention location is unknown, listed joint EU and OSCE calls for release, and said the OSCE Secretary General is working on their release.
At this time it is not known where the detainees are being held.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend waar de gevangenen worden vastgehouden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Kuzu, Van der Lee en Piri over het feit dat Taiwan graag waarnemend lid wil worden van de Internationale Burgerluchtvaartorganisatie

MPs from seven parties asked the government about Taiwan's wish to become an observer at the ICAO, including whether it could be invited under the Council's rules, its safety relevance for flights, and whether the Netherlands would support its participation at the 41st Assembly. The minister answered that Taiwan could in principle be invited as an 'other body' observer to the Council only if China agreed, is excluded from the Assembly under Taiwan's non-state status, and that the Netherlands supports meaningful Taiwan participation in coordination with like-minded countries while respecting its one-China policy.
Taiwan is not considered a state by the Netherlands and most other states in the world and therefore cannot in principle participate as an observer in these meetings.
Taiwan wordt door Nederland en de meeste andere staten in de wereld niet als staat beschouwd en kan daarom in principe niet als waarnemer aan deze vergaderingen deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over ‘Kiev wacht op tanks, Duitsland we wachten op uw belofte’

MP Agnes Mulder asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence why Germany has not supplied tanks to Ukraine despite prior commitments, and what the Netherlands can do to change this, including through NATO. The ministers answered that Ukraine needs more material support, that the Netherlands coordinates with allies including Germany, that NATO has no agreements on the type of equipment allies supply, and that they will keep urging partners to support Ukraine, without making commitments about Germany's decisions.
The cabinet makes no statements about the considerations of allies regarding military support.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over de overwegingen van bondgenoten ten aanzien van militaire steun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de wapenstilstand tussen Armenië en Azerbeidzjan is mislukt

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about renewed fighting between Armenia and Azerbaijan, including spread beyond Nagorno-Karabakh, possible Azerbaijani leverage from its gas supplies to the EU, the status of peace talks, and the EU-Azerbaijan memorandum. The minister answered that the government is concerned, supports EU-led mediation and the restart of talks, and that the memorandum creates no binding obligations.
The Netherlands supports the EU in the mediation process.
Nederland steunt de EU in het bemiddelingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat Shell en ExxonMobil de Nederlandse Aardoliemaatschappij (NAM) in de verkoop zetten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about Shell and ExxonMobil selling parts of NAM and the consequences for Groningen compensation, guarantees, gas storage and supply security. The State Secretary answered that small fields will be transferred to regional subsidiaries needing prior ministerial consent under the Mining Act, that Groningen obligations, guarantees and the Norg Accord are unaffected, and that no action is needed.
For the transfer of an interest in a field, prior consent from the State Secretary for Mining is required under the Mining Act.
Voor de overdracht van een belang in een veld is op grond van de Mijnbouwwet voorafgaande toestemming van de Staatssecretaris van Mijnbouw vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Agnes Mulder over het stopzetten van een door Buitenlandse Zaken gefinancierd vrouwenrechtenactivistenprogramma in Afghanistan

Two MPs from the CDA asked why the Dutch government stopped funding a women's rights activist programme in Afghanistan, citing deteriorating conditions for Afghan women, and what unacceptable security risks meant. The minister answered that the decision followed careful weighing of security risks against impact, that support for Afghan civil society and women's rights continues through other adapted projects, and that a further letter on longer-term engagement will address this.
The decision to stop this specific project was taken on the basis of a careful weighing of substantive arguments about security risks and achievable impact.
Het besluit om dit specifieke project stop te zetten, is genomen op basis van een zorgvuldige afweging van inhoudelijke argumenten over veiligheidsrisico's en te behalen impact.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Piri, Kuzu, Teunissen, Stoffer, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Brekelmans en Dassen over het gebrek aan humanitaire toegang in de Tigray-regio in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the lack of humanitarian access to Tigray, Ethiopia, including calls for UN investigations, sanctions, safe zones and press freedom. The minister answered that Nederland supports independent investigation and humanitarian access, has pressed for sanctions and an arms embargo within the EU without sufficient support, and will raise press access with the EU Special Envoy.
The Netherlands will continue to press, in EU and international contexts, on the three priorities mentioned above.
Nederland zal zich in blijven zetten, in EU- en internationaal verband, op de hierboven genoemde drie prioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Agens Mulder over de stand van zaken rondom het Midden-Oosten Vredesproces

MPs Sjoerdsma and Mulder asked about the postponed Palestinian elections, the humanitarian and water situation in Gaza, Israeli designations of Palestinian NGOs, settlements, and Dutch business involvement in settlements. The minister answered that elections remain postponed pending a new PA date, that Dutch policy on settlements and business ties is unchanged, and that a joint donor assessment of the NGO listings will be completed before the summer recess.
The cabinet aims to complete this joint assessment before the summer recess and inform the House.
Het kabinet streeft ernaar om voor het zomerreces deze gezamenlijke appreciatie af te ronden en uw Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat Rijkswaterstaat niet weet waar zijn metaalafval met giftige stoffen zoals Chroom-6 blijft

MPs Van der Molen and Agnes Mulder asked the government about reports that Rijkswaterstaat scrap metal containing chromium-6 was mixed and sent to smelters, including questions on enforcement, export controls and contractual safeguards. Minister Harbers answered that existing working-conditions rules, contract requirements and the Beheersregime apply, that mixing is allowed when smelters accept it, that enforcement capacity is limited, and that the ILT is drafting an action plan without giving figures on past cases.
How many cases of scrap mixing have occurred in recent years is not known to me.
In hoeveel gevallen in de afgelopen jaren sprake is van schrootvermenging is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Nispen, Knops en Agnes Mulder over de toetreding van de EU tot het EVRM

MPs Van Dijk, Van Nispen, Knops and Mulder asked about the status of the EU's accession to the European Convention on Human Rights, the remaining legal and political objections, and when talks would resume. The minister replied that negotiations are progressing slowly through seven rounds since 2020, that several legal objections remain (partly resolved), the next round is scheduled for May 2022, and the Netherlands will actively push to speed up accession.
The Netherlands wishes to fulfil the treaty obligation for the EU's accession to the ECHR as quickly as possible.
Nederland wenst de verdragsrechtelijke verplichting tot toetreding van de EU tot het EVRM zo snel mogelijk te vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Boswijk over het persbericht van de provincie Drenthe dat het kabinet overweegt de Johan Willem Frisokazerne te sluiten

CDA MPs Agnes Mulder and Boswijk asked the State Secretary for Defence whether the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen will be closed, on what grounds, what has been invested, what the regional impact is, and how other ministries' decisions are coordinated. The State Secretary answered that no decision has been taken, the barracks is part of an internal real-estate review, regional impact will be discussed with local partners, and a letter with first contours will follow in April.
It is therefore too simplistic to say that I intend to close the Johan Willem Friso barracks, but this barracks is part of this review.
Het is dus te kort door de bocht om te stellen dat ik voornemens ben de Johan Willem Frisokazerne te sluiten, maar deze kazerne maakt wel onderdeel uit van deze verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Agnes Mulder over de situatie in Mali

MPs Boswijk and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the situation in Mali, including the future of MINUSMA, the Takuba task force, French withdrawal, Russian paramilitaries, and Dutch evacuation planning. The government answered that it is very concerned, that the Dutch MINUSMA contribution is not under review for now, that Takuba is being withdrawn, and that it is monitoring developments and maintaining diplomatic contacts.
Suspending the Dutch civilian and military contribution to the UN mission MINUSMA is currently not on the table.
Het stopzetten van de Nederlandse civiele en militaire bijdrage aan de VN-missie MINUSMA is momenteel niet aan de orde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Ellemeet, Van der Graaf, Piri, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu en Teunissen over het bericht 'Polish coalition dynamics complicate rule-of-law talks, says EU’s justi

MPs asked the government whether the EU rule-of-law conditionality mechanism would be activated before Hungary's April 2022 elections and why it had not yet been used, and urged the Netherlands to press the Commission. The minister replied that the Commission had delayed the mechanism pending guidelines and a Court of Justice ruling (issued 16 February 2022), that the procedure takes at least three months so cannot be finished before the Hungarian vote, and that the Netherlands continues to urge swift guidelines and activation.

The government continues to urge the Commission to fully use the MFK rule-of-law regulation by establishing guidelines as soon as possible and starting the procedure to suspend or stop payments of EU funds.

Het kabinet blijft er bij de Commissie op aandringen om de MFK-rechtsstaatverordening volledig te benutten, door nu zo snel mogelijk richtsnoeren vast te stellen, en de procedure om tot de opschorting of stopzetting van uitkering van EU-middelen te komen, te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Stoffer, Segers en Mulder over gewonde burgers als gevolg van Turkse militaire activiteiten in Noordoost-Syrië

MPs asked the government whether Turkish military attacks in northeast Syria injuring civilians, including children, were lawful, and about Turkey's strategy and humanitarian protection of minorities. The government said it lacks details to judge the legality of specific attacks, condemned the Turkish operation, and described ongoing diplomatic efforts and support programmes for religious minorities.

The cabinet states that all countries, including Turkey, must act in accordance with international law, but does not have the details of the attacks in question and therefore cannot make statements on their lawfulness.

Het kabinet stelt voorop dat alle landen en dus ook Turkije conform het internationaal recht moeten handelen, maar beschikt niet over de details van de betreffende aanvallen en kan dus ook geen uitspraken doen over de rechtmatigheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over marteling en seksueel misbruik in Russische gevangenissen aan

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about leaked footage of torture and sexual abuse in Russian prisons, the Kremlin's response, and whether the government would press Russia bilaterally and multilaterally for an independent investigation, including by the CPT. The minister condemned the abuses, said Russia is expected to investigate and punish perpetrators, committed to raising the issue bilaterally and in multilateral fora, and noted the CPT report would be shared with Russia in spring 2022 but published only with Russian consent.
The report will only be made public after Russia's consent.
Het rapport wordt pas openbaar na instemming van Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Agnes Mulder over de klimaatimpact van door de veestapel uitgestoten methaan

MPs Boswijk and Agnes Mulder asked the ministers whether IPCC AR6 findings mean the climate impact of livestock methane is overstated, and what this implies for Dutch climate policy, LULUCF, and methane priorities. The minister answered that the IPCC does not say GWP* is better than GWP100, that GWP100 remains the international standard, that the issue will be revisited after the AR6 cycle, and that the national methane reduction target for livestock stands.
The IPCC does not make a statement about which method would be better or which method should be used.
Het IPCC doet daarbij geen uitspraak over welke methode beter zou zijn of welke methode gebruikt zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Kuik over de overstromingen in Zuid-Soedan (Jonglei State)

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign trade and development minister about the flooding in Jonglei State, South Sudan, including the humanitarian situation, hunger, disease, Dutch aid, the role of the South Sudanese government and the EU, causes, and the link to conflict. The minister answered at length, describing large humanitarian needs, Dutch funding through UN agencies, the Dutch Relief Alliance and a pooled fund, and a planned climate resilience programme with IOM; the answers are on substance and do not concern domestic executive oversight.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'Hof Polen: Pools recht weegt zwaarder dan Europees Recht'

MPs Kamminga and Agnes Mulder asked the government how it assesses the Polish Constitutional Tribunal's ruling that Polish law prevails over EU law, its consequences for the rule of law, EU instruments (infringement, Article 7, RRF, budget conditionality) and Dutch citizens and firms. The minister answered that the ruling threatens the primacy of EU law, that the Commission has the tools and is to act, that Netherlands supports strong steps and conditioning Polish RRF approval on judicial independence, and that the Prime Minister will raise it at the European Council.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Segers, Van der Plas, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Agnes Mulder en Eppink over het bericht dat Indonesië dreigt met 'uitroeiing' separatisten op Papoea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Indonesia threatened to 'eradicate' Papuan separatists, the killing of an intelligence officer, fears of disproportionate military violence and displacement, Papuans' political rights, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that Indonesia has security duties but concerns about military presence, civilian harm and rights restrictions are shared, and said the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and in EU dialogue without intervening in foreign court cases.
The Netherlands will continue to press the Indonesian authorities for a meaningful dialogue between all parties involved.
Nederland zal bij de Indonesische autoriteiten blijven aandringen op een betekenisvolle dialoog, tussen alle betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het opruimen van de bij de grote brand in Noardburgum vrijgekomen scherven van zonnepanelen

MP Agnes Mulder asked the minister about clean-up of solar panel fragments scattered after a large fire in Noardburgum, including who pays the costs, whether cleanup methods are standardised, and the status of several research projects. The state secretary answered that insurers are primarily responsible for clean-up costs under the polluter-pays rule, that research by RIVM, IFV and TKI Urban Energy is ongoing with results expected later, and that a possible protocol will be considered after the studies conclude.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over berichten dat tot 50 procent van de overwinst van subsidies voor windmolens in de portemonnee van ondernemers verdwijnt

An MP asked the minister whether subsidies for onshore wind turbines leave up to half of excess profit with entrepreneurs, citing a Groningen University study and press reports. The state secretary rejected the picture of widespread oversubsidy, defended the SDE++ tender design, and promised to examine overstimulation in the upcoming evaluation of the scheme.
In addition, the scheme will be evaluated again this year, and the extent to which excess profits occur and can be further limited will also be examined.
Daarnaast zal de regeling dit jaar opnieuw worden geëvalueerd, waarbij de mate waarin overwinsten optreden en verder kunnen worden beperkt ook zal worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk en het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘LNV wijst oplossing Borkumse Stenen van de hand’

MPs Boswijk and Agnes Mulder asked the minister whether a large closed fishing area north of Schiermonnikoog is set to take effect, why the Dutch fishers' federation's alternative plan for the Borkumse Stenen area was rejected, what alternative LNV proposed, and what the next steps are. The minister answered that the 558 km2 extension in the North Sea Agreement is targeted for 2022 but depends on EU procedures, that the fishers' alternative reduces area and ecological value, and that any boundary change needs consent of all North Sea Agreement partners.
The aim is to implement the measures as quickly as possible.
Inzet is om de maatregelen zo snel als mogelijk uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Erkens over het bericht 'Van Hoogezand tot Siddeburen: iedereen wil ’s nachts een stil windpark'

MPs Agnes Mulder and Erkens asked whether the government would consider night-time shutdown of wind turbines at park N33 in Midden-Groningen to address noise nuisance, and about current policy, noise standards, RES planning, and the business-case effects of such shutdowns. The state secretary answered that enforcement lies with municipalities, that current noise norms are scientifically based and not to be revised for now, that night shutdown would cut output and a third more capacity would be needed, and that alternatives are being discussed with the sector.
It is therefore up to the municipalities concerned to establish whether the noise standards are exceeded and to decide on possible steps based on their findings.
Het is daarom aan de betreffende gemeenten om vast te stellen of er sprake is van overschrijding van de geluidsnormen en aan de hand van hun bevindingen te besluiten over eventuele stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Joba van den Berg over het artikel 'Een windcoöperatie in een neoliberale wereld. Het grootkapitaal duwt een burgerinitiatief de markt uit'

The CDA MPs Agnes Mulder and Joba van den Berg asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a newspaper article claiming large developers push out local wind cooperatives, including whether public tendering disadvantages citizen initiatives and whether local binding or ownership should be required. The State Secretary answered that tenders on state land aim for 50% local ownership, that municipalities already have instruments to make participation conditional, and that the government will monitor participation and consider additional measures if needed.
I will critically monitor whether participation indeed comes sufficiently to the fore, and consider additional measures if that proves insufficient.
Ik zal kritisch monitoren of participatie inderdaad voldoende uit de verf komt, en aanvullende maatregelen overwegen als dat onvoldoende gebeurt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Agnes Mulder over de (ongewenste) (neven)effecten van de inwerkingtreding van het wettelijk stelsel voor werkzaamheden aan gasverbrandingsinstallaties(Koolmonoxide- of Gas

MPs Heerma and Mulder asked the Interior Minister about unintended side effects of the Gas Boiler Act (certification for gas appliance work), including rising maintenance subscription costs, withdrawal of installers from older appliances, and municipal enforcement capacity. The minister answered that costs are limited, certification is needed from 1 April 2022, cost developments will be monitored, and an evaluation is planned for 1 October 2023.

As I indicated in my answer to questions 10, 11 and 12, I will keep a close eye on developments before the statutory certification requirement takes effect on 1 April 2022, so that developments such as those you describe can be identified.

Zoals ik in mijn antwoord bij de vragen 10, 11 en 12 heb aangegeven zal ik voor die tijd (in aanloop naar de wettelijke certificeringsplicht per 1 april 2022) al wel de vinger aan de pols houden zodat ontwikkelingen zoals u die schetst kunnen worden gesignaleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Nederlandse zonnepanelen komen van Chinese bedrijven die worden verdacht van dwangarbeid’

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch solar panels are linked to Chinese firms suspected of forced labour in Xinjiang, and what the government would do about it. The government says it lacks data on Xinjiang content in Dutch panels, urges companies to apply due diligence under the OECD Guidelines and UN Guiding Principles, and says it will raise the issue at EU level and engage the sector.
It must be stated at the outset that the cabinet does not have data on the extent to which polysilicon from Xinjiang is processed in the panels used in the Netherlands.
Vooropgesteld staat dat het kabinet niet over gegevens beschikt in hoeverre de in Nederland gebruikte panelen polysilicium uit Xinjiang is verwerkt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van der Staaij, Jasper van Dijk en Agnes Mulder over de veroordeling van een monnik in Turkije voor het geven van brood aan Koerdische bezoekers, in aanvulling op vragen van het li

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about the conviction of a monk in Turkey for giving food to Kurdish visitors, the situation of Christian minorities, and whether EU-Turkey rapprochement and pre-accession aid should continue. The government answered that the Dutch embassy follows the case, that concerns about rule of law and religious freedom in Turkey are raised consistently, and that it has pressed for suspending pre-accession aid, though no Council support exists.
The Netherlands has serious concerns about human rights and the rule of law in Turkey and consistently raises these concerns.
Nederland heeft grote zorgen over de mensenrechten en de rechtsstaat in Turkije en stelt deze zorgen consequent aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhouach en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'TT te vroeg voor financiële compensatie, Mulder stelt Kamervragen'

Two CDA MPs asked whether the TT Assen motorcycle race and other events planned before 1 July 2021 can be compensated under the temporary COVID-19 event subsidy scheme, given that the Drenthe safety region bars large events until 1 June. The minister answered that events can be moved to a date between 1 July and 31 December or receive support if they meet the scheme's conditions, and that the scheme was developed in consultation with the sector and safety regions.
Events planned before 1 July can be moved to a date between 1 July and 31 December, provided it fits the local agenda and a permit is granted.
Evenementen die voor 1 juli staan gepland kunnen worden verplaatst naar een datum binnen de periode 1 juli–31 december, mits dat in de lokale agenda past en er een vergunning verleend wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Groot datalek bij NAM, 19.000 gedupeerden aardbevingsschade getroffen’

An MP asked the minister about a data breach at NAM affecting about 19,000 people with earthquake damage claims, including how it happened, what was leaked, and liability. The minister answered that NAM's file-transfer software was compromised, that mostly basic personal data was leaked with 122 cases of sensitive data, that affected people were contacted, and that NAM as controller is liable under the GDPR.
There are 122 cases in which sensitive personal data was leaked, for example email addresses and telephone numbers.
Er zijn 122 gevallen waar gevoelige persoonsgegevens is gelekt, bijvoorbeeld mailadressen en telefoonnummers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het artikel 'Buitenlandse investeerders gaan er vandoor met miljoenensubsidies én winst van zonneparken'

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports that foreign investors own most of the largest solar parks and take subsidy money abroad, and how this fits the Climate Agreement's 50% local ownership goal. The minister disputes the scale of the subsidy-outflow claim, says foreign ownership is acceptable in a free European market, and says local ownership will grow and best-practice guidance for municipalities is being prepared, but declines to change SDE++ conditions.
I therefore do not take a negative view of such developments.
Ik sta dan ook niet negatief tegenover dergelijke ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'Wederom levensgevaarlijke stenenactie Greenpeace in VK-wateren' van de Nederlandse Vissersbond

MPs Von Martels and Agnes Mulder asked the minister whether she was aware of Greenpeace UK's rock-dumping action south of Brighton, which they said endangers fishers, and what she would do given her earlier stance on the North Sea agreement. The minister said she condemns the action, raised it in international fisheries consultations, and that UK authorities are investigating and the Dutch Public Prosecution Service found no grounds for criminal investigation of a similar earlier action.
This concerns an action by the British branch of Greenpeace in the English part of the North Sea.
Het betreft een actie van de Britse tak van Greenpeace in het Engelse deel van de Noordzee.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over ''afwijzingen door het Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen van verzoeken tot vergoeding van waardedaling bij bewoners die onderdeel waren van de gerechtelijke procedure van

An MP asked whether residents who left the WAG collective lawsuit against NAM and then had their IMG compensation claims rejected could be helped without first filing objections, and why applications by co-owners are assessed only for the applicant's share. The minister explained that IMG could only process claims after withdrawal from court was confirmed, that a small number (about 20) of rejections arose from list mismatches, that IMG has contacted those residents and agreed data-sharing arrangements with WAG, and that objections remain an option though a new application is simplest.
The IMG has made arrangements with Stichting WAG and NAM regarding data exchange in these cases.
Het IMG heeft met Stichting WAG en NAM afspraken gemaakt omtrent de gegevensuitwisseling bij deze gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Agnes Mulder, Sienot, Bromet, Nijboer en Dik-Faber over het rekenmodel waardedalingsregeling dat gedupeerden benadeelt

MPs asked whether the IMG's depreciation model disadvantages the hardest-hit Groningen homes and whether the minister would intervene to apply an individual-level alternative proposed by De Kam and Blanken. The minister replied that the IMG independently sets its own method under the Tijdelijke wet Groningen, that it chose the variant giving the highest average outcomes, and that intervening would undermine its independence, though objections and appeals remain available.
It is not for me but for the IMG to determine, within the legal framework, which method it uses to handle all types of damage, including depreciation damage.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan het IMG om binnen de wettelijke kaders te bepalen welke werkwijze zij hanteert voor de afhandeling van alle schadevormen, waaronder schade door waardedaling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Agnes Mulder over de Gasopslag in Norg

MPs Dik-Faber and Mulder asked about seismic risk, ground movement and damage compensation linked to the Norg gas storage, including the IMG's suspension of damage claim decisions in Drenthe. The minister answers that risks are low, that monitoring and the IMG's compensation process are adequate, and that the IMG is independent and is awaiting TU Delft and TNO advice.
The IMG is independent in its working method as a zbo. I attach great value to this independence; the IMG itself decides how it handles the aforementioned damage claims.
Het IMG is als zbo onafhankelijk in haar werkwijze. Ik hecht grote waarde aan deze onafhankelijkheid, het IMG bepaalt zelf hoe het omgaat met bovengenoemde schade-afhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra, Peters, Agnes Mulder, Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over de betaalbaarheid van duurzaamheidsinvesteringen en de leningen die hiervoor moeten worden afgesloten

MPs asked the Minister how homeowners lacking funds for sustainability investments can be protected from being forced into loans, following a NIBUD study showing at least two million owners cannot afford them. The minister agreed that people without borrowing capacity should not be compelled to borrow, pointed to the energy-saving mortgage with income-based repayment and debt forgiveness, and promised to ask the Warmtefonds to monitor financial stress among vulnerable groups.
Daar ben ik het mee eens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het verzekeren van zonnepanelen en voor de kosten van het opruimen van schade veroorzaakt door brand bij zonnepanelen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about insurability of rooftop solar panels and who pays for cleanup of particles spread after fires, and whether food safety is checked. The minister answered that industry and insurers are working on quality standards and cleanup methods, that no new government intervention is planned, that producers bear food-safety responsibility under NVWA supervision, and that RIVM and IFV research is ongoing.
At this moment, beyond continuing these talks, I foresee no additional role for the government here.
Op dit moment voorzie ik hier bovenop de voortzetting van deze gesprekken geen aanvullende rol voor de overheid in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Postma en Omtzigt over de toepassing van het tonnageregime voor de offshoresector

MPs Mulder, Postma and Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch tonnage tax regime is stricter than in other EU countries, whether it covers vessels used to build offshore wind farms, and what this means for cost and competitiveness. The government answered that the Dutch regime is stricter on some points (e.g. Denmark allows construction-vessel profits), that wind-farm operation profits are excluded, that transport vessels to offshore parks can qualify, and that it will await an evaluation due in early 2021 before deciding on any change.
The cabinet wants to await the aforementioned evaluation before making statements on the desirability and design of any possible adjustment to the tonnage regime.
Het kabinet wil de hiervoor genoemde evaluatie afwachten, alvorens uitspraken te doen over de wenselijkheid en vormgeving van een eventuele aanpassing van de tonnageregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het de postcoderoosregeling en de nieuwe subsidieregeling voor energiecoöperaties

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the gap between the expiring postcode-rose scheme and the new subsidy scheme for energy cooperatives, including transition rules for new members and the timeline. The minister replied that the new subsidy scheme will be published around the turn of the year with an open window from 1 April 2021, that the PBL final advice settles the subsidy amounts, and that the consequences of the transition rules are still being discussed within cabinet.
I will inform your House about the start of the internet consultation.
Ik zal uw Kamer berichten over de start van de internetconsultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over het artikel Weilanden vol glas van zonnepanelen na hevige brand: nieuw probleem voor milieudiensten

MPs Geurts and Agnes Mulder asked the government whether glass shards and debris from solar panels released in fires that settle on surrounding land are a known problem, what the health risks are, and whether a national protocol and insurance-sector discussion are planned. The minister answered that RIVM will run fire experiments, IFV will consider a protocol, the farmer bears responsibility for food safety, and the insurance issue is separate, promising further steps after the research.
In consultation with the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, I will, on the basis of the RIVM research, examine whether follow-up steps are necessary.
Ik zal, in overleg met de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, aan de hand van de onderzoeken van het RIVM bezien of er eventueel vervolgstappen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber en Agnes Mulder over de oproep van de Burgemeester van Loppersum voor een andere aanpak voor de versterkingsoperatie in Groningen

MPs asked whether the government will act on the Loppersum mayor's call for a crisis team and an emergency law to speed up the Groningen earthquake reinforcement operation. The minister says the government is pursuing faster implementation, is in talks with the mayor and regional administrators, and will inform parliament on outcomes, while the reinforcement bill is still being revised after the Council of State's advice.
In line with our commitment in the General Consultation on Mining/Groningen of 24 June, we will inform the House of the outcomes as soon as possible.
Conform onze toezegging in het Algemeen Overleg Mijnbouw/Groningen van 24 juni jl. informeren wij uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de gaswinning in Pernis

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about gas extraction at Pernis, including the seismic risk, the extension of production to 2030, production volumes above the 20% margin, resident involvement and possible earthquake impacts. The minister replied that the seismic risk assessment has not changed, that a risk management plan and accelerometers were required under SodM guidance, that production stays within licensed volumes, and that residents can obtain information via the website and a planned consultation with the region.
The seismic risk in the extraction plan has been carried out by the NAM in accordance with the Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) guideline.
Het seismisch risico in het winningsplan is conform de leidraad van Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) uitgevoerd door de NAM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘NAM wil productiewater Schoonebeek injecteren in Drentse gasvelden’

An MP asked the minister about NAM's plan to inject production water from Schoonebeek into empty gas fields in southeast Drenthe, including why extra capacity is needed, whether a new permit is required, how it compares to Germany, and seismic risk. The minister answered that NAM has not yet formally filed, that a permit and seismic risk assessment with SodM advice will be required, and that injection is currently the best option given pipeline capacity limits.
An injection permit will only be granted if injection can be done safely, and without a permit no injection into the subsurface may take place.
Een injectievergunning wordt alleen verstrekt als injectie veilig kan en zonder vergunning mag er niet in de ondergrond geïnjecteerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Ronnes over zonnepanelen op sociale huurwoningen

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers how to rapidly expand solar panels on social rental housing, including a proposal from Urgenda and housing corporations to use part of the landlord levy in 2020. The government answered that the levy cannot be used this way, pointed to SDE+/SDE++ subsidies and a planned bill on corporations' energy generation, and said it would present a further package to meet the Urgenda ruling.
I am positive about the initiative of Urgenda and housing corporations to expand the number of solar panels on roofs.
Ik sta positief tegenover het initiatief van Urgenda en woningcorporaties om het aantallen zonnepanelen op daken uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Geurts en Von Martels over schade aan mestkelders, ventilatiekanalen en funderingen veroorzaakt door mijnbouwactiviteiten in Groningen

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers whether agricultural damage to manure cellars, ventilation shafts and foundations from Groningen gas extraction had been wrongly excluded from reinforcement and damage handling by NAM, CVW and the TCMG, and how farmers are heard and supported. The government answered that the TCMG handles new damage claims, uses civil liability law with the statutory presumption of causation, is consulting an expert panel on manure cellar damage due around June 2020, and is working with the Province on a programmatic approach for farmers.
The panel's advice is expected to be ready around mid-June 2020.
Naar verwachting is het advies van het panel medio juni 2020 gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Chemelot zet vol in op energie- en chemiesnelweg’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Chemelot industrial site's need for pipelines and energy infrastructure linking Rotterdam, Germany and offshore energy, and about rail transport of hazardous substances. The minister answered that a taskforce on industrial infrastructure is examining the connections, that a cost-benefit study points to modal shift to pipelines, and that talks with the province and companies will follow.
I have made arrangements with the province to discuss this with them soon.
Ik heb afspraken gemaakt met de provincie om dit binnenkort met hen te bespreken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Beckerman en Agnes Mulder over het rapport van de Noordelijke Rekenkamer ‘Herverdeling onder Hoogspanning, een onderzoek naar de verdeling naar de kosten en baten rondom wind- en

MPs asked the ministers about the Northern Audit Office report on how costs and benefits of wind and solar parks are distributed, including whether provinces can enforce compensation for residents and whether uniform national rules are needed. The minister said financial participation is important, that provinces' legal powers are being mapped with the interbestuurlijk level and will be reported after summer 2020, and that he opposes uniform national legal norms because projects differ.
Within interbestuurlijk consultation, it is currently being mapped which legal possibilities and powers decentralised governments have to set requirements on financial participation.
Binnen interbestuurlijk verband wordt momenteel in kaart gebracht welke juridische mogelijkheden/bevoegdheden decentrale overheden hebben om eisen te stellen aan financiële participatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Moorlag  en Mulder over de compensatieregeling voor omwonenden van de windparken N33 en Oostermoer

MPs Beckerman, Moorlag and Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about compensation for property value loss near the N33 and Oostermoer wind farms, including how many homes lost value and whether a 2019 VU/UvA study on turbine size and house prices calls for fairer compensation. The Minister replied that no compensation for value loss was promised, residents can apply for planning damage (planschade) compensation via the municipality or RVO, a rijksbijdrage of 2.1 million euro was added to the Drentse Monden and Oostermoer area fund, and the N33 request will be assessed similarly while no direct compensation is planned.
I do not have an overview of the number of homes in the areas of the N33 and De Drentse Monden en Oostermoer wind farms that have lost value, or the amount of value lost.
Ik heb geen overzicht van het aantal woningen in de gebieden van de windparken N33 en De Drentse Monden en Oostermoer dat in waarde is gedaald en wat de waardedaling van deze woningen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Dik-Faber en Harbers over de organisatie van de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen

Four MPs asked the Minister about reported internal chaos at the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG), its absorption of the CVW, staff turnover and whether this threatens reinforcement work. The Minister denied chaos, called reorganisation necessary, said public execution is now with the NCG and the TCMG/IMG handles compensation, and promised further attention to staff retention and continued contact.
The image that there would be chaos, as the headline above the cited report suggests, I do not recognise.
Het beeld dat er sprake zou zijn van chaos, zoals de kop boven het aangehaalde bericht suggereert, herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Van der Lee en Van Raan over de Gedragscode Zon op Land

Five MPs from different parties asked ministers about the industry-drafted Gedragscode Zon op Land (code of conduct for ground-mounted solar), its alignment with the solar-ladder motions, protection of Natura 2000 and national park areas, guidance to local authorities and RES regions, use in rijksgronden tenders, and PBL's landscape report. The government welcomed the code as consistent with the voorkeursvolgorde zon, said it will be promoted via the Nationaal Programma RES and monitored, and deferred the landscape-policy questions to a forthcoming NOVI letter.
Through the National Programme RES we will bring this code of conduct to the attention of the RES regions.
Via het Nationaal Programma RES (NP RES) brengen we deze gedragscode onder de aandacht van de RES’en.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Agnes Mulder over de vertraging van de noodkeuken op de Johan Willem Frisokazerne in Assen

MPs Van Helvert and Agnes Mulder asked why the emergency kitchen at the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen is delayed by a year, despite earlier promises of operation in summer, and what is being done about food safety and meal quality. The state secretary acknowledges the one-year delay, explains it by a switch to a new interim kitchen location after the old building proved unfit, and states the kitchen is expected in the second half of 2020 while meals are supplied from elsewhere.
Is it correct that the placement of the emergency kitchen at the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen has been delayed by one year?
Klopt het dat de plaatsing van de noodkeuken op de Johan Willem Friso kazerne in Assen met een jaar vertraagd is?
Antwoord op de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber en Agnes Mulder over het gebruik van biomassa als energiebron

MPs Dik-Faber, Sienot and Agnes Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the DNV-GL report on biomass emissions, subsidy amounts, sustainability criteria, planned plants and the RES regional energy strategies. The minister responded that a TNO study on tighter emission limits for small and medium biomass plants is underway, that a sustainability framework is being prepared with an SER advisory report expected in early 2020, and that subsidies for biomass plants continue for now.
I cannot disclose the origin of the wood pellets of a specific company, because this information is commercially confidential.
De herkomst van de houtpellets van een specifiek bedrijf kan ik – in verband met bedrijfsvertrouwelijke aard van deze informatie – niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, en Dik-Faber over het artikel ‘Gedupeerden gaswinning moeten twee keer zo lang wachten op afhandeling schade’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report that Groningen gas-damage claimants face a total wait of about 30 months, as the TCMG postponed its decision deadline by fifteen months. The Minister acknowledged the delay, attributed it to a backlog inherited by the TCMG, and announced a one-off stuwmeer scheme offering a fixed compensation of 5,000 euro to all claims received up to 12 June 2019, with variable compensation up to 11,000 euro for claims from 1 January 2019.
I have decided to enable the TCMG to apply the fixed compensation of 5,000 euro from the stuwmeer scheme to all applications received by the TCMG up to and including 12 June 2019.
Ik heb besloten het de TCMG mogelijk te maken de vaste vergoeding van € 5.000,– uit de stuwmeerregeling te laten gelden voor alle aanvragen die door de TCMG zijn ontvangen tot en met 12 juni 2019
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘windmolens medeoorzaak insectensterfte’

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about reports that wind turbines contribute to insect deaths, citing a German DLR study, and asked about insect considerations in permitting and monitoring of renewable energy. The minister said the German estimate is small relative to total insect numbers according to Dutch experts, that insects are not considered in wind permitting under the Nature Conservation Act, and that the effects of solar parks and renewable energy on insects will be explored.
In permitting wind farms under the Nature Conservation Act, insects are not taken into account.
In de vergunningverlening voor windmolenparken op grond van de Wet natuurbescherming wordt geen rekening gehouden met insecten.
