Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Ronnes en Omtzigt over de opvatting van het financieel stabiliteitscomité over het Klimaatakkoord en over de niet gepubliceerde achtergronddocumenten van het Klimaatakkoord

CDA MPs asked the ministers whether the Financial Stability Committee's warnings about mortgage lending norms and green building-linked finance conflict with the draft Climate Agreement, and why the PBL analysis's background documents and reviewer access were incomplete. The ministers replied that AFM and DNB concerns are being taken into account in designing new financing options, that the PBL published three of five background documents, and that the government holds no unpublished background documents.
It is up to the PBL to make the background documents public.
Het is aan PBL om de achtergronddocumenten openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Moorlag en Agnes Mulder over de miljoenen waardedaling van huizen door windparken

MPs Beckerman, Moorlag and Agnes Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about property value losses near wind farms, the adequacy of the planning damage scheme, the Rijkscoördinatieregeling (RCR) limiting local participation, and profit-sharing with residents. The Minister defended the existing independent planning damage procedure, promised to update the VU study and reconsider how wind areas are designated, and said participation and ownership shares will be addressed in the Klimaatakkoord framework without legally enforcing some transparency demands.
I will consult with the VU to give substance to the update.
Ik zal in overleg treden met de VU om invulling te geven aan de actualisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Ronnes en Omtzigt over de doorrekening van het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL)

MPs Mulder, Ronnes and Omtzigt (CDA) asked the ministers about the PBL cost calculation of the draft Climate Agreement's building-sector measures, including the costs per tonne of CO2 and transparency of assumptions. The minister answered that the calculations use standard insulation assumptions, that PBL has explained its models, and that the Climate and Energy Outlook may incorporate new insights.
PBL strives for full transparency about its calculations.
PBL streeft naar volledige transparantie over zijn berekeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Agnes Mulder over problemen met en leren van pilots aardgasvrije wijken voor de toekomstige wijkaanpak

CDA MPs Ronnes and Agnes Mulder asked about problems in the Nijmegen Meijhorst zero-natural-gas renovation pilot, what central information is collected on neighbourhood pilots, costs, and planning for regional heat plans. The Minister of Interior answered that residents report renovation and comfort problems being addressed, that a Knowledge and Learning Programme and monitoring are being set up, and that further details will follow in later letters.
Your House will be informed about this in the autumn of 2019.
Uw Kamer zal hierover in het najaar van 2019 worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Agnes Mulder over de ramingen en beleidsinformatie aangeleverd door het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL)

Two MPs (Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Mulder) asked about discrepancies between PBL energy projections (NEV 2017, updated analysis) and CBS consumption figures, PBL forecasting accuracy, model transparency and uncertainty margins. The minister answered that the gaps stem from differing assumptions, that the government does not doubt PBL's information, that PBL publishes its models and uncertainty ranges, and that he is working with PBL, CBS and NIBUD to improve communication about household energy bills.
I share the importance of public and verifiable models.
Ik deel het belang van openbare en toetsbare modellen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL) “rommelt met de cijfers en de impact van het eten van vlees op het klimaat overdrijft”

MPs Geurts and Agnes Mulder asked about reports that the PBL overstated the climate impact of meat eating, following objections from Stichting Agri Facts, and whether the Chambers were informed of shortcomings. The minister confirmed the PBL corrected a web publication wording, rejected the claim of shortcomings and said no changes to the Klimaatakkoord calculations are needed.
Based on the objections raised by Stichting Agri Facts and the PBL's response, I have not been able to identify any shortcomings and therefore do not endorse the Foundation's claim.

Op grond van de door de Stichting Agri Facts aangedragen bezwaren en de reactie van het PBL daarop heb ik geen tekortkomingen kunnen constateren en onderschrijf ik de stelling van de Stichting dus niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber, Agnes Mulder, Nijboer en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Stress door gasellende in bevingsgebied neemt toe’

MPs asked the minister about reports that gas-extraction stress in the Groningen earthquake area is rising, the need for psychological care funding, and NAM liability for immaterial damage. The minister acknowledged the mental health problem, pointed to ending gas extraction, independent damage and reinforcement processes, regional support programmes, and said he will await the outcome of pending court proceedings on immaterial damage.
I am awaiting the outcome of the court proceedings.
Ik wacht de uitkomst van de gerechtelijke procedures af.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Agnes Mulder over de bescherming van ondernemers uit het midden- kleinbedrijf (mkb) tegen onredelijke energiecontracten en de oproep van de Consumentenbond voor e

MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about protections for small and medium-sized businesses against onerous energy contracts and the Consumentenbond's call for a total ban on telephone sales. The State Secretary answered that small business customers with small connections get consumer protections under energy law, that exit fees are being investigated by the ACM, and that an opt-in regime for telemarketing and an incasso register are being prepared.

Therefore the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate, together with the ACM, will consider after this investigation concludes whether further measures are necessary to better protect small business customers.
Daarom beziet de Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat samen met de ACM na afronding van dit onderzoek of verdere maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn om kleinzakelijke afnemers beter te beschermen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de belastingsubsidies op elektrische auto’s, de modellen die aangepast lijken te zijn (en geen rekening meer houden met de CO2-uitstoot die gepaard gaat met he

MPs Omtzigt and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked about tax subsidies for electric cars, the CARbonTAX model used for forecasts, its validation and emissions accounting, and cost-effectiveness compared with other CO2 measures and foreign countries. The State Secretary answered at length, defending the model and tank-to-wheel accounting while conceding that fiscal stimulation of electric cars is relatively costly per tonne of CO2 avoided, and offered a technical briefing on the model without providing validation evidence.
The model is the intellectual property of research bureau Revnext. The model is not 'secret' but it is not up to the central government to make this model public.
Het model is intellectueel eigendom van onderzoeksbureau Revnext. Het model is niet «geheim» maar het is niet aan de rijksoverheid om dit model openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Kuik en Agnes Mulder over het verdwijnen van de spoedeisende zorg in Hoogeveen en Stadskanaal

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about the planned closure of the emergency departments in Hoogeveen and Stadskanaal, including ambulance response times, the role of the ambulance services and regional administrators, and the RIVM accessibility analysis. The Minister replied that the regional core team's plan is not yet a decision, that the RIVM analysis shows the 45-minute norm would still be met, and that the ambulance services are involved in a regional steering group with IGJ and NZa monitoring continuity and quality.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'Kazerne moet lang wachten op keuken'

MPs Bruins Slot and Agnes Mulder asked why the kitchen at the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen faces a long wait for new construction and whether it could be accelerated. The State Secretary answered that new building requires several lengthy steps, that an interim kitchen will open in the second half of 2019, and that procurement and appeal rules leave no room to speed up construction.
Based on the laws and regulations on procurement, objection and appeal, there are no options to speed up the new construction.
Op basis van de wet- en regelgeving op het gebied van aanbesteding, bezwaar en beroep zijn er geen mogelijkheden om de nieuwbouw te versnellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Dik-Faber, Sienot en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de metingen van het KNMI in de Groninger bodem niet kloppen

Four MPs asked the minister about reports that KNMI seismic acceleration measurements in Groningen were miscalibrated, covering the cause, when officials and SodM were informed, effects on hazard maps and damage assessment, and whether trust and oversight are affected. The minister answered in detail on the timeline and the KNMI error, said data are usable after correction, and committed to an SodM audit and an evaluation of KNMI's internal processes.
SodM is having an independent audit carried out on the quality of the KNMI's measured ground accelerations.
SodM laat een onafhankelijke audit uitvoeren op de kwaliteit van de gemeten grondversnellingen van het KNMI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Agnes Mulder, Sienot en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Ministerie erkent blunder met energierekening: Tweede Kamer boos’

MPs from VVD, D66, ChristenUnie and CDA asked why the government had used outdated 2017 PBL projections of household energy bills, which underestimated rising prices, and what the consequences are for the 2019 budget, koopkracht and the Klimaatakkoord analysis. Minister Wiebes acknowledges the government should have been less categorical and that the PBL did not update its outlook in 2018, attributes the price rise to market developments and existing policy, and promises a new PBL estimate within weeks.
The cabinet should have been less categorical at the end of last year and should have stressed more that this was a 2017 estimate.
Het kabinet had zich eind vorig jaar minder stellig moeten uitlaten en meer moeten benadrukken dat het hier ging om een raming uit 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Geurts over gevolgen van het gebrek aan netcapaciteit voor duurzame energieprojecten in Drenthe, Groningen en Overijssel

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about consequences of grid capacity shortages in Drenthe, Groningen and Overijssel for solar projects holding SDE+ subsidies that cannot connect to the grid, and whether realisation deadlines can be suspended. The minister replied that RVO can grant one year's extension case by case, that grid investment and location checks via Regional Energy Strategies are being pursued, and that talks with grid operators and ACM are ongoing.
RVO.nl has the option to grant one year's postponement of the realisation deadline from the subsidy's start date.
RVO.nl heeft de mogelijkheid om één jaar uitstel van de realisatietermijn te verlenen op de ingangsdatum van de subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van der Lee over de afvalwaterinjectie in de voormalige gasvelden in Twente

MPs Mulder (CDA) and Van der Lee (GroenLinks) asked why NAM keeps injecting produced wastewater from Schoonebeek into former gas fields in Twente rather than treating it, and whether NAM complies with its injection permits. The minister replies that the 2015-2016 six-yearly evaluation found injection still the most suitable method, that NAM will test new purification technologies at a planned test facility, and that SodM is reviewing NAM's technical evaluation report and reports NAM complies with permit conditions.
The State Supervision of Mines (SodM) supervises NAM's water injection.
Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) houdt toezicht op de waterinjectie van NAM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Agnes Mulder over mogelijke sancties van de VS op Nederlandse bedrijven

MPs Amhaouch and Agnes Mulder asked the government whether it was informed about possible US sanctions on Dutch firms involved in Nord Stream 2 and what it would do to protect them. The minister answered that the government is in regular contact with the US and EU, raises concerns about disproportionate impact, rules out a Special Purpose Vehicle for now, but gives no concrete commitments beyond continued advocacy.
The Netherlands will nevertheless continue to actively raise its concerns bilaterally and within the EU, including about the consequences for Dutch business.
Nederland blijft in bilateraal en EU-verband evenwel actief zijn zorgen onder de aandacht brengen, inclusief over de gevolgen voor het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de kosten van stimulering van elektrische auto’s en de totaal onderschatte vooruitgang in batterij technologie

MPs Omtzigt and Agnes Mulder ask whether EV tax subsidies (company car supplement, BPM, MRB, MIA) are cost-effective, how much they cost over five years, and how battery price assumptions in the CarbonTax model compare with forecasts. The government answers in detail, defending EV incentives as necessary for the transition, admitting past forecasting errors, and giving battery price figures while promising monitoring and an evaluation in 2023.
The cabinet is currently awaiting the costing of these proposals.
Het kabinet is op dit moment in afwachting van de doorrekening van deze voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het onzekere Nederlandse vestigingsklimaat voor bedrijven door klimaatregelingen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the British chemicals firm INEOS chose Antwerp over Rotterdam for a new plant, whether Dutch climate targets were the reason, and what this means for jobs and CO2 emissions. The minister answered that INEOS cited pipeline connections and its existing Antwerp presence, not climate targets, and argued Rotterdam still offers strong opportunities for low-carbon industry.
INEOS has not disclosed how many jobs are involved with the new plant.
INEOS heeft niet bekend gemaakt hoeveel banen met de nieuwe fabriek gemoeid zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Agnes Mulder, Sienot en Dik-Faber over het stimuleren van kleinschalige windprojecten

MPs from GroenLinks, CDA, D66 and ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about decommissioning of small wind turbines, municipal refusals to allow replacement of solitary mills, subsidy levels for medium-sized turbines and uncertainty around the postcode rose scheme. The Minister responded that some decommissioning is planned and monitored, that location decisions rest with provinces and municipalities, that he does not favour a separate SDE+ tariff for medium turbines, and that the successor to the net-metering scheme is still being worked out.
I note that in its report ECN calculated base amounts for hub heights of 40 to 50 metres and 50 to 60 metres respectively.
Ik teken hierbij aan dat ECN in haar rapport basisbedragen heeft berekend voor ashoogten van respectievelijk 40 tot 50 meter en 50 tot 60 meter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Amhaouch en Omtzigt over kansen voor Nederlandse batterij-industrie

MPs from the CDA asked the government whether a German one-billion-euro battery investment, possible Dutch battery opportunities, EU state aid rules and related Dutch initiatives could be supported. The State Secretary answered that Germany's plan is national but aligned with the EU initiative, that the Netherlands is exploring battery opportunities via RVO.nl, and that talks with the Commission and a Twente R&D initiative are ongoing, without firm commitments yet.
The German initiative is not yet sufficiently developed to establish whether, and if so how, it will use European funds, and whether it will conflict with European competition rules.

Het Duitse initiatief is nog onvoldoende uitgewerkt om te kunnen vaststellen of, en zo ja, hoe het gebruik zal maken van Europese middelen, en of het ook tegen Europese mededingingsregels zal aanlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Agnes Mulder over het instellen van wachttijden door de gemeente Assen om tekorten in het sociaal domein tegen te gaan

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Health about Assen's plans to introduce waiting times and budget caps in youth care and Wmo to curb deficits in the social domain. The minister confirmed awareness, noted the council removed the waiting-time proposal before adopting the measures, and stressed that municipalities retain a statutory duty to provide youth care regardless of budget overruns.
The mere fact that the municipal youth care budget is (threatening to be) exceeded does not detract from the youth care obligation.
Het enkele feit dat het gemeentelijk budget voor jeugdhulp overschreden (dreigt) te worden doet niet af aan de jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de kosten van het rijden van een auto, lease of in eigendom, elektrisch of benzine

MPs Omtzigt and Agnes Mulder asked the State Secretary of Finance for catalogue values and net monthly lease costs for several cars under 2018 and 2019 company-car tax rules, plus the cost of running a five-year-old Tesla or Mitsubishi Outlander. The State Secretary answered with tables of catalogue prices, monthly additions to income and the tax due, using substitute models where the Tesla Model 70 was unavailable.
The table below sets out, for the requested car types for 2018, the catalogue price, the monthly addition to income and the tax due on it.
In de hierna opgenomen tabel zijn van de gevraagde (typen) auto’s voor het jaar 2018 de catalogusprijs, de bijtelling per maand en de belasting die daarover verschuldigd is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Ronnes over het potentiële gebruik van slimme meters voor energiebesparing

MPs Mulder and Ronnes asked the ministers about the evaluation of the energy-saving covenant, weak uptake of smart-meter energy-saving services, and smart thermostats. Minister Wiebes answered that the evaluation is expected by end 2018, that the covenant is expected to be complied with, and that policy measures are limited to voluntary sector commitments and subsidies.
I assume that the Covenant will be complied with.
Ik ga er vanuit dat het Convenant zal worden nageleefd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Agnes Mulder, Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij over de berichten dat tegen vijf Soedische mensenrechtenactivistes de doodstraf is geëist

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that prosecutors sought the death penalty against five Saudi human rights activists, including one woman, and whether the trial is fair and what pressure the Netherlands can exert. The minister answered that the government is deeply concerned, opposes the death penalty, raises concerns with Saudi authorities and through EU channels including a joint demarche, and will raise the issue at the November UPR, but gave limited information on the trial itself.
The cabinet is following developments, including the trial of the female activist mentioned in the reports, closely.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen, waaronder het proces van de in de berichtgeving genoemde vrouwelijke activist, op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Diks, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma en Agnes Mulder over de arrestatie van opnieuw twee vrouwenrechtenactivisten in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of two more Saudi women's rights activists, whether it constitutes an attack on the movement, what joint EU steps were taken, and how the government supports civil society. The minister said the government is concerned, an EU demarche was delivered on 8 August urging clarification of charges and fair treatment, but Saudi space for civil society is limited.

On 8 August the Chargé d'Affaires of the European diplomatic mission, together with the European countries present in Riyadh including the Netherlands, delivered a demarche to the Saudi Foreign Minister.

Op 8 augustus jl. voerde de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde van de Europese diplomatieke missie samen met de in Riyad aanwezige Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, een demarche uit bij de Saoedische Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Geurts en Ronnes over aansluiting en planning van duurzame energie projecten met betrekking tot elektriciteitsnetwerken en beschermen natuur, landschap en vruchtbare landbouw

MPs from the CDA asked the Economic Affairs minister about grid connection delays for renewable energy projects, the statutory connection deadlines and sanctions, planning coordination with regional governments, and protecting nature, landscape and farmland from solar parks. The minister answered that the 18-week deadline is increasingly exceeded for some connections, that no sanctions have been imposed to date, and that regional energy strategies and the national environment vision will address spatial coordination.
For connections to the low and medium voltage grid there is no uniform recording of exceedances of the deadlines.
Voor aansluitingen op het laagspannings- en middenspanningsnet is er geen uniforme vastlegging van overschrijdingen van de termijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Agnes Mulder over geluid van warmtepompen en airco’s voor omwonenden

MPs Ronnes and Agnes Mulder asked the ministers about noise from heat pumps and air conditioners affecting neighbours, including existing national rules and possible measures. The government answered that the Bouwbesluit 2012 currently sets no neighbour-protection noise rules, that it intends to add them later in 2018, and that municipalities can use APV noise provisions in the meantime.
No rules are set in the Bouwbesluit 2012 on the noise of heat pumps and air conditioners to protect neighbours.
Aan het geluid van warmtepompen en airco’s worden in het Bouwbesluit 2012 geen regels gesteld ter bescherming van omwonenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz, Dik-Faber, Jetten en Agnes Mulder over het vertrek van de NCG

MPs asked about the role of the National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) after its director Alders resigned, covering its remit, houses inspected and reinforced, the shift of damage handling to an independent commission, funding, timelines for reinforcing 2,500 homes, and continuity of the programme. The minister answered in detail, stating the NCG no longer handles damage claims, that reinforcement decisions should be made independently of NAM with advice from the Mijnraad, and that continuity is being secured.
Because of these developments, the NCG no longer has a role in damage handling.
Vanwege deze ontwikkelingen heeft de NCG geen rol meer in de schadeafhandeling.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Voordewind, Becker, Diks, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij, Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Prominente Saudische vrouwenrechtenactivisten opgepakt’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrests of Saudi women's rights activists were only for campaigning for women's right to drive, and whether the government would raise the matter bilaterally and in the EU and call for their release. The minister said the detainees are suspected of conspiracy with foreign powers and financing hostile actors, that Nederland raised concerns with the Saudi foreign minister and is consulting partners including in the EU, and that it remains concerned about repression of dissent.
The Netherlands will continue to ask for attention to the detention of the activists and press for proper treatment.
Nederland zal aandacht blijven vragen voor de aanhoudingen van de activisten en aandringen op goede behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Agnes Mulder over de voorgenomen sluiting van de acute verloskunde in Stadskanaal en Hoogeveen

MPs Van den Berg and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the minister about Treant's plan to concentrate acute obstetrics and paediatrics in Emmen, closing Stadskanaal and Hoogeveen, including the insurer's objections, paediatrician recruitment, regional impact and consultation. The minister declined to take sides between insurer and provider, described recruitment efforts, said the decision is not yet final, and referred the remaining questions to a separate letter to parliament.
I do not wish to interfere in a discussion between the health insurer and the care provider.
Ik wil mij niet mengen in een discussie tussen de zorgverzekeraar en zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Agnes Mulder over de enorme stijging van elektriciteitstarieven op Bonaire

CDA MPs asked why electricity tariffs on Bonaire rose about 24% from January 2018, whether they are cost-covering, and whether there is protection for vulnerable consumers. The minister said tariffs were previously kept artificially low by a subsidy funded by Dutch taxpayers, that the rise is mainly due to oil prices and network costs, that a subsidy will lower network tariffs and a bill for drinking water is being prepared, and that a usage-independent tariff is introduced on 1 April.
I am in discussion with WEB about how to deploy the subsidy.
Ik ben in gesprek met WEB over hoe de subsidie in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat Shell de NAM op afstand zet

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Shell's withdrawal of its 403 liability declaration for NAM affects compensation for Groningen earthquake damage and whether Shell can escape its responsibility. The minister answered that the withdrawal was known since June 2017, that NAM's legal obligations are unaffected, and that the State, Shell and ExxonMobil are negotiating to guarantee NAM's future financial obligations.
It was known that Shell had withdrawn the 403 declaration.
Het was bekend dat Shell de 403-verklaring had ingetrokken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over mogelijke mijnbouwactiviteiten aan de grens met België bij Zuid-Limburg voor de winning van onder andere zink en mogelijke effecten voor de Nederlandse bie

CDA MPs asked whether Belgian mining exploration for zinc near the Dutch border, and the Einstein Telescope bid in South Limburg, threaten each other. The minister answered that the Belgian authorities did not notify the Netherlands, that a transboundary environmental assessment would be required, and that the Belgian mining could affect the telescope's noise environment, but that it is too early to judge and the matter will be investigated with the province and the Belgian authorities.
I was not informed by the Belgian authorities.
Ik ben door de Belgische autoriteiten niet op de hoogte gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over kosten van NAM die betaald worden door EBN

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why NAM charged EUR 48.7 million in reorganisation costs to EBN, how this arises from agreements with the state, whether Ernst & Young advice was used, and who bears Groningen damage costs. The minister answered that EBN bears 40% of operator costs under cooperation agreements, that the reorganisation was audited by Ernst & Young, but declined to share the advice citing confidential business and personal information.

Because this concerns the execution of a private-law agreement between EBN and an operator and the documents contain personal and business-sensitive information, I do not have the advice or other documents from Ernst & Young.

Omdat het hier gaat om de uitvoering van een privaatrechtelijke overeenkomst tussen EBN en een operator en de stukken persoons- en bedrijfsgevoelige informatie bevatten, beschik ik niet over het advies of andere stukken van Ernst & Young.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de berichtgeving over twijfels over de veiligheid van gasmeters

An MP asked the minister about reports that about 44,000 Landis+Gyr smart gas meters had a production defect, including repaired meters with a wrong glue, and about safety, replacement timing, cost and prevention. The minister answered that SodM has ordered replacement by 1 April 2018, that the consumer should not pay, and that responsibility for costs is still being examined.
SodM therefore ordered the grid operators concerned to replace the meters with the wrong glue immediately.
Daarop heeft SodM de betrokken netbeheerders gesommeerd de meters met de verkeerde lijm per direct te vervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over afhandeling klachten en benutting slimme meters

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about complaints over smart meters raised on the Radar broadcast, including the handling of complaints, the 'kastje-naar-de-muur' problem, and how savings potential is promoted. The minister answered that the meters measure reliably, that complaints have been handled through a step-by-step procedure with grid operators and suppliers, and that monthly consumption overviews and savings measures are being pursued.

I take the complaints in the Radar broadcast about energy suppliers' and grid operators' customer service, estimated energy use and the communication about it in relation to the smart meter as a serious signal.

Ik vat de klachten in de Radar-uitzending over de klantenservice van energieleveranciers en netbeheerders, geschat energieverbruik en de communicatie daarover in relatie tot de slimme meter op als een serieus signaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over ernstige verontreiniging door lekkages NAM in Rossum

MPs Mulder and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a serious soil and groundwater contamination from leaks at an NAM site in Rossum, including when it was discovered, why it went unnoticed, and remediation timing. The minister answered that the historic contamination, first found in 1985, cannot be traced to its cause or exact timing, that the province of Overijssel is the competent authority, and that remediation is not urgent while current use poses no unacceptable risk.
The production water comes from oil extraction in Schoonebeek.
Het productiewater is afkomstig van de oliewinning in Schoonebeek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over het artikel “Nieuwe lekkage AkzoNobel in Hengelo: kalk en pekel gelekt”

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a new large leak at AkzoNobel in Hengelo, the timeliness of reporting to SodM, a list of leaks, the company's safety management and whether its permits will be reviewed. The minister answered that the leaks were reported to SodM in time (except one, put 335), that SodM supervises AkzoNobel's safety management and leak list, and that a new risk analysis and pipeline renovation are underway, with permit revision planned.
SodM has therefore asked AkzoNobel to carry out a new risk analysis following this recent leak.
SodM heeft daarom AkzoNobel gevraagd om naar aanleiding van deze recente lekkage een nieuwe risicoanalyse uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de complexiteit van de regeling verlaagd tarief bij collectieve opwek of postcoderoosregeling

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Economic Affairs about the complexity of the reduced VAT rate scheme for collective renewable energy and the postcode rose scheme, including inconsistent tax office assessments, the effect of moving out of the postcode area, and whether a separate SDE+ category should be created. The government answered that VAT treatment depends on contractual arrangements, that an inventory of cases is underway, that moving out of the area can affect participation with only limited extra administrative burden, that the scheme will be evaluated this autumn, and that a separate SDE+ category would not reduce complexity and would harm effectiveness.
This autumn the evaluation of the scheme will begin.
Dit najaar zal begonnen worden met de evaluatie van de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van den Berg, Omtzigt, Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven en Dik-Faber over lekkages bij AKZO-Nobel in Twente

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about new well leaks at AkzoNobel in Twente, the number and effects of leaks, SodM's enforcement and projects, and liability for leak damage. The minister answered that lists of leaks are published and checked by SodM, that the effects appear limited to the immediate vicinity of leaking wells, that enhanced supervision continues with a research programme due by end 2017, and that liability stays with the party responsible at the time of the leak.
SodM urged AkzoNobel to give appropriate urgency to the investigation and remediation of leaks and possible contamination in Twente.
SodM heeft bij AkzoNobel aangedrongen op gepaste urgentie bij het onderzoek en de sanering van lekkages en mogelijke verontreinigingen in Twente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de voortzetting van betaalme.nu

MP Agnes Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about late payments to SMEs, the future of the Betaalme.nu self-regulation initiative and whether its subsidy will be extended. The minister said payment behaviour has improved but there is room for more, that self-regulation remains important alongside the 60-day payment-term law, and that talks on Betaalme.nu's future are ongoing with the subsidy ending in August 2017.
We are currently in discussion with Betaalme.nu and with representatives of the business community about the future of Betaalme.nu.
Over het vervolg van Betaalme.nu zijn we op dit moment in gesprek met Betaalme.nu en met vertegenwoordigers van het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Paternotte over het niet in kaart brengen van bepaalde regeldruk

MPs Mulder (CDA) and Paternotte (D66) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why regulatory burden from ministry, agency and supervisor policy rules is not measured, whether it counts toward the 2.5 billion euro reduction target, and what the Actal advisory council's findings on policy rules imply. The minister replied that policy rules are not formally legislation and are not counted, that no follow-up research is needed, that he is not convinced of additional costs from policy rules, but that bottlenecks will be tackled through case-by-case work and invites businesses to report problems.
Policy rules are formally speaking not legislation.
Beleidsregels zijn formeel gezien geen wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat aardbevingsbestendig bouwen niet hoeft in Groningen

MPs Ronnes and Agnes Mulder asked whether construction firms in Groningen are building non-earthquake-resistant homes, how many, why NPR 9998 was not designated in the Bouwbesluit, and whether NAM compensation could be made mandatory. Minister Kamp answered that professional firms should apply the NPR, that its application is not mandatory, that a solution for NAM covering reasonable extra costs is being explored with a result expected by end 2017, and that the NPR will be designated once clarity exists.
Nor are there exact figures on the numbers.
Ook zijn er geen exacte inzichten in aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de gasopslag bij Langelo en schadeafhandeling

An MP asked the minister about the follow-up study into damage above the Norg gas storage, the role of the National Coordinator Groningen and inspections, the seismic risk analysis, and whether the storage plan's pressure limits would cause more seismicity. The minister answered that the NCG has no role for Norg damage, that the follow-up study is folded into a broader study, that damage claims go to NAM with appeal to the Tcbb, that the revised storage plan will be submitted for advice before a decision, and that the Inspecteur-generaal der mijnen judged the risk analysis satisfactory.
Under the approval decision it is not for me to respond to the reports, but for the Inspector-General of Mines.
Het is conform het instemmingsbesluit niet aan mij om een reactie te geven op de rapportages, maar aan de Inspecteur-generaal der mijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Agnes Mulder over de toekomst van het Besthesdaziekenhuis in Hoogeveen en het Refaja ziekenhuis in Stadskanaal

MPs Bruins Slot and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked about the future of the Bethesda hospital in Hoogeveen and Refaja hospital in Stadskanaal, including obstetrics, level 3 emergency care, loss of eye care, and dialogue with the region. The State Secretary answered that nothing has changed since earlier answers, obstetrics and emergency care remain guaranteed, Treant plans regional dialogue, and the regional acute care working group's conclusions are expected before summer.
For all hospital locations of Treant Zorggroep (Bethesda in Hoogeveen, Refaja in Stadskanaal and Scheper in Emmen), clinical and acute obstetrics is available 24/7.
Voor alle ziekenhuislocaties van de Treant Zorggroep (Bethesda in Hoogeveen, Refaja in Stadskanaal en Scheper in Emmen) geldt dat de klinische en acute verloskunde 24/7 voorhanden is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over het faillissement van het Zeeuwse bedrijf Thermphos

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked about the bankruptcy of Thermphos, the Kazakh dumping ruling, the EU's role, and state responsibility for the remediation of the site containing low-level radioactive waste. The minister answered that the Rijk helped the province find remediation experts, that the damages claim is a private matter, that the EU and national state bear no direct liability for dumping, and that the company is primarily responsible for remediation under the EU radioactive waste directive.
The national government has in recent months discussed with the province of Zeeland the request for experts.
Het Rijk heeft de afgelopen periode met provincie Zeeland gesproken over de vraag om deskundigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de gaswinning in Groningen en de toename van de seismiciteit bij Loppersum

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the NAM must include SodM's requested study of rising seismicity near Loppersum in its half-yearly monitoring report, send all such reports to parliament, and deliver an alternative production-distribution study and a societal risk calculation by specified dates, and why about one billion cubic metres of production must be kept at the Loppersum clusters. The minister answered that the monitoring report is already a licence condition, that reports are sent and published, that the production study and societal risk calculation are due by 1 November 2017 under the licence conditions, and that Loppersum clusters must stay open for supply security.
Yes. Incidentally, I note that NAM also publishes the measurement and monitoring report itself.
Ja. Overigens merk ik op dat NAM de meet-en monitoringsrapportage zelf ook publiceert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Agnes Mulder over windenergie op zee en netwerken op zee

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether plans for an artificial North Sea island hub conflict with the planned offshore wind farms off the Dutch coast, and why wind farms are not sited further offshore. The minister replied that the island is a long-term idea beyond 2030, not an alternative to the 3,500 MW target for 2023, and that near-shore zones remain the cheapest to develop.
It is not an either-or, but a both-and.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Agnes Mulder over de subsidieregeling Energiebesparing en duurzame energie sportaccommodaties die opnieuw overvraagd wordt

MPs Bruins Slot and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked whether the energy-saving subsidy scheme for sports facilities was again oversubscribed within days, and about the scale of applications, the effect on club finances, and whether more funding would be provided. The State Secretary reported 583 applications totalling about 6.7 million euros as of 1 March 2017 with half still under review, gave breakdowns by measure and sport, estimated the cost of full coverage, and said the government will not add extra funds but will reuse unspent 2016 money.
I have previously informed you that this cabinet is not willing to make extra funds available for this subsidy scheme.
Ik heb u eerder laten weten dat dit kabinet niet bereid is om extra middelen vrij te maken voor deze subsidieregeling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Nieuwe generatie IT-bedrijven klaagt over gebrek aan opdrachten van overheid’

MPs Amhaouch and Mulder asked whether government awards few contracts to Dutch web and digital agencies, and whether consultants should be encouraged to partner with them. The minister replied that 65 DDA member firms received about 112 million euro in Rijk contracts over 2010-2015, that no European ICT tender in 2016 was awarded to DDA members, and that a meeting with DDA would be organised to discuss possible barriers.
The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will, together with the Ministry of Economic Affairs, organise a conversation with DDA to discuss any possible barriers.
Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties zal in samenwerking met het Ministerie van Economische Zaken een gesprek met DDA organiseren om eventuele blokkades te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Pieter Heerma en Agnes Mulder over de berichten “Bod Unilever van baan” en “De drie meedogenloze saneerders uit Brazilië”

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and the Prime Minister about a reported takeover bid for Unilever by 3G Capital, including effects on Dutch jobs, R&D, food security, sustainability, and whether Dutch takeover protection could block it. The minister answered most questions on substance, noting the bid is off the table, the Netherlands' Corporate Governance Code applies, and the planned telecom-only takeover law does not cover this sector, with no commitment to block a future bid.
As long as the acquiring party would maintain a statutory Dutch-based listed company, that listed company falls under the scope of the Dutch Corporate Governance Code.

Zolang de overnemende partij een statutair in Nederland gevestigde vennootschap met beursnotering zou handhaven, valt die beursvennootschap onder de reikwijdte van de Nederlandse Corporate Governance Code.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Gesthuizen, Oosenbrug en Agnes Mulder over de locatie Zeewolde voor de middengolfzender

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Zeewolde medium-wave mast is a non-duplicable monopoly, whether the owner NOVEC must provide sharing under the Telecommunications Act, and whether the government should help find an alternative site for Groot Nieuws Radio before its lease ends. The minister answered that finding a suitable site is the licence holder's responsibility, that the government will help assess alternatives, and that the access dispute is pending before the ACM, so he cannot comment on the substance.
During ongoing legal proceedings I cannot make substantive statements about the matter in question.
Gedurende lopende juridische procedures kan ik geen inhoudelijke uitspraken over de desbetreffende zaak doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de weergave van gegevens in het eindrapport ‘Herevaluatie Verwerking Productiewater Schoonebeek’ (eindrapport) dat door Royal Haskoning DHV in opdracht van NAM is opgestel

MP Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about claims that the Royal Haskoning DHV report on alternatives to Twente water injection misrepresented costs and capacity of purification technologies from Saltech and Nieuwe Weme, and asked for further justification, a pilot, and advisory input. Minister Kamp replied that the report was commissioned by NAM, that the additional purification variants were designed with the technology providers, that Deltares and the Commissie voor de m.e.r. are advising independently, and that a decision was expected in February 2017.
To ensure independence, I asked the Commissie voor de m.e.r. and the knowledge institute Deltares to advise me on the research design, the interim report and the final report.

Om de onafhankelijkheid te borgen heb ik de Commissie voor de m.e.r. en het kennisinstituut over water en waterzuivering Deltares gevraagd om mij te adviseren over de onderzoeksopzet, het tussenrapport en het eindrapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Nederland verspeelt kansen in veelbelovende ruimtevaartmarkt’

MPs Verhoeven and Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about an article saying the Netherlands is losing opportunities in the space market, including its low ranking in ESA programme investment and risks to ESTEC. The minister agreed space technology is important, explained Dutch ESA contributions and the geo-return principle, and said the government is looking at further support for ESTEC.
Currently it is being considered what more the Netherlands can do for ESTEC to further secure its presence in Noordwijk.
Momenteel wordt bezien wat Nederland extra kan doen voor ESTEC om haar aanwezigheid in Noordwijk verder te bestendigen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van Helvert en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Andere zorgen over kerncentrale Tihange’

MPs from the CDA asked whether it is alarming that safety plans of the Tihange nuclear plant were publicly accessible online, whether the minister will raise this with Belgium, and what cyber-security rules apply. The minister agreed it is alarming, said the ANVS has discussed it with Belgium's FANC and will raise it with his Belgian counterpart, and described existing nuclear cyber-security rules and reporting obligations.
I will also do so when I am in contact with my Belgian colleague Jambon.
Ik zal dit ook doen als ik contact heb met mijn Belgische collega Jambon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Oosenbrug over de mobiele bereikbaarheid in Nederland

MPs Agnes Mulder (CDA) and Oosenbrug (PvdA) asked the ministers about poor mobile coverage in dozens of villages, regional differences, municipal antenna permitting, and reports of 112 emergency calls failing. The minister answered that coverage is generally very good, that municipalities and operators share responsibility for local improvements, that Agentschap Telecom offers technical help, and that the national government has no power to override a municipal refusal of an antenna permit.
The national government has no possibility to overturn such a decision by a municipality.
De rijksoverheid heeft geen mogelijkheden om een dergelijk besluit van een gemeente te verwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het vergoeden van schade voor inwoners in Groningen

Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about compensation for property value loss in Groningen, whether it duplicates NAM payments, the buy-out pilot, and the annual review (ijkmoment) of the gas-extraction permit. The minister answered that the NAM value-loss case is pending before the appeals court, that the government value-increase scheme is separate from NAM's scheme, that the buy-out pilot will be evaluated in early 2017, and that decentralised governments will be involved in the annual review though without formal consultation rights.
As the case is still before the court, I will not make substantive statements about it.
Aangezien de zaak nog onder de rechter is, doe ik hier inhoudelijk geen uitspraken over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Geurts over het tegenhouden van het energiebesparingssysteem glastuinbouw door het Ministerie van Economische Zaken

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the ministry is not declaring the greenhouse horticulture energy-saving scheme (EBG) generally binding despite broad sector support and the government's own plans for sustainability initiatives. The minister answered that the request is still under assessment against applicable frameworks, that he supports the scheme's energy-saving goal, and that a separate planned bill on sustainability agreements has different conditions, promising to inform parliament as soon as possible.
The State Secretary and I will inform your House as soon as possible about the assessment of the request.
De Staatssecretaris en ik zullen uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over de beoordeling van het verzoek informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de geofoons in Twente, die bevingen meten in Twente veroorzaakt door de afvalwaterinjectie door de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM)

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked why geophones near the Twente wastewater injection sites were not all live-readable and whether NAM promised such live access, and about responsibility for data collection and analysis. Minister Kamp answered that KNMI operates and analyses the stations, that connectivity issues explain the gaps, and committed to contacting KNMI to ensure live data, open storage and periodic analyses.
Ik heb contact opgenomen met het KNMI.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘EU-president Juncker eist beter roamingplan’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he shares the Commission president's call for a better draft roaming proposal, whether roaming costs can be fully abolished in 2017, and how cross-border workers are protected. The minister replied that the Commission's new proposal defines reasonable use without day limits, that Dutch negotiating positions focus on lower wholesale tariffs and clarity for operators and regulators, and that cross-border workers may roam at domestic rates under the proposal.
I will, in the further handling of the proposal, ask for clarification of the position of border residents and cross-border workers.
Ik zal bij de verdere behandeling van het voorstel vragen om een verduidelijking van de positie van grensbewoners en grenswerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Schouten en het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat weinig Nederlanders werk vinden in Duitsland

MPs from ChristenUnie and CDA asked about a report that few Dutch people seek work in Germany, and about the Actieteam grensoverschrijdende economie en arbeid, INTERREG funding and cross-border information points. The minister acknowledges untapped cross-border job potential, describes ongoing Actieteam work with results promised in Q1 2017, and notes that border information point funding is temporary with an SZW evaluation planned for 2018.
As far as can now be seen, the cabinet will inform you of the results of the Actieteam by the first quarter of 2017 at the latest.
Naar het zich nu laat aanzien, wordt u uiterlijk in het eerste kwartaal 2017 door het kabinet geïnformeerd over de resultaten van het Actieteam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Agnes Mulder over het achterblijven van de financiering aan maatschappelijke organisaties

MPs Voordewind and Agnes Mulder asked why only about 22% of the 2016 development budget flows through civil society organisations, below the 25% target in their motion, and how the target will be met in 2016 and 2017. Minister Ploumen answered that the percentage is depressed by budget items counted as ODA (such as first-year asylum reception costs), that about 30% would flow via civil society excluding these, that the government aims for 25% without steering the channel mix, and that several programmes will be implemented through civil society organisations.
The cabinet has committed to aim for spending 25% of the ODA budget via civil society.
Het kabinet heeft toegezegd te streven naar besteding van 25% van het ODA-budget via het maatschappelijk middenveld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘NAM stuurt experts weg’

MP Agnes Mulder asked why NAM ended its agreement with contra-expertise firm Vergnes Expertise, which Groningen earthquake victims often used, and whether the government would mediate. The minister answered that NAM cited many complaints about delays and report quality, that Vergnes ended an improvement trajectory, and that residents can still obtain contra-expertise from other firms and appeal to the Arbiter Aardbevingsschade.
This concerns a cooperative relationship between two private parties in which the government is not a party and cannot simply intervene.
Het betreft een samenwerkingsrelatie tussen twee private partijen waar de overheid geen partij in is en niet zonder meer in kan treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de heropstart van de afvalwaterinjectie in Twente

MPs Mulder and Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the permits, chemical content, liability, legal classification, seismic risk and timing of the restart of wastewater injection in Twente by NAM. The minister answered all 18 questions in substance, committing to send the permits and the evaluation reports, while declining to treat the injection as a waste-disposal matter under EU rules.
Yes, I will send these permits separately to your House in the short term.
Ja, deze vergunningen zal ik op korte termijn separaat naar uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over de veiligheid van de Belgische kernreactor Tihange 2

MPs Mulder and Van Helvert asked the minister about the safety of Belgian reactor Tihange 2 after reports of irregularities in forged reactor components. The minister replied that the Belgian regulator FANC found no safety risk, that the dossier was incomplete, that no link to the reactor vessel cracks exists, and that the ANVS will keep monitoring the case and a communication plan is being developed.

I have, however, asked the ANVS to continue following the matter surrounding the irregularities at the Creusot forge and to inform me when new developments arise that are important for the safety of Dutch citizens.
Wel heb ik aan de ANVS gevraagd om de zaak rondom de onregelmatigheden bij de Creusot smederij te blijven volgen en mij te informeren wanneer er zich nieuwe ontwikkelingen voordoen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de heropstart van de oliewinning in Schoonebeek en de hervatting van de injectie van productiewater in Twente

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked the minister whether NAM had informed him of its plan to resume wastewater injection and oil production at Schoonebeek, why parliament was not informed of the decision, and to release the evaluation and Deltares report. The minister confirmed NAM notified SodM and his ministry, said the decision was postponed to year-end, promised to send the evaluation and advice by early September, but declined to provide some documents and deferred the decision to consultation with the region.
I expect to send the Commission's advice and the Deltares second opinion to your House in early September 2016.
Ik verwacht het advies van de Commissie en de second opinion van Deltares begin september 2016 naar uw Kamer toe te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Agnes Mulder over het bericht van de Consumentenbond dat hotelkamers in Nederland vaak vies zijn

MPs Heerma and Mulder asked the ministers whether a Consumentenbond finding that many hotel rooms are dirty is linked to reported exploitation of hotel cleaners, what hygiene criteria apply, and what the latest data on one- and two-star hotels show. The minister answered that no link is known, that no legal cleaning criteria exist beyond food-hygiene rules enforced by the NVWA, that no hygiene statistics are available, and that the market and review sites should handle hygiene transparency.
There are no figures known about the hygiene of hotels.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over de hygiëne van hotels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Dijkgraaf, Jasper van Dijk, Bruins, De Roon en Grashoff over de voorlopige toepassing van het vrijhandelsverdrag met Canada (CETA)

MPs asked whether Netherlands had an effective veto over provisional application of the Ukraine association agreement and would have one over provisional application of CETA, and requested legal advice on provisional application. The minister confirmed unanimity applied for the association agreement, said CETA's voting rule depends on the legal basis not yet determined, and stated the government knows of no written legal advice received on provisional application.
Whether decision-making on signature and provisional application of CETA will be by unanimity or qualified majority depends on the legal basis.
Of besluitvorming over ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing van CETA zal geschieden met unanimiteit of gekwalificeerde meerderheid is afhankelijk van de rechtsgrondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Jasper van Dijk, Dijkgraaf, Grashoff, De Roon, Jan Vos en Agnes Mulder over de voorlopige inwerkingtreding van het handelsakkoord tussen de EU en Canada (CETA)

Seven MPs asked the trade minister whether the Commission's plan to provisionally apply the EU-Canada CETA would be put to parliament, how the parliamentary reservation demanded by an earlier motion would be implemented, and whether CETA will be a mixed agreement. The minister answered that the Commissioner's commitment to consult the European Parliament is noted, that the government will formally register a parliamentary reservation in the Council once a proposal is tabled and inform the Tweede Kamer promptly, and that which parts would apply provisionally is not yet known.

If the Commission has submitted a proposal for a Council decision on signature and provisional application, the cabinet will formally implement the motion by stating in the Council that the Netherlands cannot agree to the proposal before it has been discussed with the House of Representatives.

Als de Commissie een voorstel heeft gedaan voor een Raadsbesluit voor ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing, zal het kabinet formeel uitvoering geven aan de motie door in de Raad kenbaar te maken dat Nederland niet kan instemmen met het voorstel voordat het voorstel is besproken met de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over aardbevingsbestendige normen in Groningen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about progress in setting earthquake-resistant standards for new, renovated and reinforced buildings, industrial installations and infrastructure in Groningen. The minister replied that the individual risk norm of 10^-5 per year was set in November 2015, that building norms were translated into a practice guideline, and that norms for industry and infrastructure are still being developed, with a government response expected in autumn 2016.
A response to this still open recommendation has been promised to your House. I expect to be able to give it in autumn 2016.
Aan uw Kamer is een reactie toegezegd op deze nog open staande aanbeveling. Deze verwacht ik in het najaar van 2016 te kunnen geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over slimme meters en dynamische leveringstarieven

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about dynamic energy supply tariffs, smart meter rollout figures, missing P1 ports, ICT adjustments, timelines and costs, and monitoring of meter data quality. The minister answered that consumer choice is valued but a large offer is not a goal, gave smart meter counts and a timeline for ICT changes, and declined to intervene in the market on P1-port tariffs.
What matters is that the energy contract matches the wishes of the consumer.
Het gaat er daarbij om dat het energiecontract aansluit bij de wensen van de consument.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Amhaouch over onterechte reputatieschade van bestuurders van het Water- en Energiebedrijf Bonaire

MPs Agnes Mulder and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the ministers whether the SEO report on governance at Water- en Energiebedrijf Bonaire unjustly damaged the reputations of its board members, and questioned the handling of the tender and the decision to build the wind-diesel plant. Minister Kamp answers that the SEO conclusions on governance shortcomings were confirmed by the Landsadvocaat and Mazars, that the tender produced one bid, that no criminal referral is warranted, and that no apology is due.
As appears from the answer to question 9, the investigations were not carried out unjustly.
Zoals uit het antwoord op vraag 9 blijkt, zijn de onderzoeken niet onterecht uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat windmolens in de Veenkoloniën de telescoop van Astron ‘Lofar’ dreigen te nekken

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether wind turbines in the Veenkoloniën threaten the Lofar telescope at Exloo, and why Astron was not involved earlier in the wind park planning. The minister answers that talks with Astron, the developers and the province are ongoing to mitigate interference, that the planning decision is due in Q3 2016, and that the wider questions on investments and EU contacts are not his to answer or are a national responsibility.
The talks with Astron follow their own track and that consultation is still ongoing.
Het gesprek met Astron kent een eigen traject en dat overleg vindt nog steeds plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht “Brussel blokkeert supersnel internet”

An MP asked the Economic Affairs minister about reports that Brussels blocks fast internet, including the status of a motion on accelerating broadband and the rules restricting regional investment. The minister answered that state aid rules allow public funding but require Commission approval in grey areas, that no concrete regional proposals exist yet, and that he will talk with provinces and providers to improve information sharing.
I see no reason to raise this topic in the Competitiveness Council, apart from the fact that the Council has no formal role in it.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om dit onderwerp aan de orde te brengen in de Raad voor Concurrentievermogen, daargelaten het feit dat de Raad hier geen formele rol in heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Agnes Mulder en Smaling over het bericht ‘Mondengebied monddood’

MPs Van Veldhoven, Agnes Mulder and Smaling asked why the ministry's wind park information sessions require barcode registration, ban phones-recording and filming, and whether the personal data register complies with privacy law and was reviewed by the privacy authority. The minister defended the restrictions as protecting privacy and openness, said data will be destroyed after the sessions, acknowledged the registration form lacked a controller notice, and did not seek the privacy authority's advice.

I have noted that the online registration form for the sessions does not state that the Ministry of Economic Affairs is responsible for processing the personal data and for what purpose the data is requested.

Ik heb geconstateerd dat het online registratieformulier voor de spreekuren niet vermeldt dat het Ministerie van Economische Zaken verantwoordelijk is voor de verwerking van de persoonsgegevens en met welk doel de gegevens worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder betreft het vonnis van de Hoge Raad over all-in prijzen bij mobiele telefoonabonnementen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Supreme Court ruling that all-in mobile phone subscriptions are credit agreements and whether providers unlawfully hid device prices, including what consumers and providers face and how further breaches will be prevented. The minister confirmed the ruling, said providers must state the device price separately, expects providers to comply, and pointed to ACM and AFM enforcement and the De Vries motion on exempting telecom credit from financial supervision rules.
It may be assumed that providers will bring their advertising and contract terms into line with the applicable laws and regulations.
Aangenomen mag worden dat de aanbieders hun reclame-uitingen en contractvoorwaarden in overeenstemming zullen brengen met de geldende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over hernieuwbare energie in Noordwest-Europa en regelgeving voor de visserijsector

Two MPs from the CDA asked the government to respond to a European Parliament manifesto on North Sea renewable energy and to address fishing-sector rules around offshore wind farms, including transit for vessels over 24 metres. The minister agreed to strengthen North Sea cooperation, to broaden its scope to include fisheries, and to review transit rules after a two-year trial period from 2017.

Yes. It is important that the scope of North Sea cooperation on renewable energy is broadened, integrating among other things maritime spatial planning, including the fisheries and environmental dimensions.

Ja. Het is belangrijk dat de reikwijdte van de Noordzeesamenwerking rondom hernieuwbare energie wordt verbreed, waarbij onder andere maritieme ruimtelijke ordening, inclusief de visserij- en milieudimensie, integraal wordt meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de verketeling van warmte-installaties door de werking van de Warmtewet

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the trend of individual boilers replacing collective heating systems (verketeling) and whether the Warmtewet contributes to it. The minister confirmed signals of the trend, said it mainly affects building-bound block heating with about 6,500 homes switching, attributed part of the cause to the Warmtewet's storage compensation and NMDA pricing, and committed to working on removing such incentives in the upcoming amendment without interim measures.
I aim to remove as much as possible those elements in the Warmtewet that currently (possibly) create an incentive for verketeling.
Ik streef ernaar om elementen in de Warmtewet die nu (mogelijk) een prikkel tot verketeling vormen zoveel mogelijk weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van Helvert en Knops over aanhoudende incidenten bij Belgische kerncentrales

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about recent incidents at Belgian nuclear plants Doel and Tihange, including Dutch involvement in extended operation, follow-up of IAEA recommendations, closure scenarios, communication with Dutch authorities, and joint inspections. The Minister answered that nuclear safety is a national Belgian matter, that she supports better involvement of Dutch authorities and has asked Belgium to explore it, that closure decisions rest with the Belgian regulator FANC, and that joint inspections with Belgium have started and more are planned.
The FANC will take a decision on that, if the FANC sees reason to do so.
Het FANC zal daarover, indien het FANC daar aanleiding toe ziet, een besluit nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'Noorden laat zware misdaad liggen'

MPs Oskam and Mulder asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the north of the Netherlands neglects serious crime, including staffing of the Ondermijning team and the risk of a waterbed effect. The minister answered that the team is being expanded to 69 FTE with temporary staff bridging vacancies, that large investigations increased, that the OM's warning was about long-term effects rather than observed displacement, and that the information position still needs strengthening.
The Ondermijning investigation team of the Regional Criminal Investigation Service had a formal staffing of 35.43 FTE as of 1 November 2015 and will be expanded to 69 FTE in the new establishment.
Het team Opsporing Ondermijning van de Dienst Regionale Recherche heeft per 1 november 2015 een formele bezetting van 35,43 fte en wordt in de nieuwe formatie uitgebreid naar 69 fte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over de subsidieregeling van OP Zuid

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister why the OP Zuid subsidy scheme's conditions were changed after the application deadline to exclude projects already started, and how many applications were affected. The Minister replied that the change followed EU state-aid rules on incentive effect, that the managing authority had earlier interpreted the rules too loosely, and that he sees no way to reverse the change.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over veto op proef met gasolie in Twente

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked why a test of gasoil storage in Twente salt caverns by AkzoNobel was halted, whether the company acted properly without an approved safety report, who is liable for future cavern leaks, and whether storage is safe. Minister Kamp answered that the test was not stopped, only the above-ground part was tested, the underground filling awaited a complete safety report, the revised report is now considered complete by advisers, and liability lies with the permit holder under the Mining Act and Civil Code.
I will therefore declare the safety report complete in the short term.
Ik zal op korte termijn het veiligheidsrapport dan ook volledig verklaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Agnes Mulder over de gevolgen van de huisvestingsplannen van de Rechtspraak voor de rechtbank Assen

MPs Oskam and Agnes Mulder ask the Minister of Justice how the judiciary's proposed housing plans would reduce the Assen court's caseload and staff, whether Assen remains a full sitting location, and how local consultation is handled. The Minister answers that Assen remains one of 32 sitting locations, that the plan is only a proposed decision, that criminal cases against detained suspects and commercial claims over EUR 25,000 would likely no longer be heard there, and that detailed staff and travel figures cannot yet be given.
At this stage, in which the Council and the presidents have taken a proposed decision, I cannot give an answer to this question.
Op deze vraag kan ik in dit stadium, waarin de Raad en de presidenten een voorgenomen besluit hebben genomen, geen antwoord geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht over de overdracht van de schadeafhandeling door NAM aan het CVW

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about NAM's phased handover of damage claims to the Centrum voor Veilig Wonen (CVW), and whether this contradicts earlier statements that such a transfer would risk errors. The minister answered that circumstances changed (faster CVW processing, broad wish for NAM not to handle claims itself), that about 2,300 files transfer while around 2,000 stay with NAM including complex cases, and that subsidence damage is compensated when attributed to gas extraction.
Due to the large number of cases this is not possible.
Omwille van het grote aantal zaken is dit niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Omtzigt en Van Tongeren over meetgegevens op het Nederlandse olie- en gasportaal

MPs Mulder, Omtzigt and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reported monthly wastewater injection volumes above a 300,000-barrel threshold at Rossum-Weerselo-2, the relevance of a Science study on US injection and induced seismicity, and felt tremors near the injection well. The minister replied that monthly averages stay below that threshold, that the US study is not directly transferable to Dutch conditions, that TNO and SodM are assessing it with results expected in late September, and that the geophone network is being expanded.
I expect an answer from SodM and TNO at the end of September and will inform your House about it then.
Ik verwacht eind september een antwoord van SodM en TNO en zal uw Kamer hier dan over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de douane van Turkije

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked about Turkey's new additional import duties on goods from third countries, which affect Dutch exports, and whether this breaches the EU-Turkey customs union, and what steps the government would take. The minister confirms the customs union rules, lists the additional duties, says the Dutch embassy and the European Commission have raised the issue with Turkey, and that the parties will look at modernising the customs union.
The Dutch embassy in Ankara raised the increasing duties in a conversation on 10 July with the Turkish Ministry of Economic Affairs.
De Nederlandse ambassade in Ankara heeft de toenemende heffingen aangekaart in een gesprek op 10 juli bij het Turkse Ministerie van Economische Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Gesthuizen, Agnes Mulder en Verhoeven over de aanbesteding van boekscanners en de digitalisering van rijksarchieven door het Nationaal Archief

MPs from VVD, SP, CDA and D66 asked the minister why the Nationaal Archief's digitisation of national archives is being in-sourced to the Belastingdienst rather than tendered, despite a parliamentary motion and the Commission of Procurement Experts' advice against it. The minister defends in-sourcing as lawful internal shared services, citing cost, logistics and business-case reasons, while acknowledging the earlier letter wording on loan of scanners was unfortunate and deferring answers pending a research report.
Reversing the in-sourcing of the work, as the motion requests, would lead to a further delay of, expected, at least one year.
Terugdraaien van de inbesteding van de werkzaamheden, zoals de motie vraagt, leidt tot een verdere vertraging van, naar verwachting, minimaal een jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over geïnduceerde aardbevingen en waterinjectie

An MP asked the minister about induced earthquakes from wastewater injection in Twente, citing a US study linking high-rate injection to seismicity, and asked about monitoring, injection limits and permit suspension. The minister answered that Dutch practice differs from the US, that no injection exceeded the 300,000 bbl threshold, that the seismic network will be expanded, and that no permit suspension is planned.
I did point TNO and SodM to the article and asked them to examine further the relevance of this article for the Dutch situation.
Ik heb TNO en SodM wel gewezen op het artikel en hen gevraagd de relevantie van dit artikel voor de Nederlandse situatie nader te bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt over de situatie in Burundi en de inzet van Nederland om escalatie (zoals massamoord en mogelijke genocide) te voorkomen

CDA MPs asked the ministers about the Burundi crisis over President Nkurunziza's third term, the court ruling, possible genocide risk, Dutch diplomatic and aid responses, and sanctions. The government answer refers the MPs to a separate letter (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163) answering these questions rather than answering them in this document.

The written questions from MPs Agnes Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt (all CDA), question number 2015Z08595, have been answered by the letter 'Response to committee request on the situation in Burundi and answer to questions from MPs Van Laar and Servaes, Sjoerdsma and Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt' (Parliamentary paper 29 237, no. 163).

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt (allen CDA), vraagnummer 2015Z08595 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op commissieverzoek inzake situatie in Burundi en antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes, Sjoerdsma en Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt» (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de opruiming van niet meer in gebruik zijnde windmolens

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how many decommissioned windmills remain standing in the Netherlands, why they are not removed, and how their continued presence could be prevented. The minister said the exact number is unknown, that removal is usually economically viable, and that the government is examining temporary zoning and licensing to require removal at end of life.
The exact number of no longer operational windmills that remain standing cannot be determined by me.
Het exacte aantal niet meer in gebruik zijnde windmolens dat blijft staan is voor mij niet te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het opgesteld vermogen zonne-energie in Nederland naar aanleiding van het artikel ‘scepsis over hoeveelheid zonne-energie’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the installed solar PV capacity in the Netherlands is not precisely known and how the CBS and the Productie Installatie Register data are compiled. The minister acknowledged that exact figures are unavailable, explained the CBS survey (about 20 percent uncertainty) and the registration duty under the Netcode Elektriciteit, and said grid operators report that most installations are registered without current capacity or safety problems.
Yes, it is correct that it is not exactly known how much capacity of solar energy installations has been installed in the Netherlands.
Ja, het klopt dat niet exact bekend is hoeveel vermogen aan zonne-energie-installaties in Nederland is opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Toorenburg over de voortgang van de ondergrondse opslag van kernafval in Mol

MPs Mulder and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Belgian experiment at Mol on heat effects of high-level nuclear waste storage and whether Belgian authorities had contacted Brabant authorities as agreed in 2011. The minister confirmed awareness, said Belgium had made an informal 2011 commitment to inform Brabant authorities of new developments, and said no contact was missing because stakeholders were invited to an information meeting in February.
I visited Mol in May 2013 and had NIRAS inform me about this dossier.
Ik ben in mei 2013 naar Mol geweest en heb me daar laten informeren door NIRAS over dit dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over windenergie op zee voor de Hollandse kust

An MP asked whether a closed information meeting for councillors of Zandvoort, Noordwijk and Katwijk on visual impacts of offshore wind farms was cancelled after councillors refused to keep the data confidential, and about the status of visualisations. The minister denies that confidentiality was requested, says the meeting was postponed to coincide with the public consultation on the designation of the zones, and that visualisations are still in development and will be presented to parliament when the formal procedure starts this spring.
The aim is to show a realistic representation of the plans.
Het streven is om een realistische weergave van de plannen te laten zien.
