Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de uitspraken van de president van de Europese Investeringsbank (EIB), die twijfelt aan het realiteitsgehalte van projecten die zijn ingediend voor het Europese investerin

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers whether the EIB president's doubts about projects submitted to the EFSI fund are justified, whether EFSI mainly targets unprofitable investments, and whether the government will help regional provinces' investment funds access EFSI. The minister denied that EFSI mainly targets unprofitable investments, stressed projects are economically sound and assessed on merit, and said regional parties can apply and the government will play a facilitating role.
From my responsibility for the EIB, I fulfil a facilitating role in this, together with the Minister of Economic Affairs.
Vanuit mijn verantwoordelijkheid voor de EIB vervul ik hierin een faciliterende rol, samen met de Minister van Economische Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het rapport Web & Winkel

Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked Minister Kamp whether he knows the Web & Winkel report, whether a framework for assessing retail areas' future-proofness will be drawn up with provinces and municipalities, what opportunities he sees in the experience economy, and whether mobile payment terminals fail in rural areas due to lack of network coverage. The minister confirms awareness, says a framework will be considered if there is support, promises to inform parliament in Q1 2015 on the Retailagenda, and states Dutch mobile coverage is about 99% with no known widespread payment failures.
If there is sufficient support among the parties involved, including municipalities and provinces, it will be considered how to arrive at such an assessment framework.
Als hiervoor voldoende draagvlak bestaat bij de betrokken partijen, waaronder nadrukkelijk ook gemeenten en provincies, zal worden bezien hoe tot een dergelijk afwegingskader te komen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de voor 3 februari geplande vliegshow met onbemande commerciële systemen (drones) op vliegveld Valkenburg niet door dreigt te gaan

MPs Van Helvert and Agnes Mulder asked whether the planned drone show at Valkenburg airfield, part of the TUSExpo 2015 event, is threatened by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf starting demolition of the runway, whether consultation took place, and why demolition begins now. The minister answers that the demolition follows a Masterplan and a contract signed in December 2013 that was widely known, that the organisers only contacted the agency on 26 January, that the agency offered alternative venues which were declined, and that the sloop proceeds under that contract.
The demolition has therefore been known for some time and has received media attention.
De sloop is hierdoor geruime tijd bekend en heeft media-aandacht genoten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de langetermijncontracten en gasverkoop

MP Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the separation of low- and high-calorific gas transport, gas sold via the TTF, and why Groningen gas production was not reduced further by using nitrogen conversion capacity. The minister answered that the two gas networks are physically separate, that TTF is a virtual delivery point, that the TTF volumes cannot be split by origin, and that production caps were set to protect Loppersum and supply security, with the 2015-2016 maximum lowered to 39.4 bcm per year.
The answer to question 3 related to the total volume of low-calorific gas from the Groningen field delivered via the TTF.
Het antwoord op vraag 3 had betrekking op de totale hoeveelheid laagcalorisch gas uit het Groningenveld die via de TTF is geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Omtzigt en De Rouwe over het bericht ‘Overheid sluit deal voor behoud pinautomaten’

CDA MPs asked whether the government's intention agreement with SNS RegioBank on cash-machine provision in rural areas, and its relation to a Finance Ministry pilot on avoiding ATM 'white spots', was lawful and coordinated. The minister answered that the agreement concerns local liveability rather than ATM retention, that the ACM saw no reason for a competition assessment, and that the pilot's competition-law compatibility is still under discussion with the ACM.
For an assessment under the Competition Act by the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) there is therefore no reason.
Voor een beoordeling op grond van de Mededingingswet door de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) bestaat dan ook geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over het transport via coax- en glasvezelkabel door Caiway

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked whether Caiway, taking over the Twente cable network from Ziggo from 1 January 2015, would control both transport and services and thereby block competition, and raised questions on ADSL reach, pricing, alarm services, email retention and the EU push for cable opening. The minister answered that Cogas, as network owner, is not obliged to admit other providers but has opened its network, that competition is expected on the new fibre network, that Caiway prices were aligned with Ziggo's with some service differences, and that the ACM sees no reason for investigation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de langetermijncontracten en gasverkoop

MP Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about GasTerra's long-term gas export contracts, Groningen low-calorific gas volumes, TTF trading, domestic deliveries, nitrogen conversion capacity, and whether expiring long-term contracts should be extended. The minister answered with volumes and explanations, and said the State as shareholder will ensure no new long-term contracts are concluded and existing ones are not extended or increased.
It cannot be traced what share of Groningen gas is in the low-calorific gas that end users in the Netherlands receive.
Het is niet te herleiden wat het aandeel Groningengas is in het laagcalorisch gas dat eindverbruikers in Nederland ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het beschikbaar stellen van noodhulpfondsen voor kleine NGO's

MP Agnes Mulder asks whether the minister will expand emergency Ebola funding to small NGOs with local networks and relax the Framework Partnership Agreement requirement for them. Minister Ploumen answers that funding goes mainly via the UN and large NGOs for coordination reasons, that small NGOs may submit proposals that fit a coordinated approach, and that the FPA requirement stays to ensure quality and accountability.
To qualify for funding from the emergency aid budget and the Relief Fund, NGOs must from 2015 hold an FPA.
Om in aanmerking te komen voor financiering uit de begroting voor noodhulp en het Relief Fund moeten NGO's met ingang van 2015 beschikken over een FPA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het adviesrapport Actal inzake de Voorjaarsrapportage regeldruk

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Actal's advice criticising the spring 2014 regulatory burden report, including omitted one-off and European compliance costs, incomplete annex entries, the unclear euro/hour reporting, and inconsistent adherence to fixed change dates. The minister rejected the claim that reporting is not solid, explained the exclusion of one-off and EU compliance costs, acknowledged a booking error to be corrected, and promised further clarity in the autumn report and a quantification effort for EU compliance costs.
This is correct and traceable to the fact that the regulatory burden effects and related increases partly fall on other ministries (SZW, BZK).
Dit is juist en terug te voeren op het feit dat de regeldrukeffecten en de bijbehorende toenames deels neerslaan bij andere departementen (SZW, BZK).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over het bericht ‘Cogas gooit Ziggo van de kabel, abonnees moeten naar Caiway’

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government would act after Cogas reportedly required Ziggo cable customers in Twente to move to Caiway, with no alternative provider on the new fibre network until 2015. The minister answered that the ACM has concluded access regulation cannot be imposed on cable networks, that the operator may freely choose providers, and that the government has no means to force greater customer choice, while noting it would welcome such an obligation if the EU framework allowed it.
I have no means to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat NLVOW de gedragscode windenergie niet ondertekent

MPs de Vries and Mulder asked whether the government would mediate toward a joint wind energy code of conduct after NLVOW refused to sign the NWEA-led code, and whether it would make the code binding. The minister answered that a joint code is the responsibility of private parties, urged all parties to keep talking, and declined to make any code mandatory, while noting that statutory participation and planning-damage compensation exist.
I call on the parties to keep talking with each other.
Ik roep partijen op met elkaar in gesprek te blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over vervanging van windturbines

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether replacing wind turbines previously supported under the MEP scheme with SDE+ subsidies is desirable, and whether the subsidy design favours replacement over new build. The minister confirmed 34 replacement projects (about 56 MW, turbines on average nearly 11 years old), agreed to introduce a lower base rate for replacements and cumulation checks from 2015, and said he is willing to consider whether replacement deserves support.
For replacement of existing wind turbines, a category with a tailored base amount lower than for entirely new wind turbines will be included in the SDE+.
Voor vervanging van bestaande windturbines zal in de SDE+ een categorie worden opgenomen met een daarop toegesneden basisbedrag, dat lager is dan voor volledig nieuwe windturbines.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over de besteding van de opbrengsten van de veilingen van grenscapaciteit op het elektriciteitsnet

MPs Van Hijum and Agnes Mulder asked how the €664 million from cross-border capacity auctions on the electricity grid would be spent, and whether it could improve supply security in vulnerable 'uitloper' areas. The minister answered that EU rules require the proceeds to fund interconnector investments or lower network tariffs, not grid reinforcement in uitloper areas, and described the existing TenneT reinforcement programme and timelines.
Under European regulations, TenneT is obliged to use the auction proceeds for investments related to interconnector capacity or for lowering network tariffs.
Op basis van Europese regelgeving is TenneT verplicht om de veilinggelden aan te wenden voor investeringen die samenhangen met de interconnectiecapaciteit of voor verlaging van de nettarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Kooiman over het bericht “Tienduizenden zonder 112”

MPs Agnes Mulder and Kooiman asked whether tens of thousands of people cannot reach emergency number 112 by mobile phone, and what is being done about coverage gaps and cross-border cooperation. The minister replied that TNO and Agentschap Telecom are mapping outdoor mobile coverage for 112 (map due in December), that cost and technical options are excluded from that study, and that cross-border arrangements with Belgium and Germany already route emergency calls to the correct Dutch centre.
I am currently having research carried out into outdoor mobile coverage in relation to the accessibility of the emergency number 1-1-2.
Ik laat momenteel onderzoek uitvoeren naar de mobiele dekking buitenshuis in relatie tot de bereikbaarheid van het alarmnummer 1-1-2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Snel internet verstoort kerkdienst en sport’

MP Agnes Mulder asked whether the sale of 4G frequencies disrupted wireless microphones used by churches, theatres and gyms, and whether buyers were bound by conditions and the costs to users were fair. The minister confirmed interference can occur, said alternative frequencies were found and users informed with a transition period to end 2015, and judged the problem limited based on about two monthly contacts with the Agentschap Telecom.
Based on information from Agentschap Telecom, I have the impression that the scale of the problem is limited.
Op basis van informatie van Agentschap Telecom heb ik de indruk dat de omvang van het probleem beperkt is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Agnes Mulder en Wolbert over de dreigende sluiting van attractiepark De Sprookjeshof in Zuidlaren

MPs Ziengs, Agnes Mulder and Wolbert asked about the threatened closure of the De Sprookjeshof amusement park, the inconsistent certification of identical attractions by inspection bodies, and whether the government is responsible for consistent rules. The minister answered that certification rules were applied correctly, that individual inspection was required for unique slides, that operators bear primary responsibility for compliance, and that the answers could not be sent by the requested date.
On 12 September the NVWA held consultations with the CdK Drenthe, where it was agreed that the inspection body and the owner of De Sprookjeshof will again consult on measures that ensure safety.

Op 12 september heeft de NVWA met de CdK Drenthe overleg gevoerd waarbij is afgesproken dat de keuringsinstelling en de eigenaar van De Sprookjeshof opnieuw in overleg gaan over de maatregelen die de veiligheid waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de kredietverlening aan het midden- en kleinbedrijf

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about ECB lending support for SMEs, the causes of weak SME credit, and whether family loans could be encouraged through a revived Tante Agaathregeling tax scheme. The ministers say the ECB's TLTRO effects are hard to estimate, attribute low SME lending mainly to falling demand and weaker borrower positions, and point to SME financing measures while staying cautious about new tax measures.
The cabinet has therefore decided to support market parties in setting up a subordinated loan fund (AGL) fund
Het kabinet heeft daarom besloten marktpartijen te gaan ondersteunen bij het oprichten van een achtergestelde leningenfonds (AGL)-fonds
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het 380 kV hoogspanningstracé Borssele – Rilland

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers about the urgency, necessity and routing of the 380 kV Borssele–Rilland power line, including links to offshore wind, health concerns and alternative routes. The government answered that capacity is needed given grid overload and interconnection plans, that the project is not being rushed but split procedurally, and that the health precautionary policy and buy-out scheme apply, with alternatives assessed in the environmental procedure.
There is no question of accelerated realisation of the Borssele-Rilland route.
Er is geen sprake van een versnelde realisatie van het traject Borssele-Rilland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Toorenburg, Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over het bericht dat ontbreken GSM dekking levens kan kosten

MPs from the CDA asked the government about a reported death in Lattrop where AED alerts did not arrive, whether mobile coverage gaps endanger lives, and whether providers meet licence coverage obligations. The Minister replied that the network functioned properly, that 100% coverage is not achievable, that alternative emergency routes are advised, and that no coverage requirements exist in current frequency licences, with a ministry study on mobile coverage and 112 announced.
I do not have such information available.
Dergelijke informatie heb ik niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over het bombarderen van een ziekenhuis in het Nuba gebergte in Soedan

Two CDA MPs asked the government about an alleged bombing of the only hospital in the Nuba Mountains in Sudan, the EU/UN response, Dutch private-sector trade promotion in Sudan, and a visit by Sudanese officials to Europe, and whether the government would raise the bombing with them. The government answered by referring to an earlier letter on the political situation in Sudan, without substantive answers to the individual questions.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Agnes Mulder en Geurts over de olielekkage uit opslag in lege zoutmijnen in het natuurgebied Amtsvenn (bij Enschede) en de geplande extra opslag van diesel in lege zoutmijnen onde

MPs Omtzigt, Mulder and Geurts asked about an oil leak from strategic oil storage in salt caverns at Amtsvenn in Germany and about planned diesel storage in salt caverns under Enschede, including risks to the Netherlands and whether operations should wait. The minister replied that the leak likely lies in a borehole casing, that Dutch risks are considered low, that the Enschede design differs and is monitored, that the regulator SodM can intervene, and that AkzoNobel may proceed with preparatory work but has said it will not store diesel until the German cause is clear.
If at any point I see a need to intervene, I can, under article 50 of the Mining Act, prescribe measures in cases of serious harm to safety or the environment or ground movement.

Indien ik op enig moment noodzaak zie tot ingrijpen, kan ik op grond van artikel 50 van de Mijnbouwwet, in gevallen van ernstige aantasting van de bescherming van de veiligheid, het milieu of in gevallen van beweging van de aardbodem, maatregelen voorschrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Toorenburg, Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt Justitie over gsm-ontvangst in Nederland

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about poor mobile coverage in border municipalities and whether 112 emergency calls could fail, including how many complaints and cases occurred and what action was taken. The minister answered that 100% mobile coverage is not achievable, that no registration of failed emergency calls exists, that EZ is studying coverage reach, and that citizens are advised to use a landline in emergencies.
It is not registered in how many cases an acute emergency call was not possible because no mobile coverage was available.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd in hoeveel gevallen een acute noodoproep niet mogelijk was, omdat er geen mobiele dekking voorhanden was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over het bericht “scheepswerf Peters in Kampen vraagt faillissement aan”

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about the bankruptcy of shipyard Peters in Kampen, including whether a guarantee application under the shipbuilding finance guarantee scheme was rejected and how many guarantees had been granted. The minister confirmed the bank withdrew its offer after no sound post-delivery financing was arranged, that EZ/RVO did not grant a guarantee, that €44 million in guarantees were approved in 2013, and that the curator will assess options while UWV handles job placement for affected workers.
Early 2014 RVO received a request from the bank to agree to a changed financing structure.
Begin 2014 ontving RVO een verzoek van de bank om in te stemmen met een gewijzigde financieringsopzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Geurts over het bericht ‘Hoe een Amerikaanse zakenman miljoenen verdiende aan het failliete Aldel’

MPs Mulder and Geurts asked the Economics Minister to reflect on press reports that US businessman Klesch profited from the bankrupt Aldel, including dividends, management fees, pledges over assets and a possible 14 million euro gain, and on state and provincial support given to Aldel. The minister said curators' final report is awaited before the figures can be confirmed, listed the support given (including a provincial bridging loan with conditions) and said the provincial loan was secured on expected ETS compensation, while no pre-verification of the pledges was known at the time.
Curators are currently investigating Aldel. The date for delivery of the curators' final report is not yet known.
Momenteel doen curatoren onderzoek naar Aldel. De datum van oplevering van het eindverslag van de curatoren is nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Tongeren, Paulus Jansen, Agnes Mulder en Ouwehand over het verstrekken van jodiumpillen in verband met het beperken van effecten van een nucleaire ramp

MPs from GroenLinks, SP, CDA and PvdD asked the Minister of Health whether Dutch households should receive iodine tablets in advance of a nuclear accident, given the Tsjernobyl and Fukushima experience with central storage. The minister said she is considering door-to-door distribution for some zones, will consult regional partners and the ministries involved, and admitted she does not know how long distribution takes or how many people could be reached.

In the coming months I want to work out, in consultation with the Ministers of Economic Affairs and of Security and Justice and the relevant regional partners, a proposal for effective and efficient distribution of iodine tablets.

De komende maanden wil ik in overleg met de Ministers van Economische Zaken en Veiligheid en Justitie en de betrokken regionale partners een voorstel uitwerken voor een effectieve en efficiënte distributie van jodiumtabletten.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Dik-Faber, Van Tongeren, en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat het nieuwe handelsverdrag met de VS het Nederlandse schaliegasverbod bedreigt

MPs Dik-Faber, Van Tongeren and Agnes Mulder asked whether the proposed EU-US trade deal (TTIP) and its investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS) clause could undermine a Dutch shale gas fracking ban and expose the state to damages claims, and whether Chevron's support for ISDS poses a risk. Minister Ploumen answered that ISDS would contain an exception for indirect expropriation covering general non-discriminatory public-interest measures, that parliament remains free to ban fracking, that a study on ISDS effects including on environmental regulation is underway with results due before summer, and that she cannot guarantee Chevron will not use ISDS but considers a successful claim unrealistic.
Yes, even after the conclusion of TTIP, the Dutch parliament can still take a decision on a ban on shale gas extraction.
Ja, ook na het sluiten van TTIP, kan het Nederlandse parlement nog steeds een besluit nemen over een verbod op schaliegaswinning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over energiebelasting, btw en salderen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about energy tax exemption for self-generated solar power, VAT on private solar generation, netting rules, and CBS statistics on solar output. The Minister explained that the exemption requires generation for the consumer's own account and risk, that the Tax Authority's earlier flexible practice has been withdrawn, and that VAT liability on self-consumed solar power follows from EU rules.
Your Chamber will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Uw Kamer zal daar zo spoedig mogelijk over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Rog over het nakomen van afspraken over compensatiemaatregelen inzake de gasopslag Bergermeer

CDA MPs Mulder and Rog asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the status of compensation commitments tied to the Bergermeer gas storage, including a Alkmaar energy conference, the A9 Heiloo exit, a development company with a TAQA staff member, and TAQA's headquarters move. The minister answered that most commitments are progressing (energy region, conference planned for September 2014, Pallas project, A9 exit under discussion), that the convenants are between TAQA and municipalities rather than the ministry, and that TAQA is expected to keep its headquarters commitment.
As shown in my answers to questions 2 and 4, I am of the view that good progress is being made in realising the agreed commitments.
Zoals blijkt uit mijn antwoorden op de vragen 2 en 4 ben ik van mening dat goede voortgang wordt gemaakt met het realiseren van de gemaakte afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de verklaring van het bedrijf Vitens over de beëindiging van zijn samenwerking met het Israëlische waterbedrijf Mekorot

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked the minister why she cancelled a visit to Mekorot, whether government policy discouraging trade with Israeli settlements played a role, and whether she consulted colleagues before cancelling. The minister answered that she refers to a letter of 16 January 2014, said the government sees no reason to apologise, and rejected the characterisation of chaos and diplomatic damage.
I would refer you to the letter to your House of 16 January 2014, reference 2014.35843, which addresses this matter.
Graag verwijs ik u naar de brief aan uw Kamer van 16 januari 2014, met kenmerk 2014.35843, waarin op deze kwestie wordt ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jan Vos, Gesthuizen, Agnes Mulder, Thieme, Baay-Timmerman en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de katoenproductie in Turkije

Seven MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour in Turkish cotton production, the follow-up to a Dutch-funded study, pressure on Turkish authorities and the ILO, the textile sector's responsibility, traceability of Turkish cotton, the MVO risk analysis, ILO child labour figures and child labour raised on trade missions. The minister answered that projects, workshops and a sector action plan are underway, that no EU action plan is needed given ILO efforts, that traceability is not feasible, and that the sector selection will be presented in summer 2014.
The Turkish government is primarily responsible for eliminating child labour.
De Turkse overheid is primair verantwoordelijk voor de uitbanning van kinderarbeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over de 3VO kaart

MPs Mulder and Van Hijum asked the ministers whether a prepaid 3V card topped up via beltegoed.nl and billed later to the phone bill, and whether AFM and DNB pass responsibility to each other. The minister answered that DNB and AFM share supervision, that AFM is examining whether such top-ups amount to credit, that ABN AMRO and 3V have blocked the method and launched an internal inquiry, and that the minister will raise the issue in the EU e-money directive evaluation.
DNB and the AFM cannot make statements about investigations into individual companies and products.
DNB en AFM kunnen geen mededelingen doen over onderzoeken naar individuele ondernemingen en producten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Agnes Mulder over nazorg steenkoolwinning

MPs Knops and Mulder asked the minister of Economic Affairs why damage from coal mining in Limburg is not compensated, given that claims are time-barred, why the government ignores its own technical commission's findings, whether morally owed compensation should be paid, and why the Netherlands did not share costs for securing old shafts as Germany was helped. The minister answered that claims against the Mining Damage Guarantee Fund are barred under the 30-year limitation rule, that the fund cannot pay outside legal grounds, that a separate letter on follow-up steps would be sent, and that research into post-mining effects and shaft safety is underway.

On the steps that may be taken in this context and on the investigations announced in the answer to question 8 regarding aftercare for coal mining, I will inform you further by separate letter at the same time.

Over de eventueel te nemen stappen in dit kader en over de in het antwoord op vraag 8 aangekondigde onderzoeken in het kader van de nazorg voor de steenkolenwinning zal ik u gelijktijdig bij separate brief nader informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de exclusieve afnameverplichtingen tussen brouwers en horecaondernemers op de biermarkt en het effect van aangekondigde maatregelen in de grensregio

Two MPs (Mulder and Omtzigt, CDA) asked about exclusive beer purchase obligations between brewers and hospitality businesses, expected beer excise revenue, cross-border beer consumption, and the financial effects of planned excise measures in border regions. The state secretary answered that the market must function effectively, gave the 2012 excise revenue figures, said data on cross-border consumers is not recorded, declined to give a calculation rule for the excise effect, and promised to inventory relevant memos and send any found separately by end of October.
This request cannot be met in the short term. This will first have to be inventoried.
Aan dit verzoek is niet op korte termijn te tegemoet te komen. Dit zal eerst moeten worden geïnventariseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over het bericht “AH Veendam bood kwart miljoen voor zondagopenstelling”

MPs Mulder and Van Hijum asked whether a supermarket offering a quarter million euros in sponsorship for Sunday opening amounted to bribery and whether such deals are common. The minister said he was unaware of similar practices, that municipalities must guard against conflicts of interest, and saw no reason to assume bribery in this case.
If a municipality is approached by a company asking it to use its powers in a certain way, the municipality must guard against conflicts of interest and partiality.

Indien een gemeente wordt benaderd door een bedrijf met het verzoek op een bepaalde wijze van zijn bevoegdheden gebruik te maken, dient deze gemeente te waken voor belangenverstrengeling en partijdigheid.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en AgnesMulder (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Economische Zaken over arrest van het hof in Luxemburg 219/12(Finanzamt Freistadt Rohrbach Urfahr tegen Una

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance about the CJEU ruling C-219/12 (Fuchs), which treats solar panel operation for feed-in as VAT-relevant economic activity, including why the Netherlands did not intervene, retroactive VAT recovery, administrative burden, and whether it would push for a directive change. The state secretary answered that there is no retroactive effect, that the small business exemption and annual form apply, that the revenue loss will be covered, and that the Netherlands has raised the matter with the Commission and will seek a directive amendment.
I consider the outcome of the ruling undesirable, but see no legal room in the ruling to deny entrepreneurship when the conditions are met.
Ik acht de uitkomst van het arrest ongewenst, maar zie in het arrest geen juridische ruimte om het ondernemerschap te ontkennen

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt, De Rouwe en AgnesMulder (allen CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken over de BPM, de wegenbelasting, de KIA, de MIA

Three CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance whether a Mitsubishi Outlander PHEV and a Tesla S Performance can be bought with near-zero tax burden via BPM exemption, KIA, MIA, Vamil, a 0% company-car addition and no road tax, and how this compares to conventional cars and CO2 emissions trading prices. The government confirmed the tax treatment, provided worked net-cost calculations, and said it would present measures on electric car incentives around Prinsjesdag.
In this context I inform you that around Prinsjesdag I will send your House a letter presenting a number of measures to arrive at a more balanced form of stimulating (semi-)electric cars.

In het kader van het bovenstaande deel ik u mede dat ik omstreeks Prinsjesdag een brief aan uw Kamer zal doen toekomen, waarin ik een aantal maatregelen aan u zal presenteren om te komen tot een meer evenwichtige vorm van stimulering van (semi) elektrische auto's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en De Rouwe over een mogelijk ongeoorloofde subsidiëring en staatssteun bij de verkoop van Syntus aan Keoli

MPs Mulder and De Rouwe asked whether NS's reported 11 million euro loss on the sale of Syntus to Keolis implies state-funded subsidy or illegal state aid, and whether the state ultimately bears the loss. The minister answered that the loss was a write-off on a loan and the company's value, that the sale avoided a bankruptcy, and that no state aid or distortion of competition was involved because the state is not a party to the transaction.
In this transaction there was no question of loss compensation or state aid, as the State is after all not a party to this transaction.
Bij deze transactie was geen sprake van verliescompensatie danwel staatssteun, de Staat is immers geen partij in deze transactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de problemen waar de Bond van Belastingbetalers tegenaan is gelopen

MPs Mulder and Van Hijum asked why the Bond van Belastingbetalers could not learn which firms received subsidies under the Veiligheid Kleine Bedrijven scheme, and whether recipients and uses would be published. The minister agreed in principle to publish recipients and amounts for 2011 (excluding sole traders), but refused to disclose the specific security measures funded, citing the risk to firms and staff.
I am certainly willing to make public which companies received subsidy in 2011 under Veiligheid Kleine Bedrijven and which amounts these companies received.
Ik ben zeker bereid bekend te maken welke bedrijven in 2011 subsidie hebben ontvangen in het kader van Veiligheid Kleine Bedrijven en welke bedragen deze bedrijven hebben ontvangen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over geweld in Sudan en in Zuid-Sudan en de precaire situatie tussen beide landen

Two MPs from the CDA asked the government about violence in Sudan and South Sudan, human rights abuses, humanitarian access, the Abyei dispute, the suspension of oil transport, civil society space and the future of EU and AU mediation roles. The government answered at length, noting concern, backing AU-led mediation and cross-line humanitarian access, but declined to commit to new fact-finding missions and said the EU Special Representative's mandate would be transferred.
To verify the data in these reports, humanitarian access to these areas is needed, as well as an independent investigation into the human rights situation in South Kordofan and Blue Nile.

Om de gegevens in genoemde rapporten te kunnen verifiëren is humanitaire toegang tot deze gebieden nodig, alsmede een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de mensenrechtensituatie in South Kordofan en Blue Nile.
Antwoord vragen Jan Vos en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat er gesjoemeld zou worden met groene stroom

MPs Jan Vos and Agnes Mulder asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports that green electricity was being sold using imported guarantees of origin, which may not reflect new domestic renewable capacity, and about consumer transparency. The minister confirmed the practice has been possible under EU rules for some time, said consumers can already differentiate products, and called on suppliers to state country of origin on energy labels while declining to create a single comparison system.
I think the country of origin is useful information for the consumer and I believe stating it contributes to transparency.
Ik denk dat het land van herkomst zinvolle informatie is voor de consument en vind dat het vermelden hiervan bijdraagt aan de transparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over Aanbesteding Nederlands waterproject in Benin aan een Deens bedrijf

MP Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development why a Dutch-financed water project in Benin was tendered to a Danish consortium despite government ambitions to favour Dutch firms, and how embassies and procurement rules affect such choices. The minister answered that the Dutch bid scored lower, the contract followed EU procurement rules and quality criteria, and the government will keep encouraging Dutch firms within those rules.
Given the financial size of the project in Benin, a European tender procedure was required.
Gezien de financiële omvang van het project in Benin, was een Europese aanbestedingsprocedure vereist.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat het subsidieplafond van de Subsidiefaciliteit Burgerschap en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (SBOS) voor het jaar 2013 is vastgesteld op nul

An MP asked why the 2013 SBOS subsidy ceiling was set at zero and why parliament was not informed during the budget debate. The minister answered that budget cuts led to suspending SBOS tenders, that no new project funding is available for 2013, and that the decision is unrelated to the donation-incentive study.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Middenstand boos op KPN’

An MP asks whether telecom providers like KPN may charge extra for outages they cause and whether they are legally bound to fix standard faults, and asks about the cost to SMEs. The minister says parties may agree paid higher service levels, that providers have a statutory duty to keep services available, cites KPN figures on extra service contract costs, and says KPN will consider communicating shorter repair times while the government reviews further protection for business users.
I believe parties should have the freedom to make additional agreements on more extensive service provision.
Ik vind dat partijen de vrijheid moeten hebben om aanvullende afspraken te maken over verdergaande serviceverlening.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Oskam over het bericht  “Onrust over VKB-regeling”

MPs Agnes Mulder and Oskam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about criticism that the new Vkb small-business security scheme was rushed, unequal for suppliers, non-transparent in its criteria and lacking appeal options. The minister defended the open tender run by the CCV with an independent adviser, said the criteria were not specified in the invitation, denied that only one supplier was designated, and promised evaluation of the scheme in autumn 2013.
The Centre for Crime Prevention and Safety (CCV) is responsible for implementing the new approach and has partly its own freedom of action and assessment within the frameworks set by my ministry.

Het Centrum voor Criminaliteitspreventie en Veiligheid (CCV) is verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering de nieuwe aanpak en heeft binnen de door mijn ministerie gestelde kaders deels een eigen handelings- en beoordelingsvrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Dijkgraaf, Gesthuizen en Schouten over de berichtgeving dat winkeliers boetes moeten betalen als ze niet meedoen aan de koopzondagen

MPs from CDA, SGP, SP and ChristenUnie asked the Economics Minister whether fines for shops that refuse Sunday opening, reportedly written into leases, restrict entrepreneurial freedom, and how widespread such clauses are. The minister replied that private parties are free to set lease terms, that EU freedom of establishment does not apply to private commercial relations, that the government will not intervene in contractual freedom, and that he has no overview of how many shops face such fines.
I am not aware of how often penalty clauses are included in contracts.
Het is mij niet bekend hoe vaak er boeteclausules in overeenkomsten worden opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Oskam over het bericht dat ZZP’ers (zelfstandigen zonder personeel) slachtoffer zijn van cybercriminaliteit

MPs Agnes Mulder and Oskam asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Security and Justice whether they recognise a trend of cybercriminals targeting sole traders and small firms, some going bankrupt, and what will be done about it. The government said it has no information on such a trend or on bankruptcy figures, points to an ongoing police study and a planned survey in Flevoland, and lists awareness campaigns and websites for SMEs and sole traders.
We have no information about the trend reported in the article that cybercriminals increasingly target sole traders and small firms.
Wij hebben geen informatie over de in het artikel gesignaleerde trend dat cybercriminelen het in toenemende mate voorzien hebben op eenmansbedrijven en kleine ondernemingen.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Bonis, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Agnes Mulder over seksueel geweld tegen vrouwen in India en beperkingen voor mensenrechtenorganisaties

Seven MPs asked the foreign minister about sexual violence against women and Dalit women in India and Indian restrictions on NGOs, including a Dutch human rights prize winner's trial and blacklisting of NGOs and donors. The minister said the Netherlands supports the European Parliament resolution, funds Indian women's NGOs, respects the Indian legal process while staying in contact with the prize winner, and that the Indian NGO rules are being monitored through EU channels.
I will keep you informed of relevant developments.
Ik zal u op de hoogte houden van relevante ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over bloedkolen uit Colombia

An MP asks whether Dutch power plants import coal from Colombia linked to labour, environmental and security abuses, and asks about the coal dialogue, supplier transparency and the role of trade and development policy. The minister says Colombia bears primary responsibility, companies should follow due diligence, the coal dialogue and Better Coal are the preferred route, and full supplier disclosure is not yet required.
Self-regulation based on dialogue, as described in the answers to questions 6, 8 and 7, is my preference.
Zelfregulering op basis van dialoog zoals beschreven in de antwoorden op de vragen 6,8 en 7 heeft mijn voorkeur.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘EU: China dupeert Europese staalmarkt’

MP Agnes Mulder asked whether the government agrees with the European Commission's findings that China subsidises its steel industry and its proposal to impose duties of up to 50 percent on Chinese coated steel. Minister Ploumen answered that the Commission analysis is confidential within an ongoing anti-subsidy procedure, that the government supports countervailing duties where subsidies and injury are established, and that it is following the sector and participating in the High Level Roundtable.
The European Commission's analysis is a confidential document within an ongoing anti-subsidy investigation.
De analyse van de Europese Commissie betreft een vertrouwelijk document in het kader van een lopend antisubsidie onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Wolbert en Ziengs over het verklaren van Ruinerwold tot een beschermd dorpsgezicht door de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed

Three MPs asked why the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed designates Ruinerwold as a protected village view despite opposition from the municipal council and the province, and what this means for economic development and solar panels. The minister explains the designation procedure, that municipal and provincial advice plays an important role but cultural-historical values are leading, and that the municipality decides on permits without blocking development or renewable energy.
The cultural-historical values are leading in the designation procedure, but the advice of the municipal council and Provincial Executive plays an important role in the weighing towards the decision.
De cultuurhistorische waarden zijn bij de aanwijzingsprocedure leidend, maar de adviezen van de gemeenteraad en van Gedeputeerde Staten spelen een belangrijke rol bij de afweging tot het besluit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Knops over het bericht dat honderdduizenden Nederlanders teveel betalen voor gas

MPs Agnes Mulder and Knops asked the minister whether consumers are overpaying for gas transport because of oversized connections, whether tariffs should be lowered, and whether they will be compensated. The minister disputed the VEH's conclusions, said the regulator NMa sets tariffs and he cannot compel lower ones, and noted that network operators will offer free downsizing and review compensation case by case.
I cannot force the network operators to lower the gas transport tariffs.
Ik kan de netbeheerders niet dwingen de tarieven voor het transport van gas naar beneden bij te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht «Chemische bedrijven investeren te weinig»

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that chemical companies are investing too little, whether this is typical for the sector, whether SMEs and large firms differ, how it fits with innovation contracts under the Top Sector Chemistry, and what the government does about raw material prices. The minister attributes the investment decline to Asian market growth, weak European growth and lower energy costs elsewhere, says it is a European rather than Dutch phenomenon, outlines existing raw materials policy and EU/international efforts, and does not commit to new concrete action.
The chemical industry invests over EUR 43.4 million in cash in the TKIs in 2013 alone.
De chemische industrie investeert ruim € 43,4 miljoen alleen al in cash in de TKI’s in 2013.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het voorstel voor een gasfonds

An MP asks the minister of Economic Affairs about a proposed gas fund, the use of gas revenues, sovereign wealth funds and future budget effects of declining gas income. The minister says the fund idea comes from a working group on communication about mining, that it is up to industry to finance any such fund, and that the government is studying the proposals and will inform parliament before the budget debate.
I am currently studying the working group's proposals and will then decide which ones will be taken up for further elaboration.
Ik ben nu bezig de voorstellen van de werkgroep te bestuderen en zal daarna beslissen welke opgepakt zullen worden voor nadere uitwerking.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Knops over de mogelijke sluiting van de centrale Buggenum

MPs Agnes Mulder and Knops asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the possible closure of the Buggenum Willem-Alexander power plant, its jobs, the government's options to keep it open, and security of supply. The minister answered that closure is a market decision by Nuon, that the government does not steer which plants stay open, and that security of supply remains good.
I have brought this to the attention of Nuon.
Ik heb dit onder de aandacht gebracht van Nuon.
Antwoord vragen Agnes Mulder over export van elektronica naar China en Afrika

An MP asked the state secretary about municipalities selling electronic waste outside the WeCycle system, the scale of illegal export to China and Africa, and why traders obtain export permits. The state secretary confirmed that about 60 municipalities trade part of their e-waste contrary to agreements, said illegal flows cannot be quantified, pointed to enforcement efforts, a pending Public Prosecution Service study on high dismissal rates, and a WEEE directive implementation process with a parliamentary pre-consultation.
How large the flow of illegal waste is cannot be stated.
Hoe groot de stroom illegaal afval is, is niet aan te geven.
Antwoord vragen Agnes Mulder en Bruins Slot over het besluit om bevallingen vanaf 1 januari 2013 niet meer in het Diaconessenhuis in Meppel te laten plaatsvinden

MPs Agnes Mulder and Bruins Slot (CDA) asked the health minister whether the decision to stop childbirth at the Diaconessenhuis in Meppel from 1 January 2013 was driven by a shortage of gynaecologists, and about alternatives, effects on rural access and home birth, and compliance with national norms. The minister answered that the hospital board decided on quality and efficiency grounds, that the looming gynaecologist shortage was decisive, that acute obstetric care moves to Zwolle with ambulance arrangements, and that costs remain unclear.
It is still unclear how high the costs and cost reductions resulting from this decision precisely are.
Onduidelijk is nog hoe hoog de kosten en reductie van kosten als gevolg van dit besluit precies zijn
Antwoord vragen Agnes Mulder over kolencentrales Maasvlakte

Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the coal plants at Maasvlakte, including whether the CCS subsidies and conditions for the plants were at risk and what the consequences would be for energy supply, emissions and renewables. The minister answered that the subsidies are not lost, the plants are under construction and not conditioned on CCS in their permits, and that the government remains confident in the ROAD CCS project.
The EEPR subsidy and the national co-financing are not lost for CCS if no clarity arrives in the short term.
De EEPR-subsidie en de nationale cofinanciering gaan niet voor CCS verloren als er op korte termijn geen duidelijkheid komt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Thieme, Gesthuizen, Krol, Maij, Mulder en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de productie van schoenen door grote ketens

MPs asked the government whether shoe companies using child labour in their supply chains should be held to account, excluded from state support and trade missions, and whether embassies and public procurement could be used to address it. The minister answered that due diligence duties under the OECD guidelines apply, that no shoe companies receive state support or joined trade missions, and that embassies raise labour standards where possible, while procurement social conditions already apply.
No, there are no shoe companies currently receiving government support or having previously joined trade missions.
Nee, er zijn geen schoenenbedrijven die momenteel overheidssteun ontvangen of in het verleden mee zijn geweest met handelsmissies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het meningsverschil aangaande de besteding van het nog op te richten revolverende fonds

An MP asked the minister whether there is now a unified government view on how a planned revolving development fund, financed from the aid budget, will be spent, and asked for conditions and more information. The minister answered that a unified cabinet view exists, the fund will link Dutch expertise to developing-country needs and be operational in 2014, but details of programmes will only be given in spring 2013.
As soon as the main lines of the new fund are known, I will inform the House about this in more detail.
Zodra de hoofdlijnen van het nieuwe fonds bekend zijn, zal ik de Kamer hierover nader informeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat leden van Al Shabaab terugkeren uit Somalië naar onder andere Kenia

MPs Omtzigt and Agnes Mulder asked about reports that Al Shabaab fighters are returning from Somalia to Kenya and elsewhere, including whether Dutch nationals are involved and whether Kenyan police corruption hampers counter-terrorism. The minister answered that exact numbers are unknown, cooperation is opportunistic rather than structural, Dutch nationals cannot be excluded, and Dutch support for police training and reform continues.
I do not have exact figures or detailed information on the spread.
Ik beschik niet over exacte aantallen of gedetailleerde informatie over de verspreiding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de frequentieveiling van 4G-internet

An MP from the CDA asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the pace of 4G rollout in the Netherlands, the EU Digital Agenda Commissioner's call for faster rollout, and what the government can do to ensure constant network quality. The minister agreed Europe should speed up, argued the Dutch rollout is at an early stage like elsewhere, pointed to flexible licences, extra spectrum and rollout obligations, and said the market should deliver and that network quality is covered by the new Telecommunicatiewet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Bevallen kan niet meer in ziekenhuis Meppel’

MPs Bruins Slot and Agnes Mulder ask about the decision to end childbirth at Meppel hospital from 2013, including IGZ quality findings, alternatives such as a satellite model, the 45-minute ambulance norm, regional standards, costs, and local consultation. The minister answers that the decision was driven by the expected gynaecologist shortage and low birth volume, that the RIVM and insurer Achmea show accessibility will not worsen, that the regional parties must set cooperation agreements with IGZ oversight, and that local residents were not directly involved in the decision.
The local population was not involved in the decision-making.
De lokale bevolking is in de besluitvorming niet betrokken geweest.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over een studie naar de olieprijs door IMF

An MP asked the minister about a 2012 IMF study forecasting a doubling of the oil price by 2021, its effects on the Dutch economy, and whether it undermines CPB and government energy policy. The minister replied that the model is promising but unproven, the Dutch economy would lose about 0.15 percentage points of growth per year, existing energy policy remains valid, and no new research will be commissioned.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over mogelijke capaciteitsheffing energieleveranciers

An MP asked the minister about the price effects of renewable subsidies, the risk of future electricity capacity shortages, and whether a capacity fee for power producers is needed. The minister answered that capacity is ample, rejected a capacity fee and TenneT building plants, and promised to raise capacity mechanisms at EU level.
I consider a capacity remuneration to ensure sufficient back-up capacity for electricity production in the Netherlands unnecessary and undesirable.
Ik acht een capaciteitsvergoeding om te verzekeren dat er voldoende back-up capaciteit van elektriciteitsproductie aanwezig is in Nederland onnodig en niet wenselijk.

requests the government to investigate promptly whether and to what extent specific groups of tenants get into difficulty

requests the government to ensure that integrated visions of governments on groundwater management come about under provincial leadership

requests the government to carry out an evaluation of the impact on privacy of the beneficial owners after one year and after four years after filling the UBO register

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Bruins c.s. t.v.v. nr. 8 over het registreren van inzage

Amendment requires the Chamber of Commerce UBO register to identify users, log the personal data of searchers, and let beneficial owners see how often their data was accessed, with exceptions for investigative bodies.
The Chamber gives an ultimate beneficial owner, on request, insight into how many times his data has been provided
De Kamer geeft een uiteindelijk belanghebbende op verzoek inzicht in het aantal keer dat zijn gegevens, bedoeld in artikel 15a, zijn verstrekt
Amendement van de leden Smeulders en Ronnes over het twee jaar laten voortduren van het voorkeursrecht na vernietiging van het omgevingsplan
Extends from one to two years the period during which the pre-emption right applies after annulment of an environmental plan, to allow time for repair.
'one year' is replaced by 'two years' and 'that year' by 'that term'
wordt «een jaar» vervangen door «twee jaar» en wordt «dat jaar» vervangen door «die termijn»

requests the government to make efforts to prevent such duplications in client screening as much as possible
verzoekt de regering, zich in te spannen om dergelijke «dubbelingen» in cliëntenonderzoek zo veel als mogelijk te voorkomen
Tweede nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ronnes c.s. tvv nr. 62 over toegankelijkheid van de heffingsvermindering verhuurderheffing
Amends the landlord levy tax relief so that home construction in many more municipalities, listed by name, qualifies for relief, with a lower amount for other municipalities.
This amendment provides that the landlord levy tax relief becomes accessible to taxpayers in all regions.

Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ronnes c.s. tvv nr. 36 over toegankelijkheid van de heffingsvermindering verhuurderheffing
Extends the landlord levy reduction for new rental housing to all regions, setting a lower amount for municipalities outside the listed scarcity areas.
This amendment provides that the landlord levy reduction becomes accessible to taxpayers in all regions.
Dit amendement regelt dat de heffingsvermindering verhuurderheffing voor belastingplichtigen in alle regio's toegankelijk wordt.

requests the government to engage with municipalities and provinces to stimulate experiments with the social purchase land-use category in the Crisis and Recovery Act
verzoekt de regering om met gemeenten en provincies in gesprek te treden om experimenten met bestemmingscategorie sociale koop in de Crisis- en herstelwet te stimuleren
Motie van de leden Ronnes en Koerhuis over een landelijke monitor seniorenhuisvesting
Asks the government to keep a national monitor on senior housing, modelled on the student housing monitor, and to address senior homes in municipal performance agreements.
to keep a national monitor of senior housing
een landelijke monitor seniorenhuisvesting bij te houden
Motie van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over terugbrengen van de lange wachtlijst voor een sociale huurwoning
Asks the government to map waiting-list practices and high-income applicants for social rental housing and to explore income-limit rules in a bill.
whereas a long waiting list for a social rental home can cause a sense of hopelessness
overwegende dat een lange wachtlijst voor een sociale huurwoning een gevoel van moedeloosheid kan veroorzaken
Motie van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over actief informeren over de mogelijkheden van starters op de woningmarkt

Asks the government to launch an information campaign actively informing first-time home buyers about available support such as the temporary refund of buyer's costs deduction and the SVn starter loan.
requests the government to start an information campaign actively informing starters about the possibilities available to them
verzoekt de regering, om een voorlichtingscampagne te beginnen waarbij starters actief worden geïnformeerd over de mogelijkheden
Motie van de leden Dik-Faber en Ronnes over een huisvestingsstrategie toegespitst op daklozen
Asks the government to develop a housing strategy focused on homeless people, involving municipalities, social organisations and housing corporations.
requests the government to develop a housing strategy focused on homeless people

requests the government to provide insight into the results of the earlier demolition scheme;

De Kamer geeft een uiteindelijk belanghebbende op verzoek inzicht in het aantal keer dat zijn gegevens, bedoeld in artikel 15a, zijn verstrekt
Gewijzigd amendement Ronnes c.s. t.v.v. nr. 29 over verhaal van financiële bijdragen
Lets the government by decree set categories of development contributions that municipalities and others can recover from developers, with caps and accountability rules.

By general administrative order, categories of developments to improve the physical living environment can be designated for which the environmental plan may require a financial contribution to be recovered

Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen categorieën ontwikkelingen ter verbetering van de kwaliteit van de fysieke leefomgeving worden aangewezen waarvoor in een omgevingsplan kan worden bepaald dat een financiële bijdrage wordt verhaald
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Regterschot c.s. t.v.v. nr. 20 over de vervaltermijn van een voorkeursrecht
Shortens the default expiry of a pre-emption right (voorkeursrecht) from ten to five years, extendable once, and makes the extension decision open to objection and appeal.
The owner gets an extra instrument to contest the establishment of the pre-emption right, because after the first five-year period a new decision must be taken which is open to objection and appeal.

De eigenaar krijgt een extra instrument om de vestiging van het voorkeursrecht aan te vechten, omdat er na eerste periode van 5 jaar een nieuw besluit moet worden genomen en dat voor bezwaar en beroep open staat.
Amendement van het lid Ronnes over financiële bijdragen voor ontwikkelingen van een gebied op publiekrechtelijke basis
Allows the environmental plan to impose mandatory financial contributions for area development, set by general administrative order, without strict safeguards in the text itself.
In the environmental plan, provisions on mandatory financial contributions may be included for activities designated by general administrative order
In het omgevingsplan kunnen over bij algemene maatregel van bestuur aangewezen activiteiten bepalingen worden opgenomen over verplichte financiële bijdragen
Amendement van het lid Ronnes c.s. t.v.v. 23 over financiële bijdragen voor ontwikkelingen van een gebied op publiekrechtelijke basis
Adds a power for municipalities, provinces and water boards to require financial contributions for area development under the environment act via general administrative order, with strict criteria.
Competent authorities (municipalities, provinces and water boards) should be given the legal possibility to enforce contributions under public law in specific and exceptional situations.
Bevoegd gezagen (gemeenten, provincies en waterschappen) dienen de wettelijke mogelijkheid te krijgen om in specifieke en uitzonderlijke situaties bijdragen publiekrechtelijk af te dwingen.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Regterschot c.s. t.v.v. nr. 15 over de vervaltermijn van een voorkeursrecht
Shortens the pre-emption right (voorkeursrecht) lapse period from 10 to 5 years, with one extension requiring a new decision open to objection and appeal.
The owner gets an additional instrument to challenge the establishment of the pre-emption right
De eigenaar krijgt een extra instrument om de vestiging van het voorkeursrecht aan te vechten
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes ter vervanging van nr. 7 over een evaluatiebepaling
Adds a three-year evaluation clause to the gas-appliance certification bill, reporting to parliament on effectiveness and effects on safety and regulatory burden.
Our Minister of the Interior sends to the States General within three years of the entry into force of the act a report on effectiveness and effects
Onze Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties zendt binnen drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van de wet
Motie van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over een mkb-toets voor de introductie van het nieuwe stelsel
Asks the government to carry out an SME impact test before introducing the new certification scheme for gas-combustion installation work and to inform the House.
requests the government, before introducing the new system, to carry out the SME test and to inform the House about it
verzoekt de regering, voor de introductie van het nieuwe stelsel de mkb-toets uit te voeren en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Amendement van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over een evaluatiebepaling
Adds an evaluation clause requiring the minister to report to the Staten-Generaal within three years on the effectiveness and effects of the gas-installation certification rules.
a report on the effectiveness and effects of article 2, fourth paragraph
een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van artikel 2, vierde lid

prepare a general administrative order enabling housing corporations to build rental homes up to 1,000 euro per month through an exemption from the market test

een algemene maatregel van bestuur voor te bereiden waardoor het bouwen van huurwoningen met een huur tot € 1.000 per maand door middel van een vrijstelling van de markttoets door corporaties mogelijk wordt
Motie van het lid Ronnes over het lokaal differentiëren van de DAEB-grenzen

requests the government to investigate whether corporations invest more in rental homes with rent between € 700 and € 1,000
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken of de corporaties meer investeren in huurwoningen met een huur tussen € 700 en € 1.000
Amendement van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over het afschaffen van de erfpachtheffing
Amendment stopping municipalities from requiring housing corporations to raise ground rent or repay ground discounts when converting perpetual leasehold land to mid-rent housing.
municipalities no longer be allowed to require housing corporations to repay ground discounts on mid-rent housing on perpetual leasehold land
gemeenten niet langer toe te staan om van woningcorporaties te vragen om grondkortingen van middenhuurwoningen op eeuwigdurend afgekocht erfpachtgrond terug te betalen
Motie van de leden Ronnes en Koerhuis over beschikbare middelen inzetten voor meer middenhuurwoningen in de vrije sector
Asks the government to agree with housing corporations that available funds be used for middle-rent homes in the free sector where needed.
requests the government to make agreements with the housing corporation sector
verzoekt de regering, om met de corporatiesector afspraken te maken

Lets municipal councils designate cases of out-of-plan environmental activities where participation of and consultation with third parties is mandatory before a permit application to the college.
The municipal council can designate cases of activities in which participation of and consultation with third parties is mandatory before an application for an environmental permit
De gemeenteraad kan gevallen van activiteiten aanwijzen waarin participatie van en overleg met derden verplicht is voordat een aanvraag om een omgevingsvergunning
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ronnes c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 18 over verzwaard adviesrecht voor de gemeenteraad

De uitkomst van het advies is door de toevoeging van het voorgestelde artikel 16.15b bindend.

Lowers the standard compensation forfait for planning-related damage from 5% to 4% in the Wet ruimtelijke ordening and the aviation act, so affected parties recover more of their loss from government decisions.

The submitters believe that introducing a standard forfait of 5% would lead to a deterioration in the rights of the injured party, because too large a share of the actual damage could not be recovered.

Indieners menen dat het invoeren van een standaardforfait van 5% zal leiden tot een achteruitgang in de rechten van de benadeelde, omdat een te fors deel van de feitelijk geleden schade niet verhaald kan worden.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Ronnes en Dik-Faber ter vervanging van nr. 47 over uitgangspunten voor veiligheidsnormen voor primaire waterkeringen

Amendment fixing in the Omgevingswet a minimum flood protection standard (individual death risk at most 1 in 100,000 per year by 2050) with higher protection in specified places, as a basis for water safety environmental values.

As a starting point for setting the environmental values, at least a protection level applies by which in 2050 the chance of dying from flooding behind a primary flood defence is no greater than 1 in 100,000 per year.

Als uitgangspunt voor het vaststellen van de omgevingswaarden, bedoeld in het eerste lid, onder d, geldt ten minste een beschermingsniveau waarmee in 2050 de kans om te overlijden als gevolg van een overstroming achter de primaire waterkering niet groter is dan 1 op 100.000 per jaar.

Indieners menen dat het invoeren van een standaardforfait van 5% zal leiden tot een aanzienlijke achteruitgang in de rechten van de benadeelde
Amendement van de leden Ronnes en Dik-Faber over uitgangspunten voor veiligheidsnormen voor primaire waterkeringen

Amendment to write the basic water safety standard (max 1 in 100,000 annual death risk from flooding) and higher protection criteria into the Omgevingswet itself, instead of leaving them to a general administrative order.
In the Omgevingswet these are regulated by general administrative order.
In de Omgevingswet worden deze bij algemene maatregel van bestuur geregeld.

This amendment aims to include a provision by which the competent authority can independently decide to apply division 3.4 of the General Administrative Law Act.
Dit amendement beoogt een regeling op te nemen waarmee het bevoegd gezag zelfstandig kan besluiten om afdeling 3.4 van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht toe te passen.

The rightholder receives a reasonable use fee from the initiator
De rechthebbende ontvangt van de initiatiefnemer een redelijke gebruiksvergoeding
Amendement van het lid Van Eijs c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het verplichten van participatie in door de gemeenteraad aangewezen gevallen

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ronnes ter vervanging van nr. 15 over het toevoegen van het woord aanmerkelijk voor provinciaal en nationaal belang

Provinces and the state may under article 2.3 only exercise tasks and powers when there is a considerable provincial or national interest

Provincies en het Rijk mogen op grond van artikel 2.3, tweede lid en derde lid, onder a, alleen taken en bevoegdheden uitoefenen wanneer sprake is van een «aanmerkelijk» provinciaal of nationaal belang.
Amendement van de leden Ronnes en Smeulders ter vervanging van nr. 16 over het handhaven van het forfait van 2%
Keeps the statutory planning-damage flat-rate deduction at at least 2% instead of raising it to 5%, including in the aviation compensation provision.

Indieners willen met dit amendement bewerkstelligen dat het forfait niet verhoogd wordt maar gehandhaafd blijft op ten minste 2%
Amendement van de leden Ronnes en Smeulders ter vervanging van nr. 40 over het handhaven van het forfait van 2%
Keeps the planschade compensation floor at at least 2% instead of a fixed 5% threshold, so citizens bear less uncompensated damage from government planning decisions.
The submitters believe that introducing a standard 5% lump sum will lead to a considerable decline in the rights of those harmed.
Indieners menen dat het invoeren van een standaardforfait van 5% zal leiden tot een aanzienlijke achteruitgang in de rechten van de benadeelde
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Bisschop en Ronnes ter vervanging van nr. 22 over een redelijke gebruiksvergoeding bij een gedoogplicht
Requires initiators of works under a compulsory access right (gedoogplicht) to pay owners a use fee, except public-authority initiators and grid operators or heat licence holders.
a reasonable use fee to the extent that fee is not included in the compensation for damage
een redelijke gebruiksvergoeding voor zover die vergoeding niet is inbegrepen in de vergoeding van de schade

Asks the government to have the ICT assessment bureau BIT provide an update on the Digital Environment Act system's progress and inform the House of the results.
requests the government to have the BIT provide an update in December 2019 on the progress and status of the Digital Environment Act system and inform the House of the outcomes
verzoekt de regering, het BIT in december 2019 een update te laten doen naar de voortgang en stand van zaken van het Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet, en de Kamer over de uitkomsten te informeren

Provinces and the national government may, under Article 2.3, only exercise tasks and powers when there is a considerable provincial or national interest.

Provincies en het Rijk mogen op grond van artikel 2.3, tweede lid en derde lid, onder a, alleen taken en bevoegdheden uitoefenen wanneer sprake is van een «aanmerkelijk» provinciaal of nationaal belang.
Amendement van de leden Bisschop en Ronnes over een redelijke gebruiksvergoeding bij een gedoogplicht

qa: Antwoord op vragen gesteld door van het lid Ronnes over het bericht ‘Coronavirus bedreigt ook bouw van nieuwe woningen’

MP Ronnes (CDA) asked the government about COVID-19 threats to housing construction, including whether an ambitious public-private plan could prevent job losses, whether the 75,000 homes per year target is achievable, NOW wage subsidy eligibility for construction firms, accelerating permits and maintenance, investment plans, NHG and tax measures, and a countercyclical role for housing corporations. The minister answered that a package of measures (doorbouwplan, expert teams, subsidy adjustments, and accelerated public investment) is being pursued, while disputing some premises and promising further measures around Prinsjesdag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Eijs over het bericht 'Regio vraagt minister om hulp bij verkoop Vestia-woningen'

MPs Ronnes and Van Eijs asked about the stalled sale of Vestia housing in six municipalities and the transfer-tax treatment of corporation takeovers. The minister reported intention agreements signed in May 2020, explained conditions for the transfer-tax exemption for task transfers, and said the Rijk will examine remaining facilitating measures.

Whether the transaction price in the planned transactions in the custom-made municipalities is expected to be at least market value in rented condition cannot currently be assessed, because the planned transactions still need to be worked out.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Ronnes en Palland over de website coronaverlies

MPs Van Dam, Ronnes and Palland (CDA) asked the government about the website coronaverlies.nl, which offered claim-recovery services to businesses hit by COVID-19, and whether it was a scam exploiting entrepreneurs. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the site is now offline, that it is not for the cabinet to judge whether such services are legitimate, and that victims can file a police report for the Public Prosecution Service to assess.
It is not for the cabinet to assess whether services offered on websites such as coronaverlies.nl are legitimate.

The state secretary replied that processing times are improving, points to the new small-loan guarantee scheme and optimisations to existing schemes, argues a 100% German-style guarantee is unsuitable for the Netherlands, and notes the reply came late.
The cabinet has also recently announced a separate guarantee scheme for small entrepreneurs with limited credit needs, where the credit assessment process can largely be carried out automatically.

Het kabinet heeft daarnaast recent een aparte garantieregeling aangekondigd voor kleine ondernemers met een beperkte kredietbehoefte, waarbij het kredietbeoordelingsproces grotendeels automatisch kan worden uitgevoerd.

The State Secretary answered that the reserve share is excluded from the WOZ value, that municipalities only adjust for significant reserves when analysing comparable sales, and that no change to box 3 treatment is needed.
For all municipalities, the (possible) share in the Owners' Association (VvE) reserve does not count in the valuation of the apartment under the WOZ Act.

Dit klopt niet. Ik verwijs daarbij naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2 en vraag 4.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over verworven rechten in de huurtoeslag

Two MPs (Omtzigt and Ronnes, CDA) asked about the Supreme Court-era ruling that lost acquired rights to rent allowance (huurtoeslag) can revive, and why the Tax Administration did not disclose that an automation error had applied a different practice from 2012 to 2017 affecting about 185 households in 2017 and an unknown number elsewhere. The State Secretary answered that the error was discovered and corrected only for 2017, that the figures were not fully known, that communication was late, and that the government will examine how the Council of State ruling can apply retroactively to the remaining households, reporting back by May.
Due to the duty of confidentiality, I cannot address individual cases.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting kan ik niet op individuele gevallen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Ronnes en Amhaouch over de problemen bij Centric en Oranjewoud

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about governance problems at Centric, Oranjewoud and Strukton, including an unlicensed investigator, the departure of Centric's top management, and board supervision. The government answered that Centric's services to DNB and BNG are unaffected for now, that no investigator licence exists, that FIOD received and declined to treat a complaint due to criminal proceedings, and explained the legal duties of supervisory boards, while noting the answers were delayed.
Due to overlap with investigation and prosecution under article 9:8(1)(f) of the General Administrative Law Act, this complaint, in consultation with the Public Prosecution Service, was not handled.
Wegens samenloop met opsporing en vervolging conform art. 9:8 lid 1 onderdeel f Awb is deze klacht, in afstemming met het Openbaar Ministerie, niet in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over het bericht ‘Minister vertraagt woningbouw’

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked the minister whether the Schone Lucht Akkoord (clean air agreement) would slow housing construction and whether it would impose new procurement requirements on construction equipment amid the housing shortage. The minister answered that the agreement's measures support source-based nitrogen policy, that no new binding standards are set yet, and that concrete procurement criteria will be developed with the construction sector over the coming year.

The Schone Lucht Akkoord does not yet set concrete requirements, but states the following agreement: the central government will investigate with partners how a roadmap for clean and zero-emission construction equipment can look and will publish the results in 2020.

In het Schone Lucht Akkoord zijn nog geen concrete eisen vastgelegd, maar staat de volgende afspraak: «De rijksoverheid onderzoekt daarvoor in samenwerking met partijen hoe een ingroeipad («routekaart») voor schoon en 0-emissie bouwmaterieel eruit kan zien en publiceert de resultaten in 2020» .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over de gevolgen van de Amsterdamse huisvestingsverordening inzake woningdelen voor de krapte op de huurmarkt

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about the effects of Amsterdam's new housing ordinance on shared housing and the rental market shortage, including impacts on students, expats and other sharers. The minister answered that shared housing remains possible in Amsterdam under stricter conditions, that existing legal situations are unaffected, and that the expected effects are limited, while noting that data on sharers is scarce and that a monitor will be published in September.
A monitor on shared housing in Amsterdam will be produced in September. If there is a need for it, it can be shared with the House of Representatives after publication.
In september wordt een monitor gemaakt over woningdelen in Amsterdam. Indien daar behoefte aan is, kan deze na publicatie worden gedeeld met de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over erfpacht in Amsterdam

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers for Environment and Housing and for Finance about leasehold (erfpacht) in Amsterdam, including sudden canon increases, the residual land-value method, unclear information for leaseholders, and consumer protection.
