The ministers answered that leasehold is a property right rather than a financial product, that Amsterdam offers conversion schemes and a three-expert procedure, and that existing local oversight and dispute mechanisms apply.
Leasehold is therefore not comparable to a predatory insurance policy.
Erfpacht is derhalve niet vergelijkbaar met een woekerpolis.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over het feit dat de Belastingdienst het recht op huurtoeslag heeft afgewezen, terwijl een burger het wel had doordat er sprake was van verworven rechten

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked why the tax authority refused housing benefit that a citizen received under acquired rights, and how the Council of State ruling of July 2019 is being applied. The government says the authority changed its practice from 24 July 2019, lapsed acquired rights can be revived until 1 September 2020, and past final decisions will not be reopened.
Decisions that are final will not be reopened with retroactive effect.
Besluiten die wel onherroepelijk vaststaan, worden niet met terugwerkende kracht heropend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis en Ronnes over het bericht dat Utrecht versneld ruim 9.000 woningen en nieuwe OV-verbindingen krijgt

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked why the minister reserved 60 million euros from the housing impulse for Utrecht before the allocation rules (AMvB) were published, and on what legal basis. The minister answered that the reservation is conditional on the yet-to-be-set rules and procedure, gives no guarantee of payment, is not an allocation that can be appealed, and that other regions will be assessed on the same conditions.
There is therefore no allocation of funds from the impulse yet, and so there is no possibility of objection or appeal against the intended reservation.
Er is dus nog geen sprake van een toekenning van middelen uit de impuls en daarmee is er geen bezwaar- of beroepsmogelijkheid tegen de voorgenomen reservering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Slootweg over negatieve spaarrente

Two CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister about negative deposit rates in Germany and whether Dutch banks will pass them on to savers, and about bank stress tests, ECB liquidity reserves and the Consumentenbond's call for a ban. The minister answered that banks set their own pricing, that the MFI statistics do not show higher pressure in Germany than in the Netherlands, that a ban on negative rates is discussed in a separate letter, and that Dutch reserves at the central bank have only slightly changed.
At the general meeting on the effects of ECB policy on 24 September 2019 I committed to your House to hold talks with banks.
Bij het algemeen overleg effecten van het ECB-beleid op 24 september 2019 heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd om in gesprek te gaan met banken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Ronnes over consequenties PFAS (poly- en perfluoralkylstoffen)

MPs Von Martels and Ronnes (CDA) asked about the consequences of the PFAS temporary framework for construction and dredging, including project delays, housing construction, jobs and comparison with other countries. The minister says she is in talks with the sector, has organised information meetings and regional working conferences, and is taking measures to unblock projects while noting the national framework is needed for health reasons.
I do not have independent figures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht 'Negatieve spaarrente voor consumenten lijkt onvermijdelijk'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that negative deposit rates for consumers were becoming unavoidable, and whether Belgium-style bans should be considered. The minister answered that negative rates on consumer deposits are not currently at issue, that a hard ban is a far-reaching intervention with drawbacks, and that he will talk with banks and monitor developments.
I will enter into discussions with the banks about the low interest rate and the concern that exists about a possible negative interest rate on savings deposits.
Ik zal met de banken in gesprek gaan over de lage rente en de onrust die bestaat over een mogelijke negatieve rente op spaardeposito's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Ronnes over het bericht ‘Graf Jacoba van Beieren hoort op Tholen’

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet and Ronnes asked about reports that Countess Jacoba of Bavaria, buried in the Binnenhof Hofkapel, had wished for burial in Tholen, and about the planned research into historic graves and the plaque at the Binnenhof. The Minister answered that the RCE is studying whether Van Oldenbarnevelt's remains can be identified, that the plaque will not be changed but may receive attention during renovation, and that relocating Jacoba's remains is not a condition for honouring her history.
The research report will be available in September.
Het onderzoeksrapport zal in september beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Ronnes over het bericht 'KPN legt initiatief voor glasvezel in Beemster lam'

MPs Van den Berg and Ronnes asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about KPN's plan to fiber-connect only the village cores in Beemster, which may undermine the citizen-led Breedband Beemster project. The State Secretary said competition is for the ACM to supervise, that the ACM is running a market study to be published after summer, and that he will invite the initiative to a meeting, but declined to pre-empt the ACM's findings.
I cannot anticipate the outcomes of the ACM's investigation into competition in the fiber market.
Ik kan niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de ACM naar de concurrentie in de glasvezelmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Ronnes over het bericht 'Overloon vraagt om actie tegen ‘foute vluchtelingen’'

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about residents of Overloon reporting an asylum centre with disproportionate nuisance from a small group of asylum seekers, and feelings of powerlessness, including advice to residents to get a dog, install a fence and report incidents. The State Secretary denied advising residents to get dogs or fences, acknowledged the nuisance, described stepped-up measures (including faster transfers to the EBTL facility) and stated that the Overloon-specific details and wider measures would be reported before summer recess.
On the progress of the measures I will inform your House extensively by letter before the summer recess.
Over de vorderingen van de maatregelen zal ik uw Kamer voor het zomerreces uitgebreid per brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Koerhuis over het bericht dat er fors minder vergunningen voor nieuwbouwwoningen zijn afgegeven

MPs Ronnes and Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior Affairs why building permits for new homes fell 27 percent in early 2019 and whether the ban on gas connections in new construction, the rising costs and scarce building locations are to blame. The minister acknowledged concern, linked the drop plausibly but not certainly to the gas-free new build rule and lagged application declines, said permits have since recovered, and committed only to continued monitoring.
I will continue to closely monitor the development.
Ik blijf de ontwikkeling nauwlettend monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht dat dorpen leeglopen omdat de bouwprojecten niet loskomen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of the Interior whether the housing plan supply is sufficient to close the housing shortage, citing EIB and ABF studies, and questioned provincial planning, the binnenstedelijk bouwen rule and plan data quality. The minister answered that there are enough plans (155% of projected need to 2025), outlined woondeals, the expertteam woningbouw and planning monitoring, and committed to further updates and the AO Bouwopgave.
The inventory shows that there are currently sufficient plans to meet the increase in demand and close the shortfall by 2030.
Uit de inventarisatie komt naar voren dat er op dit moment voldoende plannen zijn om te voorzien in de toename van de behoefte en het inlopen van het tekort tot 2030.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over aardgasvrij bouwen na 1 juli 2018

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked the Minister of the Interior about homes built after 1 July 2018 that are exempted from the gas-free building rule, including how many were connected to gas, the grounds used, alternatives, and future heating options. The minister answered that no precise registration exists, about 1,200 homes in 24 municipalities received exemptions, the choice of exemption rests with municipal councils, and municipalities must present heat transition plans by end 2021.
It is up to the municipal council concerned to exercise control over this.
Het is aan de betreffende gemeenteraad om hier controle op uit te oefenen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Ronnes en Omtzigt over de opvatting van het financieel stabiliteitscomité over het Klimaatakkoord en over de niet gepubliceerde achtergronddocumenten van het Klimaatakkoord

CDA MPs asked the ministers whether the Financial Stability Committee's warnings about mortgage lending norms and green building-linked finance conflict with the draft Climate Agreement, and why the PBL analysis's background documents and reviewer access were incomplete. The ministers replied that AFM and DNB concerns are being taken into account in designing new financing options, that the PBL published three of five background documents, and that the government holds no unpublished background documents.
It is up to the PBL to make the background documents public.
Het is aan PBL om de achtergronddocumenten openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over het bericht dat er vraagtekens zijn bij de fundering van de parkeergarage in Eindhoven

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked whether the foundation of the Eindhoven parking garage played a role in its collapse, citing doubts raised by Terken and Plass, and asked about the independence of the Hageman report and the OvV findings. Minister Ollongren answered that the foundation is not considered a cause, citing Hageman, the Safety Board (OvV) and TNO, and that the municipality found no material deviations in its inspections, but did not claim absolute certainty.

In carrying out its investigations, the Safety Board is bound by a duty of confidentiality and therefore does not state with whom it spoke, what information it collected and how it handled it, except as set out in its report.

Bij het uitvoeren van haar onderzoeken is de Onderzoeksraad gehouden aan een geheimhoudingsplicht en doet daarom geen uitspraken met wie er gesproken is, welke informatie verzameld is en hoe daarmee is omgegaan, behoudens wat in het rapport is weergegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Ronnes en Omtzigt over de doorrekening van het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL)

MPs Mulder, Ronnes and Omtzigt (CDA) asked the ministers about the PBL cost calculation of the draft Climate Agreement's building-sector measures, including the costs per tonne of CO2 and transparency of assumptions. The minister answered that the calculations use standard insulation assumptions, that PBL has explained its models, and that the Climate and Energy Outlook may incorporate new insights.
PBL strives for full transparency about its calculations.
PBL streeft naar volledige transparantie over zijn berekeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over woningbouw bij Utrecht

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the Rijnenburg and Reijerscop polders near Utrecht, planned for housing, should be reconsidered as a 'pauzelandschap' given Utrecht's housing shortage, and why housing plans were postponed. The Minister said housing there is a longer-term option after 2030, that spatial trade-offs are for provinces and municipalities, and that she is discussing housing capacity with the region through MIRT and a housing deal.
I share your view that Utrecht, within the MIRT/UNED mobility agreements, must make clear at which housing locations the expected growth in residents will concretely be accommodated.

Ik deel met u de visie dat Utrecht in het kader van de MIRT/UNED-afspraken over mobiliteit rond Utrecht duidelijk moet maken op welke woningbouwlocaties de verwachte groei van het aantal inwoners concreet geaccommodeerd gaat worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Ronnes en Van der Linde over het bericht dat het Ministerie van Financiën de beantwoording van Kamervragen over het handelen van het Bureau Kredietregistratie (BKR) met dat bureau

MPs Sneller, Ronnes and Van der Linde asked whether the Ministry of Finance aligned its answers to earlier parliamentary questions on BKR (credit registration bureau) conduct with BKR itself, whether measures were agreed with BKR, and about free access to personal data. The minister replies that BKR was consulted on factual points and a proposed approach was adjusted, that BKR remains independent and decides on measures, and that free access under the GDPR is provided, with no limit on the number of requests.
It is customary that, to answer parliamentary questions, contact is sought with involved parties both inside and outside government.
Het is gebruikelijk dat ten behoeve van de beantwoording van Kamervragen contact wordt gezocht met betrokken partijen van binnen en buiten de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Nijboer en Ronnes over de huurcommissie

MPs Smeulders, Nijboer and Ronnes asked the Minister of the Interior about the Huurcommissie's backlog, including its budget, causes of longer processing times, regional complaint volumes, staffing, and when the backlog will be cleared. The minister answered that about EUR 4 million is reserved for 2019 and staffing is being expanded by about 10 FTE, that the 7,500-case target for 2019 carries risks, and that the backlog is expected to be cleared only in the course of 2021.
The Huurcommissie and I consider it important to clear the increased workload as quickly as possible and to normalise processing times.
De Huurcommissie en ik vinden het belangrijk om de toegenomen werkvoorraad zo snel mogelijk in te halen en de doorlooptijden te normaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over het bericht 'Corporaties laten vergoeding NOM-woning links liggen'

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked why the government sent the Energy Performance Allowance evaluation to parliament without a policy response, why only about 6,000 zero-on-the-meter homes were built against a target of 100,000, and whether the costs and rules can be reduced. The minister said the evaluation was sent on 5 April 2019, that she will consult stakeholders and expects to report to parliament by year-end, and that she sees no reason to doubt CE Delft's cost findings but has not yet sketched alternatives.
I expect to be able to inform your House of the outcome at the end of this year.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer eind dit jaar over de uitkomst te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Agnes Mulder over problemen met en leren van pilots aardgasvrije wijken voor de toekomstige wijkaanpak

CDA MPs Ronnes and Agnes Mulder asked about problems in the Nijmegen Meijhorst zero-natural-gas renovation pilot, what central information is collected on neighbourhood pilots, costs, and planning for regional heat plans. The Minister of Interior answered that residents report renovation and comfort problems being addressed, that a Knowledge and Learning Programme and monitoring are being set up, and that further details will follow in later letters.
Your House will be informed about this in the autumn of 2019.
Uw Kamer zal hierover in het najaar van 2019 worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Van Eijs en Ronnes over antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake het tracé van buizen voor ondergronds transport van gevaarlijke stoffen

MPs Smeulders, Van Eijs and Ronnes asked for the current status of the indicative pipeline route Laarbeek-Echt/Susteren, why it remains in the Structuurvisie Buisleidingen, and whether it should be removed or subjected to a cost-benefit analysis. Minister Ollongren answered that the definitive route procedure is being stopped because insufficient information exists, that the indicative route will stay in the structure vision, that no MKBA will be made, and that the Chamber will be informed through the upcoming Nationaal Programma Energiesysteem.
An indicative route cannot be established as a definitive route without consultation with the Chamber about it.
Een indicatief tracé kan niet als definitief tracé worden vastgesteld zonder overleg daarover met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Ronnes en Smeulders over het bericht 'Huurcommissie kan stroom aan klachten niet aan'

MPs asked why complaints to the Huurcommissie (rent tribunal) surged to about 10,000 in 2018, how long cases take, and what the effect of the modernisation bill and long waits is. The minister attributes the rise to no single cause, says durations range from two months to a year, and says she cannot say how many disputes moved to the courts.
The Huurcommissie does not receive data on court proceedings before the judge.
De Huurcommissie ontvangt geen gegevens over gerechtelijke procedures bij de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Ronnes over het bericht dat sommige kleine Europese landen in trek zijn voor licenties van nieuwe betaaldiensten

MPs Sneller and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about reports that small EU states attract payment-licence applicants and about supervisory capacity, money-laundering risks linked to citizenship-by-investment schemes in Malta and Cyprus, and whether supervision should be centralised at EU level. The minister answered that PSD II harmonises supervision, that Dutch supervisors can escalate to the EBA, that the Commission is monitoring citizenship schemes, and that the government favours only gradual, criteria-based centralisation, so EU-level supervision of payment services is not warranted for now.
The cabinet therefore favours a gradual transfer of supervisory tasks away from national supervisors.
Het kabinet is daarom voorstander van een geleidelijke overgang van toezichttaken van nationale toezichthouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over problemen op de Maaslijn

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked the state secretary about financial and operational problems on the Maaslijn rail line, including provincial disputes, responsibilities for funding and rolling stock, and the impact on students. The state secretary said responsibility for the project and concession lies mainly with the three provinces, that the Rijk's contributions are fixed, and that she is monitoring the situation and in talks with the provinces, without committing to a formal mediating role.
Responsibility for implementing the project and the agreed measures lies with the three provinces, with the province of Limburg as the first point of contact.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van het project en de afgesproken maatregelen ligt bij de drie provincies, waarbij de provincie Limburg het eerste aanspreekpunt is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over de veiligheid van escaperooms in Nederland

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Interior whether escape rooms in the Netherlands are safe after a fire in Poland, including whether they meet building code rules, whether municipalities inspect them, and whether additional rules such as an emergency exit button are needed. The Minister answered that municipalities supervise compliance, that many municipalities have now decided to inspect all escape rooms, and that a specific emergency button should not be prescribed in the building code.
I am not aware whether these locations meet the requirements of the Building Decree or whether municipalities have granted permits for these locations.
Mij is niet bekend of deze locaties aan de eisen van het Bouwbesluit voldoen en of voor deze locaties door gemeenten vergunningen zijn verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Dam over het bericht ‘De Nederlandsche Bank laat bewust leemte in toezicht op witwaswet’

MPs Ronnes and Van Dam asked whether differences in unusual-transaction reporting between banks, and ING's sharp rise in 2017, prompted DNB to check other banks' monitoring systems. The minister answered that reports are not comparable across banks, that DNB conducts risk-based AML supervision and thematic investigations (2016 and 2018) that found weaknesses at several institutions, and that enforcement follows where violations occur.
DNB continuously conducts risk-based Wwft supervision of banks, including the effectiveness of transaction monitoring.
DNB houdt doorlopend risicogebaseerd Wwft-toezicht op banken, met inbegrip van de effectiviteit van de transactiemonitoring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Van den Berg en Ronnes over het bericht 'Zorginstelling omzeilt winstverbod'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Health whether the affiliated property, service and management structures of DeSeizoenen BV circumvent the profit ban in care and whether the WNT pay rules were respected. The minister answered that the IGJ and NZa are investigating and that they will share no further information for now, so he awaits the outcome.
The inspectorate and the NZa have indicated that, in the interest of their investigation, they are not providing further information at this time.
De inspectie en de NZa hebben aangegeven om in het belang van hun onderzoek op dit moment geen nadere informatie te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over het bericht “ING top niet getoetst op witwaszaak”

MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about reports that ING's top management was not re-vetted after the money-laundering settlement of EUR 775 million, and whether supervisors should conduct the assessment themselves. The minister answered that re-vetting is solely for the independent supervisor (the ECB for ING board members), that supervisory confidentiality prevents comment on whether re-vetting was considered, and that he has no power to direct the ECB.
It is solely for the independent supervisor to proceed to re-vetting when the facts and circumstances give cause for it.
Het is uitsluitend aan de onafhankelijke toezichthouder om tot hertoetsing over te gaan, wanneer de feiten en omstandigheden daartoe aanleiding geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Helvert over parkeerplaatsen bij het belastingkantoor in Maastricht

CDA MPs Ronnes and Van Helvert asked why the Tax Office in Maastricht does not open its car park to the public outside office hours and whether they would seek a solution with stakeholders. State Secretary Knops answered that security, safety and vandalism concerns, plus a higher FIOD security regime, mean the Tax Office will not admit third parties, while the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and Tax Office will study shared use of space at other sites.
The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and the Tax Office will jointly examine the possibility of multiple use of space and map what is feasible at locations where the Tax Office is the user.

Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf en de Belastingdienst zullen samen de mogelijkheid tot meervoudig ruimtegebruik onderzoeken en in beeld brengen wat er mogelijk is bij locaties waar de Belastingdienst de gebruiker is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over problemen op de Maaslijn

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about recurring disruptions and overcrowded trains on the Maaslijn railway line. The government answered that improvements depend on provincial concession measures and electrification planned for later, attributing the problems to infrastructure repair delays, a lack of rolling stock, and hard-to-detect signalling faults, while assigning responsibility to the concession holder, ProRail and the provinces.
It is the responsibility of the concession holder and concession grantors to take action on this together with ProRail.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de concessiehouder en concessieverleners om daar samen met ProRail actie op te ondernemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over ING, dat de balans met 180 miljard euro bijstelde, de accountant die niet weet wat onder die post valt, de bank die zo bankenbelasting bespaarde en vervroegd staatss

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about ING's 180 billion euro balance sheet restatement, the auditor's knowledge of its components, leverage ratio compliance, early repayment of state aid and resulting bonuses. The Minister answered that netting of cash pooling is permitted under international standards, that the components are not further known to him beyond public reporting, and that the matters are for the bank, auditor, AFM and DNB rather than the ministry.
It is up to the auditor to check the annual accounts against the standards.
Het is aan de accountant om de jaarrekening te controleren op basis van de standaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Ronnes over het bericht ‘Rabobank en ABN AMRO missen derivatendeadline’

MPs Van der Linde and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about reports that Rabobank and ABN AMRO missed the deadline for compensating SME clients affected by the derivatives scandal, and why the backlog persists. The minister acknowledged the delay, said the AFM is monitoring process optimisations and that banks have been told of parliament's displeasure, and noted that roughly 10,980 SME clients still lacked a definitive offer.
For that reason, I will, together with the AFM, continue to closely monitor that banks do everything possible to provide this clarity as quickly as possible.
Om die reden zal ik, samen met de AFM, goed blijven monitoren dat banken al het mogelijke blijven doen om deze duidelijkheid zo snel mogelijk te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Geurts over het bericht ‘Geld kan soms toch groeien op lapjes landbouwgrond’

MPs Ronnes and Geurts asked the Finance Minister whether land speculation schemes escape AFM financial supervision because the land is formally leased out, and where misled investors can turn. The minister confirmed the practices, explained that formal contract arrangements do not settle whether a land investment is a financial product since the substance of management is assessed, pointed investors to the ACM and civil remedies, and said a bill strengthening investor protection is being prepared for 2019.
I am currently preparing a bill that will strengthen the protection of investors in investment objects.
Momenteel bereid ik een wetsvoorstel voor waarmee de bescherming van beleggers in beleggingsobjecten wordt versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Dam over het bericht ‘De Nederlandsche Bank laat bewust leemte in toezicht op witwaswet’

CDA MPs Ronnes and Van Dam asked about the ING money-laundering settlement with the Public Prosecution Service, DNB's supervision of ING's remediation plan, IFI system use, unusual-transaction reporting figures by major bank, accountants' comments, and criminal liability of managers for omissions. The government answered that DNB monitors ING's remediation closely and will use supervisory tools if needed, withheld DNB information on ING's IFI use citing confidentiality, provided reporting statistics, and rejected the view that the criminal law is too focused on active conduct, declining a scientific study.
If it appears that ING has not implemented the imposed improvements in a timely and complete manner, DNB will use its supervisory instruments.
Indien blijkt dat ING niet tijdig en volledig de opgelegde verbeteringen heeft doorgevoerd, zal DNB haar toezichtinstrumentarium benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over financiële problemen NS op het Britse spoor

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes (CDA) asked about NS's financial problems on its British rail activities, including a £80 million PCS guarantee draw for East Anglia, the CLE risk-sharing mechanism, and whether Dutch fares could rise. Minister Hoekstra answered that Abellio UK has been profitable overall, that the PCS guarantees are capped by a €500 million ministerial ceiling and that the CLE index is no longer applied to new concessions, while declining to comment on ongoing negotiations with DfT.
We do not wish to anticipate the outcomes of those discussions and their consequences for the remainder of the concession term.
Wij willen niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van die gesprekken en de gevolgen daarvan voor de rest van de looptijd van de concessie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over maatregelen van Duitsland, Frankrijk en het Verenigd Koninkrijk om Amerikaanse secundaire sancties te omzeilen

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked the minister about the German, French and British plan for a special purpose vehicle to circumvent US secondary sanctions on Iran, including Dutch participation and effectiveness for Dutch firms. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports and will join the technical work and possibly the SPV later, but that it is not a solution for firms active in the US market, leaving business decisions to companies.
If well elaborated, the Netherlands will in due course participate in the SPV to be set up.
Indien goed uitgewerkt zal Nederland t.z.t. participeren in de op te zetten SPV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht ‘Kraakactie in Mill tegen uitsterfbeleid woonwagens’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of the Interior whether the squatting of a caravan site in Mill by travellers from another municipality, in protest at a municipal phase-out policy, is illegal, and what enforcement options exist, and whether the 2018 policy framework on caravan sites causes confusion. The minister answered that squatting without permits is illegal, that municipalities may enforce against it and mayors may intervene under the Public Manifestations Act, that she will discuss the framework with municipalities and traveller organisations, and that municipalities may reduce standplaatsen where there is no longer demand.
The policy framework does not give individual caravan dwellers the right to illegally occupy, appropriate or carry out illegal activities on a standplaats.
Het beleidskader geeft individuele woonwagenbewoners geen recht om illegaal een standplaats in gebruik te nemen, toe te eigenen of illegale activiteiten te ontplooien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over ING dat haar balans over 2014 en 2015 aanpaste met meer dan 180 miljard euro

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister why ING restated its 2014 and 2015 customer loans by over 180 billion euros, and whether supervision, accounting standards and the ECB were involved. The minister answered that the change reflects a shift from net to gross presentation of cash pooling in ING's accounts, that the accounting rules allow netting, and that the prudential supervisor, not the ministry, oversees such matters and does not comment on individual banks.
The ministry is not responsible for the content of the annual publication of individual banks' financial statements.
Het ministerie is niet verantwoordelijk voor de inhoud van de jaarlijkse publicatie van de jaarrekening van individuele banken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Ronnes en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Opmars No Cure, No Pay bureaus bij WOZ-bezwaren’

MPs asked about the growing share of WOZ property-valuation objections filed by no-cure-no-pay agencies, including calls for independent research, consumer protection, association sponsorship practices, municipal valuation quality, and an OZB inspection counter under the Omgevingswet. The ministers say they will commission research into the volume of such objections and related cost reimbursements before deciding on solutions, but decline to intervene in agency-association arrangements and point to existing Waarderingskamer oversight and the WOZ waardeloket.
My colleagues and I will have the development of the number of objections by no cure no pay companies and the related cost reimbursements examined.
Mijn ambtgenoten en ik zullen de ontwikkeling van de aantallen bezwaren door no cure no pay bedrijven en de in verband daarmee toegekende kostenvergoedingen laten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Ronnes over het bericht dat financiële bijsluiters niet geschikt zijn voor consumenten

MPs Sneller and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about a University of Groningen study finding financial information documents (bijsluiters) hard for consumers to understand, and about whether the EU KID and WRR-recommended measures strengthen consumers' position against financial institutions. The minister acknowledged comprehension problems, described KID improvements, pointed to the provision ban, duty of care and product oversight, and said the EU evaluation has not yet started, promising to push for a swift evaluation.
I will work to push for a swift evaluation at European level and stress that the evaluation should consider the user-friendliness and effectiveness of the KID for consumer choices.

Ik zal mij inzetten om in Europees verband een snelle evaluatie te bepleiten en benadrukken dat in de evaluatie oog is voor de gebruiksvriendelijkheid en de effectiviteit van het KID voor consumentenkeuzes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Amhaouch over de halfjaarcijfers van NS

MPs Ronnes and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about NS half-year results, including the 1% net return, the normrendement band and its history, the gap with the 7% target, and a 400 million euro working-capital swing linked to student transport payments. The government answered that the normrendement is 4%-6% since 2017, that the working-capital swing is mainly timing of the OV-studentenkaart payment, and that the state keeps a watchful eye on NS's return on equity.
The timing of payment by the state is therefore partly determinative of NS's working capital.
Het moment van uitbetaling door het Rijk is dus medebepalend voor de hoogte van het werkkapitaal van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van der Molen over het bericht dat ex-studenten geen hypotheek krijgen bij een studieschuld

MPs Ronnes and Van der Molen (CDA) asked ministers whether banks wrongly count the original rather than remaining student debt when assessing mortgage applications, and whether DUO should improve information to students. The government answered that annuity repayment makes the monthly burden constant so the original debt is weighted via fixed factors, that the explain exception exists, that information will be improved, and that excluding student debt would raise over-indebtedness risk.

At the next Platform Hypotheken in 2019, where the sector and the supervisor discuss possible bottlenecks in mortgage lending, it will be inventoried how providers use this explain possibility and whether bottlenecks are encountered.

Tijdens het volgende Platform Hypotheken in 2019, waar met de sector en de toezichthouder wordt gesproken over mogelijke knelpunten in de hypotheekverstrekking, zal worden geïnventariseerd op welke wijze aanbieders gebruik maken van deze explain-mogelijkheid en of hier knelpunten worden ondervonden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Ronnes over het potentiële gebruik van slimme meters voor energiebesparing

MPs Mulder and Ronnes asked the ministers about the evaluation of the energy-saving covenant, weak uptake of smart-meter energy-saving services, and smart thermostats. Minister Wiebes answered that the evaluation is expected by end 2018, that the covenant is expected to be complied with, and that policy measures are limited to voluntary sector commitments and subsidies.
I assume that the Covenant will be complied with.
Ik ga er vanuit dat het Convenant zal worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Ronnes en Beckerman over PUR-schuim in Vriezenveen

Three MPs asked the Minister of Interior about a family in Vriezenveen left facing a large claim after no contractor would remove demolition rubble containing PUR foam, and about PUR recycling, Bouwbesluit rules and comparisons with Germany and Belgium. The minister acknowledged the case, said the rubble was dumped as non-reusable, committed to amending the Bouwbesluit by mid-2019, and declined an independent inquiry.
However, I see no reason to commission further independent research in addition to the announced amendment of building regulations and the planned Health Council study.
Ik zie echter geen aanleiding om naast de door mij aangekondigde wijziging van de bouwregelgeving en het nog geplande onderzoek door de Gezondheidsraad nader onafhankelijk onderzoek te laten doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over de voortgangsrapportage rentederivaten, waaruit blijkt dat twee banken alle deadlines missen

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes (CDA) asked the Finance Minister why ABN AMRO and Rabobank are missing the deadline for the interest rate derivatives redress framework for SMEs, and about related issues such as advance payments, limitation periods, the mandate of the complaints committee, the withdrawn AFM fine on ABN AMRO and whether banks should pay higher interest. The Minister answered that the framework's timelines are being monitored with the AFM, that banks are contacted and committed to finishing by end 2018, and that he sees no grounds for further mandates, investigations or a higher interest rate.
I currently see insufficient reason to conduct further research into this.
Ik zie op dit moment onvoldoende aanleiding om hier verder onderzoek naar te doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over het bericht dat de Oostenrijkse bankentoezichthouder zijn toezicht op Turkse banken verscherpt en over het toezicht op Turkse banken in Nederland, waarvan tegoeden o

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch supervisors are monitoring Turkish-owned banks in the Netherlands, how much of their deposits are covered by the Dutch deposit guarantee scheme, and whether limits apply to their deposit-taking and lending. The minister answered that the five Dutch-licensed banks with Turkish ownership are fully subject to Dutch supervision and EU rules, that DNB does not publish bank-specific splits, and that a cap on foreign exposures relative to guaranteed deposits applies, while no absolute deposit cap exists.
DNB publishes financial data of individual banks on its website.
DNB publiceert financiële gegevens van individuele banken op haar website.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van der Molen over het tekort aan studentenkamers

Two CDA MPs asked about the shortage of student rooms, rising rents, housing options for starters, arrangements for international students, and whether the housing situation affects study choices. The minister disputed the figure of 40,000 unhoused students, pointed to monitor data and the rent-check route via the Huurcommissie, and said no trend yet shows housing affecting study choice.
I have not yet observed a trend showing that the housing market situation influences students' study choices.
Ik heb nog geen trend waargenomen waaruit blijkt dat de situatie op de woningmarkt de studiekeuze van studenten beïnvloedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het aantrekken van buitenlandse investeerders voor sociale woningbouw

MP Ronnes (CDA) asks whether the government endorses a website promoting foreign investment in Dutch housing, including social rental stock sold by housing corporations, and whether it will stop directing foreign investors to the regulated sector. The minister answers that the site informs about the housing market, that foreign investors are a small share, that corporation sales are subject to tenant, municipal and dispute rules, and that the site will be updated.
The website will be updated on this point.
De website zal op dit punt geactualiseerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van den Berg en Ronnes over het bericht ‘Centrale Bank van Curaçao plaatst Ennia onder curatele’

MPs Van den Berg and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister whether DNB had earlier warnings about Ennia, what steps it took, whether policyholders were informed, and about Ennia's market share and hurricane claims. The minister declined to give details on DNB's warnings and actions citing its statutory confidentiality duty, said Curaçao's central bank (CBCS) is responsible for prudential supervision of Ennia, and refused to comment on consequences for policyholders in another country.

Partly because of this statutory confidentiality duty, and because as Minister I in principle do not receive information on individual institutions supervised by DNB, it is not possible to answer the questions about the content of warnings and any steps taken.

Vanwege onder meer deze geheimhoudingsplicht -en vanwege mijn systeemverantwoordelijkheid als Minister – waarbij geldt dat ik in principe geen informatie over individuele onder toezicht staande instellingen van DNB ontvang – is het niet mogelijk om de vragen over de inhoud van waarschuwingen en eventueel genomen stappen te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van der Molen over het bericht dat meer dan 100 Nederlandse studenten hun kamer moeten verlaten voor internationale studenten

Two CDA MPs asked ministers about reports that over 100 Dutch students must leave their rooms in the former Bijlmerbajes to make way for international students, and whether this is undesirable and what will be done. The ministers answered that the temporary housing is additional capacity once converted, that the affected students were told their stay was temporary, that they will be asked to help find alternatives, and that they know of no other similar cases.
Only once this location has been made suitable for international students do the rooms count as extra capacity on top of the existing supply.
Pas op het moment dat deze locatie geschikt is gemaakt voor internationale studenten, tellen de kamers als extra capaciteit op het bestaande aanbod.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Geurts en Ronnes over aansluiting en planning van duurzame energie projecten met betrekking tot elektriciteitsnetwerken en beschermen natuur, landschap en vruchtbare landbouw

MPs from the CDA asked the Economic Affairs minister about grid connection delays for renewable energy projects, the statutory connection deadlines and sanctions, planning coordination with regional governments, and protecting nature, landscape and farmland from solar parks. The minister answered that the 18-week deadline is increasingly exceeded for some connections, that no sanctions have been imposed to date, and that regional energy strategies and the national environment vision will address spatial coordination.
For connections to the low and medium voltage grid there is no uniform recording of exceedances of the deadlines.
Voor aansluitingen op het laagspannings- en middenspanningsnet is er geen uniforme vastlegging van overschrijdingen van de termijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Agnes Mulder over geluid van warmtepompen en airco’s voor omwonenden

MPs Ronnes and Agnes Mulder asked the ministers about noise from heat pumps and air conditioners affecting neighbours, including existing national rules and possible measures. The government answered that the Bouwbesluit 2012 currently sets no neighbour-protection noise rules, that it intends to add them later in 2018, and that municipalities can use APV noise provisions in the meantime.
No rules are set in the Bouwbesluit 2012 on the noise of heat pumps and air conditioners to protect neighbours.
Aan het geluid van warmtepompen en airco’s worden in het Bouwbesluit 2012 geen regels gesteld ter bescherming van omwonenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over de berichten dat er snel hulp nodig is bij KLM en dat de Franse overheid niet van plan is Air France te redden

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked the ministers about reports that KLM needs quick help and that the French government will not rescue Air France, probing leadership risks, French influence, possible transfer of KLM assets to Paris, and the possibility of splitting the group. The minister answered that the leadership crisis is being addressed, that the Dutch public interest is safeguarded through informal contacts and board representation, that transfer to Paris is unlikely, and that he does not share the French minister's stance on a bailout.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over de bizar hoge voorbeeldrendementen bij beleggingsverzekeringen en het risico op een nieuwe (pensioen)woekerpolisaffaire

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about unrealistically high example returns (up to 16%) in investment insurance products under the EU PRIIPs regulation and the risk of a new pension-insurance scandal. The minister answered that the returns follow a mandated EU calculation method based on the past five years, that the issue is being raised at EU level with the AFM, and that Dutch parliament had no role in the delegated regulation.
Parliament was not informed about the adoption of the delegated regulation.
Over de vaststelling van de gedelegeerde verordening is Uw Kamer niet geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over woningbouwplannen in grote stedelijke regio’s

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about housing plans in large urban regions, including the claim of a chronic shortage of plans, the choice of regions for talks, whether built-up areas can absorb future demand, and pre-financing for brownfield transformation. The minister said the claim is unsourced, explained the regional selection based on scale and spatial complexity, noted studies showing inner-city potential but limits in the long term, and said a pre-financing fund is under review.
Currently I am examining how pre-financing can accelerate the transformation of these profitable inner-city locations and how private parties can contribute to a fund for such projects.
Momenteel bezie ik hoe voorfinanciering de transformatie van deze rendabele binnenstedelijke locaties kan versnellen en hoe private partijen kunnen bijdragen aan een fonds voor dergelijke projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over erfpacht

An MP from the CDA asked ministers about leasehold (erfpacht) disputes in Amsterdam, including court costs, the legal status of the Amsterdam switch scheme to perpetual leasehold, whether it amounts to an insurance product requiring AFM oversight, and the financial burden on homeowners. The minister answered that courts remain open at manageable cost, that the scheme is a contractual arrangement not an insurance product so the AFM has no role, and that the municipality offered a calculator tool and a financial safety net.
It is up to the leaseholder, possibly after obtaining legal advice on his case, to decide whether he wants to bring proceedings against the municipality.
Het is aan de erfpachter om – eventueel na het inwinnen van juridisch advies over zijn zaak – te beslissen of hij een procedure tegen de gemeente wil voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over voorbehoud van financiering en bouwkundige keuring bij de aankoop van woningen

MP Ronnes asked the Minister of the Interior about the use of financing and structural survey contingencies in house purchases, especially in Amsterdam where notaries draft purchase agreements and the survey clause is reportedly not used. The Minister said the ongoing study does not examine who drafts the contract, that talks with the notarial body are underway with an update promised, and that there are no statutory quality requirements for building surveyors while encouraging sector initiatives.
I will inform you about this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht ‘Bestuur ASR krijgt fikse verhoging van salaris’

MP Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about ASR's board pay rise of over 35% shortly after the state sold its stake, and whether Rhineland governance should apply instead of Anglo-Saxon models. The minister called the rise striking but said pay is for the supervisory board and new shareholders to decide, while confirming Dutch governance rules embody the Rhineland model and that the Volksbank's pay policy will be addressed when the bank is ready.
Because I am no longer a shareholder, I do not decide on the level of pay of ASR's board of management.
Omdat ik geen aandeelhouder meer ben, ga ik niet over de hoogte van de beloning van de raad van bestuur van a.s.r.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Ronnes en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Peking pleegt coup bij verzekeringsreus Anbang’

MPs Ronnes (CDA) and Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about reports of a Chinese state takeover of Anbang, the owner of Dutch insurer Vivat, and what this means for Dutch supervision, capitalisation, possible capital outflows, state aid and policyholder protection. The minister answered that DNB supervises Vivat under Dutch law, that Vivat has repaid loans to Anbang and may not lend to or guarantee its shareholder without DNB consent, and that policyholders face no consequence, though he had no information beyond the media on the Chinese intervention.
I have no further information on the intervention by the Chinese insurance supervisor CIRC at Anbang beyond what is known from the media.
Ik heb geen nadere informatie over de interventie van de Chinese toezichthouder op de verzekeringssector CIRC bij Anbang dan in de media bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Slootweg over het bericht 'Loek Winter omzeilt winstverbod zorg'

CDA MPs Ronnes and Slootweg asked the Minister of Health whether profit restrictions in care can be circumvented via subcontractors, BV structures, property arrangements and tenant-council rights, and whether the IGJ and WNT cover these. The Minister acknowledged the risks, promised a position letter on profit distribution by spring and a bill to bring subcontractors under the WNT by year-end, but deferred or deflected several questions to other bodies.
Therefore, together with the Minister of the Interior, work is underway on a legislative process to bring subcontractors under the WNT and thereby tackle avoidance constructions.
Daarom wordt, samen met de Minister van BZK, gewerkt aan een wetstraject om onderaannemers onder de WNT te brengen en zodoende ontwijkconstructies aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over voorbehoud van financiering en bouwkundige keuring bij de aankoop van woningen

The MP asks whether sellers are pressuring buyers to waive financing and structural-inspection conditions, whether a new model contract is applied, and whether buyers should always be able to demand an inspection. The minister answers that research is ongoing, contract freedom is preserved, the new model contract now includes these conditions by default, and the brokers' use of it will be checked.
I am willing to enter into discussion with the brokers' trade organisations to ask whether they have these figures or whether they wish to investigate this differently.
Ik ben bereid om in gesprek te gaan met de brancheorganisaties van makelaars om hen te vragen of zij deze cijfers hebben of dit anders te willen onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over gebouwen met brandgevaarlijke panelen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Dutch buildings have fire-hazardous facade panels like those in Grenfell Tower, and whether the government will identify such buildings and hold municipalities accountable. The minister answered that ACM panels are mainly used in non-residential buildings, that about five existing buildings have non-compliant facades owned by building owners who are investigating, and that she will await the Grenfell inquiry before deciding on further measures, without publicly naming buildings.
The municipal competent authority itself decides whether it is opportune to communicate externally about the signals it has received or observed itself.
Het gemeentelijk bevoegd gezag bepaalt zelf of het opportuun is om extern te communiceren over de signalen die zij heeft ontvangen of zelf heeft opgemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het onder verscherpt toezicht plaatsen van Woonstichting Vooruitgang uit Sassenheim

An MP asks the Minister whether housing association Vooruitgang in Sassenheim was placed under enhanced supervision by the Autoriteit woningcorporaties after governance failures, the resignation of the entire supervisory board, and disputes with the director-manager, and asks about information to tenants and the municipality. The Minister confirms the enhanced supervision, explains the 2017 inspection and intervention, the board's resignation, the appointment of temporary internal supervisors, and states that financial position gives no cause for concern while the association must produce a governance recovery plan.
The Aw will also press the corporation on this and act where necessary.
De Aw zal hier ook op aandringen bij de corporatie en waar nodig handelend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over verlagen van administratieve lasten en overhead bij woningcorporaties

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked the Minister of Interior Affairs whether housing corporation administrative costs, overhead, personnel, maintenance and IT costs exceed those of private landlords and how they could be reduced. The minister answered that comparison data are lacking, that corporations have statutory tasks justifying certain costs, that costs have been falling since 2013, and that the sector and the Autoriteit woningcorporaties will be monitored, with a commitment to work with the sector on reducing administrative burdens.
Due to the lack of figures from private landlords and property managers, such a comparison is not possible.
Door het ontbreken van cijfers van private verhuurders en vastgoedbeheerders is een dergelijke vergelijking niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van den Berg over erfpacht in Amsterdam

MPs Ronnes and Van den Berg (CDA) asked whether leaseholders in Amsterdam and on the Wadden islands are adequately protected, whether the eternal-lease conversion scheme is understandable for consumers, and whether UK and Norwegian legislative developments should be followed, and asked about a request to annul Amsterdam council decisions. The minister answers that existing civil law (BW title 5.7, reasonableness and fairness, informational duties) and administrative law principles provide sufficient protection, that the Amsterdam scheme is transparent enough, that no change to Dutch law is needed, and that the annulment request was rejected.
For leasehold in Amsterdam and on the Wadden islands, the leaseholders are moreover generally bound by the general principles of good administration.
Voor de erfpacht in Amsterdam en op de Waddeneilanden geldt bovendien dat de erfverpachters veelal gebonden zijn aan de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Slootweg over het verdwijnen van pinautomaten

MPs Ronnes and Slootweg (CDA) asked the Minister of Finance about reports that a quarter of cash machines may disappear, the joint management of ATMs by Rabobank, ABN AMRO and ING via Geldservice Nederland, competition concerns, municipal input, outage data, cash volumes and security. The minister confirmed the plan, said the 5 km access norm would be maintained with coverage of 99.73%, that the ACM saw no competition problem, and pointed to existing consultation channels, while admitting no data exists on outage durations.
No figures are known on the number of hours that outdoor cash machines are out of use due to a fault or being empty.
Over het aantal uren dat geldautomaten in buitenmuren buiten gebruik zijn vanwege een storing of leegstand zijn geen cijfers bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Schadeherstel in derivatendossier loopt zoveelste vertraging op’.

MPs Ronnes and Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about reported delays in compensating SMEs harmed by interest rate derivatives, and whether the AFM, banks and external file assessors are blocking progress. The minister acknowledged delays due to automation and data problems, denied a deadlock, and said banks are offering advances to vulnerable clients and he will keep pressure on them.
I remain in discussion with the AFM about this and will raise attention to it in my (introductory) meetings with banks in the coming period.
Ik blijf hierover met de AFM in gesprek en zal in mijn (kennismakings)gesprekken met banken de komende tijd hier ook aandacht voor vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over administratieve lasten bij woningcorporaties

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Interior Affairs whether housing associations' administrative burden had risen sharply under the revised Housing Act, as Aedes claimed, and what could be done to cut costs. The minister acknowledged the burden rose more than expected, estimated the structural increase at about 60 million euros, and committed to consulting sector parties on reducing burdens, pointing to existing supervision and reporting streamlining initiatives.
I agree with Aedes that it must be examined how, within the goals of the law, the administrative burden for corporations is not higher than necessary.
Ik ben het met Aedes eens dat gekeken moet worden hoe binnen de doelen van de wet de administratieve lasten voor corporaties niet hoger zijn dan nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht dat de AFM stopt met het onderzoek naar bijzonder beheer bij banken

An MP asked the Finance Minister why the AFM stopped its investigation into special management of bank SME loans, whether this falls outside its mandate, and whether the investigation will be resumed. The minister answered that the AFM has limited powers over business lending, that the sector is self-regulating via a handreiking and a forthcoming gedragscode, and that he will not ask the AFM to resume but will consider legislation if the code proves insufficient.
I share the AFM's observation that a new situation has arisen since the AFM's exploratory investigation in 2015.
Ik deel de observatie van de AFM dat er na het verkennend onderzoek van de AFM in 2015 een nieuwe situatie is ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht dat legionella doden blijft maken door de lakse bouwwereld

An MP asked the Minister whether the construction sector underestimates legionella risks, whether practice guidelines for hot and cold zones are applied, and how many deaths occur yearly. The Minister acknowledged that design and installation need attention, noted a new CUR guideline (June 2017), said municipalities enforce the Building Decree, and reported 8 to 20 deaths per year in 2005–2016.
I do not have concrete information that confirms this claim.
Ik beschik niet over concrete informatie die deze stelling bevestigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Ronnes over onvoldoende mobiel bereik in delen van Brabant

MPs Van den Berg and Ronnes asked the minister about poor mobile coverage in parts of Brabant, including whether the 112 emergency number is unreachable in Olland and what Agentschap Telecom has done. The state secretary answered that primary responsibility lies with operators and municipalities, that Agentschap Telecom forwarded the provincial letter and offers technical support, and that it is in contact with three other municipalities.
The province of Noord-Brabant acknowledges that primary responsibility for mobile accessibility lies with mobile operators and municipalities.
De provincie Noord-Brabant erkent dat de primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor mobiele bereikbaarheid bij mobiele operators en gemeenten ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht 'Geldverstrekkers huiverig bij nieuwe hypotheek ouderen'

An MP asked the Minister about reports that lenders are reluctant to give mortgages to older people and whether banks use the room for tailored exceptions to income norms. The Minister answered that lenders' use of exceptions varies widely, that some find tailored lending risky or unprofitable, and that the AFM has published clarifications; the government cannot oblige lenders to lend.
There is no obligation for lenders to provide credit or to use the exception possibilities in the Mortgage Credit Regulation.
Er bestaat geen verplichting voor kredietverstrekkers om krediet te verstrekken of gebruik te maken van de afwijkingsmogelijkheden in de Regeling hypothecair krediet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Amhaouch over de consequentie van Basel IV regels voor het financieringsmechanisme ten behoeve van ontwikkelingssamenwerking

CDA MPs asked whether Basel IV capital rules would deter bank financing of development countries and sought measures to protect such lending. The government answered that the Basel framework is risk-based without geographic distinction, that negotiations are ongoing, and that it would consider the EU implementation and impact assessment before setting its position.
It is not yet certain that higher capital requirements for investments in developing countries will be a result of the new Basel Committee regulation.
Het staat echter nog niet vast dat een verhoging van kapitaaleisen voor investeringen in ontwikkelingslanden een resultante van de nieuwe regelgeving van het Bazelse comité zal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Ronnes over de rol van de Nederlandse Spoorwegen bij de verliezen die in Schotland worden geleden

MPs Von Martels and Ronnes asked whether the minister knew Abellio ScotRail, an NS subsidiary, was loss-making and received a group loan support, and whether this is reasonable given NS's Dutch-state ownership. The minister answered that the losses were known through regular shareholder consultation, that the group guarantee is a market-standard concession requirement capped under a risk framework, and that he sees no reason to doubt NS's expectation of eventual profitability.
That was known to me. The ministry, as shareholder, regularly consults with NS on the financial position of NS and relevant group companies.
Dat was mij bekend. Het ministerie heeft als aandeelhouder regelmatig overleg met NS over de financiële stand van zaken van NS en relevante groepsonderdelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ronnes, Visser en Aukje de Vries over de samenwerking tussen KLM en Air France

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the government about the KLM-Air France relationship, including a cultural report, centralisation, the Joon/Boost subsidiary, governance and Dutch representation on the holding's executive committee. The state secretary said the cooperation is a private company matter, that the 2016 agreements still stand, that Joon will not hinder KLM's growth, and that the two-tier model is valued, while declining to comment on the report and refusing to take a position on board composition.
I did not discuss the report with the KLM management because I consider the cooperation a responsibility of the company Air France KLM and of the two airlines KLM and Air France themselves.

Ik heb over het rapport niet met de KLM-directie gesproken omdat ik de samenwerking een verantwoordelijkheid van de onderneming Air France KLM en de twee luchtvaartmaatschappijen KLM en Air France zelf vind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Koerhuis over het onderzoek naar de oorzaken van het instorten van een parkeergarage in Eindhoven

MPs Ronnes and Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior about the causes of a parking garage collapse at Eindhoven Airport, the division of building-quality responsibilities, the status of related buildings, and the scope of inspections on breedplaatvloeren. The minister answered that builders remain responsible under current rules, that the planned Wet kwaliteitsborging shifts checks to a private quality assurer, that NEN finds the norm clear but may clarify it, and that inspections were started at government buildings and gemeenten with buildings from 1999 onward.
I do not know which buildings these are.
Ik weet niet welke gebouwen dit zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht dat slechts 3% van de huurprijzen van sociale huurwoningen ‘in balans is’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a Deloitte finding that only 3% of social rental homes have rent, market value and tenant income in balance, and about the policy response. The minister said the finding is expected given that housing associations charge rents below market level, pointed to measures such as income-dependent rent increases and passend toewijzen, and noted that data on oversized social housing are no longer current.
I share the analysis that the stock of social rental housing can be used more optimally.
Ik deel de analyse dat de voorraad sociale huurwoningen optimaler benut kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over de problemen bij Anbang en de gevolgen daarvan voor de polishouders van VIVAT

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the ministers about problems at Anbang and the risks to Vivat policyholders, including the regulator's handling and possible capital extraction. The ministers answered that DNB's supervisory information is confidential, that the regulator monitors compliance and that the EUR 1.35 billion capital injection strengthened Vivat, while declining to comment on Anbang's internal affairs or future licence applications.
Information about the supervisor's assessment of the holder of a declaration of no objection is supervisory-confidential and therefore not public.
Informatie over de beoordeling door de toezichthouder van de houder van een verklaring van geen bezwaar is toezichtvertrouwelijk en daarmee niet publiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van den Berg over het bericht dat een huurkorting van 170 euro niet wordt toegestaan in Zeeland

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the Autoriteit woningcorporaties (Aw) may block a one-off rent reduction of 170 euro agreed in a housing merger in Zeeland, and why it approved the merger containing it. The Minister answered that the Woningwet bars corporations from providing such financial means outside listed exceptions, that the Aw had not objected at merger approval but could have earlier, and that structural rent reductions remain possible.
Because this specific point is not part of the assessment of merger proposals, the Autoriteit woningcorporaties gave permission for the merger.
Omdat dit specifieke punt geen onderdeel van beoordeling van fusievoorstellen is, heeft de Autoriteit woningcorporaties toestemming gegeven voor de fusie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Ronnes over de verbreding van de A2 tussen Weert en Eindhoven

Two CDA MPs asked why the government chose not to widen the A2 between Weert and Eindhoven despite daily congestion, and about the rules for paying drivers to avoid peak hours. The minister answered that the MIRT study was taken into account, that peak-avoidance payments would be capped at three months and follow Parliament's conditions, and that the region-led programme chose no-regret measures instead of a widening study because other bottlenecks had greater economic losses.
The Programme Council SmartwayZ.nl therefore weighed not having the state start an exploration for a further package of measures on the A2.
In de Programmaraad SmartwayZ.nl is daarom afgewogen nu geen verkenning door het rijk te laten starten voor een verdergaand maatregelenpakket op de A2.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Helvert over parkeren van vrachtwagens langs rijkswegen

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the shortage of truck parking along motorways, long-term parking misuse, differing rest-time enforcement in neighbouring countries, and a possible Benelux role. The minister said parking capacity is sufficient network-wide but overcrowded on busy corridors, that enforcement of long-term parking is not possible without a legal time limit, and that Dutch policy aims for a Europe-wide level playing field, with the Benelux role limited to intelligent transport systems.
I have no data on how the situation in Belgium and Luxembourg is regarding the long-term parking of vehicles or parts thereof at rest areas along the main road network.
Ik heb geen gegevens over hoe de situatie in België en Luxemburg is ten aanzien van het langdurig stallen van voertuigen of onderdelen daarvan op een verzorgingsplaats langs het hoofdwegennet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Vereniging Eigen Huis wil regeling restschuld behouden’

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the tax-deductible residual mortgage debt scheme (restschuldregeling), expiring end 2017, should be extended, given that many homeowners remain underwater. The government answered that the crisis measure has served its purpose, the housing market has recovered, and it sees no reason to extend the scheme with its associated tax loss.
I therefore see no reason to extend this scheme, which was introduced as a crisis measure, with the additional tax loss that would result.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om deze regeling, die geïntroduceerd is als crisismaatregel, te verlengen met bovendien een fiscale derving als gevolg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over de leidraad vervroegd aflossen hypotheken bij rentemiddeling

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the AFM's guideline on early repayment of mortgages under the MCD applies to rate-averaging (rentemiddeling), and whether the government will clarify this with the AFM and consumers. The minister answered that under current law the early-repayment rules do not apply to rate-averaging, but that he is preparing a regulatory change so that only the actual financial loss may be charged in such cases, with parliament involved via a pre-consultation procedure.
I am therefore preparing an amendment to the regulations so that even with rate-averaging no more than the financial disadvantage may be charged.
Ik ben daarom een wijziging van de regelgeving aan het voorbereiden, zodat ook bij rentemiddeling niet meer dan het financieel nadeel in rekening mag worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Ronnes, Omtzigt, Jetten en Van Weyenberg over het bericht in de Trouw van 4 mei 2017 “Staatsbedrijf NS ontwijkt fiscus weer”

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the government about reports that state-owned NS avoids Dutch tax via an Irish leasing subsidiary, including whether the 2015 agreements were honoured and how much tax is lost. The minister defended the arrangement as consistent with a 'level playing field' for foreign concessions, and refused to give tax figures citing secrecy rules and business confidentiality while promising phase-out of the Irish route on Dutch lines.

A more detailed specification of amounts I cannot give because under article 67 of the AWR I cannot make statements about the taxes of individual taxpayers, as business confidentiality precludes this.

Een nadere specificatie van bedragen kan ik niet geven omdat ik op grond van artikel 67 van de AWR geen uitspraken kan doen over de belastingen van individuele belastingplichtigen omdat bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid zich hiertegen verzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat aardbevingsbestendig bouwen niet hoeft in Groningen

MPs Ronnes and Agnes Mulder asked whether construction firms in Groningen are building non-earthquake-resistant homes, how many, why NPR 9998 was not designated in the Bouwbesluit, and whether NAM compensation could be made mandatory. Minister Kamp answered that professional firms should apply the NPR, that its application is not mandatory, that a solution for NAM covering reasonable extra costs is being explored with a result expected by end 2017, and that the NPR will be designated once clarity exists.
Nor are there exact figures on the numbers.
Ook zijn er geen exacte inzichten in aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over erfpacht in Amsterdam

The MP Ronnes (CDA) asks the ministers whether Amsterdam's municipal erfpacht buy-out offers and its residual land-value method warrant extra protection for homeowners, and what the tax revenue effects are. The minister replies that erfpacht is a private property right governed by the Civil Code with recourse to civil courts and general principles of good governance, that the Wft cannot apply, that the revenue effects cannot yet be estimated, and that no consultation with Amsterdam on revenue effects took place because the matter is municipal.
For municipal erfpacht, the municipality is moreover bound by the general principles of good governance.
Voor gemeentelijke erfpacht geldt bovendien dat de gemeente gebonden is aan de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Helvert over ongevallen op A73

MPs Ronnes and Van Helvert asked whether accidents on the A73 are increasing and what causes them, and whether further research will be done. The minister confirms registered accidents have risen, partly due to better registration, attributes the rise to economic recovery and mobility, and says Rijkswaterstaat will analyse the Cuijk–Boxmeer stretch where accident risk is above average.
Therefore I have asked Rijkswaterstaat to carry out an analysis of this road section in the short term, to establish the causes of the accidents
Daarom heb ik Rijkswaterstaat gevraagd op korte termijn een analyse uit te voeren op dit weggedeelte, om na te gaan wat de oorzaken zijn van de ongevallen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Geurts en Ronnes over schadevergoeding door de kapotte stuw bij Grave

Three CDA MPs asked the minister whether the state bears responsibility, through the lack of a calamity plan and slow repairs, for damages from the broken Grave weir, and whether the damage should be compensated. The minister answered that the damage was caused by the ship collision rather than a government act, so no nadeelcompensatie applies; the investigation is ongoing and the shipowner's liability-limitation request is pending in court.
However, this damage is not the result of a government decision or action, but the direct consequence of the collision.
Deze schade is echter niet het gevolg van een besluit of handeling van de overheid, maar het directe gevolg van de aanvaring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Geurts en Ronnes over de stuw bij Grave

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the damaged weir at Grave, its causes, impacts on inland shipping, residents of houseboats, dikes and other businesses, and why municipalities in Gelderland were informed later than those in Brabant. The minister answered that the cause cannot yet be determined pending a police investigation, described temporary and permanent repair measures, said the damage is not fully quantified, and promised an independent evaluation of the incident expected in spring 2017.
I cannot assess that at present. An independent evaluation will be carried out into the incident with the ship at the Grave weir.
Ik kan dat momenteel niet beoordelen. Er zal een onafhankelijke evaluatie worden uitgevoerd naar het incident met het schip bij de stuw Grave.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Ronnes over de rol die de Raad van Commissarissen van NS gespeeld heeft bij de fraude bij de aanbesteding in Limburg

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about the role of NS's supervisory board in the Limburg tender fraud, including when he learned of it, access to board minutes, discharge granted for 2014 and 2015, and damage claims. The minister answered that he was informed in April 2015 by the supervisory board, denied knowledge of board incitement to crimes, refused to release board and shareholder meeting minutes, and pointed to ongoing court and regulatory proceedings.
It is also not usual for such reports to be shared with the general meeting of shareholders.
Het is ook niet gebruikelijk dat dergelijke verslagen met de algemene vergadering van aandeelhouders worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes, Van der Linde, Albert de Vries en Dijkgraaf over het bericht dat er chaos dreigt door nieuwe zienswijze van de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM)

Four MPs asked the Minister for Housing and Government Service, on behalf of the Finance Minister, about the AFM's new view that mortgages must be tested against the lending norms in force when the binding offer is issued rather than at application, which could cause chaos for applicants. The Minister answered that a transition period until 1 February 2017 was agreed with the sector and the WEW for applications filed before 2017, that the AFM will take this into account in supervision, and that the timing of tests is a matter of clarifying the MCD-based rules.
For mortgage applications submitted before 1 January 2017 where the creditworthiness test for the binding offer takes place by 1 February 2017 at the latest, the 2016 lending norms may be applied.

Voor hypotheekaanvragen die zijn ingediend voor 1 januari 2017 waarbij de kredietwaardigheidstoets ten behoeve van het bindend aanbod uiterlijk 1 februari 2017 plaatsvindt, er met de leennormen van 2016 mag worden gerekend.
Antwoord op van de leden Ronnes en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Inkomen niet in Euro’s? Dan geen hypotheek!’

MPs Ronnes and Koolmees asked the Finance Minister whether borrowers with foreign-currency income can no longer get mortgages, and whether an investigation will follow. The minister confirmed signals from the sector, pointed to the EU Mortgage Credit Directive's currency-risk rules, and saw no reason for further investigation since ABN AMRO resumed such lending, though he will raise the issue with the European Commission.
Given the consultation held with the sector and the fact that ABN AMRO again offers mortgage credit in foreign currency, I currently see no reason for further investigation.
Gezien het overleg dat is gevoerd met de sector en het gegeven dat ABN AMRO weer hypothecaire kredieten in vreemde valuta aanbiedt, zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding voor verder onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over verborgen kosten bij autoverzekeringen, naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Autoverzekering wordt duurder’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether hidden fees such as policy, cancellation, change and prolongation charges on car insurance, and the difficulty this creates in comparing policies, should be ended through agreements with insurers. The minister answered that disclosure rules under the Wft already require all costs to be stated clearly and not hidden, that the AFM supervises this, and that additional agreements with insurers are not necessary.
I do not consider additional agreements with insurers necessary. The AFM supervises compliance with information obligations.
Aanvullende afspraken met verzekeraars acht ik niet nodig. De AFM houdt toezicht op informatieverplichtingen.
