Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes, Rog en Van Helvert over de huisvesting van studenten in hotels

MPs from the CDA asked the minister whether The Student Hotel's rentals to students, often longer than six months, breach tenancy protection, whether the rents are acceptable, and whether such hotel rooms count toward student housing goals. The minister replied that the short-stay exception may apply, that tenants must go to the rent commission or court themselves, that the Rijk has no enforcement role, and that municipalities decide on hotel-based housing.
The central government has no enforcement role on this point.
Het Rijk heeft op dit punt geen handhavende taak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Nijboer over het bericht ‘België verbiedt cfd's en binaire opties voor particulieren’

MPs Ronnes and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether Belgium's ban on marketing CFDs and binary options to consumers applies to EU-passported firms, how many complaints the Netherlands has received, and whether the Netherlands will follow suit. The minister confirmed the Belgian rule covers cross-border firms, reported about 50 complaints since 2014, and committed to work with the AFM on a comparable advertising ban for the Netherlands ahead of MiFID II.
I consider it appropriate to introduce in the Netherlands a ban comparable to the Belgian or French situation.
Ik acht het opportuun om een met de Belgische of Franse situatie vergelijkbaar verbod ook in Nederland te introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over het mogelijk maken om een hypotheek met hoge rente stapsgewijs en boetevrij om te zetten in een hypotheek met een lager rentepercentage

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked whether existing mortgage holders could convert high-rate mortgages stepwise and penalty-free to lower rates, and whether banks may still charge early-repayment fees under the new EU Mortgage Credit Directive. The minister explained that fees must now reflect actual losses for new mortgages, that the AFM is still investigating compliance for existing contracts, and that no standardised stepwise conversion guide will be published.
There is currently no overview available showing how the various mortgage lenders in the Netherlands calculate the early repayment compensation.
Er is op dit moment geen overzicht voorhanden waarin wordt weergegeven op welke wijze de verschillende hypotheekverstrekkers in Nederland de vergoeding bij vervroegde aflossing berekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over het bericht "Binnenlandse zaken paait grote gemeenten"

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes (CDA) asked the Minister of the Interior why he adopted a 33% redistribution step in the municipal fund subcluster VHROSV despite advice from the Rfv and VNG favouring full implementation, and whether he would reconsider or monitor actual costs. The Minister defended the decision as consistent with the VNG's May advice, citing open ends in the research, and said the fundamental review of the municipal fund is underway with cost monitoring feeding into it.

With this decision, which follows the VNG advice from May of this year, I have weighed the research results differently than the Rfv and the motion adopted by a narrow majority at the VNG general members meeting.

Ik ben met dit besluit, dat aansluit bij het VNG advies uit mei van dit jaar, tot een andere weging gekomen van de resultaten van het onderzoek dan de Rfv en de met een nipte meerderheid aangenomen motie op de Algemene ledenvergadering van de VNG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Ronnes en Fokke over de verhuizing van het Financieel Service Centrum Defensie van Limburg naar Utrecht

MPs Knops, Ronnes and Fokke asked the Defence Minister why the Financieel Service Centrum (FSC) in Eygelshoven is being moved to Utrecht despite earlier promises to keep work in Limburg, and how this fits with union and works-council opposition, job losses in Limburg, and the motion on fair treatment of peripheral provinces. The Minister answered that a 2015 evaluation showed the split was not natural, that US forces returning to Eygelshoven make the site unsuitable for offices, and that the decision is based primarily on operational grounds with the works council involved in implementation.
These developments were decisive in revising the earlier decision.
Deze ontwikkelingen zijn doorslaggevend geweest om het eerder genomen besluit te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over het bericht in De Telegraaf van 6 april 2016 ‘Platteland eist groter deel rijksuitkering’

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked about a Telegraaf report that rural municipalities demand a larger share of the state fund, and about AEF's recommendation to redistribute EUR 88 million toward smaller municipalities. Minister Plasterk answered that the fund managers adopted only one third of the new formula for 2016, that full implementation would shift funds toward rural municipalities, and that a decision will follow after consulting the Rfv and VNG without giving a firm date.
In deciding how the fund managers handle the study's results, the advice received from the Rfv and VNG will be taken into account.
Bij de besluitvorming over hoe de fondsbeheerders met de resultaten van het onderzoek omgaan worden de ontvangen adviezen van de Rfv en VNG betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over de opvang van statushouders in het voormalige Missiehuis in Driehuis

An MP asked the Minister for Housing and Government Property why the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf demands full costs, maintenance and taxes for the former Missiehuis in Driehuis that Velsen wants to use for refugee housing. The minister answers that the building is offered at cost-covering rent, that gemeenten can use the national subsidy scheme for local arrangements, and that the Rijk makes neither profit nor loss, leaving the decision to Velsen.
The Rijk rents to a municipality at a cost-covering price.
Het Rijk verhuurt tegen een kostendekkende prijs aan een gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Keijzer over verdringing op de woningmarkt door statushouders

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister for Housing about reports that statushouders (refugees with status) take up a third of freed-up social homes, displacing others, and about whether gemeenten can meet their housing quotas. The minister said the Companen figures come from a survey not a study, stressed local tailoring, pointed to existing subsidy and agreement instruments, and promised follow-up on the motion De Vries.
I am of the view that housing policy is best implemented at local level, with as little as possible imposed from above.
Ik ben van mening dat het woningmarktbeleid het best op lokaal niveau kan worden ingevuld waarbij zo min mogelijk van bovenaf moet worden opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Rog over de het bericht dat Amsterdamse studenten te veel huur betalen

MPs Ronnes and Rog asked the minister whether it is true that 88 percent of Amsterdam students pay rent above the statutory point system limit, and what action will be taken. The minister answered that the figure refers to 265 students who checked their rent online, not all Amsterdam students, that tenants can appeal to the rent commission, and that affordability is on the Landelijk Platform Studentenhuisvesting agenda.
Contrary to what the headline of this report suggests, my conclusion is not that nearly 88 percent of Amsterdam students pay more rent than the statutory point system allows.

Anders dan de kop van dit bericht weergeeft is mijn conclusie niet dat bijna 88 procent van de Amsterdamse studenten een hogere huur betaalt dan volgens het wettelijk puntensysteem voor huurprijzen is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over de toename van het tekort aan seniorenwoningen

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about a reported growing shortage of senior housing, the Ipso Facto/ANBO study, why small municipalities already face shortages, and whether the government will help municipalities gather data and include senior housing in performance agreements. The Minister acknowledged the report, argued senior housing is primarily a local matter, questioned a shortage, and said the government will consult the VNG and produce a practical guide for municipalities.
It is up to municipalities to decide how they fill in their housing vision and the performance agreements based on it.
Het is aan gemeenten om te bepalen hoe zij hun woonvisie, en daarop gebaseerde prestatieafspraken in willen vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht ‘Rood staan blijft duur, ondanks lage rente’

An MP from the CDA asks the Finance Minister why overdraft interest rates remain high despite low market rates, whether the legal 15% cap is fair, and whether banks should be pressed to change overdraft pricing. The minister explains the cap is tied to the statutory interest rate plus 12 points (now 14%), attributes stickiness to fixed risk and admin costs, notes the ACM found intervention could backfire, and declines new talks with banks while promising to keep urging clearer information and cheaper alternatives.
I will again bring this to the attention of banks in my discussions with them.
Dit zal ik in mijn gesprekken met banken nogmaals onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het energielabel

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Housing about the Energy Agreement target of label B for rental homes by 2020, the progress of the 400 million euro STEP subsidy, and whether corporations should be pre-financed. The minister answered that corporations are primarily accountable for the target, that subsidy is paid after renovation and pre-financing is their own responsibility, and that STEP may be made more attractive in spring 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het energielabel

An MP asks the minister about reports that the European Commission has not yet accepted the Dutch energy label methodology, including remote assessment concerns and the content of the Commission's questions. The minister replies that the transposition is complete, that the current stage is an informal EU pilot with no fine threatened, and that the Commission's questions are answered, but declines to release the correspondence in full.
I cannot provide the European Commission's questions to your House without conditions.
De vragen van de Europese Commissie kan ik niet ongeclausuleerd aan uw Kamer verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Toorenburg over binaire opties

MPs Ronnes and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked whether binary options should be treated as games of chance rather than financial products, given their prize-like payout, the broker's opposite interest, and possible refusal of successful traders. The Minister of Finance replied that binary options are classed as financial instruments under MiFID and the AFM supervises them, that a court case on the gambling question is pending, and that no new measures are planned for now.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Keijzer over de opvang van statushouders

CDA MPs Ronnes and Keijzer asked the Minister for Housing about Brabant municipalities lacking housing for refugees, rising social-housing waiting times, whether municipalities can meet their 2016 placement quotas, and the status of alternative housing under the Bestuursakkoord. Minister Blok answered that waiting-time effects cannot be precisely isolated, that municipalities should be able to meet quotas, and that 325 subsidy applications for about 1,647 places were under review.
I committed to your House on 26 November 2015 to have a study carried out into waiting times for social rental housing.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 26 november 2015 toegezegd een onderzoek te laten uitvoeren naar de wachttijden voor sociale huurwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over de rapporten van de Auditdienst Rijk

Two MPs (Ronnes and Omtzigt, CDA) asked the Finance, Justice and Security, and Defence ministers about the Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) audit reports, including a list of 2015 reports, when each was sent to parliament, and the status of six announced audits. The government answered that it sent most reports promptly, gave dates for each, said some audits are unfinished or were commissioned by other ministers, and committed to publishing the reports on the ministries' websites.
The study referred to under b is being carried out on the instructions of the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and has not yet been completed.
Het onderzoek bedoeld onder b wordt uitgevoerd in opdracht van de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Vliet over hoge vertrekbonussen bij een woningcorporatie

MPs Ronnes and Van Vliet asked the minister about exceptionally high exit payments to supervisory board members at housing corporation Weller, and whether the WNT transitional rules were properly applied. The minister answered that the payments were legal under the pre-WNT reglement and the transitional regime, that he finds them socially insensitive, and that no WNT violation was found so no clawback is planned.
Er is derhalve conform de regelgeving gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Ronnes over het bericht dat Eritrese vluchtelingen in Boxtel tijdelijk naar het azc in Oisterwijk moeten verhuizen

MPs Keijzer and Ronnes asked whether about thirty Eritrean teenage girls in Boxtel must move to the Oisterwijk reception centre, a distance of about 13-14 km, and why that move is needed when they are already in a safe environment. The State Secretary confirms the move is due to closing the Boxtel crisis emergency shelter under the new agreement between national and municipal government, that safety plays no role, and that the centre has specialised staff for unaccompanied minors.
The agreement between national government and municipalities in the recently concluded administrative agreement is that the CNO is to be phased out as quickly as possible.
De afspraak tussen Rijk en gemeenten in het recent gesloten bestuursakkoord is dat de CNO zo snel als mogelijk wordt afgebouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Oskam over binaire opties

MPs Ronnes and Oskam (CDA) asked the Finance and Justice ministers about binary options, whether they should fall under gambling law rather than securities supervision, and the status of the AFM court case and warnings. The government answered that binary options are financial instruments under MiFID and the Wft, that the AFM's appeal is pending before the CBb, that the AFM has warned investors but imposed no sanctions, and that it will push for harmonised cross-border supervision.
Due to supervisory confidentiality, the AFM cannot address whether investigations into specific parties are ongoing or whether it intends to impose measures on such a party.

Vanwege toezichtvertrouwelijkheid kan de AFM niet ingaan op de vraag of er nog onderzoeken naar specifieke partijen lopen of dat er een voornemen is tot het opleggen van maatregelen aan een dergelijke partij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht ‘Consument weet niet dat hypotheek tussentijds omlaag kan’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Housing whether homeowners are informed that they can lower their mortgage rate once loan-to-value falls, and whether banks should be pushed to inform them proactively. The minister answered that he will consult mortgage lenders on informing consumers and report back in spring 2016, without giving a substantive explanation yet.
I will inform you about this in spring 2016.
Ik zal u hierover in het voorjaar van 2016 informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir, Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Koolmees, Ronnes en Van der Linde over aankoop van Dekemahiem door Vereniging Doarpskorporaasje Jirnsum

MPs asked the minister whether housing corporation Elkien's plan to demolish 24 affordable homes for elderly and starters in Jirnsum without rebuilding, and the sale to a village cooperative, required an Inspectorate review and a residual valuation, and why the process took so long. The minister answered that local housing policy is for the municipality, that sales to third parties need the regulator's consent at no less than market value, that the residual valuation request was refused, that the earlier rules applied, and that the 12-week decision period was not exceeded.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Merkies naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Vivat verzekeringen krijgt mogelijk junkstatus’

MPs Ronnes and Merkies asked the Finance Minister about credit rating agency S&P suspending Vivat's rating after its takeover by Anbang, including effects on solvency, DNB's access to information, the Dutch management's influence, and continuity. The minister answered that the rating suspension does not directly affect solvency, that DNB granted the takeover approval with full information, that governance is a matter for the company and shareholder, and that the EUR 1.35 billion capital injection secures stability.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes c.s. over de inhoud van de prospectus voor beursgang ABN AMRO

MPs from several parties asked the Finance Minister whether the ABN AMRO prospectus for its stock market listing shows share-linked bonuses that conflict with earlier assurances and the Merkies/Nijboer amendment, and about conflicts of interest of two board members. The minister answered that identified staff may receive variable pay in non-cash form, that the top 7 board members and 25 senior managers are barred from variable pay while the state holds a stake, that the amendment is complied with, and that the bonus decisions rest with ABN AMRO itself.
ABN AMRO as a company itself bears responsibility for drawing up a variable pay scheme within the legal framework.
ABN AMRO heeft als vennootschap zelf de verantwoordelijkheid om binnen het wettelijke kader een variabele beloningsregeling op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over woekerpolissen

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about the 2011 'best of class' commitment on follow-up policy for woekerpolissen, Kifid ombudsman appointment, loss estimates, TER cost disclosure, a 2014 bonus at Nationale Nederlanden, and insurers' out-of-court settlements. The minister answered that the AFM monitors activation of policyholders, that Parliament will be consulted on the ombudsman appointment, that total damages cannot be determined, that TER rules apply, and that the AFM will report on settlements at end October.
I will consult the House of Representatives beforehand.
Ik zal hieraan voorafgaand de Tweede Kamer raadplegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over het plotselinge vertrek van de CEO van Vivat na de overname door Anbang

Christian Democrat MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about the sudden departure of VIVAT's CEO after the Anbang takeover, including DNB's conditions, debt repayment, capital injection, and shareholder obligations. The minister gave a largely evasive reply, citing supervisory confidentiality, while confirming Anbang's tax payment and committing only to continued contact and a new chair vetted by DNB.
Information about the content of a declaration of no objection is confidential supervisory information and therefore not public.
Informatie over de inhoud van een verklaring van geen bezwaar is toezichtvertrouwelijk en daarmee niet publiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Oskam over het bericht dat woningen onbereikbaar worden

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers whether housing is becoming unreachable due to the rise in asylum residence permits, and what the government is doing about it. The minister answered with figures on the housing quota for permit holders, mentioned the Ministerial Commission on Migration and local tools, but gave few concrete commitments.
I further expect that the measures proposed by the Ministerial Commission will offer further additions in this regard.
Ik verwacht daarnaast dat de maatregelen die door de Ministeriële Commissie voorgesteld worden daarop nog aanvullingen zullen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht "Toezichthouder houdt zich niet aan salarisnorm"

The MP Ronnes (CDA) asked the Minister of Finance why a newly appointed AFM supervisor was given a salary above the WNT (Balkenende) norm, whether this was justified, and whether such deviations will be avoided in future. The minister answered that the WNT allows individual exceptions and that the unique combination of knowledge, experience and labour market conditions justified one here, referring to the Staatscourant publication, while stating that the aim is to stay within the norms.
In this specific case, the unique combination of knowledge, experience and the labour market situation was reason to make an exception.
In dit specifieke geval, vormde de unieke combinatie van kennis, ervaring en de arbeidmarktsituatie reden om een uitzondering te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over verzilverd wonen

Ronnes (CDA) asked the Minister for Housing about the government's role in regulating home-equity release products sold to older homeowners, and whether the financial supervisory scope covers them. The minister explained that mortgage-type equity release falls under AFM supervision with a planned information-duty expansion, while sale-and-leaseback is governed by the Civil Code and ACM oversight, and committed to consultation with the sector.
The cabinet intends to apply the provisions in the so-called mortgage directive for regular mortgages also to equity-release mortgages.
Het kabinet is voornemens om de in de in de zogenoemde hypothekenrichtlijn 3 opgenomen voorschriften voor reguliere hypotheken ook toe te passen op opeethypotheken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt naar aanleiding van het bericht “Verdere selectie van zakenbanken voor de voorgenomen beursintroductie van ABN AMRO”

MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about the selection of underwriting banks for the planned ABN AMRO IPO, including fees, other remuneration, share allocation and whether banks can earn money from the deal. The minister answered that NLFI runs the selection, that a base fee is zero with capped expenses and a discretionary fee up to 4.5 million euro, and that share allocation follows set criteria with safeguards against improper practices.
The contract terms I will make available for confidential inspection.
De contractvoorwaarden zal ik vertrouwelijk ter inzage beschikbaar stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over de verkoop van Vivat (Reaal) aan Anbang

MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister why DNB blocked Anbang's takeover of Nationale Nederlanden, whether approvals elsewhere were delayed, how DNB views Anbang's European acquisitions, and how pension and customer data are protected after the Vivat sale. The minister declined to disclose DNB's assessment citing supervisory confidentiality, said Vivat Verzekeringen's sale was completed with DNB's no-objection statements, and pointed to existing supervision by DNB, AFM and CBP.
Information about the assessment of an application for a no-objection statement, if one had been submitted in that case, is supervisory-confidential.
Informatie over de beoordeling van een aanvraag van een verklaring van geen bezwaar, zo die in het genoemde geval zou zijn ingediend, is toezichtvertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes naar aanleiding van publicatie over vermeende overtreding van regels rondom de beursgang van ABN Amro

MP Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about reports that a NLFI employee involved in the ABN Amro listing dined with a JP Morgan executive, whether rules were broken, what action was taken, and whether Dutch banks were passed over as global coordinators. The minister confirmed NLFI's chair accepted a dinner invitation during the selection process, saw no breach of law or listing rules, reviewed the matter with an explanation from the chair, and defended a non-discriminatory, quality-based bank selection that does not require restarting.
Following the publication, Mr Enthoven was asked to provide an explanation of the matters described in the publication.
Naar aanleiding van de publicatie is de heer Enthoven gevraagd om een toelichting te geven op de in de publicatie omschreven zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Ronnes over het bericht dat bij de A4 bij Steenbergen geluidsschermen staan bij onbewoonde en gesloopte huizen

MPs Van Helvert and Ronnes asked why noise barriers were built along the A4 at Steenbergen next to homes that were bought and demolished, and whether this wasteful situation can be prevented, and whether residents without barriers will get relief. The minister explained the barriers serve as noise protection for remaining homes and the building plots, that all measures follow the Tracébesluit and noise law, and that no money is wasted.
All barriers along the route have a function in dampening noise.
Alle schermen langs het tracé hebben een functie in het dempen van geluid.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Boutkan ter vervanging van nr. 8 over het voor het toekennen van subsidie van bedrijven vereisen van een plan voor het bereiken van klimaatneutraliteit
Requires that a minister may only enable subsidies to companies if the company has a climate plan for becoming climate-neutral, with an exemption for small and medium firms.
The Minister may only judge that a measure providing funds to companies can be facilitated if a condition is that the company has a climate plan
Onze Minister kan slechts oordelen dat een maatregel waarbij financiële middelen aan bedrijven beschikbaar worden gesteld, kan worden gefaciliteerd, indien bij deze maatregel als voorwaarde
Amendement van de leden Boutkan en Dassen ter vervanging van nr. 15 over het verschaffen van inzicht in de communicatie die heeft plaatsgevonden met bedrijven en non-gouvernementele organisaties
Amendment requiring the climate fund multi-year programme to be accompanied by an overview of communications with companies and NGOs and the interests raised.
The multi-year programme is accompanied by an overview of the communication that took place with companies and non-governmental organisations
Het meerjarenprogramma gaat vergezeld van een overzicht van de communicatie die heeft plaatsgevonden met bedrijven en non-gouvernementele organisaties

Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Boutkan en Dassen ter vervanging van nr. 20 over het voor het toekennen van subsidie van bedrijven vereisen van een plan voor het bereiken van klimaatneutralite
Requires companies receiving subsidies to hold a climate plan for climate-neutral operations, with an exemption for small and medium enterprises.
The minister may only judge that a measure providing funds to companies can be facilitated if the condition for obtaining the funds is that the company has a climate plan.

Onze Minister kan slechts oordelen dat een maatregel waarbij financiële middelen aan bedrijven beschikbaar worden gesteld, kan worden gefaciliteerd, indien bij deze maatregel als voorwaarde voor de verkrijging van de middelen aan het bedrijf wordt gesteld dat het beschikt over een klimaatplan
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Boutkan ter vervanging van nr. 16 over het voor het toekennen van subsidie van bedrijven vereisen van een plan voor het bereiken van klimaatneutraliteit
Allows the Minister to support subsidies to companies only if recipients hold a climate plan for climate-neutral operations, with an exemption for small and medium enterprises.
The Minister may only judge that a measure providing funds to companies can be facilitated if the measure requires a climate plan.
Onze Minister kan slechts oordelen dat een maatregel waarbij financiële middelen aan bedrijven beschikbaar worden gesteld, kan worden gefaciliteerd, indien bij deze maatregel
Amendement van het lid Boutkan over het verschaffen van inzicht in de communicatie die heeft plaatsgevonden met bedrijven en non-gouvernementele organisaties
Requires the climate fund multi-year programme to be accompanied by an overview of communications with companies and NGOs and the interests raised, so the minister's contacts are visible.
This amendment ensures that when the Minister allocates climate fund money it is clear which communication took place and with which actors.
Dit amendement regelt dat bij de toekenning van gelden uit het Klimaatfonds door de Minister duidelijk is welke communicatie heeft plaats gevonden en met welke actoren.
Amendement van het lid Boutkan over het expliciet verplichten van maatwerkafspraken voor het bedrijfsleven
Makes binding tailor-made agreements with industry, including a decarbonisation pathway, an explicit condition for climate fund subsidies.
measures in business, if there are binding tailor-made agreements, consisting of a plan to become climate neutral
maatregelen in het bedrijfsleven, indien er bindende maatwerkafspraken zijn, bestaande uit een plan om klimaatneutraal te gaan produceren
Motie van het lid Kröger c.s. over toekomstige meevallers van het prijsplafond besteden aan de klimaat- en energietransitie
Motion asks that any future windfall from the electricity price cap be spent on the climate and energy transition.
requests the government to ensure that funds released by a future windfall of the price cap are spent on the climate and energy transition
verzoekt de regering ervoor zorg te dragen dat middelen die vrijkomen bij een toekomstige meevaller van het prijsplafond worden besteed aan de klimaat- en energietransitie
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over de begroting van het transitiefonds zo indelen dat maximaal recht wordt gedaan aan het budgetrecht van de Kamer
Asks the government to reconsider the budget structure of the Transitiefonds so that it is organised by policy objectives, giving the Chamber fuller budgetary control.
requests the government to take another thorough look at the planned budget structure of the transition fund
verzoekt de regering de voorgenomen indeling van de begroting van het transitiefonds nog eens grondig tegen het licht te houden
Amendement van het de leden Ouwehand en Boutkan ter vervanging van nr. 11 over de doelen voor dierenwelzijn en volksgezondheid
Adds animal welfare and public health risks from livestock farming as goals of the Transitiefonds for rural areas and nature, alongside existing goals.
By also including animal welfare and public health goals in the Transitiefonds for rural area and nature
Door ook de doelen voor dierenwelzijn en de volksgezondheid in het Transitiefonds landelijk gebied en natuur op te nemen
Amendement van de leden Ouwehand en Boutkan ter vervanging van nr. 15 over het alleen financieren van maatregelen ten aanzien van de stikstofnorm van 74% in 2030
Requires the nitrogen deposition target of 74% of Natura 2000 habitat to be reached by 2030 and deletes article 12 of the bill.
the environmental target of 74% will have to be reached by 2030 at the latest
zal de omgevingswaarde van 74% uiterlijk in 2030 bereikt moeten zijn
Amendement van het lid Bromet c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 19 over het bereiken van het doel van 74% voor de kritische depositiewaarde in 2030

Moves the nitrogen deposition target in the Omgevingswet and Wet natuurbescherming from 2035 to 2030 and lets the entry-into-force date be set by royal decree, which is mainly an environmental timing change.
This law must be amended because it has been agreed that those targets must be achieved by 2030.
Deze wet moet aangepast worden omdat is afgesproken dat die doelen per 2030 bereikt moeten gaan worden.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boutkan over de berichten 'Chemiereus 3M schikt pfas-rechtszaken in VS voor 10 miljard dollar' en 'Chemiebedrijf DuPont kende risico’s van PFAS al decennia en zweeg'

An MP (Boutkan) asked the minister about reports that DuPont/Chemours knew of PFAS health risks for decades and withheld information, and about the 3M settlement in US PFAS lawsuits, including causality, monitoring and cost estimates. The government said permit authorities judge whether all relevant data were submitted, that the public prosecutor is considering reopening a criminal probe, and gave largely general answers on science, cost estimates and monitoring.
It is up to the competent authority to assess whether all relevant data were provided with the permit application and, if not, whether there is reason to revoke or amend the permit.

Het is aan het bevoegd gezag om te beoordelen of bij de vergunningaanvraag alle relevante gegevens zijn verstrekt en of er, als dat niet het geval is, er reden is om de vergunning in te trekken of te wijzingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boutkan over het bericht Regeringstoestel PH-GOV voor het eerst op Groningen Airport Eelde

MP Boutkan asked the government why a 19-minute domestic flight without passengers was used to collect the King from Groningen Airport for a trip to Madrid, and why the King did not travel by train or car, and whether this is justifiable amid climate change and poverty. The government answered that the flight carried a delegation, that the choice was the most suitable after weighing efficiency, safety, cost, sustainability and availability, and that the flight request form was recently revised.
The flight was therefore not operated without passengers and was the most suitable choice for transport to Spain.
De vlucht is derhalve niet zonder passagiers afgelegd en was de meest geschikte keuze voor het vervoer naar Spanje.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boutkan en Inge van Dijk over de ongelijke fiscale behandeling grenswerkers

MPs Boutkan and Inge van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about unequal tax treatment of cross-border workers who work from home, and about negotiations with Germany and Belgium and a possible temporary arrangement like the COVID-era one. The government says it will pursue a bilateral home-working measure with Germany and Belgium, form an EU-level taskforce, and rejects a temporary COVID-style agreement as unsuitable for a permanent solution.
The Netherlands wants to include a home-working measure aimed at cross-border workers in the bilateral tax treaties with Germany and Belgium.
Nederland wil in de bilaterale belastingverdragen met Duitsland en België een thuiswerkmaatregel gericht op grenswerkers opnemen
Uitstel beantwoording vragen van de leden Boutkan en Dassen over het bericht 'Nederland laat miljoenen liggen om de wolf te weren'

Two Volt MPs asked the Minister of Finance about a newspaper report that the Netherlands leaves EU funds unused for wolf protection, including whether LIFE funds are used, and requested a detailed overview of EU funds, their uses, Dutch claims and communication. The government replied only that the answers cannot be provided within the usual deadline due to interdepartmental coordination and will follow as soon as possible.
cannot be answered within the usual period as a result of interdepartmental coordination
kunnen als gevolg van interdepartementale afstemming niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boutkan over de samenwerking tussen Japan en Zuid-Korea als reactie op de Amerikaanse CHIPS-Act

An MP asked the minister about a Business Korea report quoting Rapidus official Yasumitsu Orii on US chip regulation and Korea-Japan cooperation, and how Japan's export controls on chip technology to China relate to Dutch measures. The minister declined to comment on the Korean article, refused to detail confidential talks with partners, said Japan makes its own export-control decisions, and rejected withdrawing Dutch export measures.
As also reported in the answer of 8 November 2022 to VOLT's parliamentary questions, I cannot go into details about discussions on this subject with partner countries.
Zoals ook gemeld in het antwoord van 8 november 2022 op Kamervragen van VOLT, kan ik niet in details treden over gesprekken over dit onderwerp met partnerlanden.

m: Motie van het lid Van Haasen over bij gedifferentieerde vliegbelasting geen verhoging toepassen op vluchten naar en van Caribisch Nederland
Asks the government not to apply the proposed differentiated flight tax increase to flights to and from the Caribbean Netherlands.
requests the government not to apply an increase under the differentiated flight tax to flights to and from the Caribbean part of the Kingdom
verzoekt de regering om bij de uitwerking van de gedifferentieerde vliegbelasting geen verhoging toe te passen op vluchten naar en van het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk
Motie van het lid Van Haasen over de wet WTU-BES zo aanpassen dat Europees-Nederlanders zonder tijdsbeperking kunnen verblijven op Bonaire, Sint-Eustatius en Saba
Motion asks the government to amend the WTU-BES so European Dutch can stay on the Caribbean islands without time limit.
so that European Dutch can stay on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba without time limit
zodanig aan te passen dat Europees-Nederlanders zonder tijdsbeperking kunnen verblijven op Bonaire, Sint-Eustatius en Saba
Amendement van het lid Van Haasen over het schrappen van de voorziening voor onafhankelijke bijstand bij discriminatie op de BES
Deletes the article establishing a walk-in facility for reporting discrimination on the BES islands, arguing it is disproportionate given small populations and limited capacity.
Motie van de leden Van Haasen en Deen over onderzoeken welke uitvoeringsmogelijkheden en kosten reëel zijn
Asks the cabinet to investigate which implementation options and costs are realistic for the disability and chronic illness equal treatment law in the Caribbean Netherlands and inform the House.
requests the cabinet to investigate which implementation options and costs are realistic and to inform the House about them
verzoekt het kabinet te onderzoeken welke uitvoeringsmogelijkheden en kosten reëel zijn, en hierover de Kamer te informeren
Motie van het lid Van Haasen over geen verhoging van de vrije uitkering doorvoeren voor Bonaire
Asks the cabinet not to implement an increase of the free grant (vrije uitkering) for Bonaire in 2024, citing the island council's budget rise and surpluses.
requests the cabinet not to implement an increase of the free grant in 2024
verzoekt het kabinet geen verhoging van de vrije uitkering in 2024 door te voeren
Motie van het lid Michon-Derkzen c.s. over onderzoeken wat het effect is van de verhoging van het minimumloon op kleine, lokale mkb-ondernemers en op het vestigingsklimaat op de BES
Asks the government to study the effects of the minimum wage increase on small local businesses and on the business climate in the BES islands, and to report to the Chamber after the summer.
requests the government to investigate the effect of the minimum wage increase on small local SMEs
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken wat het effect is van de verhoging van het minimumloon op kleine, lokale mkb-ondernemers
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haasen zijn over het loslaten van de Rijkswet Aruba financieel toezicht

An MP asked why the Aruba financial supervision Rijkswet was dropped in favour of a consensus Rijkswet, what conditions apply, and whether a 1.8 percent interest reduction for Aruba should be reversed. The state secretary answered that the bill was withdrawn after Aruba withdrew support, that a consensus Rijkswet is an agreed arrangement on autonomous matters, and that the agreement and interest reduction stem from the 2024 Bestuurlijk Akkoord, so no reversal is planned.
I do not recognise the picture of a relaxed procedure.
Ik herken het beeld van een versoepeld traject niet.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Haasen over de politieke instabiliteit en corruptie in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about political instability and corruption in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, and whether the Dutch government should monitor integrity there as Transparency International does. The State Secretary acknowledged the events, said monitoring is an autonomous matter of the countries but that she values cooperation, and announced talks with Transparency International and the countries on linking them to existing integrity indices.
I am currently in talks with Transparency International and am exploring the possibilities.
Ik ben momenteel in gesprek met Transparency International en verken de mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haasen over de procedure voor de benoeming van een nieuwe gezaghebber voor Sint Eustatius en het resulterende aanwijzen van de huidige regeringscommissaris

An MP asks why the State Secretary appointed a new governor for Sint Eustatius against the unanimous advice of the island council's selection committee, and whether local sentiment and future cooperation were considered. The State Secretary says the appointment procedure is confidential so the committee's advice cannot be disclosed, and states full confidence in the appointee and in constructive cooperation with the island government.
The procedure for the appointment of a governor is confidential.
De procedure voor de benoeming van een gezaghebber is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de  antwoorden op eerdere vragen over het geweld in Chora in juni 2007

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about earlier answers on the 2007 fighting in Chora, Uruzgan, including artillery accuracy, civilian casualties, self-defence claims and the Dutch role. The Minister of Defence defended the troops' conduct, gave partial answers, withheld details citing ongoing legal proceedings and referred several questions to earlier answers or to NATO, Australia and other bodies.
On details that are still under discussion or assessment by the court in the legal case, no statements are made in the interest of the legal proceedings.
Over details die in de rechtszaak nog onderwerp zijn van discussie of van beoordeling door de rechter, worden in het belang van de rechtsgang geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Fritsma en Markuszower over ‘een jaar stilte rond de inspectie van een koopvaardijschip door marineschip de Zr. Ms. De Ruyter’

PVV MPs asked why, a year after a Dutch navy ship inspected a merchant vessel for possible sanctions violations, the government still withholds the ship's name, flag and inspection location, and how long the prosecution will take. The Minister of Justice declined to give details of the individual criminal investigation, then said the case was closed without any sanctions violation found and that neither the EU nor the UN was involved.
As is known, I do not provide information of this kind from individual criminal investigations.
Over dergelijke informatie uit individuele strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doe ik zoals bekend geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het beleid ten aanzien van families van Afghaans-Nederlandse medewerkers

The MP asks whether the cabinet disagreed on applying the IND core-family rule to evacuate relatives of Afghan staff, whether the narrow definition should be widened for dependants, and how arbitrariness is prevented. The ministers answer that the cabinet jointly decided to apply the interpreter family rules to local embassy staff, that 47 dependent family members were admitted case by case as maatwerk rather than a policy change, and that the questions were answered as soon as possible.
This does not concern a policy change, but case-by-case tailoring applied to keep the entire staff working on the evacuation for as long as possible.
Dit betreft geen beleidswijziging, maar maatwerk dat is toegepast om zo lang als mogelijk met de gehele staf te kunnen doorgaan met (het voorbereiden van) de evacuatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Van der Lee en Ellemeet over de voortgang van evacuaties uit Afghanistan

MPs Bromet, Van der Lee and Ellemeet asked the government how people covered by the Belhaj motion can still contact the Dutch state after the evacuation mailbox closed, what further evacuation efforts are planned, and how the Taliban treat those groups. The government answered that it continues limited evacuations, a special scheme for two groups is planned, about 20,000 unique emails were received, and it cannot yet confirm the Taliban's conduct clearly.
It is difficult to obtain a clear picture of the situation in Afghanistan and the conduct of the Taliban.
Het is moeilijk een eenduidig beeld te krijgen van de situatie in Afghanistan en het handelen van de Taliban.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij luchtaanvallen in Afghanistan

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Defence Minister whether the Netherlands was involved in airstrikes in Afghanistan via drone intelligence, and asked about casualties, civilian harm, and parliamentary notification. The Minister answered that the drone article concerned Iraq and Inherent Resolve, that Dutch PED capacity also supported Resolute Support in Afghanistan from 2019 (already notified to parliament), and that this capacity has now ended.
However, this deployment did not concern Afghanistan and was likewise not carried out by the Netherlands.
Deze inzet betrof echter niet Afghanistan en werd evenmin uitgevoerd door Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de aanbestedingsprocedure van de 515 terreinwagens voor de luchtmobiele brigade bij Mercedes-Benz in het programma Defensiebrede Vervanging Operationele Wielvoertuigen (DVOW)

MP Belhaj asked the Defence Minister about the procurement of 515 all-terrain vehicles for the air assault brigade, won by Mercedes-Benz, including user involvement, the selection process, ministry cooperation, delivery delays and DMO staffing. The minister answered in detail on the procedure, the award criteria and staffing, but declined to say whether delivery can be guaranteed and deferred the delivery-date question to a separate letter.

Defence is currently investigating whether the procurement can be continued and how the air assault brigade's needs can be met as quickly as possible. You will be informed separately about this in more detail.

Momenteel onderzoekt Defensie of de aanbesteding kan worden vervolgd en hoe op zo kort mogelijke termijn in de behoefte van de Luchtmobiele Brigade kan worden voorzien. U wordt hierover separaat nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over de Scania Gryphus

An MP from Forum voor Democratie asks the Defence Minister why the Scania Gryphus truck with an 8-foot container exceeds the legal 4-metre height limit, why this was not noticed earlier, and about user involvement, production status, quality guarantees, and workshop/dock fit. The Minister admits the combination is a few centimetres too tall, says the vehicles will not be delivered or driven on public roads until the supplier fixes it, and defends the design and consultation process.
Delivery of the remaining vehicles to Defence will resume once the supplier, in consultation with Defence, has found a solution for the height exceedance.
Uitlevering van de resterende voertuigen aan Defensie zal worden herstart zodra de leverancier in afstemming met Defensie een oplossing voor de hoogte-overschrijding heeft gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bestellen van vrachtwagens die hoger zijn dan wettelijk toegestaan

An MP asked the Defence Minister why 1,600 new trucks were ordered that turned out to exceed the legal 4-metre height limit, and when exemptions or consequences would follow. The minister confirmed the overshoot, said the supplier is fixing it, and explained that temporary road-use permissions valid up to twelve weeks have been granted via the NMCC with RDW route advice, while the supplier's fix timeline is unknown.
Based on this finding, it was decided that this combination may not drive on public roads until road-use permission is granted and/or the problem is resolved by the supplier.

Op basis van deze constatering is besloten dat deze combinatie niet op de openbare weg mag rijden, totdat een toestemming voor weggebruik is verleend en/of het probleem door de leverancier is opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Minister Bijleveld en Admiraals Kramer en Tas uiten zorgen tijdens commando-overdracht'

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Rajkowski asked the Defence Minister about warnings on Russian submarine activity threatening undersea data cables, cable capacity, monitoring and protection measures, and naval capabilities. The minister answered in detail on the threat and cable routes but declined operational specifics, said no incidents had been reported, and noted the matter is handled through NATO and EU cooperation.
For operational reasons we cannot give a further explanation of this.
Om operationele redenen kunnen we hierop geen nadere toelichting geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Michon-Derkzen en Valstar over het bericht ‘Frankrijk ziet Taliban-banden bij gevluchte Afghanen’

Members Van Wijngaarden, Michon-Derkzen and Valstar asked the ministers whether evacuated Afghans with Taliban, Al Qaeda or IS ties could enter the Netherlands, how security screening was done before and after evacuation, and whether the Taliban can be treated as a terrorist organisation. The State Secretary answered that all asylum applicants are screened under standard procedures, that pre-evacuation screening was largely not possible given the time pressure, and that individuals can be excluded under article 1F or prosecuted, while the Taliban as an organisation is not on UN or EU terrorism lists.
For other persons who did not work directly for Dutch officials as part of an international military or police mission, such screening was in most cases not carried out by the Netherlands in advance.

Voor de andere personen die niet rechtstreeks voor (een) Nederlandse functionaris(sen) als onderdeel van een internationale militaire of politiemissie werkten is een dergelijke screening in de meeste gevallen niet vooraf door Nederland uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Nederlandse militairen oefenen zonder vergunningen op voormalige plantage in Curaçao’

MP Belhaj asked the Defence Minister whether the military knowingly built and trained at Dovale on Curaçao without the required building permit, why permit applications were delayed, and whether training continues. The Minister answers that training rests on long-standing use and private agreements, the permit was only applied for in March 2021 after a Carmabi study, and training continues while a permit process runs with Curaçao's authorities.
In March 2021 the application for the building permit for the Dovale training camp and the first bivouac location (A) was officially and fully submitted to the Curaçao government.
In maart 2021 is de aanvraag voor de aanlegvergunning voor oefenkamp Dovale en de eerste bivaklocatie (A) officieel en volledig ingediend bij de Curaçaose overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over materiële waardering voor veteranen

MP Van Haga asked the Defence Minister how far she is willing to investigate material recognition for veterans, such as discounts at municipal facilities like swimming pools and libraries. The minister pointed to the veterans card issued by NLVi, private-sector discounts via Stichting Onbekende Helden, and said she will explore with the VNG at the next consultation how local governments could increase material recognition.
At the next consultation I will explore the possibilities to increase material recognition for veterans from the local government.
Bij het eerstvolgende overleg zal ik de mogelijkheden verkennen om de materiële waardering voor veteranen te vergroten vanuit de lokale overheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Belhaj over Noodsteun Haïti

MPs Hammelburg and Belhaj asked the ministers for Foreign Trade and Development and for Defence about Dutch emergency aid for the Haiti earthquake, including EU coordination, UN and Red Cross support, funding from the crisis reserve, technical expertise such as USAR and water experts, and military deployment. The minister answered that Nederland was asked for experts and a naval ship (Zr.Ms. Holland) was deployed, the Red Cross would release EUR 400,000, and the Dutch USAR and water-expert teams were not requested.
Yes, in that context it is good to see that aid operations are being set up from various quarters.
Ja, in dat verband is het goed te zien dat er vanuit verschillende hoeken hulpoperaties worden opgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Bromet, Ceder, Kuzu en Dassen over Afghaanse tolken

MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how the government would support Afghan interpreters and their families to evacuate as security collapsed, including whether passport requirements would be waived and a charter flight arranged. The government said it is doing everything possible to bring the group to safety, explained that Afghan authorities and airlines required passports and that airport access depends on verifiable identity, and promised a further letter on the consequences of recent developments.
The cabinet will shortly send a further letter to address the consequences of the recent developments.
Het kabinet zal op korte termijn een nadere brief sturen om in te gaan op de consequenties van de recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Bromet, Ceder en Kuzu over het beschermen van Afghanen die werkzaam waren voor Nederland tijdens de Afghanistanmissies

MPs from six parties asked the cabinet why it is not doing more to quickly bring Afghan interpreters and other former local staff who worked for Dutch missions to safety, including questions on the asylum process, document problems, non-interpreter staff, and a deportation moratorium. The ministers answered that additional staff were deployed, interpreters' remaining requirements were dropped, about 43 interpreters had arrived since June, non-interpreters are assessed individually and generously, and the moratorium's extension will be decided later.
The cabinet is taking all steps within its own power to bring the interpreters and their families to the Netherlands as quickly as possible.
Het kabinet onderneemt alle stappen die binnen het eigen vermogen liggen om de tolken en hun gezinnen op een zo kort mogelijke termijn naar Nederland over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Ceder en Kuzu over ‘De Nederlandse militairen zijn weg uit Afghanistan, maar hun tolken lopen gevaar’

MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers about Afghan interpreters and guards who worked for the Dutch mission still awaiting admission, including passport delays, EUPOL interpreters and exclusion of guards. The government gave detailed figures, explained passport and identity-verification obstacles, said it will consider guards case by case, and answered that each question would be addressed separately.
The cabinet makes maximum efforts to do what is possible if an applicant does not have a passport.
Het kabinet zet zich maximaal in om te doen wat mogelijk is indien een aanvrager niet over een paspoort beschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het naleven van de Europese privacyregels van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) bij (uitvoerings)instanties

An MP asks multiple ministers whether a long list of public bodies (DUO, CBR, SVB, IND, DJI, UWV, OM, FIOD and others) collect and process personal data in line with GDPR, and whether any are not yet compliant. The government replies per organisation, generally stating compliance, while noting ongoing work and specific gaps such as UWV's SONAR system, SVB processes still in development, and CAK access management.
UWV is working hard to comply with the GDPR.
Het UWV werkt hard om aan de AVG te voldoen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Kuzu en Ceder over de noodsituatie van de Afghaanse tolken

MPs from five parties asked the Defence Minister how many Afghan interpreters and their families had arrived in the Netherlands in June 2021, how many remain in Afghanistan, and what is being done to speed up their transfer and protect them. The government answered with case counts (90 families arrived since 2014, 84 active applications in Afghanistan, 113 rejected), listed measures to accelerate processing, and said the embassy in Kabul will remain open if security allows.
For security reasons I cannot go into these measures.
Omwille van veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik niet ingaan op deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Lee over het bericht dat de Franse president Macron Mali waarschuwt Franse troepen terug te trekken

MP van der Lee asks the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that Macron warned he would withdraw French troops from Mali if it slides into jihadism, and about the consequences of the coup for MINUSMA and Dutch contributions. The ministers answer substantively on each point, noting ECOWAS mediation, the EU's conditions, unchanged MINUSMA legal basis and Dutch C-130 contribution, and that a parliamentary letter will follow after the summer.
Your House will receive the promised supplementary Article 100 letter after the summer and well before the planned deployment, which will also cover the latest developments in Mali.

Uw Kamer zal na de zomer en in ieder geval ruim voor aanvang van de voorziene inzet de toegezegde aanvullende artikel 100-brief toekomen, waarin ook de laatste ontwikkelingen in Mali worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over eerdere antwoorden over burgerdoden in Uruzgan

The SP MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers many questions about the use of force and civilian casualties during the June 2007 defence of Chora, Afghanistan, including rules of engagement, artillery accuracy, civilian warnings and investigations. The government answered that the Dutch troops acted lawfully under humanitarian law and self-defence, withheld some operational details and classified logs citing NATO rules and the ongoing court case, and rejected calls for an independent inquiry.
To avoid disrupting the legal proceedings, no statements can be made about certain details of the deployment in question while the matter is before the court.
Om de rechtsgang niet te verstoren, kunnen zo lang deze kwestie onder de rechter is geen uitspraken worden gedaan over enkele details van de inzet in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de Nederlandse deelname aan een militaire oefening in de Westelijke Sahara

An MP asked whether Dutch participation in the military exercise African Lion 21 takes place partly in Western Sahara, whether this conflicts with the Dutch neutral stance, whether the Sahrawi population was consulted, and whether parliament was informed in advance. The government answered that the exercise is organised by USAFRICOM and, according to them, does not take place in Western Sahara, that Dutch participation has no consequences for the Dutch position, that Morocco was notified by note verbale, that parliament is not usually informed about exercises, and that participation will be assessed per exercise.
The cabinet does not comment on the deployment of partners.
Het kabinet laat zich niet uit over de inzet van partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het gebruik van explosieve wapens in dichtbevolkte gebieden

An MP asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about the high civilian share of casualties from explosive weapons in populated areas, and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The government answers that it deplores civilian harm, stresses better compliance with international humanitarian law and transparency, and says it will keep the Chamber informed on the EWIPA political declaration negotiations, while declining to commit to stronger national measures.
Yes. Once the negotiations have concluded, the cabinet will inform the Chamber of the outcome and provide further explanation of the Dutch position.
Ja. Op het moment dat de onderhandelingen geconcludeerd zijn, zal het kabinet de Kamer op de hoogte brengen van de uitkomst en nadere toelichting geven op de Nederlandse inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Fritsma over het bericht dat Nederland deelneemt aan een militaire oefening in de Westelijke Sahara

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Dutch troops were taking part in the African Lion 2021 exercise, whether it took place in Western Sahara, and why parliament was not informed. The minister confirmed Dutch participation at US invitation but stated the exercise does not take place in Western Sahara according to USAFRICOM, and that it is not customary to inform parliament about participation in exercises.
Moreover, it is not customary to inform the House about Dutch participation in military exercises.
Daarnaast is het niet gebruikelijk om de Kamer over de Nederlandse deelname aan militaire oefeningen te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht 'Ook in Nederland trekt legergroen rechts-extremisten aan'

An MP from D66 asks the Defence Minister about a Trouw report on far-right extremists being drawn to the military, citing MIVD findings and a 2019 commitment to report on far-right extremism in the armed forces. The minister confirms the commitment and says the MIVD sees far-right youth finding military work attractive but that this does not mean Defence is an attractive employer for extremists; she declines to share figures on ongoing investigations, describes existing vetting and personnel measures, and declines to comment on contact with German counterparts.
The MIVD does not share figures on ongoing investigations into far-right extremism, because that could harm the investigation.
De MIVD deelt geen cijfers over lopende onderzoeken naar rechts-extremisme, omdat dat het onderzoek kan schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Teunissen over laagvliegende vliegtuigen die vogels verstoren tijdens het broedseizoen

MPs Vestering and Teunissen asked whether low-flying military transport aircraft disturb breeding birds and whether this complies with nature protection law, and why military exercises cannot be moved abroad during COVID measures. The State Secretary answers that a 2018 preliminary assessment found military flights above 3,000 ft not disturbing, that low-level flights are conditional on avoiding important breeding areas, and that permit applications for some areas are in preparation, while refusing to halt exercises during the breeding season.
For temporary restricted areas that are regularly used for an exercise, a permit application is being prepared.
Voor tijdelijke gebieden met beperkingen die met regelmaat in gebruik zijn voor een oefening is een vergunningaanvraag in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Boswijk over de invoering van de Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Boswijk asked about the Maritime Protection Act (Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij), including the use of Vessel Protection Detachments, piracy in the Gulf of Guinea, and ILT oversight. The government answered in detail, giving request statistics, budget figures, and a reasoned refusal to designate the Gulf of Guinea as a risk area, while promising an EU pilot evaluation and ongoing ILT-Defence arrangements.
Once the results of that are known, your House will be informed about them.
Zodra de resultaten daarvan bekend zijn, zal uw Kamer daarover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de veteranenstatus van militairen die in verschillende hoedanigheid gediend hebben in de Nederlandse krijgsmacht

An MP asked the Defence Minister why military personnel who served in the Suriname troop mission, the Cold War, and humanitarian missions cannot obtain veteran status, whether this causes a sense of disregard, what alternative recognition exists, and whether a medal or decoration can be provided. The minister answered that these groups fall outside the Veterans Act definition, that existing recognition (reunion facilities, existing medals) is adequate, and that no new decoration is planned, while stating respect for their service.
The military personnel who served in the Suriname Troop Force (TRIS) were part of the Royal Netherlands Army, stationed in Paramaribo.
De militairen die hebben gediend in de Troepenmacht Suriname (TRIS) maakten onderdeel uit van de Koninklijke Landmacht, met een plaatsing in Paramaribo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht ‘Militairen verontwaardigd over achterlaten Afghaanse tolken’

MP Piri asks the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that soldiers are outraged at leaving Afghan interpreters behind, and about the number, timing, and process for bringing interpreters to the Netherlands. The minister answers that vetting of identity and Dutch service is required, that 68 interpreter households have been brought over, and that the process is ongoing with no fixed end date, while numbers are shared confidentially with parliament rather than publicly.
The cabinet has agreed to inform your House in detail about the process and the numbers in a confidential technical briefing.
Het kabinet heeft ingestemd om uw Kamer in een vertrouwelijke technische briefing in detail te informeren over het proces en de aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Boswijk en Stoffer over het munitiebudget

MPs Van Wijngaarden, Boswijk and Stoffer asked about a reported cut in the ammunition budget for training from EUR 140 million in 2021 to EUR 80 million in 2023, and its effects on readiness, missions and simulator training. The State Secretary confirmed a structural shortfall of EUR 60 million, partly covered by temporary increases, said cuts would reduce use of expensive munitions while keeping required training levels, and noted that deeper structural fixes depend on future budget room and a future cabinet decision.
It is up to a next cabinet to take a decision on this.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om hierover een besluit te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over discussie in kringen van officieren over de prioriteiten van de bestedingen van Defensie

SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Defence Minister about retired senior officers' doubts over Defence spending priorities, including the cost of nine extra F-35s, pooling with allies, and the Court of Audit's findings. The minister answered that the extra F-35s are necessary for constitutional tasks, that delivery is on schedule and the lifetime cost gap is acknowledged but no measures are taken yet, and that further choices are for a next cabinet.
The current operational target is to guard Dutch airspace 24 hours a day, seven days a week while simultaneously conducting one mission, one-off or long-term, with four aircraft.
De huidige inzetdoelstelling betreft 24 uur per dag, zeven dagen per week het Nederlandse luchtruim bewaken en tegelijkertijd met vier toestellen eenmalig of langdurig één missie uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat mariniers met schamele uitrusting naar Irak vertrokken

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that marines were deployed to Iraq with inadequate equipment, including missing radios and heavy machine guns, and whether Defence's airlift capacity is sufficient. The minister denied equipment was inadequate, attributed a delay in some items to an administrative error, explained the planning and loan arrangements for radios, and acknowledged airlift capacity still falls short of defence needs, with a new tactical transport fleet due from 2026.
The delayed equipment has meanwhile arrived in the deployment area.
Het vertraagde materieel is inmiddels in het inzetgebied gearriveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over de HCSS/Clingendael publicatie ‘Towards a Space Security Strategy, Action Points for Safeguarding Dutch Security and Prosperity in the Space Age’

An MP asks the Defence Minister about a HCSS/Clingendael report on Dutch space security, including situational awareness, EU alignment, a promised space strategy, the BRIK-II satellite, a Defence Space Security Centre and funding. The Minister says the Defence Space Agenda will address these points before summer 2021, defers decisions on capabilities and funding to the next cabinet, and gives limited detail on BRIK-II.
Before this summer I will send the House of Representatives the Defence Space Agenda.
Voor deze zomer stuur ik de Tweede Kamer de Defensie Ruimte Agenda toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over eerdere antwoorden over burgerdoden in Uruzgan

MP Karabulut asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers, after a Trouw report of a veteran's account of a 2007 incident in Uruzgan with possible civilian deaths, about the internal review, archives, and rules on force use and battle damage assessments. Minister Bijleveld-Schouten answered that the Public Prosecution Service has an ongoing fact-finding inquiry, so further details, witness hearings and the full list of incident reports are withheld for now, while a search of incident reports from 2009–2010 and an updated list will be shared.

To prevent any own investigation by the Ministry of Defence from hindering the Public Prosecution Service's inquiry, I choose to await the completion of this fact-finding inquiry before deciding on an own investigation.
Om te voorkomen dat een eventueel eigen onderzoek van het Ministerie van Defensie het onderzoek van het OM belemmert, kies ik er voor om de afronding van dit feitenonderzoek af te wachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Afghaanse tolken in levensgevaar komen als de coalitietroepen van de resolute support missie vertrekken uit Afghanistan

Two D66 MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about risks to Afghan interpreters who worked for Dutch forces as coalition troops leave Afghanistan, and about implementation of the Belhaj motion on relocating them. The government answered that over 60 interpreters with families have already come to the Netherlands, that the Afghan authorities are responsible for citizens' safety, and that interpreters meeting the conditions will be processed for asylum, with no specific numbers at risk disclosed.
On the numbers of interpreters who may be at risk, names and dates, we make no statements in the security interest of the interpreters.
Over aantallen tolken die mogelijk risico lopen, namen en data doen we uit veiligheidsbelang van de tolken geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Karabulut over “LIMC, JISTARC en andere inlichtingenwerkzaamheden van de Krijgsmacht”

MPs Belhaj and Karabulut asked the Defence Minister about the experimental Land Information Manoeuvre Centre (LIMC), its data gathering on domestic activist groups, its links to JISTARC and whether it had a legal mandate. The state secretary answered that LIMC lacked a mandate for activities outside the armed forces' own tasks, that the activities were halted in November 2020, that data is being archived or destroyed under archive rules, and that the legal framework was being reinforced.
Without a mandate it is not permitted to approach Dutch citizens.
Zonder mandaat is het niet toegestaan Nederlandse burgers te benaderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verplichte vaccinatie voor militairen

An MP from FvD asked the Defence Minister whether COVID-19 vaccination is on the list of compulsory military vaccinations, whether refusal leads to dismissal, and whether there will be compulsion. The State Secretary answered that a temporary scheme allows mandatory COVID-19 vaccination only for deployments abroad, decided per deployment on expert advice, with exemption procedures and no dismissal, only non-deployability.
For each service deployment abroad a separate decision is taken, based on expert advice.
Per dienstverrichting in het buitenland wordt een afzonderlijk besluit genomen, op basis van deskundig advies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Beertema en Fritsma over het bericht dat tientallen Chinese onderzoekers in Delft banden hadden met het Chinese leger

PVV MPs asked whether dozens of Chinese researchers at TU Delft had ties to the Chinese military, whether knowledge flowed to the PLA, whether intelligence services screen Chinese researchers, and whether universities should stop cooperating with the 'Seven Sons' universities. The government answered that the TU Delft figures are limited and that an inventory and binding risk-assessment framework on knowledge security is underway, while it declined to provide nationality data, a blacklist, or confirmation of specific knowledge transfer.

The cabinet is working on a country-neutral package of measures that together offers a course of action for both knowledge institutions and central government to counter undesirable knowledge transfer.

Het kabinet werkt aan een landenneutraal pakket maatregelen dat samengenomen een handelingsperspectief biedt aan zowel de kennisinstellingen als de rijksoverheid om ongewenste kennisoverdracht tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het doodrijden van een wolvin door drukte in natuurgebieden

An MP asked whether recreational pressure, low-flying military helicopters and deer culling on the Veluwe disturb wolves, and whether speed limits or bans should be imposed to protect wolves and otters. The minister answered that disturbance only arises when visitors break conduct rules, that the Veluwe helicopter flights are judged not to disturb wolves, and that speed limits are a local road-manager matter, while promising no new protective measures for the wolf habitat.
Yes, I am aware of the report.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over grootschalige en onrechtmatige verzameling van data van burgers door de krijgsmacht, de politie, de Belastingdienst, de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten en andere overhei

An MP from D66 asked several ministers about large-scale and unlawful data collection on citizens by the armed forces (LIMC), police systems, UWV (SONAR), the Tax Service, and COA-police data sharing, including whether these comply with GDPR and oversight rules. The ministers acknowledged shortcomings, described remediation steps such as stopping LIMC collection pending an internal review, phasing out SONAR, and ending COA data sharing, while deferring some matters to ongoing investigations and to a future cabinet on AP funding.
If it turns out that government organisations are not or insufficiently able to do so, the cabinet will discuss this with the relevant body.
Indien blijkt dat overheidsorganisaties hier niet of onvoldoende toe in staat zijn, dan gaat het kabinet hierover met het desbetreffende onderdeel in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Wiersma over het bericht 'Sensorfabrikant Photonis inzet van Nederlands-Franse strijd'

Two VVD MPs asked the Economic Affairs and Defence ministers about the Franse government's shift from allowing a sale of Photonis to Teledyne toward a French-only buyer, and the risks to Dutch jobs, innovation and RUG cooperation. The minister answered that the Netherlands will monitor the process closely, weighs Dutch interests in French screening, and outlines the Dutch investment-screening instruments being developed.
I will therefore continue to monitor this process closely.
Ik zal dit proces dan ook nauwlettend blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht 'Nederlandse militair gewond bij schietoefening op kamp in Afghanistan'

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a Dutch soldier injured during a shooting exercise in Afghanistan, including the cause, the soldier's condition, prior similar incidents and lessons learned. The minister said a Marechaussee investigation is ongoing so causes are unclear, the soldier is recovering, about 1,300 injury reports were logged from 2013 to 2020, and Defence has introduced firearms safety policy with a stuurgroep, training and a planned knowledge centre.
The Royal Military Police is currently conducting an investigation into the incident.
De Koninklijke Marechaussee voert momenteel een onderzoek uit naar het incident.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van den Berg over de betrokkenheid van Defensie bij de bestrijding van de pandemie

CDA MPs asked the Defence Minister about Defence's role in the COVID-19 pandemic and vaccination programme, including why only 150 of 1,000 standby soldiers were deployed, how 2009 differed, and whether Defence should host innovation offers. The minister answered that civil authorities lead vaccination, Defence supports planning and standby personnel as requested, and innovation offers are routed to the responsible ministries.
The civil authorities are responsible for the vaccination programme.
De civiele autoriteiten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het vaccinactieprogramma.
