Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Afghaanse tolken die Nederlanders hielpen onder vuur’

An MP from D66 asked the Defence Minister about reports that Afghan interpreters who worked for Dutch forces are being hunted and killed by the Taliban and ISIS, and about the asylum route and any special arrangement for them. The Minister answered that individual cases are assessed under a standing procedure via Foreign Affairs, Defence and the IND, with no special asylum scheme, and that threat levels for individual interpreters are unknown.
There is no special (asylum) arrangement for Afghans who worked for us at the time.
Zoals eerder gemeld, is er geen sprake van een speciale (asiel)regeling voor Afghanen die destijds voor ons hebben gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Bosman over de Arctische Raad

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers about the failure of the Arctic Council ministerial meeting in Rovaniemi, the US Secretary of State's speech on Chinese and Russian activity in the Arctic, and Russian plans for the Northern Sea Route. The government confirmed no Ministerial Declaration was adopted, said Dutch Arctic policy would be addressed in a forthcoming letter, and gave only general or deferred answers on the substantive questions.
You will receive this letter next summer.
Deze brief zult u komende zomer ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de motie Belhaj c.s. (30139, nr. 190)

An MP from D66 asked the Defence Minister how the government is implementing the adopted Belhaj motion allowing veterans with under 15 years of service to wear uniform at veterans' events, and whether veterans will be informed of its consequences. The answers were given by reference to a separate letter to parliament on uniform-wearing rights for veterans, with no substantive answers in this document.
The written questions from MP Belhaj (D66), question number 2019Z10933, have been answered by means of the letter 'Draagrecht uniformen veteranen' (Parliamentary Paper 30 139, no. 212).
Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Belhaj (D66), vraagnummer 2019Z10933 , zijn beantwoord middels brief «Draagrecht uniformen veteranen» (Kamerstuk 30 139, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over omgang van Defensie met getraumatiseerde veteranen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Defence about the treatment of traumatised veterans, including leading questions in MIP pension assessments, calculation of damages from the date of assessment, oversight of assessments, delays, and return interviews with partners. The Minister denied that questioning is suggestive, explained the oversight by the Pensions and Insurance Authority, acknowledged delays addressed by extra physicians, and said a partner-inclusive return interview is under review.
The ABP customer survey shows that the vast majority of clients who attended a consultation experienced contact with the ABP Social Medical Examination as pleasant and friendly.
Het Klantonderzoek ABP laat zien dat het overgrote deel van de klanten die op spreekuur zijn geweest het contact met Sociaal Medische Onderzoek van ABP als prettig en vriendelijk ervaart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Buitenweg over de mogelijke verhuizing van interceptieschotels uit Burum

MPs Diks and Buitenweg asked the ministers of Defence and the Interior whether the government is frustrated with the intelligence services over relocating the Burum interception dishes because of 5G, and what consultation, analysis and parliamentary involvement there would be before any relocation decision. The minister denied the frustration, said a TNO study concluded coexistence is not possible, and promised an alternative by September 2022 via international cooperation, while withholding details of that cooperation for confidentiality reasons.
Because of the confidentiality required in this context, I cannot say anything further about the precise shape of this international cooperation.
Ik kan vanwege de in dit verband vereiste vertrouwelijkheid verder geen uitspraken doen over de precieze invulling van deze internationale samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de wachttijden van veteranen voor keuringen door het ABP

An MP asked the Defence Minister why veterans face unacceptably long waits for military disability pension assessments at the ABP, including a one-year extension of reassessment deadlines. The minister attributed the delays to a shortage of insurance physicians, outlined hiring and outsourcing measures, provided case and appeal figures, and promised to clear backlogs by 2020 and cooperate with the ombudsman's inquiry.
Due to capacity problems at the ABP's Social Medical Examination Company (SMO) – problems that also occur elsewhere – it was decided to suspend the reassessments planned for 2018.
Vanwege capaciteitsproblemen bij het Bedrijf Sociaal Medisch Onderzoek (SMO) van het ABP – problemen die ook elders spelen – is besloten om de in 2018 geplande termijnherbeoordelingen op te schorten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over erkenning en compensatie van getraumatiseerde veteranen

An MP asked the Defence Minister about delays in medical assessments for traumatised veterans and the handling of compensation claims, and whether Defence is unwilling to cooperate. The minister answered that re-assessments were postponed due to staffing shortages, outlined temporary capacity measures, denied that Defence is uncooperative, and announced an evaluation of the compensation scheme and a review of the PTSS protocol.
In addition, we are working on revising the PTSS protocol, which examines whether the final medical situation can be determined earlier.
Daarnaast zijn wij bezig met de herziening van het PTSS-protocol dat kijkt of eerder de medische eindsituatie kan worden bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Remco Dijkstra, Koopmans en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht dat Defensie zich nog geen raad weet met steeds kleinere drones

VVD MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs, among others, about the difficulty of countering increasingly small drones, expert recommendations, inter-ministerial coordination, and Defence's counter-drone research and industry cooperation. The ministers replied that research is ongoing with international partners, coordination with the police and Justice and Veiligheid exists, and Nederland is pursuing counter-drone categories in EDIDP, without committing to new checks on the executive.
The cabinet will return on this matter shortly in a letter that will be sent to the House soon.
Het kabinet komt op korte termijn ter zake in een brief die uw kamer spoedig zal toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het opschorten van de trainingsmissie in Irak

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister why Parliament learned of the suspension of the Iraq training mission through the media, what the threat is, and whether the mission should be ended to protect personnel. The minister answered that personnel were informed directly, operational security prevents giving details of the threat, training has resumed under conditions, and the government will keep monitoring the situation and take precautionary measures where needed.
Due to operational security, I cannot provide further details on the grounds on which the American commander of the anti-ISIS coalition decided to temporarily raise the threat level.

In verband met de operationele veiligheid kan ik geen nadere details verstrekken over de gronden op basis waarvan de Amerikaanse commandant van de anti-ISIS coalitie besloot het dreigingsniveau tijdelijk te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over interne memo’s inzake een corruptieaffaire bij Damen Shipyards

An MP asked the Ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about internal memos concerning a corruption case at Damen Shipyards, alleged pressure from Damen against publication, and whether pending investigations affect procurement. The government answered that additional memos cannot yet be released pending a court appeal, denied undue pressure, explained that ongoing investigations are not grounds for exclusion under procurement law, and described contacts with Damen on submarine and other projects.
Once there is a final legal judgment, I will share with the House the information that may be released.
Zodra er een juridisch eindoordeel ligt, zal ik de informatie die mag worden vrijgegeven met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg, Diks en Van Ojik over het bericht 'AIVD en MI5 gestopt met samenwerking met Oostenrijkse diensten'

MPs Buitenweg, Diks and Van Ojik asked the government about reports that the AIVD and MI5 stopped cooperating with Austrian intelligence services, including effects on the Club van Bern, CTG, PESCO and the Burum satellite station. The minister declined to comment publicly on the specifics of intelligence cooperation, citing legal risk-weighing procedures, and otherwise answered that bilateral and EU relations with Austria remain good.
The AIVD and MIVD make no public statements about the precise nature of cooperation with intelligence or security services.
De AIVD en MIVD doen in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de precieze invulling van de samenwerking met inlichtingen- of veiligheidsdiensten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de toename van geweld in Mali

An MP from GroenLinks asked the government about the rise in violence in Mali, MINUSMA's role, causes linked to natural resources, diplomatic and development responses, and the Fomi Dam in Guinea. The minister answered at length, describing MINUSMA's continued necessity, Dutch diplomatic and development efforts, and noting the Fomi Dam matter is handled mainly at technical level with the Niger Basin Authority.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het tegengaan van ongewenste toegang tot het Netherlands Armed Forces Integrated Network (NAFIN)

MP Bruins Slot asked about protecting the Defence NAFIN fibre network from unwanted state and non-state influence, espionage and sabotage, including ownership, shared use by other government bodies, supply chain risks and a risk analysis. The Minister answered that NAFIN is autonomously managed by Defence, that shared use is virtually separated, and that a risk analysis exists but cannot be made public, while committing to no new report.
A risk analysis is part of the existing information security plan of NAFIN. This is not suitable for public disclosure.
Een risicoanalyse is onderdeel van het bestaande informatiebeveiligingsplan van het NAFIN. Dit leent zich niet voor openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Piloot F-16 over strijd tegen IS: Mijn grootste angst was pech’

An MP asked the Defence Minister why a Dutch F-16 pilot's public interview about anti-IS air strikes fits with the ministry's refusal to share strike data and locations or civilian casualty figures, and whether that data could now be released. The minister answered that the pilot disclosed nothing beyond information already shared with parliament, that no operational security is at stake now the mission has ended, and that specific strike data and locations will not be released, while pointing to existing reporting and coalition civilian-casualty processes.
In this context the cabinet chooses not to release specific details on the dates and/or locations of air strikes during the F-16 deployment period in Iraq and eastern Syria.
In dit kader kiest het kabinet ervoor om geen specifieke details vrij te geven over data en/of locaties van luchtaanvallen gedurende de inzetperiode van de F-16’s in Irak en Oost-Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel ‘35.000 ton bommen uit WO I lekken springstof vlak voor kust in Knokke’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Defence Minister about reports of WWI munitions leaking explosives off Knokke, Belgium, and about the risks of Dutch offshore munitions dumps, including whether recovery would be safer. The government answered that it is in contact with Belgian authorities, describes four Dutch dumps of mainly WWII conventional munitions, and states that studies found no spontaneous explosion risk or measurable environmental harm, with the monitoring to be repeated in 2019.
I cannot make further statements about the situation in Belgium; that is a matter for the Belgian government.
Over de situatie in België kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen; dat is aan de Belgische overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Week zonder vlees

An MP asked the government about its role in the Week zonder vlees (Meatless Week), whether ministries should promote it, and whether external costs of meat should be priced in. The government answered by referring to its earlier answers (Aanhangsel Handelingen 1896) and did not address the questions substantively.
The written questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD), question number 2019Z03363, on a week without meat, have been answered via Aanhangsel Handelingen, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1896.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD), vraagnummer 2019Z03363 , inzake een week zonder vlees, zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij EUROGENDFOR

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether EUROGENDFOR was involved in suppressing the yellow vest protests in France, how many Dutch officials serve in it, and whether the Macron government acted excessively. The minister denied EUROGENDFOR involvement, explained it operates only in third countries after unanimous decisions, reported eight Dutch staff, and declined to judge a French internal matter.
Nee, dit kan ik niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over klachten over asbest in Nederlandse basis in Litouwen

The SP MP Karabulut asked the Defence Minister whether Defence knows of complaints about asbestos among Dutch soldiers at the Rukla base in Lithuania, how these complaints are handled, and whether an competent inspection service will investigate and the recommendations will be implemented. The answer refers the questions to a separate letter responding to a request from MP Kerstens about the same asbestos reports, rather than answering them directly.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Van den Hul, Krol en Özütok over de Nederlandse versie van de Nashville-verklaring

MPs from several parties asked the government about the Dutch version of the Nashville Statement, its signing by a military chaplain and MPs, the Vrije Universiteit's response, effects on LGBTI youth, and biblical passages. The minister distanced the government from the statement, said courts and prosecutors will decide on complaints, and declined to comment on biblical interpretation or engage signatories.
As long as these matters are under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service and/or the court, it is not appropriate for the cabinet to make statements about them.
Zolang deze zaken ter beoordeling liggen bij het OM en/of de rechter ligt het niet in de rede dat het kabinet daarover uitspraken doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over lakse afhandeling getraumatiseerde veteraan

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Defence about the mishandling of a traumatised veteran and reservist, including repeated misconduct, failure to assess his fitness for deployment, and inadequate complaint handling. The minister acknowledged the ombudsman's criticism, listed measures taken (new pre-deployment selection, a Sociaal Medisch Team, centralised complaint coordination, an external evaluation of the complaints regulation) and rejected an independent complaints body for now, pointing to the Meldpunt Integriteit Defensie and the inspectorate.
A selection procedure has been introduced prior to a deployment.
Zo is er een selectieprocedure ingesteld voorafgaande aan een uitzending.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Meldpunt moet onafhankelijk van Defensie zijn'

An MP asked the Defence Minister why Defence recorded only four sick-soldier reports while a former staff member's own burn-pit reporting point received 122, and whether the reporting system should be reviewed, and asked for an independent reporting point. The minister replied that Defence does not know the content of the outside reports, opened an independent reporting point on 4 February 2019, and said an independent investigation will follow if reports warrant it.
For reasons of confidentiality I will not go into the contacts Defence has had with Mr Van de Nadort.
Ik ga omwille van de vertrouwelijkheid niet in op de contacten die Defensie heeft gehad met dhr. Van de Nadort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Belhaj over de herijking van de businesscase voor civiele dienstauto’s, zoals genoemd in de Najaarsnota 2018

MPs Sneller and Belhaj asked the Defence Minister about the revised business case for civilian service cars, including fleet numbers, cost and sale-value adjustments, and a correction to the Najaarsnota 2018 text. The state secretary answered in detail on replacement terms, the EUR 59.2 million downward revision, the BPM error in earlier sale-value estimates, operating costs and cash flows, and acknowledged the Najaarsnota error.
I note that an error was made in the text of the Najaarsnota regarding Defence's civilian service cars.
Ik merk op dat er een fout is gemaakt in de tekst van de Najaarsnota over de civiele dienstauto's van Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Kerstens en Den Boer over politiek verlof voor militairen om uitzending mogelijk te maken

MPs Belhaj, Kerstens and Den Boer asked whether soldiers can get political leave to attend council or assembly meetings, and whether elected councillors can temporarily transfer their seat to enable deployment abroad. The government answered that soldiers can get extraordinary leave for council duties, but that the Kieswet and Constitution allow temporary seat replacement only for pregnancy, childbirth and illness, so a constitutional amendment would be needed and it is not convinced this is necessary.
An extension of the replacement option for military deployments abroad therefore requires an amendment of the Constitution.
Een uitbreiding van de vervangingsmogelijkheid bij buitenlandse missies van militairen vereist dus een wijziging van de Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Van Gent over de mogelijkheid tot ‘politiek verlof’ voor militairen

Two VVD MPs asked whether soldiers deployed abroad can temporarily give up their municipal council seat via 'political leave', and whether the law should allow this. The government answers that the Constitution offers no basis for replacing councillors deployed abroad, the only substitution being for pregnancy, childbirth or long-term illness, and it sees no need to introduce a replacement option.
The Constitution provides no basis for replacing councillors who are sent abroad for their profession, whether voluntarily or not.
De Grondwet biedt geen grondslag voor vervanging van raadsleden die voor hun beroep al dan niet vrijwillig worden uitgezonden naar het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat drie passagiers zijn opgepakt in vliegtuig na protest tegen de uitzetting van vluchteling

An MP asked whether marechaussee officers threatened passengers with arrest and deleted footage, and whether force used to remove a protesting woman was proportionate. The government denied the threat and deletion claims, saying passengers were asked by the crew to stop filming and one deleted footage voluntarily, and described the force used as light and proportionate.
I do not recognise the picture painted in the article.
Ik herken mij in het beeld dat wordt geschetst in het artikel niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the government, in 21 questions, how it would respond to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether ministers share responsibility for climate policy and whether they will act on climate targets. The government's answer, given jointly by many ministers, refers to the answers already given in the Aanhangsel Handelingen, indicating the questions were answered by reference rather than on substance.
The written questions from MP Akerboom (PvdD), question number 2018Z24295, have been answered by way of Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Akerboom (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24295 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Bosman over het bericht ‘Rusland: buitenlandse marineschepen niet meer zomaar langs kust Siberië‘

MPs Koopmans and Bosman asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reported Russian plans to require notification before foreign naval ships use the Northern Sea Route, and related Arctic military developments. The government said the scope of the reported measure is unknown, that notification requirements would conflict with innocent passage and freedom of navigation outside Russian internal waters, and that it will send an update on the security part of the Arctic strategy in mid-2019.
Nothing is known about the precise content and scope of the (possibly planned) measure.
Over de precieze inhoud en reikwijdte van de (mogelijk voorgenomen) maatregel is niets bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse onderhandelingen met de Taliban in 2010 over een ontvoerde Nederlander

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether the Netherlands negotiated with or paid ransom to the Taliban in 2010 over a kidnapped Dutch aid worker, and asked about an ex-informant's debts, passport, and KHAD background, plus whether special operations in Afghanistan would be disclosed. The minister denied any negotiation or ransom, declined to discuss informants, ongoing legal procedures or secret operations citing confidentiality, and gave a general account of Afghanistan.
I cannot publicly discuss any sources of the MIVD.
Ik kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op eventuele bronnen van de MIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over “een onzichtbaar cyberleger”

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the size, mandate and role of the Defence Cyber Command (DCC), including whether it is understaffed, whether it can conduct offensive operations, and its role in protecting vital infrastructure. The minister answered that staffing is being strengthened with new funding, that offensive use requires a political decision and mandate under international law, and that Defence will play a larger role in protecting vital infrastructure in coordination with civilian authorities.
The supply and demand of Defence's cyber capabilities will be mapped in consultation with civilian authorities and relevant public and private partners.
Vraag en aanbod van cybercapaciteiten van Defensie worden in overleg met de civiele autoriteiten en betrokken publieke en private partners in kaart gebracht.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat de belastinginspecteur besloten heeft om de RVU-boete voor de gouden handdrukken van bijna 200 miljoen aan de belastingdienst kwijt te schelden

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary about reports that the Tax Authority was waived an RVU penalty of nearly 200 million euros on golden handshakes, and about how the Supreme Court ruling of June 2018 is applied, the consequences for the state, and rights of other employers. The government answered that the inspector applied the Supreme Court criteria, that about 95 million euros is expected to be refunded in 2019, that old policy decrees will be withdrawn, and that the Ministry of Defence will object to its own RVU levy, though it answered late and did not meet the one-week deadline.
Why did you not clearly inform the House about the major consequences for the RVU scheme paid by the state?
Vraag 6 Waarom heeft u de Kamer niet duidelijk geïnformeerd over de grote gevolgen voor de door de staat betaalde RVU-regeling?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over tekortschietend onderzoek naar ongewenst gedrag

MP Kerstens asked the Defence Minister whether the government will act on the Giebels commission's finding that inquiries into unwanted conduct within Defence are inadequate, including whether it will consider an external reporting point and how it will restore staff trust. The state secretary replied that a central independent reporting point will be placed with COID and be operational early next year, that a broader policy response will follow by end 2018, and that concrete plans for social safety will come later this year.
This independent central reporting point will be housed at the Central Organisation for Integrity Defence (COID) and will be operational early next year.
Dit onafhankelijke centrale meldpunt zal worden belegd bij de Centrale Organisatie Integriteit Defensie (COID) en is begin volgend jaar operationeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat cyberoorlog zich ook op zee afspeelt

The PVV MP Popken asked the Defence Minister about reports of cyberwarfare at sea, including whether NATO had noted rising GPS and electromagnetic interference and whether the Dutch navy had been affected, and about navy ship cybersecurity and the EU's role at sea. The minister confirmed the navy faces jamming and spoofing that is reported to MIVD or NATO, but declined to give details on the nature of these activities or the state of navy cybersecurity, citing confidentiality and security reasons.

As regards the precise nature of these activities, I cannot, like NATO, provide detailed information, for reasons of confidentiality and because it would give insight into the armed forces' capabilities.

Over de precieze aard van deze activiteiten kan ik, net als de NAVO, geen gedetailleerde mededelingen doen, omwille van de vertrouwelijkheid en het inzicht dat dat zou geven in de capaciteiten van de krijgsmacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Kooten-Arissen over het testen van zenuwgassen op proefdieren door Defensie

MPs Wassenberg and Van Kooten-Arissen asked the Defence Minister about animal testing of nerve agents on guinea pigs and rats, including ethics, the origin of animals, the number of animals used, funding for alternatives and plans to end testing. The government answered that the tests are necessary for medical countermeasures under the Animal Experiments Act, that about 100 rodents a year are used, and that testing will stop only when non-animal methods suffice, which is not expected soon.
For sound and reliable research, due to the lack of sufficient alternatives, the use of laboratory animals is still necessary.
Voor goed en betrouwbaar onderzoek is, vanwege het ontbreken van voldoende alternatieven, het gebruik van proefdieren nog steeds noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat de Europese parlement killerrobots wil verbieden

MP Belhaj asked the Defence Minister about the European Parliament's resolution calling for a ban on lethal autonomous weapons and whether the Netherlands would lead such a ban, and asked what steps had followed the 2015 AIV advisory report. The minister answered that all weapons must stay under meaningful human control, that the Netherlands opposes a ban or moratorium while working through the CCW and Article 36 reviews, and that the advisory report will be revisited in 2020.
The cabinet rejects in advance the development and use of autonomous systems that are not under human control.
Het kabinet verwerpt op voorhand de ontwikkeling en inzet van autonome systemen die niet onder menselijke controle staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de ernstig vervuilde grond van het beoogd terrein voor de Marinierskazerne in Vlissingen

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the planned Vlissingen Marine barracks site is seriously contaminated, since when Defence and the province knew, and whether the Marines' unions were informed. The State Secretary answered that contamination was known at the 2012 siting decision, that the site will be remediated where needed to meet regulations, and that the unions and works council were informed through studies and meetings.
We will ensure that during the further consultation with the TRMC, the works council is kept informed of further developments in the soil file.
We zullen er zorg voor dragen dat gedurende het vervolg van het overleg met de TRMC de medezeggenschap over de verdere ontwikkelingen in het gronddossier op de hoogte wordt gehouden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Emiel Van Dijk over de inzet van reservisten bij een terroristische aanslag

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether regular soldiers lack capacity for domestic counter-terrorism duties and whether missions should be cut, and asked about shortfalls and the constitutional role of reservists. The government answered that Defence can fulfil all committed tasks including domestic terrorism support, rejected cutting missions, acknowledged some capacity limitations addressed in the Defence White Paper, and said reservists can be deployed for constitutional tasks once trained.
Defence is able to fulfil all committed military tasks, including in the event of a terrorist attack.
Defensie is in staat om aan alle toegezegde militaire taken te voldoen, ook bij een terroristische aanslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Defensie betaalt fikse rekeningen van Kroon’

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that Defence paid large legal bills for a major, and whether the reimbursement rules for military personnel and veterans' legal aid were applied consistently. The minister explained that cases are judged individually, that deviating from the standard scheme was justified by the case's exceptional public profile, and promised a review of the veterans' compensation scheme including legal aid caps.
There is no deviation, but rather application of a different legal basis in cases where matters qualify for it.
Er is geen sprake van een afwijking, maar van toepassing van een andere grondslag in de gevallen waarin zaken daarvoor in aanmerking komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj inzake het bericht ‘Eerste energieneutrale kazerne ter wereld op Aruba’

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports of an energy-neutral barracks on Aruba and whether such projects reflect wider Defence policy. The state secretary answered that Defence has a broader sustainability programme for its real estate and renewable energy projects, with the energy and environment policy to be consolidated in a new document by spring 2019.

The Operational Energy Strategy and the Defence Energy and Environmental Policy Note will be merged, so that by next spring there is a single integrated policy document covering energy policy for both real estate and equipment.

De Operationele Energiestrategie en de Defensie Energie en Milieubeleidsnota zullen worden samengevoegd, zodat er komend voorjaar één integraal beleidsdocument ligt dat het energiebeleid voor zowel vastgoed als materieel bevat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de frauduleuze praktijken van NAVO’s cateraar Suprême

MP Kerstens asked the Defence Minister about alleged fraudulent practices by NATO catering contractor Supreme Group, including contracting choices, a 2013 US Senate hearing, the EUR 2.8 million overpayment, integrity reporting, liability for private contractors, and why the contract ran until December 2017. The minister answered that audits found overcharging which was repaid, no criminal referral was deemed necessary, contract terms were revised, and provisions were procured via pragmatic and procurement-based decisions with some questions left unanswered or referred elsewhere.
Given the nature of the findings and the fact that the overpaid amount was repaid to Defence, the ADR judged there was no reason for a criminal report.
Vanwege de aard van de bevindingen en het feit dat het te veel betaalde bedrag is terugbetaald aan Defensie, heeft de ADR geoordeeld dat er geen aanleiding was voor aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de verwarring die is ontstaan over het marineterrein in Amsterdam

An MP asked the Defence Minister about conflicting reports over whether the navy site in Amsterdam will be handed to the city, its link to the defence budget, the costs of keeping it, and its security role. The state secretary answered that Defence wants to keep part of the site for public order and security reasons, estimated savings of up to 4.2 million euros per year from divesting it, and promised to inform parliament once talks with the property agency and the city conclude.
Only once agreement is reached with the other parties on which part of the site Defence keeps can the effect on operating costs be calculated.
Pas als met de andere partijen is overeengekomen welk terreindeel Defensie behoudt, kan worden berekend wat dit betekent voor de exploitatielasten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over gezamenlijke productie van S500-raketten door Turkije en Rusland

MPs Ten Broeke and Bosman asked whether Turkey proposed joint production of S-500 missiles with Russia, whether NATO had reacted, and whether Turkey's S-400 purchase would be integrated with NATO systems and operated by Russian personnel. The government said it could not confirm the reports, that neither NATO nor the Netherlands had been formally informed, that arms procurement is a sovereign matter, and that integration of the S-400 with NATO systems is nearly ruled out.
The cabinet therefore cannot confirm these reports and does not wish to speculate about them.
Het kabinet kan deze berichten daarom niet bevestigen en wil hier niet over speculeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Maeijer over het bericht van het kabinet dat het voornemens is om 77 Marechaussees ter beschikking te stellen aan de EU missie (EULEX genaamd) in Kosovo

MPs Van Dijk and Maeijer (PVV) asked the Defence Minister why 77 Dutch military police should be made available on call for a crowd and riot control platoon in the EU EULEX mission in Kosovo, and whether this plan would be scrapped. The minister answered that stability in Kosovo serves European and Dutch interests, that a study on the availability of the unit is ongoing, and that deployment would only follow if local capacity proved insufficient, with the Dutch Parliament to be informed of the findings.
In the letter on Dutch contributions to rapid reaction forces, the House will be informed of the findings of the study.
In de brief over de Nederlandse bijdragen aan snelle reactiemachten zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd over de bevindingen van het onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over de uitspraak 201700522/1/A3 van de Raad van State en het bericht ‘Gevolgen van vernietiging IS door Nederlandse bommen blijven geheim’

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Defence Minister whether the Netherlands' air strikes against IS can be traced in the weekly Defence overview alongside CENTCOM reports, whether more detail will be published, and whether the Dutch weapon deployments reported to the Public Prosecution Service will be shared with parliament. The minister replied that coalition strikes cannot be attributed to individual countries, that the Dutch weekly overview has been expanded in detail, and that parliament has been informed confidentially and openly, while assessment of investigations is for the prosecutor.
Attacks cannot be traced back to countries from this reporting.
Aanvallen zijn hieruit niet te herleiden naar landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat de Koninklijke Marechaussee etnisch profileert op Eindhoven Airport

An MP from D66 asked the Defence Minister whether the Royal Military Police (KMar) engages in ethnic profiling at Eindhoven Airport, after a reported incident with several dark-skinned travellers pulled aside, and asked about follow-up to an Ombudsman report and complaint handling. The government answered that non-discrimination is the starting point, that profiling may include appearance but only alongside objective indicators, that the KMar has contacted the complainant and invited a formal complaint, and that it has reviewed its methods and will report on profiling in its annual integrity report.
These profiles are confidential and are used internally.
Profielen zijn vertrouwelijk en worden intern gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, De Graaf en Wilders over de uitnodiging voor een Defensie Iftar op donderdag 24 mei 2018

PVV MPs asked the Defence Minister whether he knew of a Defence Iftar invitation for 24 May 2018, and whether he agreed that Islam is a totalitarian ideology unfit for a secular armed forces and should not be facilitated. The state secretary confirmed the invitation, defended religious freedom and the integrated chaplaincy services, and said there is no room for extremist expressions in the armed forces.
Freedom of religion or belief is one of the classic fundamental rights that everyone in the Netherlands has, subject to everyone's responsibility under the law.
De vrijheid van godsdienst of levensovertuiging is één van de klassieke grondrechten die eenieder in Nederland heeft behoudens ieders verantwoordelijkheid voor de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het gelekte water uit kernreactor Doel 1 dat radioactief kan zijn

An MP asked the state secretary whether leaked water from Belgian reactor Doel 1 could be radioactive, why the Netherlands was informed late, and whether the Belgian lifetime extension should be opposed. The government answered that the water is slightly radioactive but contained with no impact on people or environment, admitted the initial communication was inadequate and will be tightened, and said Belgian lifetime extension is a Belgian competence that it will monitor closely.
The existing agreements on mutual information exchange and communication to the public will be tightened as a result.
De bestaande afspraken over onderlinge informatie-uitwisseling en communicatie naar het publiek zullen naar aanleiding hiervan worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over een MIVD-operatie in Afghanistan

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked the Defence Minister about reports that former MIVD staff in Afghanistan fear for their lives after a major's public admission of a secret operation, and about protection, a years-long procedure, and a possible lawsuit. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to comment on intelligence operations and individual cases, and said no lawsuit has been filed, only a lawyer's letter that is being studied.
As you know, I do not make public statements about intelligence operations and individual cases.
Zoals bij u bekend is, doe ik over inlichtingenoperaties en individuele gevallen in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Ojik en Ploumen over kernwapenbeleid

MPs Karabulut, Van Ojik and Ploumen asked the Dutch government about US nuclear modernisation (B61 bombs, the F-35 nuclear role, transport and accident safety) and whether the Netherlands should refuse nuclear weapons. The minister declined to give locations, numbers and transport details on alliance grounds, said the F-35 will take over the nuclear-capable role from the F-16 in line with prior policy, and pointed to a forthcoming AIV advisory report.
As the House is aware, under alliance arrangements no information can be provided on the numbers and locations of US nuclear weapons present in Europe.
Zoals de Kamer bekend kunnen op basis van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Nederland de militaire banden met Iran aanhaalt

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Defence whether the Netherlands is strengthening military ties with Iran, whether Iran threatens the West and Israel, and what the Defence department plans. The government confirmed that a defence attaché will be posted in Tehran to monitor military developments, while stating its concern about Iran's regional role and missile programme and its support for an EU dialogue with Iran.
Because of the Dutch interests in the region and Iran's role in it, it was chosen to place the new defence attaché in Tehran itself.
Vanwege de Nederlandse belangen in de regio en de rol van Iran daarin is ervoor gekozen de nieuwe defat in Teheran zelf te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Helvert en Voordewind over het benoemen van een defensieattaché in Iran

MPs from the SGP, PVV, CDA and ChristenUnie asked why the Netherlands plans to station a defence attaché in Tehran, how this relates to Iran's regional ambitions and missile programme, and to possible EU sanctions. The government answers that the posting improves monitoring of military developments and contacts with Iranian authorities, and that a parallel dialogue with Iran does not exclude concern about the missile programme.
Because of the Dutch interests in the region and Iran's role in it, it was chosen to station the new defence attaché in Tehran itself.
Vanwege de Nederlandse belangen in de regio en de rol van Iran daarin is ervoor gekozen de nieuwe defat in Teheran zelf te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over het afbreken van een inlichtingenoperatie naar aanleiding van de verklaring van een oud-commando

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked the Minister of Defence whether special forces were recalled early from a mission after a former commando's statement about a hostage incident, whether the operation was an intelligence operation under the intelligence services act, and whether democratic oversight of secret operations should be improved. The minister declined to comment publicly on intelligence operations, stated that no state secrets were disclosed and that officials assess their own statements, and referred to a separate letter on oversight of special operations; the Public Prosecution Service is investigating the statement.
Do you share the view that democratic oversight, given the major impact of such missions on society and the revelations of Major Kroon, should be improved?
Deelt u de opvatting dat de democratische controle, gezien de grote impact van dergelijke missies op samenleving alsmede de onthullingen van majoor Kroon, verbeterd dient te worden?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het schenden van oorlogsgraven in de Waddenzee en de Noordzee

An MP asked the Defence and Culture ministers about looting of WWI-era war wrecks (British submarines E3 and E5, German cruiser SMS Mainz) in the Wadden Sea and North Sea and how these war graves are registered and protected. The government answered that protection is hard to guarantee at sea, described the stricter Heritage Act rules and a planned UNESCO convention, and promised to restate existing agreements to divers and deepen cooperation.
For war wrecks of foreign warships found in Dutch waters, including HMS E3 and HMS E5, the Netherlands does not structurally search for relatives of the crew members who died on those ships.

Ten aanzien van in Nederlandse wateren aangetroffen oorlogswrakken van buitenlandse oorlogsschepen, waaronder ook HMS E3 en HMS E5, wordt niet structureel vanuit Nederland gezocht naar nabestaanden van op die schepen omgekomen bemanningsleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Luchtmacht baas wil extra aandacht voor veiligheidscultuur na lekken'

MP Ploumen asked the Defence Minister about the Air Force commander's email to staff stressing safety culture after leaks to the press, questioning whether staff felt unable to raise concerns internally. The state secretary replied that the commander's email was a routine daily order encouraging reporting through existing channels, described the reporting and anonymous-report procedures, and announced measures in a safety action plan to improve reporting willingness.
In the action plan 'A safe defence organisation' sent to your House on 28 March, Defence commits to measures to increase staff willingness to report and to strengthen its capacity to learn.

In het op 28 maart jongstleden aan uw Kamer verstuurde plan van aanpak «Een veilige defensieorganisatie» nemen we als Defensie maatregelen om de meldingsbereidheid bij medewerkers te verhogen en het lerend vermogen te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Rol Belgie in geheime operatie tegen IS’

MPs Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the Defence Minister whether Dutch intelligence supports the US-led operation Gallant Phoenix against IS, including Dutch involvement in searching a database in Jordan, and whether they had contacted their Belgian counterpart. The minister said there was no contact with the Belgian minister, that Nederland shares intelligence within the anti-ISIS coalition, and that for operational security she does not comment on specific intelligence activities.
For reasons of operational security, the cabinet makes no statements about specific activities in the intelligence domain.
In het kader van de operationele veiligheid doet het kabinet geen uitspraken over specifieke werkzaamheden in het inlichtingendomein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de ontwikkeling en het gebruik van ‘killer robots’

An SGP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about the development and use of 'killer robots' and the legal and ethical frameworks governing them. The government answered that meaningful human control must always be retained, that fully autonomous weapons are rejected in principle, and that existing international humanitarian law and weapons reviews under Article 36 provide the safeguards, while committing to revisit the advisory report in 2020.
According to the cabinet, people must always remain responsible and accountable for the use of weapon systems.
Volgens het kabinet moeten mensen altijd verantwoordelijk en aansprakelijk blijven voor de inzet van wapensystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Helvert over berichten dat Belgische en Duitse defensiehelikopters met grote problemen kampen

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Helvert asked the Defence Minister about reports that Belgian and German defence helicopters have serious availability problems, and what this means for Dutch operations in Mali. The government answered that the Belgian NFH-90 retrofit affects the Belgian contribution to MINUSMA only marginally, that the Dutch NH-90 upgrade is planned around operations, that Germany's helicopter fleet is a German matter, and that no change to Dutch operations is needed, while promising to inform parliament about helicopter capacity for the second half of 2018.
As soon as more is known about the deployment of helicopter capacity in the second half of 2018, you will be informed, as I promised you during the committee debate of 4 December 2017.
Zodra meer bekend is over de inzet van helikoptercapaciteit in de tweede helft van 2018 wordt u hierover geïnformeerd, zoals ik u tijdens het algemeen overleg van 4 december 2017 heb toegezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over vluchtende dieren door heliherrie

An MP from the Partij voor de Dieren asks the Defence Minister about animals fleeing and losing milk due to low-flying Apache helicopter exercises, including notification, the choice of site, the late publication of the permit, complaints, and scientific evidence on animal disturbance. The Secretary of State answers that the authorities were informed, the exercise was necessary for readiness, 278 reports were received, and damage claims will be compensated, but declines to halt the exercises and gives no noise measurements.
Decisions announcing large-scale exercises will in future be published at the earliest possible stage and preferably at least 4 weeks before an exercise begins.

Beschikkingen waarmee grootschalige oefeningen bekend worden gemaakt, zullen voortaan in een zo vroeg mogelijk stadium en bij voorkeur uiterlijk 4 weken voor de aanvang van een oefening worden gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over Wifi op de kazerne in Schaarsbergen

An MP asked the Defence Minister about alcohol, drug, prostitution and bullying problems at the Schaarsbergen barracks, linked to boredom and poor internet, TV and mobile reception there. The state secretary acknowledged the problems and said boredom is no excuse for misconduct, while describing ongoing measures to improve bandwidth, mobile coverage and evening activities, with broadband upgrades planned for Schaarsbergen within six months.
Boredom can never be an excuse for misconduct.
Verveling kan nooit een excuus zijn voor normoverschrijdend gedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitzending ‘2Doc: liever dood dan vermist’

MP Van Haga asks ministers about a documentary on unrecovered WWII aircraft wrecks, including the municipal discretion over salvage, cost sharing, and calls for harmonisation. The government acknowledges the emotional concerns, defends municipal discretion on safety and public order grounds, notes a 70% Rijk contribution and a working group on a decision framework, but does not change the rules.
The national government is willing to contribute to harmonising municipal policy.
Het Rijk is bereid een bijdrage te leveren aan het harmoniseren van het gemeentelijk beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van der Graaf over de televisie-uitzending ‘Liever dood dan vermist’

MPs Van der Molen and Van der Graaf asked ministers about a TV documentary on missing WWII airmen and whether municipalities can be induced to recover aircraft wrecks. The government answers that recovery is a local decision, that it lacks an overview of refused requests, that it will help harmonise municipal policy via a framework being developed, and that the framework is delayed by complexity and many parties.
The central government has no overview of that.
Daar heeft de rijksoverheid geen overzicht van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat Nederlandse infrastructuren onvoldoende zijn gedimensioneerd op het transport van zwaar militair materiaal

An MP asked whether Dutch infrastructure is still dimensioned for heavy military transport, and whether the Commander of the Armed Forces' warning about mobility risks is accepted. The ministers answered that current standards suffice for military transport, that bottlenecks are being mapped, and that EU and NATO initiatives are underway, but gave no firm national inventory timeline.
Currently it is being examined which infrastructural, legal and regulatory obstacles exist in the Netherlands.
Momenteel wordt onderzocht welke infrastructurele, juridische en regelgevende belemmeringen in Nederland precies gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de belemmering van de uitrol van 5G

The MP Moorlag asks whether the intelligence services' use of the 3.5 GHz band near the Burum satellite station blocks 5G rollout in the north, and what alternatives exist. The government answers that the 2011 restriction above the Amsterdam-Zwolle line remains until 2023, that a shielding screen proved infeasible, that alternative solutions are being studied with a decision and information to parliament expected mid-year, and that it is too early to say who bears any extra cost.
Your House is expected to be informed about the possible solution directions around mid-year.
Uw Kamer zal naar verwachting medio dit jaar over de mogelijke oplossingsrichtingen worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Belhaj en Weverling over de berichten 'Spionnenjacht blokt 5G' en 'Arena geen proeftuin voor nieuwste generatie mobiel internet'

MPs Paternotte, Belhaj and Weverling asked about press reports that intelligence services are blocking 5G rollout in the 3.5 GHz band and that the Amsterdam Arena cannot serve as a 5G testbed. The State Secretary says the rollout is important, that talks with intelligence services and neighbouring countries are ongoing, and that a solution and options will be sent to parliament around mid-2018.

Both the ministers of Defence and of the Interior and the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and Climate are working to find, on the basis of technical research, solution options for making the 3.5 GHz band available.

Zowel de ministers van Defensie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijkrelaties als de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en Klimaat zetten zich in om op basis van technisch onderzoek tot oplossingsmogelijkheden te komen voor de beschikbaarstelling van de 3,5 GHz-band.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat kleine vliegvelden vrij spel zijn voor criminelen

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister whether small airports are open to criminals, how much border-control capacity the Marechaussee lacks, what legislation must change to require digital advance passenger notifications, and whether the borders should close immediately. The Minister said the Marechaussee handles border checks only at designated border posts while police and customs cover smaller airports, that capacity is being expanded, that EU rules leave the timing of general declarations open and national rules could tighten them, and that the government does not favour immediate border closure.
To carry out the control task it is desirable that the information be supplied digitally a prescribed number of hours before entry into the Schengen area.
Ter uitvoering van de controletaak is het gewenst dat de informatie een voorgeschreven aantal uur voor binnenkomst in het Schengenland digitaal wordt aangeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Belhaj over fraude met oorlogswrakken in de Java-zee

Two MPs (Van Haga and Belhaj) asked ministers of Defence and Education, Culture and Science about reports of illegal salvage of Dutch WWII wrecks in the Java Sea, including permits and possible mass burial of remains. The ministers answered that Indonesia denies issuing permits, that the coordinates do not match the wrecks, that further joint on-site investigation is being arranged, and that next of kin are being informed.
The Netherlands is therefore currently in close consultation with the Indonesian authorities about the possibility of follow-up on-site investigation.
Nederland voert daarom op dit ogenblik nauw overleg met de Indonesische autoriteiten over de mogelijkheid van vervolgonderzoek ter plaatse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving dat resten van zeehelden op de vuilnisbelt liggen

An MP asked the Defence, Foreign Affairs and Health ministers about reports that human remains of Dutch naval war dead lie at dump sites near the Java Sea, and whether the government will recover and rebury them. The government confirmed contact with Indonesia and other flag states, offered help and requested on-site investigation, and said it will inform the families and parliament once there is clarity, though it cannot yet give a timeline.
Once there is clarity about the on-site investigation, we will inform you of this.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is over het onderzoek ter plaatse, zullen wij u hierover berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de korte training tijdens de Uruzganmissie fataal werd

An MP asks the Defence Minister about reports that a short pre-deployment training preceded fatal friendly-fire incidents in Uruzgan in 2008, whether inadequate training was to blame, and whether Defence routinely sets too high an ambition level. The Minister answers that the unit was ready, that the internal investigation found training limitations and tactical procedure lapses, and that the incident resulted from a combination of circumstances rather than a single cause or a systemic overambition.
Defence's investigation shows that the unit was ready for the mission.
Het onderzoek van Defensie laat zien dat de eenheid klaar was voor de missie.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat de Venezolaanse raffinaderij PDVSA Curaçao wil verlaten (ingezonden 3 maart 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary whether Venezuela's PDVSA would withdraw from its Curaçao refinery over US military activity, and about the consequences for alternatives and cleanup costs and the liability of Shell. The state secretary replied that no official notice of withdrawal was received, PDVSA announced a USD 1.5 billion investment, and the cost-recovery study is being prepared by Curaçao with Dutch assistance, with no firm answer on legal liability yet.
It is therefore not yet possible at this time to make a statement about legal possibilities for financial compensation regarding the cleanup of environmental pollution by the refinery.
Het is op dit moment dus nog niet mogelijk een uitspraak te doen over juridische mogelijkheden voor financiële compensatie betreffende de sanering van de milieuvervuiling door de raffinaderij.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een experiment in Almere met vier personen op een tankspuitwagen. (Ingezonden 11 februari 2010)

The MP Van Raak asks the minister about a pilot in Almere reducing fire engine crews to four personnel, questioning safety, cost, consultation with staff and the link to the debate on the veiligheidsregio's regulation. The state secretary answers that the pilot responds to a shortage of volunteers, that costs will rise, that risks were assessed and works councils consulted, and that a revised regulation on crew deviations will be sent to parliament soon.

I do not share the works council's concerns because a careful consideration also took place here and a somewhat faster first deployment with a smaller crew was chosen, with a backup from another post if needed.

Ik deel de zorgen van de OR niet omdat ook hier zorgvuldige afweging heeft plaatsgevonden en omdat gekozen is voor een zekere snellere eerste inzet met een kleinere bezetting en indien nodig een back up voorziening vanuit een andere post.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de centrale opslag van vingerafdrukken (ingezonden 16 maart 2010).

The MP asks whether fingerprints taken for passports are stored in the RAAS system managed by Sagem Identification, why a commercial firm runs it, how transmission and access are secured, and what happens to the data on bankruptcy. The minister confirms storage in RAAS since 2001, states that transmission is encrypted and access is controlled and screened, that the ministry can audit the producer, and that the data belongs to the state and falls outside any bankruptcy.
The Ministry of BZK has the right to carry out checks at the producer of Dutch travel documents.
Het ministerie van BZK heeft het recht om bij de producent van de Nederlandse reisdocumenten controles uit te voeren.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een WOB-verzoek van een student over toezicht op brandveiligheid. (ingezonden 17 februari 2010).

MP Van Raak asks the minister about a student's Wob (freedom of information) request on fire-safety supervision, which the student withdrew when a municipality signalled fees, and about municipal Wob fees and ratification of the Tromsø Convention. The state secretary replies that municipalities set their own fees and fire-safety supervision, that no integral picture of municipal fire safety exists, and that the Tromsø Convention's fee rules will be reviewed once the government takes a position.
It has therefore been left to the decentralised authorities themselves to set the tariffs for this.
Het is zodoende aan de decentrale overheden zelf overgelaten om tarieven hierover vast te stellen.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afgewezen informatieverzoeken van een student (ingezonden 17 februari 2010).

An MP asks whether a Haagse Hogeschool forced a student to apologise and redo his thesis after Wob freedom-of-information requests, and whether the VNG discouraged the student. The government denies the school coerced him, says he withdrew his requests himself over possible fees, and says VNG advice and the school's handling are not its responsibility.
No, the Haagse Hogeschool did not hinder the student in his right under the Wob to submit requests to various municipalities.
Nee, de Haagse Hogeschool heeft de student niet belemmerd in zijn recht om op grond van de Wob een verzoek aan verschillende gemeenten te doen.

Vragen van de leden Anker (ChristenUnie) en Knops (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de verschillen in grafkosten bij gemeenten (ingezonden 11 maart 2010).

MPs Anker and Knops asked the state secretary about large differences in municipal grave fees, the status of a motion requesting a cost-calculation model from the VNG, and why no step-by-step method for grave cost allocation has yet been delivered. The secretary replied that the revised cost-allocation handbook and a cost-substantiation model already exist, that the VNG will publish a grave-cost example in 2010, and that municipalities remain autonomous in setting fees.
Municipalities are autonomous in setting the fees for graves, with a maximum of cost recovery at the level of the ordinance naturally applying.
Gemeenten zijn autonoom in het vaststellen van de leges met betrekking tot graven, waarbij uiteraard een maximum geldt van kostendekkendheid op het niveau van de verordening.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Verkeer en Waterstaat over

An MP asked whether dust levels on Bonaire exceeding Antillean norms, and their likely health risks, warrant action. The state secretary answered that the indicative study cannot establish health harm, that Dutch air-quality norms do not apply to the Caribbean islands, and that the island authority is responsible for further research and measures, with the ministry offering advisory support.

It is up to the local competent authority, in this case the island territory of Bonaire, to assess the indicative study, possibly conduct further research, and on that basis select measures, draw up a programme and implement it.

Het is aan het lokale bevoegd gezag – in deze het eilandgebied Bonaire – om het indicatieve onderzoek te beoordelen, eventueel aanvullend onderzoek te doen en op basis daarvan maatregelen te selecteren.

Vragen van de leden Van Gent (GroenLinks) en Remkes (VVD) aan de staatssecretarissen van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over illegale abortuspraktijken op de Antillen e

MPs Van Gent and Remkes asked the state secretaries about the consequences of the abortion ban on the Antilles and Aruba, including the health risks of illegal abortion, enforcement, and whether to reconsider the ban and fund public information campaigns. The government said it shares concern about illegal abortion practices, will await the Antillean and Aruban governments' answers before choosing an approach, and noted that responsibility lies with those governments.
I have informed the governments of the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba of your questions 2 through 5 and asked them to provide the requested information at short notice.
Ik heb de regeringen van de Nederlandse Antillen en Aruba op de hoogte gesteld van uw vragen 2 t/m 5 en hen verzocht de door u gevraagde informatie op korte termijn aan te leveren.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het riante wachtgeld voor de opgestapte PvdA-bewindslieden (ingezonden 16 maart 2010).

PVV MPs Wilders and Brinkman asked the state secretary of Interior Affairs about the generous severance allowance (wachtgeld) for departed PvdA ministers and state secretaries, arguing it is unjustified since they left voluntarily, and asked whether the scheme should be abolished or politicians placed under the unemployment benefit law. The state secretary replied that the allowance regime for political office holders (Appa) was recently tightened, that the old rules still apply to recent departures, and that a separate regime for political office holders remains justified given political risk and the need for accessible public office.
The regime has been very recently adjusted and tightened in a number of respects.
Het regime is zeer recent aangepast en op een aantal onderdelen versoberd.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een afscheidsbonus voor een gemeentelijke ambtenaar (ingezonden 22 februari 2010).

Van Raak (SP) asks the minister whether a Doetinchem municipal official's 187,500 guilder payment in 2000, tied to a private company directorship, was proper, whether such side functions and allowances are allowed, and whether the municipality can reclaim it. The state secretary answers that the payment came from a private firm in which the municipality was a shareholder, not from the official's public role, that the municipality had no knowledge of it until 2008, and that no recovery is possible.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Graus (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een gemeentesecretaris in Heerlen (ingezonden 1 maart 2010).

MPs Brinkman and Graus asked whether the government finds it unacceptable that an externally hired municipal secretary in Heerlen cost 240,000 euros in nine months, and whether such municipalities should be penalised through the Municipal Fund. The minister responded that top incomes in the public sector should be reasonable, pointed to a pending bill (WNT) that will cap pay of externally hired officials, and said municipalities are free to spend Municipal Fund money with accountability to local councils, so no sanction is planned.
Money from the Municipal Fund may be freely spent by municipalities.
Gelden uit het Gemeentefonds zijn door gemeenten vrij te besteden.
Vragen van het lid Schinkelshoek (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het gedwongen opstappen van burgemeesters (ingezonden 2 maart 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether the resignation of a mayor who lost the confidence of the municipal council is an automatism, whether the minister has a role, and whether a cooling-off period should apply. The state secretary answered that the council must consult the commissioner of the King and observe a cooling-off period of at least two weeks before declaring a disrupted relationship, that the minister's role is limited, and that the commissioner acts as a mediator.
The role of the minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations in disrupted relationships between council and mayor is limited.
De rol van de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties bij verstoorde verhoudingen tussen raad en burgemeester is beperkt.

Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de benoeming van een gemeentesecretaris van de nog te vormen gemeente Súdwest Fryslân (ingezonden 22 februari 20

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the early appointment of a municipal secretary for the planned merged municipality of Súdwest Fryslân was premature before Parliament has decided on the merger, and what options exist to stop irreversible preparatory decisions. The State Secretary answered that the appointment is necessary for integration work, that municipalities bear responsibility for such decisions, and that he has no powers to block local appointments.
I do not have the powers to block the appointment of civil servants at local level.
Ik beschik niet over de bevoegdheden om de benoeming van ambtenaren op lokaal niveau tegen te houden.

CDA MPs asked the state secretaries whether Gorinchem's guarantees on loans to a property developer, and to a for-profit care provider, were lawful, and whether the province should investigate. The government admitted the municipality bypassed its own treasury statute requiring council approval, but said provincial supervision does not cover guarantees and declined to demand a further investigation.
The municipal executive itself then admitted that in this case it had not applied the municipality's treasury statute.
Het college van B en W heeft vervolgens zelf toegegeven in dit geval het treasurystatuut van de gemeente niet te hebben toegepast.

An MP asks whether the municipality of Noordenveld is shifting its financing problem onto businesses by extending its payment term to 60 days, and whether the government will press it to keep the 30-day norm. The state secretary respects municipal autonomy over payment terms, says the municipality has been informed of the national 30-day norm and the VNG agreement, and notes a forthcoming EU directive with a proposed 2% penalty for late payment.
I respect the autonomous power of municipalities to set rules for their payment terms.
Ik respecteer de autonome bevoegdheid van gemeenten om regels te stellen voor hun betalingstermijn.

An MP asks the Ministers of Interior and Economic Affairs about municipality Noordenveld demanding a 2% discount on invoices for prompt payment and paying late invoices after 60 days, and whether other municipalities do the same and what measures will be taken. The state secretary responds that municipalities have autonomy over payment terms, that the national government has informed Noordenveld of the 30-day standard and a planned EU directive with a 2% penalty for overdue public payments, and that it is not known whether other municipalities impose similar demands.
I respect the autonomous competence of municipalities to set rules for their payment terms.
Ik respecteer de autonome bevoegdheid van gemeenten om regels te stellen voor hun betalingstermijn.

MPs Blanksma-van den Heuvel and Vietsch asked how and when the government would inform parliament about late payments by subnational authorities beyond the 30-day limit, and whether a statutory 30-day payment term with a 2% penalty should be legislated in light of the forthcoming EU directive. The state secretary replied that the motion was treated as a call for consultation with representative bodies rather than individual municipalities, asked that it be considered handled, and said national legislation is not currently on the agenda because EU negotiations are ongoing.
Since the preparatory negotiations are in full swing, national legislation in anticipation of the Directive is currently not on the agenda.
Aangezien de voorbereidende onderhandelingen in volle gang zijn is nationale regelgeving, vooruitlopend op de Richtlijn, momenteel niet aan de orde.

MPs Omtzigt and Sterk asked whether children of seconded civil servants must be insured under the Zorgverzekeringswet, whether parents must provide a BSN when insurers request it, and how children born abroad to Dutch parents can obtain a BSN. The government answered that such children are insurable and parents must enrol them, that insurers may not refuse enrolment for lack of a BSN (a bill to clarify this is pending), and that children abroad cannot get a BSN but can request a sofinummer from the Belastingdienst, including by mail.
In the bill on tracing and insuring the uninsured (32 150), it is therefore clarified that an health insurer may not refuse to enrol someone if no BSN or sofinummer is provided.

In het wetsvoorstel Opsporing en verzekering onverzekerden zorgverzekering (32 150), wordt daarom verduidelijkt dat een zorgverzekeraar niet mag weigeren iemand in te schrijven als geen BSN of sofinummer wordt overgelegd.

An MP asked the state secretary about the status of negotiations with Bonaire on constitutional reform, whether UPB-linked officials on the election list are involved in drug trafficking, money laundering and corruption, and whether UPB still influences the talks, and whether the outcomes should be reversed. The government answered that talks with Bonaire are largely suspended pending the executive council's desired referendum, that the money laundering probe is an autonomous Antillean prosecution it cannot comment on, and that it negotiates with island leaders backed by democratically elected majorities.

A investigation into money laundering linked to international organised drug trafficking in the Antilles is currently being carried out under the direction of the Public Prosecution Service of the Netherlands Antilles.

Momenteel vindt er in opdracht en onder leiding van het Openbaar Ministerie van de Nederlandse Antillen een onderzoek plaats naar witwaspraktijken in relatie tot de internationale georganiseerde drugshandel op de Antillen.

MPs Leerdam and Kalma asked the State Secretary of Interior about the Bonaire referendum ordinance, which limits voting rights for European Dutch residents to those who lived on the island before 1 January 2007, contrary to a UN recommendation and the 2004 and Antilles rules. The answer, deferred to a letter of 2 March 2010, is not reproduced in the text, so the government's substantive position cannot be coded.
Are you willing to ask the local authorities on Bonaire for clarification on this as soon as possible?
Bent u bereid om de lokale autoriteiten op Bonaire zo spoedig mogelijk om opheldering te vragen hierover?

MP Van Raak asked the State Secretary of the Interior why nearly 3,000 Rotterdam voters received two identical polling cards, whether other municipalities are affected, how checks work, and whether duplicate cards could disrupt the upcoming election. The State Secretary replied that issuing and distributing polling cards is the municipality's responsibility, that Rotterdam should check and correct errors and account to its council, that duplicates are invalidated and replaced under the Kieswet, and that a similar problem occurred in Hengelo.
It is up to the municipality of Rotterdam to ensure that checks take place and that errors, if they occur, are corrected.
Het is aan de gemeente Rotterdam om ervoor zorg te dragen dat er controles plaatsvinden en dat fouten, als die optreden, worden gecorrigeerd.

MPs Besselink and Depla asked the state secretary whether she had urged people not to buy new-build homes in shrinking regions, and why, given that this could worsen vacancy and leave municipalities and housing corporations bearing demolition costs when developers refuse to cancel projects without compensation. The state secretary denied issuing such a call, said she urged local administrators to take responsibility for a balanced housing market, and committed to a legal advisory follow-up and an approach to support administrators on the developer problem.
In my answer to question 1 I indicated that I did not make such a call.
In het antwoord op vraag 1 heb ik aangegeven dat ik een dergelijke oproep niet heb gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het Rapport 'de evacuatie uit Afghanistan' d.d. 12 december 2021 door Crisisplan

An MP asks the ministers of Defence, Foreign Affairs and Justice about the Crisisplan report on the Afghanistan evacuation, covering implementation of recommendations, the decision-making structure, the reduction of the evacuee list from 60 to 3, the role of the IND and the expanded definition of family members. The government answers that ministries have started implementing recommendations, that the reduction to 3 was an indicative order of magnitude, that all 58 extended family members were ultimately evacuated, and that it will report on implementation before summer.
Before the coming summer, the House will be informed about the implementation of the recommendations.
Voor de aankomende zomer zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd over de implementatie van de aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het controleren en koppelen van data van onschuldige mensen

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked why no privacy impact assessment was carried out for police project Athene, which automatically linked data from asylum seekers' phones to criminal information, and whether similar projects exist and how the Council of State's advice on phone reading would be followed. The Minister answers that the police overlooked the need for a privacy test after the GDPR transition, the test was done in November 2021 and the project ended, no data was shared, and the government will clarify the legal basis for reading digital data carriers and has amended rules to meet the Council of State's advice.
As a result, the assessment only took place in November 2021, after which the project was ended.
Hierdoor heeft de toets pas plaatsgevonden in november 2021, waarna het project is beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Podt over het bericht dat de politie onschuldige asielzoekers aan strafrechtelijke informatie koppelde

MPs Van Ginneken and Podt asked whether police wrongly matched asylum seekers' phone data against criminal intelligence, whether the data still exists and whether it was used in criminal cases. The government admits the Athene project lacked a legal basis after the 2019 privacy law change, says the project was stopped and the data destroyed, and says the Raad van State advice on statutory safeguards is taken to heart, while several questions get only partial or general answers.
That realisation came through a Data Protection Impact Assessment carried out within AVIM in November 2021 as part of a force-wide programme.
Dat besef kwam dankzij de uitvoering van een Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) 2 die in november 2021 binnen AVIM als onderdeel van een korpsbreed programma is gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over de interactie tussen organisaties inzake de situatie Afghanistan en het asiel- en migratiebeleid

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked how the IND was involved in deciding who could be evacuated or relocated from Afghanistan before and after 15 August 2021, and asked for internal advice, criteria and working instructions. The government answered that the IND was involved through questionnaires, document checks, social media checks and visa approval, that the IND's internal advice will be included in the pending Wob requests without a fixed date, and that the criteria were set via the existing tolkenregeling and later adjusted under the Belhaj motion amid extreme time pressure.
In handling the Wob requests, all relevant documents will be considered, including those of IND/DSUA.
Bij de behandeling van de WOB-verzoeken zullen alle relevante stukken worden betrokken, dus ook die van IND/DSUA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verkuijlen over het bericht de helft van de slachtoffers van mensenhandel binnen enkele jaren opnieuw slachtoffer van een misdrijf wordt
