An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a report finding that half of human trafficking victims become victims of another crime within seven years, and about gaps in protection, online surveillance, aid for labour-exploitation victims and youth transition. The government acknowledged the problem, described existing protection and support measures, and promised to address the issues in its policy response to the victim monitor.
I will take this issue into account in my policy response to the Victim Monitor.
Ik zal dit vraagstuk betrekken in mijn beleidsreactie op de Slachtoffermonitor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Gevluchte Afghanen moeten bij vertrek kleren achterlaten'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why Afghan evacuees must leave clothing and belongings behind when moved between temporary shelters, and what is being done about frequent relocations and the motion on a warm welcome. The State Secretary acknowledged the situation is undesirable, said COA tries to provide tailored transport and storage, and promised a separate letter on the motion's implementation.
This situation is undesirable and COA aims for more structural shelter where residents can stay longer.
Deze situatie is onwenselijk en het COA streeft naar meer structurele opvang waar bewoners langer kunnen verblijven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Koekkoek, Jasper van Dijk, Kröger, Piri en Ceder over het Fiche 'Voorstel voor een Raadsbesluit betreffende voorlopige noodmaatregelen ten behoeve van Letland, Litouwen en Polen'

Six MPs from D66, Volt, SP, GroenLinks, PvdA and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether emergency measures for Latvia, Lithuania and Poland under Article 78(3) TFEU are still necessary, legally grounded, time-limited and consistent with asylum and human rights safeguards, including the risk of pushbacks. The government answered that the Commission's assessment of an unprecedented influx from Belarus justifies the measures, that the measures are time-limited to six months, that they largely codify existing derogations, and that it will press these states on lawful border management while not withholding support for the proposal.
The government closely follows the situation at the borders with Belarus and considers the European Commission's assessment of the situation of great importance.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie aan de grenzen met Belarus nauwlettend en acht daarbij het oordeel van de Europese Commissie ten aanzien van de beoordeling van de situatie van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de juridische basis waarmee gemeentes gedwongen worden asielzoekers op te vangen

MP Omtzigt asked whether the Secretary of State's December 2021 letters 'designating' emergency asylum reception sites for Enschede, Gorinchem and the Rotterdam region have any legal basis, and whether this amounts to an unlawful directive to municipalities. The government replied that the letters are not legal directions, have no grounding in Dutch law and no public-law effect, were a request driven by an acute shortage of about 2,000 places, and that it would not be repeated lightly; it also declined to release a decision memo, saying none was written.
The directions have no basis in Dutch statute or regulation, as I stated during the Justice and Security budget debate in the Senate on 21 December.
De aanwijzingen hebben geen grondslag in Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving, zoals ik gemeld heb bij de begrotingsbehandeling JenV in de Eerste Kamer op 21 december jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de aanwijzing aan gemeenten over de huisvesting van asielzoekers

An SP MP asked why the government designated five municipalities to host asylum seekers by letter instead of seeking voluntary cooperation, and on what legal basis. The State Secretary answered that the letters were urgent designations without legal basis or legal effect, justified by the risk of emergency tent shelters, and that such designations are a last resort.
It is not a designation in the legal sense, and the letters therefore have no public-law legal effect.
Het betreft geen aanwijzing in juridische zin en de brieven hebben dan ook geen publiekrechtelijk rechtsgevolg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de Uitvoeringsagenda Flexibilisering Asielketen (mei 2020) en de Voortgang Flexibilisering Asielketen

The MP asks about the progress of the flexible asylum chain programme: whether the target-group approach works, the status of flexible reception locations and satellite sites, the knowledge desk, and the handover of measures after the programme ended. The State Secretary answers that the approach is being applied and refined, that few flexible locations exist because of acute shortages of places, that provincial plans are not yet complete, and that a progress letter is promised with the reply delayed.
Due to a combination of various pressing circumstances and the efforts devoted to them, it regrettably has not been possible to answer your questions in time.
Door een samenloop van verschillende prangende omstandigheden en de inzet die daarop gepleegd wordt, is het tot mijn spijt niet gelukt om uw vragen tijdig te beantwoorden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Weigermigranten buiten corona uit: 'Dit blijft een grote frustratie'' en 'GGD’s mogen binnenkort vaccinatiebewijzen afgeven aan mensen zonder BS

MPs Valstar and Aukje de Vries asked about asylum seekers refusing COVID tests, vaccination coverage in reception centres, and GGD-issued vaccination certificates for undocumented people. The government answered that all arrivals are tested but refusal has no sanction, that roughly half of centre residents are recorded as vaccinated, and that deportations were cancelled for test refusals, with the government exploring legal options for compulsory testing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over de noodopvang in Heumensoord

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about critical reports on the Heumensoord emergency asylum shelter, including ombudsman and human rights body findings, why conditions had not improved in five years, the psychological harm to asylum seekers, EU reception standards, and psychiatric care provision. The State Secretary acknowledged the shelter is not optimal, said it will close around mid-January 2022, described improvements and existing care and complaint arrangements, and maintained that Dutch reception exceeds EU minimum standards.
Heumensoord will therefore be scaled down as quickly as possible.
Heumensoord wordt dan ook zo snel mogelijk afgeschaald.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu, Teunissen, Simons, Van der Plas en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse Zaken weigert Afghaanse bewakers ambassade Kabul te evacueren’

MPs asked why Dutch embassy security guards employed via a subcontractor in Kabul were not evacuated while Hungarian guards were, and whether a new direct-employment criterion was introduced without informing parliament. The government answered that the criteria for evacuation (Belhaj motion) were unchanged, that embassy guards fall under host-state responsibility and their employer is responsible, and gave figures on remaining interpreters and Afghans awaiting transfer.
There is no question of a new criterion.
Er is geen sprake van een nieuw criterium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het permanente karakter van de hoge asielinstroom

Eerdmans (JA21) asked whether the high asylum inflow of over a thousand per week is permanent, whether there is a limit to what the Netherlands can handle, and what the government will do if it is reached. The State Secretary said the inflow is now a constant factor, cited seasonal and post-COVID effects, and rejected an absolute ceiling on asylum seekers as contrary to international and European law and impractical.
An absolute ceiling on the number of asylum seekers that can be accommodated in the Netherlands does not fit this principle.
Een absolute bovengrens op het aantal asielzoekers dat in Nederland kan worden opgevangen past niet bij dit uitgangspunt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paternotte over het bericht dat de toename van coronabesmettingen in Goes veroorzaakt is door een uitbraak in de noodopvang

MPs Podt and Paternotte asked the Health Minister, on behalf of the Justice State Secretary, about reports that a rise in COVID-19 cases in Goes was caused by an outbreak in an emergency asylum reception centre, and about vaccination, quarantine, distancing and information in asylum locations. The minister answered each question in general terms, stating that current measures and protocols are in place, vaccination is offered and quarantine capacity is sufficient, and admitted that answering each question separately before the plenary debate was not achieved due to workload.
Unfortunately, that has not been achieved due to busy schedules.
Dat is vanwege drukte helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht 'Undercover naar de moskee: geheim onderzoek naar islamitische organisaties'

The MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that municipalities covertly commissioned NTA to analyse mosques and Islamic organisations, raising legality, privacy and NCTV responsibility. The Minister answered that the agreements were between municipalities and NTA so he cannot judge legality, that the NCTV had internal concerns in 2017 and it will strengthen guidance and conditions, and that he will restore trust with Islamic organisations.

Because the precise agreements on carrying out and delivering the power-field analyses were made between municipalities and NTA, I cannot make statements on whether unlawful investigative methods were used.

Omdat de precieze afspraken over de uitvoering en oplevering van de krachtenveldanalyses gemaakt zijn tussen gemeenten en NTA, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de vraag of er onrechtmatige onderzoeksmethodieken hebben plaatsgevonden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de aangenomen motie-Van der Plas over inventariseren welke gebouwen van de rijksoverheid geschikt kunnen worden gemaakt voor opvang van Afghanen of andere vluchtelingen ui

An MP asked whether the government would send a letter on how the adopted Van der Plas motion, to inventory state buildings usable for housing Afghan and other refugees, is being carried out. The State Secretary replied that the letter was sent on 12 November and that the motion is considered implemented, citing use of Defence barracks, offices and prisons, and a survey of state land and buildings.
We therefore consider this motion to be implemented.
Daarmee beschouwen wij deze motie als uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de situatie op de Griekse vluchtelingekampen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary about access restrictions, gated entry and detention concerns at new Greek island reception camps built with EU funds, and about camp conditions and winter preparation. The government replied that the Greek state now provides services previously delivered by NGOs, that gate access is controlled by biometric passes with daytime free movement, that the European Commission oversees compliance with EU reception rules, and that winter and Afghan-arrival preparations are ongoing without a specific Greek request for Dutch support.
I share with the House the principle that civil society organisations should have as much access as possible to locations where asylum seekers are received, but this need not be automatic.

Met uw Kamer onderschrijf ik het uitgangspunt dat maatschappelijke organisaties zo veel mogelijk toegang moeten hebben tot locaties waar asielzoekers worden opgevangen, maar dit hoeft geen automatisme te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Minhas over het bericht 'Meer incidenten met asielzoekers in trein Emmen-Zwolle, personeel ziek thuis'

MPs Valstar and Minhas asked about rising incidents involving asylum seekers on the Emmen-Zwolle train line, sick leave among staff, and measures taken, including bodycams, travel bans, guards and funding for a shuttle bus. The State Secretary confirmed the increase, described measures such as limited enforcement powers for supervisors and the HTL placement option, but said incident data do not record residence status and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
The police and transport operators do not register the residence status of persons involved in incidents.
De politie en vervoerders registreren niet op verblijfsstatus van personen die betrokken zijn bij incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van Ginneken over het onderzoek 'Transcript from the Margins'

MPs Podt and Van Ginneken asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the 'Transcript from the Margins' report on how the asylum procedure treats transgender applicants, including IND reliance on country information, the sourcing of ambtsberichten, misgendering in communication, and complaints. The State Secretary replied that individual assessments take the applicant's position into account, that the small sample limits representativeness, that IND will meet Transgender Netwerk Nederland, and that complaints about transgender applicants cannot be traced because asylum motive is not registered.
Following the report, the IND has therefore extended an invitation to Transgender Netwerk Nederland to meet with the IND's LHBTI coordinators.
De IND heeft naar aanleiding van het rapport daarom een uitnodiging verstrekt aan Transgender Netwerk Nederland om in gesprek te treden met de LHBTI-coördinatoren van de IND.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over een nieuw azc

An MP asked whether the Expo Assen hall is being used as an asylum reception location, what it costs, and why the government keeps housing asylum seekers at the expense of Dutch citizens and businesses, and asked when borders will be closed. The Secretary of State confirmed Expo Assen is used as temporary emergency reception until end of March 2022 for about 300 people, declined to provide business information as a private organisation, and stated the government respects international obligations and will keep asking municipalities and provinces for reception places.
Expo Assen is a private organisation and I therefore do not have the business information you requested.
Expo Assen is een private organisatie en ik beschik derhalve niet over de door u gevraagde bedrijfsinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Jasper van Dijk en Teunissen over de onveilige situatie in Georgië voor asielzoekers met een LHBTI-achtergrond

MPs Kröger, Van Dijk and Teunissen asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether Georgia remains unsafe for LHBTI asylum seekers and whether it should stop being treated as a safe country of origin for this group, including whether removals should be halted. The State Secretary replied that the designation of Georgia as a safe country of origin continues, with heightened attention for LHBTI cases, that no change in the situation is seen, and that no halt to removals is warranted, while declining to comment on individual cases.
I do not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Ellemeet, Koekkoek en Teunissen over het bericht over mogelijke push back van een groep van 27 vluchtelingen op het Griekse eiland Lesbos

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary about reports of a group of 27 refugees hiding on Lesbos to avoid alleged pushback, including claims of a pushback of a minor, unlawful strip searches of detained activists, Greek laws criminalising aid and restricting lawyers, and the status of an independent EU monitoring mechanism. The government answered that it awaits findings from Greek and EU investigations, supports an independent monitoring mechanism, notes the Commission is responsible for enforcement, and does not accept that pushbacks are normal practice.
In the absence of independent information, I await the results of such investigations.
Bij het ontbreken van eigenstandige informatie wacht ik de resultaten van dergelijke onderzoeken af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over de toename van incidenten met asielzoekers in de Nederlandse treinen

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretaries whether train staff will be protected against incidents with asylum seekers, whether asylum seekers causing nuisance can be sent back, and whether borders will be closed. The government answered that all nuisance is unacceptable and is handled through reporting, extra staff and a harder zero-tolerance approach, but that closing borders is not realistic and that nuisance alone is not legal grounds for rejecting an asylum application.

As stated in the answers to earlier questions from your House, causing nuisance on public transport legally provides insufficient grounds to reject an asylum application and to proceed to direct removal.

Zoals vermeld in de beantwoording van eerdere vragen van uw Kamer, biedt het veroorzaken van overlast in het openbaar vervoer wettelijk gezien onvoldoende grond om over te gaan tot afwijzing van een asielaanvraag en tot directe uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Asielzoekerscentra bomvol: 'We zitten tegen crisisnoodopvang aan'' en 'Afghanen de druppel'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Minister of the Interior about the overcrowding of asylum reception centres, the causes of the shortage, and the government's plans to expand capacity and speed up the outflow of status holders. The government answers that all regular reception places are full, attributes this to rising inflow, slow housing of status holders by municipalities and reception capacity pressures, and describes efforts to add temporary places, flexible housing pilots and IND backlog measures.
With this, all regular reception places are occupied and various forms of emergency reception are now being used.
Daarmee zijn alle reguliere opvangplekken bezet en wordt nu verschillende vormen van noodopvang ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het nieuwsartikel 'Raad van Europa: Nederlandse rechter normaliseert discriminatie door marechaussee'

MP Azarkan asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of the Interior about press reports on a Council of Europe rapporteur's criticism of ethnic profiling by the Royal Marechaussee and a court ruling that ethnicity may play a role in selection for mobile security checks, asking about training, complaint routes, the use of skin colour and ethnicity in risk profiles, and whether a ban is planned. The government answered that it opposes discrimination, that the court ruling is limited to mobile security checks and is under appeal, that training and complaint procedures exist, and that a cabinet position on ethnicity and nationality in risk profiles will follow after the College voor de rechten van de mens publishes its legal framework, with no ban committed to yet.
The cabinet considers it important to provide clarity on the legal frameworks that apply and are applied in the Netherlands regarding the use of ethnicity and nationality in risk models.

Het kabinet acht het van belang helderheid te bieden over de juridische kaders die van toepassing zijn en in Nederland worden toegepast ten aanzien van het gebruik van etniciteit en nationaliteit in risicomodellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over interactie asiel- en migratiebeleid en evacuaties Afghanistan

Volt MPs asked the government about the Afghanistan evacuations, including whether correspondence between ministries and the IND would be shared, the IND's role in evacuation lists, and how asylum policy relates to crisis situations. The state secretary answered that correspondence will be released via pending FOI requests with no firm timeline, that the IND had a limited support role without staff in Kabul, and that the asylum policy framework accommodates crisis situations.
Your House will therefore receive an overview of the information disclosed in this context at or immediately after its publication.
Uw Kamer zal dan ook een overzicht van de in dit kader geopenbaarde informatie ontvangen bij of onmiddellijk na de openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de uitkomst van de JBZ-Raad.

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a joint letter from twelve member states calling for EU funds to be used for barriers at external borders, and about the Dutch position on such barriers. The government answered that it shares concern about instrumentalised migration via Belarus, sees EU funds (BMVI) as supporting integrated border management, sees no concrete proposal to fund physical barriers, and that the Netherlands will judge any proposal on its merits.
At the same time, the cabinet notes that there is currently no concrete proposal to use this fund, or other EU funds, specifically for financing such barriers at the EU external borders.

Tegelijkertijd merkt het kabinet op dat er op dit moment geen concreet voorstel ligt om dit fonds, dan wel andere EU-fondsen, specifiek aan te wenden voor de financiering van dergelijke barrières aan de EU-buitengrenzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de opvangplekken bij het COA

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the decline and recent shortage of COA reception places, the waiting times for status holders, the lack of local support, and proposals for smaller, evenly spread shelters and reserve capacity. The State Secretary answered at length, explaining that places fluctuate with inflow and expiring municipal agreements, giving occupancy and processing figures, announcing temporary emergency shelters and reserve funding, but declining to commit to the SP's proposals.
I agree that it is undesirable for neighbours to rent or buy up premises to prevent asylum seekers or permit holders from moving in.
Ik ben het met u eens dat het onwenselijk is dat buurtbewoners panden huren of opkopen om zo te voorkomen dat er asielzoekers of vergunninghouders komen te wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Ter Apel overvol is

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about overcrowding at the Ter Apel asylum registration centre, including people sleeping in tents and on chairs, and why the surge was not foreseen and whether COA and the municipality have enough means to tackle nuisance. The State Secretary acknowledged the situation is unacceptable, described measures taken (extra provincial places, emergency locations, a 150,000 euro grant to Westerwolde, a toolbox against nuisance) and said the capacity shortage was not foreseen.
I deeply regret that. Together with the parties involved, I am doing everything to prevent this situation in the future.
Dat betreur ik zeer. Met de betrokken partijen doe ik er alles aan om deze situatie in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Ceder over het bericht 'Angstcultuur en machtsspelletjes en een verziekte sfeer bij afdeling van de IND: ‘die collega gaan wij afbranden’'

MPs Podt and Ceder asked the State Secretary about an NRC report on a toxic work climate and a whistleblower complaint at the IND, and whether top management intervened. The State Secretary answered that the IND investigated the signals, explained the internal reporting procedure and the role of the integrity committee, acknowledged shortcomings in caring for the complainant, and said internal protections are adequate and a culture scan is underway.
I regret that in this case the care for the complainant fell short in a number of respects.
Ik betreur dat in deze zaak in een aantal opzichten in de zorg voor de melder tekort is geschoten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over statushouders die niet kunnen naturaliseren

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked why recognised refugees and their children who cannot obtain foreign documents cannot naturalise, and whether they should be exempted from the document requirement. The State Secretary replied that the document requirement applies in principle, that individual cases can be assessed case by case, and that she will not create a categorical exemption.
No, I am not willing to create a categorical exemption.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid een categoriale vrijstelling te creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het gebrek aan daadkracht om fatsoenlijke noodopvang voor asielzoekers in te richten

An MP asked the State Secretary why emergency reception for asylum seekers in Ter Apel was overcrowded, what action was taken after the August letter, why the October Veiligheidsberaad targets were not met, and about unaccompanied minors without guardianship or care. The State Secretary answered that about 6,500 extra mostly temporary places were realised, that the regional safety councils' options could not be realised quickly, and that unaccompanied minors aged 17.5 and over would be moved to adult facilities on a one-off basis.
At present the deployment of the former prison in Zoetermeer has not been concretely worked out.
Het is op dit moment is de inzet van de voormalige gevangenis in Zoetermeer niet concreet uitgewerkt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Simons over het rapport 'Transcript from the margins' over de behandeling van trans personen uit Latijns-Amerika en de Cariben in Nederlandse asielprocedures

MPs Koekkoek and Simons asked about a report on the treatment of trans asylum seekers from Latin America and the Caribbean in Dutch asylum procedures, including recommendations for trans-specific approaches, misgendering, and police violence. The State Secretary replied that the IND already uses LHBTI coordinators and training, that trans applicants are assessed individually, that Venezuela's trans population was recently classed as a risk group, and that no further structural changes are planned beyond ongoing contact with Transgender Netwerk Nederland.
The IND's approach is always to address the asylum seeker according to their own wishes, regardless of the information in the passport.
De insteek van de IND is om de asielzoeker altijd naar wens van de asielzoeker aan te spreken, ongeacht de informatie in het paspoort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de asielinstroom en de uitspraken van staatssecretaris Broekers-Knol

An MP from JA21 asked the government about reception shortages at asylum centres, the projected 2021 asylum inflow, and the handling of the Afghanistan-related motion. The State Secretary rejected the term 'asylum crisis', attributed shortages to COVID travel easing, Afghan evacuations and slow outflow of permit holders, and stated that a numerical ceiling on asylum intake is incompatible with Nederland's obligations.
I have asked the ACVZ to broadly map the options for using policy target figures to steer different forms of migration.
Ik heb de ACVZ gevraagd om breed in kaart te brengen welke mogelijkheden bestaan voor het gebruik van beleidsmatige richtgetallen bij sturing van verschillende vormen van migratie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hijink over de dreigende uitzetting van een Armeens gezin

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Hijink asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why an Armenian family, whose children were born and raised in the Netherlands and who appear to fall under the children's pardon, faces deportation, and whether the IND can correct the procedural error. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, stated that the Afsluitingsregeling conditions apply without requiring Dutch birth, rejected the claim of arbitrariness and the call for discretionary power, and said the case will not be reviewed again once proceedings are concluded.
As your House is aware, I cannot comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat met levens van onschuldige kinderen wordt gespeeld

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why a Yazidi family was being deported to Armenia despite family members being killed there, why asylum processing took over ten years, why threats carry little weight, whether deporting minors who have lived long in the Netherlands conflicts with Article 8 ECHR, and whether the case would be re-examined. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, explained the general asylum assessment, balancing and objection procedures, and noted that the IND is handling the lawyer's objection.
Because the article concerns an individual case, I cannot respond on the substance.
Omdat het artikel over een individuele zaak gaat kan ik niet op de inhoud reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de voortdurende overlast van asielzoekers in het openbaar vervoer

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about recurring violent incidents and threats by asylum seekers on public transport, including bus drivers' reluctance to check tickets, and whether the government will take responsibility and provide permanent security. The State Secretary said incidents are unacceptable and that police and carriers do not register nationality, promised to weigh nuisance in COA placement decisions, and pointed to a 1 million euro local measures scheme while stating a letter to parliament was sent.
The police and transport operators do not register by nationality or residence status.
De politie en vervoerders registreren niet op nationaliteit noch op verblijfsstatus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Kuik over het bericht ‘Enquête: klant moet sekswerker vragen naar de leeftijd’

MPs Kuik and Bikker asked the government about an survey showing many sex workers say clients should check age and identity, the sentences in the Valkenburg case, and measures to deter clients. The Staatssecretaris answered that a client-focused package and campaign are coming, that the Penal Code will treat paid sex with minors as aggravating, and declined to discuss individual court sentences citing the separation of powers.
I attach great importance to the separation of powers and consider it inappropriate, from my position as Staatssecretaris of Justice and Security, to give an opinion on individual judicial rulings.

Ik hecht sterk aan de scheiding der machten en acht het vanuit mijn functie als de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid niet passend over individuele uitspraken van de rechter een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

An MP asked whether COVID-19 closure measures and high infection rates would push sex workers into unsafe work and whether support schemes would reach them. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, said support schemes including VLN and bijstand zelfstandigen are open to sex workers who meet the conditions, and promised continued monitoring with municipalities.

Furthermore, the cabinet, together with the VNG, Divosa and municipalities, is monitoring whether additional measures or funds are needed to bridge this limited lockdown for people facing a sudden drop in income.

Verder houdt het kabinet samen met de VNG, Divosa en gemeenten vinger aan de pols of er aanvullende maatregelen of middelen nodig zijn om deze beperkte lockdown te overbruggen voor mensen die te maken krijgen met een plotseling terugval in inkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar, Brekelmans en El Yassini over het bericht 'FBI raids ZPMC delivery vessel'

MPs Valstar, Brekelmans and El Yassini (VVD) asked about reports of FBI raids on ZPMC (a Chinese state-owned shipbuilder) over suspected espionage, whether Dutch authorities had contact with US and Chinese authorities, how work-residence permits via recognised sponsor status are vetted for firms from China, Russia and Iran, and whether that status should be reconsidered. The State Secretary declined to comment on intelligence knowledge or diplomatic contacts, said fewer than five work permits were issued to ZPMC Netherlands staff since 2015 with none revoked, described the IND's sponsor vetting and the limited role of intelligence services, and said the government is critically reviewing the sponsor scheme with a later update promised.
No public statements are made about the knowledge level of the intelligence and security services.
Over het kennisniveau van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de brief van 24 augustus 2021 (Kamerstuk 27062-124) inzake alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoekers

An MP asked the State Secretary why policy for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers was shaped by a single case, what the difference is between policy and working practice, and for the release of internal IND documents, an inventory and informational notices. The State Secretary answered that the practice was a generalised working method rather than formal policy, that the 'handvatten' document will be turned into a public work instruction, and that the inventory concerns individual casework and cannot be shared, though the related advice and most notices were released.
The inventory you requested concerns personal, individual casuistry. I therefore cannot share this inventory with the House.
De door u gevraagde inventarisatie betreft persoonsgebonden, individuele casuïstiek. Deze inventarisatie kan ik daarom niet met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Jasper van Dijk over in Nederland geboren Molukkers die stateloos zijn

MPs Paulusma and Van Dijk asked about Dutch-born Moluccans who are stateless but hold Dutch travel documents under the Moluccans Position Act, including how many there are, how naturalisation works, and whether they should be actively informed about the option of Dutch nationality with voting rights. The state secretary answers that about 850 such people hold documents, at least 450 have obtained Dutch nationality over the years, and she is willing to discuss the matter with the Moluccan community while showing restraint in actively promoting nationality, since the Act was a deliberate choice.
I am of course willing to discuss this with representatives of the Moluccan community.
Ik ben uiteraard bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met vertegenwoordigers van de Molukse gemeenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het faciliteren van illegale pushbacks

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about Dutch marechaussee support to Frontex in Lithuania, alleged illegal pushbacks of asylum seekers from Belarus, deaths at the Polish-Belarusian border, and EU funding for alleged pushbacks in Croatia. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands supplied six personnel to Frontex, that responsibility for border conduct lies with member states and the Commission, that the Netherlands raised fundamental rights concerns with Poland, and deferred the Croatia funding question to a separate reply.

It is for the Commission to ensure that border management in member states is carried out in accordance with applicable European law, and for Frontex to ensure that fundamental rights are guaranteed during Frontex operations.

Het is aan de Commissie om erop toe te zien dat de grensbewaking in lidstaten wordt uitgevoerd conform de geldende Europese wet- en regelgeving en aan Frontex om erop toe te zien dat de fundamentele rechten tijdens Frontex operaties worden gewaarborgd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Ceder en Ellemeet over het rapport van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State over de Wijziging van het Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000, in verband met het regelen van de aanmeldfase

Opposition MPs from D66, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the Council of State's criticism of the new asylum pre-registration phase, which drops the first hearing and lacks safeguards such as legal aid and medical checks before the initial hearing. The State Secretary defended the change, saying safeguards are not needed for the brief initial questioning, that statements in pre-registration do not weigh against credibility, and that an evaluation will be published in mid-2022.
The cabinet is of the view that the brief questioning on asylum motives can be justified without yet meeting the safeguards named by the Council of State.
Het kabinet is van oordeel dat de korte uitvraag van asielmotieven verantwoord kan zonder dat al aan de door de Afdeling genoemde waarborgen is voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de zaak van een uit de Oekraïne afkomstig gezin dat geen paspoort kan krijgen

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about rejected asylum seekers, including a Ukrainian family from Crimea in Friesland, who cannot obtain a passport and are effectively stateless, and about when long residence of children should outweigh state interests. The State Secretary answered that such cases are assessed individually under the buitenschuldvergunning criteria and Article 8 ECHR, that a lack of travel documents does not automatically warrant a residence permit, and that no fixed period of residence settles the balance.
As you know, I cannot comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet op individuele zaken ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder en Grinwis over de toename in arbeidsuitbuiting

Christian Union MPs asked the ministers about the sharp rise in reported labour exploitation, why few cases reach prosecution, the dismissal of a case involving Filipino truck drivers, and protection for victims. The Secretary of State answered that most reports lack sufficient evidence, explained the prosecution and inspection process, said the high evidentiary burden limits prosecution, and promised implementation of the Aanjaagteam recommendations and a later review of article 273f, while noting the cabinet is caretaker.
However, a fully functioning cabinet and financial resources are needed for the decision-making on revising article 273f of the Criminal Code.
Voor de besluitvorming over herziening van artikel 273f Sr zijn echter een missionair kabinet en financiële middelen nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, Markuszower en Wilders over woningweigering door statushouders

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether it is acceptable that refugee status holders (statushouders) refuse housing offers, citing reports of families expelled from a reception centre, and requested data on refusals since 2010. The minister answered that refusals are rare and mostly handled by COA's procedure, gave figures showing 1,696 refusal procedures since 2013 with 1,598 judged unjustified and 137 eviction procedures started, and rejected calls to deport such persons.
Of the total number of housing refusals, 98 were found justified and 1,598 were found unjustified.
Van het totale aantal woningweigeringen zijn er 98 terecht en 1.598 onterecht bevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over de situatie van Jezidische slachtoffers

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked the Dutch government about the precarious situation of Yazidi victims of IS, including women with children from IS rapists, and whether the Netherlands should create an asylum programme like Germany, France and Canada. The government acknowledged likely genocide and described support programmes, explained that resettlement is UNHCR-led and that the Netherlands has no humanitarian admission programme, and outlined revised asylum assessment practice for Yazidis; it did not answer the final question on timing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Werf en Van der Plas over het bericht dat er nieuw beleid is voor gezinshereniging waar de Kamer niet over geïnformeerd is

MPs Ceder, Van der Werf and Van der Plas asked whether the IND had quietly changed family reunification rules for unaccompanied minors, whether the Chamber was informed, and whether the change is compatible with EU law. The State Secretary replied that the IND's practice was an interpretation of 'alleenstaand' rather than a policy change, that the change was dropped after an inventory, and that affected cases will be re-examined individually.
Question 10: Are you willing to reverse the introduced policy immediately? If not, why not?
Vraag 10 Bent u bereid om het ingevoerde beleid per direct terug te draaien? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht 'Honderden asielkinderen dreigen zonder hun ouders op te moeten groeien'

A CDA MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about an NRC report that IND policy on family reunification for unaccompanied minors had changed, including whether it was pushed through against IND leadership advice and why it was not shared with parliament. The State Secretary said the IND approach was an interpretation of 'alleenstaande' rather than a policy change, that a broad inventory led to abandoning it on 23 August 2021, and that parliament was informed promptly.
In March 2021 a memo was submitted to me proposing that the IND abandon this more generally applied working method.
In maart 2021 is mij een nota voorgelegd waarin mij is voorgesteld om deze door de IND meer generiek gehanteerde werkwijze los te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het nieuwe IND-beleid waardoor honderden minderjarige vluchtelingen dreigen te moeten opgroeien zonder ouders

An MP asked why the State Secretary deployed an IND family-reunification practice narrowing the 'unaccompanied minor' concept without informing parliament, and whether it conflicts with the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child and the EU Family Reunification Directive. The State Secretary answered that the IND practice was not a policy change, that the practice has been abandoned except where a child is clearly not unaccompanied, that fees will be refunded and pending requests reviewed, while largely restating existing legal frameworks on some points.
In March 2021 I was presented with a memo proposing that this more generic practice applied by the IND be abandoned.
In maart 2021 is mij een nota voorgelegd waarin mij is voorgesteld om deze door de IND meer generiek gehanteerde werkwijze los te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het ingrijpend wijzigen van asielbeleid zonder de Kamer daarover te informeren

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why the IND changed its family reunification practice for unaccompanied minors without informing parliament, and why the change would reduce children's ability to be reunited with family. The State Secretary replied that the IND's practice was an application of the concept of 'alleenstaand' rather than a policy change, that after an internal inventory she decided to abandon the generic approach and apply it only where a minor is evidently not alone, and that the internal notes and timeline would be provided as an annex.
I informed your House of this decision without delay.
Over dit besluit heb ik uw Kamer onverwijld geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over vluchtelingen die vastzitten aan de grens tussen Polen en Wit-Rusland

An SP MP asked the government about migrants stranded at the Polish-Belarusian border, including reported deaths, lack of humanitarian access, and whether Dutch authorities would press Poland and Belarus. The minister answered that the government is concerned, cannot verify conditions due to the state of emergency and access restrictions, has urged Poland to allow humanitarian access and respect EU law, and is supporting EU sanctions and Commission action.
As your House is aware, the cabinet does not have independent information on exactly what is happening at the external borders.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend beschikt het kabinet niet over eigenstandige informatie over wat er aan de buitengrenzen precies gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de uitzending van Omroep Gelderland ‘In het vizier van de Jager’ en het artikel ‘Dit is moderne slavernij: politiek wil vrouwen van brandmerk afhelpen'

An MP asks the health and justice ministers about women branded or tattooed by loverboys and whether they must pay for removal, plus data on victims and insurance coverage. The minister answers that no victim counts exist, that victims can claim compensation via the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven, and that removal is not covered by basic insurance without a medical indication, while promising to consider alternative funding.
It is terrible when a young woman is exploited and, under pressure, has a tattoo or brand applied.
Het is vreselijk als een jonge vrouw wordt uitgebuit en onder druk een tatoeage of brandmerk aangebracht krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over visa voor kort verblijf

Eerdmans asked about short-stay (90-day) visas: annual issuance figures, how overstays are monitored and whether people who should have left are tracked, and how often the EUR 10,000 sponsor guarantee is claimed. The government answered with issuance numbers and inreisverbod counts, said there is no active monitoring of departures until the EES starts around May 2022, and said it has not yet claimed the guarantees, which is costly to enforce civilly.
At present there is no active monitoring of whether foreigners have left the Schengen area within the permitted period.
Op dit moment is nog geen sprake van een actieve monitoring of vreemdelingen het Schengengebied binnen de toegestane termijn hebben verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Piri over de evacuatie uit Afghanistan

MPs Omtzigt and Piri asked the government about the Afghanistan evacuation, including embassy correspondence, meeting records, military protection, Council of Ministers decisions, EUPOL interpreters and a promised independent inquiry. The ministers answered most questions substantively, provided some documents with redactions, declined to provide phone-call records because none exist, and committed to establishing an independent inquiry commission.
The cabinet will establish an independent external temporary commission to investigate the crisis approach, including the evacuations of the recent period.
Antwoord 17 Een onafhankelijke externe commissie van tijdelijke aard om onderzoek toe doen naar de crisisaanpak inclusief de evacuaties van de afgelopen periode zal door het kabinet worden ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Van der Staaij over een luchtbrug voor vluchtelingen uit kwetsbare groepen uit Afghanistan

MPs Ceder and Van der Staaij asked whether the government would help vulnerable Afghan refugees (women in public roles, Afghan contractors, Christians) leave Kabul via a proposed airlift and admit some into the Dutch asylum procedure, and whether Christians' religion recorded in identity documents exposes them to greater risk. The minister replied that the Dutch evacuation ended on 26 August, that the government continues efforts to bring eligible people out and cooperates with regional countries and allies, and that it cannot yet assess the extra danger to Christians.
The cabinet will continue to actively make efforts to bring people who qualify out of Afghanistan or via neighbouring countries to the Netherlands in the coming period.
Het kabinet blijft zich actief inspannen om ook de komende periode mensen die daarvoor in aanmerking komen uit Afghanistan of via de buurlanden naar Nederland over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het beleid ten aanzien van families van Afghaans-Nederlandse medewerkers

The MP asks whether the cabinet disagreed on applying the IND core-family rule to evacuate relatives of Afghan staff, whether the narrow definition should be widened for dependants, and how arbitrariness is prevented. The ministers answer that the cabinet jointly decided to apply the interpreter family rules to local embassy staff, that 47 dependent family members were admitted case by case as maatwerk rather than a policy change, and that the questions were answered as soon as possible.
This does not concern a policy change, but case-by-case tailoring applied to keep the entire staff working on the evacuation for as long as possible.
Dit betreft geen beleidswijziging, maar maatwerk dat is toegepast om zo lang als mogelijk met de gehele staf te kunnen doorgaan met (het voorbereiden van) de evacuatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Van der Lee en Ellemeet over de voortgang van evacuaties uit Afghanistan

MPs Bromet, Van der Lee and Ellemeet asked the government how people covered by the Belhaj motion can still contact the Dutch state after the evacuation mailbox closed, what further evacuation efforts are planned, and how the Taliban treat those groups. The government answered that it continues limited evacuations, a special scheme for two groups is planned, about 20,000 unique emails were received, and it cannot yet confirm the Taliban's conduct clearly.
It is difficult to obtain a clear picture of the situation in Afghanistan and the conduct of the Taliban.
Het is moeilijk een eenduidig beeld te krijgen van de situatie in Afghanistan en het handelen van de Taliban.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de manier waarop verder uitvoering gegeven wordt aan de motie-Belhaj en het beleid ten aanzien van Afghaanse vluchtelingen en ontheemden

An MP asks ministers how they assess which Afghan applicants fall under the Belhaj motion categories, what is being done with thousands of emails, whether those stranded in neighbouring countries can seek Dutch protection, and related questions on NGO lists, coalition burden-sharing, Croatia Dublin transfers and aid. The government answers that a special scheme for two groups is planned, the mailbox was closed with about 20,000 unique addresses sorted, the Vreemdelingencirculaire will be amended, and it cites Dutch engagement with allies and aid organisations.
All persons who sent a message to kabul@minbuza.nl will be informed of this by email.
Alle personen die een bericht hebben gestuurd naar kabul@minbuza.nl zullen hierover per e-mail worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de te verwachten asielstroom uit Afghanistan en Litouwen en het huidige structurele tekort aan faciliteiten in de opvang

The MP asks how the government will address shortages of asylum reception capacity in light of expected inflows from Afghanistan and Lithuania, including whether budget cuts and COVID have eroded reception capacity and whether EU-level coordination will be pursued. The State Secretary answers that talks with COA, municipalities and provinces are ongoing, temporary locations have opened, budget adequacy is under review at regular budget moments, and the government is pressing for a coordinated EU approach while noting Lithuania did not request redistribution.
In the course of October I will inform your House, together with the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, about progress.
In de loop van oktober zal ik uw Kamer, samen met de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, informeren over de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over de gevolgen van de asielinstroom van Afghanistan naar Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the consequences of the Afghan asylum influx, covering monthly asylum figures, family reunification, reception in the region, housing, crime and welfare dependency. The government answered with statistics, stated it does not use quotas, declined to make some predictions, and described existing measures and planned policy steps.
The Netherlands does not work with maximums or quotas in asylum policy.
Nederland werkt in het asielbeleid niet met maxima of quota.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht dat 58 Afghanen via Pakistan naar Nederland worden gehaald

An MP asked whether 58 Afghans who crossed into Pakistan would be brought to the Netherlands, whether the government assisted their overland crossing despite advising against it, and whether moving them from Pakistan shows the aim is relocation to the Netherlands rather than regional protection. The minister confirmed the transfers, said travel decisions are personal responsibility, and stated that the government will keep pursuing evacuation of eligible people while preferring regional protection for others.
The cabinet wants to make a special effort for interpreters and persons who had already been called up for evacuation under the Belhaj et al. motion.
Het kabinet wil een bijzondere inspanning leveren voor tolken en de personen die reeds opgeroepen waren voor evacuatie in het kader van de motie-Belhaj c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Hoe een Nederlandse reder migranten ‘terugduwde’ naar Libië'

An MP asked the State Secretary about reporting that a Dutch shipowner pushed migrants back to Libya, and whether commercial ships are increasingly involved in pushbacks and how the EU should sanction states. The government answered that the state where a rescue occurs is responsible for coordinating SAR, that it lacks figures on Dutch-flagged commercial vessels, that it refuses to comment on individual media cases, and that it will keep pressing for a predictable disembarkation mechanism and safe ports.
The cabinet does not have figures on the involvement of commercial ships in SAR operations in the Mediterranean that sail under the Dutch flag or are owned by a Dutch company.

Het kabinet beschikt niet over cijfers betreffende de betrokkenheid van commerciële schepen bij SAR-operaties in de Middellandse zee die onder Nederlandse vlag varen dan wel eigendom zijn van een Nederlands bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het afwijzen van de asielaanvraag van MH17-getuigen

SP MPs asked why the IND rejected asylum applications from two witnesses in the MH17 case and whether they are adequately protected. The Secretary of State declined to discuss individual cases, explained that IND and witness-team assessments follow different frameworks, and said the OM handles relevance of witness testimony and protection.
I do not provide information about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de verslechterde situatie van vluchtelingen in Griekenland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the deteriorated situation of refugees in Greece, following two Council of State rulings that stopped returns of status holders to Greece. The State Secretary acknowledged the Council of State's conclusion that the interstate trust principle was insufficiently motivated, announced a fact-finding study, and said she would keep pressing the European Commission for solutions on integration support and burden-sharing.
The situation of status holders in Greece must be further examined and assessed by me.
De situatie van statushouders in Griekenland dient door mij nader te worden onderzocht en beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over het falen van het EU-migratiebeleid en de gelekte Raadsnotitie voor vrijwillige terugkeer

An MP asked about the European Court of Auditors report finding weak EU returns cooperation with third countries, and about a leaked Council note on voluntary return and reintegration. The Secretary of State largely agreed with the report, described Dutch positions on EU-level coordination and a new legal framework for return, and offered mainly general measures without concrete commitments.
I share the European Court of Auditors' finding that effective return policy is necessary for an effective EU asylum and migration policy.
Ik deel de bevinding van de Europese Rekenkamer dat een effectief, werkend terugkeerbeleid noodzakelijk is voor een effectief EU asiel- en migratiebeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de invoering van grenscontroles

An MP asked whether border checks for COVID certificates at the Dutch-Belgian border show that border controls can be introduced quickly, and about their costs and effect on other Marechaussee tasks. The government answered that these checks rest on the Public Health Act rather than Schengen border controls, cost about 550,000 euro until end 2021, were staffed by the KMar only until 31 August, and that controls against illegal migration are not currently needed given strict conditions for internal border controls.
These checks are not internal border controls within the legal framework of the Schengen Borders Code.
Deze controles zijn geen binnengrenscontroles in het juridisch kader van de Schengen-grenscode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de uitkeringsafhankelijkheid en huisvesting van statushouders

An MP asks the ministers about rising benefit dependence among refugee status holders, their low education levels, the 2021 housing quota forcing municipalities to house 24,500 status holders, and whether this burdens the welfare state and housing supply. The government answers that benefit dependence falls with length of stay, that it cannot give total welfare costs, that municipalities bear housing duties under the Huisvestingswet, and lists measures to support housing and integration.
Figures are only available from the 2014 cohort onward.
Er zijn alleen cijfers beschikbaar vanaf het cohort 2014.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri en Van der Werf over de grondhouding bij de beoordeling van asielzaken door de IND en de rol van taalexperts bij het beantwoorden van vragen over de identiteit

MPs Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri and Van der Werf asked the State Secretary about the IND's basic attitude toward asylum cases and the use of language experts in identity assessments, citing an internal 2009 discussion paper and a specific Burundi case. The State Secretary answered that the IND does not steer toward rejection, that language analyses are only supplementary indications, and that no independent investigation is needed given court review.
It has never been IND policy, either now or in the past, to primarily steer toward rejecting asylum applications.
Het is nimmer het beleid van IND geweest, in het heden noch het verleden, om primair te sturen op het afwijzen van asielaanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Ceder, Segers en Van der Staaij over de situatie van Afghaanse christenen

Four MPs asked the government about the situation of Afghan Christians and converts under the Taliban, and whether asylum policy should be loosened. The government said the situation of religious minorities was already concerning, that information is limited, and that a moratorium on decisions and departures has been imposed with a new country report and further consultation with parliament promised.
After receiving the country report, the House will be further informed about the conclusions that can be drawn from it for the country-based asylum policy.
Na ontvangst van het ambtsbericht wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over de conclusies die uit dat ambtsbericht kunnen worden getrokken voor het landgeboden asielbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Michon-Derkzen en Valstar over het bericht ‘Frankrijk ziet Taliban-banden bij gevluchte Afghanen’

Members Van Wijngaarden, Michon-Derkzen and Valstar asked the ministers whether evacuated Afghans with Taliban, Al Qaeda or IS ties could enter the Netherlands, how security screening was done before and after evacuation, and whether the Taliban can be treated as a terrorist organisation. The State Secretary answered that all asylum applicants are screened under standard procedures, that pre-evacuation screening was largely not possible given the time pressure, and that individuals can be excluded under article 1F or prosecuted, while the Taliban as an organisation is not on UN or EU terrorism lists.
For other persons who did not work directly for Dutch officials as part of an international military or police mission, such screening was in most cases not carried out by the Netherlands in advance.

Voor de andere personen die niet rechtstreeks voor (een) Nederlandse functionaris(sen) als onderdeel van een internationale militaire of politiemissie werkten is een dergelijke screening in de meeste gevallen niet vooraf door Nederland uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het terugsturen van vluchtelingen naar Afghanistan

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the deteriorating situation in Afghanistan under the Taliban justifies humanitarian measures, asylum eligibility, and a halt to forced returns. The government answered that it is seriously concerned, outlined humanitarian funding, and announced a decision and departure moratorium for Afghan asylum seekers, with no forced returns to Afghanistan in 2021.
This means in principle that no decisions will be taken on pending and new asylum applications and that Afghan asylum seekers already rejected will not be returned to Afghanistan.
Dit betekent in beginsel dat er geen besluit wordt genomen op lopende en nieuwe asielaanvragen en dat reeds afgewezen Afghaanse asielzoekers niet zullen worden teruggestuurd naar Afghanistan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wuite en Van der Werf over het artikel 'Steeds moeilijker om naar Aruba te vluchten; 'we blijven het proberen''

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretaries about reports that migrants were being expelled from Aruba to Venezuela while asylum or appeal proceedings were pending, whether Aruba was breaching the Refugee Convention, and about detention conditions and legal aid in Aruba and Curaçao. The government answered that Aruban and Curaçaoan migration and asylum policy are national matters for those countries' own authorities, while offering support and cooperation, and committed to a working group on rule-of-law cooperation within the Kingdom.
Aruba's immigration policy is a matter for the country itself. It is for the authorities and judiciary of Aruba to state or assess to what extent international rules are being complied with.

Het vreemdelingenbeleid van Aruba is een landsaangelegenheid. Het is aan de autoriteiten en aan de rechterlijke macht van Aruba om zich uit te laten of te beoordelen in hoeverre conform internationale regelgeving gehandeld wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Ellemeet over het onderzoek van het Europees Parlement naar Frontex

MPs Ceder and Ellemeet asked the State Secretary about the European Parliament's Frontex inquiry, which found Frontex was aware of alleged pushbacks but did not act, and about the role of director Leggeri and what should be done. The government acknowledged the failure of reporting and complaint mechanisms, called for better follow-up and strengthened Management Board steering, but declined to share Dutch Management Board statements and said no new investigation is needed.
The government's main conclusion from the FSWG report is that the existing reporting, complaints and monitoring mechanisms have not worked sufficiently.
Het kabinet trekt als voornaamste conclusie uit het FSWG-rapport dat de bestaande rapportage-, klachten- en monitoringsmechanismen onvoldoende hebben gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van den Berg en Kuik over de aanpak van mensenhandel in de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk

MPs asked about the government's approach to human trafficking in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, including prosecutions, victim reporting, information sharing and whether the National Rapporteur's mandate should extend to the BES islands. The government answered that combating trafficking is largely a country matter, gave case and reporting figures for Caribbean Netherlands, declined to extend the National Rapporteur's mandate, and committed to raising the issue at the next Justice Ministers' meeting and evaluating the MoU in 2022.

Are you willing to come to the budget debate for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations with scenarios on how information gathering, information sharing, reception, investigation and prosecution of human trafficking in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom can be improved?

Bent u bereid voor de behandeling van de begroting Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties met scenario's te komen hoe de informatievergaring, informatiedeling, opvang, opsporing en vervolging op het gebied van mensenhandel in de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk kan worden verbeterd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, Madlener en Wilders over het bericht 'Geweld en overlast asielzoekers in ov regio Emmen: ’We zijn het spuugzat’'

PVV MPs asked whether asylum seekers in the Emmen public transport region were committing daily intimidation and violence against bus drivers, and demanded expulsion or an asylum stop. The State Secretary confirmed 7 reported incidents mostly over payment problems, said no police reports were filed, noted that the reported assault turned out not to be physical, and refused to expel offenders or halt asylum, citing legal rights and existing security measures.
Of those 7 incidents, according to Qbuzz no report and/or complaint was filed with the police.
Van die 7 incidenten is volgens Qbuzz geen melding en/of aangifte gedaan bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de aanhoudende incidenten op de bussen in en rondom Ter Apel

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about persistent incidents against bus drivers on lines in and around Ter Apel, and what steps were taken after a visit and driver letter. The State Secretary said overlap has fallen sharply, the shuttle bus will run fully this year, and that enforcement is a local responsibility, so no intervention is planned, though a one-million-euro specific grant is made available to municipalities.
The decision on security on the bus or placing security at a station does not fall under my responsibility.
De beslissing over beveiliging in de bus noch het plaatsen van beveiliging op een station vallen niet onder mijn bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Werf over het bericht dat experts van de Verenigde Naties melden dat er orgaanhandel plaatsvindt in China

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van der Werf asked the government about UN and China Tribunal reports of forced organ harvesting from prisoners of conscience in China, including Chinese legislation, Dutch links to the trade, and whether the issue will be raised in the EU and UN Human Rights Council. The government said it cannot verify the allegations, pointed to Chinese laws of 2007 and 2009-2011, reported no concrete Dutch links, declined a blacklist of Chinese hospitals, and promised a letter on the Council of Europe convention by end 2021.
The cabinet is unable to verify or refute these allegations.
Het kabinet is niet in staat om deze aanklachten te verifiëren noch te ontkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri en Simons over het rapport 'Onzichtbaar' van de Amsterdamse Ombudsman en het WODC-onderzoek naar mensen zonder rechtmatig verblijf

MPs asked the government about the Amsterdam Ombudsman's estimate that 4-6% of pupils in Amsterdam schools are undocumented, the national share, post-18 education and work prospects, economic costs, and return figures. The minister gave national percentages of students without a BSN, said the national share of undocumented children is likely lower, announced a study on newcomer funding, and declined further research on economic costs and returns, citing the legal framework.
It is not possible to state how many children staying unlawfully in the Netherlands receive national education.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel onrechtmatig in Nederland verblijvende kinderen landelijk onderwijs volgen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Aukje de Vries over het incident Testcoronanu BV en de ernstige tekortkoming in de informatiebeveiliging

MPs Rajkowski and Aukje de Vries asked the ministers about the Testcoronanu BV data breach, affected travellers, the audit of the provider's security and the vetting of test providers before connection to CoronaCheck. Minister De Jonge answered that 17,638 people had appointments, that the provider is investigating whether others accessed the database, and that the ministry checks pentest reports before connection, but declined to share the providers' DPIAs and pentest reports.
However, I cannot commit to also sharing with your House the DPIAs and pentest reports submitted by the test provider.
Ik kan echter niet toezeggen dat ook de door de testaanbieder aangeleverde DPIA’s en pentestrapportages met uw Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van Dijk, Piri en Van der Werf over de situatie van de door Nederland naar Bahrein uitgezette asielzoeker A.S.

MPs asked how the government monitors the detention of asylum seeker A.S. in Bahrain, whether he is isolated and mistreated, and what steps Netherlands and the EU take to secure his release. The minister says the embassy follows the case through regular human rights work, has raised concerns with Bahraini authorities, cannot confirm the reported conditions yet, and will continue to press for better detention conditions.
The Netherlands nevertheless follows A.S.'s case as part of the embassy in Kuwait's regular human rights work.
Nederland volgt evenwel de zaak van A.S. als onderdeel van het reguliere mensenrechtenwerk van de ambassade in Koeweit.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de berichten ‘Extra toezicht in winkels ‘asielhoofdstad’ Ter Apel: ‘Het geeft meer rust’’ en ‘Extra beveiliging tegen overlast asielzoekers in winkels Ter Apel’

An MP from JA21 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about shopfloor security in Ter Apel, reports of shoplifting by asylum seekers from 'safe' countries, the financing of shopkeepers' losses, crime and nuisance statistics, deportation and visa leverage, and house arrest or area bans for nuisance-causing residents. The State Secretary answered that a local approach is taken, that COA funded private security as a pilot, that the government is reluctant to tighten rules while demissionary, and that some measures (area bans, transfers to the HTL location, visa leverage) are being pursued or are legally constrained.
I also refer to my letter earlier this year on progress on the integrated migration agenda.
Ik wijs hier ook op mijn brief eerder dit jaar over de voortgang van de integrale migratieagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat een asielzoeker is aangeklaagd voor zeven moordpogingen

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports that an asylum seeker was charged with seven attempted murders at an asylum centre, asking why he was admitted and not detained, and whether borders should be closed. The State Secretary declined to comment on individual cases, said reducing crime and nuisance is a priority with measures already taken, and referred to earlier answers on closing borders to asylum seekers.
As your House is aware, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Werf en Piri over het terugsturen van Soedanese afgewezen asielzoekers naar Soedan

MPs from four parties asked the State Secretary about deportations of rejected Sudanese asylum seekers, including the use of language analysis, reports of ill-treatment after return, and possible contact with Sudanese intelligence officers at the embassy. The State Secretary defended the procedures as careful, said language analysis is only a supplementary indication, and maintained that there is no reason to believe returnees are targeted merely for returning.
A language analysis is only used as a supplementary instrument, namely when there is serious doubt about the stated country of origin.
Een taalanalyse wordt alleen als aanvullend instrument ingezet, namelijk wanneer er ernstige twijfel bij het gestelde land van herkomst is.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Ellian, Brekelmans en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Asielzoeker waarschuwde voor moordplan Iraanse geheime dienst'

VVD MPs asked whether the IND and AIVD were warned in advance about an Iranian-directed assassination plot and what Dutch and EU responses to Iran and to Iranian dissidents are. The state secretary declined to comment on individual cases or on AIVD working methods, pointed to existing reporting structures and the sanctions and diplomatic measures already taken, and gave no concrete new commitment.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet doe ik over individuele zaken geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het bericht dat de aanpak van zware asielcriminaliteit ernstig faalt

PVV MPs Wilders and Markuszower asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security why serious crime by asylum seekers is rising, why borders stay open, and whether offenders will be expelled and detained. The State Secretary confirmed the rise for the group in COA reception centres, gave conviction figures for Algerian, Moroccan and Tunisian residents, rejected closing the borders as unrealistic, and said expulsion for nuisance is limited by national and international law while enforcement continues.
For the immigration enforcement approach I am bound by national and international laws and regulations.
Voor de vreemdelingrechtelijke aanpak ben ik gebonden aan (inter)nationale wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het weggeven van 10.000 Nederlandse paspoorten aan gelukszoekers

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security why 10,000 former Ranov-permit holders were being given Dutch passports despite lacking identity documents, and whether this attracts asylum seekers and criminals. The State Secretary rejected the characterisations, said naturalisation conditions and the rule that doubtful identity or nationality leads to refusal still apply, and explained a categorical exemption based on a WODC/IND study; he could not say how many had lied about identity or how many were criminals, pointing to existing public-order criteria and withdrawal rules.
The number of persons who lied about their personal details when granted residence rights is unknown.
Het aantal personen dat bij het verstrekken van het verblijfsrecht heeft gelogen over hun persoonsgegevens is onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de gevolgen van de terugtrekking van de internationale troepen uit Afghanistan voor het beleid ten aanzien van Afghaanse asielzoekers

An MP asked whether rejected Afghan asylum seekers are still being returned amid the troop withdrawal, what happens to pending return cases, whether the country-of-origin report remains usable, and whether returns remain responsible. The State Secretary answered that a decision and departure moratorium has been imposed so no forced returns occur, that no forced returns to Afghanistan took place in 2021, and that the general country report will be brought forward for publication around end September with policy consequences to follow.
This means that no forced return of already rejected asylum seekers takes place.
Dit betekent dat er geen gedwongen terugkeer van reeds afgewezen asielzoekers plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Der Werf en Ceder over de ontstane situatie in Afghanistan.

MPs Van der Werf and Ceder asked whether a new Afghanistan country report would be published in October and whether it could be accelerated, whether a departure moratorium would be imposed, whether any removals to Afghanistan were planned, and whether Afghans were in immigration detention. The State Secretary referred to her letter of 11 August, which announced a decision and departure moratorium for Afghanistan and the timing of the next country report, and noted the questions crossed with that letter.
For the answers to these questions I would like to refer you to my letter of 11 August.
Voor de antwoorden op deze vragen verwijs ik u graag naar mijn brief van 11 augustus jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Bromet, Ceder en Kuzu over het beschermen van Afghanen die werkzaam waren voor Nederland tijdens de Afghanistanmissies

MPs from six parties asked the cabinet why it is not doing more to quickly bring Afghan interpreters and other former local staff who worked for Dutch missions to safety, including questions on the asylum process, document problems, non-interpreter staff, and a deportation moratorium. The ministers answered that additional staff were deployed, interpreters' remaining requirements were dropped, about 43 interpreters had arrived since June, non-interpreters are assessed individually and generously, and the moratorium's extension will be decided later.
The cabinet is taking all steps within its own power to bring the interpreters and their families to the Netherlands as quickly as possible.
Het kabinet onderneemt alle stappen die binnen het eigen vermogen liggen om de tolken en hun gezinnen op een zo kort mogelijke termijn naar Nederland over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het naleven van de Europese privacyregels van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) bij (uitvoerings)instanties

An MP asks multiple ministers whether a long list of public bodies (DUO, CBR, SVB, IND, DJI, UWV, OM, FIOD and others) collect and process personal data in line with GDPR, and whether any are not yet compliant. The government replies per organisation, generally stating compliance, while noting ongoing work and specific gaps such as UWV's SONAR system, SVB processes still in development, and CAK access management.
UWV is working hard to comply with the GDPR.
Het UWV werkt hard om aan de AVG te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht 'Loekasjenko neemt wraak en zet sluis naar Europa open voor vluchtelingen'

A CDA MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports that Belarus was letting migrants pass into Lithuania as retaliation, including whether Belarusian border guards were involved, the adequacy of border control, the camp conditions and EU action. The government answered that it condemns instrumentalisation of migrants, described the sharp rise in crossings and the Belarus-linked flights, and listed Frontex, EASO and EU sanctions support, while not answering the smuggling-liability question in detail.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Broekers-Knol is suikertante van indringers’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about press reports on criminal foreigners who should leave the Netherlands but were not monitored or did not depart, citing rising unsupervised departures in 2020 (34%).
