The State Secretary reports that about 630 departures were supervised and 320 were unsupervised in 2020, explains supervision rules, says the government is exploring amending the Aliens Act to restore the ongoing link between the undesirability declaration and the entry ban, notes Groningen hosts six people with serious entry bans in a shelter, and commits to updates on the integrated illegality approach.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat asielkinderen dreigen te worden uitgezet ondanks de Afsluitingsregeling

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security why children who have lived long in the Netherlands risk deportation despite the Afsluitingsregeling, and questions the strictness of the availability criterion, the treatment of children born during or after asylum procedures, and unequal treatment of applicants. The State Secretary defends the criteria as a deliberate balance of responsibility, admits some applicants were rejected on the availability criterion, acknowledges an earlier lenient practice on M35-K forms was abandoned, and states that the scheme is now closed and no further claims can be made.
It is inherent in setting conditions and contra-indications that some people will not meet them, resulting in rejection of the application and an obligation to leave.
Het is inherent aan het stellen van voorwaarden en contra-indicaties dat er ook mensen niet voldoen, met een afwijzing van de aanvraag en een vertrekplicht tot gevolg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Ceder over de vrijlating van het Pakistaanse echtpaar Shagufta en Shafqat

Two ChristianUnion MPs asked whether the released Pakistani Christian couple Shagufta Kausar and Shafqat Emmanuel face danger, whether the Netherlands will admit them as refugees, and what pressure is applied on Pakistan to repeal its blasphemy laws. The minister answered that the risk cannot be determined in advance, that asylum cannot be applied for at an embassy, and that the government raises the issue bilaterally and in EU channels while preferring quiet diplomacy.
It should be noted that the starting point of Dutch asylum policy is that a person can only apply for asylum in the Netherlands.
Hierbij dient aangetekend te worden dat het uitgangspunt van het Nederlandse asielbeleid is dat iemand enkel in Nederland asiel kan aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over privacy schending door het COA

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the IND shares full asylum decisions and intended rejections with the COA, and whether this enabled a COA employee to leak information about an asylum seeker online. The State Secretary confirmed the sharing, said internal investigation found no sign of a COA employee leaking the information, and stated the IND will stop sharing full decisions with the COA while alternatives are examined.
In practice it has become apparent that the COA needs certain information to carry out its statutory task, but not all the information in the decisions.
In de praktijk is gebleken dat het COA bepaalde informatie nodig heeft voor het uitvoeren van de wettelijke taak, maar niet alle informatie uit de beschikkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Kops over het bericht dat er weer miljoenen worden uitgetrokken voor de huisvesting van asielzoekers

MPs Markuszower and Kops asked whether millions spent on renovating the Gilze asylum centre and on housing for asylum seekers, including a EUR 50 million housing scheme, is justified given the Dutch housing shortage. The government answered that the renovation maintains monumental COA buildings and that the EUR 50 million scheme is mostly unearmarked, serves several priority groups, and eases pressure on social housing, while refusing to end asylum reception.
Of this amount, EUR 3 million is specifically earmarked for developing so-called interim facilities.
Van dit bedrag is € 3 miljoen specifiek bestemd voor het ontwikkelen van zogeheten tussenvoorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Markuszower over het mét subsidie huisvesten van grote statushoudersgezinnen

MPs Kops and Markuszower (PVV) asked why municipalities receive subsidies to house large refugee-status-holder families, calling it absurd and unfair to Dutch housing seekers. The State Secretary defended the scheme as necessary because large families stay too long in COA reception, and refused to end it or to have refugees find housing abroad.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de explosieve stijging van het aantal gelukszoekers dat wekelijks Nederland binnenstroomt

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether weekly asylum inflow of 400 to 700 people in weeks 22 to 25 of 2021 was unacceptable, whether weekly inflow should be zero, and whether borders should be closed to asylum seekers and migrants from Islamic countries. The State Secretary rejected the characterisation, attributed the recent rise to easing of COVID-19 travel restrictions, said the inflow is monitored and it will act if warranted, and refused to close borders, referring to earlier answers.
The inflow is closely monitored and action will be taken when this is deemed appropriate.
De instroom wordt nauwgezet gevolgd en daarop wordt geacteerd wanneer dit aangewezen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Minhas over het bericht ‘Chauffeurs balen van uitblijven oplossing voor onveilige bussen: Gemeenten en provincies blijven maar naar elkaar verwijzen’

MPs Wiersma and Minhas asked about reports that public transport between Emmen and Ter Apel remains unsafe due to nuisance by asylum seekers and that municipalities and provinces refer responsibility to each other. The government answers that incidents, mostly fare-payment problems, have fallen sharply since 2019 thanks to measures such as steward deployment, a pilot for a regional travel ban, and a 1 million euro municipal budget, while it does not register residence status of those involved.
The police and transport operators do not record the residence status of persons involved in incidents.
De politie en vervoerders registreren niet op verblijfsstatus van personen die betrokken zijn bij incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht 'Strenge wet dupeert asielkinderen'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that the strict Afsluitingsregeling for long-staying children leaves asylum children out, including how many applications were refused and on which grounds, and whether children known only to municipalities were excluded. The State Secretary answered with detailed figures, explained the availability criterion, and stated that no forced departures of rejected children were planned at the time of the question.

There were 43 applications by principal applicants refused on the basis of the criterion that the foreign national was out of sight of the national government for longer than the permitted period and did not meet the availability criterion.

Er zijn 43 aanvragen van hoofdpersonen afgewezen op basis van het criterium dat de vreemdeling langer dan de toegestane periode uit beeld was van de rijksoverheid en niet voldeed aan het beschikbaarheidscriterium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over RANOV-vergunninghouders

An SP MP asked why the State Secretary has not yet implemented parliamentary motions to exempt RANOV permit holders from nationality requirements for naturalisation, why minors born after the pardon are excluded, and why a WODC study must be awaited first. The State Secretary answered that the policy change took effect on 1 June 2021, refers to a letter on migration policy for the policy response, explains existing rules for minors' naturalisation, and states that an up-to-date picture is needed before deciding.

As I have previously informed your House, in my view an up-to-date picture is necessary to reach a carefully considered decision, in which the wish of the House is also an essential part of this consideration.

Zoals ik uw Kamer eerder heb geïnformeerd is mijns inziens een actueel beeld noodzakelijk om tot een zorgvuldig afgewogen beslissing te komen, waarbij ook de wens van de Kamer een essentieel onderdeel is van deze afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Spuitgast mist oefenruimte’ en ‘We zijn steeds meer allround hulpverlener’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the Netherlands has no training grounds for tunnel or high-rise fires, whether professional aftercare exists for firefighters who now act as all-round responders, and whether the government will reverse cuts to full crew deployment. The minister answered that regional safety boards set training programmes, that firefighters train abroad when needed, that aftercare teams exist, and that on-scene commanders decide whether to enter a burning building.
Safety regions determine the fire service training programme based on the risk profile.
Veiligheidsregio’s bepalen op basis van het risicoprofiel het oefenprogramma van de brandweer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over antiziganisme, de National Roma Integration Strategy en stateloosheid

MP Van Baarle (DENK) asked the government about anti-Gypsyism, the EU Roma integration strategy, and statelessness among Dutch Roma. The minister answered that policy is generic anti-discrimination plus targeted Roma/Sinti measures, that no data exist on stateless Roma, and that existing law already gives Roma the same naturalisation rights as other aliens.
No data are available on this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het bericht dat een asielzoeker uit Libië dreigde dat Christenen moesten worden vermoord en nu spoorloos verdwenen is

PVV MPs Wilders and Markuszower asked why a Libyan asylum seeker convicted for threats against Christians disappeared, why he received only a two-week sentence, why he was not held or deported, and whether his photo was circulated. The Secretary of State declined to comment on the individual case, explained the general vigilance and detention and publication rules, and said a two-week sentence alone does not justify refusing or revoking asylum status.
As you know, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Zoals u weet kan ik over individuele zaken geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat in Deelen in Gelderland een AZC komt met 200 asielzoekers en huisvesting voor 400 arbeidsmigranten

MPs Heinen and Aartsen asked the ministers of Finance and Social Affairs whether bonus rules at Booking.com were changed and whether such bonuses are acceptable for a company receiving state aid. Minister Koolmees answered that bonuses and dividends during NOW support are undesirable, that NOW4 will require consultation with employee representatives on bonus and dividend policy, that Booking.com has repaid its NOW advance, and that no change to the regulatory framework is planned beyond raising concerns with the European Commission.
I have no insight into the amount of bonuses paid by companies.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de hoogte van bonussen van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Sociaal sekswerker hunkert naar erkenning: ‘Mensen met een beperking hebben ook behoeften en fantasieën”

MPs Wiersma and Tellegen asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a report on social sex work for people with disabilities, asking whether it should be recognised as normal work, whether it is regulated, and whether municipalities are responsible. The State Secretary answered that sex work is a legitimate profession, that no data on users exist, that social sex work is not a municipal care responsibility under the Wmo, and that a research study on intimacy and sexuality for people with disabilities will be commissioned.
Such an overview is not available, because such data are not registered.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet voorhanden, omdat dergelijke gegevens niet geregistreerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat een asielzoeker uit Iran in korte tijd meerdere meisjes heeft aangerand

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary about reports that an Iranian asylum seeker committed multiple sexual assaults, why he had not been deported after a prior conviction, and whether he would be removed after serving his sentence. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, stated that sexual offences are unacceptable and that the courts decide on sanctions, and explained the legal conditions under which asylum residence permits can be refused or withdrawn.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals u bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de berichten ‘Complete pakketreizen met als doel een al dan niet succesvolle asielaanvraag in Nederland’ en ‘Vooral Syriërs met valse documenten’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports of all-in travel packages from Syria to the Netherlands for asylum fraud, and whether fraudulent asylum seekers should be expelled, residence permits revoked, and borders closed. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the Netherlands has become a smuggling paradise, gave prosecution figures for 2020, said dual nationality is not a basis for action, declined to give numbers on fraud-based permits, and described existing revocation and criminal procedures without committing to closing borders.
It is not possible to provide figures on the number of residence permits that may have been granted on the basis of false or forged identity or nationality documents and/or statements.
Het is niet mogelijk om cijfers te geven over het aantal verblijfsvergunningen die mogelijk op basis van valse of vervalste identiteits- of nationaliteitsdocumenten en/of verklaringen zijn verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Ceder over het bericht dat een groep bekeerlingen door de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND) als niet geloofwaardig wordt bestempeld

Two MPs (Bisschop, Ceder) asked whether the IND's assessment of converts' asylum claims, including the work of its Taskforce, amounts to injustice and whether staff expertise and safeguards are adequate. The State Secretary answered that individual cases are assessed carefully with existing safeguards (legal aid, appeal, specialist coordinators, training) and that the IND sees no injustice, while promising only talks on training and continued dialogue with the legal profession.
The asylum system has several safeguards to ensure that the foreign national is treated justly.
Het asielsysteem kent meerdere waarborgen om ervoor te zorgen dat de vreemdeling recht wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Asielzoeker met claimgeld betaalt amper mee aan opvang’

An MP asked why only about 65,000 euro in own contributions was collected from asylum seekers under the expanded contribution scheme after their asylum-related penalty payments, and whether the scheme could be tightened. The state secretary answered that the amount is substantial relative to past years, that the scheme's thresholds mirror the welfare rules, and that she sees no reason to lower asset limits or investigate foreign assets further.
The COA has no authority to actively check whether this declaration was made truthfully or to trace any assets.
Het COA heeft geen bevoegdheid om actief te controleren of deze verklaring naar waarheid is afgegeven of eventueel vermogen op te sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Asielzoeker met claimgeld betaalt amper mee aan opvang; heffen eigen bijdrage lukt nauwelijks’

An MP asked the State Secretary about a report that asylum seekers with compensation money pay little toward reception costs, and about the rules on the own contribution and damages (dwangsommen). The State Secretary explained the cost per asylum seeker, the means test and recovery rules, and the amount of damages to be paid, without committing to new action.
COA has no power to actively check whether this declaration was truthfully given or to trace any assets.
Het COA heeft geen bevoegdheid om actief te controleren of deze verklaring naar waarheid is afgegeven of eventueel vermogen op te sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Ellemeet over het monitorrapport 'Leefomstandigheden van kinderen in de asielopvang'

MPs Koekkoek and Ellemeet asked about a monitoring report on children's living conditions in asylum reception centres, including feelings of insecurity, frequent relocations and the role of COA child contact persons. The State Secretary acknowledged the report, said some improvements have been made and that recommendations are being studied, but did not commit to adopting all of them and gave only general commitments on relocations and contact persons.
I am grateful to the members of the Werkgroep Kind in azc and the involved organisations for the research and the monitoring report.
Ik ben de leden van de Werkgroep Kind in azc en de betrokken organisaties erkentelijk voor het onderzoek en het monitorrapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht dat de marechaussee de handen vol heeft aan mensensmokkel

MP Wiersma (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that the Royal Marechaussee is overwhelmed by people smuggling, and about the progress of the enforcement approach, including the motion Van Ojik/Becker. The government answered that controls, Europol cooperation, a review of extraterritorial jurisdiction, and a proposal to raise penalties are underway, but gave limited quantitative results and did not record smuggling motives systematically.
In the registration of people-smuggling incidents by the implementing organisations, the motives are not structurally recorded.
Bij de registratie van de mensensmokkel incidenten door de uitvoeringsorganisaties worden de motieven niet structureel aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht dat in Budel in Brabant inwoners de stelende asielzoekers uit het AZC zo zat zijn dat zij een burgerwacht hebben gevormd

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether residents forming neighbourhood patrols in Budel over nuisance by asylum seekers should be seen as proof of failed asylum policy, and whether the government would detain and deport offenders and reward the patrol volunteers. The State Secretary answered that these are neighbourhood prevention teams aimed at general safety, that the municipality supports them, that detention depends on legal grounds handled by prosecutors, police and courts, and that she visits municipalities regularly.
There is no question of a neighbourhood watch but of neighbourhood prevention teams.
Er is geen sprake van een buurtwacht maar van buurtpreventieteams.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Koekkoek over de dreigende uitzetting van Davit en Nunë

MPs Ceder and Koekkoek asked the State Secretary about the threatened deportation of two Groningen-born children to Armenia, citing developmental risks, the child-rights convention, social networks, and the IND's handling of the children's stay and missed-whereabouts rules. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, maintained that the best interests of the child are weighed under Article 8 ECHR, and refused to change the criteria or commission new research.
As your House is aware, I cannot comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Simons over de veiligheidssituatie in azc’s voor lhbti-asielzoekers

MPs Koekkoek and Simons asked the State Secretary about safety for LGBTI asylum seekers in reception centres, citing LGBT Asylum Support reports of frequent, unanswered incident reports and weekend gaps in follow-up. The State Secretary replied that Bureau Veiligheid forwards reports to locations without substantive feedback for privacy reasons, that after-hours incidents are handled on site, that the COA now registers suspected discrimination, and that separate LGBTI units are rejected in favour of tailored placement.
Bureau Veiligheid does not give substantive feedback, only a brief email to LGBT Asylum Support confirming the signal was received and passed on.
Bureau Veiligheid geeft geen inhoudelijke terugkoppeling, maar een korte reactie aan LGBT Asylum Support per e-mail dat het signaal is ontvangen en doorgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de Libische kustwacht migranten op verzoek van Frontex onderschept

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers whether Frontex permits or orchestrates Libyan coast guard interceptions and returns of migrants in breach of international law, and about reported pushbacks and Frontex's response. The government answered that it follows the reports closely, that Frontex has explained its cooperation with the Libyan coast guard within SAR obligations, that internal and external investigations (Management Board, European Ombudsman, Parliament, OLAF) are ongoing, and that it will push for normalised disembarkation and safe ports.
In addition, the final report of the working group can be found on the Frontex website, and the Management Board has published conclusions following this report.
10 Daarnaast is het finale rapport van de werkgroep te vinden op de website van Frontex 11 en heeft de Management Board naar aanleiding van dit rapport conclusies gepubliceerd 12 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de betrokkenheid van Frontex bij illegale pushbacks

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about Frontex's involvement in alleged illegal pushbacks, Frontex's support to the Libyan coast guard, Dutch personnel deployed to Greece, and oversight of the agency's Management Board. The government answered at length, pointing to ongoing reviews by the Management Board working group, the European Ombudsman, the European Parliament and OLAF, and committing to consider a standing working group on fundamental rights and to inform parliament on the Dutch position.
The cabinet cannot of course anticipate the outcomes of the various ongoing investigations by the European Parliament, the Ombudsman and OLAF.
Het kabinet kan uiteraard niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van de verschillende lopende onderzoeken van het Europees Parlement, de Ombudsman en OLAF
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het misbruik van ‘grijze paspoorten’ door de Turkse AK-partij

An MP asked the government whether it is aware that municipal officials linked to Turkey's ruling AK party allegedly sold grey service passports used for irregular travel to Germany, whether this facilitates people smuggling, and whether any such travellers have reached the Netherlands. The government answered that it is concerned, that Turkey has suspended service passports for non-officials on project travel, that Dutch border checks and Europol cooperation address smuggling risks, and that it is not known whether anyone obtained a passport through corruption and travelled to the Netherlands.
Reports that official documents are being misused to facilitate irregular migration towards the EU are worrying and must be thoroughly investigated.
Berichten dat officiële documenten oneigenlijk worden gebruikt om irreguliere migratie richting de EU te faciliteren zijn zorgelijk en dienen grondig te worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Hij heeft me gewoon opgelicht’

An MP asked the ministers about reports of exploitation of Asian chefs brought to the Netherlands under a residence-and-work permit scheme, including IND permits during closures, recruitment via intermediaries, job ads with harsh conditions, wage deductions and bonds. The government answered at length, stating that employers are responsible and that the Inspectorate and UWV can act, and announced it will end the scheme for non-EU chefs at first application while the scheme is reviewed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over deportatie van Syrische vluchtelingen door Denemarken

An MP asked the State Secretary and Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would challenge Denmark's decision not to renew or to revoke residence permits of about 380 Syrian refugees and whether the Netherlands would offer them asylum. The government answered that it saw no reason to intervene, citing Denmark's sovereign asylum competence, the mutual trust principle, and the appeal and ECtHR remedies available, and declined to offer asylum to those affected.
Within the normative frameworks of these treaties, member states have room to make their own policy assessment, based on the country information available to them.
Binnen de normatieve kaders van deze verdragen hebben lidstaten de ruimte om een eigen beleidsafweging te maken, aan de hand van de hun beschikbare landeninformatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het feit dat er gewoon reisbureaus zijn die zich specialiseren in leuke reizen naar Ethiopië terwijl nog steeds mensen uit dit land asiel aanvragen in Nederland

PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked whether it is absurd that Ethiopians seek asylum in the Netherlands while travel agencies sell holidays to Ethiopia, and whether all Ethiopian asylum seekers can therefore return, and whether borders should be closed to them. The State Secretary answered that asylum claims are assessed individually against the country situation, that tourist access does not equal absence of risk, that the general asylum report is being considered for implications, and that closing borders is not a realistic solution.
I am considering the implications for national asylum policy and expect to inform the House shortly.
Ik ben mij aan het beraden over de implicaties voor het landgebonden asielbeleid. Ik verwacht de Kamer daarover op korte termijn te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht dat de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND) het afgelopen jaar bijna 50.000 vreemdelingen de Nederlandse nationaliteit heeft gegeven

An MP from the PVV asked whether naturalisations of about 50,000 foreigners, many Syrians who arrived in 2015, should be reversed, Syrians returned, and nationality revocation pursued. The State Secretary answered that the security situation in Syria has not substantially improved, that return is not initiated by the government, a new general country report is awaited, and that the European Convention on Nationality prohibits revoking nationality for these reasons.
I will inform your House in due course whether there is reason to change the asylum policy towards Syria.
Ik zal uw Kamer te zijner tijd informeren of er aanleiding bestaat het asielbeleid ten aanzien van Syrië te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat er een Syrische terreurverdachte is opgepakt in een AZC in Friesland

Two PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how a Syrian terror suspect arrested in a Friesland asylum centre could enter the Netherlands and remain free, and whether migration screening can rule out further terrorists. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case because of an ongoing criminal investigation, described the layered screening and monitoring in the asylum chain, and rejected preventive detention of Syrian asylum seekers and border closure while supporting a strengthened Schengen.
As you know, I do not make statements about individual cases.
Zoals u weet doe ik over individuele zaken geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht 'Uitzetting de mist in door fouten overheid'

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why about 14% of immigration detention orders were lifted because of government procedural errors, why detention yields low departure rates for Moroccan and Algerian nationals, and what is being done to secure returns of rejected asylum seekers. The State Secretary responded that the figures show an improving trend, that detention is a last resort and procedural pressure is being addressed through a longer detention-decision period, and that cooperation with origin countries and criminal-law coordination are ongoing, with a fuller response on the ACVZ report to follow.
Although it is unfortunate that detention orders have to be lifted for these reasons, this must be seen against the background of a favourable trend.
Hoewel het onfortuinlijk is dat bewaringen om deze redenen moeten worden opgeheven, staat dit tegen de achtergrond van een gunstige trend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jansen en Smolders over de huisvesting van statushouders

MPs Jansen and Smolders asked the government about the nationalities, residence duration, permit type, housing need and waiting-time impact of the 11,000 refugee-permit holders to be housed in the second half of 2021, and about municipal consequences of missing the quota. The minister answered that nationalities cannot be precisely forecast but gave 2020 outflow figures, that all permits are initially five-year, and that the province supervises municipal quota compliance through a six-step intervention ladder ending in substitution at municipal cost.
No precise breakdown by nationality can be given for this estimate.
Bij deze raming kan geen precieze uitsplitsing naar nationaliteit worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Kops over het bericht dat 11.000 vergunninghouders in de tweede helft van dit jaar een woning moeten krijgen

PVV MPs Markuszower and Kops asked why about 11,000 asylum permit holders should receive housing within six months when Dutch citizens wait years, and whether they should be denied housing and borders closed. The minister replied that asylum protection is required by law, that housing allocation is handled by municipalities under a half-yearly quota, that no nationality-based distinction is made, and that closing borders is not a realistic solution.
No distinction is made in the Netherlands on the basis of nationality.
Er wordt in Nederland geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht dat Denemarken tijdelijke verblijfsvergunningen van Syriërs niet verlengt vanwege de verbeterde veiligheidssituatie in Syrië

Member Eerdmans (JA21) asked about Denmark not extending temporary residence permits for Syrians due to improved security, and whether the Netherlands should follow. The State Secretary reported 46,940 Syrians holding asylum residence permits, said Dutch Syria policy is based on objective ambtsberichten, found the security situation not substantially improved in the latest report, and promised a new ambtsbericht this summer with a policy review.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to prepare a new general country report on the situation in Syria.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heb ik gevraagd een nieuw algemeen ambtsbericht over de situatie in Syrië op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht dat een levensgevaarlijke asielcrimineel weer op vrije voeten is gezet en zo een slachtpartij kon aanrichten in een AZC

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why a Nigerian asylum seeker arrested a week earlier for violence was released a day later and then allegedly carried out a stabbing at an asylum centre, and whether he would be punished, deported and whether an asylum stop and closure of centres would be introduced. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, said the police and Public Prosecution Service handle criminal matters, referred to a forthcoming incident report for statistics, and did not agree to an asylum stop.
As your House is aware, I cannot comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de mogelijkheid voor gemeenten om zelfstandig staatloosheid te onderzoeken en/of vast te stellen

An MP asked whether municipalities can independently investigate and establish statelessness and recode 'nationality unknown' to 'stateless' in the BRP, and whether they should be given guidance. The state secretary answered that municipalities have only a limited registration competence based on evident documents and refused a broader investigative duty, pointing instead to a forthcoming court-based statelessness determination procedure and declining to issue a guidance document.
This concerns a low-threshold procedure open to every person who claims to be stateless, regardless of their residence status.
Het betreft een laagdrempelige procedure die toegankelijk is voor elke persoon die stelt staatloos te zijn, ongeacht diens verblijfsstatus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over onveiligheid onder buschauffeurs rondom Ter Apel

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about insecurity among bus drivers around Ter Apel, including a union survey and reduced enforcement staff. The State Secretary condemned the problem, said the responsibility for staffing and public order lies with the employer and local authorities, and listed measures taken, such as ketenmariniers, a toolbox, and a subsidy for boa's on the bus lines.
The decision on the number of boa's deployed is not mine and does not fall within my responsibility, but within the responsibility of the employer and the local triumvirate of authorities.
De beslissing over de inzet van het aantal boa's ligt niet bij mij en valt ook niet binnen mijn verantwoordelijkheid, maar binnen de verantwoordelijkheid van de werkgever en gezagsdriehoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie en het bericht 'Koolmees: geen aparte steunregeling voor sekswerkers'

An MP asked the ministers how people in prostitution can access income support and TONK during the COVID-19 crisis, including differences between municipalities and the status of a motion on exit support. The government replied that several schemes may apply depending on status, that TONK is locally implemented with variation, that municipalities are being engaged, and that a motion study will be answered in spring 2021.
The cabinet has asked municipalities to apply TONK generously.
Het kabinet heeft gemeenten verzocht de TONK ruimhartig toe te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Ceder, Jasper van Dijk en Piri over de dreigende uitzetting van Amsterdamse modelburgers Sofia en Najoua

MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the threatened deportation of two Amsterdam-raised young women, questioning whether the IND's decision, its appeal against the court ruling and the rules for residence under article 8 ECHR were consistent with the rights of children and the courts' findings. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, noted the IND has withdrawn the appeal and granted residence, and explained general routes and guidance for adults who grew up in the Netherlands without residence status.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases nor into the considerations underlying the decision to lodge an appeal.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken noch op overwegingen die ten grondslag liggen aan het instellen van Hoger Beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de kwalificatie 'veilig land' in asielzaken

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security how the Council of State's ruling that the 'safe country' designations in asylum cases must be better substantiated affects pending and past asylum decisions, and how sources will be broadened. The State Secretary answers that re-assessments of Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia and Georgia have started with more sources, that pending cases are finished where possible, and that past decisions may need re-assessment where the motivation cannot be repaired.
However, a larger number of sources must be consulted, including in particular information from other member states, EASO, UNHCR, the Council of Europe and other relevant international organisations.
Wel moet een groter aantal bronnen worden geraadpleegd, waaronder in het bijzonder informatie uit andere lidstaten, EASO, UNHCR, Raad van Europa en andere relevante internationale organisaties.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de uitvoering van de motie Jasper van Dijk en Van Toorenburg over het wegnemen van de juridische belemmeringen voor naturalisatie van RANOV-vergunninghouders

An MP asked why the Secretary of State delays implementing a motion on removing legal obstacles to naturalisation for RANOV permit holders by commissioning new research, and why WODC is used for this politically. The Secretary replied that current figures and expert input are needed before deciding, that IND and WODC each contribute distinct parts of one report, and that the study takes only a few months.
I consider it important to make a decision based on current and complete information.
Ik vind het belangrijk om op basis van actuele en volledige informatie een besluit te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeets, Kuik, Jasper van Dijk, Ceder en Piri over het bericht ‘Tina en Jacob moeten weg!’

MPs from D66, CDA, SP, ChristenUnie and PvdA asked whether Armenian Syrians facing revocation of asylum status are treated unequally, and why some keep their permits while others lose them. The State Secretary answered that re-assessment is individual, that the IND does not register these figures, and that a 2021 court ruling concerned insufficient reasoning on equality, not discrimination.
The requested numerical data cannot be provided.
De gevraagde cijfermatige gegeven kunnen niet verstrekt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Ellemeet, Ceder, Kuik en Koekkoek over de mogelijke uitzetting van Tina en Jacob

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why Tina and Jacob, Syrian-Armenians, faced deportation to Armenia and whether their family ties and residence in the Netherlands should count. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case on privacy and confidentiality grounds, explained the IND's general approach to dual nationals and safe third countries, and noted that the IND had granted a residence permit.
As said, I cannot go into the individual case.
Zoals gezegd kan ik niet ingaan op de individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Bouali over het verdwijnen van Vietnamese alleenstaande kinderen uit de COA-opvang

MPs Van Ojik and Bouali asked about Vietnamese unaccompanied minors disappearing from COA shelter, including police handling of two boys later found in the Essex case, trafficking criteria, and new work procedures. The state secretary answered that police monitored the boys across the border without a concrete suspicion, that no 'doorlaten' occurred, that Vietnamese minors are placed in protected shelter, and described existing cooperation with the UK and EU.
In the Netherlands this case will be reflected upon and it will be examined which possible lessons can be drawn from it.
In Nederland zal gereflecteerd worden op deze zaak en zal worden bezien welke mogelijke lessen hier uit getrokken kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over een radiouitzending over het Essexdrama waarbij 39 slachtoffers vielen

SP MPs Van Nispen and Van Dijk asked about an Argos radio broadcast on the Essex tragedy, the police surveillance of two Vietnamese minors, the lawyer's exclusion, why no Dutch prosecutions followed, and alleged pressure on the EMM report. The state secretary defended the police and prosecution handling, said no concrete suspicion arose, gave limited figures on missing Vietnamese minors, and declined to order a new investigation.
It is generally not customary to inform a lawyer about the progress of a police investigation.
Het is in het algemeen niet gebruikelijk om een advocaat te informeren over de voortgang van een politioneel onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Jasper van Dijk over de zware omstandigheden op Lesbos en Kamp Moria 2.0

An MP asked the State Secretary about harsh conditions at Lesbos camps (Moria 2.0), including sanitation, lead contamination, winterization, and the age of unaccompanied minors. The government answered that Mavrovouni is better than Moria in most respects, that toilet ratios meet standards, that lead levels in living zones are within limits with precautionary measures, and it listed Dutch financial contributions.
The government is therefore not planning to join the call of the various organisations.
Het kabinet is daarom niet voornemens om zich aan te sluiten bij de oproep van de verschillende organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Markuszower over het bericht ‘Asielzoekers (14, 15 en 16) aangehouden na gewelddadige inbraak Oisterwijk’

PVV MPs asked whether juveniles aged 14-16 who commit serious crimes should always be tried under adult criminal law, for statistics on asylum-seeking minors suspected of crimes, for expulsion of convicted asylum seekers and their families, and for closing borders and asylum centres. The State Secretary replied that the juvenile justice system is sufficiently equipped, promised a conference on maximum penalties, said data for 2015-2017 would require detailed research and 2020 figures will appear in the Staat van Migratie, stated that return will be pursued where grounds exist (without discussing individual files), and rejected closing borders as unrealistic.
Of course, due to the Personal Data Protection Act I cannot go into the individual files.
Natuurlijk kan ik vanwege de wet bescherming persoonsgegevens niet in gaan op de individuele dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Toorenburg over het niet uitvoeren van de motie over de naturalisatie van circa 10.000 pardonners (Ranov-vergunninghouders

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Van Toorenburg asked why the government has not implemented a motion to speed up naturalisation of about 10,000 Ranov permit holders, given earlier reports, and whether it will implement the motion immediately. The State Secretary answers that she knows the earlier reports but has commissioned additional research into the current group and its obstacles, with results expected in July 2021, which are relevant to how the motion will be implemented.

For this purpose I have commissioned additional research, in which I asked to map the current group of Ranov permit holders and the obstacles they currently experience in submitting a naturalisation application.

Hiervoor heb ik een aanvullend onderzoek ingesteld, waarbij ik gevraagd heb de actuele groep Ranov-vergunninghouders en de knelpunten die zij op dit moment ervaren voor het indienen van een naturalisatieverzoek in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Weigering coronatest kan asielzoeker respijt geven; ’Consequentie is dat de terugkeer geen doorgang vindt’'

An MP asked how many rejected asylum seekers with a departure obligation refused PCR tests, where they ended up, whether detention is possible, and whether refusal should be criminalised. The government said refusal is not registered and cannot be retrieved without individual file research, that refusal to cooperate can be weighed in detention decisions under time limits, and that it will not introduce a general criminal offence of unlawful stay.
How many foreigners at any time refused to cooperate with a PCR test could currently only be determined through extensive individual file research and cannot reasonably be realised.

Hoeveel vreemdelingen op enig moment hebben geweigerd medewerking te verlenen aan de afname van een PCR-test zou op dit moment alleen te achterhalen zijn door een omvangrijk, individueel dossieronderzoek en kan redelijkerwijs niet worden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Voordewind en Kuiken over het bericht 'Achterstanden bij IND in behandeling asielaanvragen zijn groter dan gemeld bij de Tweede Kamer'

MPs Groothuizen, Voordewind and Kuiken asked whether the IND's backlog of asylum applications is larger than reported to parliament, and why repeat applications from before 1 April 2020 are not all handled by the Taskforce. The State Secretary denies that the backlog is larger, explains the Taskforce scope and the 15,350-case figure, and describes how repeat applicants are notified and scheduled.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de bejegening van LHBT-asielzoekers door het COA

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that LGBT asylum seekers were mistreated by COA staff, including a threat with a knife and a transfer described as deportation, and whether COA staff are trained to treat them with tact. The State Secretary did not recognise the picture painted by the reports, declined to discuss individual cases, pointed to a letter of 5 March on LGBTI safety measures, and said COA residents were informed of the evening curfew before transfers.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Groothuizen, Van Ojik en Jasper van Dijk over pushbacks van vluchtelingen door de Kroatische grensbewaking

MPs asked the State Secretary whether she knew of Danish Refugee Council and EenVandaag reports of pushbacks and violence by Croatian border guards, and whether she would raise them at EU Justice and Home Affairs Council, press the Commission, reconsider mutual trust in Croatia and address the damage to EU asylum policy. The State Secretary said the allegations are serious and must be investigated, that the subject was discussed at the January 2021 JHA Council and under Croatia's Schengen action plan, that the Commission is in dialogue with Croatia and is setting up an independent monitoring mechanism, and that mutual trust applies unless a court rules otherwise.
No court rulings have been made regarding Croatia that would mean the principle of mutual trust can no longer be assumed.
Over Kroatië zijn in dezen geen rechterlijke uitspraken gedaan die tot gevolg hebben dat niet langer kan worden uitgegaan van het interstatelijk vertrouwensbeginsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de brief van werkgroep kind in AZC 'Impact corona op kinderen in AZC’s'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a working group letter reporting that children in asylum centres face poor internet, too few laptops and tablets, and reduced mental health and care support during COVID-19 school closures, and whether children can return to school. The government acknowledged the problems, described COA wifi upgrades, device funding of EUR 24 million via SIVON, maintained care consultations in adapted form, and noted that schools reopened from February and March 2021, with asylum-centre pupils prioritised.

As I shared with the House in my June 2020 letter, the COA, although providing good wifi to residents is not a standard service, decided during the first lockdown to invest in expanding bandwidth and wifi capacity, mainly for home schooling.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van juni 2020 met uw Kamer heb gedeeld heeft het COA, ondanks dat het aanbieden van goede wifi voor bewoners geen standaarddienst is, tijdens de eerste lockdown besloten om, met name ten behoeve van het thuisonderwijs, te investeren in uitbreiding van de bandbreedte en de wifi-capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over dna-testen in verband met verzoeken tot gezinshereniging voor vluchtelingen

An MP asked whether the IND's four-week deadline for booking DNA tests at the embassy, after which family reunification applications for refugees are rejected, is lawful and proportionate, and whether minors are adequately protected. The Secretary of State defended the practice as a long-standing deadline, said applicants can file new applications with priority once they are reachable, and committed only to exploring cooperation with UNHCR and IOM.
This concerns a period applied in practice that aligns with the response period the foreign national receives when a file is incomplete.
Het betreft een termijn die in de praktijk wordt gehanteerd en aansluit bij de reactietermijn die de vreemdeling krijgt wanneer er sprake is van een incompleet dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'Lange rijen bij registratie in Ter Apel'

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about long queues and night-time conditions for asylum seekers at the registration point in Ter Apel, including opening hours of AVIM, the planned chain coordinator, and preparation for instroom peaks. The State Secretary answered that after-hours arrivals wait in heated pavilions, that AVIM capacity is sufficient on average, that a chain coordinator started on 1 November 2020, and that the Flexibilisering Asielketen programme has been handed over to partner organisations.

To completely prevent asylum seekers having to spend a night in a pavilion, the registration process would need to run 24 hours a day, seven days a week, since asylum seekers arrive day and night in Ter Apel.

Om helemaal te voorkomen dat asielzoekers een nacht in een paviljoen moeten doorbrengen, zou het aanmeldproces 24 uur per dag zeven dagen per week moeten draaien, aangezien asielzoekers dag en nacht aankomen in Ter Apel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Voordewind over het bericht 'Wat er met Ali, Samoal, Ibrahim gebeurde na hun uitzetting naar Soedan'

MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Voordewind asked whether the government monitors asylum seekers deported to Sudan, whether the NISS mistreats returnees, and why deportations continued despite reports of torture. The State Secretary answered that post-return monitoring is not part of Dutch return policy, that no concrete evidence of irregularities linked to deportations was received, and that Sudan is considered safe enough for returns.
Monitoring does not form part of the Dutch return policy.
Monitoring geen deel uitmaakt van het Nederlandse terugkeerbeleid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof 'Alvorens een terugkeerbesluit uit te vaardigen tegen een niet-begeleide minderjarige, moet een lidstaat nagaan of er voor de minderjarige

MP Groothuizen asked whether Dutch policy complies with the European Court ruling that a member state must first check whether adequate reception exists before issuing a return decision for unaccompanied minors, and why the state did not check for minors over 15. The State Secretary acknowledged the ruling, said the DT&V previously checked adequacy only after the return decision, and that return decisions for unaccompanied minors are being withdrawn and no new ones issued pending a policy decision.

Under the previously applicable practice, the Dutch Return and Departure Service (DT&V) only examined after issuing a return decision whether adequate reception existed to enable return, with the return suspended.

In de voorheen geldende uitvoeringspraktijk onderzocht de Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek (DT&V) eerst ná het nemen van een terugkeerbesluit of er adequate opvang was om terugkeer te realiseren, onder opschorting van de terugkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de uitspraken van Eurocommissaris Johansson dat Europa meer migranten nodig heeft

An SGP MP asks the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of Health about EU Commissioner Johansson's remarks that Europe needs more migrants, and about the implications for Dutch migration debate and policy. The government answers that the remarks have no consequences for the Dutch situation, that member states decide on labour migration numbers, that a general migration ceiling is not current policy, and that the relevant demographic and sectoral analyses (Verkenning 2050, WRR report) are still awaited.
The final report of the Verkenning 2050, which will contain a calculation of the societal implications, is expected in spring 2021.
Het eindrapport van de Verkenning 2050, dat een doorrekening van de maatschappelijke implicaties zal bevatten, is in het voorjaar van 2021 voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Wörsdörfer over signalen over problematiek samenhangend met de overgang van statushouders van een AZC naar de gemeente

VVD MPs asked how status holders are transferred from asylum reception centres to municipalities, what factors guide placement, what funding and information municipalities receive, and whether their care needs and municipal difficulties are being addressed. The State Secretary explained the COA-to-municipality matching and information-sharing process, noted some information gaps and a review underway, and stated that funding and care needs are handled under the same criteria as other residents, with an Ombudsman investigation into unaccompanied minors pending.
Your House will be informed about this shortly.
Uw Kamer wordt hierover op korte termijn geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht ‘Eerst Assads strijder, nu asiel in Nederland’?

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether IND granted residence to Assad regime affiliates, why few 1F exclusions were applied, why prosecution has lagged behind Germany, why reports from the Syrian community went unanswered, and how victims are protected from threats. The minister declines to discuss individual cases, defends the existing 1F policy and the Team Internationale Misdrijven, admits one unanswered report due to an error, and points to existing protection measures without new commitments.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet in gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van de leden Groothuizen, Van Dam en Buitenweg over de rechtsstaat in Polen en de gevolgen voor Nederland

MPs Groothuizen, Van Dam and Buitenweg asked the government about media pluralism and press freedom in Poland, press lawsuits, EU tools, Polish asylum claims under the Aznar protocol, free movement, and detained Polish suspects after extradition suspensions. The government answered at length, largely describing EU monitoring frameworks, noting the limits of EU instruments, declining to provide asylum-motive statistics, and reporting that no one is held in Dutch detention solely due to the suspension.
The cabinet is not aware that Polish citizens are currently experiencing problems exercising their right to free movement in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet is er niet mee bekend dat Poolse burgers momenteel problemen ondervinden bij het uitoefenen van hun recht op vrij verkeer in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het landgebonden asielbeleid voor China

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the Dutch asylum policy for Chinese nationals, which allows examining Turkey as a first country of asylum or safe third country for Uyghurs, should change given a reported China-Turkey extradition treaty, and asked about Uyghur asylum numbers, ratification timing, and whether Chinese journalists and bloggers should be treated as a risk group. The State Secretary answered that the policy will not change for now because the treaty is unratified and safety is assessed individually, that Chinese asylum seekers numbered 56 in 2020 with no Chinese nationals returned to Turkey, and that journalists and bloggers cannot be treated as a risk group as a whole in China.
I will closely monitor developments and where necessary gather information on this.
Ik zal de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend in de gaten houden en waar nodig informatie hierover inwinnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Ojik over zorg en begeleiding voor ex-AMV'ers vanaf 18 jaar

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about extended care and support for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers (AMV'ers) after they turn 18, including whether a uniform scheme and extra funding should be found. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for adult status holders, that Nidos extension is already possible at municipal cost, and that no structural or incidental funds are available in 2021, while promising ambtelijk contact but no timeline.
Should a new cabinet wish to regulate the support of the group you mean structurally and nationally, a civil-servant proposal will be requested for that purpose.
Mocht een nieuw kabinet de begeleiding van de door u bedoelde groep structureel en landelijk willen regelen, dan zal gevraagd worden om een ambtelijk voorstel daartoe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de Kamerbrieven 'Voortgang afdoen vertraagde zaken IND' 'Gevolgen van de COVID-19-pandemie voor het migratiebeleid'

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the backlog of asylum cases at the IND, the stock of open cases at the end of 2020, the monthly reduction of the backlog, expected inflows and follow-up family reunification, and the new IND financing model. The State Secretary answered with figures on the open caseload, a forecast for July 2021, a commitment to monthly publication of backlog figures, and an assessment that the financing model cannot yet be evaluated.

The IND will publish these figures monthly around the 10th of the month for the time being, until the Taskforce has finished clearing the backlog of first asylum applications from before 1 April 2020.

De IND zal de komende tijd deze cijfers maandelijks rond de 10 de van de maand publiceren, tot het moment dat de Taskforce klaar is met het wegwerken van de achterstand op eerste asielaanvragen van voor 1 april 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over overlastgevende asielzoekers in de omgeving van AZC Budel

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about nuisance by asylum seekers around the AZC Budel reception centre, including a police response failure, use of 'knokploegen', and renovation plans. The State Secretary answers that nuisance is unacceptable, that police capacity is a matter for the regional mayor and police chief, that a range of measures (ketenmariniers, Top-X list, htl placement, sober reception) is in place, and that the renovation does not increase places and the municipality and COA continue dialogue.
The regional mayor and the regional police chief are responsible for local police capacity.
De regioburgemeester en de regionale politiechef gaan over de lokale politiecapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van de Molen en Van Toorenburg n.a.v. het bericht ‘Slecht Engels sprekende internationale studenten verdwijnen mogelijk in illegaliteit'

CDA MPs asked whether international students who fail to master English disappear into illegality, how the visa system tracks departures, and whether other EU countries face the same problem. The minister replied that no data exist on students who stay on illegally, that there are few signs of deliberate misuse so no extra action is planned, and that the English-language exemption in the code of conduct is optional for institutions, not a tightening of language requirements.
There is no data available if a student chooses not to return to their country of origin but goes into illegality or applies for residence in another country, whether or not within the EU.

Er zijn geen gegevens voorhanden als een student ervoor kiest om niet terug te keren naar zijn land van herkomst maar de illegaliteit ingaat of verblijf aanvraagt in een ander land, al dan niet binnen de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Jasper van Dijk en Kuiken over de bureaucratie waarmee Ranov-vergunninghouders worden tegengewerkt bij het verkrijgen van het Nederlanderschap

MPs Van Ojik, Van Dijk and Kuiken asked why Ranov permit holders who have lived in the Netherlands for decades must meet a strict document requirement to naturalise, and whether the requirement should be dropped or Ranov permits converted to asylum permits. The State Secretary answers that individual exceptions are possible, that Ranov holders were found not to need protection and can be expected to obtain documents from their country of origin, and that a new WODC study will examine problems Ranov holders experience.

The policy ensures that, in the naturalisation procedure, the personal details and current possession of a foreign nationality are as far as possible known and demonstrated for foreigners with a regular right of residence.

Het beleid borgt dat in de naturalisatieprocedure zo goed als mogelijk de persoonsgegevens en het actueel bezit van de vreemde nationaliteit bekend en aangetoond zijn van vreemdelingen met een regulier verblijfrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de situatie in de Griekse vluchtelingenkampen

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary about deteriorating conditions in Greek refugee camps, including rat bites on babies, winter unpreparedness, and whether a civil-military emergency operation under Frontex and faster asylum processing should be pursued. The government answered that conditions at the new Mavrovouni camp are better than at Moria, that the lead-contamination concerns were addressed, and that given Greek, EU and Frontex efforts it sees no reason for an emergency operation or faster-track measures.

Given the efforts of the Greek government, the support provided by the European Commission, EASO, Frontex, UNHCR and others, and the recent improvements in the situation of asylum seekers on the Greek islands that have resulted from this, I see no reason at this time for the mentioned civil-military emergency operation.

Gezien de inspanningen van de Griekse regering, de ondersteuning die hierbij wordt geboden door de Europese Commissie, EASO, Frontex, UNHCR en anderen en de recente verbeteringen van de situatie van asielzoekers op de Griekse eilanden die hiervan het resultaat zijn, zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding voor genoemde civiel-militaire noodoperatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht ‘Geen enkel alleenstaand kind uit kamp Moria is in Nederland aangekomen’

MP Kuiken asked whether the promised relocation of unaccompanied minors from Moria has been met, given that no such child had arrived, and whether the government will take more people from Greece. The State Secretary answered that two unaccompanied minors arrived in January, declined to comment on individual cases, defended the selection of vulnerable people from several Greek locations, and said no additional relocation offer is planned.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Driejarig meisje gevonden in modder van Moria, na vermoedelijke verkrachting’

MPs Kuiken, Ploumen and Van den Hul asked whether the government shares outrage over reports of a three-year-old girl sexually assaulted in the Moria camp area, whether the new Mavrovouni camp on Lesbos falls short on safety for vulnerable people, and whether the Netherlands will take in more vulnerable people. The State Secretary answered that the government shares the concern and cites safety improvements at Mavrovouni, but says conditions still fall short of standards and that no additional resettlement offer will be made beyond the existing commitments.
The cabinet does not intend to make an additional resettlement offer.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om een additioneel herplaatsingsaanbod te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht 'Eerst Assads strijder, nu asiel in Nederland'

MP Kuzu asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether they knew of Assad-regime sympathisers and alleged war criminals in the Netherlands who received asylum, and what would be done about it, including the disappearance of a Syrian whistleblower. The State Secretary replied that 1F exclusion is applied through individual assessment, that criminal investigations depend on concrete suspicion and realistic prospects, that Syrian refugees are protected like any other resident, and declined to discuss individual cases.
I cannot go into these individual cases or persons.
Ik kan niet ingaan op deze individuele zaken of personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'veroordeelde oorlogsmisdadigers kunnen mogelijk asiel krijgen'

MPs Becker and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether a Raad van State ruling of December 2020 lets people excluded under Article 1F (war crimes) obtain asylum in the Netherlands, and whether they could gain residence via family ties to an EU citizen in another member state. The Secretary of State answered that the ruling concerns entry bans and public-order risk rather than asylum, that 1F exclusion from asylum remains unchanged, and that no legislative change is needed.
The Council of State ruling brings no change to the existing laws and regulations or their interpretation, nor to the 1F policy.
De uitspraak van de Raad van State brengt geen verandering in (de uitleg van) bestaande wet- en regelgeving, ook niet in het 1F-beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Vluchtelingen die in Nederland aankwamen, waren al statushouders in Griekenland’

MPs Kuiken, Ploumen and Van den Hul asked whether only 50 of the promised 100 children and vulnerable people had arrived from Greece, whether recent arrivals already held Greek status, whether the government would meet the Moria deal, and whether it would reverse returns and act on conditions on Lesbos. The government answered that it will not make an additional relocation offer, that status holders in the Netherlands are returned to Greece as lawful under EU rules, and that conditions at Mavrovouni are better than at Moria though still needing structural improvement.
The cabinet does not intend to make an additional relocation offer.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om een additioneel herplaatsingsaanbod te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘Brandbom bij Syrisch gezin in Heerlen: burenruzie of racisme’

The MP Kuzu asks the ministers about a Syrian family in Heerlen subjected to months of threats, intimidation and violence, including a reported firebomb, and about the roles of the municipality, police, housing corporation Vincio Wonen and its past discrimination record. The minister answers that investigations are ongoing and declines to discuss the specific incidents, states that local authorities are primarily responsible for safety and housing, and says the corporation's discrimination matter was previously prosecuted and dismissed while a new review of social media is underway.
While this investigation is ongoing, I do not wish to go into the substance of this specific case and the possible incidents.
Lopende dit onderzoek wil ik niet inhoudelijk ingaan op deze specifieke casus en de eventuele incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van der Graaf over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

An MP asked the government about the effects of the COVID-19 crisis on sex workers, including health protection, registration of clients, financial support, and the status of parlour clubs. The Minister answered that sex work has been hit hard, that sex establishments are closed and non-medical contact work is banned, that support schemes are available but largely inaccessible to non-self-employed sex workers, and that the regulation bill will be submitted shortly.
The bill on the regulation of sex work will be submitted to your House at very short notice.
Het wetsvoorstel Regulering Sekswerk zal op zeer korte termijn bij uw Kamer worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het onbereikbaar maken van Nederlanderschap

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why raising the naturalisation language requirement to B1 would make citizenship unreachable for many newcomers, including low-literate refugees, and what the consequences would be for voting rights and daily life. The State Secretary defended the B1 requirement as the crown on successful integration, pointed to the Z-route and the option procedure, and said the draft naturalisation test decree was still under review after consultation.
The coalition agreement states that the language requirement for both integration and naturalisation will be raised to B1 of the Common European Framework.
In het regeerakkoord is opgenomen dat zowel voor inburgering als voor naturalisatie de taaleis wordt verhoogd naar B1 van het Referentiekader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berge over de gevolgen van de Covid-19-maatregelen voor sekswerkers

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about confusion over Covid-19 rules for sex workers, their exclusion from the TOZO income support for opting-in workers, and whether they should be consulted and financially supported. The State Secretary acknowledged the communication problems, pointed to existing schemes (TOZO, WW, bijstand, planned TONK) and gave no new financial commitment.
The number of COVID-19 infections in sex work is not registered.
Het aantal COVID-19-besmettingen in het sekswerk wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Wijngaarden over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad inzake het inreisverbod

MPs Becker and Van Wijngaarden asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the Supreme Court ruling on entry bans, the use of criminal prosecution under article 197 Sr for illegal residents, detention and reception of those with bans, and the relation to unwanted-person declarations. The State Secretary answered that prosecutions have sharply declined pending a Court of Justice ruling, gave approximate figures (about 10 people detained), explained the return procedure and reception policy, and referred to earlier letters for further detail.
It is not possible to give a precise picture of how many foreigners reside unlawfully in the Netherlands and therefore also not how many of them have an entry ban.
Het is niet mogelijk een precies beeld te geven van hoeveel vreemdelingen onrechtmatig in Nederland verblijven en dus ook niet hoeveel van hen een inreisverbod hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de anonimiteit van homoseksuele asielzoekers

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether a published article naming and photographing a rejected gay asylum-seeking couple, without clear consent, was taken down, whether consent was given, whether publication endangers them on return, and whether their asylum case will be reconsidered. The State Secretary confirmed the article was removed from the website and government channels, said consent was not unambiguous and the magazine will tighten safeguards, but declined to comment on individual cases and only generally said all relevant facts are considered.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Van Toorenburg en Voordewind over het beëindigen van de coulance-regeling

MPs Groothuizen, Van Toorenburg and Voordewind asked why the COA coulance (grace) regime for rejected asylum seekers, used in the first lockdown, was not reintroduced, and whether people are being put onto the street during the current lockdown. The State Secretary replied that asylum processes are classed as vital, that accommodation options (vbl, family locations) remain available, that the coulance is not reinstated, and that departures are realistic.
Since there are shelter facilities for rejected asylum seekers and the asylum chain processes remain operational, I have decided not to reintroduce the coulance regime.
Aangezien er onderdakvoorzieningen zijn voor afgewezen asielzoekers en de processen in de asielketen operationeel blijven, heb ik besloten de coulanceregeling niet opnieuw in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘Snelle douane helpt luchtvaart uit Corona’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of Infrastructure about press reports on US preclearance at Schiphol, including the timeline of talks, economic benefits, and the process to implement it. The government replied that negotiations continue with Dutch sovereignty conditions maintained, the bilateral treaty must be concluded and then submitted to parliament, and the timing depends on negotiations and parliamentary process.
Only after the bilateral treaty negotiations are fully concluded can the treaty be signed. Afterwards the treaty will be submitted to parliament for approval.
Pas nadat de bilaterale verdragsonderhandelingen volledig zijn afgerond, kan het verdrag ondertekend worden. Daarna zal het verdrag ter goedkeuring aan het parlement worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the coronavirus-related closure of brothels, the risk that sex workers work without oversight when they lack income support, and client registration. The State Secretary supported the closures, pointed to existing income schemes (NOW, TVL, Tozo, general assistance) extended to 1 July 2021, and defended client registration as necessary for GGD contact tracing.
Sex workers who meet the conditions can claim these financial schemes or regular provisions, with general assistance as the safety net.
Sekswerkers die voldoen aan de voorwaarden kunnen aanspraak maken op deze financiële regelingen of op de reguliere voorzieningen, met als vangnet de algemene bijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen met naturalisatie

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why long-term regular residents who lack identity or nationality documents, including those who regularised under the 2007 Ranov/general pardon scheme, cannot obtain naturalisation, and whether the document requirement should be dropped. The State Secretary explained that exceptions exist for 'good reasons' on a case-by-case basis, that embassies usually cannot issue birth certificates, and that the policy will not be changed, arguing that Ranov holders are generally not stateless.
A change in policy is not being considered.
Een aanpassing van het beleid wordt niet overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘UNHCR urges investigation following deadly incident at Libya disembarkation point’

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a deadly incident at a Libyan disembarkation point and calls by UNHCR and IOM for an independent investigation, including the EU's support to the Libyan coast guard and the role of Operation Irini. The government supports an independent investigation, says the EU's training of the Libyan coast guard is not direct financial aid, and states it is not taking part in Irini's disembarkation mechanism and is still considering a future contribution.
The Netherlands supports the call by IOM and UNHCR for an independent investigation to establish the precise circumstances of the incident.
Nederland steunt de oproep van IOM en UNHCR tot het doen van onafhankelijk onderzoek om de precieze toedracht van het incident boven tafel te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de verblijfstitel voor personen tijdens de coronatijd in Nederland

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how COVID-19 travel restrictions affect the permitted stay of foreign nationals, including those with Dutch partners, and whether leniency and entry bans would be avoided. The State Secretary answered that overstay caused by COVID-19 travel restrictions counts as force majeure, that partner status is not weighed at the border, and that leniency is applied in such cases, with a reference to the long-distance relationship scheme.
An situation of force majeure arises when the foreign national can demonstrate that an earlier departure was not possible due to travel restrictions in connection with COVID-19.
Er ontstaat een overmachtssituatie wanneer de vreemdeling kan aantonen dat een eerder vertrek niet mogelijk was vanwege reisbeperkingen in het kader van COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht "Geen 4 maanden, maar één dag cel en taakstraf voor man (46) die betaalde seks met 16-jarig meisje had"

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a court sentence of one day in prison and a community service order for a man who paid for sex with a 16-year-old, and about whether sentencing circumvents the ban on community service for article 248b Sr, the trend in such sentences, prioritising human trafficking cases, and the measures promised under the Kuik motion on deterring buyers of sex with minors. The State Secretary answers that buyers should be punished, that the judge has discretion within the legal framework, that only 11 of 121 convictions since 2012 involved 1-2 days' custody plus community service, and that the promised package and a planned statutory strengthening of the payment element are being developed.
I consider it desirable that clients of sex with minors are punished.
Ik acht het wenselijk dat klanten van seks met minderjarigen worden bestraft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Ziengs over het bericht “Treinterreur door asielzoekers op de Vechtdallijn”

MPs Becker and Ziengs asked the state secretaries about reports of asylum seekers committing violence against rail staff on the Vechtdal line and whether they were from safe countries, which azc they came from, what steps were taken, and whether a travel ban would be imposed. The government condemned the behaviour, said it does not register residence status of offenders, described existing measures such as Top-X lists, travel bans and a pilot regional travel ban in Eastern Netherlands, and gave few individual details.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de achterstanden in de huisvesting van statushouders bij gemeenten en het provinciale toezicht daarop

An MP asked about growing backlogs by municipalities in housing status holders (vergunninghouders) and provincial oversight via the intervention ladder. The minister acknowledged the backlog is concerning, provided per-province tiers, and argued provincial oversight functions well while a broader oversight improvement agenda is underway.
Supervision of the housing of status holders by municipalities is assigned to the province.
Het toezicht op de huisvesting van vergunninghouders door gemeenten is belegd bij de provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat een lesbische asielzoekster dreigt teruggestuurd te worden naar Nigeria.

MP Kuiken asked whether a lesbian asylum seeker threatened with return to Nigeria is at risk, whether the IND applies a 'development of orientation' process test, and whether an independent investigation will be launched into IND assessments of LGBTI claims.
