The Staatssecretaris acknowledges the situation is serious and LGBTI persons are a risk group, denies the IND requires a 'bewustwordingsproces', and declines an independent investigation, pointing instead to an ongoing WODC evaluation.
The WODC is currently conducting an evaluation of the credibility assessment, based on the new work instructions, of LGBT and conversion cases by the IND.
Momenteel is het WODC bezig met een evaluatie van de geloofwaardigheidsbeoordeling, aan de hand van de nieuwe werkinstructies, van lhbt- en bekeringszaken door de IND.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Veldman over het bericht 'Twee asielzoekers in azc Ter Apel besmet met Corona'

MPs Becker and Veldman asked about reports of COVID-19 infections at the Ter Apel reception centre, including the applicable protocol, quarantine of contacts and arrivals from high-risk areas, and protection of staff and vulnerable asylum seekers. The State Secretary answered that no Ter Apel-specific protocol exists, describes the general COA/GGD/GZA protocol, and sets out quarantine, testing and staff protection measures, while several answers note capacity constraints.
There is no protocol specifically for the Ter Apel reception centre. Therefore I cannot provide it to you.
Er is geen protocol voor specifiek het aanmeldcentrum ter Apel. Derhalve kan ik u dat niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de betrokkenheid van Frontex bij pushbacks

An MP asked the State Secretary about reported Frontex involvement in illegal pushbacks of migrants and whether an independent investigation is needed. The government says the incidents must be investigated under existing Frontex procedures, that no Dutch staff were involved, and that an independent inquiry is not needed for now while awaiting the internal investigation.
On the basis of the foregoing, the cabinet does not consider a separate, independent investigation necessary at this time.
Op basis van het voorgaande acht het kabinet een apart, onafhankelijk onderzoek op dit moment niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de voortgang van de evacuatie van asielzoekers van het Griekse eiland Lesbos

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the evacuation of asylum seekers from Lesbos, including conditions at the Kara Tepe camp, sanitation, healthcare, lead contamination, and the relocation of unaccompanied minors to the Netherlands. The government answered that conditions are improving under Greek and EU management, that Pikpa is empty and Kara Tepe is to close by year end, and that the Netherlands offered to relocate 100 people but sees no reason to increase that offer.
I have already committed to informing your House about this in more detail.
Ik heb uw Kamer reeds toegezegd hier nader over te informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over een onderzoek van de Raad voor de rechtshandhaving naar de bejegening van in bewaring gestelde vreemdelingen in Curaçao en het AIV-rapport ‘Veiligheid en recht

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked about a Raad voor de rechtshandhaving inspection of detention conditions for migrants in Curaçao, the AIV advisory report on Caribbean security, the ombudsman's complaint that his recommendations are ignored, lack of legal aid and NGO access for Venezuelans, two minors reportedly detained, a Human Rights Institute recommendation, and a recent fire at the SDKK facility. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao decides whether to adopt inspection recommendations, though the Netherlands keeps pressing for improvements and Curaçao's project plan includes recommended measures, declined to intervene in the ombudsman matter, said legal aid is Curaçao's responsibility, denied that minors are currently held, and deferred the AIV-related questions to a later government response.
Under the Kingdom Act on the Council for Law Enforcement, it is up to the authorities of Curaçao to decide whether the recommendations in the inspection report are adopted.
Op basis van de Rijkswet Raad voor de Rechtshandhaving is het aan de autoriteiten van Curaçao om te bepalen of de aanbevelingen uit het betreffende inspectierapport worden overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over het landgebonden asielbeleid ten aanzien van Armenië en Azerbeidzjan

MPs Van Ojik, Voordewind and Jasper van Dijk asked whether escalating fighting in Nagorno-Karabach and neighbouring Armenian-Azerbaijani border areas warrants revising asylum return policy and the Armenia safe-country designation, and whether a return moratorium is needed. The State Secretary replied that the policy stands for now, citing the 10 November ceasefire and monitoring of the situation, with individual asylum assessments continuing and a possible new thematic country report if developments warrant it.
Depending on developments, a new (thematic) country report may be requested, which will address the security situation in Azerbaijan.
Afhankelijk van de ontwikkelingen kan een nieuw (thematisch) ambtsbericht worden opgevraagd, waarbij dan wordt ingegaan op de veiligheidssituatie in Azerbeidzjan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat gemeenten subsidie krijgen om overlastgevende asielzoekers bezig te houden

An MP from the PVV asks whether overlastgevende asylum seekers should be deported rather than supported with subsidised projects, and whether the government's approach wastes taxpayers' money. The Staatssecretaris replies that the government is pursuing a hard integrated approach with the migration chain, municipalities and police, but that deportation of asylum seekers in procedure for causing nuisance is not possible, and that existing measures will be extended or tightened.
Given that everyone is entitled to a fair asylum procedure, it is not possible to deport asylum seekers awaiting their asylum procedure from the Netherlands on the grounds of causing nuisance.

Gezien het feit dat iedereen recht heeft op een eerlijke asielprocedure, is het niet mogelijk asielzoekers in afwachting van hun asielprocedure Nederland uit te zetten op grond van het veroorzaken van overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'COA zoekt honderden extra plekken voor asielzoekers in Oost-Nederland'

MP Becker (VVD) asked the State Secretary about reports that COA is seeking hundreds of extra asylum reception places in Eastern Netherlands, asking about the causes, capacity forecasts, municipal cooperation and whether municipalities can attach conditions to locations. The State Secretary answered that capacity is near its maximum, that no three-year forecast can be given, that the response to municipalities runs through COA and regional tables, and that a small-scale pilot of about ten locations is being prepared.
I therefore cannot give a forecast for the coming three years, nor a breakdown by type of asylum seeker.
Ik kan dus geen prognose geven voor de komende drie jaar, net zomin als een uitsplitsing naar type asielzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Lange rijen bij registratie in Ter Apel'

MPs Groothuizen and Van Toorenburg asked why asylum seekers arriving in Ter Apel still lacked beds despite new pavilions and rising inflow, and what measures will prevent this. The State Secretary explained the new registration process, the four heated pavilions and a waiting room for after-hours arrivals, and said a chain coordinator was appointed to optimise capacity, though there is no firm guarantee of a bed every night.

It is expressly not intended that asylum seekers spend two nights in the waiting room, but in the event of an unexpected peak in registrations, where vulnerable asylum seekers get priority, this cannot always be prevented.

Het is uitdrukkelijk niet de bedoeling dat asielzoekers twee nachten doorbrengen in de «wachtkamer», maar bij een onverwachte piek in het aantal aanmeldingen waarbij kwetsbare asielzoekers voorrang krijgen, is het niet altijd te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Spanje scheidt migrantenkinderen van hun ouders'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether separating migrant children from their parents in Spain violates children's rights and whether the Netherlands would object at EU level. The State Secretary acknowledged that separation without good reason violates children's rights, noted Spain's DNA-verification protocol and new family accommodation, and saw no need for further EU action given Spain's measures and the Commission's proposals.
In the asylum procedure itself, children are not separated from their parents.
In de asielprocedure zelf worden kinderen niet gescheiden van de ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'IND ontdekt fraude met asielzoekers'

An MP asked the State Secretary whether asylum seekers who obtained residence permits by lying about their sexual orientation can have those permits revoked, and about the burden of proof and sanctions. The State Secretary answered that revocation is possible where feasible but that the IND bears the burden of proof, that an investigation into Ugandan cases found 36 possible grounds for revocation (one revocation so far), and that the government will further examine the issue.
To revoke, the IND must demonstrate that a ground for revocation exists.
Om tot een intrekking over te kunnen gaan dient de IND aan te tonen dat er sprake is van een intrekkingsgrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) in de jacht op internationale studenten de grenzen opzoekt

MPs Beertema and Emiel van Dijk asked whether the University of Amsterdam enrolls international students in preparatory years for other programmes to obtain residence permits, and whether the government will end this and related agent recruitment. The minister answers that the practice does not fit the national code of conduct, that IND will consult the UvA, and that the code commission's report on preparatory tracks will be discussed with the umbrella organisations.
Enrolling students in a programme other than the one they wish to follow, including the associated preparatory year, is not in line with the intention of the Code of Conduct.

Het inschrijven van studenten voor een andere opleiding, inclusief het bijbehorend voorbereidend jaar, dan de opleiding die de student wenst te volgen, is niet in overeenstemming met de intentie van de Gedragscode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de verblijfstitel voor personen tijdens de coronatijd in Nederland zonder visumplicht

An MP asked how the Dutch government legalises stays beyond the 90/180-day visa-free limit for non-visa-required foreigners stuck in the Netherlands during COVID-19, and why EU and IND websites appear to differ. The State Secretary answered that the IND no longer extends stays or grants permits, that overstays are tolerated only where departure is genuinely impossible, and that such persons may face an entry ban on exit.
Because of Covid-19, however, the policy choice has been made not to extend stays by issuing a residence annotation sticker, nor to grant a residence permit.
Wegens Covid-19 is echter de beleidskeuze gemaakt om het verblijf niet meer middels het afgeven van een sticker verblijfsaantekening te verlengen, noch een verblijfsvergunning te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Bisschop over de handreiking levensbeschouwing van het COA

MPs Voordewind and Bisschop asked the State Secretary whether COA's religious neutrality rules, which ban political and religious group gatherings even in residents' rooms, are lawful given constitutional and ECHR freedom of religion, and how residents can reach religious institutions. The State Secretary defended the rules as necessary to protect residents' privacy and safety, said residents may hold small private religious studies and COA helps find outside venues, and said the handreiking is under evaluation.
As a politically and religiously neutral organisation, COA has a duty to protect the personal privacy of all residents and to ensure liveability and safety at the reception locations.
Het COA heeft als politiek en religieus neutrale organisatie een taak om de persoonlijke levenssfeer van alle bewoners te bewaken en de leefbaarheid en veiligheid op de opvanglocaties te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Exclusive: Cyprus sold passports to criminals and fugitives’

MP Groothuizen asked the government about reports that Cyprus and Malta sold golden passports to criminals and fugitives, and whether the Dutch scheme should be abolished, whether EU action or an infringement procedure is possible, and whether due diligence could be transferred to Europol. The State Secretary answered that such schemes can facilitate crime, that Cyprus is abolishing its scheme, Malta has tightened its checks, the Dutch scheme will be reviewed after a year, and that the Commission is primarily responsible for any infringement procedure.
If after one year it appears that the scheme does not have this potential, it will be abolished.
Mocht na één jaar blijken dat de regeling deze potentie niet heeft, dan wordt zij afgeschaft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Vluchtelingen vast in oorlogsgebied door sluiting ambassades’

MPs Sjoerdsma and Groothuizen asked whether ambassador closures due to COVID-19 leave about 1,500 refugee family members stranded in war zones and what the government will do. The minister answered that no exact figures exist, that about 90% of relevant posts have resumed visa services, that the government has eased rules and reissue arrangements, but that it cannot control the safety of people in conflict areas and cannot say when the remaining closed posts will reopen.

There is no insight into the exact number of refugee families (family reunification followers) who cannot come to the Netherlands for family reunification due to restricted consular services of an embassy or consulate-general.

Er is geen inzicht in het exacte aantal vluchtelingengezinnen (nareizigers) dat niet naar Nederland kan komen voor gezinshereniging door beperktere consulaire dienstverlening van een ambassade of consulaat-generaal.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Ojik over de coronamaatregelen in de asielketen

MP Van Ojik asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about COVID-19 infections, testing, hygiene supplies and distancing in COA asylum reception centres and immigration detention. The State Secretary answered that infections are reported per location, that protocols and quarantine arrangements exist, that residents must largely provide their own masks and hygiene products, and that complaints at Rotterdam detention centre are pending before a court.
I cannot respond on matters that are still before the court.
Over zaken die nog onder de rechter zijn, kan ik geen reactie geven.
Antwoord opvragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Hoe de UvA in de jacht op de internationale student de grenzen opzoekt'

MPs Van der Molen and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked about reports that the UvA, via the private firm OnCampus, admits non-EEA students with havo-level qualifications through a preparatory year, and whether this breaches the WHW and the Gedragscode. The minister replied that the Landelijke Commissie report is being awaited, that the Inspectie does not supervise these preparatory programmes, that the practice conflicts with the spirit of the law and code, and that further steps and consultations with the sector and Inspectie will follow.
The preparatory education offered to international students does not constitute education as defined in the WHW.
Het voorbereidend onderwijs dat aan internationale studenten wordt aangeboden betreft geen onderwijs zoals gedefinieerd in de WHW.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Asscher, Van Otterloo, Van Ojik en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat het Verenigd Koninkrijk met nieuwe wetgeving afspraken uit het uittredingsakkoord niet na dreigt te komen

Five MPs asked the government about the UK's planned Internal Market Bill, which would breach parts of the Withdrawal Agreement, and its risks for citizens' rights and Dutch nationals in the UK. The State Secretary answered that the government shares concerns, monitors citizens' rights implementation with the Commission, sees no current signs of further UK legislation undermining citizens' rights, and will consider information measures for Dutch nationals in the UK.

The government therefore monitors, together with the European Commission and in several ways, whether these rights are being honoured, including via the Joint Committee and the Dutch embassy in the UK.
Het kabinet monitort daarom samen met de Europese Commissie op verschillende manieren of deze rechten worden nagekomen, onder meer via het Gemengd Comité en via de Nederlandse ambassade in het VK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een afgeschermde mailinglist voor pedoseksuelen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a closed mailing list for paedophiles could be used to plan offences, and whether freedom of expression can be overridden in such cases and whether justice authorities may examine its content. The minister said such expression is punishable if it constitutes a criminal offence, that this is under investigation by the prosecution service, and that no substantive statements can be made about ongoing investigations.
No substantive statements are made about ongoing investigations by the prosecution service.
Over lopende onderzoeken van het OM worden geen inhoudelijke mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een door COVID getroffen vluchtelingenkampen

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary about calls to evacuate COVID-19-hit refugee camps in Greece, including whether overcrowding and poor hygiene raise infection risk and whether the Netherlands would contribute to large-scale evacuation. The government acknowledged the risk, described Dutch support (a hospitainer, relocations to the mainland, a cooperation on unaccompanied minors) and largely answered by describing Greek and EU measures without committing to evacuation.
The cabinet has informed your House on several occasions about the conditions and the measures taken by the Greek government to prevent an outbreak of COVID-19 among migrants on the islands.

Het kabinet heeft uw Kamer op verschillende momenten geïnformeerd over de omstandigheden en de maatregelen die door de Griekse overheid zijn getroffen om de uitbraak van COVID-19 onder de migranten op de eilanden te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de optie om via UNHCR-hervestiging de noodsituatie op de Griekse eilanden te verlichten

An MP asked the State Secretary about conditions in the Greek island camps (Moria) and whether UNHCR resettlement, including of unaccompanied minors, should be expanded to relieve them. The government acknowledges the poor conditions and local hostility, notes Greek efforts and transfers, and declines to reassign unaccompanied minors but agrees to take 50 minors and 50 family migrants via the existing quota.
In response, the cabinet has decided, as a rare exception, to offer Greece to take in 50 unaccompanied minors and 50 migrants in family units with minor children.
In reactie daarop, heeft het kabinet besloten, om bij hoge uitzondering, Griekenland aan te bieden 50 amv en 50 migranten in gezinsverband met minderjarige kinderen op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het sluiten van de COVID-19 kliniek op Lesbos

An MP asked the Dutch government whether a COVID-19 clinic run by MSF on Lesbos was closed by Greek authorities while Dutch officials were arranging a replacement hospital container, and what Dutch funds were spent. The government answered that the container was donated at Greek request in April, the choice of location was Greek responsibility, there is no causal link to the MSF closure, and the container was damaged in the Moria fires and is currently out of use.

The cabinet therefore has no indications to suppose that there is a causal link between the acceptance of the donation of the hospital container in April by the national authorities and the closure of the MSF clinic in July by the local authorities.

Het kabinet heeft dan ook geen aanwijzingen om te veronderstellen dat er een causaal verband bestaat tussen het aanvaarden van de schenking van de hospitainer in april jl. door de nationale autoriteiten en de sluiting van de kliniek van MSF in juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Eerste coronabesmetting vastgesteld in Grieks vluchtelingenkamp Moria'

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the COVID-19 outbreak in the Moria refugee camp on Lesbos, including medical care, the need for evacuation, and taking in minors. The government answered that it supports Greece with medical aid and transfers of vulnerable migrants, and that it will take in 50 unaccompanied minors and 50 family migrants with children, while avoiding a commitment to broader action.
Given the exceptional situation on Lesbos, the cabinet has decided to offer the Greek government to take in 50 unaccompanied minors and 50 migrants in family units with minor children.
Gelet op de uitzonderlijke situatie op Lesbos heeft het kabinet besloten de Griekse overheid aan te bieden om 50 amv en 50 migranten in gezinsverband met minderjarige kinderen over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Eerste coronabesmetting vastgesteld in Grieks vluchtelingenkamp Moria’

The MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of Health about the first COVID-19 infection found in the Moria refugee camp on Lesbos, including contact with Greek counterparts, medical needs, testing, evacuations and EU funding. The government answered that it has regular contact with Greece, that camp residents are now tested, that Netherlands contributed a hospitainer and EUR 1 million to UNICEF, and that the number of migrants on the Greek islands fell from about 42,000 to 26,000.
The cabinet has informed the House on several occasions about the circumstances and the measures taken by the Greek government to prevent an outbreak of COVID-19 among migrants on the islands.

Het kabinet heeft uw Kamer op verschillende momenten geïnformeerd over de omstandigheden en de maatregelen die door de Griekse overheid zijn getroffen om de uitbraak van COVID-19 onder de migranten op de eilanden te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de financiering van Grieks wanbeleid op Lesbos

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister and the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the Netherlands financed mismanagement on Lesbos, including a hospital container donated for a COVID-19 clinic that coincided with the closure of an MSF clinic, and the links with MotG and a Greek youth-care project. The minister denied any causal link between the donation and the MSF closure, said the location was a Greek decision, and described the Dutch-funded reception places for unaccompanied minors and the offer to take 50 minors and 50 families.

We have taken note of the article 'Hallucinant, Netherlands finances Greek mismanagement on Lesbos', but we do not endorse the claimed connection between the donation of the hospital container and the closure of the Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) clinic.

Wij hebben kennisgenomen van het artikel «Hallucinant, Nederland financiert Grieks wanbeleid op Lesbos», maar onderschrijven de gestelde samenhang tussen het schenken van de hospitainer en het sluiten van de kliniek van Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Branden in Grieks opvangkamp Moria, migranten gevlucht'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security, on behalf of the foreign ministers, how the government would respond to the fire that destroyed much of the Moria migrant camp on Lesbos, including evacuation, child reception, a new medical clinic and contact with Greece. The government answered that it offered support to Greece, pledged EUR 1 million to UNICEF's response, agreed to take in 50 unaccompanied minors and 50 family migrants, and is pressing for an integrated EU response.

In addition to this humanitarian contribution, the cabinet has decided, in response to this exceptional and tragic situation, to offer the Greek government to take in 50 unaccompanied minor foreigners and 50 migrants in family units with minor children.

Naast deze humanitaire bijdrage heeft het kabinet in reactie op deze uitzonderlijke en tragische situatie besloten de Griekse overheid aan te bieden om 50 alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen (amv) en 50 migranten in gezinsverband met minderjarige kinderen over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het feit dat minder dan 50 kinderen op Lesbos voldoen aan de eisen om opgehaald te worden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security why fewer than 50 unaccompanied minors on Lesbos meet the criteria for transfer, and whether the criteria would be loosened and how many children would be taken in. The government answered that details of the group were not known when the offer was made, that several EU states are coordinating relocation, that the number of 100 is not meagre, and that it will inform parliament once the Dutch offer is worked out.
I will inform your House as soon as possible about the elaboration of the Dutch relocation offer.
Ik zal uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk informeren over de uitwerking van het Nederlandse herplaatsingsaanbod.
Antwoord op vagen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Groothuizen over het bericht 'Lange rijen bij registratie in Ter Apel'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Groothuizen asked why asylum registration at Ter Apel stalled, with long queues and people sleeping on chairs or the floor, and why no bed was provided. The Secretary of State attributed the delays to a higher-than-expected August intake combined with COVID-19 procedures, said a temporary pavilion with beds was not yet ready, and promised flexible capacity planning and a 24-hour registration target.
Unfortunately this facility was not yet ready when the intake in early August was higher than expected for several days.
Helaas was deze inrichting nog niet gereed toen de instroom begin augustus een aantal dagen hoger was dan verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de chaos bij de IND-taskforce die de achterstallige asielzaken moet afdoen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports of chaos at the IND task force clearing backlogged asylum cases, including incomplete files, unanswered calls, lawyers unable to assist clients, and cases pushed into the extended procedure. The State Secretary referred to a 7 September letter, acknowledged start-up problems now being addressed, reported over 4,000 cases cleared by 1 September, and committed to clearing all task-force cases by year end.
The start-up problems have been and are now being addressed.
De opstartproblemen zijn en worden inmiddels aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'Antihomogeweld in AZC: Vrouw overgoten met kokend water'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a report that a Nigerian asylum seeker was scalded with boiling water in a reception centre, including questions on denied medical care, the perpetrator's continued residence, and protection of LGBTI residents against anti-gay violence. The State Secretary said the police are investigating, that care was given, that suspects were moved and interviewed, and that existing COA measures are adequate, without committing to new measures.
However, I cannot go into detail about the specific circumstances of the individual case.
Ik kan echter niet gedetailleerd ingaan op de specifieke omstandigheden van de individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'Vrouw overgoten met kokend water in azc: 'Alle LHBTI-vluchtelingen zijn onveilig in hun azc'

An MP asked about an incident in an asylum centre where a woman was scalded with boiling water, the protection of LHBTI asylum seekers, and whether a 2016 motion calling for separate safe accommodation for vulnerable groups had been implemented. The State Secretary said the incident is under police investigation, declined to give details of individual care, and rejected categorical separate accommodation for vulnerable groups, arguing it stigmatises them.
I cannot go into the specific circumstances of the individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de specifieke omstandigheden van de individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over een incident in een AZC waarbij een lesbische vrouw met kokend water werd overgoten

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about an incident in an asylum centre where a lesbian woman was scalded with boiling water, whether she received proper medical care and aftercare, whether LHBTI asylum seekers face higher risk and why no data exists, what protections exist, and whether a separate centre should be created. The State Secretary said the case was handled correctly and the victim got immediate care, that no LHBTI-specific incident figures are recorded, describes existing protection measures, and rejected separate LHBTI accommodation.
I cannot go into detail on the specific circumstances of the individual case.
Ik kan niet gedetailleerd ingaan op de specifieke omstandigheden van de individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'COA plaatst Nigeriaans slachtoffer homohaat over naar ander azc'

MP Becker asked the State Secretary and Integration Minister, after reports that a Nigerian victim of anti-gay violence at an asylum centre was moved rather than the perpetrators, how incidents are prevented, recorded and punished, and whether asylum seekers can be required to sign equality principles or be placed in a handhavings location. The government answered that perpetrators are addressed through COA measures and police referral, victims may be moved at their own choice, no incident statistics are kept and mandatory pre-integration was rejected, while promising a policy response to a COA audit.
As you know, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Zoals u bekend, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Chaos bij taskforce asielaanvragen’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports of chaos at the asylum taskforce, staffing levels, communication problems, cases pushed into the extended asylum procedure, and dossier quality. The State Secretary answered that staffing is growing via IND and external hires, communication was improved, capacity-driven transfers occur but the taskforce aims to clear them quickly, and quality safeguards apply, without committing to new structural changes.
As I indicated in my letter to the House of 7 September, new measures may deviate from the current way of working, so tension may arise with quality requirements and service delivery.

Zoals ik in mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 7 september jl. heb aangegeven, kunnen nieuwe maatregelen afwijken van de huidige werkwijze waardoor spanning kan ontstaan met de kwaliteitsvereisten en de dienstverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Groothuizen over het bericht 'Achterstand bij de IND wegwerken was het idee; het werd netflixen'

MPs Van Toorenburg (CDA) and Groothuizen (D66) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that new IND decision-makers were advised to watch Netflix documentaries on asylum seekers' countries of origin, and about chaos, quality, and prioritisation problems in the IND backlog taskforce. The State Secretary answered that training uses optional viewing tips alongside written material, that start-up problems were organisational and are being addressed, that quality is safeguarded, and that about 4,000 cases were closed by 1 September with roughly 11,000 remaining.
These programmes are offered optionally outside the mandatory regular training component; staff can therefore choose to watch them when their workload allows.

Deze programma's worden facultatief aangeboden buiten het verplichte reguliere opleidingsdeel; men kan er dus voor kiezen de programma's te bekijken op het moment dat de werkomvang daar ruimte toe biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Chaos bij taskforce asielaanvragen’

An MP asks whether asylum lawyers are excluded from scheduling their clients' hearings, whether this undermines free choice of counsel, and whether a proposed two-week scheduling procedure should be adopted. The State Secretary says cooperation with the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand and COA is in place, lawyers can arrange substitutes, and regular consultation with the bar continues, but the proposed scheduling procedure cannot be adopted given the Taskforce's tight planning.
In principle this is not desirable, since the right to free choice of lawyer is a great good.
In beginsel is dit niet wenselijk, het recht op vrije advocaatkeuze is immers een groot goed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de berichtgeving dat COA geen informatie meer deelt

An MP asked whether COA stopped sharing asylum-seeker information with police, why, and how crime among asylum seekers will be tackled given the murder of Rik van de Rakt. The government confirmed the suspension pending an external review of the legal basis under art. 107 Vreemdelingenwet, while stating that other data flows continue and promising to inform parliament of the outcome.
Pending the outcome of the external review, COA's board decided on 16 July to immediately suspend sharing personal data with the police.
In afwachting van de uitkomsten van de externe toetsing heeft het bestuur van het COA op 16 juli jl. besloten het delen van persoonsgegevens met de politie per direct op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Emiel van Dijk en Kops over het aan hun lot overlaten van kwetsbare Nederlanders ten gunste van statushouders in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked whether it is unacceptable that Amsterdam gives housing priority to refugee status holders over Dutch residents with medical problems, and whether subsidies to Amsterdam should be cut. The minister replied that there is no discrimination by nationality, that municipalities set their own urgency categories and must meet the statutory quota, and that she will not withhold support but is funding pilots and housing projects.
No distinction is made in the Netherlands on the basis of nationality.
In Nederland wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de familie S

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the S. family, Palestinian refugees who fled Gaza to Turkey, including their sick child and whether they could be resettled to the Netherlands. The government answered that resettlement only happens on UNHCR referral, that it cannot comment further on a court ruling under appeal, and it pointed to EU and bilateral support programmes in Turkey.
Pending this appeal, I cannot go further into this matter.
Hangende dit beroep kan ik niet verder op deze kwestie ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over illegale veelplegers

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about illegal repeat offenders, including a Moroccan man with nearly 600 police contacts who has stayed in the Netherlands for fifty years without a residence permit, and whether failing return policy and reluctant countries of origin explain this. The State Secretary rejects that return policy has failed, acknowledges the need for improvement, explains the procedural and detention obstacles, describes EU-coordinated diplomatic and visa instruments, and says dialogue with Morocco is ongoing but was hampered by COVID-19.
As you know, I do not go into individual cases in public answers.
Zoals u weet ga ik in openbare beantwoording niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Koopmans en Middendorp over het bericht dat honderden Chinezen hun valse identiteit ‘herstelden’ bij gemeenten

MPs from the VVD asked the government about reports that hundreds of Chinese nationals 'restored' false identities through municipalities, covering detection, document verification, nationality consequences, limitation periods and sanctions. The State Secretary answered at length, describing existing procedures and safeguards, rejecting several proposed legal changes, and committing only to approach Chinese authorities if useful.
It is not possible to answer this question using data from the BRP.
Het is niet mogelijk om met behulp van gegevens uit de BRP deze vraag te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'Irakees die zijn Friese vrouw voor ogen van hun kinderen doodde alweer vrij'

PVV MPs asked why an Iraqi man who killed his Frisian wife in front of their children was released so quickly by Iraqi authorities, and called for entry bans and an end to asylum for nationals of countries such as Iraq. The State Secretary said Iraq's prosecution is an internal matter he cannot judge, that Nederland uses Article 1F to exclude criminals from asylum, and that asylum claims must be assessed individually rather than halted by country.
At the same time, in my view it is not for a minister to pass judgment on the prosecution of a criminal offence.
Tegelijkertijd is het naar mijn mening niet aan een bewindspersoon om een oordeel uit te spreken over de berechting van een strafbaar feit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over mogelijke fouten bij het dodelijk drama met Rik van de Rakt als slachtoffer

SP MPs asked whether information-sharing failures between COA, the municipality and care providers contributed to a fatal incident involving an asylum status holder, and whether the system should be investigated. The State Secretary said the criminal investigation is ongoing, that COA shared what legally could be shared, that medical data sharing is governed by consent rules, and that she is willing to review information sharing with partners and noted recent inspection reviews.
The criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het onderzoek naar een statushouder in Bernheze

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about an independent review of a refugee (statushouder) in Bernheze, including gaps in the national matching system, the municipality's limited information on the person's medical problems, and whether municipalities can request transfer. The State Secretary called the incident regrettable, said information sharing was limited by medical confidentiality, pointed to ongoing consultation with COA, the VNG and municipalities, and noted that inter-municipal transfer is already possible.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Becker over het bericht ‘Moord op Rik van de Rakt: foutengala rond Soedanese verdachte; ’Cruciale informatie vanwege privacy niet gedeeld’’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Becker asked the State Secretary about a report on the murder of Rik van de Rakt by a Sudanese status holder, and whether mental health information was withheld from the receiving municipality because of privacy rules. The State Secretary said privacy law governs sharing medical information, that COA shares what it lawfully may, that the report is the municipality's responsibility, and that partners will review the allocation and information-sharing process.
Strict privacy laws and regulations apply to sharing medical information, and for status holders these are no different than for other citizens in the Netherlands.
Voor het delen van medische informatie geldt strikte wet- en regelgeving op het gebied van privacy, die voor statushouders niet anders is dan voor andere burgers in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Bommelding bij Amsterdamse kerk om doop ex-moslims’

MPs Van der Graaf and Voordewind asked the Justice Minister about threats against people who convert or leave Islam, including a bomb threat at an Amsterdam church, and about police registration and COA handling of such threats. The minister agreed the problem is serious and not limited to Amsterdam, said he would await Amsterdam's study before commissioning his own, described police anti-discrimination screening and COA preventive and reporting procedures.
I will have myself informed about the outcomes of the Amsterdam municipality's study before considering conducting my own investigation.
Ik zal mij laten informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de gemeente Amsterdam alvorens zelf een onderzoek te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over de door het ministerie van J&V en het COA ondersteunde promotievideo over Nederland als bestemmingsland voor asielzoekers

PVV MPs Van Dijk and Wilders asked whether the government supported a video promoting the Netherlands to asylum seekers, its costs, and whether it would be removed and asylum entry stopped. The State Secretary answered that the video was made and funded by an external party, that the ministries and agencies were only consulted, and that the government bears no responsibility for it and will not close the borders.
The Ministry of Justice and Security, COA and IND are not the sender of the video and did not finance it.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, COA en IND zijn niet de afzender van het filmpje en hebben dit ook niet gefinancierd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het lekken van data van slachtoffers van mensenhandel

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the leak of personal data of human trafficking victims and smuggling signals held by the COA, and how affected people are protected and whether their asylum status is affected. The State Secretary confirmed the leak, described the data involved and the COA's notification efforts, and said that trafficking victims' residence status and ongoing asylum cases will be assessed individually, with consultation between COA, IND and the prosecution ongoing.
For ongoing asylum applications, consultation is currently taking place between the COA and the IND to assess what consequences this may have.
Voor lopende asielaanvragen geldt dat momenteel overleg plaatsvindt tussen het COA en de IND om te inventariseren welke gevolgen dit mogelijk heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Remco Dijksta over het bericht dat mensensmokkel via visserij een ‘blinde vlek’

MPs Becker and Dijkstra asked the government about an Inspectorate report finding that maritime smuggling via fishing and leisure boats is a blind spot, including gaps in risk information, staffing, systems and cooperation. The State Secretary answered that current risk assessments show limited risks, that controls continue, and that improvements such as joint risk analyses, system modernisation and training are being explored or pursued.
Following the findings of the inspection report, the KMar and ZHP are currently exploring options to strengthen their intensive cooperation.
Naar aanleiding van de bevindingen van het inspectierapport verkennen de KMar en ZHP momenteel de mogelijkheden om de intensieve samenwerking te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, Markuszower en Wilders over een massale vechtpartij in AZC Budel

PVV MPs asked why only one asylum seeker was arrested after a mass brawl at AZC Budel involving about 100 residents, whether all rioters would be jailed and deported, and whether the centre and all AZCs should be closed and an asylum stop imposed. The State Secretary said about 15 people were directly or indirectly involved, declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, and rejected closing the centres or borders, noting COA can impose sanctions under the ROV.
While the criminal investigation is ongoing, I cannot provide further information on the outcome of this investigation.
Gedurende het lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen over de uitkomst van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over het bericht dat de overheid wil dat Nederlanders een asielzoeker in huis nemen

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why the government wants Dutch citizens to host asylum seekers, asking why it does not close the borders instead, whether the minister has hosted anyone, whether well-known Dutch people were asked to host, and whether hosting will ever become mandatory. The State Secretary answered that the voluntary logeerregeling applies only to status holders (vergunninghouders), not asylum seekers, that closing borders is not a realistic solution, and that participation remains voluntary for both host and guest.
This starting point of the scheme is not up for discussion.
Dit uitgangspunt van de regeling staat niet ter discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht dat Helmonder Farad K. tonnen verdiende met 90 verzonnen verhalen voor asielzoekers en waar tegen vier jaar cel is geëist

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a case in which a lawyer earned large sums from about 90 fabricated conversion stories for asylum seekers, and about how the IND verifies conversions and detects such fraud. The State Secretary answered that the IND assesses conversion claims on three pillars, does not actively check statusholders after status is granted, relies on signals to detect organised fraud, does not register religious belief, and intends to reassess the affected cases and revoke statuses where no ground for protection remains.
The IND intends to reassess these cases and is currently examining which follow-up steps will be taken for this reassessment.
De IND is voornemens om deze zaken te herbeoordelen en momenteel wordt door de IND nagegaan welke vervolgstappen genomen zullen worden ten behoeve van deze herbeoordeling.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over de Grieks-Nederlandse samenwerking ter verbetering van de situatie van alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoekers in Griekenland

MPs Groothuizen, Voordewind and Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary for progress on the Greek-Dutch initiative to set up reception places and a guardianship system for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers in Greece, including timelines, partners, funding, obstacles and the role of NIDOS. The State Secretary answered that a MoU was signed on 18 June, a steering group met on 14 July, 48 reception places are being prepared with no fixed timetable, no funding has yet been transferred, and Greek authorities remain responsible.
On further progress I will continue to inform your House on a periodic basis.
Over de verdere voortgang zal ik uw Kamer op periodieke basis blijven informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over afspraken met Griekenland over de opvang van minderjarige asielzoekers

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the timing, locations, guardianship arrangements, and sustainability of the Netherlands' agreement with Greece to house unaccompanied minor asylum seekers. The State Secretary answered that the MoU confirms existing agreements, that about 48 shelter places are being prepared near Athens with Dutch and Greek partners, and that guardianship and integration support will be developed, without committing to relocating children to the Netherlands.
I will continue to keep your House informed periodically about the further progress.
Over de verdere voortgang zal ik uw Kamer op periodieke basis blijven informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over 11.000 mensen voor wie naturalisatie onmogelijk is

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security why about 11,000 former pardon-scheme (Ranov) residents cannot naturalise despite long legal stay, and questions strict identity and nationality document requirements, including for minors who turn adult. The State Secretary says eligibility conditions apply, documents are required in principle, no groups are excluded by the document rule, and declines to provide statistics on documentary hardship cases, citing capacity.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Groothuizen en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Geef kennismigranten en internationaal talent meer zekerheid tijdens de coronacrisis’

Three D66 MPs asked whether knowledge migrants and international students in the Netherlands should get more legal certainty during the COVID-19 crisis, including relaxed study-progress rules, extended job-search periods, and deadlines. The government answered that it will not impose consequences on temporary salary-criterion breaches under the Wtv scheme, offers flexibility on study progress and language tests, and is only exploring a broader interpretation of job-search rules, with no firm extension of the search period.

When insufficient study progress is caused by the coronavirus crisis, institutions can treat this as an excusable reason for the study delay, and this has no consequences for the student's residence permit.

Wanneer onvoldoende studievoortgang is veroorzaakt door de coronacrisis, kunnen instellingen dit aanmerken als een verschoonbare reden voor de studievertraging en heeft dit geen gevolgen voor de verblijfsvergunning van de student.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Stroom bootmigranten uit Libië zwelt weer aan’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports of a renewed rise in boat migrants from Libya, including conditions in Libyan detention centres during the COVID-19 crisis, whether rescued migrants are being returned to Libya, and EU coordination on disembarkation. The government answered that it monitors the situation, that the Libyan coast guard has intercepted about 4,400 people this year and about 2,000 are in official detention centres, that it has no indication of more returns to Libya, and that no specific EU consultation on disembarkation took place, while stating it will not participate in the voluntary redistribution mechanism of Operation Irini.
The Netherlands has not shown willingness to take part in the redistribution mechanism because the mechanism deviates from the cabinet's position on this theme.
Nederland heeft zich niet bereid getoond om deel te nemen aan het herverdelingsmechanisme aangezien het mechanisme afwijkt van het kabinetsstandpunt op dit thema.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'IOM deplores killing 30 trafficked migrants Libya'

An MP from D66 asked the ministers about the killing of 30 trafficked migrants in Libya, whether the incident would be investigated, and how Dutch policy addresses conditions for residents and migrants in Libya. The government condemned the incident, called on Libyan authorities for a thorough investigation in the Human Rights Council, and listed humanitarian funding and efforts to close detention centres.

In addition, the Netherlands expressed horror at the incident in a national statement to the Human Rights Council on 18 June and called on the Libyan authorities to conduct a thorough investigation with the aim of holding the perpetrators accountable.

Daarnaast heeft Nederland in een nationale verklaring in de Mensenrechtenraad op 18 juni jl. afschuw uitgesproken over het incident en de Libische autoriteiten opgeroepen tot een grondig onderzoek met als doel de daders ter verantwoording te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘IND wees ultiem verzoek asielzoeker Bahrein af'

MPs Voordewind and Groothuizen asked how the IND handled new evidence and documents from a Bahraini asylum seeker facing risks on return, and why the Inspectorate report on the case was kept confidential. The State Secretary largely declined to discuss the individual case, explained general asylum assessment and document-handling procedures, and said publication of the report was withheld to protect the person's privacy and interests.
The government has, especially in individual cases in the field of immigration law, a duty to ensure that a person's interests and privacy are not violated.
De overheid heeft, zeker in individuele zaken op het terrein van vreemdelingenrecht, een plicht om er zorg voor te dragen dat de belangen en de privacy van een persoon niet worden geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat zwangere Afrikaanse vrouwen uit asielopvang verdwenen zijn

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that pregnant African women disappeared from asylum reception centres, including whether 25 had gone missing and whether trafficking was suspected. The State Secretary confirmed that 961 people of Nigerian origin left with unknown destination in 2019, promised a phenomenon study on trafficking signals, and said that departures are the residents' own choice while sharing that protection measures exist.
In November 2019 COA issued signals about pregnant women of African origin who leave with unknown destination.
Het COA heeft in november 2019 signalen afgegeven over zwangere vrouwen van Afrikaanse komaf die met onbekende bestemming vertrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Zwangere Afrikaanse asielzoeksters verdwijnen uit opvang'

MPs Van der Graaf and Van Ojik asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports that pregnant African asylum seekers disappeared from reception centres, including whether this resembles the Koolvis trafficking case, and what protection and follow-up is planned. The State Secretary said trafficking is not yet established, that COA and EMM have acted on signals, that a phenomenon study will be undertaken and reported after the summer recess, and that the answers to some questions were delayed.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to answer the questions within the requested time limit.
Het is helaas niet gelukt om de vragen binnen de gevraagde termijn te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over corona onder bewoners azc Sneek

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the relocation of infected and quarantined residents of the Sneek asylum centre to Zoutkamp, notified residents, protective measures and whether residents could refuse mixing with infected people. The government answered that the relocation was decided jointly by GGD, Veiligheidsregio and COA to stop the spread, that residents were informed by COA staff, and that protective measures and information were provided, while largely referring back to its answer on question 7 for the mixing question.

Following the test results, in consultation between GGD Fryslân, Veiligheidsregio Fryslân and COA it was decided to relocate infected persons, their family members and those belonging to their housing unit.

Naar aanleiding van de testuitslagen is in afstemming tussen GGD Fryslân, Veiligheidsregio Fryslân en het COA besloten om besmette personen, hun gezinsleden en degenen die tot hun wooneenheid behoren over te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Rog en Van Toorenburg over het rapport van het Centrum tegen Kinderhandel en Mensenhandel

MPs Kuik, Rog and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a report on criminal exploitation of Dutch pupils, including the number of awareness programmes run, schools' reluctance to be open about incidents, victim and perpetrator data, and monitoring of progress. The State Secretary answered that schools are being supported, that programme rollout is ongoing, that data-gathering with statistics bodies and the Rapporteur is being explored, and that the Chamber will be informed through progress letters.
Your House will be further informed in the progress letter of the programme Samen tegen mensenhandel about the outcomes of these discussions.
Uw Kamer wordt in de voortgangsbrief van het programma Samen tegen mensenhandel nader geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over de verplichte Marokkaanse nationaliteit

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether they would support Dutch-Moroccans seeking to renounce their compulsory Moroccan nationality, whether consular support and Moroccan consular influence in the Netherlands would be addressed, and whether they would negotiate with Morocco and EU partners. The government sympathised with the wish for choice in nationality, said it would raise the issue with Morocco, which pointed to its existing law, and said it would address undesirable foreign influence under its existing approach, without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet has understanding for this wish for freedom of choice.
Het kabinet heeft begrip voor deze wens tot keuzevrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Koopmans en Wiersma over het artikel ‘Marokkaanse Nederlanders bevrijd ons van de dubbele nationaliteit’

MPs from the VVD asked the government how it responds to Moroccan-Dutch citizens who want to renounce dual nationality, whether Morocco's diaspora institutions interfere in the Netherlands, and what practical help and EU position apply. The ministers answer that renunciation rights should be respected abroad, that foreign interference is handled under the 2018 unwanted-interference approach, and that the Moroccan and Turkish nationality rules are the responsibility of those states.
There can be no question of undesired influence on the individual lives of Dutch nationals and the choices they make.
Er kan geen sprake zijn van ongewenste beïnvloeding op de individuele levens van Nederlanders en de keuzes die zij maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Groothuizen over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer ‘Asiel, herplaatsing en terugkeer van migranten’

Two Dutch MPs (Voordewind and Groothuizen) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the European Court of Auditors report on asylum, relocation and return of migrants in Greece and Italy, including use of EU funds, relocation shortfalls, return rates, backlogs and conditions for unaccompanied minors. The State Secretary answered at length, largely agreeing with the report's findings and recommendations, explaining relocation and funding figures, and pointing primarily to Greek and Italian authorities for implementation while promising continued support and some concrete steps.
The cabinet therefore takes due note of the relevant analyses in the report and in principle agrees with the recommendations.
Het kabinet neemt dan ook goede nota van de betreffende analyses in het rapport, en sluit zich in beginsel aan bij de aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Voordewind, Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Ojik over het bericht dat Griekenland asielzoekers stiekem terugstuurt naar Turkije

MPs from five parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how the Netherlands views reports that Greece secretly returns asylum seekers to Turkey, whether this breaches the ECHR, and whether the government will press for independent investigation in EU and Council of Europe settings. The government says it has no independent information to confirm or refute the reports, that Greece denies them and temporarily suspended asylum applications from March to April 2020, and that it expects Greece and the EU to comply with the ECHR, leaving investigation to the Commission and to complaints by those affected.
The Netherlands does not have independent information to confirm or refute the precise circumstances of the findings described in the article.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie om de precieze toedracht van de in het artikel geschetste bevindingen te bevestigen of te ontkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een gevaarlijke situatie in asielzoekerscentra door tekort aan hulpmiddelen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether asylum reception centres lack protective equipment and quarantine places, and what is being done about it, plus questions on an internal COA survey and infection and sick-leave figures. The State Secretary answered that COA staff follow RIVM guidance, a mask order was delivered in late April, some centres have limited quarantine space, the survey findings are summarised, and figures on infections are given.
I am closely monitoring the situation at the COA locations and have every confidence that the measures taken are currently adequate.
Ik volg de situatie op de COA-locaties nauwgezet en heb er alle vertrouwen in dat de getroffen maatregelen op dit moment adequaat zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Van den Hul, Westerveld, Van Ojik, Groothuizen en Van Meenen over onderwijs in asielzoekerscentra

Six MPs asked about schooling in asylum reception centres (azc's) during COVID-19, including poor wifi and lack of laptops for online lessons. The State Secretary answered that wifi capacity was expanded at all COA locations, EUR 6.3 million was allocated for devices, and schools must offer distance learning.
It is undesirable that online education is not possible due to limitations in network connections or the availability of tablets, laptops or computers.
Het is onwenselijk dat online onderwijs niet mogelijk is door beperkingen in netwerkverbindingen of de beschikbaarheid van tablets, laptops of computers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over COA-personeel dat zich onveilig voelt door ‘Minderjarige’ criminele Noord-Afrikanen

An MP asks the State Secretary about COA staff feeling unsafe due to criminal asylum seekers, return of such people, the Top-X approach, a handhaving location, sharing Top-X data with mayors, and a complaints point for staff. The State Secretary answers that overlast is unacceptable, describes existing measures (HTL Hoogeveen, Top-X, ketenmariniers), says data sharing requires legal basis under the AVG and is being examined, and sees no need for a staff complaints point.

I am examining whether, under existing legal frameworks (such as police and public order legislation), it is possible to share certain information from the migration chain about persons on the Top X list with the local authorities' triangle for public order and safety.

Ik onderzoek of het onder bestaande wettelijke kaders (zoals de politie – en openbare orde wetgeving) eventueel mogelijk is om in het kader van de openbare orde en veiligheid bepaalde informatie van de migratieketen over personen op de Top X lijst te delen met de lokale gezagsdriehoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Van Weyenberg over “de steunmaatregelen voor sekswerkers”

D66 MPs Bouali and Van Weyenberg asked whether sex workers, including opting-in workers without employee premiums, can access COVID-19 support schemes (Tozo, WW, NOW), how many are affected, and why sex work may only resume on 1 September. Minister Koolmees answered that lawfully resident persons may claim Tozo, WW or general assistance if they meet criteria, that opting-in workers cannot claim WW or NOW, that sex work reopening on 1 September follows the cabinet route map and expert advice, and that he sees no way to reopen earlier.
It is not known how many sex workers there are in the Netherlands.
Niet bekend is hoeveel sekswerkers er in Nederland zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Asielzoekers zitten vast op een militaire kazerne, advocaten mogen er niet bij’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether asylum lawyers and Vluchtelingenwerk Nederland lacked access to the emergency reception at the Zoutkamp military barracks, and why asylum applications could not be lodged there. The State Secretary acknowledged that access was very limited during the emergency period, justified this as a proportionate Covid-19 measure, noted the site has since closed, and said applications are now processed again at COA locations.
During the period asylum seekers stayed at the emergency site, legal aid providers had very limited access to the emergency accommodation.
In de periode dat asielzoekers verbleven in de noodonderdaklocatie rechtsbijstandverleners zeer beperkt toegang hadden tot de noodonderdaklocatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het uitblijven van een wet inzake de vaststelling van staatloosheid

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why the promised bill on establishing statelessness has not been submitted, and about a stateless doctor who cannot work, the discretionary power for such cases, and volunteering by undocumented people. The State Secretary said the bill is delayed and will be communicated soon, declined to discuss individual cases, stated the discretionary power was abolished in May 2019 and now applies only in exceptional hardship cases, and confirmed undocumented persons may not volunteer.
I informed your House on 19 July 2019 that work has been underway for some time on a bill concerning statelessness.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 19 juli 2019 geïnformeerd dat al enige tijd wordt gewerkt aan de totstandkoming van een wetsvoorstel over staatloosheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over "arbeidsmigranten met corona"

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked the ministers about COVID-19 risks for migrant workers, including dismissals, working while sick, Labour Inspectorate complaints and returns home. The minister replied that employers must keep workers safe, reported 1,210 corona complaints (169 about migrant workers) with 109 investigated, and described an interdepartmental taskforce and EU guidance on free movement.
The Labour Inspectorate supervises compliance with the Working Conditions Act.
De Inspectie SZW houdt toezicht op de Arbowet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Emiel van Dijk over een verdubbeling van criminaliteit door asielzoekers

An MP from PVV asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why media got information on asylum-centre incidents before parliament, whether all incidents by asylum seekers, rejected or withdrawn permits and removals can be sent, and whether a full asylum stop will be imposed. The State Secretary said the press report used an unofficial version, sent the official 2019 incident overview, and rejected a categorical border closure as unrealistic while stating the government manages public-order risks.
As I indicated in the question hour on 19 May, the report in NRC, published before it was sent to your House on 13 May, was based on a version of the incident overview that I did not provide.

Zoals ik heb aangegeven in het vragenuur op 19 mei jl. is de berichtgeving (in de NRC) vóór de verzending aan uw Kamer op 13 mei gebaseerd op een versie van het incidentenoverzicht die niet door mij is verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de bestrijding van mensenhandel

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Justice and Security ministers why police missed the 2019 target of 190 OM suspects for human trafficking (only 145 registered) and about related issues including Dublin claimants, the webcrawler, lure profiles, minors and a Tilburg campaign. The ministers acknowledge the shortfall, attribute it largely to the influx of Dublin claimants and AVIM staffing pressures, promise a recalibration of the target, and defer several questions to later letters or the WODC study.
In 2019 not the agreed 190 but 145 suspects were registered with the OM for prosecution.
In 2019 werden niet de afgesproken 190, maar 145 verdachten ter vervolging ingeschreven bij het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, Kops en Wilders over de achterstelling van Nederlandse woningzoekenden

PVV MPs asked whether the municipality of Vlaardingen giving refugees priority on social rental housing is discrimination against Dutch citizens, whether municipalities should be barred from such priority, and whether temporary asylum permits should be withdrawn so social housing goes only to Dutch nationals. The minister rejected the discrimination framing, explained that municipalities set their own urgency categories and that housing refugees serves integration, and refused to withdraw asylum permits.

After the mandatory urgency status of status holders was removed from the Housing Act on 1 July 2017, municipalities can themselves decide which categories of housing seekers they wish to include as urgency categories in the housing ordinance.

Nadat de verplichte urgentiestatus van statushouders per 1 juli 2017 uit de Huisvestingswet is gehaald kunnen gemeenten zelf bepalen welke categorieën woningzoekenden ze als urgentiecategorie in de huisvestingsverordening wensen op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van den Berge over het voornemen de aangenomen motie over Afghaanse misbruikslachtoffers niet uit te voeren

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why the State Secretary will not implement an adopted motion granting protection to Afghan bacha bazi abuse victims, and why the response took nearly four months. The State Secretary replies that literal implementation conflicts with the EU Qualification Directive, that existing asylum assessment already protects such victims where needed, and that she is nonetheless willing to designate them as a risk group in the Vreemdelingencirculaire.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik, Kuiken, Groothuizen, Voordewind en Van Toorenburg over het voorstel om migranten op de Griekse eilanden vanwege corona over te brengen naar stilliggende cruisesc

MPs from six parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the Netherlands would press the EU to evacuate migrants from overcrowded Greek island camps, such as Moria, to idle cruise ships to prevent a COVID-19 outbreak, and why Dutch relocation promises were not being kept. The government answered that the Greek authorities are primarily responsible, that transfers to the mainland are already ongoing, that the Netherlands is backing a Greek-Dutch programme for unaccompanied minors, and that cruise-ship accommodation was judged unnecessary and costly by Greece.
In principle it is for the Greek authorities to take adequate measures to address the COVID-19 situation.
Het is in beginsel aan de Griekse autoriteiten om adequate maatregelen te treffen om de COVID-19 situatie het hoofd te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een crowdfundingsactie voor Chun

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a crowdfunding campaign for Chun, an undocumented man with no residence status, and whether the government will grant him regular residence so he can live with dignity after sixteen years in limbo. The State Secretary acknowledged the public support, pointed to the buitenschuldbeleid (external-circumstances policy) as the available route, and declined to comment on the individual case.
As your House is aware, I cannot go into individual cases when answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, kan ik in de beantwoording van Kamervragen niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Kuik en Kuiken over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

MPs asked the government about the consequences of the COVID-19 crisis for people in prostitution, including unregistered workers without income support, bed-bath-bread shelter, exit programmes, police raids, and online advertising for physical services. The minister answered that sex workers can access existing support schemes and municipal shelters, that a ban on prostitution applies under the emergency ordinance, that exit demand has not yet grown substantially, and that the ordinance may be amended to address online advertising.
Such possibilities are currently being examined.
Op dit moment worden zulke mogelijkheden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het Onderzoek Meisjes in de gevarenzone 'Ik verlang naar een veilige plek´

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about exploitation of vulnerable girls by loverboys, police and prosecution capacity, specialist care, and measures targeting clients and hotels. The State Secretary answered that data on case outcomes cannot be isolated, that police and zeden teams cooperate, and that research and a package of measures on clients are in preparation, with a concrete package promised before summer.
It turns out it is not possible to retrieve from the systems specifically for this target group how many cases over the past three years led to criminal investigations and convictions.

Het blijkt tenslotte niet mogelijk om specifiek voor deze doelgroep uit de systemen te halen hoeveel zaken er de afgelopen drie jaar hebben geleid tot opsporingsonderzoeken en uiteindelijke veroordelingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over criminaliteit onder asielzoekers

An MP asked the State Secretary about a reported rise in crime by asylum seekers in 2019 and why it is not being tackled, including whether criminal asylum seekers from safe countries should leave and whether a secret report would be shared. The State Secretary confirmed a 27 percent rise in registered offences, said the cause needs further WODC research, outlined existing enforcement measures, and noted the press report concerned a draft.
I have therefore asked the WODC to conduct further research into this.
Ik heb het WODC daarom gevraagd om hier nader onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Rog en Van Toorenburg over het rapport van het Centrum tegen Kinderhandel en Mensenhandel (CKM) aangaande criminele uitbuiting onder Nederlandse scholieren

MPs Kuik, Rog and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the government about a CKM report on criminal exploitation and drug-related recruitment of Dutch schoolchildren, including school protocols, normalisation of drugs, prosecution statistics, non-punishment protection and the UK approach. The state secretary answered that protocols and prevention programmes exist, that data on drug-related trafficking cases is not registered separately, and that the government will explore closer cooperation and learn from the UK.
The Public Prosecution Service does not register in how many of these cases the exploitation is drug-related, nor whether it occurs among schoolchildren.
Het OM registreert niet in hoeveel van deze gevallen het gaat om drugsgerelateerde uitbuiting, en ook niet of dat gebeurt onder scholieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het falend terugkeerbeleid

An MP from the Labour party asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the failing return policy: whether Morocco's readmission of 52 rejected asylum seekers was undermined by inability to locate them, whether pressure measures in the coalition agreement are futile, how many cases involve disappearance, how many rejected asylum seekers remain, and whether subsidised return-training projects are effective. The government answered that Morocco's cooperation is insufficient, that about 40 nationality confirmations in 2019 concerned persons already out of view and about 420 disappeared after confirmation, that it seeks longer detention possibilities under EU rules, that a study on the number of irregular residents is underway, and that the subsidy scheme will be evaluated.
I would have preferred that they had still been available for return to Morocco, but as you know, there are considerable limits to the possibilities of placing someone in detention.
Ik had liever gezien dat ze nog beschikbaar waren geweest voor terugkeer naar Marokko, maar zoals u bekend, zitten er de nodige beperkingen aan de mogelijkheden om iemand in bewaring te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over falend terugkeerbeleid

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the failure of Dutch return policy, including countries refusing to cooperate with returns, the lack of sanctions, Morocco readmission, returns failing because migrants disappeared, and subsidised return training. The government answers that it weighs each country case by case, will inform parliament in spring, admits that in roughly 2,670 cases migrants disappeared after nationality confirmation, and commits to evaluating the return training subsidy.
In accordance with the Becker motion, the cabinet will inform your House in writing about this in the spring.
Conform de motie Becker zal het kabinet uw Kamer dit voorjaar hierover schriftelijk informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het op 6 mei 1963 te Straatsburg tot stand gekomen Verdrag betreffende beperking van gevallen van meervoudige nationaliteit en betreffende militaire verplichtingen in geval v

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the 1963 Strasbourg convention on multiple nationality, whose first chapter now binds only Austria and the Netherlands, should be terminated given the government's plan to modernise nationality law. The State Secretary answered that the convention's limited reach has little effect on Dutch nationality law and that any decision to terminate depends on the modernisation plans, which will also take account of a 2019 EU Court ruling.
Whether it is necessary and desirable to terminate (chapter I of) the Convention depends partly on the precise elaboration of the coalition agreement's commitment to modernise nationality law.

De vraag in hoeverre het noodzakelijk en wenselijk is om (hoofdstuk I van het) Verdrag op te zeggen is mede afhankelijk van de precieze uitwerking van de afspraak in het regeerakkoord tot modernisering van het nationaliteitsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Becker over terugkeerprogramma’s voor uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers

MPs Van Toorenburg (CDA) and Becker (VVD) asked about subsidised return programmes for rejected asylum seekers, including amounts spent, selection and quality control, effectiveness and whether subsidy depends on actual return. The State Secretary answered that 17 completed projects cost about 3.17 million euro and achieved roughly 45% verified departures, promised an evaluation of the subsidy scheme in autumn, and said it would be reviewed whether subsidy conditions should change.
Because I consider it important to provide insight into how the subsidy funds under the Ondersteuning Zelfstandig Vertrek scheme are spent, I have instructed that this scheme be evaluated.
Omdat ik het belangrijk vind inzage te geven in de besteding van de subsidiegelden die onder de Regeling Ondersteuning Zelfstandig Vertrek vallen, heb ik opdracht gegeven deze regeling te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Becker en Koopmans over de Europese Afrikastrategie

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the new EU-Africa strategy, its migration section, conditionality linking migration cooperation to returns, the EIB president's remarks on open procurement, Chinese contractors in African infrastructure, and untied aid.
