The minister's answers largely defend the Commission's approach as balanced and consistent with Dutch policy, while declining to press for the specific linkages the MPs proposed and rejecting a shift away from untied aid.
The cabinet assesses the migration section of the Commission communication on the EU-Africa Strategy as balanced
Het kabinet beoordeelt de paragraaf over migratie in de Commissiemededeling over de EU-Afrika Strategie als gebalanceerd
Antwoord op vragen de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Canada en Nederland testen trans-Atlantische vluchten zonder paspoort’

D66 MPs asked about a Canada-Netherlands pilot testing passport-free transatlantic travel via facial recognition and a digital traveller identity, including its origins, necessity, duration, privacy safeguards, data use and function creep. The Secretary of State answered that the pilot is voluntary, governed by a data protection impact assessment, will be evaluated and shared with parliament, but gave only general or deferred answers on several points and no firm plans for other countries.
The outcomes and evaluation of the test will be published and I will share them with your House.
De uitkomsten en evaluatie van de test worden gepubliceerd en deel ik met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Nederland op slot voor vluchteling per vliegtuig’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a report that asylum seekers can practically no longer reach the EU by plane, and about how airlines refuse passengers and cooperate in removals. The State Secretary rejected any obligation to facilitate onward migration, said airlines are bound by carrier sanctions, admitted that refusals are not systematically registered, and promised a policy response only after the advisory commission's reports are complete.
A policy response will be given after all sub-reports of the ACVZ have been completed.
Een beleidsreactie zal worden gegeven nadat alle deelrapporten van de ACVZ zijn afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de onveilige situatie voor homo’s en transgenders in Iran

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked whether the government had correctly assessed the safety of gay and transgender people in Iran, and whether it had used relevant reports and a letter from 6Rang in its country report. The State Secretary answered that the country report relies on source-verified information, that a supplementary analysis confirmed the March 2019 assessment and found no essential change, and that there is no reason to revise the policy, with a further update planned for 2021.
The conclusion of the investigation is that the situation as described in the March 2019 country report is confirmed.
De conclusie van het onderzoek is dat de situatie zoals deze beschreven is in het ambtsbericht van maart 2019 bevestigd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over ‘sekswerkers die tussen wal en schip vallen door de coronacrisis’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether sex workers outside the Tozo and WW schemes, such as opt-in workers and EU nationals, are left without income during the coronavirus crisis, and asked about protection, municipal coordination and the shift to online platforms. The government answered that these groups may qualify for social assistance under conditions, pointed to the ban on contact occupations in the emergency ordinances, and said it is in contact with the VNG.
In addition, I am in contact with the VNG to see how we can jointly move municipalities, where necessary, to assist sex workers experiencing problems due to the coronavirus.
Daarnaast ben ik in contact met de VNG om te bezien hoe wij gezamenlijk gemeenten waar nodig kunnen bewegen om sekswerkers die problemen ondervinden door het coronavirus, tegemoet te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Bruins over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

MPs Van der Graaf and Bruins asked about the effects of the coronavirus crisis on sex workers, including exit programmes, income support, closure rules, online advertising, and shelter. The government answered that exit demand is being monitored, that municipalities bear responsibility for shelter and most support, and that it advises against forcing websites to block physical-service advertising.
In parallel, I have asked the RUPS organisations about the requests for help they have received since the start of the coronavirus crisis and the nature of these requests.
Parallel daaraan heb ik bij de Rups-organisaties een uitvraag gedaan naar de hulpvragen die zij sinds het begin van de coronacrisis ontvangen en wat de aard is van deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over oorlogsmisdadigers in de gemeentelijke bed-, bad-, brood voorziening

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about war criminals (1F-status) receiving municipal bed-bath-bread shelter, asking for figures, assurances on deportation, agreements on closing such shelters, and an instruction to Leiden. The State Secretary confirmed pursuit of forced departure but noted Article 3 ECHR limits, said BBB shelters are municipal responsibility without national legal power to instruct them, and committed to closing some BBB shelters and exploring alternative return countries.
There is no immigration-law power to give an instruction of the above kind.
Er bestaat geen vreemdelingenrechtelijke bevoegdheid tot het geven van een aanwijzing van bovengenoemde strekking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over het bericht 'Turkije zet grenzen open: Syriërs naar Europa'

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey would open its borders to Syrians heading for Europe, including Dutch diplomatic action on Idlib, the future of EU-Turkey support, and conditions on the Greek islands. The government answered that it considers this unacceptable, sees no signs of large-scale border crossings, supports enforcing the EU-Turkey Statement, and outlined EU and bilateral aid to Greece and humanitarian funding.
It is highly undesirable that people are used in this way for political purposes.
Het is zeer onwenselijk dat mensen op deze manier worden ingezet voor politieke doeleinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de schrijnende humanitaire situatie op de Griekse eilanden

MP Voordewind asked the government about the humanitarian crisis on the Greek islands, what the EU and the Netherlands could do to ease it, and whether the Netherlands would relocate vulnerable migrants and unaccompanied minors. The State Secretary answered that the issue was discussed in EU Justice and Home Affairs councils, that the Dutch line focuses on enforcing the EU-Turkey Statement with support for Greece, that material and financial aid was sent, and that ad hoc relocation is not currently envisaged.
Accelerated relocation procedures are currently not under consideration.
Van versnelde relocatieprocedures is momenteel geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de overheid al jaren weet van vermissingen van Vietnamese kinderen

MP Jasper van Dijk asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the government has known for years about disappearances of Vietnamese children from protected reception, whether the Chamber was informed, and whether earlier signals of trafficking were reported. The State Secretary answers that the phenomenon has long been known, that reports and two research studies were shared with the Chamber over time, that earlier statements were correct though indications of smuggling existed, and commits to measures set out in a letter of 23 March.
Do you acknowledge that the Chamber was not, or at least incompletely, informed?
Vraag 6 Erkent u dat de Kamer niet of tenminste onvolledig is geïnformeerd?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Stampvol vluchtelingenkamp Lesbos kansloos bij besmetting coronavirus’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Foreign Minister about COVID-19 risks in Greek migrant camps such as Moria, including protection measures, evacuation, and use of EU funds. The government answered that no migrants in Moria had tested positive yet, described Greek and EU containment measures and financial support, and said evacuation is in principle Greece's responsibility, with EU emergency mechanisms available if requested.
Responsibility for the decision on evacuating migrants from the Greek islands lies in principle with Greece.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de beslissing over een evacuatie van migranten op de Griekse eilanden ligt in beginsel bij Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over corona en de vele andere levensbedreigende risico’s in vluchtelingenkampen op Griekse eilanden

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked whether the government shares concern about COVID-19 and other life-threatening conditions in Greek island migrant camps, and whether it will take in unaccompanied children from there. The State Secretary says the government shares the concerns, lists Greek and EU measures and humanitarian support, and rejects ad hoc relocation of unaccompanied minors as a structural solution, while favouring structural improvements.
The government does not consider the ad hoc admission of unaccompanied minors a structural solution.
Het ad hoc opnemen van AMV's vindt het kabinet geen structurele oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Belhaj en Groothuizen over een Nederlandse bijdrage aan een gereactiveerde ‘Sophia-missie’

MPs Sjoerdsma, Belhaj and Groothuizen asked the ministers about the Berlin Libya conference, the EU arms embargo monitoring role, reactivating the Sophia mission, humanitarian and migration effects, and a Dutch contribution. The government welcomed the Berlin outcomes, said EUNAVFOR MED Irini (succeeding Sophia) will implement the UN arms embargo, and said a Dutch contribution of staff officers in Rome is likely while further capacity decisions await military advice.
The cabinet is still considering a possible contribution with other capabilities.
Het kabinet beraadt zich nog op een eventuele bijdrage met andere capaciteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het groeiende tekort aan opvangplekken in de asielopvang

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the growing shortage of asylum reception places, including municipal reluctance, nuisance by some asylum seekers, IND backlogs, expiring reception contracts, and returns cooperation with Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia. The State Secretary answered that extra beds are urgently needed, that COA is preparing buffer capacity, that nuisance undermines local support, and that returns cooperation is being pursued, while listing 14 locations with contracts expiring in 2020-2021 without stating which will be renewed.
It is not possible at this time to indicate which will and which will not be extended, nor the reasons underlying this for the municipalities concerned.
Het is nu niet aan te geven welke wel en welke niet verlengd zullen worden, evenals welke redenen daaraan ten grondslag liggen voor de betreffende gemeentes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat van 2,3 miljoen migranten onbekend is waar zij zich bevinden

An SP MP asked the ministers why the government cannot track the addresses of about 2.3 million non-resident migrants with a citizen service number, which hampers inspection and enforcement against exploitation. The minister replied that many of these registrations are not migrants at all (e.g. cross-border workers), that address verification requires other data, that a plan to improve registration is being prepared, and that a further letter will follow.
Not being able to access contact details of a migrant worker hinders the Inspectorate in carrying out its tasks, both in supervision and in investigation.
Het niet kunnen beschikken over contactgegevens van een arbeidsmigrant belemmert de Inspectie dus in haar taakuitvoering, zowel bij toezicht als opsporing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de situatie in Kameroen

An MP asked the government about the humanitarian, security and political situation in Cameroon, including refugee flows, human rights, the February 2020 elections, education, and Dutch and EU support. The ministers answered in detail on the crises, Dutch aid of 2 million euros, EU pressure for dialogue, and Cameroon-related asylum figures.
The Netherlands contributed 2 million euros to the emergency aid programme of the Dutch Relief Alliance in Cameroon.
Nederland heeft 2 miljoen euro bijgedragen aan het noodhulpprogramma van de Dutch Relief Alliance in Kameroen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kerstens, Van Dijk, Moorlag en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het Coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party (PvdA) asked the ministers of health, social affairs, economic affairs and the state secretary of justice about IC bed capacity, care for budget holders, immigration detention during the coronavirus crisis, temporary worker and self-employed income support, Schiphol security staff conditions, childcare leave and state support for firms. The minister answered most questions substantively, describing measures and plans, while declining to commit to a fixed IC bed scenario beyond referring to earlier letters and saying the 40-hour norm and PBM supplies were still under review.
I refer you to that for brevity.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Bruins over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

MPs Van der Graaf and Bruins asked about the impact of the COVID-19 crisis on people in prostitution, including which guidelines apply to various sex work sectors, income support, exit programmes and housing. The State Secretary answered that emergency ordinances close brothels, window prostitution, sex clubs and sex theatres while street work, escort, home prostitution and porn are not covered, that self-employed sex workers may qualify for a temporary income scheme run by municipalities, and that exit-programme capacity will be reviewed after the crisis.

I am willing, after the peak of the coronavirus crisis, to examine whether there is a significantly higher inflow of clients into the exit programmes, and whether more funds are needed and can become available.
Ik ben bereid na de piek van de coronacrisis te bezien of er significant hogere toestroom van cliënten bij de uitstapprogramma's is, en of er meer middelen nodig zijn en beschikbaar kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Van Aalst en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat asielzoekers buschauffeurs intimideren en reizigers bestelen

PVV MPs asked why asylum seekers who intimidate bus drivers and rob passengers are allowed to continue, and whether they should be expelled or jailed. The state secretary answered that overlast by asylum seekers is a serious but relatively small group problem, cited cooperation with transport partners, a landelijk convenant and Top-X lists, and said such behaviour leads to lik-op-stuk measures.
For nuisance behaviour the starting point is that, regardless of the person, this is not tolerated and leads to firm enforcement measures.
Bij overlastgevend gedrag is het vertrekpunt dat, ongeacht de persoon, dit niet wordt getolereerd en dit leidt tot lik-op-stuk maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘KLM weigerde Lili en Howick te vervoeren‘

MPs Becker and Remco Dijkstra asked whether KLM, partly state-owned, cancelled the flight of two deported children (Lili and Howick) at the last moment, what agreements exist with KLM on removals, whether airlines can be sanctioned for frustrating deportation policy, and whether the state should talk to KLM. The State Secretary confirmed KLM's decision, said the captain bears final responsibility for safe flight operation, declined to examine KLM's risk assessment, and stated that no sanctions exist and that KLM's independent decision is separate from the government's decision on the children.

I respect the decision KLM made to not transport these passengers on grounds of safe flight operation, and given KLM's professionalism and long-standing good cooperation, I see no reason to inquire into the risk assessment in this specific case.

Ik respecteer de beslissing die de KLM heeft genomen om uit hoofde van een veilige vluchtuitvoering deze passagiers niet te vervoeren en gelet op de professionaliteit van de KLM en de jarenlange goede samenwerking, zie ik geen aanleiding om navraag te doen naar de risico inschatting in deze specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Becker over het bericht ‘Ladingen afgekeurd wegens inklimmers‘

MPs Dijkstra and Becker asked the ministers about reports that cargo was rejected because stowaways were found, including the size of the damage, the numbers and nationalities of stowaways and what happens to them, and what measures are taken against smuggling networks. The government answered that it has no overview of the damage or of rejected cargo, outlined expulsion and prosecution practice, listed border measures and cooperation with the UK and Belgium, and said smuggling is investigated where signals exist.
The government has no insight into the extent of the damage suffered in the transport sector from rejected cargo due to stowaways.
De overheid heeft geen inzicht in de omvang van de schade die wordt geleden in de transportsector door het afkeuren van ladingen vanwege inklimmers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat asielzoekers niet welkom zijn in Ter Apel vanwege het Coronavirus

The Member of Parliament Jasper van Dijk asked whether new asylum seekers were being turned away from Ter Apel due to Covid-19, where they would be housed, why a second registration centre was not opened, whether return interviews were cancelled, and what measures protect staff and residents. The State Secretary confirmed that the asylum procedure for new arrivals was suspended and that an emergency shelter was being set up, ruled out a second centre, said return interviews only continue in exceptional cases, and described hygiene and cooperation measures with the GGD.
The decision taken is that for asylum seekers who newly register, the asylum procedure is suspended.
Het besluit dat is genomen is dat voor asielzoekers die zich nieuw aanmelden de asielprocedure wordt opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de vierdelige reportage van Nieuwsuur en het bericht ‘Officier mensenhandel waarschuwt: veel seksuele uitbuiting in de prostitutie’

An MP asked the State Secretary about Nieuwsuur reporting on sexual exploitation in prostitution, including local variation in rules, enforcement, and the effects of lifting the brothel ban. The State Secretary answered that the regulation bill (Wrs) is meant to create uniform national rules and licensing, that municipalities keep local enforcement, and committed to consulting the sector on transparency and cash use.
I do not have an overview of the differences in licensing requirements that municipalities impose.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van verschillen in vergunningseisen die gemeenten stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat de Eritreeër die tot 6 jaar cel en TBS veroordeeld is voor doodslag, verkrachting en mishandeling van een oudere dame in Amsterdam, welli

MPs Markuszower and Emiel van Dijk asked whether an Eritrean sentenced to six years and TBS for manslaughter, rape and assault could be guaranteed deportation and loss of residence after serving his sentence, and whether that matches earlier statements by the state secretary. The state secretary declined to comment on the individual case, said the IND will decide on revoking the residence permit once the conviction is final, and said public safety is a primary consideration.
I will not go into the substance of individual cases and cannot anticipate the IND's decision or the course of the TBS treatment.
Ik ga niet in op de inhoud van individuele zaken en kan ook niet vooruitlopen op de beslissing van de IND of het verloop van de behandeling in het TBS-traject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over het bericht ‘Vreemdelingenadvocaten: ‘Curaçao zet Venezolanen collectief uit’

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked about reports that Curaçao collectively expelled Venezuelans and about detention conditions in the immigration barracks on Curaçao, including whether the Kingdom should intervene. The government answered that Curaçao is responsible for detention conditions, that Netherlands supports improvements, and that Kingdom intervention is a last resort, while promising continued monitoring and not committing to an independent visit.
Intervention by the Kingdom under the Charter is a last resort.
Ingrijpen door het Koninkrijk op grond van het Statuut is een laatste redmiddel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Ziengs over de EuroStar trein naar London

MPs Kröger and Ziengs asked about the status of the four-country border control and security treaties for the Eurostar service to London, the reported shortage of Marechaussee capacity for a third daily train, remaining obstacles, implementation of their motions, and earlier commitments on capacity. The State Secretary replied that the treaties are concluded and due for signing by 30 April 2020, that Marechaussee capacity is being arranged for the extra trains, and that provisional application will proceed without blocking the direct service.
The aim is that the treaties will be signed by 30 April 2020 at the latest.
De inzet is dat de ondertekening van de verdragen in ieder geval voor 30 april 2020 zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Chun; de man die niet bestaat

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how the government responds to the case of Chun, a stateless man who cannot return to China nor obtain residence in the Netherlands, and whether the government will grant him a residence permit. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case, confirmed that the buitenschuldbeleid (no-fault policy) exists for such situations, gave aggregate figures on applications and grants, and stated that international law does not oblige granting residence in such cases.
As your House is aware, I cannot go into individual cases when answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, kan ik in de beantwoording van Kamervragen niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Becker over het gesprek van de Commissie Justitie en Veiligheid met de nieuwe Eurocommissaris Johansson

MPs Van Toorenburg and Becker asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether she agrees with EU Commissioner Johansson that the Netherlands does not fully use EU rules allowing detention of migrants, and whether she will have this analysed. The State Secretary answered that the government will pursue wider administrative migrant detention within EU law, has asked the Commission for an analysis, and commissioned WODC research with results expected in 2021.
I indicated to the Commissioner that I would like an explanation and/or analysis from the Commission of the possibilities that the current regulations offer regarding detention.
Ik heb de Eurocommissaris aangegeven dat ik graag een toelichting en/of analyse zou krijgen van de Commissie op de mogelijkheden die de huidige regelgeving biedt op het onderdeel van bewaring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Annahita (22) krijgt duizenden reacties nadat ze als enige op vlucht naar VS wordt geweigerd'

MPs Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the ministers about reports that a Dutch woman was refused boarding to the US at Schiphol, whether the US immigration liaison officers have powers on Dutch soil, and about pre-clearance negotiations. The government declined to comment on the individual case, stated that IAP officers only advise airlines and need consent for photographs, and said pre-clearance negotiations are ongoing with Dutch sovereignty and Dutch standards to be respected.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘2500 jonge alleenstaande asielzoekers verdwenen’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that about 2,500 unaccompanied minor asylum seekers disappeared from reception centres, why some centres see many disappearances, why the Amber Alert system is not used for them, and what has been done since a July 2019 debate and a revised protocol. The State Secretary confirms roughly 2,570 such disappearances over 2010-2019, states that open (not closed) reception means minors may leave, explains the Ter Apel and Oisterwijk pattern, rejects the premise that Amber Alert is excluded, and promises analysis results and a reply within four weeks.
Within four weeks your House will receive the research results and my response to them by letter.
Uw Kamer ontvangt binnen vier weken per brief de onderzoeksresultaten en mijn reactie daarop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Je kunt niet tien keer met hetzelfde komen’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security to explain her remark that the asylum system should be based more on rules than on rights, and how that fits with the Van Zwol report on repeat asylum applications. The State Secretary answered that rights and rules are out of balance given misuse of the procedure, that she seeks new rules and EU-level tools while keeping the right to asylum, and described IND measures against hopeless repeat applications with average processing times of about 150 days.
To be able to counter misuse of the asylum system and the associated facilities, I want the European rights-based system to be supplemented with a well-functioning, rules-based system.

Om misbruik van het asielsysteem en de bijbehorende voorzieningen tegen te kunnen gaan, wil ik dat het Europese op rechten gebaseerde systeem wordt aangevuld met een goed functionerend, op regels gebaseerd systeem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Oxfam: nieuwe wet verslechtert situatie asielzoekers Griekse eilanden’

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked whether asylum seekers in Greece lack access to a fair asylum procedure and legal aid, whether the European Commission will supervise access to lawyers in closed centres, and how much EU money supports legal aid. The State Secretary acknowledges remaining bottlenecks including limited legal aid, says the government presses Greece for improvements, notes the Commission's oversight role and EUR 322,000 in EU legal-aid funding, but lacks exact figures and deems Commission involvement in closed centres premature.
The cabinet does not have the exact figures for the number of asylum seekers currently having access to legal aid.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de exacte cijfers van het aantal asielzoekers dat momenteel toegang heeft tot juridische bijstand.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de stand van zaken in de processen tegen de door Nederland uitgeleverde Rwandezen I. en M. en de zaak tegen de moeder van de Rwandese oppositiepolitica Victoire Ingabire

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the progress of trials in Rwanda against two genocide suspects extradited from the Netherlands, the delay in their trials, and the case concerning the mother of Victoire Ingabire, including the confiscation of her passport. The ministers answered that trials are being monitored by the ICJ, that the High Court trial of one suspect is nearing conclusion while no end date is given for the other, that they see no unreasonable delay, and that they decline to comment on the passport case while defending extradition as responsible.
It is my custom to exercise restraint in my statements on ongoing cases.
Er past mij, zoals gebruikelijk, terughoudendheid in mijn mededelingen over lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat Syrische vluchtelingen die christen zijn geweigerd worden in VN-opvangkampen

An ChristenUnie MP asked the ministers whether Syrian Christian refugees are refused entry to UN camps in Jordan and whether separate camps or investigation are needed. The government says it has no information confirming refusals, is in ongoing dialogue with UNHCR on non-discrimination, sees no structural discrimination, and rejects separate camps.
The government has no information that Christian refugees are being refused in the UN refugee camps in Jordan.
Het kabinet heeft geen informatie dat christelijke vluchtelingen geweigerd worden in de VN-vluchtelingenkampen in Jordanië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Maeijer over het bericht dat Griekenland volgend jaar 100.000 migranten verwacht

Two PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how the Netherlands would prevent migrants expected in Greece from reaching Dutch soil, and about Dutch funding to Turkey under the EU-Turkey deal. The government answered that the EU-Turkey statement has reduced irregular flows, that the Dutch contribution is EUR 140 million to Syrian refugees in Turkey, and that border controls follow the Schengen acquis with shared EU responsibility.
This makes the Statement an effective instrument in countering illegal migration.
Dit maakt de Verklaring een effectief instrument in het tegengaan van illegale migratie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat de EU-steun aan Marokko nauwelijks effect heeft

MPs Maeijer and Van Dijk asked whether EU aid to Morocco, criticised by the European Court of Auditors as ineffective, could be recovered, how much Dutch money had flowed there, and why funding should continue given Morocco's refusal to take back rejected nationals. The minister answered that the ECA found limited effectiveness but no evidence of misappropriation, gave the aid totals and Dutch share, and said migration cooperation is pursued through EU instruments while the NDICI negotiations are still ongoing.
The report contains no indications of misappropriation.
Het rapport bevat geen aanwijzingen voor malversaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over de aankoop van Maltese paspoorten door spionnen, fraudeurs, mensenhandelaren en belastingontduikers

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government shares concern that Maltese passports sold to investors have gone to suspected criminals and spies, and whether it will press Malta on its vetting. The government said it finds such passport sales undesirable, relies on Malta's due diligence checks, and will pursue dialogue at EU level once the Commission's expected 2020 report is published.
The government shares that concern and considers the so-called sale of passports, whereby a third-country national can also obtain EU citizenship, an undesirable form of naturalisation.
Het kabinet deelt die zorg en acht het zogenoemd verkopen van paspoorten, waardoor een derdelander ook het EU-burgerschap kan verkrijgen, een onwenselijke wijze van naturalisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Omtzigt, Kuiken en Verhoeven over de paspoorthandel van Malta en de betrokkenheid van een professor van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

MPs asked the government about Malta's citizenship-by-investment scheme, the listed buyers of Maltese passports, the AIVD warning, the Rule of Law situation in Malta, and a Groningen professor's links to a passport firm. The minister answered that the Maltese list covers all naturalisations, that the Commission is monitoring such schemes and the government will seek dialogue, that the Prime Minister raised rule-of-law concerns with his Maltese counterpart, and that the university is examining the professor's activities.
The cabinet considers the sale of passports to non-EU citizens who are suspected of crimes to be undesirable.
Het kabinet acht de verkoop van paspoorten aan niet-EU burgers, die onder verdenking staan van misdrijven, ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Emiel van Dijk over eigen woningen voor Nieuwegeinse statushouders

Two PVV MPs asked whether it is discriminatory that Nieuwegein reserves 30 social rental homes for single refugee status holders, and whether asylum permits should be revoked so social housing goes only to Dutch residents. The minister answered that nationality-based distinctions are not made, that municipalities set their own urgency categories, that the social housing construction claim is disputed, and that revoking permits is refused.
No distinction is made in the Netherlands on the basis of nationality.
In Nederland wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Maeijer over Moldaviërs die naar Nederland worden gesmokkeld

MPs Emiel van Dijk and Maeijer asked about Moldovans being smuggled to the Netherlands, how many have applied for asylum since visa-free travel in 2014, whether medical and reception support should stop, whether visa-free travel causes illegal stay, and whether the emergency brake or visa reintroduction should be used. The government reported asylum and return figures, restricted medical care for the first two months of reception from 1 December 2019, said the emergency brake is not currently appropriate, and promised a letter on the asylum outcomes in Q1 2020.
Parliament will be informed in the first quarter of 2020 about how the asylum applications of the group of Moldovans who arrived from November are being handled.
Over de afhandeling van de asielaanvragen van de groep Moldaviërs die vanaf november zijn ingestroomd wordt uw Kamer in het eerste kwartaal 2020 geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het COA asielzoekers, die slachtoffer zijn van een zedendelict, afraadt aangifte te doen

MPs Kuiken and Van Dijk asked whether COA advised asylum seekers who were victims of sexual offences, including gay victims, against filing police reports, and how often such victims report. The State Secretary replied that COA encourages reporting, that it has no evidence of such advice beyond the media report, that no internal investigation exists, and that police and COA hold no central figures on this.
COA encourages residents to file police reports and provides support where needed.
Het COA stimuleert bewoners om aangifte te doen en biedt waar nodig ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een in Nederland geboren jongen van 19 die als illegaal in de gevangenis belandt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why a Dutch-born 19-year-old was detained as an illegal resident and why no one prevented this, and whether he would be released and given Dutch nationality. The State Secretary declined to go into individual detail for privacy reasons, defended the court-reviewed detention and IND procedure, and said the IND is still assessing the new residence application.
When answering questions about individual cases from your House, I am, as is known, bound by rules on the privacy of the person concerned.
Ik ben bij de beantwoording van vragen over individuele zaken door uw Kamer, zoals bekend is, gebonden aan regels omtrent de privacy van een betrokkene
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Markuszower over het bericht dat KLM weigerde mee te werken aan het vertrek van Lili en Howick

MPs Van Dijk and Markuszower asked whether KLM's refusal to fly two Armenian children deported by the Netherlands undermined court rulings, how often airlines have refused deportations, and what the costs are. The State Secretary referred to the Inspectorate's report and its announced measures, said airlines generally cooperate but the captain may refuse passengers for safety reasons, and said the state cannot assess the costs or KLM's reasoning.
I cannot speculate on the considerations KLM made before deciding not to transport the two children.
Ik kan niet speculeren over de afwegingen die de KLM heeft gemaakt voorafgaand aan het besluit de twee kinderen niet te vervoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Maeijer over migrantenschepen die mogen aanmeren in Italië

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government can guarantee that migrants from the Ocean Viking and Alan Kurdi, allowed to dock in Italy, will not be taken in by the Netherlands, and criticised the European Commission's role in redistributing them. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands will in principle no longer take part in ad hoc disembarkation arrangements without a structural solution, and that the Commission only coordinates relocation at a member state's request.

As stated in the letter to parliament of 14 January 2019, the Netherlands, without a concrete prospect of a structural solution, will no longer participate in ad hoc measures within the framework of disembarkation.

Zoals vermeld in de Kamerbrief van 14 januari 2019, zal Nederland, zonder een concreet perspectief op een structurele oplossing, niet meer deelnemen aan ad hoc maatregelen in het kader van ontscheping.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Voordewind over het bericht dat vluchtelingen worden uitgehongerd in Libië

MPs Van Dijk and Voordewind asked whether refugees in Libya are being starved out of the UNHCR gathering centre in Tripoli, and what the government will do about it. The government acknowledges the dire conditions, explains that UNHCR is shifting aid to urban centres and phasing out catering, and points to additional funding and existing resettlement and evacuation channels, without committing to new resettlement.
As the House has been informed on several occasions, the difficult conditions for refugees and migrants in Libya are a cause for concern.
Zoals vaker aan uw Kamer gemeld zijn de zware omstandigheden voor vluchtelingen en migranten in Libië zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk bericht 'Zet asielzoekers veilige landen apart'

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a report that Ter Apel wants asylum seekers from safe countries housed separately, and about related concerns on shop theft, police presence, bus transport and schooling. The State Secretary says overlast from this group is a priority, points to a separate reception form and transfer to the Hoogeveen supervision location, notes the police station is being kept in Ter Apel, and says schooling is covered by existing rules.
The COA, together with the parties involved, is looking for a suitable location for the separate form of reception.
Het COA is samen met betrokken partijen op zoek naar een geschikte locatie voor de separate opvangvorm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over het bericht ‘Vreemdelingenadvocaten: 'Curaçao zet Venezolanen collectief uit’

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked about reports that Curaçao collectively expels Venezuelan migrants without individual assessment, detention conditions, minors, oversight by the Kingdom, and Dutch military assistance. The minister answers that individual screening is procedurally required, that Curaçao's judiciary must review compliance, that 95 of 97 intercepted persons were returned after individual assessment, and that Dutch military support was provided under Curaçao's authority with some improvements to detention facilities pending.
It is not for the Dutch government but for the judiciary of Curaçao to assess, where relevant cases arise, to what extent irregularities occur in an expulsion.

Het is niet aan de regering van Nederland, maar aan de rechterlijke macht in Curaçao om in eventueel voorkomende gevallen te beoordelen in hoeverre er zich onregelmatigheden voordoen bij een uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het risico op een toenemende migratiestroom via de Balkan

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about rising migration pressure on the Western Balkans route, EU border control failures, visa checks at border posts, MFF funding and cooperation with EU partners. The State Secretary answered that the Commission reports increased pressure but not comparable to 2015–2016, that member states are primarily responsible for border control with EU evaluation and Frontex vulnerability assessments as checks, and that the Netherlands supports more migration priority in the next MFF and continued EU support to the region.
Individual EU member states are primarily responsible for border supervision at the external borders and must carry out border control in accordance with the Schengen acquis.
De individuele EU-lidstaten zijn primair verantwoordelijk voor het grenstoezicht aan de buitengrenzen en zij dienen conform het Schengenacquis grenstoezicht uit te voeren.
Àntwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Helder over het bericht dat asielzoekers georganiseerd op rooftocht door Amsterdam gaan

PVV MPs asked whether asylum seekers organising robberies in Amsterdam should be prosecuted as criminal organisation members, deported, and whether a full asylum stop should be imposed, and how many such suspects are imprisoned or deported. The State Secretary said police do not record residence status, so figures are unavailable, referred to the VRIS protocol and about 910 VRIS-linked departures in 2019 to September, and rejected a categorical asylum stop as unrealistic.
The police chief informed me that no figures are available, other than the total number of criminals mentioned in the Telegraaf article.
De korpschef heeft mij erover geïnformeerd dat er geen cijfers beschikbaar zijn, anders dan het totaal aantal criminelen dat is genoemd in het artikel in De Telegraaf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht 'Vluchtelingenwerk bezorgd om uitzetting Afghaanse tolk'

MPs Belhaj, Groothuizen and Voordewind asked whether an Afghan former interpreter for the US army, refused asylum and facing deportation, is consistent with government statements on risk groups for interpreters in Afghanistan, and how such cases are weighed. The government declined to discuss individual cases, explained that interpreters who worked for international missions are now treated as a systematically persecuted group following a motion, and estimated about ten former local staff granted asylum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een Afghaanse tolk die vreest voor zijn leven omdat hij Nederland dreigt te worden uitgezet

MPs asked whether Afghan interpreters who worked for Western forces, and who face Taliban threats, should receive categorical protection and whether the deportation of one such interpreter would breach non-refoulement. The government answered that the 2019 country report placed this group in a risk group where minor indications can suffice, that it has since adopted systematic persecution for interpreters of international missions following a motion, and that every application is assessed individually; it did not hold data on how many interpreters are in hiding or killed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het artikel ‘Illegaal vlogt en feest op kosten gemeente’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether municipal subsidy money for illegal migrants (LVV programme) undermines national policy, and whether they should be made to leave rather than learn Dutch. The State Secretary answered that spending is a local matter, that LVV aims at durable solutions mostly meaning return, and that the convenant partners are in ongoing dialogue with Amsterdam.
It is not for me, as State Secretary for Justice and Security, to pass judgment on this.
Het is niet aan mij, als Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid, om hier een oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over illegalen die panden kraken

MPs Fritsma, Emiel van Dijk and Wilders asked why the "We are here" group of squatters can squat buildings unpunished, whether members have been prosecuted or removed from the Netherlands, and whether they will be evicted and expelled immediately. The Minister answered that no figures on prosecutions or removals of this group are kept, that arrest does not end unlawful squatting (eviction is the effective tool), that the OM applies its existing policy, and that most of the group refuses to cooperate with return.
The Public Prosecution Service does not keep records of criminal offences committed by persons who count themselves as part of the "We are here" group.
Door het Openbaar Ministerie wordt geen registratie bijgehouden van strafbare feiten die gepleegd zijn door personen die zich rekenen tot de «We are here» groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de nog volstrekt onhoudbare en verslechtende situatie op vluchtelingenkampen op Lesbos

An MP from the Labour party asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the deteriorating conditions in the Moria camp on Lesbos and whether this amounts to a humanitarian disaster requiring urgent aid. The government acknowledges the poor and worsening conditions, describes its support via blankets, experts and EU funds, and points to Greek asylum reforms as the lasting solution.
The cabinet shares your concerns about the reception conditions on the Greek islands.
Het kabinet deelt uw zorgen over de opvangomstandigheden op de Griekse eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over schrijnende omstandigheden voor vluchtelingen op Lesbos

The MP asked why conditions in the Lesbos refugee camp remain unacceptable after a fatal stabbing and what the government will do with European partners to bring rapid structural improvements. The State Secretary agreed the situation is alarming, said Greece must take responsibility for structural reforms while the Netherlands keeps pressing and supporting, and pointed to new Greek asylum legislation without giving a firm timeline.
Greece must nevertheless itself take responsibility for carrying out these structural improvements.
Griekenland dient evenwel zelf verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor het doorvoeren van deze structurele verbeteringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de volstrekt onhoudbare situatie op vluchtelingenkampen op Lesbos

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the reported unliveable conditions in the Lesbos camps, including children's rights, and what concrete steps the EU and the Netherlands would take. The government shares the concern, says Greece must take responsibility and that the Netherlands offers support, and notes Greece's request to relocate up to 2,500 unaccompanied minors, which it is considering while opposing a new relocation round in principle.
The Netherlands consistently presses for this, at official and political level, bilaterally and within the EU.
Nederland dringt daar voortdurend op aan, op ambtelijk en politiek niveau, bilateraal en in EU-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Het kamp op Lesbos was nooit zó vol’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about reports that the Lesbos camps are overcrowded, the departure of camp directors, the worsening conditions on Greek islands, EU funding use, and the Greek proposal to designate Turkey as a safe country. The State Secretary answered that conditions have deteriorated, that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised concerns with Greek authorities, that asylum procedure reform is the responsibility of the Greek government, and that the Chamber will be informed of significant changes.
If new agreements are made at European level on the Netherlands' involvement regarding the situation in the Greek refugee camps, your House will of course be informed.
Mochten er nieuwe afspraken worden gemaakt in Europees verband over de inzet omtrent de situatie in de Griekse vluchtelingenkampen, dan zal uw Kamer uiteraard geïnformeerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de berichten ‘Door de privacywetgeving verdwijnen de slachtoffers van mensenhandel uit beeld’ en ‘Minder meldingen seksuele uitbuiting, niet minder zaken’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports that registered human trafficking victims nearly halved, and whether GDPR privacy rules are to blame. The State Secretary answered that privacy rules may have contributed but do not fully explain the decline, promised a policy response in Q1 2020, and declined to create a statutory basis for processing victims' data without consent.
I do not recognise the National Rapporteur's claim that the policy is built on loose sand.
Ik herken de stelling van de Nationaal Rapporteur dat er bij het beleid sprake is van «los zand» niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het sluiten van speciale unit voor LHBTQ-asielzoekers in Ter Apel

An MP asked the State Secretary whether COA is closing a protected unit for LGBTQ asylum seekers in Ter Apel, why, and how their safety will be ensured. The State Secretary replied that COA does not place vulnerable groups together as a rule, that placement is primarily logistical with individual safety measures, and declined to create protected accommodation or meet LGBT Asylum Support.
COA looks at what is needed in each individual case and ensures a safe place.
Het COA bekijkt per individueel geval wat nodig is en draagt zorg voor een veilige plek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘COA lijkt te stoppen met consequente beschermde opvang LHBTQ-asielzoekers’

MPs Bergkamp and Groothuizen asked whether the COA closed the dedicated LHBTQ unit in Ter Apel, how this squares with a 2016 motion, and whether separate shelter is still needed. The State Secretary answered that the COA does not run dedicated LHBTQ shelter, prefers not to group specific groups, but tries to place residents with similar backgrounds within a location and can transfer people when unsafe; the answers to most questions refer back to answer 2.
The COA does not have protected shelter for LHBTQ residents.
Het COA beschikt niet over beschermde opvang voor LHBTQ bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Van der Graaf over de uitzending van Undercover Nederland over de misstanden die plaatsvinden in een legale seksinrichting in Doetinchem

MPs Kuik and Van der Graaf asked how the government would respond to reported abuse, including coerced prostitution, in a licensed sex establishment in Doetinchem, and whether such establishments should be closed and perpetrators prosecuted. The Staatssecretaris answered that licensing, enforcement and closure are local competences, that municipal and police checks found no confirmed abuse or grounds for criminal investigation, and pointed to a planned national licensing requirement in the sex work regulation bill.
Licensing, supervision and enforcement within the sex industry are local competences.
Vergunningverlening en toezicht en handhaving binnen de seksbranche zijn lokale bevoegdheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat er duizenden nieuwe opvangplekken nodig zijn voor asielzoekers

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary and Minister about reports that thousands of new asylum reception places were needed, questioning the earlier closure of reception centres, the absence of reserve capacity, waiting times and municipal responsibility. The government replied that capacity planning is under consultation with municipalities and provinces, that flexible reception forms are being developed, and that the IND is recruiting staff, while giving only partial data on waiting times and housing.
At this moment the IND is (still) not able to extract the waiting times from the systems.
Op dit moment is de IND (nog) niet in staat om de wachttijden uit de systemen te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Den Boer en Verhoeven over paspoorthandel op Malta

Three D66 MPs asked the government about passport sales in Malta, including whether they enable crime, the role of the Maltese state, AIVD warnings, and Dutch positions in the EU. The government answered that Malta conducts due diligence but this is no guarantee, that it sees such sales as undesirable but that citizenship remains national competence, that it will await an EU Commission process before dialogue, and that the Dutch investor residence scheme will be reviewed for added value.
As indicated in the answer to question 6, it is wise to await the outcome of these Commission initiatives and then engage in dialogue, preferably at EU level, on these schemes.

Zoals in de beantwoording van vraag 6 is aangegeven, is het verstandig om de uitkomst van deze initiatieven van de Commissie af te wachten en op basis daarvan de dialoog – bij voorkeur op EU-niveau – over genoemde regelingen aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Weverling over de artikelen ‘Asielzoekers uit veilige landen terroriseren Harderwijk’ en ‘Harderwijk is diefstallen door asielzoekers beu’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Weverling asked about press reports of crime by asylum seekers from safe countries in Harderwijk, their nationalities, unknown-destination departures, and returns. The State Secretary declined to address Harderwijk specifically, gave national figures showing nearly half of suspects were from Algeria and Morocco, and described efforts to improve returns, including conditional cooperation with origin countries.
Each year I inform the House about incidents through the incident overview in the Aliens Chain Report (RVK).
Jaarlijks informeer ik uw Kamer over incidenten door middel van het incidentenoverzicht in de Rapportage Vreemdelingenketen (RVK).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Laatste aso AZC in Nederland sluit deuren'

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the closure of the last extra supervised reception location (EBTL) for troublesome asylum seekers, the safety of reception, union involvement, the number of safe-country asylum applicants, and the pilot's costs. The State Secretary answered that talks with the municipality of Hoogeveen on alternative reception are ongoing, that a WODC evaluation is expected soon, and gave cost and intake figures while declining to give a firm date or number of relocations yet.
As soon as I know the outcome of this, I will inform your House.
Zodra ik de uitkomst hiervan weet, zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Paternotte over de Kerncijfers asiel en migratie, juni 2019

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about language provision for asylum seekers from several countries (Yemen, Syria, Eritrea, Turkey, Iran, Iraq), the link to long IND waiting times, and whether same-day language lessons are possible as the coalition agreement promises. The State Secretary answered that Syrians, Eritreans and stateless people already receive NT2 lessons at procedure centres, that the eligible group will be widened by 1 January 2020 based on recognition rates and numbers, and that the Flexibilisering Asielketen programme is developing a framework to prioritise likely-admissible claims.
As soon as possible for implementation, and at the latest by 1 January 2020, the group of asylum seekers who receive an offer will be updated.
Zo snel als mogelijk voor de uitvoering, uiterlijk per 1 januari 2020 wordt de doelgroep van asielzoekers die een aanbod krijgen, geactualiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Staatloze asielzoeker hoopt op uitweg uit niemandsland’

A D66 MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a Council of State ruling that a residence permit under the outside-fault policy (buitenschuldbeleid) cannot be refused merely because the DT&V issued no positive advisory opinion, and how requirements for stateless applicants are clarified. The State Secretary accepted the ruling, announced a change to the Vreemdelingencirculaire allowing the DT&V to issue a reasoned advisory report, and gave statistics on stateless applicants while declining to discuss individual cases.
The decision must state reasons for the extent to which the foreign national meets the conditions for granting a residence permit under the outside-fault policy.
In de beschikking dient te worden gemotiveerd in hoeverre de vreemdeling aan de voorwaarden voor verlening van een verblijfsvergunning op grond van het buitenschuldbeleid voldoet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Jasper van Dijk, Van Toorenburg, Groothuizen en Bisschop over het bericht dat een medewerker bij de IND door zijn leidinggevende onder druk werd gezet om zijn eigen dossi

MPs asked whether internal IND emails showing a supervisor discussing 'constructions' around asylum decisions contradict the De Leeuw commission's finding of no directed instructions to break rules, and whether further investigation, contact with ministry officials, and a meeting with the whistleblower are warranted. The State Secretary replied that the emails were included in the commission's research, found no reason for further investigation or doubt about the report's reliability or independence, declined to discuss individual personnel matters citing privacy, and saw no reason to meet the whistleblower.
I therefore see no reason for additional investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding voor een aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Emiel van Dijk over extra druk op de woningmarkt door nieuwe vluchtelingenstroom

Two PVV MPs asked whether the arrival of refugees adds pressure on the housing market and whether statushouders should be denied housing that Dutch citizens need. The minister answered that housing is allocated without nationality distinctions, that municipalities set urgency categories locally, and that pilots with flexible housing solutions are being funded.
No distinction is made in the Netherlands on the basis of nationality.
In Nederland wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over het artikel "De uit zee opgepikte migranten moeten wel ergens van boord kunnen, waarschuwen Nederlandse reders"

MPs Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked about reports that rescued migrants struggle to disembark, a hijacked merchant ship, and EU Operation Sophia, and asked for measures on safe ports and safety. The government answered that it has no such figures, supports calls for safe ports and a structural EU disembarkation solution, and noted that Sophia's mandate targets smuggling rather than rescue and was extended unchanged for six months.
The cabinet does not have such figures.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over dergelijke cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over de kosten van Nederlanders met een (niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify the costs of (non-Western) immigrant-background residents across justice and security spending, and to say how it compares with revenues from fees. The minister answered that police, terrorism, prison, and immigration services do not record costs or outcomes by migration background, so the requested breakdowns and estimates cannot be provided.
Data on the costs of police deployment with regard to citizens with a (non-Western) migration background are not available.
Gegevens over de kosten van de inzet van politie ten aanzien van burgers met een (niet westerse) migratieachtergrond, zijn niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de situatie op en rond de Middellandse Zee

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about migrants rescued at sea being sent to a bombed Libyan detention centre, Italy's law fining rescuers, and the EU Sophia mission and Macron's migration mechanism. The government confirmed the Tajoura transfers, said it urged Libya to stop taking rescued people there and to open safer centres, noted the EU extended Sophia's mandate, said it was too early to assess the Italian law, and reported no tangible progress on a temporary relocation mechanism.
The Ministry of Internal Affairs of the UN-backed Government of National Accord decided on 1 August to close three detention centres, including the Tajoura centre.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse zaken van de door de VN gesteunde regering van het Nationale Akkoord (GNA), heeft op 1 augustus jl. besloten drie detentiecentra te sluiten, waaronder het centrum in Tajoura.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Schonis en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Italy holds Netherlands, EU ‘responsible’ for migrant boat’

MPs asked the government about Italy holding the Netherlands and the EU responsible for migrants aboard the Sea-Watch 3, about Dutch obligations under the SAR convention, and about progress on a structural EU solution for disembarkation. The minister answered that Netherlands requested a port and asked the Commission to coordinate, that primary SAR responsibility lies with the state of the rescue zone, that no structural solution has yet been found, and that the government keeps pressing for one.
The cabinet will continue to press for a mechanism in which as large a group as possible, if not all member states, takes its responsibility.
Het kabinet zal blijven aandringen op een mechanisme waarin een zo groot mogelijke groep, zo niet alle lidstaten, haar verantwoordelijkheid neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik, Voordewind en Kuiken over het artikel ‘De uit zee opgepikte migranten moeten wel ergens van boord kunnen, waarschuwen Nederlandse reders’

MPs asked the government about shipowners' difficulties finding safe ports for rescued migrants in the Mediterranean, the suspension of EU naval mission Sophia, disembarkation platforms in North Africa, and Libya returns. The government agreed safe ports are needed, said a causal link to Sophia cannot be established, noted some North African ports have accepted rescued migrants, and pointed to ongoing EU negotiations and an informal JHA Council without a concrete mechanism.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma en Diertens over de situatie op Curaçao

MPs Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma and Diertens asked about the situation on Curaçao, including the Article 3 ECHR protection procedure, detention conditions for Venezuelan migrants, border and drug and arms smuggling controls, and funding. The government answered that the procedure was revised and adopted, that detention upgrades are being funded, and that border controls and support measures are being strengthened, while stressing that law enforcement is Curaçao's autonomous responsibility.
It is primarily up to the country of Curaçao to ensure that the procedure is properly implemented and to ensure that effective legal remedies and the necessary capacity exist.

Het is primair aan het land Curaçao om erop toe te zien dat op goede wijze invulling wordt gegeven aan de procedure en zorg te dragen voor het bestaan van effectieve rechtsmiddelen en de daarbij benodigde capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Ojik over garantstelling sprekers De Balie

GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether the IND's demand for a financial guarantee for Turkish and Sri Lankan guest speakers at De Balie hinders free public debate, and whether such demands could be dropped for debate-centre invitees. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said EU Schengen visa rules allow a guarantee as one way to show sufficient means, and argued the motion on event security does not override those rules.
I cannot, however, go into the individual case, also for reasons of protecting personal data.
Ik kan evenwel niet op de individuele casus ingaan, ook om redenen van bescherming van persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de hoogte van leges voor een Kinderpardon-aanvraag

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the €164 fee for a Kinderpardon (Afsluitingsregeling) application is proportionate and whether affordability for less wealthy applicants should matter or be investigated. The State Secretary answered that the fee was set at a reduced level, tied to the 2013 regulation and indexed, that the IND offered case-by-case flexibility for those unable to pay, and that affordability was a factor, but no further investigation into the fee's effect on applicants would be undertaken.
I do not intend to conduct further research into the affordability of the fees.
Ik ben niet voornemens verder onderzoek in te stellen naar de betaalbaarheid van de leges.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de opvang van Venezolaanse migranten

An MP asked whether the 23.8 million euro Dutch funding for Aruba and Curaçao concerning Venezuelan migrants is mainly spent on deterrence and detention, how much goes to asylum procedure and reception, and whether a share should fund fair treatment. The State Secretary answered that 7.2 million is reserved for optimising the migration chain and that migration policy is an autonomous matter of the Caribbean countries, with reception funded for vulnerable groups such as trafficking victims.
The starting point for Dutch support to the countries is that, in line with the constitutional relations within the Kingdom, responsibility for migration policy is an autonomous matter.

Uitgangspunt voor de Nederlandse ondersteuning aan de landen is dat conform de staatsrechtelijke verhoudingen binnen het Koninkrijk de verantwoordelijkheid voor het migratiebeleid een autonome aangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Mediterranean will be 'sea of blood' without rescue boats, UN warns’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about a UN warning that the Mediterranean would become a 'sea of blood' without rescue boats, and about related asylum trends and deaths at sea. The government answered that causal links between NGO rescue ships and drowning are hard to show, that the EU is discussing disembarkation and longer-term measures, and that Operation Sophia's mandate does not include rescue.
Such causal links are difficult to demonstrate.
Dergelijke oorzakelijke verbanden zijn lastig aan te tonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘Nederland nog niet akkoord met migrantendeal’

SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Justice Minister and State Secretary about reports that the Netherlands had not agreed to a Franco-German plan for rapid assessment and distribution of migrants arriving in Europe, and about alternatives such as regional reception facilities. The State Secretary referred to the informal JHA council report, saying the talks produced no temporary mechanism acceptable to the cabinet, and that it will keep pushing for shared responsibility including arrival states and a border procedure; she added there is no EU majority for externalised asylum procedures.
The cabinet will continue to press for a mechanism in which as large a group as possible, if not all member states, takes its responsibility, including the arrival states.
Het kabinet zal blijven aandringen op een mechanisme waarin een zo groot mogelijke groep, zo niet alle lidstaten, haar verantwoordelijkheid neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over een nieuw Europees migratieplan over bootmigranten

PVV MPs asked whether fourteen member states agreed to an EU plan to redistribute migrants rescued by NGOs, whether the government would keep its promise not to take in such migrants again, and whether it would stop participating in such plans and impose an asylum stop. The State Secretary answered that few member states are actually considering the mechanism, that the Netherlands will in principle not join ad hoc solutions, and that the duty to rescue at sea remains, while refusing an asylum stop as contrary to international obligations.
For brevity I refer your House to the letter of 14 January. It does not state that the cabinet will never again take in migrants from ships like the Sea Watch-3.
Kortheidshalve verwijs ik uw Kamer naar de brief van 14 januari jl. Daarin wordt niet gesteld dat het kabinet nooit meer migranten over zal nemen van schepen als de Sea Watch-3.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Opvangkampen op Samos een hel: dit niet eerder gezien’

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked the state secretary about reports of overcrowded and inhumane camps on Samos, including lack of electricity, water and toilets, long asylum waiting times, and EU funding and NGO support. The government acknowledged the problems, said Greece bears primary responsibility, and pointed to Dutch expert support and the new Greek government's priorities without committing to new funding.
Progress on this support will be reported to your House separately.
Over de voortgang van deze steun wordt uw Kamer separaat geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over het bericht dat stelende asielzoekers in Ter Apel de gedupeerde ondernemers uit eigen zak gaan compenseren

PVV MPs asked whether the state should compensate shopkeepers robbed by asylum seekers in Ter Apel, with asylum seekers' living allowance withheld to repay damages, and asked for a detailed overview of crimes by asylum seekers by location. The Secretary of State defended a pilot letting SODA recover indirect damages from asylum seekers' living allowance, declined to provide a per-location, per-offence breakdown, and deferred on the parliamentary work visit.
I am considering how a next incident overview will be structured.
Ik beraad mij op de wijze waarop een volgend incidentoverzicht zal worden vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Oeigoeren in Europese landen worden onder druk gezet door de Chinese overheid’

Two D66 MPs asked the government whether reports that Uyghurs in Europe, including the Netherlands, are pressured and intimidated by Chinese authorities are true, and what protection, asylum figures, extradition practice and diplomatic action exist. The government confirms that such pressure is reported and calls unwanted foreign interference unacceptable, lists available protective tools and recent diplomatic efforts, but gives no statistics on Uyghur asylum applications (sensitive data) and no concrete new action.
Therefore this data is not registered in a way that makes it possible to generate an answer to this question from the automated information systems of the migration chain.
Daarom worden deze gegevens niet geregistreerd op een manier die het mogelijk maakt om een antwoord op deze vraag te genereren vanuit de geautomatiseerde informatiesystemen van de migratieketen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Groothuizen over de toepassing van de nieuwe werkinstructie voor de beoordeling van lhbti’s en bekeerlingen

MPs Voordewind and Groothuizen asked the State Secretary about criticism from COC and Stichting Gave of the IND's new guidelines for assessing LGBTI and convert asylum claims, including use of 'self-acceptance' criteria, stereotyping, third-party statements, passive conversion and expectations about religious study. The State Secretary largely rejected the criticism, stating the guidelines are applied correctly, that the concepts were dropped but may still arise, and that existing cases need not be reassessed except via new facts or the motion-based repeat-application route.
However, I do not rule out that errors are occasionally made.
Ik sluit echter niet uit dat er af en toe fouten worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, Fritsma en Wilders over de steekpartij op klaarlichte dag bij het  asielzoekerscentrum in Arnhem

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether the suspect in a stabbing at the Arnhem asylum centre had been detained and deported, whether the centre should close, and whether a full asylum stop should be introduced. The state secretary declined to discuss individual cases, described existing COA measures and cooperation with police, rejected closing the centre, and rejected an asylum stop.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u bekend ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Wilders en Emiel van Dijk over het aantal personen met een migratieachtergrond

MPs Fritsma, Wilders and Van Dijk asked how many people with a non-Western migration background live in the Netherlands, whether third and fourth generations should be counted, whether dual nationality registration should be reinstated, and whether diversity is obscured by current categories. The minister answered with CBS figures (about 2.31 million, 13.4%), said estimating deeper generations is not policy-relevant, declined to reinstate nationality registration citing the Wet BRP conclusion that no obstacles had arisen, and disagreed that the categories hide diversity.
I also see no policy reason to make estimates of how many persons have at least one of their four grandparents, or even one of their eight great-grandparents, originating from abroad.

Ik zie verder ook geen beleidsmatige reden om schattingen te maken van hoeveel personen minstens één van de vier grootouders, of zelfs één van de acht overgrootouders, afkomstig is uit een buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ojik over het bericht "Deportaties in Turkije: 'Ze hebben hem naar Syrië gestuurd'"

MP Van Ojik asked the government about reports that Turkey deports Syrian refugees to unsafe areas, whether the EU-Turkey deal is still in force and whether EU funds should be conditioned on stopping such deportations. The State Secretary replied that the government has no indication of a structural deportation policy, that non-refoulement binds Turkey, that the deal still operates, that EUR 5.6 billion has been committed with EUR 3.45 billion contracted, and that Nederland raises the issue bilaterally without committing to conditioning funds.

As reported in the answer to the questions from MP Groothuizen (D66) on 'Deportations in Turkey: They sent him to Syria', there is currently no reason to assume a structural policy of deporting Syrian refugees from Turkey.

Zoals gemeld in de beantwoording van de vragen van het lid Groothuizen (D66) over «Deportaties in Turkije: «Ze hebben hem naar Syrië gestuurd»», is er op dit moment geen aanleiding om aan te nemen dat er sprake is van een structureel beleid om Syrische vluchtelingen uit Turkije uit te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het  bericht “Deportaties in Turkije: ‘Ze hebben hem  naar Syrië gestuurd’”

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the government about reports that Turkey deported Syrian refugees to Syria, a country not considered safe, and about the implications for the EU-Turkey agreement and for Greek arrivals. The State Secretary answered that Turkey claims returns are voluntary, that about 340,000 Syrians have returned, that international partners could not confirm structural forced returns though a few individual cases suggest involuntary returns, and that no direct link to Greek arrivals can be concluded.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the developments.
Nederland blijft de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over een ontsnapte vreemdeling uit detentiecentrum Rotterdam

PVV MPs asked how a migrant could escape from the Rotterdam detention centre, what would prevent recurrence, his nationality and criminal record, whether he had been returned, and how many escapes had occurred over the past decade. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, said an internal investigation was ordered into the escape, reported that he remains wanted, and gave a table showing 8 escapes and 23 other withdrawals since 2009.
The Security and Integrity bureau of the Custodial Institutions Agency has been instructed to investigate how the escape took place and how a repetition can be prevented.

Het bureau Veiligheid en Integriteit van de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen heeft de opdracht gekregen te onderzoeken hoe de ontvluchting plaats heeft kunnen vinden en hoe een herhaling kan worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de uitzetting van de heer Isbatov

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the deportation of an asylum seeker to Azerbaijan who was reportedly arrested there, including whether his arrest related to political activities and whether the IND's political-asylum assessments are adequate. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, said the Dutch asylum procedure is careful, saw no need for concrete improvements, and noted that no statistics on political asylum motives are registered.
As your House is aware, I cannot make statements about individual cases in connection with the privacy of the person concerned.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend, kan ik in verband met de privacy van de betrokken persoon geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het landgebonden asielbeleid

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about asylum policy for Sudan, Iran, Afghanistan and Russia, including LHBTI risks, child-related conditions and alternatives to protection. The State Secretary answered that a new Sudan report is expected in October 2019, reclassified gay men from Iran as a risk group, rejected the demand that gay people hide their orientation, and explained that children are not a designated risk group but are assessed individually.
With my letter of 1 July 2019 I sent you my response to the latest general country report on Afghanistan.
Met mijn brief van 1 juli 2019 heb ik u mijn reactie toegestuurd op het laatste algemene ambtsbericht over Afghanistan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Hungary depriving asylum seekers of food- Council  of Europe’

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether Hungary's treatment of asylum seekers, reported as food deprivation, also breaches international law such as the Refugee Convention, whether this has been raised in other fora, and whether Hungary has a duty of care and what aid options exist. The government answered that parts of Hungarian asylum policy conflict with international obligations, that the Commission has started infringement procedures and the Article 7 process covers fundamental rights, that it will keep raising concerns bilaterally and in the EU, and that it awaits the outcomes of the infringement procedures before further steps, with no specific aid discussed in the Council of Europe.
The cabinet awaits the outcomes of the infringement procedures before taking any new steps.
Het kabinet wacht de uitkomsten van de inbreukprocedures af alvorens nieuwe stappen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Honderd Cubanen lopen illegale mars voor homorechten: 'Historisch moment'’
