MPs Groothuizen and Bergkamp asked about reports that Cuban police arrested demonstrators at an unauthorised LGBTI rights march, and whether this changes the Dutch policy that LGBTI Cubans can generally return safely, including questions on monitoring, Cuban returnees, asylum statistics and a new country report. The government regrets the arrests and violence, says there is no reason to change policy since discrimination is not systematic enough to amount to persecution, will raise the issue with Cuban authorities, and holds that sufficient reliable information exists so no new thematic country report is needed.
I therefore cannot confirm these reports.
Ik kan berichtgeving hierover dan ook niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het uitblijven van een wetsvoorstel rond het vaststellen van staatloosheid

An MP asked why the planned bill on establishing statelessness, promised for spring 2018 and scheduled for Q1 2019, had still not been submitted, and asked about the estimated number of stateless persons and support for municipalities. The State Secretary said the bill is still in preparation and will be reported on after the summer, disputed the 8,000 estimate as not based on established data, and offered to discuss municipal problems with VNG.
Contrary to what was hoped, the submission date previously communicated to your House was not met.
Anders dan gehoopt is het eerder aan uw Kamer gecommuniceerde moment van indiening niet gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht dat jonge vrouwen die Saoedi-Arabië ontvluchten om een gedwongen huwelijk en seksueel misbruik te voorkomen

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister and justice state secretary about reports that two young Saudi women fleeing forced marriage were refused boarding in Georgia, whether they would be admitted, and what the government was doing on Saudi women's rights. The minister said the reports could not be confirmed, no visa application was made, asylum for such women runs only through UNHCR resettlement, and that Nederland repeatedly raises women's rights bilaterally and in the EU and UN.
Because of the small numbers, it is not possible for privacy and technical reasons to state what the asylum motives are.
Vanwege de kleine aantallen is het om privacy technische redenen niet mogelijk aan te geven wat de asielmotieven zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de problemen inzake het asielbeleid

Baudet (FvD) asks the state secretary for Justice and Security about alleged failures of asylum policy, including mass immigration, asylum backlogs, penalty payments, criminality and safety in reception centres, Syrian residence permits, illegal residents, pardons and border controls. The state secretary rejects the claim of a failing asylum policy, answers most questions in general terms, withholds or does not provide several figures, and points to ongoing reviews and the integrated migration agenda.
No, I do not acknowledge that there is a failing asylum policy.
Nee, dat er sprake is van een falend asielbeleid erken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Markuszower en Wilders over de statushouder die een 68 jarige vrouw doodmartelde

MPs from the PVV asked whether the statushouder (refugee status holder) suspected of a fatal assault on a 68-year-old woman would have his residence permit revoked and be deported, how screening failed to catch him, and whether asylum seekers and migrants from Islamic countries should be barred. The minister replied that individual cases are not discussed, outlined the screening and monitoring process, said revocation is limited by EU and refugee-convention rules and that the government will not categorically close borders.
In principle I make no statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik in beginsel geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat Middelburg stelende asielzoekers beu is

Fritsma (PVV) asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security how thieving asylum seekers can still operate freely despite government pledges, and why asylum admissions are not halted, asylum centres closed and criminal asylum seekers removed. The State Secretary points to a package of measures including a person-focused approach, rejects a total asylum stop as unrealistic, and argues that 2019 removal figures cannot yet be compared because departures lag decisions.
The cabinet endeavours to limit risks to public order as much as possible and to promote safety.
Het kabinet spant zich ervoor in ervoor risico's voor de openbare orde zo veel mogelijk te beperken en de veiligheid te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de uitvoering van de gewijzigde motie over een jaarlijkse rapportage over migratie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether she recalled promising an annual report on progress under the cabinet's migration agenda, and when the report would arrive, including whether it could be sent a month before the budget debate. The State Secretary confirmed the promise, agreed that sending it a month before the budget debate is valuable, and said the report will be sent as soon as possible after the summer recess.
Your House will receive the annual report as soon as possible after the summer recess.
Uw Kamer ontvangt de jaarlijkse rapportage zo snel mogelijk na het zomerreces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Dissidenten uit Hongkong krijgen voor het eerst asiel in Duitsland’

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign and justice ministers about Hong Kong's proposed extradition law to China, its risks for Dutch citizens and firms, and German asylum grants to Hong Kong dissidents. The government said it had raised concerns with Hong Kong's leader and the EU, that the law was suspended, and that asylum decisions do not reflect on the rule of law in the country of origin.
The cabinet will closely follow developments and, if necessary, consider what the consequences should be for cooperation with Hong Kong on the surrender of fugitive offenders.

Het kabinet zal de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet blijven volgen en zal zo nodig bezien wat de eventuele gevolgen zouden moeten zijn voor de samenwerking met Hongkong op het gebied van overlevering van voortvluchtige delinquenten.
